papers.title: Programmable Microgel Degradation in Dynamic Granular Hydrogels Guides Extracellular Matrix Assembly During Tissue Repair
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Granular hydrogels have attracted widespread interest for wound healing applications, yet their static design, in which microstructure and void space remain fixed, contrasts with the dynamic nature of tissue repair where processes like provisional extracellular matrix (pECM) assembly, cell organization, and nascent tissue formation evolve over time. Here, this disparity is addressed by designing dynamic granular hydrogels that are modularly assembled using microgels with pre‐programmed and precise degradation rates ranging from a few days to several weeks. Microgel degradation is controlled via modulation of hydrolytic susceptibility of hyaluronic acid polymers. The biological significance of timed pore expansion in dynamic granular hydrogels is investigated in a mouse muscle crush injury model. While slow‐degrading hydrogels support a distinct spatial assembly of cell‐instructive interstitial matrix and basement membrane proteins in the expanded pore space, this pECM remodeling is adversely altered in non‐degrading or fast‐degrading hydrogels. Slow‐degrading dynamic granular hydrogels also show long‐term therapeutic benefits on muscle wound healing, evidenced by reduced fibrosis, enhanced myogenesis, and improved functional force recovery. Collectively, these striking results demonstrate the profound significance of incorporating dynamicity through controlled microgel degradation in advanced granular biomaterials to improve tissue repair outcomes.

papers.title_zh: 动态颗粒水凝胶中可编程微凝胶降解引导组织修复过程中的细胞外基质组装
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计具有预编程精确降解速率（数天至数周）的动态颗粒水凝胶，通过调控透明质酸水解敏感性实现定时孔道扩张，并在小鼠肌肉挤压伤模型中证明慢降解水凝胶促进细胞外基质空间组装与肌肉功能恢复。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对颗粒水凝胶静态设计（微观结构与空隙固定）与组织修复动态过程（临时细胞外基质组装、细胞组织化、新生组织形成随时间演化）之间的不匹配问题，提出用可编程降解微凝胶模块化组装动态颗粒水凝胶。微凝胶降解速率通过调节透明质酸聚合物的水解敏感性实现精确控制，范围从数天到数周。研究在小鼠肌肉挤压伤模型中考察定时孔道扩张的生物学意义，比较慢降解、非降解和快降解水凝胶对临时细胞外基质重塑的影响，并评估长期治疗效益。该工作意义在于将动态性通过受控微凝胶降解引入先进颗粒生物材料，以改善组织修复结果。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：通过调节透明质酸聚合物水解敏感性控制微凝胶降解；用预编程降解速率的微凝胶模块化组装动态颗粒水凝胶；在小鼠肌肉挤压伤模型中评估孔道扩张的生物学意义与长期治疗效益。摘要未报告具体表征手段、降解速率数值、力学测试方法及统计细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于自组装与动态孔道调控主线，其定时孔道扩张与细胞外基质空间组装概念对介孔/框架材料的孔道动态调控设计有类比启发价值，但材料体系为水凝胶而非MOF/COF/HOF或介孔无机材料，与导电框架主线关联较弱。若关注动态孔结构与生物界面组装可略读，否则不必全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；微凝胶具体降解速率数值、透明质酸修饰化学、孔道尺寸变化、动物模型细节、纤维化与肌生成定量指标及力学恢复数据均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 微凝胶降解速率可通过调节透明质酸水解敏感性预编程，范围从数天到数周
慢降解水凝胶在扩张的孔道空间中支持细胞指导性间质基质与基底膜蛋白的独特空间组装

papers.title: Modulating Bonding States and Stability of Conductive Coordination Polymers
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Conductive coordination polymers (CCPs) could combine the merits of both conductive polymers and metal‐organic frameworks (MOFs) and hence have attracted extensive attention for various applications. However, the modulation of their properties is challenging and rarely studied. Herein, three CCPs, denoted as Cu─6O, Cu─6N, and Cu─3O3N, featuring Cu─O 4 , Cu─(NH) 4 , and Cu─O 2 (NH) 2 units respectively, are constructed to systematically investigate the effect of the ligating atoms and bonding states on the properties. Spectroscopic and theoretical analyses reveal that Cu─O bonds are dominated by electrostatic interactions, whereas Cu─N bonds exhibit stronger covalent character, and the mixed Cu─O 2 (NH) 2 unit further enhances the overall bond strength by optimizing orbital hybridization and energy matching. Consequently, Cu─6O shows the weakest Cu─X (X═O or NH) bonds, poorest thermal stability and undergoes irreversible degradation upon base conditions at pH above ∼9.5, while also suffering severe structural degradation under electrochemical condition. The degradation mechanism was also revealed. Conversely, the stronger coordination bonds in Cu─6N and Cu─3O3N endow them with superior thermal, chemical, and electrochemical stability. This work highlights the essential role of ligating atoms in determining the bonding states and provides a design principle for developing robust CCPs.

papers.title_zh: 调控导电配位聚合物的成键状态与稳定性
papers.summary_zh: 研究构建三种配位原子不同的导电配位聚合物Cu─6O、Cu─6N和Cu─3O3N，结合光谱与理论分析揭示Cu─O以静电作用为主、Cu─N共价性更强，混合Cu─O2(NH)2单元优化轨道杂化与能量匹配，从而显著提升热、化学与电化学稳定性。
papers.research_details_zh: 导电配位聚合物（CCP）可兼具导电聚合物与MOF的优点，但其性质调控困难且研究较少。研究设计并构建三种CCP：Cu─6O、Cu─6N和Cu─3O3N，分别含Cu─O4、Cu─(NH)4和Cu─O2(NH)2单元，系统考察配位原子与成键状态对性质的影响。光谱与理论分析表明Cu─O键以静电相互作用为主，Cu─N键共价性更强，混合Cu─O2(NH)2单元通过优化轨道杂化与能量匹配进一步增强整体键强度。结果Cu─6O的Cu─X键最弱、热稳定性最差，在pH约9.5以上碱性条件发生不可逆降解，电化学条件下也严重结构降解，并揭示了降解机制；Cu─6N与Cu─3O3N因配位键更强而具更优热、化学与电化学稳定性。该工作强调配位原子对成键状态的决定作用，为开发稳健CCP提供设计原则。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：构建三种含不同Cu─O/Cu─N配位单元的CCP；采用光谱分析与理论分析研究成键状态；考察热稳定性、碱性条件（pH约9.5以上）化学稳定性及电化学条件下的结构稳定性，并揭示降解机制。摘要未报告具体光谱技术、理论计算方法、电化学测试条件及稳定性定量数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究直接关联导电MOF/配位聚合物主线的稳定性调控问题，配位原子与成键状态—稳定性关系为设计稳健导电框架提供可操作原则，对电化学合成与器件应用中的框架稳定性评估有参考价值。属核心推荐，值得全文精读以获取具体表征与降解机制细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；具体光谱表征手段、理论计算细节、电化学测试条件、稳定性定量数据及降解产物结构均需全文核查。

papers.title: Phenol-Driven Modulation Enables the Crystallization of Titanium Metal–Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Abstract Titanium-based metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) remain among the most challenging frameworks to synthesize due to the high reactivity of Ti(IV) precursors, particularly when in combination with strongly coordinating phenolate ligands. Phenol is an untapped modulator for MOF synthesis that enabled the formation of a new crystalline Ti-MOF phase, otherwise unattainable through established modulators. We show how transient Ti-phenolate species formed in solution regulate titanium coordination equilibria and demonstrate the broader applicability of phenol modulation for several reported Ti-MOF systems. As a result of phenol modulation, we isolate a previously elusive crystalline titanium ellagate sustainable MOF, TUW-11, composed of monometallic Ti(IV) centers and plant-derived ellagic acid linkers. Three-dimensional electron diffraction, synchrotron X-ray techniques, and scanning transmission electron microscopy reveal a layered microporous framework with 1.1 nm channels. TUW-11 exhibits a narrow band gap, p-type semiconducting behavior, and ligand-centered visible-light photoresponse. These findings demonstrate phenol modulation as a powerful strategy for controlling titanium-phenolate framework formation and expand the synthetic toolbox available for Ti-MOF discovery.

papers.title_zh: 苯酚驱动调控实现钛金属有机框架的结晶
papers.summary_zh: 研究首次将苯酚作为未开发的调控剂用于Ti-MOF合成，通过瞬态Ti-苯酚物种调节钛配位平衡，获得此前难以结晶的钛鞣花酸MOF TUW-11，其具1.1 nm通道、窄带隙、p型半导体行为及配体中心可见光响应。
papers.research_details_zh: 钛基MOF因Ti(IV)前驱体反应活性高、尤其与强配位酚盐配体结合时难以合成。研究提出苯酚作为未被利用的调控剂，利用溶液中形成的瞬态Ti-苯酚物种调节钛配位平衡，使原本通过既有调控剂无法获得的新的结晶Ti-MOF相得以形成，并证明苯酚调控对多个已报道Ti-MOF体系具有更广泛适用性。由此分离出此前难以获得的结晶钛鞣花酸可持续MOF TUW-11，由单金属Ti(IV)中心与植物来源鞣花酸连接体构成。三维电子衍射、同步辐射X射线技术与扫描透射电子显微镜揭示其层状微孔框架，具1.1 nm通道。TUW-11表现窄带隙、p型半导体行为及配体中心可见光光响应。该工作证明苯酚调控是控制钛-酚盐框架形成的有力策略，拓展了Ti-MOF发现的合成工具箱。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：以苯酚为调控剂进行Ti-MOF合成，利用瞬态Ti-苯酚物种调节配位平衡；采用三维电子衍射、同步辐射X射线技术和扫描透射电子显微镜解析结构；表征带隙、半导体类型及可见光光响应。摘要未报告具体合成温度/溶剂、带隙数值、电导率及光响应测试条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究关联MOF结晶调控与半导体框架主线，苯酚调控策略为高活性金属—强配位配体体系提供新合成工具，TUW-11的p型半导体与可见光响应提示其在光电应用的潜力。属核心推荐，值得全文精读以获取合成条件与结构—性能定量细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；具体合成条件、苯酚用量与瞬态物种证据、带隙数值、电导率、光响应测试条件及框架稳定性均需全文核查。

papers.title: Construction of Single-Atom Cobalt in Ordered Mesoporous Metal–Organic Frameworks for Boosting CO2 Conversion
papers.abstract: Abstract Constructing single-atom transition-metal-implanted mesoporous metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) for CO2 conversion is of great importance for achieving carbon neutrality, yet remains a formidable challenge. This work presents a modular optimization of cerium-based metal–organic frameworks by incorporating Co single atoms with ordered mesopores (OMCU). These periodically arranged mesopores in OMCU were fabricated by synergistically combining the Hofmeister effect with a soft-template structure-oriented strategy. Mechanistic investigations reveal that the Co single atoms could not only accelerate photogenerated electron participation in CO2 conversion but also lower the energy barrier by promoting the formation of a new intermediate, *OCHO, along a specific reduction pathway, as directly observed by in situ Raman and operando ATR-IR spectroscopy. Density functional theory calculations corroborate that Co atoms favor the generation of *OCHO-related intermediates, omitting the high energy input for CO2·– formation and resulting in outstanding CO2 reduction performance, which is equivalent to a 10.84-fold enhancement in CO generation rate compared to that of the pristine MOF in the presence of TEA and bipyridinium ruthenium. This work provides an effective strategy through the construction of active cobalt sites within ordered mesoporous cerium-based MOFs for modulating the key intermediates in CO2 photoreduction.

papers.title_zh: 在有序介孔金属有机框架中构建单原子钴以促进CO2转化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过Hofmeister效应与软模板导向策略协同，在铈基MOF中构建有序介孔并植入Co单原子，用于CO2光还原。Co单原子促进*OCHO中间体形成、降低能垒，使CO生成速率较原始MOF提升10.84倍。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对在介孔MOF中构建单原子过渡金属位点以提升CO2转化性能这一挑战，提出对铈基MOF进行模块化优化，将Co单原子与有序介孔（OMCU）结合。有序介孔的构筑采用Hofmeister效应与软模板结构导向策略协同实现。机理研究结合原位拉曼和operando ATR-IR光谱直接观测到Co单原子促进特定还原路径中新中间体*OCHO的形成，从而降低能垒；DFT计算进一步证实Co原子有利于生成*OCHO相关中间体，绕过CO2·–形成所需的高能量输入。在TEA和联吡啶钌存在下，OMCU的CO生成速率较原始MOF提升10.84倍。该工作为在有序介孔铈基MOF中构建活性钴位点以调控CO2光还原关键中间体提供了有效策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的合成策略为Hofmeister效应与软模板结构导向策略协同构筑有序介孔，并在铈基MOF中引入Co单原子。表征与机理研究采用原位拉曼光谱和operando ATR-IR光谱直接观测中间体，并结合密度泛函理论计算。性能测试为在TEA和联吡啶钌存在条件下的CO2光还原，以CO生成速率评价。摘要未报告具体合成条件、前驱体、表征参数及测试细节。

papers.title: Dynamically and Reversibly Functionalized Self-Assembled Platelets via Noncovalent Interactions
papers.abstract: Abstract The creation of polymeric assemblies with reconfigurable surface functionality remains a major challenge for programmable soft materials. Covalent modification strategies can provide stable functional materials, but often require harsh reaction conditions or irreversible bond formation. Here, we integrate noncovalent interactions with crystallization-driven self-assembly (CDSA) to construct polymer platelets with region-selective functionalization and controllable responsiveness under mild conditions. Polycaprolactone-based platelets bearing cyclodextrin, barbituric acid, or related recognition motifs were prepared and subsequently orthogonal modified with complementary fluorescent guests through host–guest interactions or hydrogen bonding. Confocal fluorescence microscopy confirmed platelet-localized dye incorporation, while competitive displacement and relabeling demonstrated reversible molecular loading and release without disrupting platelet structural integrity. This work establishes supramolecular modification of CDSA-based assemblies as a modular route to soft materials with controllable and reconfigurable molecular functionality under mild conditions.

papers.title_zh: 通过非共价相互作用对自组装片层进行动态可逆功能化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作将非共价相互作用与结晶驱动自组装结合，制备含环糊精、巴比妥酸等识别基元的聚己内酯片层，并通过主客体作用或氢键正交修饰荧光客体，实现温和条件下可逆分子负载与释放且不破坏片层结构。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对可重构表面功能的聚合物组装体这一可编程软材料难题，指出共价修饰虽稳定但常需苛刻条件或不可逆成键。作者将非共价相互作用与结晶驱动自组装（CDSA）结合，构建具有区域选择性功能化和可控响应性的聚合物片层。具体制备了含环糊精、巴比妥酸或相关识别基元的聚己内酯基片层，随后通过主客体相互作用或氢键以正交方式修饰互补荧光客体。共聚焦荧光显微镜确认染料定位于片层内；竞争置换与再标记实验证明分子负载与释放可逆，且不破坏片层结构完整性。该工作确立了基于CDSA组装体的超分子修饰作为温和条件下制备可控、可重构分子功能软材料的模块化途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的制备方法为结晶驱动自组装（CDSA），构建聚己内酯基片层并引入环糊精、巴比妥酸或相关识别基元。功能化采用主客体相互作用或氢键进行正交修饰。表征手段为共聚焦荧光显微镜确认染料定位，并通过竞争置换与再标记实验评估可逆负载与释放及结构完整性。摘要未报告具体聚合条件、片层尺寸表征及定量释放数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文属于自组装技术主线，展示CDSA制备聚合物片层并结合非共价识别实现可重构表面功能化，其区域选择性修饰与可逆负载—释放思路对框架材料/组装体的后修饰与动态功能化有方法学借鉴意义。局限在于体系为聚己内酯聚合物片层，非MOF/COF/HOF框架，且摘要未涉及导电性或电化学。与介孔导电框架主线关联较间接，可作为组装与超分子修饰的拓展阅读。

papers.title: Constructing the Transfer Ladder between Active Sites and Functional Units within the Cluster-Based Catalyst for Reductive Amination
papers.abstract: Abstract The remote communication between active sites and the surrounding environment within a heterogeneous catalyst for the orderly bonding of reactive species is highly desired yet very challenging. Here we find that the phosphotungstate with a mesoporous framework (abbreviated as mPTA) has an extraordinary ability to accommodate ammonia but has no activity for catalytic reductive amination, while the Pd3(S-Adm)3(PPh3)3+ (Pd3 for short; S-Adm = 1-adamantanethiol) cluster enables the above reaction but insufficient ammonia occurring on the cluster leads to low activity and inferior selectivity. We thereby construct a transfer channel between the active cluster (Pd3) and the functional unit (mPTA), which is identified as an interfacial ladder of Pd–O–W, delivering ammonia molecules from the functional unit to the active center. The mPTA resembles a pump source to supply ammonia to meet the requirement for the reductive amination over the cluster, in which ammonia hops the ladder to expediently react with H2 and carbonyl compounds awaiting on Pd sites, finally giving rise to remarkable performances with a high yield of amines. We recognize that the interactive cooperation of inner catalysis with peripheral input across two different compounds holds promise in decoupling and controlling complex chemical ecosystems for high-quality productivity.

papers.title_zh: 在簇基催化剂中构建活性位点与功能单元之间的传递阶梯用于还原胺化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作发现介孔框架磷钨酸盐（mPTA）能容纳氨但无还原胺化活性，Pd3簇有活性但氨供给不足；作者构建Pd–O–W界面阶梯作为传递通道，将氨从mPTA输送至Pd3活性中心，显著提高胺产率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对多相催化剂中活性位点与周围环境远程沟通以实现反应物种有序键合这一挑战。作者发现具有介孔框架的磷钨酸盐（mPTA）具有优异的氨容纳能力但对催化还原胺化无活性；而Pd3(S-Adm)3(PPh3)3+（Pd3）簇能催化该反应，但簇上氨不足导致活性低、选择性差。为此在活性簇Pd3与功能单元mPTA之间构建传递通道，鉴定为Pd–O–W界面阶梯，将氨分子从功能单元输送至活性中心。mPTA类似泵源，为簇上还原胺化供氨，氨经阶梯跃迁与等待在Pd位点的H2和羰基化合物反应，最终获得高胺产率的优异性能。作者认为这种内部催化与外围输入跨两种化合物的协同互动，有望用于解耦和调控复杂化学体系以实现高质量生产力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的材料体系为介孔框架磷钨酸盐mPTA与Pd3(S-Adm)3(PPh3)3+簇（S-Adm为1-金刚烷硫醇）。研究通过对比mPTA与Pd3单独及组合体系的催化表现识别功能分工，并鉴定Pd–O–W界面阶梯作为氨传递通道。性能评价为催化还原胺化，以胺产率和选择性衡量。摘要未报告具体合成步骤、表征手段及反应条件。

papers.title: Hierarchical Descriptor-Driven Machine Learning Reveals the Structure–Performance Landscape of Hydrogen-Bonded Organic Frameworks for CO 2 /N 2 Separation
papers.abstract: Abstract Hydrogen-bonded organic frameworks (HOFs) are emerging as promising adsorbents for postcombustion CO2 capture owing to their mild self-assembly, solution processability, and facile regeneration, yet the structural and chemical factors governing their separation performance remain poorly resolved. Here, we report an integrated computational workflow combining high-throughput GCMC simulation, interpretable machine learning, and atomistic mechanism analysis to evaluate 84,261 HOFs for CO2/N2 separation under simulated flue-gas conditions. After benchmarking against experimental isotherms, a hierarchical four-level descriptor set spanning geometric, thermodynamic, elemental, and chemical/electronic features was constructed. Among eight algorithms, XGBoost delivered the highest accuracy (R2 = 0.93), and both feature importance and SHAP analyses identified geometric and thermodynamic descriptors as the dominant determinants of selectivity. High-performance HOFs converge on a common signature of smaller pores, denser frameworks, and enriched polar hydrogen-bond-donating groups (amino and carboxyl moieties), which cooperatively strengthen framework-CO2 interactions and widen the CO2/N2 heat-of-adsorption gap. Three-dimensional density mapping and geometry-based hydrogen-bond statistics confirm that preferential framework-CO2 hydrogen bonding is the key microscopic driving force, whereas N2 remains uniformly dispersed and forms essentially no effective hydrogen bonds. This work provides a high-fidelity predictive model and transferable design rules that advance HOF-based CO2/N2 separation from isolated breakthroughs toward mechanism-guided systematic design.

papers.title_zh: 分层描述符驱动的机器学习揭示用于CO2/N2分离的氢键有机框架的结构—性能图景
papers.summary_zh: 该工作整合高通量GCMC模拟、可解释机器学习与原子机制分析，评估84261种HOF在模拟烟气条件下的CO2/N2分离性能，构建四级分层描述符集，XGBoost模型R2达0.93，并提炼出小孔、致密骨架与极性氢键给体基团协同增强选择性的设计规则。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对氢键有机框架（HOFs）在燃烧后CO2捕集中结构与化学因素如何决定分离性能尚不明确的问题，采用集成计算工作流对84261种HOFs在模拟烟气条件下进行CO2/N2分离评估。流程包括高通量GCMC模拟、可解释机器学习与原子尺度机制分析，并以实验等温线进行基准校验。随后构建涵盖几何、热力学、元素及化学/电子特征的四级分层描述符集，比较八种算法。研究意义在于将HOF基CO2/N2分离从孤立突破推进到机制引导的系统设计，提供高保真预测模型与可迁移设计规则。摘要未报告具体烟气温度、压力组成及HOF构建单元细节。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：高通量GCMC模拟评估CO2/N2分离；以实验等温线进行基准校验；构建几何、热力学、元素和化学/电子四级分层描述符集；比较八种机器学习算法并用XGBoost建模；采用特征重要性与SHAP分析；进行三维密度映射和基于几何的氢键统计。摘要未报告具体合成实验或表征手段。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文直接关联介孔/微孔框架材料的气体分离主线，以HOF自组装体系为对象，提供机器学习辅助的框架筛选与描述符设计思路，对理解孔结构、骨架密度与极性基团对CO2/N2选择性的协同作用有参考价值。其局限在于纯计算筛选，摘要未报告实验验证的吸附容量或循环稳定性，值得全文精读以核查描述符定义与模型适用边界。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；具体烟气条件、HOF构建单元、GCMC力场、数据集划分、实验等温线来源及模型泛化验证等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 在八种算法中XGBoost精度最高，R2=0.93。
特征重要性与SHAP分析表明几何和热力学描述符是选择性的主导决定因素。
高性能HOFs收敛于小孔、致密骨架及富集极性氢键给体基团（氨基和羧基）的共同特征，协同增强框架—CO2相互作用并拓宽CO2/N2吸附热差。

papers.title: Modulating Local Electronegativity in Covalent Organic Frameworks for Host–Guest Oxygen Reduction
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Developing high‐performance metal‐free electrocatalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction remains a major challenge in sustainable energy conversion. Herein, we report a host–guest chemistry strategy based on metal‐free covalent organic frameworks (COFs) to significantly enhance the catalytic performance. Unlike conventional COFs that focus primarily on linkage chemistry or heteroatom doping, our approach explicitly leverages molecular‐level design to create tailored binding pockets within the COFs pores, enabling high selectivity and strong interactions with O 2 . A series of fluorene‐based COF hosts with systematically tuned electronegativity are designed and synthesized to strengthen molecular recognition and binding toward oxygen via tailored electronic and structural environments. The optimized material achieves a remarkable half‐wave potential ( E 1/2 , vs. RHE) of 0.78 V, among the highest reported metal‐free COF‐based catalysts. This exceptional performance originates from enhanced host–guest recognition, which effectively facilitates O 2 adsorption while optimizing the stabilization and subsequent dissociation of key reaction intermediates on the active site. Through a combination of in situ characterization and theoretical calculations, these host–guest interactions promote the optimized adsorption of intermediates and accelerate reaction kinetics. This study provides a new paradigm for the design of high‐efficiency metal‐free electrocatalysts through precise molecular recognition, opening avenues for advanced catalytic systems beyond conventional approaches.

papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对可持续能源转化中高性能无金属氧还原电催化剂的需求，采用主客体化学策略，区别于传统COF侧重连接化学或杂原子掺杂的思路，明确利用分子级设计在COF孔道内构建定制结合口袋，以实现对O2的高选择性和强相互作用。设计并合成一系列芴基COF主体，系统调控其电负性，通过定制电子与结构环境增强对氧的分子识别与结合。优化材料实现0.78 V（vs. RHE）的半波电位。结合原位表征与理论计算，揭示主客体相互作用促进中间体优化吸附并加速反应动力学。意义在于为通过精确分子识别设计高效无金属电催化剂提供新范式。摘要未报告具体孔径、比表面积及稳定性数据。

papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；具体COF结构、电负性调控基元、原位表征手段、理论计算模型及稳定性测试等关键细节仍需全文核查。

papers.title: Hierarchically Porous Polyaniline Film via Interfacial Self-Assembly for Ultrafast Dual-Band Electrochromic Smart Window
papers.abstract: Abstract Dual-band electrochromic smart windows, capable of independently regulating visible and near-infrared solar radiation, offer an effective route toward reducing building/vehicle energy consumption. However, their practical implementation is often limited by slow switching kinetics, insufficient bistability, as well as challenges in fabricating polychromatic, uniform, and scalable electrochromic films with efficient ion and charge transport. Here, we report an interfacial self-assembly strategy to fabricate large-area polyaniline (PANI) thin films featuring a hierarchically porous architecture and thickness-dependent porosity gradient. The self-assembly process, driven by solvent exchange at the air–water interface and modulated by surfactant confinement, produces interconnected PANI nanoparticle networks with both in-plane hierarchical pores and out-of-plane structural gradation. This architecture facilitates electrolyte penetration and charge transport across the film thickness. As a result, the PANI films enable rapid and stable dual-band electrochromic modulation, exhibiting three distinct optical states (“bright”, “cool”, and “dark”) with independent control of visible and near-infrared transmittance. The assembled devices demonstrate fast response (coloration/bleaching times of 1.8/4 s at 633 nm and 1.2/3.6 s at 1200 nm), high coloration efficiency, and excellent optical bistability, together with effective indoor thermal regulation. These results establish interfacial self-assembly as a versatile approach for engineering functional polymer films for next-generation energy-efficient smart windows.

papers.title_zh: 界面自组装制备多级孔聚苯胺薄膜用于超快双波段电致变色智能窗
papers.summary_zh: 该工作采用界面自组装策略制备大面积多级孔聚苯胺薄膜，通过溶剂交换与表面活性剂限域形成面内多级孔和厚度方向孔隙梯度，实现可见与近红外独立调控的三态双波段电致变色，响应快且双稳态优异。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对双波段电致变色智能窗切换动力学慢、双稳态不足以及多色均匀可放大薄膜制备困难的问题，提出在空气—水界面利用溶剂交换驱动、表面活性剂限域调控的界面自组装策略，制备大面积聚苯胺薄膜。所得薄膜具有多级孔结构及随厚度变化的孔隙梯度，由互连的聚苯胺纳米颗粒网络构成，兼具面内多级孔与面外结构梯度。该结构有利于电解液渗透和跨膜厚电荷传输。薄膜可实现快速稳定的双波段电致变色调制，呈现亮态、冷态和暗态三种光学状态，可见与近红外透过率可独立控制。器件在633纳米和1200纳米处表现出快速着色/漂白响应、高着色效率和优异光学双稳态，并具备有效的室内热调控能力。该工作将界面自组装确立为面向下一代节能智能窗的功能聚合物薄膜工程化方法。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用空气—水界面溶剂交换驱动的界面自组装制备聚苯胺薄膜，并以表面活性剂限域调控组装结构。表征与测试涉及薄膜多级孔结构、面内孔与面外结构梯度的确认，以及电致变色性能测试：在633纳米和1200纳米处测定着色/漂白响应时间，评估着色效率、光学双稳态和三种光学状态的可见与近红外透过率调控，并演示室内热调控。具体表征手段与合成条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装技术与多级孔功能薄膜的交叉方向，对理解界面自组装调控孔隙梯度、电荷传输与电致变色性能的关系有直接参考价值，并可启发框架或聚合物薄膜的组装—传输—器件性能研究。其材料体系为聚苯胺而非MOF/COF/HOF，机制与框架材料组装关联有限；若关注多级孔薄膜组装与电化学器件，值得全文精读。

key_findings_zh: 界面自组装结合溶剂交换与表面活性剂限域，可制备大面积、多级孔且沿厚度方向具有孔隙梯度的聚苯胺薄膜。
薄膜实现亮态、冷态、暗态三种光学状态，可见与近红外透过率可独立调控。

papers.title: V‐Shaped Linkers Modulate Covalent Organic Frameworks' Interlayer Spacing for Efficient Iodine Capture
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Significantly enlarging and precisely regulating the interlayer spacing of two‐dimensional covalent organic frameworks (2D COFs) is both meaningful and challenging. Capitalizing on the weak conjugation effects inherent in flexible monomer assembly, this study proposes an interlayer regulation strategy for constructing 2D flexible COFs using dual‐flexible monomers. By introducing nonlinear V‐shaped linkers, we elucidated the core structure‐property relationship of “angle‐packing‐spacing” and established a novel assembly method for synthesizing highly crystalline 2D nonlinear COFs (NLCOFs). Crucially, the V‐shaped topology effectively suppresses interlayer π‐π stacking interactions, thereby enabling controllable expansion and precise tuning of COF interlayer spacing within the range of 4.2 Å to 4.5 Å. Moreover, fine‐tuning the included angle of linkers allows NLCOFs' structural optimization, allowing control over the adsorption and transport properties toward guest molecules such as iodine vapor and iodomethane. This work provides fundamental insights into the rational design of flexible crystalline COFs and establishes a potentially generalizable strategy for interlayer engineering.

papers.title_zh: V形连接基调控共价有机框架层间距用于高效碘捕获
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以双柔性单体和V形连接基构建高结晶二维非线性共价有机框架，利用V形拓扑抑制层间π-π堆积，将层间距精确调控在4.2至4.5埃，并据此调节对碘蒸气和碘甲烷的吸附与传输性能。

papers.title: Chemical Reaction‐Powered Self‐Assembly and Dehydration of Supramolecular Hydrogels for Phase‐Transitional Robots
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Phase‐transitional robots have long intrigued the scientists from multidisciplinary fields, yet their realization remains a formidable task due to the lack of soft materials that seamlessly integrate phase transition with actuation functionality. Here, we report phase‐transitional hydrogel robots enabled by chemical reaction‐powered supramolecular gelation of a peptide solution followed by a dehydration process. The peptide contains a carboxyl group which can be converted into hydrophobic oxazolone moiety upon addition of carbodiimide. This chemical transformation neutralizes the negative charge of the peptide, thereby activating its self‐assembly into a hydrogel. Interestingly, over time, the hydrogel network becomes more hydrophobic because of the progressive formation of hydrophobic oxazolone species, which in turn leads to dehydration‐induced macroscopic contraction of the hydrogel. The contraction degree can be regulated by changing the concentrations of carbodiimide. This sol‐to‐gel transition followed by actuation behavior enables phase‐transitional robots that can flow into complex terrains to catch and transport cargoes, showing extraordinary morphological adaptivity. As an application, we show that the robot can adaptively enter a narrow channel to regulate an electrical circuit. This work unlocks the potential of chemically fueled supramolecular self‐assembly for the development of phase‐transitional robots that show unparalleled morphological adaptivity and functionalities.

papers.title_zh: 化学反应驱动的超分子水凝胶自组装与脱水用于相变机器人
papers.summary_zh: 该工作利用碳二亚胺将肽中羧基转化为疏水噁唑酮，中和负电荷并驱动肽自组装成超分子水凝胶，随后疏水物种渐进形成引发脱水收缩，收缩程度可由碳二亚胺浓度调控，从而实现可流动、可抓取运输货物的相变机器人。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对相变机器人缺乏能无缝整合相变与驱动功能的软材料这一难题，提出以化学反应驱动的超分子凝胶化结合脱水过程构建相变水凝胶机器人。所用肽含羧基，加入碳二亚胺后羧基转化为疏水噁唑酮部分，化学转化中和肽的负电荷，从而激活其自组装形成水凝胶。随时间推移，疏水噁唑酮物种逐步形成使水凝胶网络疏水性增强，进而导致脱水诱导的宏观收缩。收缩程度可通过改变碳二亚胺浓度调控。这种溶胶—凝胶转变及随后的驱动行为使相变机器人能够流入复杂地形以抓取和运输货物，展现突出的形态适应性。应用演示中，机器人可自适应进入狭窄通道以调控电路。该工作释放了化学燃料驱动超分子自组装在相变机器人中的潜力，赋予其形态适应性与功能。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用含羧基肽溶液，通过加入碳二亚胺实现化学转化并驱动超分子自组装形成水凝胶，随后进行脱水过程；通过改变碳二亚胺浓度调控水凝胶收缩程度。功能演示包括机器人流入复杂地形抓取和运输货物，以及进入狭窄通道调控电路。摘要未报告具体肽序列、浓度、表征手段和力学测试方法。

papers.title: Micelles as a Confined Liquid: Standard and Two-Dimensional Kinetics of Solute Rotation in Surfactant Micelles
papers.abstract: Abstract The dynamics inside a surfactant micelle show clear confinement effects: solute rotation slows and develops a nonexponential relaxation. Multiple rate constants─rate dispersion─must be involved. These effects have been widely attributed to solutes confined to an outer layer of strongly ordered hydrocarbon chains, a layer similar to a Langmuir-Blodgett film. In this picture, confinement effects result from a surface phenomenon enhanced by the high surface area of a nanometer-sized particle. This paper presents results that are inconsistent with strong chain ordering. Varying the solute shows that most of the confinement-induced slowing is at the center of the micelle, not near its surface. Two-dimensional (two-relaxation-period) kinetics show that rate dispersion is mostly due to rate heterogeneity among different solute molecules. A homogeneous component of the stretched dynamics is also identified and is attributed to the coupling of the solute rotation with conformational relaxation of the hydrocarbon chains. In a picture consistent with these results, the micelle is unstructured, and the solutes are more widely distributed than in the conventional model. Confinement effects are not due to surface effects; they are due to the clash in the lengths of the hydrocarbon chain and the particle diameter. This study is enabled by a nonparametric, “data-first” approach that enhances the interpretation of kinetics, especially two-dimensional kinetics.

papers.title_zh: 胶束作为受限液体：表面活性剂胶束中溶质旋转的标准动力学与二维动力学
papers.summary_zh: 该文质疑胶束受限效应源于表面有序链层的传统观点，通过变溶质与二维动力学分析表明，受限减速主要发生在胶束中心，速率分散主要源于不同溶质分子间的速率异质性，并识别出与烃链构象弛豫耦合的均相组分。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于表面活性剂胶束内部溶质旋转的受限效应及其微观起源。传统模型将溶质旋转减慢和非指数弛豫归因于溶质被限制在类似Langmuir-Blodgett膜的高度有序外层烃链中，即一种由纳米颗粒高比表面积增强的表面现象。本文通过改变溶质分子考察受限减速的空间分布，并采用二维（双弛豫周期）动力学方法区分速率分散的来源。结果显示，大部分受限诱导的减速位于胶束中心而非表面附近；速率分散主要来自不同溶质分子之间的速率异质性，同时识别出一个均相拉伸动力学组分，并将其归因于溶质旋转与烃链构象弛豫的耦合。作者据此提出胶束内部无结构、溶质分布比传统模型更宽的图像，认为受限效应源于烃链长度与颗粒直径之间的不匹配，而非表面效应。该工作借助非参数化“数据优先”方法提升动力学尤其是二维动力学的解读能力，对理解软物质受限动力学具有方法学意义。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提到采用变溶质策略考察胶束内溶质旋转动力学，并应用二维（双弛豫周期）动力学分析区分速率分散来源；同时使用非参数化“数据优先”方法增强动力学数据解读。摘要未报告具体的表面活性剂种类、溶质分子结构、光谱技术、温度条件及定量拟合参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文属于自组装胶束体系中的受限动力学研究，与自组装技术主线相关，但并非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或框架材料电化学合成方向。其方法学价值在于二维动力学与“数据优先”分析策略，可启发框架孔道内客体动力学的异质性与耦合机制研究；对框架材料主线直接价值有限，若关注受限空间动力学表征方法可略读，否则不必精读全文。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；具体表面活性剂与溶质体系、表征手段、温度与浓度条件、二维动力学数据及定量参数均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 大部分受限诱导的溶质旋转减速发生在胶束中心，而非近表面区域，与传统表面有序层模型不一致。
二维动力学表明速率分散主要源于不同溶质分子间的速率异质性，并识别出与烃链构象弛豫耦合的均相拉伸动力学组分。
提出胶束内部无结构、溶质分布更宽的图像，受限效应归因于烃链长度与颗粒直径的不匹配而非表面效应。

papers.title: Nonfullerene Acceptor−Iridium Coordination Polymer as a Triplet Sensitizer for Efficient Organic Photovoltaics
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Utilizing triplet excitons has been recognized as a promising method to boost performances of organic solar cells (OSCs). Although long lifetime and diffusion length of triplet excitons have been observed in some systems, efficiencies of triplet‐sensitized OSCs are still moderate because of the lack of an efficient way to generate and transfer triplet excitons. In this study, we report a nonfullerene acceptor–iridium coordination polymer (BTP‐N‐Ir) as a triplet sensitizer in ternary OSCs for utilizing triplet excitons to improve photocurrents. The triplet polymer sensitizer shows a small singlet‐triplet energy gap, facilitating the generation of long‐lived triplet excitons, which transfer to an intra‐moiety excited (i‐EX) state of the acceptor in ternary films, dissociating into free charges to contribute photocurrents. Such a new triplet‐exciton transfer pathway with the i‐EX as an intermediate state is more effective than those in previous systems, leading to the highest efficiency of 20.37% for OSCs with a triplet sensitizer.

papers.title_zh: 非富勒烯受体-铱配位聚合物作为三线态敏化剂用于高效有机光伏
papers.summary_zh: 该文报道一种非富勒烯受体-铱配位聚合物BTP-N-Ir作为三元有机太阳能电池的三线态敏化剂，其小单-三线态能隙利于产生长寿命三线态激子，经受体分子内激发态中间态实现更有效的三线态激子转移与电荷解离，使器件效率达20.37%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是有机太阳能电池中三线态激子虽具长寿命和长扩散长度，但缺乏高效产生与转移三线态激子的途径，导致三线态敏化器件效率中等。材料体系为非富勒烯受体与铱配位形成的配位聚合物BTP-N-Ir，作为三线态敏化剂引入三元有机太阳能电池。设计策略利用该三线态聚合物敏化剂的小单-三线态能隙促进长寿命三线态激子产生，并使其转移至三元薄膜中受体的分子内激发态，该态作为中间态进一步解离为自由电荷贡献光电流。研究过程包括在三元薄膜中表征三线态激子向受体分子内激发态的转移路径，并评估其对光电流和器件效率的提升。意义在于提出以受体分子内激发态为中间态的新型三线态激子转移路径，较此前体系更有效，并实现含三线态敏化剂有机太阳能电池的最高效率20.37%，为利用三线态激子提升光伏性能提供配位聚合物敏化剂设计思路。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提到构建非富勒烯受体-铱配位聚合物BTP-N-Ir并作为三线态敏化剂制备三元有机太阳能电池薄膜与器件，评估三线态激子产生、向受体分子内激发态转移及电荷解离对光电流的贡献，并测试器件效率。摘要未报告具体合成步骤、表征技术、能隙数值、激子寿命及器件稳定性数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文涉及配位聚合物作为功能组分用于光电器件，与框架材料主线中的配位聚合物相关，但其结构为三线态敏化剂而非介孔或共轭框架，且不涉及电化学合成或自组装。对配位聚合物光电功能化有参考价值，对介孔导电MOF与框架电化学合成主线直接价值有限；若关注配位聚合物激子调控可读摘要，全文精读优先级较低。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；配位聚合物结构、合成条件、光物理表征、能隙与激子寿命数值及器件测试细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: BTP-N-Ir三线态聚合物敏化剂具有小单-三线态能隙，有利于产生长寿命三线态激子。
三线态激子转移至三元薄膜中受体的分子内激发态，并以该态为中间态解离为自由电荷贡献光电流。
该三线态激子转移路径较此前体系更有效，使含三线态敏化剂的有机太阳能电池效率达到20.37%。

papers.title: Coupling Ligand Tuning With Polymer‐Induced Aperture Regulation for Molecular Sieving in Flexible MOFs
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Framework flexibility fundamentally limits molecular sieving in many metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) by enlarging their effective pore apertures beyond crystallographic constraints. This challenge is pronounced in zeolitic imidazolate framework‐8 (ZIF‐8), where dynamic aperture expansion prevents CO 2 /N 2 size‐sieving despite an ideally positioned nominal aperture size. Here, we show that polymer infiltration enables in situ regulation of dynamic apertures, converting ZIF‐8 from a nonselective adsorbent into a CO 2 /N 2 molecular sieve. During mixed‐matrix membrane (MMM) formation, poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate (PEGDA) partially infiltrates ZIF cavities and suppresses framework dynamics, as supported by solid‐state NMR ( 1 H‐ 13 C HetCor) and spin–lattice relaxation. Consequently, the CO 2 /N 2 diffusion selectivity of ZIF‐8‐NH 2 with 6 mol% 2‐aminobenzimidazole increased from 0.58 (polymer‐free) to 26.6 within the polymer environment, enabling CO 2 /N 2 size sieving. Membranes with 20 wt% filler achieved a CO 2 permeability of 261.7 Barrer and a CO 2 /N 2 selectivity of 73.9. This strategy is generalizable to other flexible ZIFs, such as ZIF‐7 and ZIF‐67, establishing polymer infiltration as a simple and versatile route for controlling dynamic MOF apertures for effective gas separation.

papers.title_zh: 配体调控与聚合物诱导孔径调节耦合实现柔性MOF分子筛分
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对ZIF-8框架柔性导致动态孔径扩张、无法实现CO2/N2尺寸筛分的问题，利用PEGDA部分渗入ZIF空腔抑制框架动力学，使ZIF-8-NH2的CO2/N2扩散选择性由0.58提升至26.6，混合基质膜CO2渗透率达261.7 Barrer、选择性73.9。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于框架柔性会扩大MOF有效孔径、突破晶体学孔径限制，从而根本性限制分子筛分；ZIF-8虽名义孔径理想，但动态孔径扩张使其无法实现CO2/N2尺寸筛分。材料体系为ZIF-8及氨基功能化ZIF-8-NH2，并引入6 mol% 2-氨基苯并咪唑进行配体调控，同时以聚乙二醇二丙烯酸酯PEGDA作为聚合物渗入组分。设计策略是在混合基质膜形成过程中使PEGDA部分渗入ZIF空腔，抑制框架动力学，实现动态孔径的原位调节。研究通过固态NMR（1H-13C HetCor）和自旋-晶格弛豫表征支持PEGDA渗入与框架动力学抑制。结果使ZIF-8-NH2的CO2/N2扩散选择性从无聚合物时的0.58提高到聚合物环境中的26.6，实现CO2/N2尺寸筛分；含20 wt%填料的膜CO2渗透率为261.7 Barrer、CO2/N2选择性为73.9。该策略可推广至ZIF-7和ZIF-67等其他柔性ZIF，表明聚合物渗入是控制动态MOF孔径的简便通用途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提到配体调控引入6 mol% 2-氨基苯并咪唑，在混合基质膜形成过程中以PEGDA部分渗入ZIF空腔，采用固态NMR（1H-13C HetCor）和自旋-晶格弛豫表征框架动力学，并测试混合基质膜的CO2/N2扩散选择性与渗透选择性。摘要未报告膜制备详细条件、气体测试温度压力及长期稳定性数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文直接涉及MOF框架柔性与孔径调控，与框架材料主线高度相关，尤其对理解柔性MOF动态孔径抑制与分子筛分具有实际价值；其聚合物渗入策略可为框架孔道限域与复合膜设计提供参考。但该文不涉及介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，属拓展性参考；若关注柔性MOF气体分离与孔径调控，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；ZIF合成细节、PEGDA渗入量、NMR谱图证据、气体分离测试条件及膜稳定性等关键细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: PEGDA部分渗入ZIF空腔并抑制框架动力学，固态NMR与自旋-晶格弛豫结果支持该作用。
ZIF-8-NH2（6 mol% 2-氨基苯并咪唑）的CO2/N2扩散选择性由无聚合物时的0.58提升至聚合物环境中的26.6，实现CO2/N2尺寸筛分。
含20 wt%填料的混合基质膜CO2渗透率达261.7 Barrer、CO2/N2选择性达73.9。
该聚合物渗入策略可推广至ZIF-7和ZIF-67等其他柔性ZIF。

papers.title: HOMO‐Level Alignment as a Design Descriptor for Donor–Acceptor Covalent Organic Frameworks in Aqueous Zinc‐Iodine Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aqueous zinc–iodine batteries (ZIBs) offer high voltage and inherent safety, but face a persistent trade‐off among fast kinetics, long cycling stability, and high iodine loading. Donor–acceptor (D–A) covalent organic frameworks (COFs) have emerged as promising iodine hosts, yet the rational design is hindered by an unclear understanding of what truly governs charge‐transfer efficiency—with most studies empirically pursuing higher energy density without clear design rules. In this study, we establish highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) level alignment relative to iodine's redox potential as the governing descriptor for charge‐transfer efficiency. Analyzing a series of units with progressively elevated HOMO levels reveals a clear trend: higher HOMO levels enhance electron donation to iodine and promote charge transfer. The optimally designed NT‐COF, which combines a triphenylamine (TPA) donor with favorable HOMO alignment and a naphthalene diimide (NTCDI) acceptor with extended conjugation, exhibits the best electrochemical performance. Even with a high iodine loading (∼50.5 wt%), it delivers stable cycling and reliable low‐temperature operation. Spectroscopic and theoretical analyses confirm that the energetic alignment facilitates chemisorptive iodine anchoring, accelerates charge transfer, and suppresses polyiodide dissolution. This synergy confirms that rational COF design must combine energy‐level alignment with structural conjugation.

papers.title_zh: HOMO能级对齐作为供体-受体共价有机框架在水系锌碘电池中的设计描述符
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出以COF的HOMO能级相对碘氧化还原电位的对齐程度作为供体-受体COF电荷转移效率的调控描述符，并据此设计NT-COF，在高碘负载约50.5 wt%下实现稳定循环与低温运行，为COF碘宿主提供理性设计规则。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对水系锌碘电池中快速动力学、长循环稳定性与高碘负载难以兼得的矛盾，以及供体-受体COF作为碘宿主缺乏明确设计规则的问题，提出以最高占据分子轨道能级相对碘氧化还原电位的对齐程度作为电荷转移效率的主导描述符。作者分析了一系列HOMO能级逐步升高的构建单元，观察到HOMO能级越高越有利于向碘供电子并促进电荷转移的趋势。据此设计的最优NT-COF将具有有利HOMO对齐的三苯胺供体与具有扩展共轭的萘二酰亚胺受体相结合，获得最佳电化学性能。该工作将能级对齐与结构共轭并列为COF理性设计必须兼顾的两个要素，为供体-受体框架材料的分子级设计提供了可操作的描述符思路。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：对一系列HOMO能级递升的构建单元进行比较分析；合成以三苯胺为供体、萘二酰亚胺为受体的NT-COF；电化学性能测试（循环稳定性、低温运行、高碘负载条件）；光谱分析与理论分析，用于验证能级对齐对碘化学吸附、电荷转移及多碘化物溶解抑制的作用。具体合成条件、表征手段种类与测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF的理性设计主线，将分子轨道能级对齐引入框架材料设计描述符体系，对供体-受体COF在电化学储能中的应用具有方法学参考价值。其局限在于摘要仅给出单一最优体系与定性机制描述，缺乏系列材料的定量构效对比数据。鉴于设计规则清晰且涉及高负载与低温等边界条件，值得全文精读以核查能级调控与性能关联的完整证据链。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读。COF的具体合成条件与溶剂体系、表征技术细节、HOMO能级的数值范围、电化学测试参数（电流密度、容量保持率、循环圈数、低温温度）、多碘化物抑制的直接证据及理论计算细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: HOMO能级相对碘氧化还原电位的对齐程度被确立为供体-受体COF电荷转移效率的主导描述符，HOMO能级升高可增强向碘的电子供给并促进电荷转移。
最优NT-COF结合三苯胺供体与萘二酰亚胺受体，在约50.5 wt%的高碘负载下仍实现稳定循环和可靠的低温运行。
光谱与理论分析表明，能级对齐促进碘的化学吸附锚定、加速电荷转移并抑制多碘化物溶解。
合理的COF设计需同时兼顾能级对齐与结构共轭，二者协同决定性能。

papers.title: Regioselective Growth of Mesoporous Metal–Organic Frameworks for the Construction of Anisotropic Nanohybrids
papers.abstract: Abstract Mesoporous anisotropic nanohybrids (m-ANHs) have attracted growing interest because their structural asymmetry enables unique advantages in applications such as multidrug co-delivery and cascade catalysis. However, anisotropic growth in mesoporous systems has thus far been largely confined to an amorphous framework. Achieving regioselective growth of crystalline functional units integrated with mesoporous frameworks remains highly challenging, primarily because of the intrinsic competition at the heterointerface between crystal nucleation/deposition and micelle-directed mesostructural coassembly. Herein, we report an acidity-gated interfacial crystallization-coassembly switching strategy to construct single-crystalline mesoporous MOF (meso-MOF)-based ANHs. This strategy enables the site-selective growth of a new single-crystalline meso-MOF compartment at predefined heterointerfaces, yielding a diverse family of well-defined frame-like, dumbbell-like, and ternary spiny nanohybrids. Mechanistically, precise regulation of the HCl/CH3COOH ratio modulates the nucleation kinetics of MOF precursors, generating localized supersaturation that is sufficient to trigger site-selective heterogeneous nucleation. Concurrently, synchronization of MOF nucleation/growth with interfacial micelle-directed coassembly allows crystallization and mesopore organization to proceed cooperatively. The applicability of this interfacial regulation is demonstrated in several lattice-compatible and chemically stable MOF systems with different compositions and hybrid configurations. As a proof of concept, the hierarchical spiny topology significantly enhances physical bacteria–material interactions, endowing the ternary ANHs with superior antibacterial performance. Remarkably, even in the absence of any drug loading, the ANHs achieve an approximately 90% inhibition efficiency against drug-resistant bacteria. This work establishes a versatile route to regioselectively integrate single-crystalline mesoporous domains into complex anisotropic nanohybrids and highlights the functional potential of structurally programmed crystalline mesoporous interfaces.

papers.title_zh: 介孔金属有机框架的区位选择性生长用于构建各向异性纳米杂化物
papers.summary_zh: 提出酸度门控的界面结晶-共组装切换策略，在预定异质界面上区位选择性生长单晶介孔MOF，构建框架状、哑铃状及三元刺状各向异性纳米杂化物，并展示其抗菌功能。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是介孔体系中各向异性生长长期局限于无定形框架，难以将结晶功能单元与介孔框架区位选择性整合，核心矛盾在于异质界面上晶体成核/沉积与胶束导向介观结构共组装之间的竞争。作者提出酸度门控的界面结晶-共组装切换策略，通过精确调控HCl/CH3COOH比例调节MOF前驱体成核动力学，产生足以触发位点选择性异相成核的局部过饱和，同时使MOF成核/生长与界面胶束导向共组装同步，实现结晶与介孔组织协同进行。该策略在多种晶格兼容、化学稳定的不同组成与杂化构型MOF体系中得到验证，得到框架状、哑铃状和三元刺状纳米杂化物。作为概念验证，分级刺状拓扑增强细菌-材料物理相互作用，使三元各向异性纳米杂化物在无载药条件下对耐药菌达到约90%抑制效率。该工作为将单晶介孔域区位选择性整合进复杂各向异性纳米杂化物提供了通用路线。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以HCl/CH3COOH比例调控的酸度门控界面结晶-共组装切换合成策略；在预定异质界面上区位选择性生长单晶介孔MOF；胶束导向的介观结构共组装；在多种晶格兼容、化学稳定的MOF体系中验证策略适用性；以细菌-材料物理相互作用和耐药菌抑制效率评价抗菌性能。具体表征手段摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 直接契合介孔导电MOF与框架材料组装主线：提供单晶介孔MOF区位选择性生长与界面结晶-共组装协同的通用策略，对介孔框架的各向异性组装和异质界面设计有实际参考价值。但摘要未报告导电性、孔结构参数与具体表征，若关注导电MOF需全文核查；鉴于策略新颖且具定量抗菌结果，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。HCl/CH3COOH具体比例、成核动力学定量数据、介孔孔径与比表面积、晶体学表征、抗菌测试菌株与实验条件等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过调控HCl/CH3COOH比例调节MOF前驱体成核动力学，产生局部过饱和以实现位点选择性异相成核。
MOF成核/生长与界面胶束导向共组装同步，使结晶与介孔组织协同进行。
获得框架状、哑铃状和三元刺状三类明确形貌的各向异性纳米杂化物，并在多种晶格兼容、化学稳定的MOF体系中验证策略适用性。
三元刺状纳米杂化物在无任何载药条件下对耐药菌实现约90%抑制效率。

papers.title: In Situ Polymerization of Covalent Organic Frameworks Networks for Efficient and Stable Perovskite Solar Cells
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The crystallization quality and defect density of perovskite films are key factors determining the performance and lifetime of perovskite solar cells (PSCs). Moreover, covalent organic frameworks (COFs) have emerged as highly promising multifunctional passivators for PSCs due to their abundant functional groups, periodic pore channels, and excellent chemical stability. However, the strong π–π stacking interactions resulting from the inherently rigid aromatic backbone of COFs lead to extremely poor dispersibility in conventional solvents, severely limiting further improvements in their passivation efficiency and device performance. In response to this issue, we propose a COF‐based synergistic assembly strategy (SAS): introducing two monomers into the perovskite precursor solution and the antisolvent, respectively, to form a COF network via in situ polymerization at grain boundaries during the annealing process. This design not only avoids the agglomeration issues associated with pre‐synthesized COFs, but also effectively regulates crystallization kinetics, passivates defects, suppresses ion migration, and enhances the film's hydrophobicity through the synergistic effects of hydrogen bonding and coordination. The SAS‐treated PSCs achieve a high power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.74% and excellent long‐term stability. This strategy provides a new approach to material design for achieving high efficiency and stability in PSCs.

papers.title_zh: 共价有机框架网络的原位聚合用于高效稳定钙钛矿太阳能电池
papers.summary_zh: 针对预合成COF分散性差的问题，提出COF基协同组装策略：两种单体分别引入钙钛矿前驱液和反溶剂，退火时在晶界原位聚合形成COF网络，实现缺陷钝化与结晶调控，PCE达26.74%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是钙钛矿薄膜结晶质量与缺陷密度决定电池性能与寿命，COF因功能基团丰富、周期孔道和化学稳定性被视为有前景的多功能钝化剂，但其刚性芳香骨架的强π-π堆叠导致在常规溶剂中分散性极差，限制钝化效率与器件性能提升。作者提出COF基协同组装策略：将两种单体分别引入钙钛矿前驱体溶液和反溶剂，在退火过程中于晶界处原位聚合形成COF网络。该设计避免预合成COF的团聚问题，并通过氢键与配位协同作用调控结晶动力学、钝化缺陷、抑制离子迁移、增强薄膜疏水性。经该策略处理的钙钛矿太阳能电池获得26.74%的光电转换效率并具有优异长期稳定性。该工作为高效稳定钙钛矿太阳能电池的材料设计提供了新途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：将两种COF单体分别引入钙钛矿前驱体溶液和反溶剂；退火过程中在晶界原位聚合形成COF网络；通过氢键与配位协同作用调控结晶与钝化缺陷；以光电转换效率和长期稳定性评价器件性能。具体表征手段与稳定性测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 与共轭COF及框架材料组装主线相关：展示COF在晶界原位聚合的协同组装思路，规避预合成COF分散性差的问题，对框架材料在光电薄膜中的组装应用有参考价值。但研究面向钙钛矿钝化而非介孔或导电框架本身，与介孔MOF/导电MOF主线关联有限；若关注COF组装策略可全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。COF单体种类与结构、原位聚合表征证据、缺陷钝化与离子迁移抑制的定量数据、稳定性测试条件等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 两种单体分别置于前驱液与反溶剂中，退火时在晶界原位聚合形成COF网络，避免预合成COF的团聚问题。
氢键与配位协同作用调控结晶动力学、钝化缺陷、抑制离子迁移并增强薄膜疏水性。
协同组装策略处理的钙钛矿太阳能电池光电转换效率达26.74%，并具有优异长期稳定性。

papers.title: Decoupling OH and H Binding via Dual‐Site Conductive MOFs for Efficient Alkaline Hydrogen Evolution
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Efficient regulation of the hydrogen and hydroxyl binding energies (HBE/OHBE) lies at the core of developing high‐performance alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) electrocatalysts, yet it remains challenging due to the inherent correlation between the two binding energies. Herein, we demonstrate a d ‐electron modulation strategy on dual‐metal sites to break the scaling constraint and synergistically optimize HBE and OHBE. A well‐defined Cu‐based two‐dimensional conductive metal–organic framework (Cu‐HHTP) serves as a universal host to incorporate various 3 d transition metals (Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu), yielding M–Cu dual sites with finely tunable d ‐electron configurations. Density functional theory calculations combined with experiments reveal that higher d ‐electron occupancy of the secondary metal site lowers the d ‐band center, and the water dissociation energy barrier exhibits a typical volcano‐type trend. The Co–Cu dual sites at the volcano apex promote the Volmer step through optimized OHBE and water adsorption. Meanwhile, this dual‐site configuration promotes the rearrangement of interfacial water molecules by disrupting the hydrogen‐bond network, thereby optimizing HBE. This work decouples HBE and OHBE via d ‐electron configuration, shifting the design paradigm from empirical screening to predictive design.

papers.title_zh: 双位点导电MOF解耦OH与H结合用于高效碱性析氢
papers.summary_zh: 以Cu-HHTP二维导电MOF为通用宿主引入多种3d过渡金属构建M-Cu双位点，通过d电子调控解耦HBE与OHBE，Co-Cu位点位于火山顶点，优化Volmer步骤与界面水重排。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是碱性析氢反应中氢结合能与羟基结合能存在内在关联，难以同时优化，制约高性能电催化剂开发。作者提出在双金属位点上进行d电子调控以打破标度关系、协同优化HBE与OHBE的策略。以结构明确的Cu基二维导电MOF（Cu-HHTP）作为通用宿主，引入Mn、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu等多种3d过渡金属，形成d电子构型可精细调节的M-Cu双位点。密度泛函理论计算结合实验表明，第二金属位点d电子占据率越高，d带中心越低，水解离能垒呈典型火山型趋势；位于火山顶点的Co-Cu双位点通过优化的OHBE与水吸附促进Volmer步骤，同时该双位点构型通过破坏氢键网络促进界面水分子重排，从而优化HBE。该工作通过d电子构型解耦HBE与OHBE，将设计范式从经验筛选转向预测性设计。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以Cu-HHTP二维导电MOF为宿主构建M-Cu双位点的合成策略；密度泛函理论计算与实验相结合，分析d电子占据率、d带中心、水解离能垒及火山型趋势；以碱性析氢反应评价催化性能，涉及Volmer步骤、OHBE/HBE与界面水分子重排分析。具体电化学测试条件与表征手段摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 契合导电MOF主线：以二维导电MOF为通用宿主构建双金属位点，展示d电子调控解耦HBE/OHBE的预测性设计思路，对导电MOF电催化应用有实际参考价值。但研究聚焦碱性HER催化机制，未涉及介孔结构或自组装；若关注导电MOF位点设计值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。M-Cu位点的具体合成与表征证据、DFT计算参数、电化学测试条件与性能数值等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 以Cu-HHTP二维导电MOF为通用宿主引入Mn、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu，形成d电子构型可调的M-Cu双位点。
第二金属位点d电子占据率升高使d带中心降低，水解离能垒呈典型火山型趋势。
火山顶点的Co-Cu双位点通过优化OHBE与水吸附促进Volmer步骤，并通过破坏氢键网络促进界面水重排以优化HBE。
通过d电子构型实现HBE与OHBE解耦，设计范式从经验筛选转向预测性设计。

papers.title: Chemical Reaction‐Powered Self‐Assembly and Dehydration of Supramolecular Hydrogels for Phase‐Transitional Robots
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Phase‐transitional robots have long intrigued the scientists from multidisciplinary fields, yet their realization remains a formidable task due to the lack of soft materials that seamlessly integrate phase transition with actuation functionality. Here, we report phase‐transitional hydrogel robots enabled by chemical reaction‐powered supramolecular gelation of a peptide solution followed by a dehydration process. The peptide contains a carboxyl group which can be converted into hydrophobic oxazolone moiety upon addition of carbodiimide. This chemical transformation neutralizes the negative charge of the peptide, thereby activating its self‐assembly into a hydrogel. Interestingly, over time, the hydrogel network becomes more hydrophobic because of the progressive formation of hydrophobic oxazolone species, which in turn leads to dehydration‐induced macroscopic contraction of the hydrogel. The contraction degree can be regulated by changing the concentrations of carbodiimide. This sol‐to‐gel transition followed by actuation behavior enables phase‐transitional robots that can flow into complex terrains to catch and transport cargoes, showing extraordinary morphological adaptivity. As an application, we show that the robot can adaptively enter a narrow channel to regulate an electrical circuit. This work unlocks the potential of chemically fueled supramolecular self‐assembly for the development of phase‐transitional robots that show unparalleled morphological adaptivity and functionalities.

papers.title_zh: 化学反应驱动的超分子水凝胶自组装与脱水用于相变机器人
papers.summary_zh: 该工作利用碳二亚胺将肽羧基转化为疏水噁唑酮，驱动肽溶液自组装成超分子水凝胶，并随疏水物种累积发生脱水收缩，实现可调控的溶胶—凝胶—驱动转变，构建能适应复杂地形并调控电路的相变机器人。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对相变机器人缺乏兼具相变与驱动功能软材料的问题，提出以化学反应驱动肽超分子凝胶化并结合脱水过程构建相变水凝胶机器人。材料体系为含羧基的肽溶液，加入碳二亚胺后羧基转化为疏水噁唑酮，负电荷被中和，从而激活自组装形成水凝胶。随时间推移，疏水噁唑酮物种逐步生成使凝胶网络更疏水，进而引发脱水诱导的宏观收缩。收缩程度可通过改变碳二亚胺浓度调控。该溶胶—凝胶转变及后续驱动行为使机器人能流入复杂地形抓取和运输货物，展示形态自适应能力；作为应用，机器人可自适应进入狭窄通道调控电路。该工作拓展了化学燃料驱动超分子自组装在相变机器人中的应用潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告的方法包括：向含羧基肽溶液中加入碳二亚胺以驱动化学转化与超分子凝胶化；通过改变碳二亚胺浓度调控水凝胶收缩程度；观察溶胶—凝胶转变及脱水诱导的宏观收缩行为；演示机器人在复杂地形抓取运输货物以及进入狭窄通道调控电路的应用。摘要未报告具体表征手段、力学测试和定量收缩数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装技术与软材料驱动交叉方向，其化学燃料驱动超分子凝胶化及脱水收缩策略对框架材料/介孔材料的动态组装与自适应结构设计有方法学启发。但研究对象为肽超分子水凝胶，不涉及MOF/COF/HOF或介孔导电框架，与主线材料体系距离较远；若关注化学反应驱动自组装与宏观形变耦合，值得浏览全文，否则精读优先级有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；碳二亚胺具体种类与浓度、肽序列、凝胶化时间、收缩率定量数据、表征方法与机器人驱动机制细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 碳二亚胺将肽羧基转化为疏水噁唑酮并中和负电荷，激活肽自组装形成水凝胶。
随时间推进疏水噁唑酮逐步生成使凝胶网络更疏水，导致脱水诱导的宏观收缩。
水凝胶收缩程度可通过改变碳二亚胺浓度调控。
所得相变机器人可流入复杂地形抓取运输货物，并能自适应进入狭窄通道调控电路。

papers.title: A Photosensitizer Bearing an Asymmetric “Push-Pull” Bipyridine Ligand Enhances Excited State Electron Transfer
papers.abstract: Abstract Herein we report RuII photosensitizers that bear a single “push-pull” ligand designed to polarize charge on a single pyridine ring of 2,2′-bipyridine (bpy) in the metal-to-ligand charge-transfer (MLCT) excited state for enhanced excited state electron transfer. The photosensitizers have the general structure [Ru(dtb)2(4-CO2H,4′-R-bpy)]2+, where R is –H (RuHcb), −CF3 (RuFcb), and −CH3 (RuMcb) and dtb is 4,4′-(tert-butyl)2-bpy. These photosensitizers were synthesized, characterized spectroscopically and electrochemically, and contrasted with [Ru(dtb)2(dcb)]2+ (RuDcb) that bears the more common dicarboxylic acid ligand, Dcb = 4,4′-(CO2H)2-bipyridine. When anchored to mesoporous TiO2 thin films in a 0.1 M LiClO4/CH3CN electrolyte, RuMcb|TiO2 displayed the largest excited state electron injection yield ϕinj = 0.90 and, generally, ϕinj decreased as R became more electron withdrawing. RuDcb|TiO2 displayed a significantly lower ϕinj = 0.80. Transient absorption spectra recorded on ps and ns time scales and spectroelectrochemical data revealed that ∼70% of the total ϕinj for RuMcb occurred on a sub ps time scale that could not be kinetically resolved, only 20% occurred on this same time scale for RuDcb. Quantum chemical simulations were utilized to characterize the charge transfer excited states, the surface binding, and the interfacial electron transfer kinetics. Apart from RuFcb, the data reveal that the push–pull ligand had little impact on the ground state and a significant one on the MLCT excited state, polarizing charge on a sub-ps time scale for more efficient interfacial electron transfer. More broadly, the data reveals that push–pull ligands can be optimized for excited state electron transfer reactivity.

papers.title_zh: 含不对称“推—拉”联吡啶配体的光敏剂增强激发态电子转移
papers.summary_zh: 该工作合成三种含单个推—拉联吡啶配体的RuII光敏剂，发现给电子甲基取代物RuMcb在介孔TiO2薄膜上激发态电子注入产率最高达0.90，且约70%注入发生在亚皮秒尺度，表明推—拉配体可极化MLCT激发态电荷以提升界面电子转移。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对RuII光敏剂在金属—配体电荷转移激发态下电荷分布调控与界面电子转移效率问题，设计含单个推—拉配体的光敏剂，使2,2′-联吡啶单个吡啶环上的电荷在MLCT激发态被极化。材料体系通式为[Ru(dtb)2(4-CO2H,4′-R-bpy)]2+，R为–H、–CF3、–CH3，分别对应RuHcb、RuFcb、RuMcb，dtb为4,4′-(叔丁基)2-bpy；并以含常规二羧酸配体的RuDcb作为对照。光敏剂经合成、光谱与电化学表征后锚定于介孔TiO2薄膜，在0.1 M LiClO4/CH3CN电解液中评估激发态电子注入。结果显示RuMcb|TiO2注入产率最高，随R吸电子性增强注入产率总体下降，RuDcb|TiO2显著较低。瞬态吸收与光谱电化学揭示RuMcb总注入中约70%发生在无法动力学分辨的亚皮秒尺度，RuDcb仅20%。量子化学模拟用于表征电荷转移激发态、表面结合与界面电子转移动力学。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告的方法包括：合成通式[Ru(dtb)2(4-CO2H,4′-R-bpy)]2+的RuII光敏剂（R=–H、–CF3、–CH3）及对照RuDcb；进行光谱与电化学表征；将光敏剂锚定于介孔TiO2薄膜，在0.1 M LiClO4/CH3CN电解液中测定激发态电子注入产率；采用皮秒与纳秒瞬态吸收光谱及光谱电化学分析电子转移动力学；利用量子化学模拟表征电荷转移激发态、表面结合与界面电子转移。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作以介孔TiO2薄膜为锚定平台，研究推—拉配体对MLCT激发态电荷极化和界面电子转移的调控，对介孔材料界面光物理与光电功能化有参考价值，其瞬态吸收与光谱电化学方法可借鉴于框架材料/介孔材料的光电表征。但材料主体为RuII分子光敏剂而非MOF/COF/HOF框架，与介孔导电MOF主线关联有限；若关注介孔半导体界面电子转移机制，值得精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；配体合成细节、薄膜制备参数、瞬态吸收拟合、量子化学计算方法和稳定性数据均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: RuMcb|TiO2在0.1 M LiClO4/CH3CN电解液中显示最大激发态电子注入产率ϕinj=0.90，RuDcb|TiO2显著较低为0.80。
总体上ϕinj随R吸电子性增强而下降。
RuMcb总ϕinj中约70%发生在亚皮秒尺度，RuDcb同一时间尺度仅20%。
除RuFcb外，推—拉配体对基态影响很小，但显著影响MLCT激发态，在亚皮秒尺度极化电荷以促进界面电子转移。

papers.title: Metal-organic framework/MXene composites: design strategies and applications for energy storage, catalysis, and sensing
papers.abstract: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), as crystalline porous materials with tunable chemical compositions, have attracted widespread interest for energy-related applications. However, their low electrical conductivity and limited structural stability under electrochemical conditions restrict practical deployment. Integrating MOFs with two-dimensional transition metal carbides/nitrides (MXenes) creates composite materials that combine the high surface area and active sites of MOFs with the metallic conductivity and mechanical flexibility of MXenes. This review summarizes recent progress on MOF/MXene composites. The major synthetic routes are classified into four categories: in situ growth with interfacial chemical bonding, electrostatic self-assembly, post-synthetic transformation into metal oxides, sulfides, and phosphides, and interface engineering. Their applications are discussed across electrochemical energy storage (lithium, sodium, potassium, and zinc-ion batteries, and supercapacitors), energy conversion (electrocatalytic hydrogen/oxygen evolution, oxygen reduction, and photocatalysis), and sensing. Despite research advances, challenges remain for practical application, including MXene oxidation during processing and operation, difficulties in large-scale fabrication with batch-to-batch consistency, and the need for precise interfacial regulation. Finally, future research directions are outlined, including artificial intelligence-assisted material screening, construction of three-dimensional hierarchical structures, and evaluation of industrial applicability through standardized testing protocols.

papers.title_zh: 金属有机框架/MXene复合材料：面向储能、催化与传感的设计策略及应用
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统总结MOF/MXene复合材料，将合成路线归为界面化学键原位生长、静电自组装、后合成转化为金属氧化物/硫化物/磷化物及界面工程四类，评述其在电化学储能、能源转化与传感中的应用，并指出MXene氧化、规模化批次一致性和界面精准调控等挑战。
papers.research_details_zh: 综述针对MOF导电性低、电化学条件下结构稳定性有限而限制实际应用的问题，提出将MOF与二维过渡金属碳化物/氮化物MXene复合，以结合MOF高比表面积和活性位点与MXene金属导电性和机械柔韧性。文章将主要合成路线分为四类：伴随界面化学键的原位生长、静电自组装、后合成转化为金属氧化物/硫化物/磷化物以及界面工程。应用讨论覆盖电化学储能（锂、钠、钾、锌离子电池和超级电容器）、能源转化（电催化析氢/析氧、氧还原和光催化）与传感。文章指出实际应用仍面临MXene在加工和运行中氧化、规模化制备批次一致性困难以及界面精准调控需求等挑战，并展望人工智能辅助材料筛选、三维分级结构构建和标准化测试评估工业适用性等方向。
papers.methods_zh: 作为综述，摘要报告的方法学框架为文献归纳与分类：按合成路线将MOF/MXene复合材料分为界面化学键原位生长、静电自组装、后合成转化为金属氧化物/硫化物/磷化物及界面工程四类；按应用领域评述电化学储能、能源转化与传感性能；并讨论MXene氧化、规模化批次一致性和界面调控等挑战及人工智能辅助筛选、三维分级结构和标准化测试等未来方向。摘要未报告具体实验表征或性能测试数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与框架材料主线高度相关，尤其涉及MOF与二维导电材料的复合设计、静电自组装路线及电化学储能/催化应用，可为介孔导电MOF和框架材料组装提供设计策略参考。其局限在于综述层面，摘要未给出具体性能数值与界面机制证据；适合作为MOF/MXene复合方向的入门与路线梳理精读，并据全文核查具体案例与数据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；具体文献案例、合成参数、性能数值、界面表征证据和挑战论述的支撑数据均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: MOF/MXene复合可结合MOF高比表面积与活性位点及MXene金属导电性与机械柔韧性，以缓解MOF导电性低和电化学稳定性不足的问题。
主要合成路线被归纳为四类：界面化学键原位生长、静电自组装、后合成转化为金属氧化物/硫化物/磷化物以及界面工程。
应用覆盖锂/钠/钾/锌离子电池、超级电容器、电催化析氢/析氧、氧还原、光催化与传感。
实际应用挑战包括MXene加工与运行中氧化、规模化制备批次一致性困难及界面精准调控需求。

papers.title: Processing Window Expansion Enables Uniform Crystallization in Scalable Ambient‐Fabricated Perovskite Photovoltaics
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Slot‐die coating is a promising scalable deposition technique for perovskite devices due to its high material utilization and inherent compatibility with continuous manufacturing. However, a narrow deposition‐to‐annealing time window and inhomogeneous ink distribution limit the device performance. Herein, we report a combined additive (CA) strategy that simultaneously regulates nucleation kinetics and phase evolution, broadening the processing window for slot‐die coating in the ambient. By synergistically introducing rubidium thiocyanate (RbSCN) and formamidinium thiocyanate (FASCN), an in situ coordination mechanism is established that lowers the energy barrier for the δ‐to‐α phase transition while suppressing non‐photoactive phase formation. This leads to uniform crystallization over an extended time window exceeding 100 s, yielding dense large‐grained α‐FAPbI 3 films with minimized vertical compositional gradient and reduced residual strain. The resulting films exhibit suppressed defects, prolonged carrier lifetime, and optimized energy‐level alignment, enabling efficient charge extraction and reduced nonradiative recombination. The CA strategy enables highly uniform large‐area deposition to deliver an efficiency of 22.70% for perovskite solar modules. Meanwhile, the unencapsulated devices maintain 97.76% of the initial efficiency under ISOS‐L‐3 for 1300 h. This CA strategy establishes a generalizable pathway for decoupling crystallization kinetics from processing constraints, providing a robust method for scalable high‐performance perovskite photovoltaics.

papers.title_zh: 加工窗口扩展实现可规模化环境制备钙钛矿光伏的均匀结晶
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出RbSCN与FASCN组合添加剂策略，同步调控成核动力学与相演化，将狭缝涂布沉积到退火的时间窗口扩展至超过100秒，获得致密大晶粒α-FAPbI3薄膜，组件效率达22.70%，未封装器件在ISOS-L-3下1300小时保持初始效率97.76%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对狭缝涂布制备钙钛矿时沉积到退火时间窗口窄、墨水分布不均限制器件性能的问题，采用组合添加剂策略，将硫氰酸铷与硫氰酸甲脒协同引入钙钛矿墨水体系。摘要指出该策略建立原位配位机制，降低δ相向α相转变的能垒，同时抑制非光活性相形成，从而在超过100秒的延长时间窗口内实现均匀结晶。所得α-FAPbI3薄膜具有致密大晶粒特征，垂直组分梯度最小化且残余应变降低，薄膜缺陷受到抑制、载流子寿命延长、能级排列优化，促进电荷提取并减少非辐射复合。该策略实现高度均匀的大面积沉积，使钙钛矿太阳能组件效率达到22.70%，未封装器件在ISOS-L-3条件下1300小时后保持初始效率的97.76%。其意义在于将结晶动力学与加工约束解耦，为可规模化高性能钙钛矿光伏提供通用路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及狭缝涂布沉积与环境条件下制备钙钛矿薄膜及组件；采用硫氰酸铷和硫氰酸甲脒作为组合添加剂调控成核与相演化；通过时间窗口评估结晶均匀性，并表征薄膜的晶粒结构、垂直组分梯度、残余应变、缺陷、载流子寿命与能级排列；开展组件效率测试以及ISOS-L-3条件下的未封装器件稳定性测试。摘要未报告具体表征仪器型号、测试条件细节与统计样本数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作虽以钙钛矿光伏为主，但其组合添加剂调控成核动力学、扩展加工窗口并实现均匀大面积结晶的思路，对框架材料与介孔材料的自组装、结晶调控及可规模化沉积具有方法学参考价值。局限在于不涉及MOF/COF/HOF或介孔框架体系，电化学合成亦未涉及。若关注溶液加工结晶动力学与规模化制备的通用策略，值得全文精读以核查机制细节。

papers.title: 3D Cuprous Iodide Cluster‐Covalent Organic Framework for Ultrasensitive and Highly Selective Trace HF Detection at Room Temperature
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hydrofluoric acid (HF) poses a serious and irreversible threat to human health necessitating the development of highly sensitive and selective detection materials. Herein, a three‐dimensional cuprous iodide cluster‐based covalent organic framework (CuI‐MCOF), with diamond topology has been successfully prepared, which shows an ultrafast and highly sensitive response to HF gas. At room temperature, CuI‐MCOF displays an exceptional response of 7188% toward 100 ppm HF, with remarkably rapid response/recovery times of 3 s/2 s at 4 ppm. Notably, the sensor achieves an ultralow detection limit of 21 ppb, outperforming previously reported HF sensors. Moreover, it demonstrates outstanding selectivity and anti‐interference performance, maintaining stable responses to 4 ppm HF even in the presence of 16 interfering gases (100 ppm each). Experiments combined with density‐functional theory calculations reveal that the imine‐linker N atoms serve as reversible HF adsorption–desorption sites, while the electron‐rich CuI clusters enhance dipole interactions and facilitate charge transfer. Leveraging these properties, an on‐chip miniaturized perceptron system integrated with evaluation algorithms is developed for anti‐interference HF discrimination, spatiotemporal distribution estimation, and leakage source prediction. This work provides a new strategy for designing high‐performance HF sensors and expands the application of cluster‐based COFs in gas sensing.

papers.title_zh: 三维碘化亚铜簇共价有机框架用于室温超灵敏高选择性痕量HF检测
papers.summary_zh: 该研究制备了具有金刚石拓扑的三维碘化亚铜簇基共价有机框架CuI-MCOF，在室温下对100 ppm HF响应达7188%，4 ppm下响应/恢复时间为3秒/2秒，检测限低至21 ppb，并构建片上微型感知系统实现抗干扰HF判别与泄漏源预测。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对氢氟酸对人体健康构成严重且不可逆威胁、亟需高灵敏高选择性检测材料的问题，成功制备了三维碘化亚铜簇基共价有机框架CuI-MCOF，摘要明确其具有金刚石拓扑。该材料对HF气体表现出超快且高灵敏响应：室温下对100 ppm HF响应达7188%，4 ppm下响应与恢复时间分别为3秒和2秒，检测限低至21 ppb，优于此前报道的HF传感器。材料还表现出优异选择性与抗干扰性能，在16种干扰气体各100 ppm共存时对4 ppm HF仍保持稳定响应。实验结合密度泛函理论计算揭示，亚胺连接基中的氮原子作为可逆的HF吸附—脱附位点，富电子CuI簇增强偶极相互作用并促进电荷转移。基于上述性能，研究开发了集成评估算法的片上微型感知系统，用于抗干扰HF判别、时空分布估计与泄漏源预测。该工作为高性能HF传感器设计提供新策略，并拓展了簇基COF在气体传感中的应用。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确包括三维CuI-MCOF的制备与金刚石拓扑结构确认；室温下HF气体传感性能测试，涵盖响应值、响应/恢复时间、检测限、选择性与多气体抗干扰测试；实验结合密度泛函理论计算解析吸附位点与电荷转移机制；并开发集成评估算法的片上微型感知系统用于HF判别与泄漏源预测。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器、传感测试装置细节与算法类型。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接契合共轭COF与框架材料主线，展示簇基三维COF在气体传感中的应用，其亚胺位点可逆吸附与富电子簇协同机制对框架材料的功能化设计有参考价值。局限在于摘要未涉及介孔结构、电化学合成或自组装工艺细节。对关注COF传感与簇基框架的研究者值得全文精读，以核查合成与器件细节。

在16种各100 ppm干扰气体共存下，对4 ppm HF仍保持稳定响应，选择性与抗干扰性能突出。
实验与DFT计算表明亚胺连接基氮原子为可逆HF吸附—脱附位点，富电子CuI簇增强偶极相互作用并促进电荷转移。

papers.title: Beyond Linker Length: Three-Dimensional Linker Geometry Governs Flexibility in Zn–Triazolate MOFs
papers.abstract: Abstract Flexible metal–organic frameworks undergo cooperative structural transformations that underpin applications in molecular separations, sensing, and gas storage; however, the molecular origins of framework flexibility remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the role of linker geometry in directing the structural response of a family of isoreticular Zn–triazolate pillared-layer MOFs incorporating cubane (cdc), bicyclo[1.1.1]pentane (pdc), and bicyclo[2.2.2]octane (boct) dicarboxylate linkers. Variable-temperature and in situ CO2 powder X-ray diffraction, variable-temperature single-crystal X-ray diffraction, gas adsorption measurements, and machine-learning-enabled atomistic simulations reveal fundamentally different mechanical responses despite the frameworks possessing closely related architectures. The cdc framework exhibits reversible cooperative breathing, the pdc analogue undergoes pathway-dependent structural reorganization consistent with kinetic trapping following cooling of the activated framework to 77 K, whereas the boct framework accommodates deformation through continuous elastic distortion without discrete phase transitions. Computational analysis demonstrates that these contrasting behaviors arise primarily from the manner in which linker geometry governs strain accommodation within the flexible Zn–triazolate sheets, rather than from the deformation of the linker itself. These results establish structure–mechanics relationships across this family of flexible MOFs and demonstrate that subtle changes in molecular geometry provide a powerful strategy for programming cooperative structural behavior.

papers.title_zh: 超越连接基长度：三维连接基几何构型主导Zn-三唑MOF的柔性
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较含立方烷、双环[1.1.1]戊烷与双环[2.2.2]辛烷二羧酸连接基的同构Zn-三唑柱撑层MOF，发现三者分别表现可逆协同呼吸、路径依赖结构重组与连续弹性畸变，证明连接基几何构型而非长度主导柔性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对柔性金属有机框架发生协同结构转变但分子起源认识不足的问题，考察连接基几何构型在同构网状Zn-三唑柱撑层MOF家族中对结构响应的影响。所研究的框架分别引入立方烷二羧酸、双环[1.1.1]戊烷二羧酸和双环[2.2.2]辛烷二羧酸连接基。通过变温与原位CO2粉末X射线衍射、变温单晶X射线衍射、气体吸附测量以及机器学习辅助的原子模拟，揭示尽管框架结构密切相关，三者机械响应根本不同：cdc框架表现可逆协同呼吸，pdc类似物在活化框架冷却至77 K后表现与动力学捕获一致的路径依赖结构重组，boct框架则通过连续弹性畸变容纳形变而无离散相变。计算分析表明这些差异主要源于连接基几何构型调控柔性Zn-三唑层内应变容纳方式，而非连接基本身形变。该结果建立该柔性MOF家族的结构—力学关系，表明分子几何的细微变化是编程协同结构行为的有力策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用变温与原位CO2粉末X射线衍射、变温单晶X射线衍射、气体吸附测量以及机器学习辅助的原子模拟，对含cdc、pdc与boct二羧酸连接基的同构Zn-三唑柱撑层MOF进行比较研究，并结合计算分析解析层内应变容纳机制。摘要未报告具体合成条件、活化流程细节、吸附气体种类与温度点、模拟方法参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接契合MOF框架材料主线，以连接基三维几何构型而非长度解释柔性差异，为框架材料的结构—力学关系与协同结构行为设计提供明确依据。局限在于摘要未涉及介孔性、电化学合成或自组装工艺。对关注柔性MOF结构转变机制与计算辅助解析的研究者值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；连接基合成、框架活化条件、衍射与吸附数据细节、机器学习模拟方法及路径依赖行为的完整证据链仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: cdc框架表现可逆协同呼吸，pdc类似物表现与动力学捕获一致的路径依赖结构重组，boct框架通过连续弹性畸变容纳形变而无离散相变。
计算分析表明差异主要源于连接基几何构型对柔性Zn-三唑层内应变容纳方式的调控，而非连接基本身形变。
分子几何的细微变化可作为编程MOF协同结构行为的有效策略，建立该同构家族的结构—力学关系。

papers.title: Harnessing the Hard‐Soft Acid‐Base Principle in Sulfur‐Dense Flexible Covalent Organic Frameworks for Targeted Gold Sequestration
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Efficient gold (Au) recovery from e‐waste and industrial effluents is crucial for sustainable resource management, yet building crystalline covalent organic frameworks (COFs) with dense sulfur soft sites under Hard‐Soft Acid‐Base (HSAB) guidance is severely hindered by the intrinsic rotational freedom of thioether linkages, which typically precipitates amorphous networks. Herein, we report the rational synthesis of sulfur‐bridged flexible COFs by tailoring solvothermal kinetics to enable the construction of crystalline topological framework isomers ( sql and kgm nets) from an identical tetracyclic C‐S bond‐enriched monomer. The kgm framework was further functionalized with pendant methyl sulfide groups, generating abundant soft binding sites. Consequently, the resulting electron‐rich framework delivers an exceptional Au uptake capacity of 6420 mg g −1 , ranking among the highest values reported to date for COFs under dark conditions, alongside rapid uptake kinetics and excellent selectivity. Combined spectroscopic and theoretical investigations reveal that sulfur sites play a central role in Au capture by providing abundant active sites, facilitating the coordination of Au species, and promoting electron transfer, thereby favoring the reduction of Au(III) to Au(0). This paradigm underscores the potency of the HSAB principle as a robust blueprint for designing high‐performance adsorbents aimed at the sustainable precious metal recovery.

papers.title: Spin‐State Modulation of Octahedral Co Sites for Enhancing Nitrate‐to‐Ammonia Conversion
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Ammonia is vital for agriculture and a promising carbon‐free energy carrier, but its industrial production via the Haber–Bosch process is energy‐intensive and emits substantial CO 2 . Electrocatalytic nitrogen oxide reduction to ammonia offers a green alternative, by using renewable electricity under ambient conditions while enabling nitrogen resource utilization. Herein, we report a metal–organic framework (MOF)‐derived Co 3 O 4 electrocatalyst (MD‐Co 3 O 4 ) prepared by controlled pyrolysis of Co‐MOF‐74, which achieved a high Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 96.7% and excellent stability for the electrosynthesis of NH 3 from nitrate, along with robust activity over a wide pH and nitrate concentration range. Comprehensive spectroscopic characterizations and density functional theory calculations revealed that the oxygen vacancies generated during MOF pyrolysis induce coordination distortion of octahedral Co sites, leading to a high‐spin state transition with an electron‐rich configuration that synergistically enhances nitrate adsorption and interfacial electron transfer, thereby boosting the intrinsic activity. Moreover, this MOF‐based strategy is applicable to other M 1 Co 2 O 4 spinels, which provides an effective approach for spin engineering at the atomic scale and sustainable ammonia synthesis.

papers.title_zh: 调控八面体Co位点自旋态增强硝酸盐到氨的转化
papers.summary_zh: 通过对Co-MOF-74受控热解制备MOF衍生Co3O4电催化剂，实现硝酸盐电合成氨的法拉第效率96.7%和优异稳定性，光谱与DFT揭示热解产生的氧空位诱导八面体Co位点配位畸变与高自旋态转变，从而增强硝酸盐吸附与界面电子转移。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是开发绿色电催化硝酸盐还原制氨替代高能耗Haber-Bosch过程。作者以Co-MOF-74为前驱体，通过受控热解制备MOF衍生Co3O4电催化剂（MD-Co3O4）。该催化剂在硝酸盐电合成氨中实现96.7%的法拉第效率，具有优异稳定性，并在宽pH和宽硝酸盐浓度范围内保持稳健活性。综合光谱表征与密度泛函理论计算表明，MOF热解过程中产生的氧空位诱导八面体Co位点配位畸变，引发高自旋态转变并形成富电子构型，协同增强硝酸盐吸附和界面电子转移，从而提升本征活性。该MOF基策略还可推广至其他M1Co2O4尖晶石，为原子尺度自旋工程和可持续氨合成提供途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：Co-MOF-74的受控热解制备MD-Co3O4；硝酸盐电还原合成氨的性能测试（法拉第效率、稳定性、宽pH与宽硝酸盐浓度范围）；综合光谱表征；密度泛函理论计算。具体热解条件、光谱种类和电化学测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于MOF衍生材料与电化学合成交叉方向，涉及配位环境调控与自旋态工程，对框架材料衍生电催化剂的设计有参考价值。但其主体为热解氧化物而非介孔或共轭框架本身，与介孔导电MOF主线关联有限，可按需选读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读。具体热解温度与气氛、光谱表征类型、电化学测试条件及DFT计算细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: MD-Co3O4在硝酸盐电合成氨中实现96.7%的法拉第效率，并具优异稳定性和宽pH、宽硝酸盐浓度范围的稳健活性。
MOF热解产生的氧空位诱导八面体Co位点配位畸变，导致高自旋态转变和富电子构型。
高自旋富电子构型协同增强硝酸盐吸附与界面电子转移，提升本征活性；该策略可推广至其他M1Co2O4尖晶石。

papers.title: Interface-Engineered Flexible Conductive Metal–Organic Framework Films for Multimodal Energy Applications
papers.abstract: Conspectus Conductive metal–organic frameworks (c-MOFs) represent a distinct class of porous conductive materials. Compared with conventional MOFs, c-MOFs integrate intrinsically high electrical conductivity with a high surface area and an ordered porous structure, enabling efficient electron and ion transport. Engineering c-MOFs into continuous and flexible films offers a promising strategy for translating their properties into practical devices. Key strategies for film engineering include solution processing, interfacial growth, and chemical vapor deposition, which allow precise control over the film morphology, thickness, and alignment of conductive channels. Thin-film fabrication preserves structural integrity and pore connectivity, enhances interfacial contact, and facilitates device integration, thereby promoting coupled ionic and electronic transport. These properties render c-MOF films suitable for multimodal energy transformation. In energy storage, their mechanical compliance, flexibility, and high porosity enable conformal integration with deformable and wearable devices while maintaining rapid charge transport and long-term cycling stability. In energy harvesting and conversion, their ordered porous networks, tunable electronic structures, and freestanding mechanically flexible architectures enable efficient adaptation to diverse energy inputs, facilitating energy conversion involving electrical, mechanical, chemical, thermal, and optical processes while maintaining the structural integrity under dynamic deformation. This versatility supports the development of integrated systems capable of simultaneously storing, harvesting, and converting multiple energy modalities for wearable and portable devices. This Account highlights our recent studies on the nanoengineering of c-MOFs on the surface of cellulose nanofibers (CNFs) through interfacial synthesis, enabling the fabrication of freestanding, flexible, and mechanically robust CNF@c-MOF nanopapers, as well as their applications in energy harvesting, conversion, and storage. We discuss the fundamental principles governing the interfacial growth of c-MOF nanostructures on flexible nanofibrous substrates, including the regulation of metal–ligand coordination and interfacial chemical interactions that govern hierarchical assembly toward functional flexible architectures. This Account also summarizes recent advances in the fabrication of flexible c-MOF films, covering representative preparation strategies, structural design approaches, and their unique roles in emerging energy technologies. Future progress in metal center selection, ligand electronic modulation, pore architecture optimization, interface engineering, and composite integration will further improve electron–ion transport, mechanical durability, and device-level compatibility. By combining flexible substrates with multiscale hierarchical structures, flexible c-MOF films can establish interconnected transport networks and adaptive functional interfaces, enabling high-performance, lightweight, and multifunctional energy devices. These advances highlight flexible c-MOF films as a promising platform for next-generation energy technologies that simultaneously demand mechanical flexibility, structural stability, and efficient synergistic electron–ion transport.

papers.title_zh: 界面工程化柔性导电金属有机框架薄膜用于多模态能源应用
papers.summary_zh: 该Account综述了导电MOF薄膜的界面合成策略，重点介绍在纤维素纳米纤维表面界面生长c-MOF以制备自支撑柔性纳米纸，并总结其在能量收集、转换与存储等多模态能源器件中的应用前景。
papers.research_details_zh: 本文聚焦导电金属有机框架（c-MOFs）从本征多孔导电材料向实用器件转化的薄膜化难题。研究体系为c-MOFs及其与纤维素纳米纤维（CNFs）复合的柔性薄膜。设计策略包括溶液加工、界面生长和化学气相沉积，以精确调控薄膜形貌、厚度及导电通道取向；核心策略是在CNF表面通过界面合成纳米工程化c-MOF，构建自支撑、柔性且机械稳健的CNF@c-MOF纳米纸。研究过程讨论了柔性纳米纤维基底上c-MOF纳米结构界面生长的基本原理，包括金属-配体配位调控和界面化学相互作用对分级组装为功能柔性架构的支配作用，并总结了柔性c-MOF薄膜的制备策略、结构设计及其在能源技术中的独特作用。意义在于提出通过金属中心选择、配体电子调控、孔结构优化、界面工程和复合集成来改善电子-离子传输、机械耐久性和器件兼容性，为轻量、多功能能源器件提供平台。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的制备策略包括溶液加工、界面生长和化学气相沉积；核心方法为在纤维素纳米纤维表面进行界面合成以生长c-MOF纳米结构。摘要还讨论了金属-配体配位和界面化学相互作用的调控原理，以及薄膜形貌、厚度和导电通道取向的控制。摘要未报告具体的表征手段和性能测试数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文直接契合介孔导电MOF、框架材料组装及电化学合成主线，提供了c-MOF薄膜界面生长与柔性复合的综述视角，对理解导电框架的组装-传输-器件关系有参考价值。但作为Account，摘要未给出具体实验数据和表征细节，适合作为方向性精读和文献追溯入口，而非获取定量结果的首选。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级解读；具体的合成条件、表征方法、电导率数值、器件性能参数及机制证据仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: c-MOFs兼具高电导率、高比表面积和有序多孔结构，可实现高效电子与离子传输。
在CNF表面通过界面合成可制备自支撑、柔性且机械稳健的CNF@c-MOF纳米纸。
薄膜化可保持结构完整性和孔连通性、增强界面接触并促进离子-电子耦合传输。
金属中心选择、配体电子调控、孔结构优化、界面工程和复合集成是进一步提升性能的关键方向。

papers.title: Tailoring Lead Iodide Crystals Through Organic Templating and Inorganic Heterostructuring for Optoelectronics
papers.abstract: Metal-halide perovskites are leading candidates for next-generation solar cells and light-emitting diodes. Because the absorber or emitter forms by reaction of an inorganic scaffold with a cation salt, the crystallographic quality of the lead iodide (PbI2) precursor strongly influences device performance: small, disordered crystallites propagate grain boundaries, trap states and incomplete conversion. This article examines the structural chemistry linking PbI2 crystal engineering to optoelectronic outcomes. We contrast the electronic structure of halide and oxide perovskites and discuss how the A-site cation, rationalised through the Goldschmidt tolerance factor, determines whether three-dimensional or moisture-resistant two-dimensional phases form. Attention is given to template-assisted strategies, notably lead-fumarate and related metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) used as sacrificial scaffolds or interfacial buffers that promote large, oriented PbI2 crystallites and suppress halide-ion migration. We distinguish which degradation pathways such engineering can and cannot mitigate and assess its transferability to lead-free halides. We then present an original case study in which pressed PbI2/SnO2 composite plates (5 and 15 wt% SnO2), prepared by aqueous crystallisation, serve as a macroscopic model of heterojunction-mediated charge transport. Powder X-ray diffraction confirms that the PbI2 host retains its hexagonal structure in both composites. Under dark, daylight and 3–100 W UV (365 nm) illumination, the 15 wt% composite delivers roughly two orders of magnitude higher photocurrent than pristine PbI2, consistent with Type-II band-offset-driven electron extraction into a connected SnO2 network, while the diminishing gain per added wt% points to an optimum filler loading. These results provide device-independent support for the interfacial charge-separation principles discussed throughout.

papers.title_zh: 通过有机模板化和无机异质结构调控碘化铅晶体用于光电子学
papers.summary_zh: 该文从结构化学角度讨论PbI2晶体工程与光电子性能的关联，评述MOF模板辅助策略对PbI2晶粒取向和卤素迁移的调控，并以PbI2/SnO2复合片为宏观模型验证异质结电荷分离。
papers.research_details_zh: 本文关注金属卤化物钙钛矿器件中PbI2前驱体晶体质量对性能的影响：小而无序的晶粒会引入晶界、陷阱态和不完全转化。研究体系包括卤化物与氧化物钙钛矿的电子结构对比、A位阳离子与Goldschmidt容差因子对三维或二维相形成的决定作用，以及铅富马酸盐等相关MOF作为牺牲模板或界面缓冲层促进大尺寸取向PbI2晶粒并抑制卤素离子迁移。文章区分了此类工程可缓解和不可缓解的降解路径，并评估其对无铅卤化物的可迁移性。原创案例为水溶液结晶制备的5和15 wt% SnO2压片PbI2/SnO2复合板，作为异质结介导电荷传输的宏观模型。意义在于提供不依赖器件的界面电荷分离原理支持。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及水溶液结晶制备PbI2/SnO2复合压片（5和15 wt% SnO2），粉末X射线衍射确认物相结构，并在暗态、日光及3–100 W紫外（365 nm）光照下进行光电流测试。摘要还讨论了Goldschmidt容差因子分析和模板辅助策略的文献评述。摘要未报告其他表征与器件制备细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文涉及MOF作为牺牲模板或界面缓冲层调控无机晶体生长，与框架材料辅助组装和界面工程主线相关，但其核心是PbI2晶体工程与光电子应用，并非介孔导电MOF或COF/HOF。摘要给出的复合片光电流数据可作为异质结电荷分离的定性参考，全文精读价值中等，适合关注MOF模板化无机异质结构的读者。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级解读；MOF模板的具体结构、复合片制备条件、光电流绝对值、能带偏移数值及降解机制细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 粉末X射线衍射确认两种复合物中PbI2主体均保持六方结构。
在暗态、日光和3–100 W紫外（365 nm）光照下，15 wt%复合物的光电流比纯PbI2高约两个数量级。
光电流提升与Type-II能带偏移驱动电子提取进入连通的SnO2网络一致。
每增加单位wt%的增益递减，提示存在最佳填料负载。

papers.title: Functional Surface Self‐Assembly on Nitinol Biliary Stents for Enhanced Anti‐Fouling and Low‐Friction Behavior
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Nitinol (NiTi) stents are widely used for biliary decompression, but their biofluid‐exposed metallic surfaces remain susceptible to mechanical irritation, bacterial colonization, sludge deposition, and inflammation‐associated restenosis. Inspired by the dynamic, low‐adhesion interfacial function of the native glycocalyx, we developed a self‐assembled slippery liquid‐infused porous surface (SASLIPS) for NiTi biliary stents. The modified surface formed a continuous liquid‐infused architecture, exhibited water sliding angles <0.5°, and reduced adhesion under the tested conditions. SASLIPS decreased the coefficient of friction (COF) from 0.69 (NiTi) to 0.09 (SASLIPS), reduced biliary sludge accretion, inhibited 96.98% of E. coli adhesion and biofilm formation, and attenuated inflammatory responses, while preserving macroscopic thermally induced shape recovery. Molecular dynamics simulations supported favorable interactions between perfluorooctyltrichlorosilane (PFOTS) and perfluorodecalin (PFD) and showed that the PFD‐rich interfacial region reduced water and cholesterol access to the modeled substrate. In a porcine study with independent 1‐ and 6‐month cohorts, SASLIPS‐coatedstents showed 89.92% lower sludge‐associated autofluorescence than bare NiTi stents at 1 month and no gross evidence of luminal obstruction at the 6‐month retrieval. This work established a liquid‐infused fluorinated surface strategy for engineering anti‐fouling, anti‐inflammatory, and mechanically compatible biliary stents, and offered a materials‐driven solution to persistent interfacial failure in biofluid‐rich implant environments.

papers.title_zh: 镍钛胆道支架功能表面自组装用于增强抗污和低摩擦行为
papers.summary_zh: 该研究受糖萼低黏附界面启发，在镍钛胆道支架上构建自组装滑液注入多孔表面，显著降低摩擦系数、抑制细菌黏附和生物膜形成，并在猪模型中减少污泥沉积且保持形状记忆功能。
papers.research_details_zh: 本文针对镍钛（NiTi）胆道支架在生物流体环境中易受机械刺激、细菌定植、污泥沉积和炎症相关再狭窄的问题，受天然糖萼动态低黏附界面功能启发，设计自组装滑液注入多孔表面（SASLIPS）。材料体系为NiTi支架表面的氟化多孔层与全氟萘烷（PFD）注入液相。研究过程包括表面改性形成连续注液架构、水滑动角与黏附测试、摩擦系数测试、污泥沉积与大肠杆菌黏附和生物膜抑制评价、炎症响应评估以及宏观热致形状恢复验证；分子动力学模拟用于支持全氟辛基三氯硅烷（PFOTS）与PFD的有利相互作用及PFD富集界面降低水和胆固醇接近模型基底。猪研究采用独立1个月和6个月队列评价污泥相关自发荧光和管腔阻塞。意义在于提出面向生物流体富集植入环境的液注氟化表面抗污策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及在NiTi支架上自组装构建SASLIPS表面，水滑动角与黏附测试，摩擦系数测试，污泥沉积评价，大肠杆菌黏附和生物膜抑制实验，炎症响应评估，宏观热致形状恢复观察，分子动力学模拟，以及猪1个月和6个月队列的污泥相关自发荧光和管腔阻塞评价。摘要未报告具体涂层表征手段和模拟参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文核心是医用镍钛支架的表面抗污与低摩擦改性，与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料及框架材料电化学合成主线关联较弱；其自组装和注液多孔表面策略对界面工程有方法学参考，但并非框架材料研究。摘要数据完整度较高，若关注生物医用表面自组装可略读，对框架材料主线全文精读价值有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级解读；涂层化学组成细节、多孔结构表征、模拟参数、动物实验样本量和统计方法仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: SASLIPS形成连续注液架构，水滑动角小于0.5°。
摩擦系数由NiTi的0.69降至SASLIPS的0.09。
抑制96.98%的大肠杆菌黏附和生物膜形成，并减轻炎症响应，同时保持宏观热致形状恢复。
猪1个月队列中SASLIPS涂层支架污泥相关自发荧光较裸NiTi低89.92%，6个月回收未见管腔阻塞的肉眼证据。

papers.title: Emergent Molecular Weaving in an Ionic Metal‐Organic Network for CO 2 Conversion
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Molecular weaving has emerged as a powerful design strategy in supramolecular chemistry, yet most woven frameworks rely on rigid ligands and elaborate templating. Here, we report a minimalistic, aqueous‐phase synthesis of a woven metal‐organic superstructure assembled from Cu 2+ and 2,4,6‐trinitrobenzene‐1,3,5‐triol (TNPG). In the crystal, asymmetric coordination of TNPG with Cu 2+ yields charged one‐dimensional (1D) polymeric strands featuring both distorted octahedral and square planar geometries. These strands interlace at a specific angle to form a two‐dimensional (2D) woven architecture, a rare 1D─1D topological weaving stabilized by hydrogen bonding. The structure also incorporates discrete Cu 2+ cationic complexes, where metal coordination significantly perturbs the aromatic π‐conjugated system of TNPG. These cationic units are tethered within the network through strong hydrogen bonding and electrostatic attraction to the anionic woven strands, contributing to the structural integrity of the superstructure. Given the redox‐active Cu 2+ centers, electronically modulated ligand environment, and framework stability, the Cu‐TNPG network was evaluated for visible‐light‐driven CO 2 reduction. The photocatalytic performance of Cu‐TNPG originates from its high charge separation efficiency and abundant catalytically active sites. Moreover, mild thermal pre‐activation led to enhanced CO evolution efficiency through structural modulations, with a selectivity of ∼85% for CO over H 2 , highlighting its structural and functional versatility.
