papers.title_zh: 离子型金属有机网络中的涌现分子编织用于CO2转化
papers.summary_zh: 该文以Cu2+与TNPG在水相中简约合成一种编织金属有机超结构，由带电一维链交织成二维编织网络，并含离散Cu2+阳离子单元；该网络用于可见光驱动CO2还原，热预活化后CO选择性约85%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对多数编织框架依赖刚性配体和复杂模板的问题，提出水相简约合成由Cu2+与2,4,6-三硝基苯-1,3,5-三酚（TNPG）组装的编织金属有机超结构。晶体中TNPG与Cu2+的不对称配位形成同时具有畸变八面体和平面正方形几何的带电一维聚合物链，这些链以特定角度交织成二维编织架构，属于少见的由氢键稳定的1D─1D拓扑编织。结构还包含离散Cu2+阳离子配合物，其金属配位显著扰动TNPG的芳香π共轭体系，这些阳离子单元通过强氢键和静电吸引固定于阴离子编织链之间，增强超结构完整性。基于氧化还原活性Cu2+中心、电子调制配体环境和框架稳定性，作者评估了Cu-TNPG网络的可见光驱动CO2还原性能，并考察温和热预活化对结构调制和CO析出效率的影响。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：采用水相合成制备Cu-TNPG网络；通过晶体结构分析确定一维链配位几何、链间交织角度及二维编织拓扑，并识别离散Cu2+阳离子单元及其与编织链的氢键和静电作用；评估可见光驱动CO2还原性能，考察电荷分离效率与催化活性位点；采用温和热预活化进行结构调制并比较CO析出效率与CO/H2选择性。其他合成条件、表征手段和测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于配位框架的组装与拓扑编织，展示水相简约合成、1D─1D编织及离散金属单元协同稳定超结构的策略，并将编织结构与可见光CO2还原性能关联，对框架材料组装和催化功能化有参考价值。但其并非介孔或导电MOF主线，摘要未报告孔结构、导电性及长期稳定性，建议作为编织拓扑与后处理调制的拓展案例浏览，是否精读需全文核查。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级信息。合成配比、温度、晶体学参数、光催化测试条件、热预活化具体温度、表观量子效率及稳定性数据等关键细节均需全文核查，摘要未报告处不得推断。
key_findings_zh: Cu-TNPG形成由带电一维聚合物链以特定角度交织、经氢键稳定的二维1D─1D拓扑编织结构。
离散Cu2+阳离子配合物的金属配位显著扰动TNPG的芳香π共轭体系，并通过强氢键和静电吸引固定于阴离子编织链间。
Cu-TNPG的光催化CO2还原性能源于高电荷分离效率和丰富催化活性位点。
温和热预活化通过结构调制提升CO析出效率，CO相对H2的选择性约为85%。

papers.title: Asymmetric Interfacial Stress-Driven Demulsification in Heterogeneous Wetting MOF Beds
papers.abstract: Abstract Separating surfactant-stabilized dual-type oil/water emulsions remains challenging due to the intrinsic limitations of traditional single-wettability filters. Herein, a heterogeneous composite particle-based bed was constructed by blending pristine hydrophilic MOF UiO-66-NH2 with oleyl phosphate-modified hydrophobic MOF UiO-66-NH2–OP. The mixed bed combines droplet capture with interfacial destabilization: tortuous interparticle channels promote hydrodynamic deformation, while adjacent domains of contrasting wettability are proposed to induce asymmetric interfacial stresses and Marangoni-driven film disruption. Subsequent droplet coalescence and interception enable separation of both emulsion types. Filtration tests proved the composite bed outperformed single-wettability counterparts for dual-type emulsions, achieving over 90% rejection and a peak permeance of 5861.3 L·m–2·h–1·bar–1. This work establishes an emulsion separation strategy via MOF wettability modulation and particle-bed construction, shedding light on the design of high-performance, tunable separation materials.

papers.title_zh: 异质润湿MOF床层中不对称界面应力驱动破乳
papers.summary_zh: 该文将亲水UiO-66-NH2与疏水UiO-66-NH2–OP混合构建异质复合颗粒床，利用相邻反差润湿域诱导不对称界面应力和Marangoni驱动膜破裂，实现双类型乳液分离，截留率超90%，峰值渗透率达5861.3 L·m–2·h–1·bar–1。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对表面活性剂稳定的双类型油水乳液难以用单一润湿性滤材分离的问题，构建异质复合颗粒床：将原始亲水MOF UiO-66-NH2与油基磷酸修饰的疏水MOF UiO-66-NH2–OP共混。该混合床结合液滴捕获与界面失稳：颗粒间曲折通道促进液滴发生流体力学变形，而相邻的反差润湿域被提出可诱导不对称界面应力和Marangoni驱动的液膜破裂，随后液滴聚并和被拦截，从而分离两种类型乳液。过滤测试证明复合床对双类型乳液的分离性能优于单一润湿性对照，截留率超过90%，峰值渗透率达5861.3 L·m–2·h–1·bar–1。该工作建立了通过MOF润湿性调制和颗粒床构建实现乳液分离的策略，为高性能可调分离材料设计提供思路。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：以油基磷酸对UiO-66-NH2进行疏水改性制备UiO-66-NH2–OP，并与原始亲水UiO-66-NH2共混构建异质复合颗粒床；通过过滤测试评价对表面活性剂稳定的双类型油水乳液的分离性能，测定截留率和渗透率，并与单一润湿性床层对照；机制层面提出曲折通道促进液滴变形及反差润湿域诱导不对称界面应力和Marangoni驱动膜破裂。具体改性条件、床层参数和表征手段摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作聚焦MOF颗粒床的润湿性调制与界面组装，提出异质润湿域驱动破乳的分离策略，对框架材料在乳液分离和界面工程中的应用有实际参考价值。其与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成主线关联较弱，摘要亦未报告孔结构、导电性及长期运行稳定性，建议作为MOF润湿性调控与颗粒床构建的拓展案例浏览，是否精读需全文核查。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级信息。MOF改性程度、颗粒尺寸、床层填充参数、乳液体系组成、测试循环与稳定性、界面应力与Marangoni效应的直接实验证据等关键细节均需全文核查，摘要未报告处不得推断。
key_findings_zh: 亲水UiO-66-NH2与疏水UiO-66-NH2–OP共混的异质颗粒床对双类型乳液分离优于单一润湿性对照。
复合床实现超过90%的截留率和5861.3 L·m–2·h–1·bar–1的峰值渗透率。
提出相邻反差润湿域诱导不对称界面应力和Marangoni驱动液膜破裂，随后液滴聚并和被拦截的分离机制。

papers.title: Aligned Self-Assembled Nanostructure by Chemical Force Trigger, Biased Migration, and Oscillatory Hydrogel Growth
papers.abstract: Abstract Cells generate pico-to-nanonewton forces through metabolic circuits and diffusion for downstream processes, including stress fiber assembly and cellular growth. The inherent complexities of the system’s processing, reactivity, and adaptability make it difficult to recapitulate in a synthetic setting. Herein, we compartmentalized the urease-urea feedback-controlled reaction network (FCRN), demonstrating global vs local function adaptability by coupling with peptide self-assembly. Compartmentalized FCRN (c-FCRN) facilitates chemical energy-to-mechanical energy conversion, creating forces on the piconewton scale, allowing nanofiber alignment, akin to what a cell does. The trade-off between multiple microscale interactions in the chemo-material network implies molecular-biased migration resembling chemotactic-like directed motion in synthetic settings, which promotes spatial self-assembly remodelling. Consequently, regulating the reaction-diffusion chemistry, we demonstrate oscillatory hydrogel growth by encasing the c-FCRN with a physical membrane barrier. Furthermore, c-FCRN provides a rudimentary structure-building system to create various complex hydrogel structures, bypassing the 3D printing tools. Thus, the chemo-material network provides proof-of-concept for biomimetic material development by emulating biologically inspired technologies.

papers.title_zh: 化学力触发、偏置迁移与振荡水凝胶生长实现取向自组装纳米结构
papers.summary_zh: 该文将脲酶-尿素反馈控制反应网络区室化，并与肽自组装耦合，实现皮牛顿级化学力到机械力的转换和纳米纤维取向，展示类趋化偏置迁移及受膜屏障约束的振荡水凝胶生长，为无需3D打印的复杂水凝胶结构构建提供概念验证。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对细胞通过代谢回路和扩散产生皮至纳牛顿力以驱动应力纤维组装和细胞生长等过程，而合成体系难以复现其复杂性、反应性和适应性这一问题，将脲酶-尿素反馈控制反应网络（FCRN）区室化，并与肽自组装耦合，以展示全局与局部功能的适应性。区室化FCRN（c-FCRN）促进化学能向机械能转换，产生皮牛顿级力，使纳米纤维取向，类似细胞行为。化学-材料网络中多种微尺度相互作用之间的权衡意味着分子偏置迁移，类似合成体系中的趋化性定向运动，促进空间自组装重塑。通过调控反应-扩散化学，并用物理膜屏障包裹c-FCRN，作者展示了振荡水凝胶生长。此外，c-FCRN提供基础的结构构建系统，可绕过3D打印工具制备多种复杂水凝胶结构，为仿生材料开发提供概念验证。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：将脲酶-尿素反馈控制反应网络进行区室化，并与肽自组装耦合构建化学-材料网络；通过该体系实现化学能向机械能转换并产生皮牛顿级力，观察纳米纤维取向；调控反应-扩散化学，并以物理膜屏障包裹c-FCRN实现振荡水凝胶生长；利用该体系构建多种复杂水凝胶结构。具体区室化方式、肽序列、力测量手段、振荡周期和结构表征方法摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装与反应-扩散调控的交叉方向，展示化学力触发取向组装、偏置迁移和振荡生长，对自组装技术和动态水凝胶结构构建有概念性参考价值。其不涉及介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，摘要也未报告框架材料相关内容，建议作为自组装与仿生动态体系的拓展阅读，是否精读需结合全文核查。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级信息。区室化构建细节、肽分子设计、皮牛顿力的测量方法与数值、振荡生长周期与幅度、结构分辨率表征及普适性边界等关键细节均需全文核查，摘要未报告处不得推断。
key_findings_zh: 区室化脲酶-尿素反馈控制反应网络与肽自组装耦合，实现化学能向机械能转换并产生皮牛顿级力，驱动纳米纤维取向。
化学-材料网络中的多尺度相互作用权衡导致分子偏置迁移，类似趋化性定向运动，促进空间自组装重塑。
通过调控反应-扩散化学并以物理膜屏障包裹c-FCRN，实现振荡水凝胶生长。
c-FCRN可作为基础结构构建系统，绕过3D打印制备多种复杂水凝胶结构。

papers.title: Metal–Organic Framework Synthesis Strategies for Efficient Encapsulation and Sustained Release of Bioactive Compounds
papers.abstract: Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) have emerged as versatile carriers for biomedical applications because of their tunable porosity, high surface area, and structural robustness. Their biocompatibility depends on carefully selecting nontoxic metals such as Fe, Zn, or Mg; safe organic ligands, including carboxylates, imidazolates, and pyridines; and stabilizing coatings such as polyethylene glycol (PEG), chitosan, and polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) that enhance aqueous stability and enable controlled release. Conventional synthesis methods typically yield highly crystalline frameworks but require long reaction times and extensive solvent use. In contrast, nonconventional approaches are gaining popularity for their faster, energy‐efficient methods. Techniques such as microwave irradiation, sonochemical activation, and electrochemical synthesis provide rapid, controllable conditions that reduce energy consumption and shorten reaction times. In particular, mechanochemical encapsulation is an eco‐friendly, sustainable, scalable, and high‐yield methodology that enables in situ entrapment of bioactive molecules and enhances adsorption capacity. Moreover, the mechanochemical methodology enables modulation of physicochemical parameters such as morphology and particle size, which critically influence adsorption behavior and host–guest interactions. Examples of encapsulation processes involving antidiabetic agents, anticancer therapeutics, and antioxidants are presented, and these can be translated into mechanochemical approaches. In this regard, MOFs stand out as promising platforms for targeted delivery and sustained release. Integrating rational component selection, coating strategies, and sustainable synthesis methodologies positions MOFs as next‐generation biocompatible carriers for precision biomedical applications.

papers.title_zh: 用于生物活性化合物高效封装与持续释放的金属有机框架合成策略
papers.summary_zh: 该综述讨论MOF作为生物医学载体的组分选择、涂层稳定化及合成策略，重点比较常规合成与微波、声化学、电化学和机械化学等非常规方法，强调机械化学封装在绿色、可放大和原位包封方面的优势。
papers.research_details_zh: 该文聚焦MOF在生物活性化合物封装与持续释放中的应用，提出生物相容性取决于无毒金属（Fe、Zn、Mg）、安全有机配体（羧酸盐、咪唑盐、吡啶类）以及PEG、壳聚糖、PVP等稳定涂层的合理选择。文章指出常规合成通常得到高结晶框架，但反应时间长、溶剂用量大；非常规方法如微波辐照、声化学活化和电化学合成可提供快速、可控、低能耗和短反应时间的条件。特别强调机械化学封装是一种环境友好、可持续、可放大且高产率的方法，可实现生物活性分子的原位包封并提高吸附容量，同时可调控形貌和粒径等影响吸附行为与主客体相互作用的物理化学参数。文中还列举了抗糖尿病药物、抗癌治疗剂和抗氧化剂的封装过程，并讨论其向机械化学方法的转化。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的合成方法包括常规合成、微波辐照、声化学活化、电化学合成和机械化学封装；材料设计涉及金属节点、有机配体及PEG、壳聚糖、PVP等涂层策略；应用示例涵盖抗糖尿病药物、抗癌治疗剂和抗氧化剂的封装。摘要未报告具体表征技术、性能测试条件和定量释放数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文与框架材料组装和电化学合成主线相关，尤其提供MOF非常规合成与机械化学封装的策略框架，对理解框架材料在生物医学载体中的设计逻辑有参考价值。但其侧重综述性策略归纳，摘要未给出具体实验数据和机制证据，若需方法细节和性能对比，建议全文精读并核查。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级信息。摘要未报告具体金属/配体组合、封装效率、释放曲线、表征手段、细胞或动物实验条件及定量性能数据，相关关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: MOF的生物相容性依赖无毒金属、安全配体和稳定涂层的协同选择。
微波、声化学和电化学合成可缩短反应时间并降低能耗，相较常规合成更具快速可控性。
机械化学封装被描述为环境友好、可持续、可放大、高产率且可原位包封生物活性分子的方法。
形貌和粒径等物理化学参数会显著影响吸附行为与主客体相互作用。

papers.title: A Precursor Design Principle for Archipelagic Hard‐Carbon Structural Evolution Through Cohesion–Solvation Regulation of Asphaltene Molecular Heterogeneity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Sodium‐ion batteries are central to the development of affordable electrochemical storage for renewable energy integration. Yet hard‐carbon anode design lacks a precursor‐level principle linking molecular assembly in chemically heterogeneous feedstocks to oxidative stabilization and closed‐pore formation. Here we establish a precursor‐level cohesion‐solvation design principle for regulating molecular selection and assembly in heterogeneous aromatic feedstocks. Toluene‐fractionated asphaltene precursors undergo oxidative crosslinking, redirecting carbonization from continuous coke‐like growth toward separated turbostratic domains and confined closed pores. A hard‐carbon performance screening index (HPSI) quantifies structural and electrochemical performance, while density functional theory (DFT) reveals stronger Na affinity and lower migration barriers in defect‐engineered carbon galleries. The solvent‐selected AHC‐80‐1400 delivers 400.1 mAh g −1 at 0.05 A g −1 with 87.7% ICE and retains 92.3% capacity after 10 000 cycles, while sustaining wide‐temperature sodium storage with 91.8% and 90.4% retention at −20°C and 50°C, respectively. At scale, a 10‐kg batch enables a 1.18 Ah NFM||AHC‐80‐1400 pouch cell, delivering 163.3 Wh kg −1 and 95.5% retention after 700 cycles. A cradle‐to‐gate life‐cycle assessment (LCA) shows that AHC‐80‐1400 production reduces climate‐change impact by 33.7% relative to Commercial HC. These findings establish precursor‐stage molecular selection as a design principle for harnessing feedstock heterogeneity to control carbonization trajectories and electrochemical function.

papers.title_zh: 通过沥青质分子异质性的内聚-溶剂化调控实现群岛型硬碳结构演化的前驱体设计原则
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出前驱体层面的内聚-溶剂化设计原则，利用甲苯分级沥青质前驱体经氧化交联调控碳化路径，形成分离的乱层结构域和封闭孔，并实现高性能、宽温域和可放大的钠离子电池硬碳负极。
papers.research_details_zh: 该文针对钠离子电池硬碳负极设计缺乏从前驱体分子组装到氧化稳定化和封闭孔形成之间联系的问题，建立前驱体层面的内聚-溶剂化设计原则，用于调控化学异质芳香原料中的分子选择和组装。甲苯分级沥青质前驱体经历氧化交联，使碳化从连续焦炭状生长转向分离的乱层结构域和受限封闭孔。研究提出硬碳性能筛选指数（HPSI）以量化结构和电化学性能，并用密度泛函理论（DFT）揭示缺陷工程碳层间具有更强Na亲和力和更低迁移势垒。溶剂选择的AHC-80-1400在0.05 A g−1下提供400.1 mAh g−1容量、87.7%首次库仑效率，并在10000次循环后保持92.3%容量；在−20°C和50°C下分别保持91.8%和90.4%容量。10 kg批次可制备1.18 Ah NFM||AHC-80-1400软包电池，提供163.3 Wh kg−1并在700次循环后保持95.5%。 cradle-to-gate生命周期评估显示，相较商业硬碳，AHC-80-1400生产使气候变化影响降低33.7%。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括甲苯分级处理沥青质前驱体、氧化交联、碳化、硬碳性能筛选指数（HPSI）评估、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、电化学性能测试（容量、首次库仑效率、循环稳定性、宽温域测试）、10 kg批次放大和软包电池制备，以及cradle-to-gate生命周期评估（LCA）。摘要未报告具体氧化交联条件、碳化温度程序、表征手段和DFT计算细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文虽非MOF/COF/HOF体系，但其前驱体分子组装调控、受限封闭孔形成和碳化路径设计，对框架材料衍生碳、介孔/微孔结构调控及电化学储能研究有方法学借鉴价值。定量电化学数据和放大验证较完整，若关注前驱体组装与孔结构—性能关系，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级信息。摘要未报告前驱体分级具体条件、氧化交联参数、碳化程序、表征技术、DFT模型细节及软包电池测试协议，相关关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: AHC-80-1400在0.05 A g−1下提供400.1 mAh g−1容量和87.7%首次库仑效率，10000次循环后容量保持92.3%。
该材料在−20°C和50°C下分别保持91.8%和90.4%容量，展现宽温域钠存储能力。

papers.title: General Synthesis of Inverse Opal Covalent Organic Framework Photonic Crystals
papers.abstract: Abstract Constructing highly crystalline inverse opal covalent organic framework photonic crystals (IO COF PhCs) remains challenging due to the incompatibility between the spatial confinement required for inverse opal replication and the synthesis process of COFs. Inspired by the semi-solid chitin infiltration and confined solidification process in beetle photonic architectures, a solvent-free template-assisted melt pressing (STAMP) strategy is developed for the general synthesis of crystalline IO COF PhCs. The quasi-solid precursor state facilitates efficient template infiltration while remaining reactive for COF crystallization, affording ordered macroporous photonic architectures within 3 min. This strategy is broadly applicable to a library of 16 COFs spanning β-ketoenamine, hydrazone, imine, and imide linkages, yielding decimeter-scale monoliths with designable structural colors across the visible spectrum. By integrating periodic macroporosity, permanent framework porosity, and photonic functionality into one material platform, the resulting IO COF PhCs enable cross-scale programmable optical encoding and visually self-reporting adsorption. The application potential of IO COF PhCs is demonstrated for biomimetic anti-counterfeiting patterns and structural-color-indicated Au capture. This work establishes a general route toward crystalline IO COF PhCs and provides a versatile platform for coupling molecular functionality with photonic regulation in advanced smart materials.

papers.title: Suppressing Ostwald Ripening Enables Programmable Growth of Radially Hierarchical MOF Superstructures Toward Multichannel Optical Waveguiding
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Metal‐organic frameworks (MOF) homostructures or heterostructures with domain‐controlled emissive colors have demonstrated significant potential for high‐throughput sensing, anti‐counterfeiting, and information encryption. However, the precise construction of heterostructures with radially branched units remains challenging, primarily because the Ostwald ripening effect during crystal growth tends to drive one‐dimensional elongation. Here, we propose a programmable nucleation‐controlled strategy to spatially construct radially hierarchical MOF superstructures. During crystal growth, suppression of the Ostwald ripening effect triggers stable nucleation events in the system. Subsequently, the relatively high surface energy at the tips of 1D microrods promotes the secondary nucleation on the terminal facets, thereby leading to the formation of radially hierarchical superstructures. The acquired radial architectures with small angular deviations enable efficient multichannel optical signal output. The suppressing‐Ostwald‐ripening‐driven programmable growth paradigm provides a new route for the synthesis of multichannel waveguiding heterostructures and shows broad application prospects in advanced optoelectronic devices, multi‐channel information transmission, and encryption technologies.

papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对具有域控发光颜色的MOF同质或异质结构在传感、防伪和信息加密中的潜力，但径向分支异质结构精确构建困难的问题。核心难点在于晶体生长过程中的奥斯特瓦尔德熟化效应倾向于驱动一维伸长，不利于径向分级结构的形成。作者提出可编程成核控制策略：在晶体生长过程中抑制奥斯特瓦尔德熟化效应，使体系发生稳定的成核事件；随后利用一维微棒尖端较高的表面能促进端面上的二次成核，从而形成径向分级超结构。所得径向架构具有较小的角度偏差，可实现高效的多通道光学信号输出。该抑制奥斯特瓦尔德熟化驱动的可编程生长范式为多通道波导异质结构合成提供了新路线，在先进光电器件、多通道信息传输和加密技术中具有应用前景。摘要未报告具体MOF组成、配体种类、合成温度、溶剂体系及波导性能的定量数值。

papers.title: Synergistic Interaction Engineering Enables Homogeneous Mixed‐Cation Perovskite Single Crystals for High‐Performance X‐Ray Detection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Mixed A‐site compositions are an effective route to boost the x‐ray detection performance of perovskite single crystals, yet their growth is often accompanied by pronounced spatial compositional inhomogeneity. This macroscopic phase segregation originates from mismatched formation energies and crystallization kinetics among the different cation components, leading to internal composition gradients that hinder carrier transport but are rarely addressed in perovskite single‐crystal research. Here, we report an acetic acid‐enabled synergistic interaction‐engineering strategy for growing phase‐homogeneous mixed‐cation perovskite single crystals. Acetic acid simultaneously lowers the formation barrier of the formamidinium‐rich phase and suppresses the rapid assembly of the methylammonium‐rich phase, thereby balancing their crystallization rates and eliminating compositional gradients across the crystal. Owing to the improved uniformity and crystal quality, x‐ray detectors based on these single crystals deliver a sensitivity of 3.54 × 10 6 µC Gy −1 cm −2 , a low detection limit of 2.65 nGy s −1 , and excellent operational stability. This kinetic‐regulation concept offers a practical pathway to homogeneous mixed‐cation perovskite single crystals and supports their use in low‐dose, high‐performance optoelectronic devices.

papers.title: Low-Temperature Aqueous Upgrading of Waste PET Plastics into Metal–Organic Frameworks with Confined PdNi Clusters for High-Performance Semihydrogenation of Alkynes
papers.abstract: Abstract The selective semihydrogenation of alkynes to alkenes is an important industrial process for the production of bulk and fine chemicals. However, the activity and selectivity trade-off of alkyne hydrogenation has been a long-standing challenge, due to undesirable overhydrogenation or insufficient activity of the designed catalysts. Here, we report a sustainable route for high-performance alkyne hydrogenation using a metal–organic framework (MOF) confined PdNi cluster (PdcNi) catalyst, synthesized directly from waste polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastics under low-temperature aqueous conditions. The PdcNi@UiO-66 catalyst with dispersed Pd clusters anchored on Ni clusters not only maximizes Pd utilization but also establishes a new pathway for the recycling of plastics. Importantly, when employed as a catalyst for phenylacetylene semihydrogenation, PdcNi@UiO-66 exhibited outstanding activity and selectivity, achieving a turnover frequency (TOF) of up to 67,470 h–1 at 65 °C. This performance significantly surpasses that of previously reported catalysts and is nearly 20 times higher than that of the commercial Lindlar catalyst. DFT calculations combined with experimental results reveal that the PdcNi cluster exhibits a moderate adsorption strength toward both reactants and target products, compared with its nanoparticle and single-atom counterparts. This balanced adsorption leads to a more favorable thermodynamic tendency for styrene desorption rather than overhydrogenation, ultimately contributing to the high activity and selectivity. This study demonstrates a direct route to transforming PET waste into high-performance MOF-based catalysts for selective hydrogenation, offering a cost-effective and sustainable solution for plastic recycling and the development of high-performance catalysts.

papers.title: From Coacervates to Ordered Lattices: Sequence‐Guided Condensation of Polyelectrolyte Complexes Through Designed Coiled‐Coil Peptides
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Electrostatic complexation of oppositely charged biomacromolecules produces a spectrum of condensed phases, from liquid coacervates to ordered solids. Yet the underlying amino acid sequence‐level rules remain poorly understood. Here, we utilize computationally designed coiled‐coil peptide “bundlemers” as a programmable platform to systematically investigate these principles. This study demonstrates that precise control over the material phase formed through electrostatic complexation is achieved through subtle amino acid sequence modifications. By tuning coiled coil terminal motifs and surface charge distribution, bundlemer‐polypeptide complexation can span liquid coacervates, soft solids, or solid precipitates. Specifically, bundlemer coiled coil nanoparticles with +24 charge were complexed with different lengths of polyanionic polypeptide. Nanoparticles with a mixed charge character containing both acidic and basic amino acids produced coacervate phases. When the bundlemers displayed only basic amino acids making a single charge‐type +24 nanoparticle, solid precipitates with specific hexagonal lattice symmetry were formed. When the charge character was flipped with negatively charged bundlemers and positively charged polypeptide, similar hexagonally packed complexes were formed. This work establishes a robust framework for programming the self‐assembly of polyelectrolyte‐based soft matter, offering a sequence‐guided pathway from disordered liquid condensates to precisely defined, ordered nanomaterials.

papers.title_zh: 从凝聚层到有序晶格：通过设计的卷曲螺旋肽实现聚电解质复合物的序列引导凝聚
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以计算设计的卷曲螺旋肽“束聚体”为可编程平台，揭示氨基酸序列细微修饰可调控聚电解质复合物的相行为，实现从液态凝聚层、软固体到具有六方晶格对称性固体沉淀的可控转变，为序列引导的自组装提供框架。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对带相反电荷生物大分子静电复合形成凝聚层至有序固体过程中氨基酸序列层面规律不清的问题，采用计算设计的卷曲螺旋肽纳米颗粒（bundlemers）作为可编程平台。通过调节卷曲螺旋末端基序和表面电荷分布，将带+24电荷的束聚体与不同长度的聚阴离子多肽复合。结果显示，同时含酸性和碱性氨基酸的混合电荷纳米颗粒形成凝聚层相；仅显示碱性氨基酸的单一电荷型+24纳米颗粒则形成具有特定六方晶格对称性的固体沉淀；将电荷性质翻转、使用带负电束聚体与带正电多肽也形成类似的六方堆积复合物。该工作建立了编程聚电解质软物质自组装的稳健框架，提供从无序液态凝聚物到精确有序纳米材料的序列引导路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用计算设计的卷曲螺旋肽“束聚体”作为平台，将带+24电荷的束聚体纳米颗粒与不同长度的聚阴离子多肽进行静电复合，并通过调节卷曲螺旋末端基序和表面电荷分布系统考察相行为。摘要提及对形成的液态凝聚层、软固体和固体沉淀进行相态识别，并报告固体沉淀具有特定六方晶格对称性。摘要未报告具体的表征仪器、测试条件及定量参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与自组装技术及框架材料组装主线相关，提供了利用序列设计编程静电复合相行为、从无序凝聚层向有序晶格转变的思路，对理解软物质自组装和有序纳米材料构建有参考价值。但其体系为肽-聚电解质复合物，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料， relevance有限，可作为自组装调控策略的拓展阅读，是否精读全文取决于对肽基有序组装兴趣。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体表征手段、晶格参数、力学或流变数据、复合物组成比例及形成条件等关键细节，仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过调节卷曲螺旋末端基序和表面电荷分布，束聚体-多肽复合可跨越液态凝聚层、软固体或固体沉淀等不同相态。
含酸性和碱性氨基酸的混合电荷+24束聚体纳米颗粒与聚阴离子多肽复合时形成凝聚层相。
仅显示碱性氨基酸的单一电荷型+24束聚体纳米颗粒形成具有特定六方晶格对称性的固体沉淀。
电荷性质翻转后，带负电束聚体与带正电多肽也形成类似的六方堆积复合物。

papers.title: Manganese-Coordinated Rhein Hydrogel as a Vaccine Adjuvant for Synergistically Enhanced Humoral and Cellular Immunity
papers.abstract: Abstract Manganese ions (Mn2+), which act as agonists of the cGAS-STING pathway, hold considerable promise as vaccine adjuvants. However, free Mn2+ is rapidly cleared after injection, making it difficult to sustain local immune stimulation. In this study, we exploited the coordination between Mn2+ and rhein, a naturally occurring anthraquinone small molecule, to construct a novel injectable Rhe@Mn hydrogel through one-step self-assembly. Within the hydrogel, densely packed supramolecular nanofibers intertwine to form a three-dimensional network, and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) confirmed the uniform distribution of Mn along the nanofibers. Rheological testing showed that the Rhe@Mn hydrogel had favorable viscoelasticity and structural stability. In vitro studies, the Rhe@Mn hydrogel retained the STING-agonist activity of Mn2+ and effectively promoted antigen uptake by DCs and their maturation. In vivo, the hydrogel formed an antigen depot at the injection site, enabling sustained antigen release for up to 10 days. It also efficiently recruited immune cells, including DCs and macrophages, thereby establishing a local immune microenvironment enriched in antigen-presenting cells. After a single immunization, the Rhe@Mn hydrogel vaccine increased the abundance of germinal-center B (GC B) cells in lymph nodes by approximately 3.7-fold, significantly enhanced antigen-specific humoral and cellular immune responses, and established durable immune memory. This study provides a facile, functionally integrated platform for adjuvant-antigen co-delivery in subunit vaccines.

papers.title_zh: 锰配位大黄酸水凝胶作为疫苗佐剂协同增强体液和细胞免疫
papers.summary_zh: 研究利用Mn2+与天然蒽醌小分子大黄酸的配位作用，一步自组装构建可注射Rhe@Mn水凝胶。该凝胶由超分子纳米纤维交织成三维网络，保留STING激动活性，形成抗原储库并持续释放抗原10天，单次免疫显著增强体液和细胞免疫及免疫记忆。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对游离Mn2+注射后快速清除、难以维持局部免疫刺激的问题，利用Mn2+与天然蒽醌小分子大黄酸之间的配位作用，通过一步自组装构建新型可注射Rhe@Mn水凝胶。摘要报告水凝胶内密集堆积的超分子纳米纤维交织形成三维网络，EDS确认Mn沿纳米纤维均匀分布，流变测试显示良好黏弹性和结构稳定性。体外研究表明水凝胶保留Mn2+的STING激动活性，有效促进DC对抗原的摄取和成熟。体内水凝胶在注射部位形成抗原储库，持续释放抗原长达10天，并有效招募DC和巨噬细胞等免疫细胞，建立富含抗原呈递细胞的局部免疫微环境。单次免疫后，水凝胶疫苗使淋巴结生发中心B细胞丰度提高约3.7倍，显著增强抗原特异性体液和细胞免疫应答，并建立持久免疫记忆。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用Mn2+与大黄酸配位的一步自组装构建可注射水凝胶；使用能量色散X射线光谱（EDS）确认Mn沿纳米纤维均匀分布；采用流变测试评价黏弹性和结构稳定性；体外评估STING激动活性、DC抗原摄取和成熟；体内评估抗原储库形成、抗原释放时长、免疫细胞招募及单次免疫后的生发中心B细胞丰度和抗原特异性免疫应答。摘要未报告具体表征仪器型号和测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于配位自组装水凝胶与免疫佐剂方向，与自组装技术及配位材料相关，但并非介孔导电MOF、共轭MOF/COF/HOF或介孔材料，对框架材料组装和电化学合成主线价值有限。其配位驱动一步自组装和纳米纤维网络构建策略可作为超分子组装拓展参考，不建议作为核心全文精读，除非关注生物医学自组装应用。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告水凝胶具体组成比例、纳米纤维尺寸、流变参数、抗原释放曲线细节、免疫细胞定量数据及机制证据等，仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Rhe@Mn水凝胶由超分子纳米纤维交织成三维网络，EDS确认Mn沿纳米纤维均匀分布，流变测试显示良好黏弹性和结构稳定性。
水凝胶在体外保留Mn2+的STING激动活性，促进DC抗原摄取和成熟；体内形成抗原储库，持续释放抗原长达10天。
单次免疫后淋巴结生发中心B细胞丰度提高约3.7倍，显著增强抗原特异性体液和细胞免疫应答并建立持久免疫记忆。

papers.title: Interfacial Charge Modulation of Covalent Metal–Organic Frameworks for Efficient H 2 O 2 Electrosynthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Electrochemical H 2 O 2 synthesis through the two‐electron oxygen reduction reaction offers a sustainable alternative to the energy‐intensive anthraquinone process. Crystalline porous frameworks are attractive for this route because of their structural precision, yet poor electrolyte wetting and limited electrochemical accessibility often restrict their practical performance. Here, we report an interfacial charge‐modulation strategy that transforms covalent metal–organic frameworks into highly wetted and electrochemically accessible catalytic interfaces. By incorporating cationic ethidium bromide units into a trinuclear copper‐pyrazolate framework, we construct EB‐Cu 3 ‐COF featuring enlarged interlayer spacing, enhanced interfacial charge transfer, and optimized *OOH intermediate adsorption. Consequently, EB‐Cu 3 ‐COF achieves up to 99% H 2 O 2 selectivity and a flow‐cell production rate of 39 420 mmol·g cat −1 ·h −1 , ranking among the best‐performing non‐pyrolyzed porous organic electrocatalysts reported to date. This work establishes interfacial charge‐modulation as a design principle for translating crystalline structural precision into electrochemically active interfaces.

papers.title_zh: 共价金属有机框架的界面电荷调控用于高效过氧化氢电合成
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出界面电荷调控策略，将阳离子乙锭溴化物单元引入三核铜-吡唑框架，构建EB-Cu3-COF，显著改善电解液润湿性与电化学可及性，实现最高99%的H2O2选择性和39420 mmol·gcat−1·h−1的流动池产率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对晶态多孔框架在电化学双电子氧还原制H2O2中因电解液润湿性差和电化学可及性受限而性能不佳的问题，提出界面电荷调控策略。材料体系为三核铜-吡唑框架，通过引入阳离子乙锭溴化物单元构建EB-Cu3-COF。摘要报告该材料具有扩大的层间距、增强的界面电荷转移以及优化的*OOH中间体吸附。研究过程围绕将晶态结构精确性转化为电化学活性界面展开，最终获得高H2O2选择性和流动池产率。其意义在于确立界面电荷调控作为设计原则，用于提升晶态多孔框架的电催化界面性能。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：将阳离子乙锭溴化物单元引入三核铜-吡唑框架以构建EB-Cu3-COF；通过层间距、界面电荷转移和*OOH中间体吸附等指标评估界面电荷调控效果；在流动池中测试H2O2电合成性能并报告选择性与产率。具体合成条件、表征手段和测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭/晶态框架材料的电化学合成主线，提供界面电荷调控改善框架润湿性与电化学可及性的设计思路，并给出明确的 selectivity 与产率指标，值得全文精读以核查合成细节、表征证据与性能测试条件。局限在于摘要未报告长期稳定性、具体电解液条件及对照体系数据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；合成条件、表征方法、电解液组成、稳定性数据及对照实验等关键细节仍需全文核查。

papers.title: Methyl-Induced Hydrophobicity and Electronically Tuned Copper Nanocluster COF for Highly Selective Nitrate to Ammonia Electrosynthesis
papers.abstract: Electrochemical nitrate reduction reaction (eNO3-RR) offers a promising route for sustainable ammonia production while mitigating nitrate pollution. Yet high NH3 selectivity remains challenging owing to proton-coupled multi-electron transfer pathways and competing hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). Herein, we report a trinuclear Cu nanocluster-based covalent organic framework (CuMePh) featuring methylfunctionalized π-conjugated extended porous framework that provides a molecular-level strategy for modifying the interfacial wettability and electronic environment of the catalytic framework. Benefiting from this modulation strategy, CuMePh exhibits a maximum faradaic efficiency (FE) of 98% for nitrate to ammonia conversion, with an NH3 production rate of 2161 μg h-1 cm-2 (5402.5 μg h-1 mg-1 cat.) at -0.5 V versus RHE under the investigated alkaline conditions. Compared with the non-methylated CuPh analogue, CuMePh also exhibits a higher water contact angle. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that the electronenriched Cu3-cluster nodes in CuMePh facilitate nitrate activation and sequential hydrogenation by lowering the free-energy requirement and optimizing intermediates binding, while simultaneously suppressing the competing HER. This work highlights a molecular-level design principle that couples electronic-structure engineering with interfacial-property regulation in nanocluster-based COFs, offering new opportunities for developing highly selective electrocatalysts for sustainable nitrogen-cycle transformations.

papers.title_zh: 甲基诱导疏水性与电子调控的铜纳米簇COF用于高选择性硝酸盐制氨电合成
papers.summary_zh: 该工作构建甲基功能化的三核铜纳米簇共价有机框架CuMePh，通过分子层面同时调控界面润湿性与电子环境，在碱性条件下实现最高98%的硝酸盐制氨法拉第效率和2161 μg·h−1·cm−2的NH3产率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对电化学硝酸盐还原制氨中因质子耦合多电子转移路径和竞争性析氢反应导致的高NH3选择性难题。材料体系为基于三核铜纳米簇的共价有机框架CuMePh，其特征是甲基功能化的π共轭延伸多孔框架，提供分子层面调控催化框架界面润湿性和电子环境的策略。摘要报告CuMePh在考察的碱性条件下、相对于RHE的−0.5 V电位下实现最高98%的法拉第效率和2161 μg·h−1·cm−2（5402.5 μg·h−1·mg−1cat.）的NH3产率。与非甲基化类似物CuPh相比，CuMePh表现出更高的水接触角。DFT计算揭示富电子的Cu3簇节点通过降低自由能需求和优化中间体结合促进硝酸盐活化与连续加氢，同时抑制竞争性HER。该工作提出电子结构工程与界面性质调控耦合的分子层面设计原则。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：合成甲基功能化的三核铜纳米簇COF（CuMePh）及其非甲基化类似物CuPh；通过水接触角评估界面润湿性；在碱性条件下于−0.5 V vs RHE测试硝酸盐还原制氨的法拉第效率与NH3产率；采用DFT计算分析Cu3簇节点的电子结构、自由能需求与中间体结合。具体合成条件、表征手段和电解液组成摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF与电化学合成主线，展示通过甲基功能化同时调控框架润湿性和金属簇节点电子结构的分子层面设计原则，并给出明确的法拉第效率与产率数据，值得全文精读以核查合成、表征与电化学测试细节。局限在于摘要仅报告单一电位下的性能，稳定性与更宽电位窗口数据未报告。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级解读；合成条件、表征方法、电解液组成、稳定性测试及DFT计算细节仍需全文核查。

papers.title: Cluster‐Scale MoO x ‐IrO 2 Heterointerfaces Steer Dual‐Site Coupling and Interfacial Water Dynamics for Fast and Durable Oxygen Evolution
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Proton exchange membrane water electrolyzers (PEMWEs) are central to renewable‐powered green hydrogen production. As the benchmark electrocatalyst for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER), conventional single‐phase IrO 2 is constrained by linear scaling relations among oxygenated intermediates, compounded by severe mass‐transport limitations and poorly regulated interfacial water structures. Here, we design a Turing‐type MoO x ‐IrO 2 heterostructure with strongly coupled cluster‐scale interfaces, which enables dual‐function Ir‐Mo synergy that breaks fundamental kinetic limitations and optimizes interfacial water structures. At the reaction pathway level, Brønsted‐acidic MoO x clusters promote water dissociation to generate reactive Mo─OH* intermediates, triggering radical coupling with adjacent Ir─O* species to form OOH* and thus circumventing the linear scaling relation. At the interfacial microenvironment level, MoO x reorganizes the rigid hydrogen‐bonding networks and increases the population of free H 2 O species, effectively alleviating concentration overpotentials under high‐current‐density operation. When integrated into a practical 25 cm 2 membrane electrode assembly, this catalyst delivers a PEMWE cell voltage of 1.71 V at 3 A cm −2 and an ultralow degradation rate of ∼9.5 µV h −1 over 1000 h, with a total platinum‐group‐metal loading of merely 0.5 mg cm −2 across both electrodes. Our dual‐modulation strategy establishes a transformative paradigm for developing low‐iridium and durable OER electrocatalysts toward practical green hydrogen production.

papers.title_zh: 簇尺度MoOx-IrO2异质界面调控双位点耦合与界面水动力学实现快速耐久析氧
papers.summary_zh: 该工作设计Turing型MoOx-IrO2簇尺度异质结构，通过Brønsted酸性MoOx促进水解离并重构界面氢键网络，在25 cm2膜电极组件中实现3 A·cm−2下1.71 V槽压和1000小时约9.5 μV·h−1的超低衰减。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对质子交换膜水电解器中基准单相IrO2受含氧中间体线性标度关系限制、严重传质受限及界面水结构调控不佳的问题。材料体系为Turing型MoOx-IrO2异质结构，具有强耦合的簇尺度界面，实现Ir-Mo双功能协同。在反应路径层面，Brønsted酸性MoOx簇促进水解离生成活性Mo─OH*中间体，触发与相邻Ir─O*物种的自由基偶联形成OOH*，从而规避线性标度关系。在界面微环境层面，MoOx重组刚性氢键网络并增加自由H2O物种数量，缓解高电流密度下的浓差过电位。将该催化剂集成到实际25 cm2膜电极组件中，在3 A·cm−2下实现1.71 V槽压，1000小时内衰减率约9.5 μV·h−1，双电极总铂族金属负载仅0.5 mg·cm−2。该双调控策略为低铱耐久OER电催化剂提供范式。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：设计Turing型MoOx-IrO2簇尺度异质结构；在25 cm2膜电极组件中评估PEMWE性能，报告3 A·cm−2下槽压、1000小时衰减率及铂族金属总负载；通过反应路径分析提出Mo─OH*与Ir─O*自由基偶联形成OOH*的机制；通过界面微环境分析说明MoOx重组氢键网络并增加自由H2O物种。具体合成条件、表征手段和测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作虽非框架材料，但涉及异质界面组装、界面水结构调控与电化学器件级验证，对理解界面微环境调控和膜电极集成具有拓展参考价值。其明确的器件级槽压、衰减率和低铱负载数据值得关注，但与本主线（介孔导电MOF、共轭框架、自组装）的直接关联有限，建议作为拓展阅读而非核心精读。

papers.title: Membrane-induced eggshell biomineralization towards controllable crystallization
papers.abstract: Abstract The avian eggshell is an extreme example of rapid biomineralization, yet how its underlying substrate, the eggshell membrane (ESM), initiates this process remains elusive, and the application potential of this fundamental biological mechanism has yet to be explored. Across the 33 avian species examined, ESMs consistently promoted CaCO3 crystallization under standardized in vitro conditions and exhibited low heterogeneous nucleation barriers. Inspired by this mechanism, we designed a biomimetic fibrous membrane (b-FM) that reproduces the structural and chemical features of natural ESMs. The b-FM achieves a deposition rate of 0.58 mg cm−2 day−1, surpassing the fastest natural ESM (0.46 mg cm−2 day−1). This efficiency arises from a threefold synergistic mechanism: (1) strong negative surface potential promoting Ca2⁺ accumulation, (2) reduced heterogeneous nucleation energy barrier, and (3) regulated crystallization pathways. Demonstrating its application potential, a b-FM/glass fiber mesh (b-FM/GF) composite module was employed for water softening in a circulating cooling-water system. In a 30-day continuous circulation experiment, the b-FM/GF-treated system maintained softened water quality and effectively suppressed pipe scaling, with less than 2% reduction in the effective pipe area. These findings reveal shared features of ESM-promoted mineralization and establish design principles for industrial crystallization control.

papers.title_zh: 膜诱导的蛋壳生物矿化实现可控结晶
papers.summary_zh: 研究在33种鸟类中证实蛋壳膜均能促进碳酸钙结晶并降低异相成核势垒，据此设计仿生纤维膜，沉积速率超过天然蛋壳膜，并在循环冷却水软化中抑制管道结垢。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对蛋壳膜如何启动禽类蛋壳快速生物矿化这一未解问题，并探索该生物机制的应用潜力。作者在标准化体外条件下考察33种鸟类的蛋壳膜，发现其一致促进碳酸钙结晶且异相成核势垒较低。基于此机制，设计仿生纤维膜b-FM，复现天然蛋壳膜的结构与化学特征。b-FM沉积速率达0.58 mg cm−2 day−1，高于最快的天然蛋壳膜0.46 mg cm−2 day−1。作者将效率归因于三重协同机制：强负表面电位促进钙离子富集、降低异相成核能垒、调控结晶路径。应用层面构建b-FM/玻璃纤维网复合模块，用于循环冷却水系统软化，30天连续循环中维持软化水质并抑制管道结垢，有效管面积减少低于2%。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告的方法包括：对33种鸟类蛋壳膜在标准化体外条件下进行CaCO3结晶测试并评估异相成核势垒；依据天然蛋壳膜结构与化学特征设计仿生纤维膜b-FM；测定b-FM的沉积速率并与天然蛋壳膜比较；构建b-FM/玻璃纤维网复合模块，在循环冷却水系统中开展30天连续循环实验，监测软化水质与管道结垢及有效管面积变化。摘要未报告具体表征手段与成核势垒数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于生物矿化启发的膜材料与结晶调控，与介孔材料、框架材料及电化学合成主线关联较弱，但其成核势垒调控、界面化学设计与自组装/沉积策略对理解框架材料成核与膜基结晶有一定借鉴价值。摘要未涉及MOF/COF/HOF或介孔结构，应用场景为工业水软化，建议作为拓展阅读，不必优先精读全文。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。摘要未报告具体表征方法、成核势垒数值、b-FM的组成与结构细节、长期实验的统计学重复性及结垢抑制的微观机制，这些关键细节需核查全文。
key_findings_zh: 33种鸟类蛋壳膜在标准化体外条件下均促进CaCO3结晶并表现低异相成核势垒。
仿生纤维膜b-FM沉积速率0.58 mg cm−2 day−1，超过最快天然蛋壳膜的0.46 mg cm−2 day−1。
高效沉积源于强负表面电位促进Ca2+富集、降低异相成核能垒和调控结晶路径三重协同机制。
b-FM/玻璃纤维网模块在30天连续循环冷却水实验中维持软化水质，有效管面积减少低于2%。

papers.title: Breaking Symmetry Cancellation: Heterovalent Substitution Unlocks Ultrastrong, Phase-Matchable Nonlinearity in Deep-Ultraviolet Tetrahedral Crystals
papers.abstract: Abstract Deep-ultraviolet (deep-UV) nonlinear optical (NLO) crystals demand a challenging integration of strong second-harmonic generation (SHG), sufficient birefringence for phase matching (PM), and a wide bandgap (λ &lt; 200 nm). In tetrahedron-based materials, the hyperpolarizabilities of constituent tetrahedra usually nearly cancel due to structural symmetry, resulting in weak SHG and small birefringence─a classic example being α-SiO2. Breaking this symmetry-driven cancellation while retaining deep-UV transparency thus represents a key chemical design challenge. Here, we report a deep-UV transparent NLO crystal BeSO4 derived from α-SiO2 via stepwise heterovalent tetrahedral substitution. This crystal crystallizes in the noncentrosymmetric tetragonal space group, with alternating BeO4 and SO4 tetrahedra forming [Be3S3O18] six-membered rings. By effectively breaking the symmetry cancellation via alternating low-valence (Be2+) and high-valence (S6+) tetrahedra, BeSO4 achieves a deep-UV cutoff at 176 nm, an exceptional SHG response of 5.1 × KDP at 1064 nm─the strongest among all deep-UV sulfates and Be-containing deep-UV crystals, and a birefringence of 0.038 at 590 nm, almost seven times that of the isostructural BPO4. Unlike BPO4 and α-SiO2, BeSO4 exhibits SHG behavior consistent with phase-matchability, and under 532 nm excitation, it produces a detectable second-harmonic signal at 266 nm. First-principles calculations reveal that the enhanced performance originates from shorter S–O bonds, stronger orbital hybridization, a narrower bandgap, and highly anisotropic electron density, all stemming from the successful cancellation-breaking strategy. It should be noted that the main novelty of this work lies in single-crystal growth, linear/nonlinear optical properties, and mechanistic analysis, since the crystal structure of BeSO4 has been previously reported.

papers.title_zh: 打破对称性抵消：异价取代在深紫外四面体晶体中解锁超强且可相位匹配的非线性
papers.summary_zh: 研究以α-SiO2为原型，通过分步异价四面体取代设计BeSO4晶体，打破四面体超极化率对称抵消，实现176 nm深紫外截止、5.1倍KDP的倍频响应和0.038双折射，并观测到266 nm倍频信号。
papers.research_details_zh: 深紫外非线性光学晶体需同时满足强倍频、足够双折射以实现相位匹配和宽禁带。四面体基材料中组成四面体的超极化率常因结构对称而近乎抵消，导致倍频弱、双折射小，α-SiO2为典型例子。作者提出在保持深紫外透明的前提下打破对称性抵消的化学设计思路，以α-SiO2为母体，通过分步异价四面体取代得到BeSO4。该晶体属非中心对称四方空间群，BeO4与SO4四面体交替排列形成[Be3S3O18]六元环。通过低价Be2+与高价S6+四面体交替，有效打破对称性抵消。BeSO4深紫外截止176 nm，1064 nm下倍频响应为5.1倍KDP，为深紫外硫酸盐及含铍深紫外晶体中最强，590 nm双折射0.038，约为同构BPO4的七倍。与BPO4和α-SiO2不同，BeSO4的倍频行为与可相位匹配性一致，532 nm激发下产生266 nm可检测倍频信号。第一性原理计算表明性能提升源于更短S–O键、更强轨道杂化、更窄带隙和高度各向异性电子密度。作者说明其新颖性在于单晶生长、线性/非线性光学性质与机理分析，BeSO4晶体结构此前已有报道。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告的方法包括：以α-SiO2为母体进行分步异价四面体取代设计并生长BeSO4单晶；确定其非中心对称四方空间群结构及[Be3S3O18]六元环排列；测定深紫外截止、1064 nm倍频响应、590 nm双折射及532 nm激发下的266 nm倍频信号；采用第一性原理计算分析S–O键、轨道杂化、带隙与电子密度各向异性。摘要未报告具体晶体生长条件与完整表征参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作聚焦深紫外非线性光学晶体，与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料及电化学合成主线关联有限，但其通过异价取代打破对称性抵消、调控四面体组装与电子结构的思路，对框架材料中次级构筑单元对称性与功能调控有方法学借鉴。摘要未涉及孔结构或框架组装，建议作为拓展阅读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。摘要未报告单晶生长具体条件、倍频与双折射测量细节、计算模型参数及相位匹配角等关键数据，需核查全文。
key_findings_zh: BeSO4深紫外截止176 nm，1064 nm下倍频响应5.1倍KDP，为深紫外硫酸盐和含铍深紫外晶体中最强。
590 nm双折射0.038，约为同构BPO4的七倍，且倍频行为与相位匹配性一致，532 nm激发下观测到266 nm倍频信号。
第一性原理计算将性能提升归因于更短S–O键、更强轨道杂化、更窄带隙和高度各向异性电子密度。
BeSO4晶体结构此前已有报道，本工作新颖性在于单晶生长、线性/非线性光学性质与机理分析。

papers.title: Elucidating Liquid‐Phase Guest Transport Across MOF Single Crystals: Interplay of Adsorption, Desorption, and Intracrystalline Diffusion
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Although metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) provide molecular selectivity in separations, understanding diffusion within these materials remains challenging due to the intertwined contributions of inherent pore architecture and grain boundaries in packed‐bed systems. To isolate the intracrystalline diffusion behavior, molecular transport across MOF single crystals was investigated in binary and ternary liquid‐phase systems. Diffusion rates were found to vary significantly even among guest molecules with identical kinetic diameters. By isolating the intracrystalline diffusion process, the slow transport is attributed to strong guest–framework interactions rather than pore clogging. This is corroborated by the increase in diffusion rates upon reducing the guest–framework interactions through selection of a more strongly interacting solvent. This study provides mechanistic insights into intrinsic diffusion in MOFs and benchmark behavior to calibrate computational approaches.

papers.title_zh: 解析液相客体在MOF单晶中的传输：吸附、脱附与晶内扩散的相互作用
papers.summary_zh: 研究以MOF单晶隔离晶内扩散，在二元和三元液相体系中考察客体传输，发现即使动力学直径相同的客体扩散速率也显著不同，慢传输归因于强客体—框架相互作用而非孔道堵塞。
papers.research_details_zh: MOF在分离中提供分子选择性，但填充床体系中本征孔结构与晶界贡献交织，使扩散理解困难。为隔离晶内扩散行为，作者在二元和三元液相体系中研究客体分子跨MOF单晶的传输。结果显示，即使动力学直径相同的客体分子，扩散速率也显著不同。通过隔离晶内扩散过程，作者将慢传输归因于强客体—框架相互作用，而非孔道堵塞。这一判断得到佐证：通过选择相互作用更强的溶剂来削弱客体—框架相互作用后，扩散速率上升。该研究为MOF本征扩散提供机制认识，并为校准计算方法提供基准行为。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告的方法包括：以MOF单晶为对象隔离晶内扩散过程，在二元和三元液相体系中开展客体分子跨单晶传输实验；比较不同客体（包括动力学直径相同者）的扩散速率；通过选择相互作用更强的溶剂调控客体—框架相互作用并观察扩散速率变化。摘要未报告具体MOF种类、客体分子、扩散系数数值及表征手段。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联框架材料（MOF）中的分子传输机制，对理解MOF孔道内客体扩散、分离性能与框架—客体相互作用有实际价值，并可为框架材料扩散计算方法提供基准。摘要未涉及介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，建议作为框架材料传输机理方向的重点拓展阅读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。摘要未报告MOF具体结构、客体与溶剂种类、扩散系数数值、单晶尺寸与实验温度等关键细节，需核查全文。
key_findings_zh: 在二元和三元液相体系中，即使动力学直径相同的客体分子，跨MOF单晶的扩散速率也显著不同。
隔离晶内扩散后，慢传输归因于强客体—框架相互作用而非孔道堵塞。
选用相互作用更强的溶剂削弱客体—框架相互作用后，扩散速率上升，佐证上述机制。
研究为MOF本征扩散提供机制认识并给出可校准计算方法的基准行为。

papers.title: Length Scale Coordination Between Effective Electron Diffusion and Light‐Emitting Boosts Electrochemiluminescence Efficiency
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Electrochemiluminescence (ECL), the emission of light excited by electrochemical reactions, has drawn attention as a powerful tool for bioassays and environmental monitoring. Nonetheless, a limited understanding of the bulk electron transport (ET) process in solid‐state ECL emitters, particularly the mismatch between the electron diffusion length ( L n ) at the photoelectrode and the light‐emitting layer thickness ( d ), significantly undermines the ECL efficiency ( Φ ECL ) and impedes practical applications. Herein, we report L n /d as a quantitative impedance‐derived kinetic‐matching descriptor of bulk electron transport in solid‐state ECL systems, and an empirical L n / d range (0.9–1.2) for achieving high ECL efficiency is identified from the slope behavior of temporal ECL evolution curves. This strategy was further confirmed experimentally across different ECL systems, including metal‐organic frameworks (MOF), poly(heptazine imide) (PHI), and carbon nitride with tunable band structures. The optimal L n / d ratio range enabled superior electron transport and mass transfer, yielding a record‐high cathodic ECL efficiency for carbon nitride (CN) and enabling a visual tetracycline (TC) sensor with an excellent detection range and limit.

papers.title_zh: 有效电子扩散与发光之间的长度尺度协调提升电化学发光效率
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出以电子扩散长度与发光层厚度之比L_n/d作为固态电化学发光体系体相电子传输的动力学匹配描述符，并从时间分辨ECL演化曲线斜率中识别出0.9–1.2的高效区间，在MOF、PHI和氮化碳等体系中实验验证，实现氮化碳创纪录的阴极ECL效率及四环素可视化传感。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对固态电化学发光发射体中体相电子传输过程理解不足的问题，特别是光电极处电子扩散长度L_n与发光层厚度d失配导致ECL效率Φ_ECL下降的瓶颈。作者提出将L_n/d作为由阻抗推导的定量动力学匹配描述符，用于描述固态ECL体系的体相电子传输，并通过时间分辨ECL演化曲线的斜率行为识别出实现高ECL效率的经验L_n/d区间（0.9–1.2）。该策略在具有可调能带结构的不同ECL体系中得到实验验证，包括金属有机框架（MOF）、聚庚嗪酰亚胺（PHI）和氮化碳。最优L_n/d比值区间可同时改善电子传输与传质，从而获得氮化碳创纪录的阴极ECL效率，并构建了具有优异检测范围和检出限的四环素可视化传感器。该工作将长度尺度匹配概念引入固态ECL发射体设计，为框架材料及碳氮材料的ECL性能优化提供了可量化的设计判据。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以阻抗推导获得电子扩散长度L_n并定义L_n/d动力学匹配描述符；通过时间分辨ECL演化曲线的斜率行为识别高效L_n/d区间；在MOF、聚庚嗪酰亚胺（PHI）及可调能带结构氮化碳等不同ECL体系中进行实验验证；评估电子传输与传质性能及ECL效率；构建四环素可视化传感器并考察其检测范围与检出限。具体合成条件、表征手段与测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔导电MOF及框架材料电化学功能主线相关：其以MOF作为验证体系之一，提出用L_n/d长度尺度匹配判据优化固态ECL效率，对框架材料在电化学发光器件中的膜厚与传输长度协同设计有直接参考价值。局限在于摘要未给出MOF具体结构、孔道特征及介孔/导电性信息，框架材料部分仅为验证性证据。若关注框架材料电化学合成与组装—性能关系，值得全文精读以核查MOF体系细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要内容整理。MOF的具体组成与结构、合成与组装方法、阻抗测试条件、L_n计算方法、ECL效率数值、传感器检测范围与检出限等关键细节摘要未报告，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 提出L_n/d作为阻抗推导的固态ECL体相电子传输动力学匹配描述符，并识别出0.9–1.2的高ECL效率经验区间。
该L_n/d策略在MOF、聚庚嗪酰亚胺（PHI）和可调能带结构氮化碳等不同ECL体系中获得实验验证。
最优L_n/d区间同时促进电子传输与传质，使氮化碳获得创纪录的阴极ECL效率。
基于该策略构建的四环素可视化传感器表现出优异的检测范围和检出限（具体数值摘要未报告）。

papers.title: Cooperative Dual-Template Assembly of Bimodal Interconnected Mesoporous Carbon Nanospheres with Boosted Charge Transport
papers.abstract: Abstract Mesoporous materials have attracted great research attention since their first advent in 1990s; however, the self-assembly of soft micelles can generate only unary periodicity. A feasible strategy capable of building multinary pore structures remains scarcely explored due to huge synthetic difficulty. Herein, we explore a cooperative dual-template assembly route, which allows for compatible interaction of Pluronic P123 and L64 in solution, to successfully construct a type of mesoporous carbon nanospheres with bimodal mesopores. The key to such construction of hierarchical mesopores from a pure soft-template process without recruitment of a hard template mainly relies on the formation of composite micelles with both suitable mutual interactions and individually stabilized condensed states. The resultant mesoporous carbon spheres possess good uniformity in morphology and mesoporosity, including a mean particle size at ∼200 nm, a high surface area of 537 m2 g–1, and an interconnected bimodal mesopore size centered at 11.1 and 4.2 nm along with a massive amount of micropores. Moreover, this dual-template assembly strategy allows for precise structural regulation over the pore curvature and pore size through tailoring the reaction conditions. As a proof of concept, the fabricated bimodal mesoporous carbon, as an ammonium-ion battery anode, showcases excellent electrochemical performances owing to its permeable and gradient porous structure for fast mass and charge transfer. Our study underscores a facile and extendable toolbox for synthesizing complex or hierarchical mesostructures as advanced energy model materials.

papers.title_zh: 协同双模板组装双峰互连介孔碳纳米球以提升电荷传输
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出P123与L64协同双模板组装策略，在纯软模板体系中构建具有双峰互连介孔的碳纳米球，实现孔径与孔曲率的精确调控，并作为铵离子电池负极展现出优异的电化学性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对软胶束自组装通常只能产生单一周期性孔结构、多级孔构建困难的问题，探索P123与L64在溶液中兼容相互作用的协同双模板组装路线，成功构建具有双峰介孔的介孔碳纳米球。其关键在于形成兼具合适相互作用与各自稳定缩合态的复合胶束，从而在不引入硬模板的纯软模板过程中实现分级介孔构建。所得材料形貌与介孔性均匀，平均粒径约200 nm，比表面积537 m2 g–1，互连双峰介孔孔径分别集中于11.1和4.2 nm，并含大量微孔。该策略可通过调节反应条件精确调控孔曲率与孔径。作为概念验证，该双峰介孔碳用作铵离子电池负极，凭借可渗透的梯度孔结构实现快速质量与电荷传输，表现出优异电化学性能。研究为合成复杂或分级介观结构及先进能源模型材料提供了简便可扩展的工具箱。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用P123与L64协同双模板自组装路线构建介孔碳纳米球，通过调节反应条件调控孔曲率与孔径；对产物进行了形貌与介孔性表征，报告了粒径、比表面积、双峰介孔孔径及微孔数量；并以铵离子电池负极为应用场景进行电化学性能测试。具体合成温度、时间、前驱体、表征手段名称及电池测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于介孔材料与自组装技术主线，展示纯软模板双模板协同组装构建双峰互连介孔碳的可行途径，对介孔碳的孔结构调控与电荷传输设计有直接参考价值。其材料为碳而非MOF/COF框架，且电化学应用为铵离子电池负极而非框架材料电合成，与导电MOF、共轭框架主线关联有限。若关注软模板分级介孔构建策略值得浏览，全文精读必要性中等。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。合成细节、前驱体与反应条件、具体表征手段、电化学测试条件及性能数值等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: P123与L64协同双模板组装可在纯软模板体系中形成复合胶束，构建双峰互连介孔碳纳米球，无需硬模板。
所得碳球平均粒径约200 nm，比表面积537 m2 g–1，互连双峰介孔孔径中心为11.1和4.2 nm，并含大量微孔。
通过调节反应条件可精确调控孔曲率与孔径。
作为铵离子电池负极，可渗透梯度孔结构促进快速质量与电荷传输，展现优异电化学性能。

papers.title: Interfacial Charge Modulation of Covalent Metal–Organic Frameworks for Efficient H 2 O 2 Electrosynthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Electrochemical H 2 O 2 synthesis through the two‐electron oxygen reduction reaction offers a sustainable alternative to the energy‐intensive anthraquinone process. Crystalline porous frameworks are attractive for this route because of their structural precision, yet poor electrolyte wetting and limited electrochemical accessibility often restrict their practical performance. Here, we report an interfacial charge‐modulation strategy that transforms covalent metal–organic frameworks into highly wetted and electrochemically accessible catalytic interfaces. By incorporating cationic ethidium bromide units into a trinuclear copper‐pyrazolate framework, we construct EB‐Cu 3 ‐COF featuring enlarged interlayer spacing, enhanced interfacial charge transfer, and optimized *OOH intermediate adsorption. Consequently, EB‐Cu 3 ‐COF achieves up to 99% H 2 O 2 selectivity and a flow‐cell production rate of 39 420 mmol·g cat −1 ·h −1 , ranking among the best‐performing non‐pyrolyzed porous organic electrocatalysts reported to date. This work establishes interfacial charge‐modulation as a design principle for translating crystalline structural precision into electrochemically active interfaces.

papers.title_zh: 共价金属有机框架的界面电荷调控用于高效H2O2电合成
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将阳离子乙锭溴化物单元引入三核铜吡唑框架，构建EB-Cu3-COF，通过界面电荷调控改善润湿性与电化学可及性，实现高达99%的H2O2选择性和39420 mmol·gcat−1·h−1的流动池产率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对晶体多孔框架在二电子氧还原制H2O2中因电解质润湿性差和电化学可及性受限而影响实际性能的问题，提出界面电荷调控策略，将晶体共价金属有机框架转化为高度润湿且电化学可及的催化界面。具体在三核铜吡唑框架中引入阳离子乙锭溴化物单元，构建EB-Cu3-COF，获得扩大的层间距、增强的界面电荷转移以及优化的*OOH中间体吸附。所得材料在H2O2电合成中达到高达99%的H2O2选择性，流动池产率达39420 mmol·gcat−1·h−1，跻身目前已报道最佳非热解多孔有机电催化剂之列。该工作将界面电荷调控确立为把晶体结构精确性转化为电化学活性界面的设计原则。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用将阳离子乙锭溴化物单元掺入三核铜吡唑框架的合成策略构建EB-Cu3-COF，并以二电子氧还原反应进行电化学H2O2合成性能评价，在流动池中测定产率与选择性；同时报告了层间距、界面电荷转移及*OOH中间体吸附等性质。具体合成条件、表征手段、电解液与测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接契合共轭框架与电化学合成主线，属于共价金属有机框架用于电催化H2O2合成的代表性设计，界面电荷调控与润湿性改善策略对框架材料电化学可及性研究有实际借鉴价值。其定量性能指标明确，核心推荐级别合理。局限在于摘要未给出稳定性、长时运行及具体结构表征细节，建议全文精读以核查合成与性能边界。

key_findings_zh: 将阳离子乙锭溴化物单元引入三核铜吡唑框架构建EB-Cu3-COF，实现扩大的层间距、增强的界面电荷转移和优化的*OOH吸附。
EB-Cu3-COF的H2O2选择性高达99%，流动池产率达39420 mmol·gcat−1·h−1。

papers.title: Mobius Aromatic Figure-Eight Knotted Three-Dimensional Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Abstract Möbius aromaticity extends the concept of aromaticity into the topological dimension. However, the synthesis of well-defined molecular systems with this unique property, especially the assembly into infinite polymeric networks, remains a significant challenge due to uncontrolled ring-strain effects. Herein, we report the synthesis of a Möbius aromatic hexa[2,3-thienylene] macrocycle (HTE) with a striking figure-eight shape and the control sample of tetra[2,3-thienylene] (TTE) with an antiaromatic nature, which is further assembled into the extended 3D covalent organic frameworks (COFs) of NUST-67 and NUST-66. The Möbius aromaticity of HTE can modulate the oxidation potential, lower the p-band center of active sites, and weaken the adsorption strength of the *OOH intermediate. As a result, the obtained NUST-67, with a thermodynamically optimized reaction pathway and kinetically enhanced mass/charge transfer, exhibits much superior electrocatalytic activity and selectivity toward H2O2 reduction with industrial-grade performance than NUST-66, featuring a current density window of 100–400 mA cm–2 and an H2O2 Faradic efficiency exceeding 88%. This study discloses the first integration of a Möbius aromatic unit into a COF and elucidates the working effect of aromaticity by a targeted electrocatalytic probe, which establishes a new paradigm for designing organic electrocatalysts by aromaticity engineering.

papers.title_zh: 莫比乌斯芳香八字结三维共价有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该研究合成具有八字形的莫比乌斯芳香六[2,3-噻吩撑]大环HTE及反芳香对照TTE，并组装为三维COF NUST-67与NUST-66，NUST-67在H2O2还原中表现出工业级电流密度窗口和超过88%的法拉第效率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对莫比乌斯芳香性虽将芳香性拓展至拓扑维度、但具有该性质的明确分子体系尤其是无限聚合物网络的合成因环张力难以控制而极具挑战的问题，合成了具有醒目八字形结构的莫比乌斯芳香六[2,3-噻吩撑]大环HTE，以及具反芳香性质的对照四[2,3-噻吩撑]TTE，并进一步组装为扩展三维共价有机框架NUST-67与NUST-66。HTE的莫比乌斯芳香性可调节氧化电位、降低活性位点p带中心并削弱*OOH中间体吸附强度。结果NUST-67具有热力学优化的反应路径和动力学增强的质量/电荷传输，在H2O2还原中表现出远优于NUST-66的电催化活性与选择性，达到工业级性能，电流密度窗口为100–400 mA cm–2，H2O2法拉第效率超过88%。该研究首次将莫比乌斯芳香单元整合入COF，并通过靶向电催化探针阐明芳香性作用效应。

HTE的莫比乌斯芳香性可调节氧化电位、降低活性位点p带中心并削弱*OOH中间体吸附。

papers.title: A Novel pH‐Activatable Nanozyme for Treating Breast Cancer Bone Metastasis by Regulating Cancer Cell Metabolic Reprogramming and the Tumor Microenvironment
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Multi‐omics analyses implicate enhanced oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) in breast cancer bone metastasis (BCBM). To target this metabolic vulnerability, we develop SPMMPA, a bone‐targeted nanozyme comprising a Prussian blue core, a disulfide‐bridged mesoporous silica interlayer, and a manganese oxide shell, functionalized with polyethylenimine, alendronate, and the Ser‐Asp‐Ser‐Ser‐Asp peptide. Its acid‐enhanced catalytic activity promotes reactive oxygen species production and glutathione depletion, accompanied by mitochondrial dysfunction, reduced OXPHOS and adenosine triphosphate production, and downregulation of peroxisome proliferator‐activated receptor gamma coactivator 1‐alpha. Alendronate and silicon release contribute to reduced osteoclast activity and preservation of bone structure. Near‐infrared irradiation further enhances treatment efficacy through photothermal heating below 48°C. In mouse models of BCBM, SPMMPA suppresses tumor growth and alleviates osteolysis, without overt toxicity in the assays performed. These findings support a pH‐responsive catalytic strategy that couples disruption of tumor energy metabolism with protection of bone homeostasis.

papers.title_zh: 一种新型pH激活纳米酶通过调控癌细胞代谢重编程和肿瘤微环境治疗乳腺癌骨转移
papers.summary_zh: 本研究开发骨靶向纳米酶SPMMPA，利用酸增强催化活性产生活性氧并耗竭谷胱甘肽，抑制氧化磷酸化与ATP生成，同时释放阿仑膦酸钠和硅以保护骨结构，在乳腺癌骨转移小鼠模型中抑制肿瘤并缓解骨溶解。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对多组学分析提示氧化磷酸化增强与乳腺癌骨转移相关的代谢脆弱性，作者构建了SPMMPA纳米酶。该材料以普鲁士蓝为核心，外层为二硫键桥连的介孔二氧化硅中间层，再包覆氧化锰壳层，并功能化聚乙烯亚胺、阿仑膦酸钠和Ser-Asp-Ser-Ser-Asp肽以实现骨靶向。研究考察了其酸增强催化活性对活性氧产生和谷胱甘肽耗竭的促进作用，以及对线粒体功能、氧化磷酸化和ATP产生的影响，并检测过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1α的下调。同时评估阿仑膦酸钠和硅释放对破骨细胞活性及骨结构的作用，并联合近红外照射进行光热增强治疗。该工作提出了一种将肿瘤能量代谢干扰与骨稳态保护相结合的pH响应催化策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告了多组学分析用于提示氧化磷酸化增强；材料构建采用普鲁士蓝核心、二硫键桥连介孔二氧化硅中间层和氧化锰壳层，并进行聚乙烯亚胺、阿仑膦酸钠及骨靶向肽功能化。性能评价涉及催化活性、活性氧与谷胱甘肽检测、线粒体功能与ATP相关指标、破骨细胞活性与骨结构评估、近红外光热治疗以及乳腺癌骨转移小鼠模型中的抗肿瘤和抗骨溶解评价。具体表征手段与测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文与介孔材料及框架材料组装主线为间接相关：其介孔二氧化硅中间层和核壳组装体现介孔无机材料在生物催化与药物递送中的集成设计，但并非导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成研究。对关注介孔壳层功能化、刺激响应释放和骨靶向纳米酶的研究者有参考价值；若主线聚焦框架材料电化学或导电性，则精读优先级有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属摘要级信息。材料的详细合成条件、介孔结构参数、表征图谱、催化机制证据、动物实验规模与统计结果、毒性评价细节等均需查阅全文核实；摘要未报告的内容未作补充。
key_findings_zh: SPMMPA具有酸增强催化活性，可促进活性氧产生并耗竭谷胱甘肽。
处理伴随线粒体功能障碍、氧化磷酸化和ATP产生减少，以及PGC-1α下调。
阿仑膦酸钠和硅释放有助于降低破骨细胞活性并保护骨结构。
近红外照射通过低于48°C的光热加热进一步增强疗效；小鼠模型中抑制肿瘤生长并缓解骨溶解，所测 assay 未见明显毒性。

papers.title: Dynamic Supramolecular Probe With Chloride‐Guided Assembly and DNA‐Mediated Intracellular Reorganization for Tumor Therapy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Subcellularly targeted molecules usually act through static localization, whereas systems that undergo environment‐triggered state transitions and functional reprogramming remain underexplored. Here, we develop alkyl‐chain‐tunable Ly‐Cn molecules whose intracellular behavior is governed by chloride‐dependent assembly and DNA‐mediated supramolecular reorganization. Responsiveness varies nonmonotonically with chain length, with Ly‐12 achieving an optimal balance. At physiologically relevant chloride concentrations, Ly‐12 undergoes a threshold‐like aggregation transition into supramolecular nanoparticles that are subsequently reorganized and disassembled by DNA. This dual‐responsive process drives initial accumulation in lysosome‐associated compartments, followed by lysosome‐to‐nucleus redistribution and DNA‐mediated nuclear trapping. Ly‐12 thereby acts beyond passive nuclear targeting: it initiates lysosomal perturbation that propagates into oxidative stress, endoplasmic‐reticulum stress, and DNA damage, while white‐light irradiation amplifies this cascade. Transcriptomic analysis corroborates the progressive stress response. In HeLa xenografts, intratumoral Ly‐12 produces marked antitumor efficacy that is further enhanced by white‐light irradiation, without evident systemic toxicity. These findings establish an environment‐responsive supramolecular strategy that converts ion‐regulated assembly and organelle redistribution into light‐amplified therapeutic activity.

papers.title_zh: 氯离子引导组装与DNA介导胞内重组的动态超分子探针用于肿瘤治疗
papers.summary_zh: 研究开发烷基链可调的Ly-Cn超分子分子，其中Ly-12在生理氯离子浓度下发生阈值式聚集形成超分子纳米颗粒，随后由DNA重组和解组装，驱动溶酶体到细胞核 redistribution 并引发级联应激，白光照射增强抗肿瘤效果。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对亚细胞靶向分子多依赖静态定位、缺乏环境触发状态转变与功能重编程的问题，作者设计了一系列烷基链可调的Ly-Cn分子，其胞内行为受氯离子依赖组装和DNA介导超分子重组调控。响应性随链长呈非单调变化，Ly-12达到最佳平衡。在生理相关氯离子浓度下，Ly-12发生阈值样聚集转变形成超分子纳米颗粒，随后被DNA重组和解组装。该双重响应过程首先促使分子在溶酶体相关区室积累，继而发生溶酶体到细胞核的再分布及DNA介导的核内滞留。Ly-12由此启动溶酶体扰动，并传播为氧化应激、内质网应激和DNA损伤，白光照射可放大该级联。转录组分析支持渐进性应激响应。该策略将离子调控组装和细胞器再分布转化为光增强治疗活性。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告了烷基链可调Ly-Cn分子的设计合成、氯离子依赖组装与DNA介导重组的胞内行为研究、溶酶体与细胞核分布观察、氧化应激/内质网应激/DNA损伤相关应激评价、转录组分析，以及HeLa异种移植瘤模型中瘤内给药联合白光照射的抗肿瘤与全身毒性评价。具体合成条件、组装表征手段、氯离子浓度阈值和光照参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文与自组装技术主线直接相关，展示了离子引导的超分子组装、链长调控的非单调响应以及DNA介导的胞内超分子重组，对理解环境响应型组装体的亚细胞命运调控有参考价值。但其材料为小分子超分子体系，不涉及介孔导电MOF、共轭COF/HOF或电化学合成；若关注框架材料组装，可作为超分子动态组装思路的拓展阅读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属摘要级信息。Ly-Cn的具体化学结构、组装表征、氯离子阈值、DNA重组机制、转录组数据和动物实验统计等关键细节需查阅全文核实；摘要未报告的内容未作补充。
key_findings_zh: Ly-Cn的响应性随烷基链长度呈非单调变化，Ly-12具有最佳平衡。
在生理相关氯离子浓度下，Ly-12发生阈值样聚集形成超分子纳米颗粒，并可被DNA重组和解组装。
Ly-12驱动溶酶体相关区室初始积累，随后溶酶体到细胞核再分布并发生DNA介导的核内滞留。
Ly-12引发溶酶体扰动并传播为氧化应激、内质网应激和DNA损伤，白光照射放大该级联；HeLa异种移植瘤中瘤内注射Ly-12显示明显抗肿瘤效果且白光增强，未见明显全身毒性。

papers.title: In Situ Constructed Pore‐Chain Interlocked Networks in Polyimide‐Covalent Organic Framework Nanocomposites Enable Ultralow k Dielectrics for High‐Fidelity Signal Transmission
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The ultralow k porous polymer dielectrics have been widely explored for Integrated circuit (IC) interconnects, 5G/6G communications, and wearable devices. However, disordered pore structures and poor interfacial adhesion remain a major challenge, thus making it difficult to decouple the k ‐tanδ trade‐off. Here, we employ hollow covalent organic frameworks (H‐TD‐COF) as multifunctional molecular anchoring nodes to construct robust pore‐chain interlocked networks in polyimide nanofibrous films. The amino‐functionalized COF shells participate in the in situ growth of polyimide (PI) chains, thus enabling interlocked interfaces that fundamentally restrict segmental mobility and suppress dipolar relaxation. Subsequent electrospinning technique allows anchored chains to be stretched along the fiber axis and immobilizes them within an oriented fibrous architecture. This simultaneously disrupts long‐range charge migration pathways while preserving stress‐transfer and heat‐dissipation continuity. The resulting PI‐g‐COF (4) nanocomposites with 4 wt% H‐TD‐COF loading achieve an ultralow dielectric constant of 1.50 and dielectric loss of 0.001 at 1 kHz, with highly stable dielectric properties up to 250°C. Notably, device‐level measurements further reveal a signal‐to‐noise‐and‐distortion ratio (SINAD) of 22.30 dB under 200 MHz crosstalk interference, showing a 52.2% improvement over commercial polyimide. This work lays solid foundations for nanoscale interfacial regulation in porous polymer nanocomposites towards ultralow k dielectrics.

papers.title_zh: 聚酰亚胺-共价有机框架纳米复合材料中原位构建孔-链互锁网络实现超低k介电材料用于高保真信号传输
papers.summary_zh: 研究以中空共价有机框架H-TD-COF为多功能分子锚定节点，在聚酰亚胺纳米纤维膜中原位构建孔-链互锁网络，4 wt%负载下获得1 kHz介电常数1.50、介电损耗0.001，并显著提升信号传输保真度。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对多孔聚合物介电材料中无序孔结构和较差界面粘附难以解耦介电常数与介电损耗权衡的问题，作者采用中空共价有机框架H-TD-COF作为多功能分子锚定节点，在聚酰亚胺纳米纤维膜中构建稳固的孔-链互锁网络。氨基功能化COF壳层参与聚酰亚胺链的原位生长，形成互锁界面，从根本上限制链段运动并抑制偶极弛豫。随后通过静电纺丝技术使锚定链沿纤维轴拉伸并固定于取向纤维结构中，同时打断长程电荷迁移路径并保持应力传递和散热连续性。所得PI-g-COF(4)纳米复合材料在4 wt% H-TD-COF负载下于1 kHz实现1.50的超低介电常数和0.001的介电损耗，介电性能在高达250°C下保持高度稳定。器件级测量显示在200 MHz串扰干扰下信噪失真比为22.30 dB，较商用聚酰亚胺提升52.2%。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告了以中空共价有机框架H-TD-COF为锚定节点、氨基功能化COF壳层参与聚酰亚胺链原位生长，随后采用静电纺丝制备取向纳米纤维复合材料。性能评价包括不同H-TD-COF负载量下的介电常数与介电损耗测试、温度稳定性测试以及器件级信号传输与串扰干扰测量。具体COF合成条件、原位生长参数、静电纺丝条件和表征手段摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文与共轭COF及框架材料组装主线高度相关，展示了COF作为界面锚定节点参与聚合物原位生长并构建互锁网络，进而调控多孔介电性能。其价值在于提供COF-聚合物界面组装与孔结构有序化的设计思路，但研究不涉及导电MOF、介孔导电框架或电化学合成；对介孔/多孔介电复合材料方向值得精读，对电化学合成主线相关性有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属摘要级信息。H-TD-COF的结构细节、原位生长与静电纺丝条件、介电测试频率范围与温度稳定性数据细节、器件测量条件和统计结果等需查阅全文核实；摘要未报告的内容未作补充。
key_findings_zh: 4 wt% H-TD-COF负载的PI-g-COF(4)在1 kHz下介电常数为1.50、介电损耗为0.001。
介电性能在高达250°C下保持高度稳定。
器件级测量在200 MHz串扰干扰下信噪失真比为22.30 dB，较商用聚酰亚胺提升52.2%。
氨基功能化COF壳层参与PI链原位生长形成互锁界面，限制链段运动并抑制偶极弛豫；静电纺丝取向纤维结构打断长程电荷迁移并保持应力传递与散热连续性。

papers.title: One-Pot Hierarchical Assembly of Simple Molecules to Vinylene- and Indole-Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Abstract The development in the synthesis of covalent organic frameworks (COFs) has been oriented toward the integration of simplicity, accessibility, stability, diversity, and functionality. However, a central bottleneck remains the lack of effective strategies for assembling simple, unsymmetric, and readily available molecules into highly ordered frameworks. Here, we report a practical synthesis of robust, diversified, and functional COFs via one-pot assembly from a low-cost and simple-structured molecule, 4-methyl-3-nitrobenzonitrile (MNBN). Leveraging the versatile but orthogonal reactivities of MNBN, a three-step cascade sequence, including nitrile cyclotrimerization, Knoevenagel condensation, and reductive cyclization, achieved the symmetrization, reticulation, and functionalization in one pot, thereby enabling the hierarchical construction of two series of COFs with stable o-nitrostyrene or indole linkages. The resulting COFs displayed high crystallinity, permanent porosity, and exceptional stability; solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance (SSNMR) experiments combined with selective isotopic-labeling synthesis further confirmed the high selectivity and controllability of the hierarchical assembly. Notably, the indole-linked COFs, featuring conjugated and electron-rich frameworks, displayed emergent photoelectronic properties and served as efficient, reusable catalysts in both metal-free photocatalytic and metallaphotoredox reactions. By hierarchically exploiting the intrinsic reactivity of a simple, unsymmetric molecule, this work bridges classical organic synthesis and cross-scale covalent assembly, achieving the programmable construction of stable, diversified, and functional COFs.

papers.title_zh: 简单分子一锅分级组装为乙烯基和吲哚连接的共价有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该工作以廉价非对称分子4-甲基-3-硝基苯甲腈为唯一起始物，通过一锅三步串联反应实现对称化、成网与功能化，分级构建两类高结晶、永久多孔且稳定的COF，并展示吲哚连接COF的光电与催化功能。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对COF合成中难以将简单、非对称、易得分子组装为高度有序框架的瓶颈，提出以4-甲基-3-硝基苯甲腈（MNBN）为单一前体的分级组装策略。利用该分子正交反应性，将腈环三聚、Knoevenagel缩合与还原环化三步级联在一锅内完成，分别实现对称化、成网和功能化，从而构建两类分别含稳定邻硝基苯乙烯连接或吲哚连接的COF系列。所得材料表现出高结晶性、永久孔隙率和优异稳定性；固态核磁结合选择性同位素标记合成证实了分级组装的高选择性与可控性。吲哚连接COF具有共轭富电子框架，呈现新生的光电性质，并可作为高效可重复使用的无金属光催化和金属光氧化还原反应催化剂。该工作通过层级利用简单非对称分子的本征反应性，连接经典有机合成与跨尺度共价组装，实现稳定、多样、功能化COF的可编程构建。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以MNBN为前体的一锅三步级联合成（腈环三聚、Knoevenagel缩合、还原环化）；固态核磁共振（SSNMR）表征结合选择性同位素标记合成以验证选择性与可控性；对COF的结晶性、永久孔隙率和稳定性进行评价；以及将吲哚连接COF用于无金属光催化和金属光氧化还原反应并考察其可重复使用性。具体表征仪器、性能测试条件与定量数据摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接契合共轭COF的组装与功能化主线，其分级一锅组装策略对框架材料的可编程合成具有方法学参考价值，吲哚连接COF的光电与催化功能也值得关注。局限在于摘要未给出孔结构参数、稳定性测试条件和催化性能数值，难以判断性能水平。建议全文精读以核查合成细节、连接方式证据与催化数据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。COF的具体拓扑结构、孔径与比表面积、稳定性测试条件、光催化与金属光氧化还原反应的具体底物、产率、循环次数及机制证据等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 一锅三步级联（腈环三聚、Knoevenagel缩合、还原环化）可从单一简单非对称分子MNBN分级构建两类COF。
所得COF具有高结晶性、永久孔隙率和优异稳定性，固态核磁与选择性同位素标记证实组装的高选择性和可控性。
吲哚连接COF因共轭富电子框架呈现新生的光电性质，并可作为高效、可重复使用的无金属光催化剂和金属光氧化还原催化剂。

papers.title: Tuning Pore Geometry of Zirconium Metal–Organic Frameworks via Bent Ligands for Enhanced Sulfide Oxidation Catalysis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Pore engineering represents a powerful strategy to tailor the physicochemical properties of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), yet the structure‐activity relationship linking pore geometry to catalytic performance remains poorly understood for zirconium‐based MOFs (Zr‐MOFs). Herein, we report a new Zr‐MOF (PCN‐1010), featuring a scu topology with channel‐type porosity via ligand conformational bending. Distinct from the ftw ‐topology Zr‐MOF with cage‐type porosity constructed from a straight tetra‐topic ligand, PCN‐1010 contains 8‐connected Zr 6 clusters with more accessible catalytic sites and open one‐dimensional (1D) channels. The bent conformation of the linker creates alternating concave and convex surfaces along the c ‐axis, facilitating the accessibility of the active sites. In addition, PCN‐1010 exhibits high chemical stability in various organic solvents owing to the robust zirconium‐oxo coordination. As a catalytic platform for sulfide oxidation, PCN‐1010, integrated with 12‐tungstophosphoric acid, delivers high‐selectivity sulfone production with a yield of 97% instead of sulfoxide at room temperature, alongside good recyclability and broad substrate compatibility. The enhanced catalytic performance of PCN‐1010 relative to its cage‐type ftw counterpart demonstrates that rational pore geometry regulation via ligand bending is an effective route to optimize mass transport and active‐site accessibility.

papers.title_zh: 通过弯曲配体调控锆基金属有机框架的孔几何结构以增强硫化物氧化催化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作用弯曲配体构建scu拓扑、一维通道型孔结构的Zr-MOF PCN-1010，与直线配体形成的ftw笼型孔结构对比，证明配体弯曲调控孔几何可提升活性位点可及性与硫化物氧化催化性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究聚焦Zr-MOF中孔几何结构与催化性能之间构效关系不清的问题。作者以配体构象弯曲为设计手段，构建了具有scu拓扑和通道型孔隙的新Zr-MOF PCN-1010。与由直线四齿配体构建的ftw拓扑笼型孔Zr-MOF不同，PCN-1010含8连接的Zr6簇，具有更易接近的催化位点和开放的一维通道；弯曲连接体沿c轴形成交替的凹面和凸面，促进活性位点可及性。得益于稳固的锆氧配位，PCN-1010在多种有机溶剂中具有高化学稳定性。将其与12-钨磷酸整合作为硫化物氧化催化平台，在室温下高选择性地生成砜而非亚砜，产率达97%，并具有良好可回收性和广泛底物兼容性。与笼型ftw对照材料的性能比较表明，通过配体弯曲合理调控孔几何是优化传质和活性位点可及性的有效途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以弯曲配体构建scu拓扑Zr-MOF的溶剂热类合成（具体合成条件摘要未报告）；结构表征确认scu拓扑、8连接Zr6簇和一维通道；在多种有机溶剂中评价化学稳定性；将PCN-1010与12-钨磷酸整合构建硫化物氧化催化平台，在室温下测试砜的选择性和产率，并考察可回收性与底物兼容性；与ftw拓扑笼型对照Zr-MOF进行性能比较。具体表征手段与测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于MOF孔工程与催化应用，与介孔/孔结构调控及框架材料催化主线相关，其配体弯曲调控孔几何的思路对框架材料设计有借鉴意义。但研究对象为微孔通道型Zr-MOF而非介孔或导电MOF，与核心主线的直接关联有限。摘要缺少孔结构参数和对照实验细节，建议按需选读全文核查结构与催化数据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。PCN-1010的孔径与比表面积、配体结构、合成条件、结构解析手段、稳定性测试细节、催化反应条件、循环次数及构效关系的直接证据仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 弯曲配体使PCN-1010形成scu拓扑、一维开放通道和8连接Zr6簇，沿c轴呈现交替凹凸表面，活性位点更易接近。
PCN-1010在多种有机溶剂中具有高化学稳定性。
PCN-1010与12-钨磷酸整合后，室温下硫化物氧化高选择性生成砜，产率97%，并具良好可回收性和广泛底物兼容性。
与笼型ftw对照Zr-MOF相比性能提升，表明配体弯曲调控孔几何可优化传质与活性位点可及性。

papers.title: Large‐Scale Sulfur Quantum Dots Production Coupled With Hydrogen Evolution Via Electrochemical‐Chemical Tandem Synthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Production of value‐added chemicals and materials through electrochemical processes represents a game‐changing synthetic route, yet its scalability has not been demonstrated. Here, we report a tandem electrochemical‐chemical process that converts aqueous sulfide feedstocks into sulfur quantum dots (SQDs) while co‐producing hydrogen. Based on cost‐effective, commercially available Ni 3 FeMo 0.1 powders, a heterostructured Ni 3 FeMo 0.1 @NiTe 2 catalyst is developed, which drives the electrochemical sulfide‐to‐polysulfide oxidation reaction at current densities up to 1.0 A cm −2 with a voltage of only 1.07 V in natural seawater electrolyte at 80°C, and achieves stable operation for over 290 h in the membrane electrode assembly while maintaining excellent performance in four‐cell electrolyzer stacks with a SQD yield rate of 142 mg cm −2 day −1 . Operando spectroscopy investigations and density functional theory calculations reveal that multi‐metal electronic delocalization around Ni, Fe and Mo active centers confines sulfidation to the catalyst surface and stabilizes a higher surface sulfur coverage, thereby lowering the energy barrier to the rate‐determining step while suppressing bulk NiS formation. The resulting SQDs exhibit excitation‐dependent photoluminescence tunable across the violet‐to‐blue region. This work demonstrates surface‐reconstruction engineering as a rational catalyst‐design principle for coupled electrosynthesis of nanomaterials and green hydrogen, and moreover, it showcases scale‐up synthesis of SQDs with tunable photoluminescence.

papers.title_zh: 电化学-化学串联合成实现硫量子点大规模制备并耦合析氢
papers.summary_zh: 该工作开发Ni3FeMo0.1@NiTe2异质结构催化剂，通过电化学-化学串联过程将硫化物 feedstock 转化为硫量子点并联产氢气，在膜电极组件中实现高电流密度稳定运行和规模化产率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对电化学过程规模化不足的问题，提出将含水硫化物原料转化为硫量子点（SQDs）并同时联产氢气的串联电化学-化学路线。以低成本商用Ni3FeMo0.1粉末为基础，构建异质结构Ni3FeMo0.1@NiTe2催化剂，在80摄氏度天然海水电解液中以仅1.07 V电压驱动硫化物到多硫化物的氧化反应，电流密度可达1.0 A cm-2；在膜电极组件中稳定运行超过290小时，并在四电池电解堆中保持优异性能，SQD产率达142 mg cm-2 day-1。原位光谱与密度泛函理论计算表明，Ni、Fe、Mo活性中心周围的多金属电子离域将硫化限制在催化剂表面并稳定更高的表面硫覆盖度，从而降低决速步能垒并抑制体相NiS生成。所得SQDs呈现随激发波长依赖的紫到蓝区可调光致发光。该工作将表面重构工程确立为纳米材料与绿氢耦合电合成的催化剂设计原则，并展示可调光致发光SQDs的放大合成。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以商用Ni3FeMo0.1粉末构建Ni3FeMo0.1@NiTe2异质结构催化剂；在80摄氏度天然海水电解液中进行电化学硫化物到多硫化物氧化反应，并在膜电极组件和四电池电解堆中评价稳定性与产率；采用原位光谱研究和密度泛函理论计算解析活性中心电子结构与反应路径；对所得SQDs进行光致发光表征。具体催化剂制备条件、表征仪器和测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于电化学合成与纳米材料规模化制备，与电化学合成主线相关，其串联电化学-化学策略和表面重构设计原则对电合成纳米材料有参考价值。但研究对象为硫量子点而非框架材料，与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架及自组装主线关联较弱。摘要数据较具体，若关注电合成规模化可精读全文核查催化剂制备与器件细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。催化剂的具体制备方法、结构与形貌表征、电解液组成、膜电极组件构型、原位光谱指认、DFT计算细节及SQD尺寸与发光机制仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Ni3FeMo0.1@NiTe2在80摄氏度天然海水中以1.07 V电压实现高达1.0 A cm-2的硫化物到多硫化物氧化电流密度。
膜电极组件稳定运行超过290小时，四电池电解堆中SQD产率达142 mg cm-2 day-1。
原位光谱与DFT表明多金属电子离域将硫化限制在表面、稳定高表面硫覆盖度，降低决速步能垒并抑制体相NiS生成。
所得SQDs具有随激发波长依赖的紫到蓝区可调光致发光。

papers.title: Programmable Budding and Fission of Janus Polymersomes for Tunable Cargo Release
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Internally phase‐separated Janus polymersomes are attractive biomimetic compartments, yet their formation remains fundamentally limited by membrane fission arising from strong copolymer incompatibility. Here, we show that a solvent‐assisted double‐emulsion strategy overcomes this limitation by enabling the formation of kinetically stable Janus giant unilamellar vesicles (JGUVs) across a substantially broader thermodynamic window than solvent‐free methods. Using a Flory‐Huggins‐based phase diagram, we establish a thermodynamic framework that correlates the Gibbs free energy of mixing with membrane morphology, and is fully consistent with the experimentally observed structures. This framework reveals how transient solvent plasticization during self‐assembly promotes copolymer compatibilization and suppresses premature membrane fission, while fluorescence recovery after photobleaching (FRAP) confirms that enhanced membrane fluidity occurs only during assembly and that no significant residual solvent remains after evaporation. Building on these stable Janus architectures, we demonstrate programmable membrane remodeling through osmotic stress, enabling reversible budding, controlled fission via long‐lived intermediate states, and operation down to 5 µm vesicle sizes. Finally, we show that these membrane transformations provide staged and tunable release of encapsulated cargo. Together, these findings establish a general strategy for programming the formation, remodeling, and function of Janus polymersomes, opening new opportunities for controlled delivery, artificial cell engineering, and adaptive biomimetic materials.

papers.title_zh: Janus聚合物囊泡的可编程出芽与分裂用于可调货物释放
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用溶剂辅助双乳液策略，在更宽热力学窗口内构建动力学稳定的Janus巨型单层囊泡，并以Flory-Huggins相图关联混合自由能与膜形貌。借助渗透胁迫实现可逆出芽、可控分裂及分级货物释放，为Janus聚合物囊泡的形成、重塑与功能编程提供通用策略。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对内部相分离Janus聚合物囊泡因共聚物强不相容性而易发生膜分裂、难以稳定形成的问题，提出溶剂辅助双乳液策略，在较无溶剂法显著更宽的热力学窗口内制备动力学稳定的Janus巨型单层囊泡。作者建立基于Flory-Huggins的相图，将混合Gibbs自由能与膜形貌关联，并与实验观察结构一致。该热力学框架揭示自组装过程中瞬态溶剂增塑促进共聚物增容、抑制过早膜分裂；FRAP证实膜流动性增强仅发生于组装阶段，蒸发后无显著残留溶剂。基于稳定Janus结构，利用渗透胁迫实现可编程膜重塑，包括可逆出芽、经长寿命中间态的可控分裂，并可操作至5微米囊泡尺寸。膜转变进一步实现封装货物的分级、可调释放。该工作为Janus聚合物囊泡的形成、重塑和功能编程建立通用策略，面向受控递送、人工细胞工程和自适应仿生材料。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：溶剂辅助双乳液自组装制备Janus巨型单层囊泡；基于Flory-Huggins的相图构建热力学框架；荧光漂白后恢复（FRAP）评估膜流动性与残留溶剂；渗透胁迫诱导膜重塑（出芽、分裂）；以及封装货物的释放测试。摘要未报告具体溶剂种类、共聚物组成、渗透压条件及定量释放曲线等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 对自组装技术与框架/软材料组装主线具有方法学参考价值：其溶剂增塑调控相分离与膜稳定性的热力学框架，可启发介孔或框架材料自组装中的动力学捕获与形貌控制；渗透胁迫驱动的可编程膜重塑与分级释放展示了动态结构—功能耦合。但研究对象为聚合物囊泡而非MOF/COF/HOF或介孔无机材料，与导电框架、电化学合成主线关联有限，属于拓展性借鉴，是否精读取决于对软物质自组装与刺激响应释放的兴趣。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。共聚物化学结构、溶剂体系、相图参数、FRAP定量数据、分裂中间态寿命、释放效率与动力学等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 溶剂辅助双乳液策略在较无溶剂法显著更宽的热力学窗口内形成动力学稳定的Janus巨型单层囊泡。
基于Flory-Huggins的相图将混合Gibbs自由能与膜形貌关联，并与实验观察结构一致。
FRAP证实膜流动性增强仅发生在组装阶段，蒸发后无显著残留溶剂。
渗透胁迫实现可逆出芽、经长寿命中间态的可控分裂，可操作至5微米囊泡尺寸，并实现分级可调货物释放。

papers.title: Swelling–Shrinking Strategy of Polymer Nanospheres for the Creation of Novel Nanostructured Materials
papers.abstract: Conspectus The rational construction of polymer nanostructures with tunable architectures and integrated functions has become a central pursuit in contemporary materials science. Owing to their soft nature and environmental responsiveness, polymer nanoparticles can undergo dynamic morphological evolution under external regulation, offering an attractive platform for constructing hollow, porous, anisotropic, and hierarchically organized nanostructures. Importantly, these architectures are not merely geometric variations; they determine mass-transport pathways, regulate interfacial reactions, accommodate guest species, and govern the performance of polymer-based functional materials in catalysis, biomedicine, and related fields. Nevertheless, transforming simple polymer nanospheres into complex nanoscale architectures with high precision remains challenging. Conventional templating or etching methods often involve multistep procedures, harsh conditions, or sacrificial components, which restrict structural precision, compositional diversity, and scalability. Against this backdrop, the swelling–shrinking strategy has emerged as a controllable and versatile approach for reshaping polymer nanospheres from within. Typically, polymer particles are first induced to swell by selected solvents, temperature variation, or other external factors, allowing their internal networks to loosen, reorganize, or accommodate foreign components. Subsequent shrinking, driven by solvent exchange, chain relaxation, cross-linking, precipitation, or interfacial contraction, locks these transient states into stable nanostructures. In essence, swelling acts as a nanoscale “breathing” process that opens the polymer matrix, whereas shrinking functions as a “locking” step that sculpts and stabilizes cavities, pores, shells, and asymmetric domains. Such a controllable volume transition transforms soft polymers into sophisticated nanostructured architectures without relying entirely on rigid templates. In this Account, we present our perspective on swelling–shrinking of polymer nanospheres as a structural transformation strategy with particular emphasis on how this concept has guided our recent work on polydopamine (PDA)-based nanostructures. We use Polystyrene (PS), Poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA), and Resorcinol–formaldehyde resin (RF) particles as mechanistic references to clarify how solvent affinity, chain mobility, cross-linking density, and interfacial confinement regulate polymer volume change and structural fixation. These model systems help define the basic design logic: swelling creates a transient soft state, whereas shrinking locks nonequilibrium morphologies into hollow, yolk@shell, porous, or anisotropic architectures. Building on this understanding, we focus on PDA as the central material system. In our studies, PDA swelling–shrinking is coupled with interfacial adhesion, mesoporous silica assembly, photothermal response, and surface chemistry, enabling asymmetric yolk@shell structures, multisized porous shells, and PDA-based nanomotors. We discuss how these structures are formed, how their internal asymmetry and permeable shells are controlled, and why they are useful for catalysis and biomedical delivery. In catalysis, porous transport channels, confined reaction spaces, localized heating, and particle motion work together to enhance reaction efficiency. In biomedical systems, PDA-derived asymmetric porous structures enable gene loading, NIR-assisted delivery, and microenvironment regulation. Finally, we discuss remaining challenges in quantitatively understanding swelling kinetics, controlling nonequilibrium fixation, improving reproducibility, and extending this strategy to broader functional polymer systems.

papers.title_zh: 聚合物纳米球的溶胀—收缩策略用于构建新型纳米结构材料
papers.summary_zh: 该Account系统阐述以溶胀—收缩作为聚合物纳米球内部结构转变策略：溶胀打开聚合物网络形成瞬态软态，收缩将非平衡形貌锁定为中空、蛋黄@壳、多孔或各向异性结构。以PS、PMMA和RF为机理参照，重点讨论聚多巴胺体系与介孔二氧化硅组装、光热响应及催化/生物医学应用。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究聚焦如何将简单聚合物纳米球高精度转化为复杂纳米结构，指出传统模板法或刻蚀法常涉及多步流程、苛刻条件或牺牲组分，限制结构精度、组成多样性和可扩展性。作者提出溶胀—收缩策略：先由选定溶剂、温度变化或其他外部因素诱导颗粒溶胀，使内部网络松散、重组或容纳外来组分；随后通过溶剂交换、链松弛、交联、沉淀或界面收缩驱动收缩，将瞬态状态锁定为稳定纳米结构。溶胀被视为纳米尺度呼吸过程以打开聚合物基体，收缩则作为锁定步骤塑造并稳定空腔、孔、壳层和各向异性畴。文章以聚苯乙烯、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯和间苯二酚—甲醛树脂颗粒为机理参照，阐明溶剂亲和性、链迁移性、交联密度和界面限域如何调控体积变化与结构固定。在此基础上重点讨论聚多巴胺体系，将溶胀—收缩与界面黏附、介孔二氧化硅组装、光热响应和表面化学耦合，构建不对称蛋黄@壳结构、多尺寸多孔壳层及PDA基纳米马达，并讨论其在催化与生物医学递送中的用途。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法与手段包括：溶剂、温度或其他外部因素诱导溶胀；溶剂交换、链松弛、交联、沉淀或界面收缩驱动收缩固定；以PS、PMMA和RF颗粒作为机理参照体系；聚多巴胺与介孔二氧化硅组装、界面黏附、光热响应和表面化学耦合构建复合纳米结构；以及针对催化与生物医学递送的性能讨论。摘要未报告具体溶剂、交联剂、介孔二氧化硅合成条件及定量性能数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 对介孔材料与自组装主线有直接方法学价值：溶胀—收缩作为无刚性模板的结构转变策略，与介孔二氧化硅组装结合可构建多级多孔与蛋黄@壳结构，其关于交联密度、界面限域和溶剂亲和性的设计逻辑可迁移至框架/聚合物复合介孔材料的形貌调控。局限在于本文为Account综述，以PDA软材料为中心，未涉及导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，定量证据有限；适合作为介孔复合与软模板组装的思路参考，而非框架电化学方向的全文精读首选。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本条目为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要（Conspectus）。具体溶胀/收缩溶剂体系、交联条件、介孔二氧化硅组装参数、孔径与壳层尺寸、催化与递送定量结果等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 溶胀—收缩策略可在不完全依赖刚性模板的情况下，将聚合物纳米球转化为中空、蛋黄@壳、多孔和各向异性纳米结构。
溶剂亲和性、链迁移性、交联密度和界面限域是调控聚合物体积变化与结构固定的基本设计参数。
聚多巴胺体系的溶胀—收缩可与界面黏附、介孔二氧化硅组装、光热响应和表面化学耦合，形成不对称蛋黄@壳、多尺寸多孔壳层和PDA基纳米马达。
多孔传输通道、限域反应空间、局域加热和颗粒运动协同提升催化效率；PDA衍生不对称多孔结构可用于基因负载和近红外辅助递送。

papers.title: A Dynamic Self-Reporting Metal–Organic Framework System for Catalysis and Real-Time Reaction Monitoring
papers.abstract: Abstract Modern catalysis research has primarily focused on improving catalyst activity, selectivity, and stability through active-site engineering, microenvironment regulation, and mechanistic understanding. However, the sustainability and efficiency of catalytic processes also depend on the dynamic evolution of reaction systems, including substrate consumption, catalyst deactivation, and product accumulation. Despite their importance, these changes are typically assessed by off-line analysis rather than real-time monitoring, which hinders efficient process optimization and sustainable operation. Here, we develop a dynamic self-reporting (DSR) catalytic system based on Ag@UiO-66-(COOH)2/NDCA that simultaneously functions as a heterogeneous oxidation catalyst and an optical reporter for reaction progress. During oxidation, the emission intensity at 440 nm increases with product formation and exhibits a strong quantitative correlation with benzaldehyde yield, enabling reaction progress to be continuously tracked across a series of substituted benzyl alcohols. Mechanistic studies indicate that the luminescence response is governed by competitive absorption and substrate-dependent interactions. Density functional theory calculations further reveal that benzyl alcohol forms stronger dispersion-stabilized π···π interactions with the emissive NDCA2– linkers than benzaldehyde, resulting in more pronounced luminescence quenching. As benzyl alcohol is converted into the more weakly interacting product, this quenching is progressively relieved, producing a measurable increase in emission intensity that reports the reaction progress. This integration provides a platform for reaction monitoring, process optimization, and future automated manufacturing.
