papers.title_zh: 硫键驱动的电化学溴化物捕获：苯并噻唑功能化共价有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将苯并噻唑功能化COF用作硫键供体，通过C─S键σ-空穴优先识别Br⁻而非Cl⁻。介孔BTzTp与微孔TTzTp对照揭示孔道可及性作用，BTzTp@rGO复合电极实现高选择性、高稳定性电化学溴捕获。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对反渗透产水中溴化物选择性去除难题，提出以苯并噻唑功能化共价有机框架作为硫键供体的设计策略，利用C─S键轴上的σ-空穴优先与更软、更易极化的Br⁻作用而非Cl⁻。作者合成了两种保持相同识别位点但孔道尺寸不同的COF：介孔BTzTp约2.45 nm和微孔TTzTp约1.13 nm，以评估孔道可及性的作用。将BTzTp与rGO复合构建电极用于杂化电容去离子。研究通过电化学性能测试评价比电容、吸附容量、循环稳定性和选择性，并结合密度泛函理论计算解析识别机制。该工作展示了在节能水净化系统中高选择性、稳定去除溴化物的可行策略，同时以同识别位点、不同孔径的对照体系强化了孔道结构与性能关系的论证。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：合成苯并噻唑功能化COF（介孔BTzTp与微孔TTzTp）；制备BTzTp@rGO复合材料；以电化学测试评价比电容、溴吸附容量、循环稳定性及Br⁻/Cl⁻选择性；采用密度泛函理论计算分析C─S···Br⁻几何、归一化接触、HOMO离域与电荷转移。具体合成条件、表征手段及测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF、介孔框架与电化学合成/应用主线，展示了以孔道尺寸对照解析框架识别位点可及性的思路，并将硫键识别与电化学去离子结合。其介孔COF复合电极的稳定性与选择性数据对框架材料电化学应用有参考价值。局限在于摘要仅给出单一pH与有限循环数据，机制主要依赖DFT。值得全文精读以核查合成、表征与电化学细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级信息。COF合成条件、表征数据、电极制备工艺、电解液与测试参数、循环寿命外推及选择性测试条件等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: BTzTp@rGO复合物比电容为47 F g⁻¹，pH 4下最大溴吸附容量为36.7 mg-Br⁻ g⁻¹。
50次循环后电容保持率约99%，摘要称其为溴选择性HCDI电极中已报道的最高循环稳定性，选择性α Br/Cl = 10。
DFT计算表明选择性源于强硫键作用：近线性C─S···Br⁻几何（178°–179°）、归一化接触0.84、S···Br⁻界面HOMO离域，且向Br⁻的电荷转移（0.222 e）大于Cl⁻（0.154 e）。

papers.title: Stable Open-Shell Bowl-Shaped Cycloarene with Multiple Hybrid Spin–Spin Coupling and Tunable Radical Characters
papers.abstract: Abstract The precise syntheses of well-defined cycloarenes and stable open-shell polyradicaloids are two challenging topics in chemistry and materials science. Herein, the first example of a cycloarene polyradicaloid molecule (CPR) with three types of adjacent spin–spin coupling was successfully synthesized in single-crystal form by fusing Chichibabin, Schlenk, and o-quinodimethane hydrocarbons into a conjugated double-stranded bowl structure. It exhibits a small singlet–triplet energy gap, significant polyradical characters, and remarkable stability (t1/2 = 110 days in air-saturated solution). Interestingly, CPR adapts a rigid oval-bowl-shaped configuration and demonstrates fascinating encapsulation of fullerenes C60 and C70. Crucially, various experimental results confirm that the intramolecular spin–spin interactions can be effectively modulated by an electron-accepting guest, which represents the first systematic study of the radical characters in π-conjugated polyradicaloids by a supramolecular assembly strategy. Our findings provide a new approach for constructing stable cycloarene polyradicaloids and a novel strategy for manipulating radical spin coupling.

papers.title_zh: 具有多重混合自旋-自旋耦合和可调自由基特征的稳定开壳碗状环芳烃
papers.summary_zh: 该研究首次合成单晶形式的环芳烃多自由基分子，将Chichibabin、Schlenk与邻醌二甲烷烃稠合成共轭双股碗状结构，具小单-三重态能隙、显著多自由基特征和空气饱和溶液中110天半衰期稳定性，并可包封C60/C70调控自旋耦合。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究面向明确结构环芳烃与稳定开壳多自由基体两类合成难题，设计并合成了首个具有三种相邻自旋-自旋耦合类型的环芳烃多自由基分子。设计策略是将Chichibabin、Schlenk和邻醌二甲烷烃稠合进共轭双股碗状结构，并以单晶形式获得产物。该分子表现出小单-三重态能隙、显著多自由基特征以及在空气饱和溶液中t1/2 = 110天的显著稳定性。分子采取刚性椭圆碗状构型，可包封富勒烯C60和C70。关键的是，多种实验结果表明分子内自旋-自旋相互作用可被电子受体客体有效调控，摘要称这是首次以超分子组装策略系统研究π共轭多自由基体中自由基特征。该工作为构建稳定环芳烃多自由基体及操控自由基自旋耦合提供了新途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现：将Chichibabin、Schlenk和邻醌二甲烷烃稠合构建共轭双股碗状分子的合成策略；以单晶形式获得产物；通过多种实验结果表明自旋-自旋相互作用可被电子受体客体调控；以超分子组装策略研究自由基特征；富勒烯C60和C70包封实验。具体表征手段、能隙数值及耦合机制细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于共轭框架/超分子组装与自由基化学交叉方向，其碗状共轭多自由基的客体包封与自旋耦合调控策略，对框架材料组装调控电子结构有方法学启发。但与介孔导电MOF、COF/HOF电化学合成主线关联较间接，摘要未涉及孔道或电化学性能。可作为超分子组装调控自由基特征的拓展阅读，是否精读取决于对自旋耦合机制的兴趣。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级信息。单-三重态能隙具体数值、自由基特征定量、客体调控的实验证据类型、表征方法与稳定性测试条件等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 首次以单晶形式合成含三种相邻自旋-自旋耦合类型的环芳烃多自由基分子，具小单-三重态能隙和显著多自由基特征。
在空气饱和溶液中半衰期t1/2 = 110天，显示显著稳定性。

papers.title: Regulating sodium deposition and interfacial chemistry via sulfur-embedded carbon spheres enables high-power Ah-level sodium-metal batteries
papers.abstract: Sodium metal batteries offer high energy density and abundant resources, yet their cycling stability is hindered by uncontrolled Na dendrite growth, especially under high capacity and high-rate conditions. Although three-dimensional sodiophilic matrixes can enable uniform Na deposition, the large specific surface area often exacerbates interfacial side reactions, while excessive mass/volume fraction compromises the overall energy density and power performance. Herein, we design sulfur-embedded mesoporous hollow carbon spheres as a matrix for Na metal negative electrodes. The sulfur species not only guide confined nucleation and uniform deposition of Na within the carbon spheres, but also participate in forming Na2S nanocrystals in the solid electrolyte interphase. These nanocrystals facilitate the decomposition of fluoroethylene carbonate, contributing to a NaF-rich robust solid electrolyte interphase that stabilizes the interface. With only 5 wt% sulfur-embedded mesoporous hollow carbon spheres, the sodium composite electrode achieves stable cycling at high current density (up to 40 mA cm−2) and high areal capacity (up to 40 mAh cm−2). Notably, the pouch cells deliver high specific energy up to 178 Wh kg−1 and high specific power up to 420 W kg−1 when coupled with Na3V2(PO4)3, based on total cell mass, highlighting a feasible matrix design for practical high-performance sodium metal batteries. Sodium metal batteries offer high energy density but suffer from dendritic Na growth and unstable interphases. Here, authors design sulfur-embedded mesoporous carbon spheres that regulate Na deposition and form a robust NaF-rich interphase, enabling high power Ah-level sodium metal batteries with long cycle life.

papers.title_zh: 硫嵌入介孔空心碳球调控钠沉积与界面化学实现高功率安时级钠金属电池
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计硫嵌入介孔空心碳球作为钠金属负极基体，硫物种引导限域成核与均匀沉积，并参与形成Na2S纳米晶促进FEC分解，构建富NaF稳定SEI。仅5 wt%添加即实现高电流密度与高面容量稳定循环，软包电池达178 Wh kg⁻¹和420 W kg⁻¹。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对钠金属电池在高容量和高倍率下钠枝晶生长导致循环稳定性差的问题。虽然三维亲钠基体可实现均匀钠沉积，但大比表面积加剧界面副反应，过量质量/体积分数又损害能量密度与功率性能。作者设计硫嵌入介孔空心碳球作为钠金属负极基体：硫物种一方面引导钠在碳球内限域成核与均匀沉积，另一方面参与在固体电解质界面中形成Na2S纳米晶；这些纳米晶促进氟代碳酸乙烯酯分解，有助于形成富NaF的稳固SEI以稳定界面。仅添加5 wt%硫嵌入介孔空心碳球，钠复合电极即在高电流密度（最高40 mA cm⁻²）和高面容量（最高40 mAh cm⁻²）下实现稳定循环。与Na3V2(PO4)3配对时，基于电池总质量的软包电池比能量最高178 Wh kg⁻¹、比功率最高420 W kg⁻¹，展示了面向实用高性能钠金属电池的可行基体设计。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现：设计并制备硫嵌入介孔空心碳球基体；构建含5 wt%该碳球的钠复合电极；在高电流密度和高面容量条件下进行电化学循环测试；分析固体电解质界面中Na2S纳米晶与富NaF SEI的形成；与Na3V2(PO4)3正极配对组装软包电池并评价比能量与比功率。具体合成路线、表征手段与测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作以介孔空心碳球为结构平台，涉及介孔材料、成核组装与界面化学调控，对理解介孔碳基体中限域沉积与SEI设计有参考价值。但其对象是钠金属负极而非导电MOF/COF框架，与框架材料电化学合成主线关联有限。摘要给出的高倍率、高面容量与软包电池数据较具体，若关注介孔碳在金属负极中的界面调控可精读，否则可作为拓展参考。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目与摘要，属摘要级信息。碳球合成与硫嵌入方法、孔结构表征、SEI成分定量证据、循环寿命与库仑效率、软包电池测试条件等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 仅5 wt%硫嵌入介孔空心碳球，钠复合电极可在高达40 mA cm⁻²电流密度和高达40 mAh cm⁻²面容量下稳定循环。
硫物种引导限域成核与均匀钠沉积，并参与形成Na2S纳米晶，促进FEC分解以构建富NaF稳固SEI。
与Na3V2(PO4)3配对的软包电池基于总质量实现比能量最高178 Wh kg⁻¹、比功率最高420 W kg⁻¹。

papers.title: Development of Ester-Based Covalent Organic Framework Film Optical Waveguides for Their Competitive SO2 Gas Sensing Application
papers.abstract: Abstract Ester-based covalent organic frameworks (COFs) demonstrate improved sensing stability and enhanced dipole–dipole (μ–μ) interactions for competitive SO2 sensing upon various acidic gases. An ester-based COF, referred to as [H4bptc-TOPT]n-COF, was synthesized using biphenyl-3,3′,5,5′-tetracarboxylic acid (H4bptc) monomer and 4,4′,4″-(1,3,5-triazine-2,4,6-triyl) triphenol (TOPT) linker through a one-pot solvothermal method. The resulting COF films were optically transparent and exhibited an irregular hexagonal mesoporous architecture and a high refractive index (from 1.7247 to1.9073), which supports strong single-mode (TE0) guided light, meeting the essential criteria for an optical waveguide sensor (OWGS). As an OWGS, the [H4bptc-TOPT]n-COF film demonstrated high efficiency in SO2 sensing upon various acidic gases. The spectral analysis and density-functional theory computations indicated that the ester group and benzene ring in [H4bptc-TOPT]n-COF contribute to SO2 sensing through μ–μ interactions, which are associated with increased adsorption energy, elongated ester bond length, and reduced bond angles, leading to an increase in the refractive index, adsorption coefficient, and almost reversible morphological change of the [H4bptc-TOPT]n-COF. The presented OWGS features a fast response (tres = 2 s), a wide detection range (100 ppm to 10 ppb), a low detection limit (2.5 ppb), and excellent resistance to interference at 293 K despite its weak immunity to humidity. Furthermore, SO2 adsorption weight of 17.18 ng·cm–2 was determined on per unit area of the [H4bptc-TOPT]n-COF film surface upon μ–μ interactions.

papers.title_zh: 用于竞争性SO2气体传感的酯基共价有机框架薄膜光波导的研制
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过一锅溶剂热法合成酯基COF薄膜[H4bptc-TOPT]n-COF，构建光波导传感器，实现对SO2的快速、宽范围、低检测限传感，并借助光谱与DFT计算揭示酯基和苯环通过偶极-偶极相互作用参与传感的机制。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对酸性气体中竞争性SO2传感的稳定性与选择性需求，采用联苯-3,3′,5,5′-四甲酸（H4bptc）单体与4,4′,4″-(1,3,5-三嗪-2,4,6-三基)三苯酚（TOPT）连接体，通过一锅溶剂热法合成酯基COF[H4bptc-TOPT]n-COF薄膜。所得薄膜光学透明，具有不规则六边形介孔结构，折射率在1.7247至1.9073之间，可支持强单模（TE0）导光，满足光波导传感器（OWGS）的基本条件。作为OWGS，该薄膜在多种酸性气体中对SO2表现出高效传感。光谱分析与密度泛函理论计算表明，COF中的酯基和苯环通过偶极-偶极（μ–μ）相互作用参与SO2传感，伴随吸附能增加、酯键键长伸长和键角减小，导致折射率、吸附系数增加以及几乎可逆的形貌变化。该工作展示了酯基COF薄膜作为光波导传感平台的潜力，并给出了传感性能的定量边界。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用一锅溶剂热法合成酯基COF薄膜；对薄膜进行光学透明性、介孔结构（不规则六边形）和折射率表征，并评估其单模TE0导光能力；以光波导传感器形式测试对SO2及多种酸性气体的传感性能，包括响应时间、检测范围、检测限、抗干扰性和湿度影响；结合光谱分析与密度泛函理论计算研究传感机制，并测定SO2吸附重量。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联介孔COF薄膜的组装与光波导传感应用，展示了酯基COF在气体传感中的结构—性能关系及μ–μ相互作用机制，对框架材料组装和电化学合成主线中的传感功能化设计有参考价值。其局限在于仅针对SO2传感且湿度免疫较弱，摘要未报告电化学合成或电化学测试内容；若关注COF薄膜光学传感与介孔结构调控，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级解读；合成条件细节、薄膜厚度、表征参数、传感测试条件、DFT计算模型及湿度影响的具体数据等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 酯基COF薄膜[H4bptc-TOPT]n-COF具有不规则六边形介孔结构，折射率为1.7247至1.9073，支持单模TE0导光。
作为光波导传感器，响应时间tres=2 s，检测范围100 ppm至10 ppb，检测限2.5 ppb，在293 K下抗干扰性优异，但对湿度免疫较弱。
光谱分析与DFT计算表明酯基和苯环通过μ–μ相互作用参与SO2传感，伴随吸附能增加、酯键伸长、键角减小，以及折射率和吸附系数增加和几乎可逆的形貌变化。
在μ–μ相互作用下，单位面积COF薄膜表面的SO2吸附重量为17.18 ng·cm–2。

papers.title: Impact of Backbone Fluorination on Self-Assembly and Mixed Conduction of Isoindigo-Based Polymers
papers.abstract: Abstract Fluorination is a common method to induce backbone planarity in semiconducting polymers via noncovalent interactions that effectively lock the rotation of single bonds along the backbone. Often explored in dry-state devices, fluorination of isoindigo polymer backbones in mixed conductors remains relatively unexplored. Herein, we investigated systematic fluorination of a family of isoindigo-based mixed conducting polymers with hybrid ethylene glycol-based side chains to probe the impact of fluorination on the resulting assembly and electrochemical performance. Through UV–Vis–NIR, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, and electrochemical methods, we showed that fluorination effectively planarizes portions of the backbone depending on the fluorination location, even with ethylene glycol side chains, and the placement of fluorine atoms along the backbone is crucial toward organic electrochemical transistor (OECT) device performance. Electronic conduction was found to be improved upon fluorinating the isoindigo acceptor unit in OECTs, but it came at the cost of decreased volumetric ionic capacitance. Further, fluorinating the bithiophene donor inhibited p-type conduction in OECTs. As a result, systematic fluorination revealed the importance of understanding the nuanced design requirements of isoindigo-based mixed conductors for the optimal balance of both modes of conduction in aqueous environments.
papers.recommendation: 同时命中导电/共轭框架、组装与结晶，建议优先检查其合成路径与孔结构证据。
papers.title_zh: 主链氟化对异靛基聚合物自组装及混合传导的影响
papers.summary_zh: 该研究系统氟化异靛基混合传导聚合物主链，结合光谱与电化学方法揭示氟化位置对主链平面化、自组装及有机电化学晶体管性能的影响，发现氟化受电子单元可提升电子传导但降低体积离子电容，而氟化给电子单元抑制p型传导。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究关注氟化作为诱导主链平面化的常见策略在混合传导聚合物中相对未被探索的问题。作者设计了一系列异靛基混合传导聚合物，带有杂化乙二醇基侧链，并对主链进行系统氟化，以探究氟化对组装和电化学性能的影响。通过紫外-可见-近红外、傅里叶变换红外、拉曼光谱和电化学方法，研究表明氟化可根据氟化位置有效平面化部分主链，即使存在乙二醇侧链也是如此；氟原子沿主链的位置对有机电化学晶体管（OECT）器件性能至关重要。在OECT中，氟化异靛受电子单元可改善电子传导，但代价是体积离子电容下降；氟化联噻吩给电子单元则抑制p型传导。该系统性氟化研究揭示了异靛基混合传导聚合物在水环境中平衡电子与离子传导的细致设计需求。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用紫外-可见-近红外光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、拉曼光谱和电化学方法研究一系列异靛基混合传导聚合物的主链氟化效应；以有机电化学晶体管（OECT）器件评估电子传导和体积离子电容等性能。摘要未报告具体合成步骤、氟化位置数量及器件制备细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装与混合传导聚合物研究，涉及主链氟化调控组装和电化学性能，对理解框架/聚合物材料中电子与离子传导平衡有拓展参考价值。但其材料体系为异靛基聚合物而非介孔导电MOF或共轭框架材料，且摘要未报告电化学合成或框架组装内容；与主线关联较间接，可作为混合传导设计思路的拓展阅读，是否全文精读取决于对聚合物OECT的兴趣。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级解读；具体聚合物结构、氟化位置与数量、合成条件、OECT器件参数及定量电化学数据等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 氟化可根据位置有效平面化部分主链，即使带有乙二醇侧链；氟原子沿主链的位置对OECT器件性能至关重要。
在OECT中氟化异靛受电子单元改善电子传导，但导致体积离子电容下降。
氟化联噻吩给电子单元抑制OECT中的p型传导。
系统性氟化揭示了异靛基混合传导聚合物在水环境中优化电子与离子两种传导模式平衡的设计要求。

papers.title: Topology-Engineered Dual-Functional COFs with Spatially Cooperated Hydrophilic and Photocatalytic Sites for Harvesting Safe Water from Polluted Atmosphere
papers.abstract: Abstract Atmospheric water harvesting (AWH) has emerged as a promising decentralized solution for freshwater supply in off-grid regions by extracting ubiquitous moisture from the air. However, the atmosphere also carries airborne pathogens and, under extreme scenarios, toxic chemicals, which can be coharvested to contaminate the collected water. Despite extensive efforts to maximize water uptake, the safety of the harvested water has been largely neglected in the pursuit of higher water production yields. Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) provide crystalline, molecularly programmable platforms for integrating water adsorption with photocatalytic detoxification. However, achieving such functional synergy depends on framework topology, which governs site accessibility and mass transport. Here, we report topology-engineered dual-functional COFs that regulate spatial cooperation among hydrophilic sites, photoactive sites, and pore structures in a series of 1D and 2D hydrazone COFs constructed from identical molecular building blocks. Compared to the compact 1D chain packing, the open and continuous channels of the 2D framework increase functional-site accessibility, support hydrogen-bonded water network formation, and facilitate charge-carrier separation and O2 activation. The optimized Por-TAH (2D) exhibits a saturated water uptake of 629 mg g–1, releases 94% of adsorbed water under mild heating, inactivates 99.99% of S. aureus within 1 h, and completely converts chemical agents with high selectivity within 10 min. As a proof-of-concept application, continuous-flow operation demonstrates integrated water harvesting and photocatalytic detoxification, yielding safe water free of detectable mustard gas simulants. This study establishes topology-directed spatial cooperation as a design principle for multifunctional porous materials, enabling safe water production from real contaminated air.

papers.title_zh: 拓扑工程双功能COF的空间协同亲水与光催化位点用于从污染大气中获取安全水
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以相同分子构建单元合成一系列1D和2D腙基COF，通过拓扑工程调控亲水位点、光活性位点与孔道的空间协同，优化得到Por-TAH（2D），实现高吸水、温和释放、快速杀菌和化学毒剂完全转化，并演示连续流安全水生产。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对大气水收集（AWH）中收集水安全性被忽视的问题：大气携带病原体和有毒化学物质，可能共收集污染水体。COF提供晶态、分子可编程平台以整合水吸附与光催化解毒，但功能协同取决于框架拓扑，拓扑决定位点可及性和传质。作者以相同分子构建单元合成一系列1D和2D腙基COF，进行拓扑工程以调控亲水位点、光活性位点和孔结构的空间协同。与紧凑的1D链堆积相比，2D框架的开放连续通道提高了功能位点可及性，支持氢键水网络形成，并促进电荷载流子分离和O2活化。优化得到的Por-TAH（2D）饱和吸水量为629 mg g–1，温和加热下释放94%吸附水，1 h内灭活99.99%金黄色葡萄球菌，10 min内高选择性完全转化化学毒剂。作为概念验证，连续流操作实现集成水收集与光催化解毒，产出无可检测芥子气模拟物的安全水。该研究确立了拓扑导向空间协同作为多功能多孔材料的设计原则。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确以相同分子构建单元合成一系列1D和2D腙基COF，通过拓扑工程调控功能位点空间协同；评估饱和水吸附量、温和加热下的水释放率、对金黄色葡萄球菌的灭活率、化学毒剂转化率与选择性；并以连续流操作进行水收集与光催化解毒的概念验证，检测芥子气模拟物。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段和光催化测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF的拓扑设计与多功能位点空间协同，涉及孔道结构、传质、水吸附和光催化解毒，对框架材料组装与功能集成主线有较高参考价值。其局限在于摘要未报告电化学合成或导电性内容，且应用聚焦大气水收集；若关注COF拓扑—性能关系和多功能孔材料设计，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于题目和摘要，属摘要级解读；具体合成条件、COF结构表征、光催化机制证据、连续流装置参数及毒剂检测方法等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 2D框架的开放连续通道相比紧凑1D链堆积提高功能位点可及性，支持氢键水网络形成，并促进电荷载流子分离和O2活化。
优化Por-TAH（2D）饱和吸水量629 mg g–1，温和加热下释放94%吸附水。
Por-TAH（2D）在1 h内灭活99.99%金黄色葡萄球菌，10 min内高选择性完全转化化学毒剂。
连续流操作实现集成水收集与光催化解毒，产出无可检测芥子气模拟物的安全水。

papers.title: Surface-Layer Pore Aperture Engineering in a Metal–Organic Framework for High-Capacity CO2/C2H2 Molecular Sieving
papers.abstract: Abstract Molecular sieving in metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) is commonly achieved by narrowing the entire pore network, which enhances size exclusion but often sacrifices adsorption capacity. Here we report surface-layer pore aperture engineering as a spatially decoupled strategy for high-capacity CO2/C2H2 molecular sieving. Through surface-confined coordination modification of a copper-based MOF, the external pore apertures were selectively regulated while the internal adsorption space was largely preserved. Microscopy, elemental mapping, depth-resolved XPS, and X-ray absorption spectroscopy support the formation of a surface-confined functional shell at the pore aperture. The modified framework converts a nonselective, high-capacity adsorbent into a CO2/C2H2 molecular sieve. BUT-169-NH2-TRZ retains a high CO2 uptake of 90.3 cm3 g–1 at 298 K and 1 bar while suppressing C2H2 adsorption to 2.7 cm3 g–1, representing a new benchmark for CO2/C2H2 sieving separation. Further optimization with hexylamine affords faster CO2 transport and dynamic CO2/C2H2 separation, delivering a high productivity of 1.13 mol kg–1 for C2H2 (purity &gt; 99.99%) over repeated breakthrough cycles. This work establishes surface-layer pore aperture engineering as a route to overcome the conventional selectivity–capacity trade-off in molecular sieving separations.

papers.title_zh: 金属有机框架表层孔口工程实现高容量CO2/C2H2分子筛分
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出表层孔口工程策略，对铜基MOF外表面孔口进行配位修饰，在基本保留内部吸附空间的同时将非选择性高容量吸附剂转化为CO2/C2H2分子筛，实现高CO2吸附容量与高分离选择性兼得。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对MOF分子筛分中普遍存在的选择性—容量权衡问题：传统方法通过收窄整个孔道网络增强尺寸排斥，却牺牲吸附容量。作者提出空间解耦的表层孔口工程策略，以铜基MOF为母体，通过表面限域配位修饰选择性调控外表面孔口，而内部吸附空间基本保留。显微术、元素映射、深度分辨XPS和X射线吸收谱支持在孔口处形成表面限域功能壳层。修饰后的框架由非选择性高容量吸附剂转变为CO2/C2H2分子筛。进一步以己胺优化后获得更快的CO2传输和动态CO2/C2H2分离性能。该工作确立了表层孔口工程作为克服分子筛分中传统选择性—容量权衡的可行路径，对介孔/微孔框架材料的孔口精细调控具有方法学意义。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的合成方法为表面限域配位修饰（包括己胺后处理优化）；表征手段包括显微术、元素映射、深度分辨XPS和X射线吸收谱；性能测试包括298 K、1 bar下的CO2与C2H2吸附测试以及重复穿透循环的动态分离测试。具体合成条件、修饰试剂用量与表征参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联框架材料孔口工程与分子筛分主线，提出表层与内部空间解耦的设计思路，对介孔/微孔MOF的孔口精细修饰和气体分离应用有实际参考价值。其策略可迁移至其他框架材料的表面功能化。局限在于仅涉及CO2/C2H2体系，长期稳定性与规模化制备摘要未报告，建议全文精读以核查修饰层结构与孔口调控机制。

papers.title: Dynamic Soft‐Confinement via Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Frameworks Reshapes C–C Coupling Interfacial Chemistry at Bi 1 –Bi 2 Sites
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The core bottleneck in photocatalytic CO 2 reduction toward multi‐carbon oxygenates lies in the thermodynamic‐kinetic dual limitations of the C–C coupling step. Conventional strategies have focused on intrinsic electronic structure optimization of active sites while overlooking the critical influence of the reaction microenvironment on coupling probability. Herein, we propose a dynamic soft‐confinement catalytic strategy by in situ constructing a disordered hydrogen‐bonded organic framework (HOF) layer on Bi 3 O 4 Br surfaces, thereby establishing an HOF/Bi 3 O 4 Br integrated photocatalytic system. The introduction of HOF not only induces the formation of asymmetric Bi 1 –Bi 2 coupling sites but also establishes a dynamic hydrogen‐bonding microenvironment surrounding them. This microenvironment enhances CO 2 coverage near the coupling sites by constructing a persistent carbon source enrichment layer. Simultaneously, the interfacial polarization field promotes exciton dissociation and directs electron transport toward the Bi 1 –Bi 2 sites. Furthermore, the reconfigurable hydrogen bonds impose orientational soft confinement on *CO intermediates, guiding them into spatial configurations favorable for *OCCO bond formation. This soft‐hard synergistic interfacial design enables 0.7HOF/Bi 3 O 4 Br to achieve a CH 3 COOH production rate of 325.12 µmol g −1 h −1 with 98.81% product selectivity under sacrificial agent‐free conditions. This work demonstrates that dynamic microenvironment programming around active sites constitutes a critical pathway for overcoming the photocatalytic C–C coupling bottleneck.

papers.title_zh: 氢键有机框架动态软限域重塑Bi1–Bi2位点C–C偶联界面化学
papers.summary_zh: 该工作在Bi3O4Br表面原位构建无序氢键有机框架层，诱导不对称Bi1–Bi2偶联位点并建立动态氢键微环境，通过软硬协同界面设计提升光催化CO2还原C–C偶联效率与乙酸选择性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对光催化CO2还原制多碳含氧产物中C–C偶联步骤的热力学—动力学双重限制，指出传统策略聚焦活性位点本征电子结构优化而忽视反应微环境对偶联概率的影响。作者提出动态软限域催化策略，在Bi3O4Br表面原位构建无序氢键有机框架（HOF）层，形成HOF/Bi3O4Br一体化光催化体系。HOF引入不仅诱导形成不对称Bi1–Bi2偶联位点，还在其周围建立动态氢键微环境：持续碳源富集层提高偶联位点附近CO2覆盖度；界面极化场促进激子解离并引导电子向Bi1–Bi2位点传输；可重构氢键对*CO中间体施加取向性软限域，引导其进入有利于*OCCO成键的空间构型。软硬协同界面设计使0.7HOF/Bi3O4Br在无牺牲剂条件下实现乙酸产率325.12 µmol g–1 h–1、产物选择性98.81%。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：在Bi3O4Br表面原位构建无序HOF层制备HOF/Bi3O4Br复合光催化体系；在无牺牲剂条件下进行光催化CO2还原性能测试，评价乙酸产率与产物选择性。具体HOF单体、原位组装条件、光照参数及界面表征手段摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作将HOF作为动态软限域层用于调控界面反应微环境，拓展了HOF在框架材料组装与催化界面工程中的应用，对共轭/氢键框架材料的原位构建及微环境编程主线有参考价值。其软限域概念可启发框架材料与无机半导体复合的界面设计。局限在于体系为光催化CO2还原，与电化学合成主线关联有限，建议全文精读以核查HOF结构与界面机制证据。

HOF层诱导形成不对称Bi1–Bi2偶联位点，并构建持续碳源富集层提高偶联位点附近CO2覆盖度。
界面极化场促进激子解离并引导电子传输至Bi1–Bi2位点；可重构氢键对*CO中间体施加取向性软限域，引导有利于*OCCO成键的构型。

papers.title: Constructing Dinuclear Cd2-Porphyrin Motifs in Metal–Organic Frameworks to Accelerate Intersystem Crossing for Boosting Photocatalytic Aerobic Oxidation
papers.abstract: Abstract Dinuclear metalloporphyrin cores remain elusive in metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), despite their potential to direct spin–orbit coupling and triplet sensitization for efficient singlet oxygen (1O2) generation. Herein, we report a structurally precise series of Cd-porphyrin MOFs to elucidate how porphyrin-core nuclearity and coordination geometry influence 1O2 photosensitization. Solvothermal regulation affords three crystalline porous frameworks featuring a free-base porphyrin core (QPF-8), a mononuclear Cd-porphyrin unit (QPF-9), and a dinuclear Cd2-porphyrin motif (QPF-10). QPF-8 serves as an additional free-base reference, whereas the closely related QPF-9 and QPF-10 provide a direct platform for probing how mono- and dinuclear porphyrin coordination environments influence photophysical properties. QPF-10 exhibits a measured 1O2 quantum yield of 0.68, compared with 0.50 for QPF-9. Spectroscopic analyses and theoretical calculations associate the dinuclear motif with enhanced metal-porphyrin orbital mixing and a 4.59-fold increase in the calculated S1–T1 spin–orbit coupling matrix element (from 3.14 to 14.40 cm–1), supporting more effective triplet photosensitization. Consistent with these photophysical properties, QPF-10 demonstrates superior catalytic activity in the aerobic photooxidation of 1,5-dihydroxynaphthalene. Notably, its activity is approximately twice that of the archetypal PCN-224(Zn) and also exceeds that of the Pt-based QPF-1(Pt). These results identify dinuclear porphyrin coordination as a structural strategy for enhancing triplet photosensitization in crystalline heterogeneous catalysts.

papers.title_zh: 在金属有机框架中构建双核Cd2-卟啉基元加速系间窜越以提升光催化有氧氧化

papers.title: Hidden Truchet Architecture in Zinc p -Hydroxybenzoate
papers.abstract: Abstract We redetermine the structure of the disordered metal–organic framework Zn(hba) (hba2– = the dianion of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid). Using single-crystal X-ray diffraction measurements, we characterize the structured diffuse scattering that is experimentally observed for this material and which is characteristic of strongly correlated disorder. We use geometric and crystal-chemical arguments to propose a general model for correlated disorder in Zn(hba), and then relate this model to a specific realization of so-called Truchet tilings. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we proceed to show that the model so developed is simultaneously consistent with both the average crystal structure solution described previously and the structured diffuse scattering reported here. The existence of ordered analogues with different but related chemistry suggests scope for control over correlated disorder in this family of metal–organic frameworks. Our study illustrates the potential for a Truchet-tile formalism to help describe and understand more generally the correlated disorder that can occur in network structures.

papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对无序金属有机框架Zn(hba)（hba2–为4-羟基苯甲酸双阴离子）的结构解析问题。作者通过单晶X射线衍射测量该材料实验观察到的结构化漫散射，指出其是强相关无序的特征。基于几何与晶体化学论证，提出Zn(hba)中相关无序的一般模型，并将该模型与Truchet铺砌的一种具体实现相联系。随后用蒙特卡罗模拟证明所建模型同时与先前报道的平均晶体结构解和本文报道的结构化漫散射一致。摘要还指出，具有不同但相关化学组成的有序类似物的存在，提示该金属有机框架家族中相关无序具有调控空间。该工作意义在于展示Truchet铺砌形式化方法可用于更普遍地描述和理解网络结构中的相关无序。

papers.title: Bioinspired Adaptive Ångström‐Channels in a Hydrogen‐Bonded Metal–Organic Framework for Selective Water Removal From Gas Streams by Molecular Sieving Dehydration
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The removal of water from light hydrocarbons is a critical yet energy‐intensive step in petrochemical processes. Conventional adsorbents often suffer from high regeneration temperatures and undesirable co‐adsorption. Inspired by the selective water transport mechanism of aquaporins, we report a hydrogen‐bonded metal–organic framework, ZNU‐33, featuring bioinspired adaptive one‐dimensional channels. The pore walls are decorated with both positively charged (Hbpa + ) and negatively charged (HEDP 4− ) recognition sites. Using in situ single‐crystal x‐ray diffraction, we captured five phases of ZNU‐33, activated (ZNU‐33‐α), intermediate (ZNU‐33‐β), partially dehydrated (ZNU‐33‐γ and ZNU‐33‐γ2), and fully hydrated ZNU‐33, directly visualizing a water‑triggered structural transition. Structural snapshots reveal water uptake proceeding from free‐channel water to Cu 2+ coordination and then to extended hydrogen‐bonded water chains. ZNU‐33 exhibits high water uptake (9.50 mmol/g at 2.85 kPa and 298 K) and negligible adsorption of CO 2 and all light hydrocarbons. Breakthrough experiments demonstrate efficient water removal under wide flow rates, temperatures, and humidity levels, with water‐adsorption capacity recoverable under substantially milder activation conditions than those required by the investigated conventional zeolites. This work not only provides a high‑performance material for selective dehydration, but also establishes a bioinspired adaptive adsorption mechanism for designing water‐selective adsorbents.

papers.title_zh: 氢键金属有机框架中仿生自适应埃级通道用于气流分子筛脱水选择性除水
papers.summary_zh: 报道氢键金属有机框架ZNU-33，具仿生自适应一维通道和正负识别位点，原位单晶X射线衍射捕获五个相并可视化水触发结构转变，实现高水吸附与轻烃/CO2近零吸附及宽条件突破脱水。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对轻烃中除水这一关键但高能耗的石化步骤，常规吸附剂存在再生温度高和共吸附问题。受水通道蛋白选择性水传输机制启发，作者报道氢键金属有机框架ZNU-33，具有仿生自适应一维通道，孔壁修饰带正电的Hbpa+和带负电的HEDP4−识别位点。利用原位单晶X射线衍射捕获ZNU-33的五个相：活化相ZNU-33-α、中间相ZNU-33-β、部分脱水相ZNU-33-γ和ZNU-33-γ2以及完全水合ZNU-33，直接可视化水触发的结构转变。结构快照揭示水吸附从自由通道水到Cu2+配位再到延伸氢键水链的过程。ZNU-33表现出高水吸附量（298 K、2.85 kPa下9.50 mmol/g），对CO2和所有轻烃吸附可忽略。突破实验证明在宽流速、温度和湿度下高效除水，且水吸附容量可在比所考察常规沸石显著更温和的活化条件下恢复。

papers.title: Charge Donated by the Framework, Reactivity Expressed at the Metal: Tetrathiafulvalene-Programmed Nitrate Reduction to Ammonia
papers.abstract: The decisive challenge in nitrate-to-ammonia electrosynthesis is not simply supplying electrons, but ensuring that successive nitrogen intermediates remain chemically convertible. Here, we establish a molecular strategy that differentiates framework-derived electronic character from metal-directed reaction selectivity through TU-420, a crystalline covalent organic framework integrating electron-donating tetrathiafulvalene and electron-accepting, metal-coordinating bipyridine units. Electronic-structure analysis identifies complementary donor-associated and acceptor-like states, while Xray absorption spectroscopy reveals distinct approximately six-coordinate Fe–O/N and four-coordinate Cu–O/N environments within the conserved architecture. Remarkably, TU-420-Fe achieves 98.1% ammonia Faradaic efficiency at −0.60 V versus the reversible hydrogen electrode and an ammonia production rate of 4.33 mg h-1 cm-2 at −0.80 V, whereas TU-420-Cu exhibits substantially lower selectivity despite its stronger cathodic response. Isotope-labeling experiments establish nitrate as the nitrogen source, while in situ attenuated total reflectance surface-enhanced infrared absorption spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, and differential electrochemical mass spectrometry reveal signatures consistent with evolving nitrogen–oxygen and hydrogenated nitrogen species. Density functional theory identifies the mechanistic distinction: Fe supports a favorable *NHO-mediated reduction sequence with a maximum uphill free-energy increment of 0.30 eV, while substantially alleviating the energetic penalty associated with the competing *NOH-mediated route relative to Cu. These findings identify the energetic fate of partially reduced nitrogen, rather than electron consumption alone, as a determinant of ammonia selectivity and establish electronically differentiated covalent architectures as platforms for programming metal-dependent multielectron catalysis.

papers.title_zh: 由框架提供电荷、在金属位点表达反应性：四硫富瓦烯编程的硝酸盐还原制氨
papers.summary_zh: 该工作以整合给体四硫富瓦烯与受体联吡啶的晶态共价有机框架TU-420为平台，将框架电子特性与金属反应选择性解耦。TU-420-Fe在−0.60 V下实现98.1%氨法拉第效率，并揭示部分还原氮中间体的能量命运而非电子消耗量决定氨选择性。
papers.research_details_zh: 硝酸盐到氨的电合成关键挑战在于保证连续氮中间体保持化学可转化性，而非单纯供电子。作者提出分子策略，通过TU-420这一晶态共价有机框架，将框架来源的电子特性与金属导向的反应选择性区分开来。TU-420整合了给电子的四硫富瓦烯与受电子且可配位金属的联吡啶单元。电子结构分析识别出互补的给体相关态与受体样态，X射线吸收谱揭示在保守架构内存在约六配位的Fe–O/N和四配位的Cu–O/N环境。TU-420-Fe在−0.60 V（相对于可逆氢电极）下达到98.1%的氨法拉第效率，在−0.80 V下氨产率为4.33 mg h-1 cm-2，而TU-420-Cu尽管阴极响应更强，选择性却显著更低。同位素标记确认硝酸盐为氮源，原位ATR-SEIRAS、拉曼和微分电化学质谱揭示了与氮氧物种及加氢氮物种演化一致的光谱特征。DFT识别出机制差异：Fe支持有利的*NHO介导还原序列，最大上坡自由能增量仅0.30 eV，同时相对Cu显著缓解了竞争性*NOH介导路径的能量惩罚。该研究将部分还原氮的能量命运而非单纯电子消耗确定为氨选择性的决定因素，并确立电子差异化共价架构作为编程金属依赖多电子催化的平台。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：合成晶态共价有机框架TU-420并引入Fe和Cu金属位点；电子结构分析；X射线吸收谱表征金属配位环境；在−0.60 V和−0.80 V vs. RHE下进行电化学硝酸盐还原性能测试，计算氨法拉第效率和产率；同位素标记实验确定氮源；原位衰减全反射表面增强红外吸收光谱、拉曼光谱和微分电化学质谱监测反应中间体；密度泛函理论计算比较Fe与Cu上的还原路径自由能。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接契合介孔导电MOF、共轭COF及框架材料组装与电化学合成主线，展示了通过给体—受体共价框架编程金属位点反应选择性的策略，对框架材料在多电子电催化中的应用有实际参考价值。其定量性能与机制证据较完整，值得全文精读以核查合成细节、框架导电性、金属负载方式及原位光谱指认。

papers.title: Disentangling Modulator and Fluoride Chemistry in Rare-Earth Metal–Organic Framework Formation via Multinuclear NMR Spectroscopy: A Mechanism-Guided Synthetic Redesign
papers.abstract: Abstract Metal–organic framework (MOF) chemistry continues to expand, highlighting the need for molecular insight into framework formation. Solution-phase NMR provides a powerful, accessible, and economical means to probe these mechanisms. We examine the formation of rare-earth (RE) UiO-66, focusing on Yttrium(III)-UiO-66. RE-UiO-66 contains a hexa-metallic node in which the metals are bridged by μ3-fluorido, μ3-hydroxido, and/or μ3-oxido ligands, with benzenedicarboxylate linkers connecting nodes. The fluorido ligand derives from the α-fluorinated modulators required for this synthesis, yet its formation and incorporation pathways are unclear. Using in situ multinuclear NMR spectroscopy, we demonstrate that MOF formation proceeds via zero-order kinetics. Modulator is consumed approximately an order of magnitude faster than linker. The fluoride ligand is formed via nucleophilic aromatic substitution between modulator and in situ-generated dimethylamine. Mass balance suggests that the modulator plays a dual role, coordinating to the metal cation and generating fluoride. However, when solvent hydrolysis precedes MOF formation, the modulator acts primarily as a fluoride source; in situ-formed acetic acid acts as the modulator. Thus, the dual modulator role can be decoupled; benzoic acid functions as the modulator and tetramethylammonium fluoride serves as the fluoride source. Under these modified conditions, linker consumption is slow. When solvent hydrolysis precedes MOF formation, the reaction accelerates. This highlights the complex influence of acidity, competitive binding of fluoride, modulator, and linker on kinetically labile rare-earth metals. The tetramethylammonium fluoride procedure provides a versatile pathway to RE-UiO-66 derivatives (RE = Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Yb, Lu) and two Y-UiO-67 derivatives.

papers.title_zh: 通过多核NMR光谱解析稀土金属有机框架形成中的调节剂与氟化物化学：机制指导的合成再设计
papers.summary_zh: 该工作利用原位多核NMR研究稀土Y-UiO-66形成机制，发现MOF形成遵循零级动力学，调节剂消耗比连接体快约一个数量级，氟配体经调节剂与原位二甲胺的亲核芳香取代生成。基于机制解耦调节剂与氟源，发展出通用合成路径。
papers.research_details_zh: 金属有机框架化学持续扩展，亟需对框架形成过程的分子层面认识。溶液相NMR为探测这些机制提供了强大、易得且经济的手段。作者研究稀土UIO-66的形成，聚焦Y(III)-UiO-66。RE-UiO-66包含六金属节点，金属间由μ3-氟、μ3-羟基和/或μ3-氧配体桥连，苯二甲酸连接体连接节点。氟配体来源于该合成所需的α-氟化调节剂，但其形成与引入路径尚不清楚。利用原位多核NMR光谱，作者证明MOF形成遵循零级动力学。调节剂消耗比连接体快约一个数量级。氟配体通过调节剂与原位生成的二甲胺之间的亲核芳香取代形成。质量平衡表明调节剂发挥双重作用：配位金属阳离子并生成氟。然而，当溶剂水解先于MOF形成时，调节剂主要作为氟源；原位生成的乙酸充当调节剂。因此，调节剂的双重作用可被解耦：苯甲酸作为调节剂，四甲基铵氟化物作为氟源。在修改条件下，连接体消耗缓慢。当溶剂水解先于MOF形成时，反应加速。这凸显了酸性、氟化物、调节剂和连接体竞争结合对动力学不稳定稀土金属的复杂影响。四甲基铵氟化物流程为RE-UiO-66衍生物（RE = Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Yb, Lu）和两种Y-UiO-67衍生物提供了通用路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：溶液相原位多核NMR光谱监测Y-UiO-66形成过程；动力学分析确定反应级数和调节剂与连接体的消耗速率；质量平衡分析；通过改变溶剂水解顺序和引入四甲基铵氟化物进行机制指导的合成再设计；将优化流程应用于多种稀土（Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Yb, Lu）UiO-66衍生物及两种Y-UiO-67衍生物的合成。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于金属有机框架合成机制研究，对框架材料组装与可控合成主线有实际价值，尤其为稀土MOF中调节剂与氟源的角色解耦提供了分子层面依据。其机制指导的合成再设计思路可迁移至其他动力学不稳定金属的MOF制备。定量结果与通用性验证较明确，值得全文精读以核查NMR指认、动力学模型及衍生物表征。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。具体NMR实验条件、动力学拟合细节、中间体结构指认、质量平衡数据、各衍生物的相纯度与结晶性、以及四甲基铵氟化物流程的产率等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 原位多核NMR表明Y-UiO-66的MOF形成遵循零级动力学，调节剂消耗比连接体快约一个数量级。
氟配体通过调节剂与原位生成的二甲胺之间的亲核芳香取代形成，调节剂具有配位金属和生成氟的双重作用。
当溶剂水解先于MOF形成时，调节剂主要作为氟源，原位生成的乙酸充当调节剂，反应加速。
通过解耦调节剂与氟源，以苯甲酸为调节剂、四甲基铵氟化物为氟源，可将该流程拓展至多种RE-UiO-66衍生物（RE = Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Yb, Lu）及两种Y-UiO-67衍生物。

papers.title: Photocatalytic Tandem Reaction for Urea Synthesis From Atmospheric CO 2 and N 2
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Photocatalytic urea synthesis directly from atmospheric CO 2 and N 2 offers a sustainable route to bypass the energy‐intensive Bosch–Meiser process, yet simultaneously achieving CO 2 capture and reduction, N 2 activation, and C─N coupling within a single system remains challenging. Herein, we report a two‐step tandem platform combining ionic‐liquid‐modified metal–organic framework (IL@PCN‐250‐Fe 2 Co) with a trinuclear copper‐based covalent organic framework (HTP‐Cu 3 ‐imi‐COF) for urea photosynthesis from air. The IL@MOF captures atmospheric CO 2 and photoreduces it to CO, while HTP‐Cu 3 ‐imi‐COF couples the generated CO with ambient N 2 into urea. This synergistic tandem configuration delivers a urea production rate of 259.87 µg·g cat −1 ·h −1 under air, marking the first demonstration of photocatalytic urea synthesis from atmospheric CO 2 and N 2 . In situ spectroscopic measurements and DFT calculations reveal that the imidazole‐functionalized HTP segments act as hole‐rich oxidation domains, promoting water oxidation to generate *OH species that oxidize locally enriched N 2 to *NO intermediates. Simultaneously, the Cu 3 clusters serve as electron‐rich centers for CO adsorption and activation, forming *CO that couples with *NO via the critical *OCNO intermediate toward urea formation. This work not only showcases the first photocatalytic urea synthesis from air but also establishes a modular paradigm for cascade catalysts that integrate capture and conversion toward sustainable chemical transformations.

papers.title: From Dark Photocatalysis to Photobattery‐Type Operation: A Re‐Functionalized Ti‐MOF for Solar Energy Storage
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Efficient harvesting, storage, and on‐demand release of solar energy are essential for overcoming the intermittency of sunlight and enabling continuous solar energy‐driven processes, yet achieving storage of photogenerated charge remains challenging. Here, we report a Ti‐based bipyridine MOF, COK47‐bpy, and its ReCl(CO) 3 ‐functionalized analogue, ReCl47‐bpy , as photochargeable materials for time‐decoupled solar energy utilization. Re incorporation introduces localized photosensitizing and “electron sink” sites while preserving the parent framework structure, enabling visible‐light response, faster charge accumulation, and improved charge retention. In colloidal suspension, ReCl47‐bpy reaches an electron storage capacity of 19.5 C g −1 MOF under simulated solar irradiation and retains about 70% of the stored charge after 2.5 months. The stored electrons can be released on demand for dark hydrogen (H 2 ) evolution with electron‐to‐H 2 efficiencies exceeding 90%. Beyond colloids, when fabricated as robust FTO‐supported layers, ReCl47‐bpy |FTO photoelectrodes deliver capacities of up to ∼7.0 mAh g −1 MOF upon photocharging under 1 Sun irradiation. Overall, this work establishes Re‐functionalized Ti‐MOFs as versatile platforms for solar‐driven charge storage, dark photocatalysis, and MOF‐based photoelectrodes, toward the development of next‐generation MOF‐based energy devices.

papers.title: Layered Spin‐Crossover Metal‐Organic Frameworks for Light‐Induced Control of Two‐Dimensional Quantum Materials
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Metal‐organic frameworks (MOFs) are widely explored for gas separation, catalysis, or energy storage, yet their integration with other electronically functional materials remains largely unexplored. Here, we integrate the layered Hofmann‐type spin‐crossover (SCO) MOF {Fe II (pyS 2 Et) 2 [Pt II (CN) 4 ]} into electrical nanodevices to control the properties of two‐dimensional (2D) quantum materials. Our molecular approach exploits the stimuli‐responsive nature of SCO‐layered materials as switchable building blocks. We demonstrate selective modulation of the electronic transport in van der Waals heterostructures interfacing SCO with 2D quantum materials (few‐layer graphene, magnetic CrSBr, superconducting NbSe 2 ) through the strain induced via thermal and light‐induced spin transitions. In graphene, the conductivity is selectively switched by light. In spin‐valves based on CrSBr bilayers, the MOF triggers magnetic hysteresis (absent in pristine CrSBr) and enables tunable non‐volatile zero‐field memory. In NbSe 2 , light modulates the superconducting critical current and transition temperature. These results establish layered stimuli‐responsive SCO MOFs as active molecular control elements for 2D quantum materials, providing a route to strain‐mediated control of electronic, magnetic, and superconducting functionalities, and extending MOF‐based architectures beyond traditional porous‐matter applications toward multifunctional electronics and spintronics.

papers.title_zh: 用于光诱导控制二维量子材料的层状自旋交叉金属有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该工作将层状Hofmann型自旋交叉MOF {FeII(pyS2Et)2[PtII(CN)4]}集成到电学纳米器件中，通过热和光诱导自旋转变产生的应变，选择性调控石墨烯、CrSBr和NbSe2等二维量子材料的电子、磁性和超导特性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对MOF与电子功能材料集成这一尚未充分探索的领域，旨在利用自旋交叉材料的刺激响应性作为可切换构建单元。将层状Hofmann型自旋交叉MOF {FeII(pyS2Et)2[PtII(CN)4]}集成到电学纳米器件中，通过热和光诱导自旋转变产生的应变，控制二维量子材料（少层石墨烯、磁性CrSBr、超导NbSe2）的性质。在石墨烯中，电导率可通过光选择性切换。在基于CrSBr双层的自旋阀中，MOF触发磁滞（原始CrSBr中不存在）并实现可调非易失零场存储器。在NbSe2中，光调制超导临界电流和转变温度。这些结果确立了层状刺激响应SCO MOF作为二维量子材料的活性分子控制元件，提供了应变介导控制电子、磁性和超导功能的途径，将MOF基架构从传统多孔材料应用拓展到多功能电子学和自旋电子学。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：将层状Hofmann型自旋交叉MOF {FeII(pyS2Et)2[PtII(CN)4]}集成到电学纳米器件中；构建与少层石墨烯、磁性CrSBr、超导NbSe2的范德华异质结构；通过热和光诱导自旋转变产生应变；测试石墨烯电导率切换、CrSBr自旋阀磁滞与零场存储、NbSe2超导临界电流与转变温度调制。摘要未报告具体器件制备、表征手段及测试条件细节。

papers.title: Bioinspired Adaptive Ångström‐Channels in a Hydrogen‐Bonded Metal–Organic Framework for Selective Water Removal From Gas Streams by Molecular Sieving Dehydration
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The removal of water from light hydrocarbons is a critical yet energy‐intensive step in petrochemical processes. Conventional adsorbents often suffer from high regeneration temperatures and undesirable co‐adsorption. Inspired by the selective water transport mechanism of aquaporins, we report a hydrogen‐bonded metal–organic framework, ZNU‐33, featuring bioinspired adaptive one‐dimensional channels. The pore walls are decorated with both positively charged (Hbpa + ) and negatively charged (HEDP 4− ) recognition sites. Using in situ single‐crystal x‐ray diffraction, we captured five phases of ZNU‐33, activated (ZNU‐33‐α), intermediate (ZNU‐33‐β), partially dehydrated (ZNU‐33‐γ and ZNU‐33‐γ2), and fully hydrated ZNU‐33, directly visualizing a water‑triggered structural transition. Structural snapshots reveal water uptake proceeding from free‐channel water to Cu 2+ coordination and then to extended hydrogen‐bonded water chains. ZNU‐33 exhibits high water uptake (9.50 mmol/g at 2.85 kPa and 298 K) and negligible adsorption of CO 2 and all light hydrocarbons. Breakthrough experiments demonstrate efficient water removal under wide flow rates, temperatures, and humidity levels, with water‐adsorption capacity recoverable under substantially milder activation conditions than those required by the investigated conventional zeolites. This work not only provides a high‑performance material for selective dehydration, but also establishes a bioinspired adaptive adsorption mechanism for designing water‐selective adsorbents.

papers.title_zh: 仿生自适应埃级通道的氢键金属有机框架用于通过分子筛脱水从气流中选择性除水
papers.summary_zh: 受水通道蛋白启发，报道了氢键金属有机框架ZNU-33，其具有仿生自适应一维通道，孔壁修饰有正负电荷识别位点。该材料展现出高水吸附容量，对CO2和轻烃几乎不吸附，并在宽流速、温度和湿度下实现高效除水，再生条件温和。
papers.research_details_zh: 轻烃中水的去除是石化过程中关键但高能耗的步骤，传统吸附剂存在再生温度高和共吸附问题。受水通道蛋白选择性水传输机制启发，研究者报道了氢键金属有机框架ZNU-33，其具有仿生自适应一维通道，孔壁装饰有正电荷（Hbpa+）和负电荷（HEDP4−）识别位点。通过原位单晶X射线衍射，捕获了ZNU-33的五个相：活化态（ZNU-33-α）、中间态（ZNU-33-β）、部分脱水态（ZNU-33-γ和ZNU-33-γ2）和完全水合态ZNU-33，直接可视化了水触发的结构转变。结构快照揭示水吸收过程从自由通道水到Cu2+配位，再到扩展的氢键水链。ZNU-33表现出高水吸附量（2.85 kPa和298 K下为9.50 mmol/g），对CO2和所有轻烃吸附可忽略。突破实验证明在宽流速、温度和湿度水平下高效除水，水吸附容量可在比传统沸石更温和的活化条件下恢复。该工作不仅提供了选择性脱水的高性能材料，还建立了仿生自适应吸附机制用于设计水选择性吸附剂。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道了原位单晶X射线衍射用于捕获ZNU-33的五个相并可视化水触发结构转变；水吸附测量在2.85 kPa和298 K下进行；突破实验用于评估在宽流速、温度和湿度水平下的除水性能；再生条件与研究的传统沸石进行比较。摘要未报告其他合成、组装或表征方法的具体细节。

papers.title: Hierarchical Ion-Conducting Materials Based on Polymer-Aligned Nanoparticles within Poly(vinyl benzyl methoxy poly(ethylene oxide) ether)- block -polystyrene Diblock Copolymer
papers.abstract: Abstract Solid polymer electrolytes based on poly(ethylene oxide) (PEO) are promising alternatives to liquid electrolytes for safer lithium-ion batteries. Here, we report hierarchical solid polymer electrolytes obtained by selectively incorporating lithium sulfonamide-functionalized polymer nanoparticles (LiNPs) into a microphase-separated poly(vinyl benzyl methoxy poly(ethylene oxide) ether)-block-polystyrene block copolymer. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) demonstrate that the phase-segregated lamellar morphology of the block copolymer is preserved upon nanoparticle incorporation. Notably, the LiNPs preferentially localize within the poly(ethylene glycol)-rich lamellae, generating hierarchical structures with ordering across multiple length scales arising from block copolymer self-assembly, selective nanoparticle organization, and poly(ethylene glycol) crystallization. Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) reveals that the crystallinity of the poly(ethylene glycol) phase depends strongly on nanoparticle loading and plasticizer content. These hierarchical electrolytes exhibit high ionic conductivity, which is further enhanced by the addition of sulfolane as a plasticizer. These results elucidate the interplay between hierarchical morphology, phase crystallinity, and ion transport in block copolymer-based solid electrolytes, providing design guidelines for mechanically robust solid electrolytes with enhanced transport performance.

papers.title_zh: 基于聚(乙烯基苄基甲氧基聚(乙二醇)醚)-嵌段-聚苯乙烯二嵌段共聚物中聚合物排列纳米粒子的分级离子导电材料
papers.summary_zh: 报道了通过将锂磺酰胺功能化聚合物纳米粒子选择性掺入微相分离的嵌段共聚物中，获得分级固体聚合物电解质。纳米粒子优先定位在富聚乙二醇片层中，形成多尺度有序结构，离子电导率高，添加砜烷作为增塑剂可进一步增强。
papers.research_details_zh: 基于聚环氧乙烷的固体聚合物电解质是锂离子电池中液体电解质的有前景替代品。研究者报道了通过将锂磺酰胺功能化聚合物纳米粒子（LiNPs）选择性掺入微相分离的聚(乙烯基苄基甲氧基聚(乙二醇)醚)-嵌段-聚苯乙烯嵌段共聚物中，获得分级固体聚合物电解质。透射电子显微镜、原子力显微镜和小角X射线散射表明，纳米粒子掺入后嵌段共聚物的相分离片层形态得以保留。值得注意的是，LiNPs优先定位在富聚乙二醇片层内，产生具有多尺度有序的分级结构，源于嵌段共聚物自组装、选择性纳米粒子组织和聚乙二醇结晶。差示扫描量热法揭示聚乙二醇相的结晶度强烈依赖于纳米粒子负载量和增塑剂含量。这些分级电解质表现出高离子电导率，添加砜烷作为增塑剂可进一步增强。结果阐明了嵌段共聚物基固体电解质中分级形态、相结晶度和离子传输之间的相互作用，为设计具有增强传输性能的机械稳健固体电解质提供了指导。

papers.title: From α-Helices to Mesoscale Order: Structure–Packing Relationships in Polypeptide Block Copolymer Films
papers.abstract: Abstract Polypeptide-based block copolymers are promising platforms for creating hierarchical nanostructures because their secondary structures can direct mesoscale self-assembly. This study investigates how polypeptide chain length and thermal annealing govern the hierarchical organization of poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(ε-benzyloxycarbonyl-l-lysine) (PEG-b-PZLL) thin films. Combined FTIR, AFM, AFM-IR, and synchrotron GIWAXS/GISAXS analyses reveal that PZLL segments predominantly form α-helical conformations that assemble into hexagonally packed domains with nearly constant lattice parameters across compositions. Increasing the PZLL degree of polymerization stabilizes the α-helical structure, promotes preferential in-plane orientation of cylindrical domains, and enables the formation of long-range ordered fibrillar morphologies, whereas short PZLL chains partially transform into β-sheet structures during film formation and after high-temperature annealing. These findings establish a direct relationship between the secondary structure, orientational ordering, and mesoscale morphology in self-assembled polypeptide block copolymer films.

papers.title_zh: 从α-螺旋到介观有序：多肽嵌段共聚物薄膜中的结构-堆积关系
papers.summary_zh: 研究了多肽链长度和热退火如何调控聚乙二醇-b-聚(ε-苄氧羰基-L-赖氨酸)薄膜的分级组织。PZLL段主要形成α-螺旋构象并组装成六方堆积域，增加聚合度稳定α-螺旋、促进面内取向和长程有序纤维形态。
papers.research_details_zh: 多肽基嵌段共聚物是创建分级纳米结构的有前景平台，因为其二级结构可以指导介观自组装。本研究探讨了多肽链长度和热退火如何调控聚乙二醇-b-聚(ε-苄氧羰基-L-赖氨酸)（PEG-b-PZLL）薄膜的分级组织。结合FTIR、AFM、AFM-IR和同步辐射GIWAXS/GISAXS分析，揭示PZLL段主要形成α-螺旋构象，组装成六方堆积域，在不同组成下晶格参数几乎恒定。增加PZLL聚合度稳定α-螺旋结构，促进柱状域的面内优先取向，并能够形成长程有序纤维形态，而短PZLL链在薄膜形成过程中和高温退火后部分转变为β-折叠结构。这些发现建立了自组装多肽嵌段共聚物薄膜中二级结构、取向有序和介观形态之间的直接关系。

papers.title: Confined‐Space Self‐Assembly of Nano‐HNS Into Hierarchical Micro‐Nano Structured Microspheres for Selective Stimuli Sensitization and Passivation
papers.abstract: To address the balance between reactivity and safety in nano-HNS, this study presents a green composite molding strategy that facilitates the self-assembly of nano-HNS into micro-nano-structured microspheres within confined spaces. This approach utilizes confined spaces to precisely control the morphology and size of the resultant microspheres. The effects of process parameters on the morphology and size of microspheres were systematically investigated, and the underlying formation mechanisms were elucidated. Comprehensive characterizations encompassing morphology, crystal structure, mechanical sensitivity, thermal behavior, and impact properties were conducted. The results demonstrate that the synthesized HNS microspheres possess high sphericity, an average particle size of 224.2 µm, and exhibit favorable fluidity and bulk density. This approach effectively reduces the mechanical sensitivity of the material while preserving the crystal structure and thermal stability of HNS-IV (impact sensitivity: 12 J vs. 20 J; friction sensitivity: 216 N vs. 240 N). Furthermore, it enhances the initial sensitivity to short duration shock, as evidenced by reductions in the 50% and 99.9% initiation voltages by 18 and 48 V, respectively. This approach facilitates the synergistic stimulation of selective sensitization and passivation. This methodology is straightforward and applicable, providing a versatile and eco-friendly approach for the multi-structural modification of nano-HNS.

papers.title_zh: 受限空间自组装纳米HNS构筑分级微纳结构微球以实现选择性刺激敏化与钝化
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用绿色复合成型策略，在受限空间内将纳米HNS自组装为分级微纳结构微球，实现了形貌与尺寸的精准调控。所得微球球形度高、平均粒径224.2微米，在保持HNS-IV晶体结构与热稳定性的同时降低机械感度并提升短脉冲冲击起爆敏感性，实现选择性敏化与钝化的协同。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对纳米HNS反应性与安全性难以兼顾的问题，本研究提出一种绿色复合成型策略，利用受限空间促使纳米HNS自组装形成微纳结构微球，并借助受限空间精确控制微球的形貌与尺寸。研究系统考察了工艺参数对微球形貌和尺寸的影响，并阐明了其形成机制。表征涵盖形貌、晶体结构、机械感度、热行为和冲击性能。结果表明，合成的HNS微球球形度高，平均粒径为224.2微米，具有良好流动性和堆积密度。该方法在保留HNS-IV晶体结构和热稳定性的同时，有效降低了材料的机械感度，并增强了对短持续时间冲击的初始敏感性，体现为50%和99.9%起爆电压分别降低18 V和48 V。该策略简单易行，为纳米HNS的多结构改性提供了通用且环保的途径，对含能材料微纳结构组装与性能调控具有参考意义。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用绿色复合成型策略，在受限空间内诱导纳米HNS自组装形成微纳结构微球。系统考察工艺参数对微球形貌与尺寸的影响并探讨形成机制。表征包括形貌、晶体结构、机械感度、热行为和冲击性能测试。摘要未报告具体表征仪器型号、合成温度、溶剂体系及组装时间等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于受限空间自组装与微纳结构构筑方向，对框架材料及介孔材料领域的自组装形貌控制策略有方法学借鉴价值，但其材料体系为含能材料HNS而非MOF/COF/HOF，与介孔导电MOF等主线关联较弱。若关注受限空间组装与分级结构调控的通用思路，可略读；若聚焦框架材料电化学合成，则参考价值有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体合成条件、溶剂、温度、时间、表征仪器型号、形成机制细节及统计误差等关键信息，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 合成的HNS微球球形度高，平均粒径为224.2微米，并具有良好流动性和堆积密度。
该方法在保留HNS-IV晶体结构和热稳定性的同时降低机械感度：冲击感度由20 J降至12 J，摩擦感度由240 N降至216 N。
短持续时间冲击初始敏感性增强，50%和99.9%起爆电压分别降低18 V和48 V。
实现了选择性敏化与钝化的协同刺激效果。

papers.title: Tetrapyridophenazine-Based Vinylene-Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks for Efficient Sequential Photocatalysis and Continuous-Flow Synthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract Vinylene-linked covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are promising photocatalysts because their conjugated sp2-carbon frameworks combine exceptional chemical stability with efficient charge transport. However, the limited reversibility of C═C bond formation narrows the scope of polymerizable monomers, restricting the structural diversity and electronic tunability of vinylene-linked COFs. Here, we report a molecular design strategy based on a planar, electron-deficient, nitrogen-rich tetrapyridophenazine (TTPhz) building block for constructing vinylene-linked COFs. Knoevenagel polycondensation of a polymerizable TTPhz monomer with aromatic dialdehydes affords three highly crystalline COFs with tunable donor–acceptor interactions and electronic structures. The optimized fluorinated framework, TTPhz-COF-3, exhibits efficient charge separation and transport, enabling a previously unreported one-pot sequential photocatalytic synthesis of 2,3-dihydrobenzofuran derivatives from arylboronic acids through tandem aerobic hydroxylation and oxidative [3 + 2] cycloaddition. The catalyst displays broad substrate scope, excellent recyclability, and enables gram-scale continuous-flow synthesis of a key intermediate of the natural product (±)-conocarpan with a 4-fold higher turnover frequency than the corresponding batch process. This work expands the structural and functional scope of vinylene-linked COFs and establishes molecular building-block design as a general strategy for developing advanced crystalline organic photocatalysts.

papers.title_zh: 基于四吡啶并吩嗪的乙烯基连接共价有机框架用于高效串联光催化与连续流合成
papers.summary_zh: 该工作以平面缺电子富氮四吡啶并吩嗪为构筑单元，通过Knoevenagel缩聚制备三种高结晶乙烯基连接COF，其中氟化TTPhz-COF-3电荷分离与传输最优，可实现芳基硼酸一锅串联光催化合成二氢苯并呋喃，并完成克级连续流合成。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对乙烯基连接COF因C=C成键可逆性有限而单体范围窄、结构多样性与电子可调性受限的问题，提出以平面、缺电子、富氮的四吡啶并吩嗪（TTPhz）为分子构筑单元的设计策略。将可聚合TTPhz单体与芳香二醛进行Knoevenagel缩聚，得到三种高结晶COF，并实现给体-受体相互作用与电子结构的调控。优化后的氟化框架TTPhz-COF-3表现出高效电荷分离与传输，可从未见报道地一锅顺序光催化芳基硼酸经串联有氧羟基化和氧化[3+2]环加成合成2,3-二氢苯并呋喃衍生物。催化剂具有宽底物范围、优异可回收性，并实现天然产物(±)-conocarpan关键中间体的克级连续流合成，转化频率较相应批次过程高4倍。该工作拓展了乙烯基连接COF的结构与功能范围，并确立分子构筑单元设计作为开发先进晶态有机光催化剂的通用策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以可聚合TTPhz单体与芳香二醛进行Knoevenagel缩聚合成乙烯基连接COF；对所得COF进行结晶性表征并调控给体-受体相互作用与电子结构；评估TTPhz-COF-3的电荷分离与传输；开展芳基硼酸一锅顺序光催化串联有氧羟基化和氧化[3+2]环加成反应；考察底物范围与可回收性；进行(±)-conocarpan关键中间体的克级连续流合成并与批次过程比较转化频率。其他合成条件、表征手段与测试细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF与框架材料光催化主线，提供以缺电子富氮平面构筑单元扩展乙烯基连接COF结构多样性和电子可调性的设计思路，并展示串联光催化与连续流放大的实际价值。局限在于摘要未报告具体结晶度、能带位置、电荷传输定量参数及连续流装置细节，若关注COF光催化与流动化学结合值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据所提供题目与摘要，属摘要级解读。COF的具体合成条件、结晶度数据、比表面积、能带结构、电荷分离与传输的定量证据、光催化反应条件、底物范围细节、可回收性测试次数、连续流装置参数及转化频率数值等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 以TTPhz为构筑单元与芳香二醛经Knoevenagel缩聚得到三种高结晶乙烯基连接COF，并实现给体-受体相互作用与电子结构可调。
氟化TTPhz-COF-3具有高效电荷分离与传输，可一锅顺序光催化芳基硼酸经有氧羟基化和氧化[3+2]环加成合成2,3-二氢苯并呋喃衍生物。
催化剂底物范围宽、可回收性好，并实现(±)-conocarpan关键中间体克级连续流合成，转化频率较批次过程高4倍。

papers.title: Engineering Intrinsic Mixed Sodium Ionic–Electronic Conductivity in a Nickel Bis(diimine) Metal–Organic Framework
papers.abstract: Abstract Mixed ionic–electronic conductors (MIECs) are highly desirable for a wide range of electronic applications, however, developing single-phase MIECs with intrinsic transport properties under ambient conditions remains challenging. Herein, we report a Na+-ion and electron mixed-conducting metal–organic framework (MOF), Ni-HITP-SO3Na, by tethering anionic sulfonate side chains with Na+ counterions onto the 2,3,6,7,10,11-hexaiminotriphenylene (HITP) ligand of a d-π conjugated nickel bis(diimine)-based framework. Ni-HITP-SO3Na is highly crystalline with honeycomb networks and microporous with surface area of 412 m2 g–1. Remarkably, Ni-HITP-SO3Na exhibits dual transport without relying on conductive fillers, guest electrolytes, or external ion sources. Four-probe measurements reveal a high electronic conductivity of 0.7 ± 0.3 S cm–1, and DC polarization yields a sodium ionic conductivity of (3.7 ± 0.7) × 10–6 S cm–1 at room temperature in the solid state, which can be further improved to (1.5 ± 0.4) × 10–5 S cm–1 with the assistance of solvents. These results, to the best of our knowledge, demonstrate the first MOF that intrinsically combines electronic and sodium ionic conduction, delivering competitive mixed conductivity among reported MIECs, particularly under ambient temperature. The mixed conductivity originates from the intact d–π conjugation for electronic transport and the sulfonate-functionalized pore walls that afford low-barrier Na+ pathways via a relay transport mechanism involving transient bridging coordination between neighboring sulfonate groups. This work highlights embedding ion-transport functionality directly into conductive MOF backbones as an effective route to structurally well-defined, highly porous framework MIECs for electrochemical and iontronic devices.

papers.title_zh: 在镍双(二亚胺)金属-有机框架中构建本征混合钠离子-电子导电性
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过在d-π共轭镍双(二亚胺)框架的HITP配体上接枝磺酸钠侧链，制得高结晶蜂窝状微孔MOF Ni-HITP-SO3Na，其在无导电填料、客体电解质或外部离子源条件下同时具备电子与钠离子传导，室温电子电导率达0.7 S cm–1。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对在环境条件下开发具有本征传输性能的单相混合离子-电子导体（MIEC）的挑战，报道了一种钠离子与电子混合传导的金属-有机框架Ni-HITP-SO3Na。设计策略是在d-π共轭镍双(二亚胺)基框架的2,3,6,7,10,11-六氨基三亚苯（HITP）配体上接枝带Na+反离子的阴离子磺酸侧链。所得材料高度结晶、呈蜂窝网络且为微孔结构，比表面积为412 m2 g–1。Ni-HITP-SO3Na无需导电填料、客体电解质或外部离子源即可实现双重传输。四探针测量显示其电子电导率高达0.7 ± 0.3 S cm–1，直流极化在室温固态下给出钠离子电导率为(3.7 ± 0.7) × 10–6 S cm–1，在溶剂辅助下可进一步提升至(1.5 ± 0.4) × 10–5 S cm–1。作者认为这是首个本征结合电子与钠离子传导的MOF，在已报道MIEC中具有竞争力，尤其在环境温度下。混合导电性源于完整的d-π共轭实现电子传输，以及磺酸功能化孔壁通过相邻磺酸基团间瞬态桥连配位的接力传输机制提供低势垒Na+通路。该工作表明将离子传输功能直接嵌入导电MOF骨架，是构建结构明确、高孔隙率框架MIEC用于电化学与离子电子器件的有效途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：在HITP配体上接枝阴离子磺酸侧链与Na+反离子构建Ni-HITP-SO3Na；表征其结晶性、蜂窝网络与微孔结构并测定比表面积；在无导电填料、客体电解质或外部离子源条件下评估双重传输；采用四探针测量电子电导率；采用直流极化测量室温固态钠离子电导率并考察溶剂辅助影响；提出基于d-π共轭和磺酸基团接力传输的机制。其他合成条件、结构表征细节与器件测试摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联介孔/微孔导电MOF与框架材料电化学主线，展示将离子传输功能嵌入d-π共轭导电MOF骨架以构建单相MIEC的策略，对离子电子器件与电化学应用有参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告孔径分布、活化能、迁移数、稳定性及器件验证等关键数据，若关注导电MOF混合传导机制值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据所提供题目与摘要，属摘要级解读。MOF的具体合成条件、晶体结构解析、孔径分布、电导率测试条件与误差来源、钠离子迁移数、活化能、稳定性、溶剂辅助机制细节及器件应用验证等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Ni-HITP-SO3Na为高度结晶蜂窝状微孔MOF，比表面积412 m2 g–1，无需导电填料、客体电解质或外部离子源即可实现钠离子与电子双重传输。
四探针测得电子电导率为0.7 ± 0.3 S cm–1；直流极化测得室温固态钠离子电导率为(3.7 ± 0.7) × 10–6 S cm–1，溶剂辅助下提升至(1.5 ± 0.4) × 10–5 S cm–1。
混合导电性源于完整d-π共轭的电子传输和磺酸功能化孔壁经相邻磺酸基团瞬态桥连配位的接力传输机制提供低势垒Na+通路。
作者认为这是首个本征结合电子与钠离子传导的MOF，在环境温度下具有已报道MIEC中具竞争力的混合导电性。

papers.title: Functionalized Olefin-Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks for Selective Mercury Capture and Recovery from Vinyl Chloride-Rich Gas Streams
papers.abstract: Abstract The calcium carbide-derived acetylene hydrochlorination route for vinyl chloride monomer (VCM, C2H3Cl) production remains a major source of mercury consumption and emission owing to its reliance on HgCl2/activated carbon catalysts. Selective removal of elemental mercury (Hg0) from crude VCM streams is intrinsically challenging because Hg0 must be captured from C2H3Cl-rich and HCl-containing atmospheres without coadsorbing valuable C2H3Cl. Here, we report a pore-engineered covalent organic framework (COF) platform in which olefin-linked sp2-carbon-conjugated frameworks suppress nonspecific C2H3Cl adsorption, while Cu-coordinated 2-(methylthio)ethoxy side chains create well-defined Cu–O2S2 pockets for selective Hg0 capture. These structural features afford an ideal adsorbed solution theory-predicted Hg0/C2H3Cl selectivity exceeding 20,000. Notably, dynamic breakthrough experiments under simulated industrial conditions containing 5 vol % HCl further revealed a Hg0 breakthrough time of over 10,000 min g–1 in C2H3Cl-rich streams, with a separation factor of approximately 52, demonstrating exceptional resistance to acid-induced deactivation. Treatment of the spent adsorbent with Na2S solution enables regeneration over 30 consecutive cycles and converts captured mercury into chemically stable HgS. This work establishes a molecularly precise removal–recovery platform for elemental mercury from chemically complex industrial gas streams, highlighting the power of programmed pore microenvironments to discriminate trace toxic species from abundant value-added molecules under chemically aggressive conditions.

papers.title_zh: 功能化烯烃连接共价有机框架用于从富氯乙烯气流中选择性捕集与回收汞
papers.summary_zh: 该工作构建孔工程化烯烃连接COF平台，以sp2碳共轭骨架抑制非特异性氯乙烯吸附，并由Cu配位2-(甲硫基)乙氧基侧链形成Cu–O2S2口袋选择性捕集Hg0，在模拟工业条件下实现超长穿透时间与约52的分离因子，并可经Na2S再生30次以上。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对电石乙炔法氯乙烯单体生产中HgCl2/活性炭催化剂导致汞消耗与排放，以及从富C2H3Cl和含HCl气氛中选择性脱除元素汞（Hg0）而不共吸附有价值C2H3Cl的内在难题，报道了一种孔工程化共价有机框架平台。该平台中烯烃连接的sp2碳共轭框架抑制非特异性C2H3Cl吸附，而Cu配位的2-(甲硫基)乙氧基侧链构建明确的Cu–O2S2口袋用于选择性捕集Hg0。这些结构特征使理想吸附溶液理论预测的Hg0/C2H3Cl选择性超过20,000。在含5 vol % HCl的模拟工业条件动态穿透实验中，富C2H3Cl气流中Hg0穿透时间超过10,000 min g–1，分离因子约为52，显示出优异的抗酸致失活能力。用Na2S溶液处理饱和吸附剂可实现30次连续循环再生，并将捕集的汞转化为化学稳定的HgS。该工作建立了从化学复杂工业气流中分子精确脱除-回收元素汞的平台，凸显程序化孔微环境在化学苛刻条件下区分痕量有毒物种与大量增值分子的能力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：构建孔工程化烯烃连接COF平台并引入Cu配位2-(甲硫基)乙氧基侧链；采用理想吸附溶液理论预测Hg0/C2H3Cl选择性；在含5 vol % HCl的模拟工业条件下开展动态穿透实验，测定Hg0穿透时间与分离因子；用Na2S溶液处理饱和吸附剂进行再生循环并转化捕集汞为HgS。其他合成条件、结构表征、吸附等温线与再生条件细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF与框架材料孔环境工程主线，展示以sp2碳共轭骨架抑制非特异性吸附、以金属配位侧链构建选择性捕集位点的分子精确设计策略，对复杂工业气流中痕量毒物脱除与回收有实际价值。局限在于摘要未报告COF结晶度、孔结构、Cu配位证据、吸附容量及再生后性能衰减等细节，若关注COF气体分离与汞捕集值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据所提供题目与摘要，属摘要级解读。COF的具体合成条件、结晶度与孔结构数据、Cu配位结构表征、Hg0吸附容量、穿透实验装置与条件、再生循环后性能变化及HgS转化证据等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 烯烃连接sp2碳共轭COF骨架抑制非特异性C2H3Cl吸附，Cu配位2-(甲硫基)乙氧基侧链形成Cu–O2S2口袋选择性捕集Hg0。
理想吸附溶液理论预测Hg0/C2H3Cl选择性超过20,000；含5 vol % HCl模拟工业条件下动态穿透实验中Hg0穿透时间超过10,000 min g–1，分离因子约52。
Na2S溶液处理饱和吸附剂可实现30次连续循环再生，并将捕集的汞转化为化学稳定的HgS。

papers.title: Clickable Photolabile Linkers for Convenient Immobilization and Light-Controlled Release of Substrates from Solid Support
papers.abstract: Abstract Photolabile linkers (PLLs) enable spatiotemporal control over substrate release but often suffer from slow photorelease kinetics, low quantum yields, or limited functionalization options. Here, we report a family of heterobifunctional PLLs based on (3-hydroxy-5-alkoxynaphthalen-2-yl)methyl (NQMP) chromophores that combine rapid, high-yielding photochemical cleavage with orthogonal conjugation chemistries for efficient substrate immobilization and light-triggered release. Six heterobifunctional NQMP-based linkers bearing terminal acetylene, cyclooctyne, amine, carboxyl, allyl, and biotin groups were synthesized and employed for the immobilization of fluorescent dyes, acetylsalicylic acid, biotin, avidin, and doxorubicin on silica microspheres and mesoporous silica nanoparticles. Mild UV-A irradiation resulted in efficient release of the attached payloads while preserving the integrity of the solid support. Mesoporous silica nanoparticles provide high loading capacity and are suitable for light-controlled drug delivery. The modular design, excellent photochemical efficiency, orthogonal conjugation chemistries, and compatibility with diverse substrates make NQMP-based PLLs versatile tools for reversible surface functionalization, controlled cargo release, affinity capture, and photoresponsive drug delivery applications.

papers.title_zh: 可点击光不稳定连接体用于固相基质上底物的便捷固定与光控释放
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报告了一类基于NQMP发色团的双功能光不稳定连接体，兼具快速高效光裂解与正交偶联化学，可将染料、药物、生物素等多种底物固定于二氧化硅微球及介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒上，并在温和UV-A照射下实现光控释放，同时保持固相基质完整性。
papers.research_details_zh: 光不稳定连接体可实现底物释放的时空控制，但常受限于光释放动力学慢、量子产率低或官能化选项有限。该研究设计了一类基于(3-羟基-5-烷氧基萘-2-基)甲基即NQMP发色团的异双功能光不稳定连接体，将快速、高产率的光化学裂解与正交偶联化学相结合。作者合成了六种带有末端炔基、环辛炔、氨基、羧基、烯丙基和生物素基团的异双功能NQMP连接体，并将其用于将荧光染料、乙酰水杨酸、生物素、亲和素和阿霉素固定在二氧化硅微球及介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒上。温和UV-A照射可高效释放所连接的载荷，同时保持固相基质的完整性。介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒提供高负载容量，适用于光控药物递送。该模块化设计、优异的光化学效率、正交偶联化学及对多种底物的兼容性，使NQMP基光不稳定连接体成为可逆表面功能化、受控货物释放、亲和捕获及光响应药物递送的多功能工具。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成六种异双功能NQMP基光不稳定连接体；利用正交偶联化学将荧光染料、乙酰水杨酸、生物素、亲和素和阿霉素固定于二氧化硅微球及介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒；采用温和UV-A照射触发光化学裂解释放载荷。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、表征手段、光释放动力学参数及量子产率等详细数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料及框架材料组装和功能化主线相关，展示了介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒作为光响应药物递送载体的应用潜力，其正交偶联与光控释放策略对框架材料后修饰和刺激响应释放设计有借鉴价值。但该研究聚焦于无定形二氧化硅载体而非晶态框架材料，与导电MOF、COF等方向关联有限，建议作为拓展阅读，重点关注其光不稳定连接体设计思路。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未使用摘要之外的常识或推测。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征数据、光释放动力学参数、量子产率、负载量数值及生物实验细节，这些关键信息需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 合成了六种异双功能NQMP基光不稳定连接体，分别带有末端炔基、环辛炔、氨基、羧基、烯丙基和生物素基团。
成功将荧光染料、乙酰水杨酸、生物素、亲和素和阿霉素固定于二氧化硅微球和介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒上。
温和UV-A照射可实现高效载荷释放，同时保持固相基质完整性。
介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒提供高负载容量，适用于光控药物递送。

papers.title: Differential Adaptation between Active Sites and Charge‐Transport Networks in Covalent Organic Frameworks for H 2 O 2 Photosynthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are promising photocatalysts for H 2 O 2 production. However, optimizing their electronic structure to enhance oxygen activation, charge separation, and transport remains challenging. Herein, a dual‐dimensional COF platform was constructed by integrating diazine isomers, pyridazine (Dz) and pyrazine (Pz), with tunable linkage chemistries (sp 2 c‐, mix‐, and imi‐linked), enabling decoupled regulation and systematic investigation of active‐site electronic environments and framework charge‐transport behavior. Experiments and theoretical calculations revealed that N ‐heterocyclic isomers primarily govern O 2 activation configurations and oxygen reduction reaction pathways, whereas linkage chemistry mainly regulates framework charge transport. More importantly, a previously unrecognized differential adaptation mechanism is revealed: in the intrinsically asymmetric Dz systems, highly conjugated sp 2 c linkages further enhance electron delocalization and transport, maximizing photocatalytic performance and enabling sp 2 c‐COF‐Dz to achieve the highest H 2 O 2 production rate (9270 µmol h −1 g −1 ); in contrast, in the Pz systems, mixed‐linkage architectures generate localized electron‐density gradients that compensate for insufficient site polarization by disrupting electronic symmetry, resulting in higher activity than the sp 2 c‐linked COF. These findings uncover a matching relationship between active‐site electronic structures and linkage‐mediated charge transport behavior, providing a site‐framework matching principle for the rational design of high‐performance COF photocatalysts.

papers.title_zh: 共价有机框架中活性位点与电荷传输网络的差异化适配用于过氧化氢光合成
papers.summary_zh: 该研究构建了双维度COF平台，通过整合哒嗪与吡嗪异构体及可调连接化学，实现活性位点电子环境与框架电荷传输行为的解耦调控，揭示了活性位点电子结构与连接介导电荷传输之间的匹配关系，sp2c-COF-Dz获得最高H2O2产率9270 µmol h−1 g−1。
papers.research_details_zh: 共价有机框架是颇具前景的H2O2光催化剂，但优化其电子结构以增强氧活化、电荷分离和传输仍具挑战。该研究构建了一个双维度COF平台，将哒嗪和吡嗪异构体与可调连接化学即sp2c-、混合和imi-连接相结合，实现对活性位点电子环境和框架电荷传输行为的解耦调控与系统研究。实验与理论计算表明，N-杂环异构体主要调控O2活化构型和氧还原反应路径，而连接化学主要调控框架电荷传输。更重要的是，研究揭示了一种此前未被认识的差异化适配机制：在本质不对称的Dz体系中，高度共轭的sp2c连接进一步增强电子离域和传输，最大化光催化性能，使sp2c-COF-Dz达到最高H2O2产率9270 µmol h−1 g−1；相反，在Pz体系中，混合连接结构产生局域电子密度梯度，通过破坏电子对称性补偿位点极化不足，从而获得比sp2c连接COF更高的活性。这些发现揭示了活性位点电子结构与连接介导电荷传输行为之间的匹配关系，为高性能COF光催化剂的理性设计提供了位点-框架匹配原则。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：构建双维度COF平台，整合哒嗪和吡嗪异构体与sp2c-、混合和imi-连接化学；开展实验与理论计算以研究活性位点电子环境和框架电荷传输行为；进行光催化H2O2生产性能测试。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征手段、理论计算方法和光催化测试参数等详细内容。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF及框架材料电荷传输主线，其双维度COF平台设计、活性位点与连接化学的解耦调控策略以及位点-框架匹配原则，对高性能框架光催化剂设计具有重要参考价值。研究涉及的电荷传输机制和结构-性能关系与导电MOF/COF方向高度契合，建议全文精读以获取合成细节和完整机理证据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未使用摘要之外的常识或推测。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、表征数据、理论计算细节、光催化测试条件及稳定性数据等，这些关键信息需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: N-杂环异构体主要调控O2活化构型和氧还原反应路径，连接化学主要调控框架电荷传输。
在不对称Dz体系中，sp2c连接增强电子离域和传输，sp2c-COF-Dz获得最高H2O2产率9270 µmol h−1 g−1。
在Pz体系中，混合连接结构通过破坏电子对称性产生局域电子密度梯度，活性高于sp2c连接COF。
揭示了活性位点电子结构与连接介导电荷传输之间的差异化适配机制，提出位点-框架匹配原则。

papers.title: Stereoselective polysubstituted bicyclo[1.1.0]butane synthesis by rhodium-catalyzed kinetic resolution
papers.abstract: Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes (BCBs) are a distinctive class of strained small-ring carbocycles of growing importance in synthetic and medicinal chemistry. However, the enantioselective synthesis of polysubstituted BCBs remains a largely unsolved challenge. In this study, we report a general chemical platform for the stereoselective assembly of chiral or meso 1,2,3,4-tetrasubstituted BCBs from internal alkynes and carbenes through stepwise [2+1+1’] or one-pot [2+1+1] cycloaddition reactions, respectively. Successful execution of these transformations exploits the combination of triftosylhydrazones (carbene precursors) and chiral dirhodium catalysts. The sterically hindered catalyst Rh 2 ( R -3,5- di PheTPCP) 4 features a confined chiral microenvironment that enables exquisite discrimination between cyclopropene enantiomers, affording highly enantioenriched polysubstituted BCBs through kinetic resolution upon reaction with chiral rhodium carbenes. This chemistry operates under mild reaction conditions, uses readily available starting materials, and exhibits broad substrate scope.

papers.title_zh: 铑催化动力学拆分立体选择性合成多取代双环[1.1.0]丁烷
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道了一种通用化学平台，通过逐步[2+1+1']或一锅[2+1+1]环加成反应，从内炔和卡宾前体立体选择性组装手性或内消旋1,2,3,4-四取代双环[1.1.0]丁烷，利用手性二铑催化剂的空间受限微环境实现环丙烯对映体的动力学拆分。
papers.research_details_zh: 双环[1.1.0]丁烷是一类独特的张力小环碳环化合物，在合成和药物化学中日益重要，但多取代BCB的对映选择性合成仍 largely 未解决。该研究报告了一种通用化学平台，通过逐步[2+1+1']或一锅[2+1+1]环加成反应，分别从内炔和卡宾前体立体选择性组装手性或内消旋1,2,3,4-四取代BCB。这些转化的成功实施利用了三氟甲磺酰腙作为卡宾前体与手性二铑催化剂的组合。空间位阻型催化剂Rh2(R-3,5-diPheTPCP)4具有受限手性微环境，能够精细区分环丙烯对映体，通过与手性铑卡宾反应时的动力学拆分获得高对映富集的多取代BCB。该化学在温和反应条件下进行，使用易得起始原料，并表现出广泛的底物范围。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：使用三氟甲磺酰腙作为卡宾前体，手性二铑催化剂Rh2(R-3,5-diPheTPCP)4催化；通过逐步[2+1+1']或一锅[2+1+1]环加成反应从内炔和卡宾前体合成多取代BCB；通过动力学拆分实现环丙烯对映体区分。摘要未报告具体的反应条件、表征手段、对映选择性数值及底物范围细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔导电MOF、共轭COF/HOF、框架材料组装及电化学合成等研究主线关联较弱，属于有机合成方法学范畴。其手性催化剂设计和动力学拆分策略对框架材料中手性位点构建可能有间接启发，但整体不属于核心关注方向，建议作为拓展了解，无需优先精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未使用摘要之外的常识或推测。摘要未报告具体的反应条件、催化剂用量、对映选择性数值、产率、底物范围及表征数据等，这些关键信息需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 建立了通过逐步[2+1+1']或一锅[2+1+1]环加成从内炔和卡宾前体立体选择性组装手性或内消旋1,2,3,4-四取代BCB的通用平台。
空间位阻型催化剂Rh2(R-3,5-diPheTPCP)4的受限手性微环境可精细区分环丙烯对映体，通过动力学拆分获得高对映富集多取代BCB。
该化学在温和条件下进行，使用易得起始原料，具有广泛底物范围。

papers.title: Bridge‐Length‐Dependent Diradical and Mixed‐Valence Radical in Benzene Triimide Cages
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Supramolecular radical cages are captivating architectures in supramolecular chemistry and materials science; however, their construction and precise regulation of electronic states and magnetic properties remain substantially challenging. Herein, we report the synthesis, structures, and magnetic properties of a series of covalent organic radical cages, generated by reducing the benzene triimide (BTI) radical precursors within the corresponding neutral cages. The m ‐xylene‐bridged cage with two parallel BTI units separated by 5.4 Å undergoes stepwise reduction to afford both mixed‐valence monoradical and diradical cages. In contrast, the cavity‐expanded cage with naphthalene bridges (7.6 Å) preferentially gives a mixed‐valence monoradical even under excess reductant. This discrepancy originates from cavity‐mediated host–guest interactions of the radical cages, which selectively stabilize the mixed‐valence monoradical of the naphthalene‐bridged cage. All the radical cages exhibit good stability and are characterized by single‐crystal x‐ray diffraction, EPR, and UV–vis–NIR spectroscopy. For the m ‐xylene‐bridged diradical cage, the two BTI radical units are weakly coupled, exhibiting a singlet ground state with a narrow singlet–triplet energy gap (Δ E ST = –1.63 kcal/mol). The naphthalene‐bridged mixed‐valence monoradical cage features an unpaired electron delocalized over the two BTI units and exhibits antiferromagnetic interactions arising from its one‐dimensional linear assembly in the solid state.

papers.title_zh: 苯三酰亚胺笼中桥连长度依赖的双自由基与混合价自由基
papers.summary_zh: 该研究合成了一系列共价有机自由基笼，通过还原中性笼内的苯三酰亚胺前体获得。间二甲苯桥连笼可逐步还原生成混合价单自由基和双自由基，而萘桥连扩腔笼即使过量还原剂也优先形成混合价单自由基，揭示了空腔介导的主客体相互作用对电子态的选择性稳定。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题为如何构建超分子自由基笼并精确调控其电子态与磁性质。材料体系为基于苯三酰亚胺的共价有机自由基笼，分别采用间二甲苯桥连和萘桥连。设计策略是通过改变桥连长度调控两个平行BTI单元间距，间二甲苯桥连间距为5.4 Å，萘桥连扩腔间距为7.6 Å。研究过程为还原中性笼内的BTI自由基前体，得到一系列自由基笼，并利用单晶X射线衍射、EPR和紫外-可见-近红外光谱进行表征。意义在于发现空腔介导的主客体相互作用可选择性稳定萘桥连笼的混合价单自由基，为超分子自由基笼的电子态调控提供了新思路。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成中性笼及BTI自由基前体，通过还原中性笼内的BTI自由基前体生成共价有机自由基笼；采用单晶X射线衍射、电子顺磁共振和紫外-可见-近红外光谱对自由基笼进行表征；通过磁学性质测试研究双自由基的耦合及单-三线态能隙，以及混合价单自由基的磁相互作用。摘要未报告具体的还原剂种类、反应条件及磁化率拟合细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于超分子自由基笼与共轭框架材料交叉方向，对理解框架空腔如何调控自由基电子态和磁性质具有参考价值。其桥连长度依赖的还原行为与主客体稳定机制可为介孔导电MOF及共轭框架的电子结构设计提供启发。但该研究聚焦于离散有机笼而非延伸框架，且电化学合成与导电性未涉及，与介孔导电MOF主线关联有限，建议根据对自由基笼电子调控的兴趣选择性精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征细节或数值。摘要未报告还原剂种类、反应溶剂、温度、产率、磁化率拟合参数及电化学数据等关键细节，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 间二甲苯桥连笼中两个平行BTI单元间距为5.4 Å，可逐步还原生成混合价单自由基和双自由基笼。
萘桥连扩腔笼间距为7.6 Å，即使过量还原剂也优先形成混合价单自由基，归因于空腔介导的主客体相互作用选择性稳定该态。
间二甲苯桥连双自由基笼中两个BTI自由基单元弱耦合，呈现单线态基态，单-三线态能隙ΔEST = –1.63 kcal/mol。
萘桥连混合价单自由基笼中未配对电子离域于两个BTI单元上，固态中因一维线性组装而表现反铁磁相互作用。

papers.title: Unilateral Functionalization of Covalent Organic Frameworks: Local Electronic Modulation and Morphology-Enabled Mass Transport for Electrocatalytic Hydrogen Peroxide Production
papers.abstract: Abstract Achieving high selectivity and activity in the two-electron oxygen reduction reaction (2e– ORR) pathway critically depends on the synergistic modulation of a catalyst’s electronic structure and mass diffusion channels. This work proposes an asymmetric modulation strategy via unilateral functionalization, in which −CH3, −CN, −SO3H, and −NO2 moieties are incorporated into a series of covalent organic frameworks (COFs), systematically unraveling the multilevel regulatory mechanisms exerted by functional groups from molecular to macroscopic morphological scales. The research demonstrates that introducing strong electron-withdrawing −NO2 groups can effectively enhance charge transfer at adjacent carbon active sites, reduce the formation barrier of OOH* intermediates, and induce efficient 2e– ORR activity. Concurrently, the polarity and steric effects of functional groups induce structural evolution in COFs from spherical, rod-like to spiderweb-like architectures, wherein the interconnected network of COF-NO2 substantially enhances the diffusion efficiency of reactants and products. This synergy between electronic structure and macroscopic morphology enables COF-NO2 to achieve 94% H2O2 selectivity and a high production rate of 10.5 mol gcat–1 h–1 with sustained stability. This work not only provides outstanding catalysts for efficient electrochemical H2O2 synthesis but also clarifies functional group-induced electronic and morphological modulation, offering a novel paradigm for the rational design of porous catalytic materials.

papers.title_zh: 共价有机框架的单侧功能化：局域电子调控与形貌促进传质用于电催化过氧化氢生产
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出单侧功能化不对称调控策略，将−CH3、−CN、−SO3H和−NO2引入COFs，系统揭示官能团从分子到宏观形貌的多层次调控机制。强吸电子−NO2增强相邻碳活性位点电荷转移，降低OOH*形成能垒，并诱导蜘蛛网状互连形貌，实现94% H2O2选择性和10.5 mol gcat–1 h–1产率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题为如何通过协同调控催化剂电子结构与传质通道，实现2e– ORR路径的高选择性和高活性。材料体系为一系列单侧功能化的共价有机框架，引入−CH3、−CN、−SO3H和−NO2基团。设计策略为不对称单侧功能化，从分子尺度到宏观形貌尺度系统解析官能团的多层次调控机制。研究过程包括合成不同官能团修饰的COFs，表征其电子结构、形貌演变及电催化2e– ORR性能。意义在于阐明官能团诱导的电子与形貌协同调控，为多孔催化材料的理性设计提供新范式，并获得高效电化学H2O2合成催化剂。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成一系列单侧功能化COFs，引入−CH3、−CN、−SO3H和−NO2基团；表征官能团诱导的电子结构变化和形貌演变；评估2e– ORR电催化性能，包括H2O2选择性、产率和稳定性测试。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征技术名称、电化学测试装置及稳定性测试时长等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF的电子结构调控与电催化应用，对理解官能团如何从分子尺度影响框架电子态并进一步调控宏观形貌和传质具有重要参考价值。其单侧功能化策略和电子-形貌协同设计思路可迁移至介孔导电MOF及其他框架材料的电化学合成与催化研究。定量性能突出，机制阐述较系统，值得全文精读以获取合成细节和表征证据。

key_findings_zh: 引入强吸电子−NO2可增强相邻碳活性位点电荷转移，降低OOH*中间体形成能垒，诱导高效2e– ORR活性。
官能团的极性和位阻效应诱导COFs结构从球形、棒状演变为蜘蛛网状，其中COF-NO2的互连网络显著提升反应物和产物扩散效率。

papers.title: Chiralizing Covalent Organic Frameworks to Boost H 2 O 2 Photosynthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Solar‐driven H 2 O 2 photosynthesis offers a sustainable route to on‐site oxidant production, yet the selective reduction of triplet O 2 to spin‐paired H 2 O 2 remains kinetically challenging. Covalent organic framework (COF) photocatalysts have largely focused on charge separation and active‐site reactivity, while overlooking the spin character of electrons transferred to O 2 . Here we discover that chiralization renders COFs significantly enhanced production of H 2 O 2 , and report a chiralization strategy for spin‐regulated H 2 O 2 photosynthesis in β‐ketoenamine‐linked COFs. The chiral frameworks enable spin‐selective electron transport, favor the O–O‐bond‐preserving reduction pathway and lower the apparent kinetic barrier for H 2 O 2 formation. Chiralization enhances H 2 O 2 production by 38.7%–252.1% relative to achiral counterparts. A bipyridine‐containing chiral COF reaches 22.8 mmol g −1 h −1 using solely water and oxygen, with an apparent quantum yield of 10.3% at 420 nm, placing it at the forefront of sacrificial‐agent‐free COF systems. Membrane‐integrated chiral COFs enable continuous‐flow H 2 O 2 production. These findings establish chirality as a design parameter coupling spin‐selective electron transport with O 2 reduction pathway control, opening new directions for COF photocatalysis.

papers.title: Graphene Materials With Anomalous Infrared Emissivity Yet Superb Chemical Stability
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Low infrared emissivity materials (i.e., metallic materials) are of significance for thermal radiation regulation. However, the easy‐corrosion susceptibility and poor chemical stability are common bottleneck issues that affect their applications. We report a versatile electronic structure modulation strategy for low infrared (IR) emissivity graphene by engineering the surface chemistry of precursor graphene oxide and the followed reduction/doping process. The fabrication protocols minimize the irreparable disruption of the intrinsic graphitic structure and enable controllable assembly of nanosheets by suppressing formation of carboxyl groups. More significantly, the convenient reduction and halogen doping effects synergistically minimize electron scattering and enhance interfacial charge transport. The low‐defective graphitic structure and the ordered multiscale architecture, as well as halogen doping effect, afford exceptional carrier mobility (∼27.1 cm 2 V −1 s −1 ), carrier density (5.73 × 10 20 cm −3 ), and electrical conductivity comparable to highly oriented pyrolytic graphite. Surprisingly, the anomalous metallic response gives the lowest IR emissivity (0.15, 8–14 µm) for carbon materials, comparable to MXene and traditional metallic materials. The large‐scale processability and outstanding long‐term stability under chemical conditions offer new insights for the potential infrared applications of graphene materials.

papers.title: Architecting 3D Space‐Charge Heterointerfacial Networks for Electrode‐Scale Ion Transport
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Harnessing space‐charge effects to govern carrier dynamics is central to nanoionics, yet translating localized nanoscale transport into continuous electrode‐wide percolation remains challenging. Here, we report an architectural strategy that uses Na 2 O/Na 2 CO 3 heterointerfaces as local nanoionic transport units and organizes them into a bulk‐distributed, three‐dimensional network throughout a preformed electrode. This architecture is realized by coupling ultralow‐flux Na‐vapor metallization with mesopore‐regulated gas‐solid conversion in a preformed metal‐organic framework (MOF) host. The synergy of space‐charge carrier enrichment and MOF‐mediated lattice distortion simultaneously boosts carrier density and lowers migration barriers, yielding an estimated local interfacial conductivity on the order of 10 −7 S cm −1 at 25°C, from intrinsically insulating Na 2 O (10 −12 S cm −1 ) and Na 2 CO 3 (10 −23 S cm −1 ). Integrated with conducting carbon, this functionally percolating network enables stable solid‐state presodiation and ultrahigh‐rate sodium‐ion full cells. This work bridges the gap between nanoscopic interface physics and macroscopic device functionality, identifying the spatial connectivity of phase boundaries, rather than the localized space‐charge effect alone, as a programmable design variable for next‐generation solid‐state ionics.

papers.title: Characterization and functional evaluation of urea-mesoporous nano-silica and urea-reduced graphene oxide nanocomposites on rice–wheat and soil health
papers.abstract: Nanocomposites, a novel class of eco-friendly delivery materials, have emerged as promising candidates for improving nutrient retention and delivery efficiency in agricultural systems. This research covers synthesis of mesoporous nano silica (mNs) and reduced graphene oxide (rGO) based urea nanocomposites to assess their impact on crop response and soil health under greenhouse rice–wheat pot sequence. The characterization of developed nanocomposites was performed using FTIR, EDX, SEM, TEM, XRD and SAED technology. FTIR spectroscopy revealed molecular signatures viz N–H and C=O stretching patterns, confirming the incorporation of urea into nanomaterial framework. SEM and TEM further showed the formation of interface structures on silica and graphene surfaces due to urea engraftment. Functional evaluation revealed that urea-mNS nanocomposite at N120 (Urea-mNS)-P60-K40 consistently showed highest grain and straw yield, nitrogen content and nitrogen uptake in rice–wheat sequence. Further, N90 (Urea-mNS)-P60-K40 led to higher available N, P, K, microbial population and dehydrogenase activity (DHA). Contrarily, rGO-based nanocomposites reduced crop performance, nutrient availability and microbial activity at higher nitrogen levels. These findings suggest that mNS-based nanocomposites may serve as promising nutrient carrier systems in agriculture, while emphasizing the need for tailored strategies for rGO-based formulations. Nevertheless, dedicated release studies are required to confirm their potential controlled nutrient-release behavior.

papers.title: Nitrogen‐Doped Mesoporous Carbon Loaded With Zn Single Atoms as a Catalyst for the Synthesis of 2,4(5)‐Diarylimidazoles
papers.abstract: Single‐atom catalysts have emerged as highly effective alternatives to conventional metal catalysts due to their uniform active sites and superior catalytic performance. Stabilizing single zinc atoms on nitrogen‐doped mesoporous carbon (NMC) enhances their stability, selectivity, electrical conductivity, and compatibility with green chemistry principles. In this study, a Zn@NMC catalyst was synthesized via solvent evaporation‐induced self‐assembly, followed by thermal polymerization and pyrolysis, and characterized by 1 H nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), Brunauer–Emmett–Teller, thermogravimetric analysis, scanning electron microscopy, and energy‐dispersive X‐ray mapping analyses. The catalyst was successfully applied in the one‐pot Radziszewski synthesis of 12 2,4(5)‐diarylimidazole derivatives from phenylglyoxal, various substituted benzaldehydes, and ammonium acetate. 1 H NMR, 13 C NMR, and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy were used to characterize the products. Optimal results were obtained in methanol at room temperature (25 °C) for 12 h, affording the desired products in yields of up to 97%. The incorporation of isolated zinc atoms into the nitrogen‐rich carbon matrix significantly improved selectivity toward the target diarylimidazoles by suppressing side reactions and preventing catalyst deactivation.
