papers.title: MOF-derived hierarchical FeCo3S4@graphitic carbon/rGO nanoarchitectures for high-energy and high-power supercapacitors
papers.abstract: A hierarchical FeCo₃S₄@gC/rGO (Fe-Co-S@gC/rGO) hybrid nanocomposite was synthesized through a MOF-assisted solution-mediated assembly and two-step thermal treatment strategy for supercapacitor applications. The resulting architecture integrates reduced graphene oxide (rGO), graphitic carbon (gC), and cobalt sulfide-based nanostructures to improve electrical conductivity, electrolyte accessibility, and structural stability. Structural characterization confirmed the formation of a porous Fe-Co-S@gC/rGO framework with uniformly distributed Fe, Co, S, C, N, and O species. Electrochemical measurements showed that the optimized Fe-Co-S@gC/rGO electrode delivered a high specific capacitance of 1827 F g −1 at 0.5 A g −1 and retained strong cycling durability. An asymmetric supercapacitor assembled using Fe-Co-S@gC/rGO as the positive electrode and rGO as the negative electrode exhibited favorable energy-storage performance and long-term stability. The device delivered 974.1 F g⁻¹ at 0.5 A g⁻¹ and achieved a high energy density of 541.2 Wh kg⁻¹ at a power density of 8213.4 W kg⁻¹. Additionally, long-term durability was confirmed over 12,000 charge–discharge cycles and 10,000 voltammetry cycles. The enhanced electrochemical behavior is attributed to the combined effects of hierarchical porosity, conductive graphitic carbon/rGO networks, and abundant redox-active sites. These results suggest that Fe-Co-S@gC/rGO is a promising electrode material for advanced supercapacitor applications.

papers.title: Unlocking the Tertiary Nitrogen Effect in 3D Anisotropic Covalent Organic Frameworks to Achieve Record Iodine Capture under Industrial Conditions
papers.abstract: Abstract Using porous adsorbents to achieve efficient capture of radioactive iodine from nuclear waste under industrial conditions remains a formidable challenge, since most adsorbents just exhibit a low iodine uptake under such conditions. We herein show two 3D [8 + 4]-assembled covalent organic frameworks (COFs, ECUT-COF-99 and ECUT-COF-100) for this challenging target. The two COFs feature a minimal-transitivity [3 4] flu-derived net, which allows anisotropic isoreticular expansion through a general sequential derived-net approach. ECUT-COF-100 was found to give an ultrahigh iodine uptake of 1.51 g/g under simulated industrial conditions (150 °C and 150 ppmv I2), 5.2-fold that of ECUT-COF-99 (0.29 g/g). Such performance also far exceeds all established organic adsorbents for this use. Mechanism studies reveal that nonaromatic tertiary nitrogen atoms allow for strong charge transfer from the lone-pair electrons of tertiary nitrogen to I2, leading to the formation of ionic iodides (I3– and I5–) and the N·+ radical cation and then fixing of ionic iodides by Coulomb interactions. This work not only provides a promising adsorbent with record iodine uptake for radioactive iodine capture from nuclear waste but also highlights a new insight into the tertiary nitrogen effect in 3D COFs for efficient iodine capture.

papers.title: Tailoring Superhydrophobic Ultramicropores in Covalent Organic Frameworks for Humidity-Resistant Methane Purification
papers.abstract: Abstract Efficient purification of methane from raw natural gas under humid conditions remains challenging because water adsorption often degrades the separation performance and structural stability of porous adsorbents. Here we report a topology- and stacking-guided molecular design strategy that integrates ultramicropore engineering with pore-surface fluorination to construct superhydrophobic covalent organic frameworks (COFs) for humidity-resistant methane purification. Two isoreticular fluorinated COFs, TF-COF and NF-COF, were constructed by rationally controlling framework topology and interlayer stacking, generating well-defined ultramicropores for size-selective discrimination of C1–C3 hydrocarbons. Fluorination simultaneously enhances pore-wall hydrophobicity and strengthens host–guest interactions, creating a confined adsorption environment that promotes hydrocarbon recognition while effectively suppressing competitive water adsorption. As a result, NF-COF exhibits a propane uptake of 99.4 cm3 g–1 and an exceptional C3H8/CH4 IAST selectivity of 251.7 at 298 K. Dynamic breakthrough experiments further demonstrate efficient methane purification under both dry and highly humid conditions, with the separation performance fully retained at 97% relative humidity owing to its superhydrophobic surface. Theoretical calculations reveal that densely distributed fluorine atoms generate synergistic pore confinement and multiple C–H···F van der Waals interactions, simultaneously maximizing adsorption capacity and molecular discrimination. These findings establish fluorinated superhydrophobic COFs as a robust platform for energy-efficient natural gas upgrading under industrially relevant humid conditions.

papers.title: Charge‐Delocalizing sp‐Hybridized COFs for Selective H 2 O 2 Electrosynthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ) is an important oxidant for chemical manufacturing, environmental remediation, and biomedical applications, yet its industrial production still relies mainly on the energy‐intensive anthraquinone process. Electrochemical H 2 O 2 synthesis via the two‐electron oxygen reduction reaction (2e − ORR) provides a sustainable alternative but is often hindered by sluggish charge transport and insufficient O 2 activation. Here, we develop a bond‐hybridization strategy by incorporating sp‐hybridized acetylene units into the vertex or linker of covalent organic frameworks (COFs). The resulting COFs feature extended π‐conjugation, enhanced charge delocalization, and electronically polarized pores, thereby strengthening O 2 adsorption and activation. Compared with sp 2 ‐dominated analogues, these sp‐hybridized COFs show faster charge‐transfer kinetics, higher H 2 O 2 selectivity, and improved 2e − ORR activity. In a flow cell, the optimized catalyst delivers an H 2 O 2 production rate of 27.8 mol g −1 h −1 and a peak Faradaic efficiency of 91.7% at 150 mA cm −2 . Mechanistic analyses combining electronic‐structure calculations and in situ vibrational spectroscopy reveal that sp hybridization reshapes frontier‐orbital distributions and local charge density, thereby coupling framework‐wide charge delocalization with favorable O 2 adsorption and *OOH stabilization. These results establish bond hybridization as a molecular‐level design parameter for catalytic selectivity in COFs, extending framework engineering beyond conventional functional‐group and building‐block modification.

papers.title: ZIF-8 for advanced biosensors: from synthesis strategies to sensing platforms, applications and structure-performance relationships
papers.abstract: Zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8), a well-known member of the metal-organic framework (MOF) family, has garnered considerable interest because of its remarkable biocompatibility, large surface area, chemical stability, and structural tunability. ZIF-8 and its derivatives are promising for sophisticated biosensing applications because of these characteristics. This review systematically examines recent advances in ZIF-8 based biosensors, covering ZIF-8 synthesis strategies from conventional to bioinspired and environmentally friendly approaches, including solvothermal/hydrothermal, mechanochemical, sonochemical, seed-assisted, and self-assembly methods. The resulting ZIF-8 structures and their roles in different sensing platforms are critically discussed, with particular attention to crystal size, framework defects, hierarchical porosity, surface modification, and composite interfaces that influence analyte transport, biomolecule retention, and signal generation. The review also examines the incorporation of ZIF-8 into electrochemical, fluorescence, colorimetric, electrochemiluminescent, and SERS-based biosensors, emphasizing its functions in signal amplification, improved selectivity, and biomolecule immobilization. Additionally, structure-performance relationships are further discussed for the detection of food contaminants, environmental pollutants, and biomolecules. Future opportunities for real-world applications and important issues like sensitivity, repeatability, stability in complex systems and commercialization of these sensors are discussed. Overall, this review provides a comprehensive perspective on ZIF-8 synthesis, sensing platforms, applications, and structure-performance relationships, supporting the rational development of next-generation ZIF-8 based biosensors.

papers.title: Tailoring Backbone Angles of Regioisomeric Covalent Organic Frameworks: Distinct O 2 Adsorption Modes Enabling Efficient H 2 O 2 Electrosynthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) possess periodic skeletons and well‐defined catalytic sites, allowing precise molecular‐level regulation of interfacial properties in electrocatalytic oxygen reduction. However, conventional structural modifications fail to systematically tune oxygen adsorption geometry and interfacial electronic coupling. Here, we report a linkage‐angle engineering strategy that alters the bonding positions of reactive aldehyde groups to fabricate three regioisomeric COFs with predefined backbone dihedral angles of 180°, 120°, and 60°. The angle‑driven regioisomeric effect induces considerable differences in dipole moments together with uneven charge distribution. These collective structural features remodel oxygen‑surface interactions and modulate the intrinsic catalytic kinetics. Theoretical calculations confirm that the compact 60° framework of o ‐TPDA‐COF reconstructs confined pore interfacial microenvironments. Unlike the Griffiths‑type oxygen adsorption favored in its angular analogues, molecular oxygen preferentially adopts the Pauling configuration within o ‐TPDA‐COF to stabilize OOH* intermediates. Consequently, the optimal o ‐TPDA‐COF reaches an excellent H 2 O 2 productivity of 12.82 mol g cat −1 h −1 and a Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 91.64%. This work realizes controllable modulation of oxygen‑adsorption behaviors in COF‑based 2e – oxygen reduction, delivering a novel geometry‑oriented design paradigm for porous electrocatalytic frameworks.

papers.title: In Situ Metal Chelation for Topology Regulation and Single‐Site Construction in Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Precise regulation over the dimensionality and topology of covalent organic frameworks (COFs) through metal coordination remains a fundamental challenge. Herein, we report an in situ metal‐chelation strategy for topology regulation and single‐site construction in COFs using a bifunctional β ‐hydroxy ketone‐functionalized HDBC monomer. Metal‐free Schiff‐base condensation of HDBC with TAPy affords a one‐dimensional covalent ribbon framework, named COF‐HDBC. Strikingly, in situ Cu 2+ chelation during solvothermal crystallization redirects the assembly pathway toward a two‐dimensional bex ‐type Cu‐COF‐HDBC containing framework‐embedded Cu─O coordination sites. Post‐synthetic metalation of preassembled COF‐HDBC fails to trigger this transformation, verifying the indispensable structure‐directing effect of in situ chelation during nucleation and growth. This strategy is extendable to Ni 2+ and Co 2+ , affording isostructural metal‐chelated COFs. Multiscale characterizations and Cu K‐edge XAFS collectively support the proposed framework structures and the predominantly isolated nature of the Cu centers. As a functional validation, Cu‐COF‐HDBC enables selective CO 2 /CO electroreduction to CH 4 . This work establishes in situ metal chelation as a synthetic handle for programming COF topology and constructing framework‐embedded single‐metal sites, offering a versatile route to crystalline porous materials with complex architectures and tunable functions.

papers.title: Linkage-Engineered Fabrication of a Robust 1,6-Anthrazoline-Linked Covalent Organic Framework with Significantly Promoted Exciton Dissociation for Superior Photocatalysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are promising polymeric photocatalysts for solar-driven hydrogen evolution, yet their performance is often hampered by tightly bound excitons that suppress efficient charge separation. Herein, we present a linkage engineering strategy that directly attenuates excitonic effects through a facile two-step postsynthetic protocol combining imine bond locking with site-specific protonation. This approach affords a new class of readily functionalizable 1,6-anthrazoline-linked COFs (TP-PACOFs) featuring cationic, fully conjugated backbones with high planarity, tunable donor–acceptor character, and well-preserved crystallinity. Such a structurally synergistic design enables the cyano-containing derivative, TP-PACOF-CN, to overcome the “trade-off” barrier among synthetic accessibility, light-harvesting capability, exciton binding strength, surface wettability, and chemical stability. Strikingly, TP-PACOF-CN achieves a benchmark sacrificial photocatalytic hydrogen evolution rate of 307.8 mmol g–1 h–1 under visible-light irradiation, which is 1.9 times higher than that of its biquinoline-linked analogue and surpasses nearly all reported COF-based photocatalysts. Moreover, it delivers an apparent quantum yield (AQY) of 31.6% at 420 nm, retains activity up to 700 nm (AQY = 1.9%) and exhibits excellent recyclability. Comprehensive spectroscopic investigations and theoretical simulations demonstrate that the ingenious architectural motif of TP-PACOF-CN significantly promotes exciton dissociation and facilitates charge-carrier dynamics. This work provides valuable insights into exciton management in organic semiconductors and underscores the potential of structurally engineered COFs for high-efficiency solar fuel production.

papers.title: Electrochemical Detection of Hg(II) Using EASA-Derived Glutathione-Modified Mesoporous Silica Films
papers.abstract: Mercury contamination threatens aquatic ecosystems and human health because of its toxicity, persistence, and potential for bioaccumulation. This study investigated an electrochemically assisted self-assembly (EASA)-derived glutathione-modified thiol-functionalized mesoporous silica film on a fluorine-doped tin oxide (FTO) electrode as a proof-of-concept interface for Hg(II) detection. Films containing 5–15 mol% (3-mercaptopropyl)trimethoxysilane (MPTMS) were evaluated using charged redox probes, and the 10 mol% composition produced the highest electrochemical response. FTIR analysis supported silica-network formation and the retention of glutathione-associated functional groups. Under the selected conditions of pH 5.0, a deposition potential of −0.70 V, and a deposition time of 5 min, the MSF-GSH/FTO electrode exhibited a linear response from 5 to 60 µM Hg(II), with an estimated calibration-based detection limit of 4.27 µM. Resolved oxidation peaks were observed for Hg, Pb, and Cd in a mixed-metal solution. The interface combines direct EASA film formation, thiol incorporation, and post-deposition glutathione modification; however, further sensitivity improvement, replication, stability testing, and real-sample validation are required.

papers.title: Proximity‐Engineered Dual‐Atomic Cobalt Sites Enable Adaptive Spin Catalysis for Simultaneous Oxygen and Peroxide Reduction
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Breaking the intrinsic adsorption conflicts among oxygen intermediates remains a central challenge in oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) electrocatalysis. Although spin‐state engineering offers an effective strategy for tuning catalytic activity, conventional approaches generally focus on a single‐spin configuration, which cannot simultaneously satisfy the distinct energetic requirements of different ORR intermediates. Here, we introduce an adaptive spin catalysis concept through proximity engineering of dual‐atomic Co sites confined within a one‐dimensional covalent organic framework. Precisely regulating the Co–Co separation while preserving the local coordination environment induces inter‐site electronic coupling, giving rise to coexisting high‐spin and low‐spin Co configurations. Combined spectroscopic characterizations and theoretical calculations support a mechanistic framework in which these coexisting spin configurations provide complementary catalytic functions for distinct intermediates along the multistep ORR pathway, thereby alleviating adsorption conflicts. Consequently, the proximity‐engineered catalyst delivers outstanding ORR activity with a half‐wave potential of 0.96 V versus reversible hydrogen electrode, outperforming both its spatially separated counterpart and commercial Pt/C. The catalyst also efficiently mediates both O 2 and H 2 O 2 reduction while suppressing peroxide decomposition, enabling enhanced performance in rechargeable zinc–air batteries and peroxide‐assisted aluminum–air batteries. This work establishes a molecular framework for exploiting spin‐state complementarity in atomic catalysts for advanced energy‐conversion reactions.

papers.title: Cerium Valence‐Gated Interfacial Exciton Reconstruction for Fluorescence Modulation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Interfacial electronic coupling plays a decisive role in governing excited‐state evolution and signal transduction in optoelectronic systems, yet dynamically adaptive interfaces driven by valence‐state evolution remain largely unexplored in fluorescent sensing platforms. Herein, an Eu‐functionalized Ce‐MOF/CTF heterointerface is constructed to establish a valence‐responsive optoelectronic system for dual‐mode H 2 O 2 sensing. Upon oxidative stimulation, the Ce‐MOF/CTF heterointerface dynamically reconstructs the interfacial charge‐transfer network through Ce 3+ /Ce 4+ valence‐state evolution, enabling modulation of electron migration across the interface and synchronously regulating Eu‐centered luminescence, CTF‐derived fluorescence, and nanozyme‐mediated catalytic outputs. The results reveal that oxidative valence evolution induces adaptive interfacial electronic redistribution and excited‐state pathway reconstruction, thereby amplifying microscopic electronic perturbations into programmable fluorescence–catalytic responses. Beyond conventional sensing systems dominated by static emissive centers, this work demonstrates that adaptive interface states can function as dynamic optoelectronic units for intelligent signal transduction. Furthermore, the interfacial optical response can be integrated into flexible electrospun membranes and machine‐learning‐assisted visual recognition systems, enabling portable dual‐mode visual sensing. This work provides a new perspective for constructing adaptive optoelectronic interfaces through valence‐state engineering and establishes a general framework for next‐generation intelligent sensing platforms.

papers.research_details_zh: 针对荧光传感平台中由价态演化驱动的动态自适应界面研究不足的问题，作者构建了Eu功能化Ce-MOF/CTF异质界面，建立价态响应型光电系统用于双模式H2O2传感。在氧化刺激下，Ce-MOF/CTF异质界面通过Ce3+/Ce4+价态演化动态重构界面电荷转移网络，调控跨界面电子迁移，并同步调节Eu中心发光、CTF衍生荧光和纳米酶介导的催化输出。结果表明，氧化价态演化诱导自适应界面电子重分布和激发态路径重构，从而将微观电子扰动放大为可编程的荧光–催化响应。该工作证明自适应界面态可作为动态光电单元用于智能信号转导，并将界面光学响应集成到柔性电纺膜和机器学习辅助视觉识别系统中，实现便携式双模式视觉传感，为通过价态工程构建自适应光电界面提供了新视角。

papers.title: Bifunctional Metal–Organic Frameworks Integrate Energy‐ and Electron‐Transfer Pathways for Enhanced Photodynamic Therapy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) have emerged as promising nanophotosensitizers for photodynamic therapy (PDT), but most reported systems rely predominantly on a single O 2 ‐activation pathway, limiting their ability to produce complementary reactive oxygen species (ROS). Herein, we report a bifunctional MOF, Hf‐VIO‐DBP, that integrates porphyrinic photosensitizers (DBP) and viologen electron mediators (VIO 2+ ) within a single framework to establish a dual‐channel photoactive platform. The close spatial proximity of these two functional units enables efficient intra‐framework electron transfer while preserving the energy transfer capability of the porphyrinic photosensitizers. Upon 630 nm irradiation, excited DBP transfers electrons to VIO 2+ to generate viologen radical species, which mediate O 2 reduction to generate type I ROS, including superoxide, hydrogen peroxide, and hydroxyl radicals. The resulting DBP radical cation is reduced by endogenous biomolecules such as 1,4‐dihydronicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, thereby regenerating DBP and sustaining the photoredox cycle. Concurrently, energy transfer from excited DBP to O 2 produces singlet oxygen through a type II pathway. Compared with the viologen‐free MOF analogue, Hf‐VIO‐DBP markedly enhances type I ROS generation while retaining efficient type II ROS production, resulting in substantially improved overall ROS yields and phototoxicity. Therefore, Hf‐VIO‐DBP achieves potent PDT efficacy in CT26 and MC38 murine colon cancer models.

papers.title_zh: 双功能金属–有机框架整合能量与电子转移路径增强光动力治疗
papers.summary_zh: 该工作将卟啉光敏剂DBP与紫精电子介体VIO2+整合于Hf-VIO-DBP单一MOF中，构建双通道光活性平台，在630 nm光照下同时通过电子转移产生I型ROS和能量转移产生单线态氧，显著提高ROS产率和光毒性，在CT26和MC38小鼠结肠癌模型中实现有效PDT。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对多数MOF纳米光敏剂依赖单一O2活化路径、难以产生互补活性氧物种的问题，作者报道了双功能MOF Hf-VIO-DBP，将卟啉光敏剂DBP和紫精电子介体VIO2+整合于同一框架内，建立双通道光活性平台。两种功能单元的紧密空间邻近实现高效框架内电子转移，同时保留卟啉光敏剂的能量转移能力。在630 nm光照下，激发态DBP将电子转移给VIO2+生成紫精自由基物种，介导O2还原产生I型ROS，包括超氧阴离子、过氧化氢和羟基自由基；生成的DBP阳离子自由基可被内源性生物分子如1,4-二氢烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸还原，从而再生DBP并维持光氧化还原循环。同时，激发态DBP向O2的能量转移通过II型路径产生单线态氧。与无紫精的MOF类似物相比，Hf-VIO-DBP显著增强I型ROS生成，同时保留高效II型ROS产生，整体ROS产率和光毒性大幅提升，在CT26和MC38小鼠结肠癌模型中实现强效PDT。

papers.title: Engineering Polar Nanoregions in COFs via Controlled Symmetry Breaking Toward Piezocatalysis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT To address the limited piezocatalytic activity of covalent organic frameworks (COFs) arising from high structural symmetry and rapid charge recombination, an imine‐linked COFs (TFB‐TAPT) is synthesized by Schiff‐base condensation of 1,3,5‐triformylbenzene (TFB) and 2,4,6‐tri(4‐aminophenyl)‐1,3,5‐triazine (TAPT), followed by partial substitution of amino ligands with 1H,1H‐undecafluorohexylamine (UFHA) through a building‐block exchange strategy to afford TFB‐TAPT‐FA. This approach achieves controlled symmetry breaking with precise polar group distribution, without the lattice disruption caused by asymmetric monomers in one‐pot methods. The resulting randomly oriented polar nanoregions exhibit relaxation behavior, collectively generating a strong piezoelectric response under external stimuli. Piezoresponse force microscopy (PFM) measurements indicate that TFB‐TAPT‐FA has a piezoelectric coefficient of 140 pm/V, 2.5 times that of TFB‐TAPT. This amplification of the electromechanical response arises from the polar nanoregions, as evidenced by its higher calculated dipole moment (5.68 Debye). Consequently, TFB‐TAPT‐FA achieves an impressive piezocatalytic hydrogen production rate of 3.8 mmol g −1 h −1 , marking a 17‐fold improvement over TFB‐TAPT. Notably, TFB‐TAPT‐FA enables efficient hydrogen production without cocatalysts or heterojunctions. More broadly, the introduction of polar nanoregions similarly enhances the performance of other imine‐linked COFs, demonstrating a potentially general strategy for designing piezocatalysts through nanoscale polarization engineering in COFs.

papers.title_zh: 通过受控对称性破缺在COFs中构建极性纳米区域以实现压电催化
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对亚胺连接COF因高结构对称性和快速电荷复合导致压电催化活性受限的问题，采用构筑单元交换策略在TFB-TAPT中部分引入含氟极性基团，实现受控对称性破缺并形成极性纳米区域，显著增强压电响应和压电催化产氢性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是亚胺连接共价有机框架因高结构对称性和快速电荷复合而压电催化活性有限。材料体系为TFB-TAPT，由1,3,5-三甲酰基苯与2,4,6-三(4-氨基苯基)-1,3,5-三嗪通过席夫碱缩合合成。设计策略是采用构筑单元交换策略，用1H,1H-十一氟己胺部分取代氨基配体，得到TFB-TAPT-FA，实现受控对称性破缺和精确极性基团分布，避免一锅法中不对称单体造成的晶格破坏。所得随机取向极性纳米区域表现出弛豫行为，在外界刺激下集体产生强压电响应。该策略在多种亚胺连接COF中同样提升性能，表明纳米尺度极化工程可作为设计压电催化剂的潜在通用策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：通过席夫碱缩合合成TFB-TAPT；通过构筑单元交换策略用1H,1H-十一氟己胺部分取代氨基配体得到TFB-TAPT-FA；采用压电响应力显微镜测量压电系数；通过计算偶极矩评估极性；进行压电催化产氢性能测试。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器参数及产氢测试详细条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF、框架材料组装与电化学/催化应用主线，提出通过构筑单元交换实现受控对称性破缺和极性纳米区域构建，为COF压电催化设计提供可推广策略。其定量结果明确、机制证据较清晰，值得全文精读以核查合成细节、结构表征和普适性验证。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。关键细节如合成条件、构筑单元交换程度、结构表征数据、PFM测试参数、偶极矩计算方法、产氢测试条件及普适性COF范围仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: PFM测量表明TFB-TAPT-FA的压电系数为140 pm/V，是TFB-TAPT的2.5倍。
TFB-TAPT-FA的计算偶极矩更高，为5.68 Debye，归因于极性纳米区域。
TFB-TAPT-FA的压电催化产氢速率达到3.8 mmol g−1 h−1，比TFB-TAPT提高17倍。
TFB-TAPT-FA无需助催化剂或异质结即可实现高效产氢，且极性纳米区域策略可推广至其他亚胺连接COF。

papers.title: Supramolecular Assembly of Photoresponsive Molecular Amphiphile for Functional Soft Matter
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Photoresponsive molecular amphiphiles, obtained by incorporating amphiphilic moieties on a photoresponsive core, effectively bridge synthetic organic molecules with functional photoresponsive soft matters across multiple length‐scales in aqueous media. Well‐established molecular design strategies and principles have been identified for exquisitely designing versatile photoresponsive molecular amphiphiles and systematically programing both structures and functions across multiple length‐scales to obtain mesoscopic and even macroscopic properties. The thrive of photoresponsive molecular amphiphiles drastically expand the potentiality by offering plenty opportunities for their utilization in various fields. Here, we summarize the increasingly enriched applications of photoresponsive molecular amphiphiles according to different aqueous environment (water‐containing interfaces, solution states, and macroscopic soft scaffolds), describing how photoresponsive molecular amphiphiles were designed to fit in varieties of fascinating applications by inducing photoresponsive propensities into complex aqueous media and constructing functionality with versatile photoresponsive moieties.

papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是光响应分子两亲物如何桥接合成有机分子与功能光响应软物质，并在水相介质中跨多尺度实现结构 and 功能编程。材料体系为在光响应核心上引入两亲性基团得到的光响应分子两亲物。设计策略包括已建立的分子设计策略和原则，用于精确设计多功能光响应分子两亲物，并系统编程跨多尺度结构与功能，以获得介观甚至宏观性质。研究过程按不同水相环境总结其应用：含水界面、溶液态和宏观软支架，描述如何通过将光响应倾向引入复杂水相介质并利用多种光响应基团构建功能。意义在于光响应分子两亲物的发展极大拓展了其在多个领域的应用潜力。

papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与自组装技术及超分子材料主线相关，但未聚焦介孔导电MOF、共轭COF/HOF或其他框架材料，也未涉及电化学合成。其价值在于提供光响应分子两亲物跨尺度组装的设计原则和应用分类，可作为自组装背景参考，但与本主线框架材料直接关联有限，是否精读取决于对光响应软物质组装的需求。

papers.title: One‐Pot Construction of Amine‐Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks via Photoredox‐Catalyzed Reductive Amination
papers.abstract: Photocatalytic synthesis, as a green and efficient approach to organic synthesis, has been widely adopted in various organic transformations; however, its application in the synthesis of covalent organic frameworks (COFs) remains in the early stages of development. Moreover, to date, no photocatalytic approach has been employed for the synthesis of amine-linked COFs, which feature a higher density of basic sites and demonstrate enhanced stability. Herein, we report a novel one-pot photoredox-catalyzed reductive amination strategy for the synthesis of amine-linked COFs under ambient conditions for the first time. Based on this strategy, a series of amine-linked COFs were synthesized. Among these materials, DT-Am-COF exhibits excellent photocatalytic activity and demonstrates high efficiency as a catalyst for the light-driven oxidative hydrogenation of arylboronic acids and oxidation of sulfides. This study not only presents an effective method for the synthesis of amine-linked COFs, but also opens new insights into their preparation.

papers.title_zh: 通过光氧化还原催化还原胺化一锅构建胺连接共价有机框架

papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是光催化合成虽在有机合成中广泛应用，但在COF合成中仍处早期，且尚无光催化方法用于合成具有更高碱性位点密度和增强稳定性的胺连接COF。材料体系为胺连接COF，其中DT-Am-COF被重点研究。设计策略是开发新型一锅光氧化还原催化还原胺化策略，在环境条件下合成胺连接COF。基于该策略合成了一系列胺连接COF。研究过程包括评估所得材料的光催化活性，发现DT-Am-COF在光驱动芳基硼酸氧化氢化和硫化物氧化中作为催化剂表现出高效率。该研究不仅提供胺连接COF的有效合成方法，也为其制备开辟新思路。

papers.title: Record‐High Birefringence Achieved by Linearly Extended π‑Conjugated Building Blocks in Metal‐Free Sulfate
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The advancement of birefringent materials is critical for next‐generation integrated photonics, yet conventional systems face intrinsic limitations in birefringence magnitude. Sulfate crystals offer a promising platform but have been hindered by their dependence on specific metal cations and insufficient optical anisotropy. Here, we report a molecular design strategy that overcomes these constraints by employing linearly extended π‐conjugated organic cations as high‐anisotropy building units. Through rational amino‐functionalization of C 12 H 8 N 2 , we engineer the novel cation [H 2 (C 12 H 10 N 4 )] 2 + , which exhibits an exceptional polarizability anisotropy of 156.7 a.u. Using a mild aqueous route, a metal‐free sulfate crystal, [H 2 (C 12 H 10 N 4 )]SO 4 ·3H 2 O was synthesized, which achieves a record birefringence of 0.981 at 550 nm, surpassing all known sulfate birefringent materials and outperforming commercial benchmarks and setting a new performance standard for birefringent sulfates. Structural analysis reveals that the cations align via hydrogen‐bond‐directed assembly with sulfate tetrahedra into a quasi‐two‐dimensional anisotropic structure, thereby maximizing the macroscopic optical response. This study demonstrates that incorporating linearly extended π‐conjugated organic building blocks into sulfate frameworks sever as a robust strategy for discovering highly birefringent crystals.

papers.title_zh: 在无金属硫酸盐中通过线性延伸π共轭构筑单元实现创纪录高双折射
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以线性延伸π共轭有机阳离子为高各向异性构筑单元，经氨基功能化设计新型阳离子，温和水相合成无金属硫酸盐晶体，在550 nm处实现0.981的创纪录双折射，超越已知硫酸盐双折射材料及商业基准。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于传统双折射材料存在双折射幅度固有局限，硫酸盐晶体虽具潜力但依赖特定金属阳离子且光学各向异性不足。设计策略是采用线性延伸π共轭有机阳离子作为高各向异性构筑单元，通过对C12H8N2进行理性氨基功能化，设计出新型阳离子[H2(C12H10N4)]2+，其极化率各向异性达156.7 a.u.。采用温和水相路线合成无金属硫酸盐晶体[H2(C12H10N4)]SO4·3H2O。结构分析表明阳离子通过氢键导向组装与硫酸根四面体排列成准二维各向异性结构，从而最大化宏观光学响应。该研究证明将线性延伸π共轭有机构筑单元引入硫酸盐框架是发现高双折射晶体的稳健策略。

papers.title: Structural Rigidity Enables Amplified Spontaneous Emission in 2D Alkylammonium Tin Perovskites
papers.abstract: Abstract Two-dimensional tin perovskites are attracting increasing attention for coherent light emission, yet the impact of organic cations on their properties remains poorly understood. Here, we compare the Ruddlesden–Popper (RP) butylammonium tin iodide (BA2SnI4) and Dion–Jacobson (DJ) 1,4-diammoniobutane tin iodide (DABSnI4) perovskites to investigate the impact of the two structural types on their photophysical and optical gain properties. Combining X-ray diffraction and solid-state NMR spectroscopy, we reveal the different templating properties of the mono- and ditopic cations on the long-range structural order and local coordination environment, identifying an unreported phase transition for DABSnI4. The constrained molecular motions in the DJ perovskite provide an increased structural rigidity that also suppresses vibrational modes of the inorganic sublattice. The consequent lower exciton–phonon coupling and exciton binding energy, reduced defectivity, and modulation of the exciton recombination dynamics create favorable conditions to stabilize the population inversion and achieve amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) in DABSnI4, in net contrast with BA2SnI4 where ASE could not be obtained. This work highlights that Dion–Jacobson perovskites can create more rigid structural environments with positive feedback on the photophysical properties, providing a simple but effective design strategy for the synthesis of improved materials for optoelectronic applications.

papers.title: Three-Dimensional Covalent Organic Framework for the Capture of Nitrogen Dioxide
papers.abstract: Abstract We report the first adsorption isotherm of nitrogen dioxide (NO2) in covalent organic frameworks (COFs). Leveraging the dihedral angle (43.6°) of the biphenyl unit in biphenyl-3,3′,5,5′-tetracarbaldehyde, upon reaction with p-phenylenediamine, a three-dimensional COF, PKU-800, has been synthesized. Powder X-ray diffraction, hyperpolarised solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, and modeling collectively reveal that PKU-800 exhibits a triply interpenetrated qtz-type framework structure, which incorporates missing-aldehyde defects (∼8%) and thus pendant amine termini (∼16%). At 298 K, PKU-800 shows remarkable adsorption of NO2 (4.8 and 18.8 mmol g–1 at 0.01 and 1.0 bar, respectively), representing a new benchmark for NO2 sorbents. Dynamic breakthrough experiments confirm efficient capture of NO2 (from 2500 to &lt; 0.1 ppm) by PKU-800 under both dry and wet conditions, with dynamic capacities of 4.97 and 5.27 mmol g–1, respectively. In situ spectroscopic and modeling studies reveal that PKU-800 combines a robust three-dimensional topology, fully accessible channels, and strong binding interactions at both the imine and amino sites to synergistically trap NO2, which can be converted readily to nitric acid upon reaction with water in air.

papers.title_zh: 用于捕获二氧化氮的三维共价有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该工作报道了COF中首个NO2吸附等温线，利用联苯-3,3′,5,5′-四甲醛的二面角与对苯二胺反应合成三维COF PKU-800。其三重互穿qtz型框架含缺失醛缺陷和悬挂胺端基，在298 K下实现创纪录NO2吸附，并在干湿条件下高效动态穿透捕获NO2。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是开发可高效捕获NO2的共价有机框架材料，并首次获得COF中NO2吸附等温线。材料体系为以联苯-3,3′,5,5′-四甲醛为构筑单元、与对苯二胺反应合成的三维COF PKU-800，设计策略利用联苯单元43.6°二面角构建三维拓扑。粉末X射线衍射、超极化固态核磁共振谱和建模共同揭示PKU-800具有三重互穿qtz型框架结构，并含约8%缺失醛缺陷，因此产生约16%悬挂胺端基。298 K下PKU-800对NO2表现出显著吸附，在0.01和1.0 bar分别为4.8和18.8 mmol g–1，成为NO2吸附剂新基准。动态穿透实验确认其在干燥和湿润条件下均可将NO2从2500 ppm高效捕获至小于0.1 ppm，动态容量分别为4.97和5.27 mmol g–1。原位光谱和建模表明，稳健三维拓扑、完全可及通道以及亚胺和氨基位点的强结合作用协同捕获NO2，且NO2可与空气中水反应转化为硝酸。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：由联苯-3,3′,5,5′-四甲醛与对苯二胺反应合成三维COF PKU-800；采用粉末X射线衍射、超极化固态核磁共振谱和建模解析结构；测试298 K下NO2吸附等温线；进行干燥和湿润条件下动态穿透实验；结合原位光谱和建模研究吸附位点与机制。摘要未报告合成温度、溶剂、活化条件及循环稳定性细节。

papers.title: Spatially Decoupled Cascade Oxygen Reduction on Bi Single‐Atom and Cluster‐Hybrid Sites for Hydroxyl Radical Generation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The two‐electron oxygen reduction reaction (2e − ORR) for H 2 O 2 production and the subsequent in situ activation to ·OH are constrained by linear scaling relationships, making it difficult for a single active site to simultaneously optimize O 2 activation and H 2 O 2 conversion. This work overcomes the trade‐off by spatially decoupling the cascade reaction onto single‐atom and cluster‐hybrid sites and employing photoelectrocatalysis (PEC). Through a ligand‐exchange and pyrolysis route derived from a metal–organic framework precursor, Bi single atoms and clusters are co‐anchored on B‐doped TiO 2 . The hybrid interface thermodynamically optimizes the intermediate adsorption energies to ensure cascade selectivity, whereas PEC kinetically accelerates the H 2 O 2 ‐to‐·OH conversion by supplying photogenerated electrons. Density functional theory and free‐energy diagrams indicate that H 2 O 2 forms at the single atoms and dissociates into ·OH at the clusters, with the relationship between the p‐band center and ·OH yield following the Sabatier principle. The catalyst delivers a ·OH production rate of 250 µM h −1 at neutral pH and remains active over a broad pH range (3–9). Moreover, it enables broad‐spectrum removal of recalcitrant organic pollutants and retains stable performance over 50 h of operation in a flow‐cell reactor. This work offers guidance for designing cascade catalysts at single‐atom and cluster‐hybrid interfaces.

papers.title_zh: Bi单原子与团簇杂化位点上空间解耦级联氧还原用于羟基自由基生成
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过金属–有机框架前驱体经配体交换和热解，将Bi单原子与团簇共锚定于B掺杂TiO2，实现2e− ORR产H2O2与H2O2活化产·OH的空间解耦。杂化界面优化中间体吸附，光电催化加速H2O2转化，在中性pH下·OH产率达250 µM h−1，并可在pH 3–9及流动池中稳定运行。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是突破2e−氧还原产H2O2并原位活化生成·OH过程中线性标度关系限制，使单一活性位点难以同时优化O2活化和H2O2转化。设计策略是将级联反应空间解耦到单原子和团簇杂化位点，并采用光电催化。材料通过金属–有机框架前驱体的配体交换和热解路线制备，Bi单原子和团簇共锚定在B掺杂TiO2上。杂化界面从热力学上优化中间体吸附能以保障级联选择性，光电催化通过提供光生电子从动力学上加速H2O2向·OH转化。密度泛函理论和自由能图表明H2O2在单原子上形成，并在团簇上解离为·OH，p带中心与·OH产率关系遵循Sabatier原理。催化剂在中性pH下·OH产率为250 µM h−1，并在pH 3–9宽范围内保持活性，还可广谱去除难降解有机污染物，在流动池反应器中稳定运行超过50 h。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以金属–有机框架为前驱体，经配体交换和热解制备Bi单原子与团簇共锚定B掺杂TiO2；采用光电催化进行级联氧还原；利用密度泛函理论和自由能图分析中间体吸附与反应路径；测试·OH产率、pH适用范围、难降解有机污染物去除及流动池长期运行稳定性。摘要未报告具体前驱体、热解温度、光照条件、Bi负载量和污染物种类。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料衍生催化剂与电化学/光电催化主线，展示MOF前驱体构建单原子–团簇杂化位点并空间解耦级联反应，对框架衍生催化位点设计和氧还原反应有实际参考价值。其定量产率、宽pH和50 h稳定性较突出，若关注MOF衍生催化剂及级联催化，值得全文精读。局限是摘要未给出H2O2选择性和具体污染物去除率。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。具体MOF前驱体组成、配体交换与热解条件、Bi负载量、光电催化测试参数、H2O2选择性、污染物种类与去除率、DFT模型及稳定性测试细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Bi单原子与团簇共锚定于B掺杂TiO2，形成空间解耦的级联催化杂化界面。
DFT和自由能图表明H2O2在单原子位点形成，并在团簇位点解离为·OH，p带中心与·OH产率关系遵循Sabatier原理。
催化剂在中性pH下·OH产率为250 µM h−1，并在pH 3–9范围内保持活性。
在流动池反应器中稳定运行超过50 h，并可广谱去除难降解有机污染物。

papers.title: Cooperative Agostic‐Type C─H···Cu, Quadrupolar Cu···CO 2 , and C─H···O/π Interactions in an Ultra‐Microporous MOF Enable One‐Step Methane Purification From Quaternary C 3 H 8 /C 2 H 6 /CO 2 /CH 4
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT While agostic‐type C─H···metal σ‐interactions are central to organometallic catalysis, their role in gas separation remains elusive. In this study, a robust phosphine‐functionalized ultra‐microporous Cu(I/II)‐organic framework, LIFM‐XYY‐15, featuring open metal sites (OMSs) and rich aromatic pore walls, is designed to enable one‐step CH 4 purification from a quaternary C 3 H 8 /C 2 H 6 /CO 2 /CH 4 mixture. Notably, LIFM‐XYY‐15 exhibits much higher C 3 H 8 /C 2 H 6 /CO 2 uptakes than CH 4 , showing C 3 H 8 /CH 4 , C 2 H 6 /CH 4 , and CO 2 /CH 4 uptake ratios of 2.46, 2.30, and 3.92 at 298 K and 1 bar, respectively, which are significantly raised to 12.18, 8.59, and 9.89 at 0.1 bar. The separation potentials (∆ q ) reach 22.12 (C 3 H 8 /CH 4 ), 20.34 (C 2 H 6 /CH 4 ), and 43.69 (CO 2 /CH 4 ) cm 3 cm −3 at 298 K and 1 bar, demonstrating excellent CH 4 purification ability from the quaternary mixture. Breakthrough experiments confirm the delivery of high‐purity CH 4 (≥99.9%) with a productivity of 1.39 mol L −1 with excellent recyclability. The in situ single‐crystal x‐ray diffraction (SCXRD), in situ FT‐IR spectroscopy, and molecular simulations reveal that the exceptional selectivity arises from the synergistic interplay of agostic‐type C─H···Cu, quadrupole‐electrostatic Cu···‐CO 2 , and alkane C─H···O/π interactions, which collectively reinforce the affinity for C 2 –C 3 hydrocarbons and CO 2 while disfavoring CH 4 . This work discloses a crucial role of agostic‐type interactions as a powerful yet underexplored design principle for selective hydrocarbon separations.

papers.title_zh: 超微孔MOF中协同的类抓氢C─H···Cu、四极Cu···CO2和C─H···O/π相互作用实现从C3H8/C2H6/CO2/CH4四元混合物中一步纯化甲烷
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计了一种膦功能化超微孔Cu(I/II)-有机框架LIFM-XYY-15，利用类抓氢C─H···Cu、四极Cu···CO2及C─H···O/π协同作用，从四元混合物中一步纯化CH4，获得≥99.9%高纯甲烷，产率1.39 mol L−1，并具优异循环性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是类抓氢C─H···金属σ相互作用在气体分离中的作用尚不明确。作者设计了一种稳健的膦功能化超微孔Cu(I/II)-有机框架LIFM-XYY-15，具有开放金属位点和富芳环孔壁，用于从C3H8/C2H6/CO2/CH4四元混合物中一步纯化CH4。在298 K和1 bar下，C3H8/CH4、C2H6/CH4和CO2/CH4吸附比分别为2.46、2.30和3.92，在0.1 bar下显著提升至12.18、8.59和9.89。分离势Δq在298 K和1 bar下分别达到22.12、20.34和43.69 cm3 cm−3。穿透实验证实可获得高纯CH4（≥99.9%），产率1.39 mol L−1，且循环性优异。原位单晶X射线衍射、原位FT-IR和分子模拟揭示，优异选择性源于类抓氢C─H···Cu、四极-静电Cu···CO2和烷烃C─H···O/π相互作用的协同，增强了对C2–C3烃和CO2的亲和力而排斥CH4。该工作揭示了类抓氢相互作用作为强大但未被充分探索的选择性烃分离设计原则的关键作用。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道了以下方法：设计并合成膦功能化超微孔Cu(I/II)-有机框架LIFM-XYY-15；在298 K和1 bar及0.1 bar下进行单组分气体吸附测试，获得C3H8、C2H6、CO2和CH4的吸附量及吸附比；计算分离势Δq；开展四元混合物穿透实验评估CH4纯度和产率及循环性；采用原位单晶X射线衍射（SCXRD）、原位FT-IR光谱和分子模拟研究相互作用机制。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作对介孔导电MOF及框架材料的气体分离研究主线具有实际价值：它展示了超微孔MOF中开放金属位点与富芳环孔壁协同实现多组分烃/CO2/CH4高效分离，并首次将类抓氢C─H···Cu相互作用作为分离设计原则。局限在于摘要未报告材料的具体孔结构参数、稳定性数据及规模化制备可行性。鉴于其定量分离性能、机制证据和穿透验证较为完整，值得全文精读。

分离势Δq在298 K和1 bar下分别达到22.12（C3H8/CH4）、20.34（C2H6/CH4）和43.69（CO2/CH4）cm3 cm−3。
穿透实验证实从四元混合物中一步纯化可获得高纯CH4（≥99.9%），产率1.39 mol L−1，且循环性优异。

papers.title: Weak Interaction-Driven Self-Assembly of Low-Hygroscopicity Oxidizers for Biocidal Nanoenergetic Materials with Favorable Ignition Performance
papers.abstract: Abstract Iodine pentoxide (I2O5) features a high elemental iodine content, and the composite materials formed with nano-aluminum (n-Al) exhibit both high reactivity and abundant gas generation. However, the n-Al/I2O5 system suffers from a long ignition delay and strong hygroscopicity of I2O5. In this work, a novel iodine-rich energetic oxidizer, [C2H10N2](H2I3O9)2 (EAI-2), was designed and synthesized via weak interaction-driven self-assembly, achieving an ultralow hygroscopicity of ≤0.06% and a high iodine content of 68.26%. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction revealed that the supramolecular architecture was stabilized by cooperative halogen bonds (I···O) and hydrogen bonds (N−H···O). These cooperative interactions effectively shielded the samples from moisture adsorption. Three n-Al/EAI-2 composites were prepared via physical mixing (PM), cooling crystallization (CC), and spray antisolvent (SA) methods. Systematic characterizations demonstrated that the preparation method profoundly affected the crystal morphology, interfacial contact, and mixing uniformity of the composites. SA-n-Al/EAI-2 exhibited the most intimate interfacial contact, attributed to the rapid nucleation and constrained crystal growth during the antisolvent-induced precipitation. Consequently, SA-n-Al/EAI-2 displayed superior sensitivity performances, with an impact sensitivity of &gt;30 J, a friction sensitivity of 108 N, and a flame sensitivity of 7.9 cm, outperforming CC-n-Al/EAI-2. The ignition delay of SA-n-Al/EAI-2 (337.6 ms) was significantly shorter than that of n-Al/I2O5 (1039.6 ms) and PM-n-Al/EAI-2 (946.7 ms), demonstrating the critical role of interfacial engineering in energy release behavior. This study elucidates the relationship between crystallization methodology, supramolecular structure, and energetic performance, providing a crystal-engineering strategy for the design of advanced nano-thermites.

papers.title_zh: 弱相互作用驱动的低吸湿性氧化剂自组装用于具有良好点火性能的杀菌纳米含能材料
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过弱相互作用驱动自组装设计合成新型富碘氧化剂[C2H10N2](H2I3O9)2（EAI-2），实现≤0.06%超低吸湿性和68.26%高碘含量，并制备三种n-Al/EAI-2复合材料，其中喷雾反溶剂法样品界面接触最紧密，点火延迟显著缩短至337.6 ms。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是n-Al/I2O5体系存在点火延迟长和I2O5吸湿性强的问题。作者设计并合成了一种新型富碘含能氧化剂[C2H10N2](H2I3O9)2（EAI-2），通过弱相互作用驱动自组装实现超低吸湿性（≤0.06%）和高碘含量（68.26%）。单晶X射线衍射揭示超分子结构由协同卤键（I···O）和氢键（N−H···O）稳定，这些协同相互作用有效屏蔽了样品对水分的吸附。通过物理混合（PM）、冷却结晶（CC）和喷雾反溶剂（SA）三种方法制备了三种n-Al/EAI-2复合材料。系统表征表明制备方法深刻影响复合材料的晶体形貌、界面接触和混合均匀性。SA-n-Al/EAI-2表现出最紧密的界面接触，归因于反溶剂诱导沉淀过程中的快速成核和受限晶体生长。因此，SA-n-Al/EAI-2显示出优异的感度性能：撞击感度>30 J、摩擦感度108 N、火焰感度7.9 cm，优于CC-n-Al/EAI-2。SA-n-Al/EAI-2的点火延迟（337.6 ms）显著短于n-Al/I2O5（1039.6 ms）和PM-n-Al/EAI-2（946.7 ms），证明界面工程在能量释放行为中的关键作用。该研究阐明了结晶方法、超分子结构与含能性能之间的关系，为先进纳米铝热剂设计提供了晶体工程策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道了以下方法：通过弱相互作用驱动自组装设计合成EAI-2；采用单晶X射线衍射解析超分子结构；通过物理混合（PM）、冷却结晶（CC）和喷雾反溶剂（SA）三种方法制备n-Al/EAI-2复合材料；系统表征复合材料晶体形貌、界面接触和混合均匀性；测试感度性能（撞击感度、摩擦感度、火焰感度）和点火延迟。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作对自组装技术和框架材料组装研究主线具有拓展价值：它展示了弱相互作用（卤键与氢键）驱动的超分子自组装可有效调控氧化剂的吸湿性和含能性能，并通过结晶方法工程优化界面接触与点火行为。局限在于摘要未报告EAI-2的晶体结构细节、热稳定性及长期储存稳定性。鉴于其定量感度与点火数据完整，且涉及自组装与晶体工程策略，值得全文精读。

单晶X射线衍射揭示超分子结构由协同卤键（I···O）和氢键（N−H···O）稳定，有效屏蔽水分吸附。

SA-n-Al/EAI-2点火延迟为337.6 ms，显著短于n-Al/I2O5（1039.6 ms）和PM-n-Al/EAI-2（946.7 ms）。

papers.title: Mortise‐and‐Tenon Molecular Joint Covalent Organic Frameworks With Tunable Topology for Photothermal‐Catalytic Cross‐Dehydrogenative Coupling
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The controllable regulation of dimensionality and interpenetration in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) is crucial for optimizing photocatalytic performance, yet the translation of 3D COFs from structural construction to functional customization remains challenging. Here, we successfully designed a series of mortise‐and‐tenon molecular joint COFs by rationally engineering a twisted tetraphthaldehyde ligand bearing π‐conjugated “clips”. Stepwise extension of the “clips” enables topological evolution from 2D to twofold interpenetrated 3D, and ultimately to noninterpenetrated 3D structure. Notably, DHP‐CuPor‐COF with noninterpenetrated 3D structure amplifies light‐harvesting efficiency and substrate accessibility, enabling superior photothermal conversion and catalytic performance over its 2D and twofold interpenetrated 3D counterparts. To the best of our knowledge, it delivers highly efficient photothermal‐catalytic C─X (X = O, S) bond formation for selective transformation of phenolic compounds via cross‐dehydrogenative coupling (CDC) reactions (conv., >90% and yield, >80%), markedly outperforming conventional thermal catalysis. The high efficiency arises from the synergistic of open 3D channels, abundant Cu‐porphyrin active sites and strong photothermal effect. This work provides an innovative strategy to tune the topological chemistry of COFs for advanced photocatalytic applications.

papers.title_zh: 榫卯分子接头共价有机框架：可调拓扑结构用于光热催化交叉脱氢偶联
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过设计含π共轭夹子的扭曲四醛配体，构建榫卯分子接头COF系列，实现从2D到互穿3D再到非互穿3D的拓扑演化。非互穿3D DHP-CuPor-COF兼具光捕获与底物可及性，光热催化C-X键形成转化率超90%、产率超80%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对COF维度与互穿程度难以可控调控、3D COF从结构构建到功能定制转化困难的问题，设计了一系列榫卯分子接头COF。设计策略是理性工程化一种带有π共轭夹子的扭曲四醛配体，通过逐步延伸夹子实现拓扑演化：从2D结构到二重互穿3D结构，最终到非互穿3D结构。研究比较了非互穿3D DHP-CuPor-COF与其2D及二重互穿3D对应物的性能，发现非互穿3D结构放大了光捕获效率和底物可及性，从而实现更优异的光热转换和催化性能。该材料用于酚类化合物的交叉脱氢偶联反应，实现C-X（X=O、S）键的高效光热催化形成。高效率来源于开放3D通道、丰富的Cu-卟啉活性位点和强光热效应的协同作用。该工作为调控COF拓扑化学以用于先进光催化应用提供了创新策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：理性设计含π共轭夹子的扭曲四醛配体，通过逐步延伸夹子构建榫卯分子接头COF系列；合成DHP-CuPor-COF及其2D和二重互穿3D对应物；比较不同拓扑结构的光捕获效率、底物可及性、光热转换和催化性能；进行酚类化合物的光热催化交叉脱氢偶联反应，评估C-X（X=O、S）键形成的转化率和产率。摘要未报告具体表征手段、合成条件和测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接契合共轭COF与框架材料组装主线，提供通过配体分子工程调控COF拓扑（维度与互穿）以优化光催化性能的策略，对介孔导电MOF及框架材料的光热催化设计有参考价值。其拓扑—性能关系明确，定量结果突出，值得全文精读以核查合成细节、表征证据和普适性。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段、光热转换效率数值、反应时间、底物范围、循环稳定性及机理验证细节，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过逐步延伸π共轭夹子，实现COF拓扑从2D到二重互穿3D、再到非互穿3D的可控演化。
非互穿3D DHP-CuPor-COF的光捕获效率和底物可及性优于2D及二重互穿3D对应物，光热转换和催化性能更优。
光热催化交叉脱氢偶联实现C-X（X=O、S）键形成，转化率>90%、产率>80%，显著优于传统热催化。
高效率归因于开放3D通道、丰富Cu-卟啉活性位点与强光热效应的协同作用。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Electric Double Layer with Ion‐Transport Pathways for Practical Zinc‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Manipulating the electric double layer (EDL) structure at nanoscale remains largely underexplored yet extremely challenging for practical Ah‐level aqueous zinc‐ion batteries (AZIBs). Here, we construct a heterogeneous nanostructured EDL with intrinsic ion‐transport pathways via cation‐anion coordination strategy, which synergistically enhances the thermodynamic stability and kinetic reversibility of the Zn anode. In‐situ characterizations and theoretical simulations demonstrate that the long‐chain ionic additive triggers the interfacial ion rearrangement and assembly within the EDL, where hydrophobic carbon chains self‐aggregate into dense apolar nanodomains, and cationic groups electrostatically attract anions and co‐assemble to form interconnected polar nanodomains. This uniquely heterogeneous EDL thermodynamically confines H 2 O activity and efficiently inhibits side reactions. Meanwhile, the interconnected polar ion‐transport pathways accelerate Zn 2+ migration and desolvation kinetics, achieving an ultrahigh Zn 2+ transference number (0.89) and dendrite‐free Zn deposition. Consequently, Zn//Zn cell delivers stable cycling over 1,200 h (25 mA cm −2 , 12.5 mAh cm −2 ) and Zn//NVO full cell retains 100% capacity after 30,000 cycles at 5 A g −1 . Furthermore, 0.2‐Ah and 1.1‐Ah pouch cells exhibit stable operation for 2,500 and 257 cycles, respectively. This work establishes a new paradigm for EDL nanostructure engineering, advancing practical AZIBs.

papers.title_zh: 具有离子传输路径的异质双电层用于实用锌离子电池
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过阳离子-阴离子配位策略构建具有本征离子传输路径的异质纳米结构双电层，长链离子添加剂诱导界面离子重排与组装，形成疏水非极性纳米域和互连极性纳米域，协同提升锌负极热力学稳定性与动力学可逆性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对实用安时级水系锌离子电池中纳米尺度双电层结构调控难题，构建了具有本征离子传输路径的异质纳米结构双电层。设计策略采用阳离子-阴离子配位策略，利用长链离子添加剂触发双电层内界面离子重排与组装：疏水碳链自聚集形成致密非极性纳米域，阳离子基团静电吸引阴离子并共组装形成互连极性纳米域。原位表征和理论模拟证实了上述界面组装行为。该异质双电层在热力学上限制水活性并抑制副反应，同时互连极性离子传输路径加速Zn2+迁移和去溶剂化动力学，实现超高Zn2+迁移数（0.89）和无枝晶锌沉积。该工作为双电层纳米结构工程建立了新范式，推动实用水系锌离子电池发展。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：采用阳离子-阴离子配位策略，引入长链离子添加剂构建异质双电层；使用原位表征和理论模拟研究界面离子重排与组装行为；测试Zn2+迁移数、锌沉积形貌；组装Zn//Zn对称电池、Zn//NVO全电池及0.2-Ah和1.1-Ah软包电池进行循环性能评估。摘要未报告具体添加剂化学结构、电解液配方、表征技术细节和模拟方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作涉及自组装与配位化学在电化学界面中的应用，其长链离子添加剂诱导的界面离子组装与纳米域形成机制，对框架材料组装和电化学合成主线有方法学借鉴意义。但研究对象为锌离子电池电解液界面，非框架材料本身，属于拓展推荐，值得关注其自组装策略和原位表征方法。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告长链离子添加剂的具体化学结构、电解液组成、原位表征技术类型、理论模拟方法细节及软包电池测试条件，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 长链离子添加剂触发双电层内界面离子重排与组装，形成疏水非极性纳米域和互连极性纳米域构成的异质双电层。
异质双电层热力学限制水活性并抑制副反应，互连极性离子传输路径加速Zn2+迁移和去溶剂化动力学。
实现超高Zn2+迁移数0.89和无枝晶锌沉积。
Zn//Zn电池在25 mA cm−2、12.5 mAh cm−2下稳定循环超1200 h；Zn//NVO全电池在5 A g−1下30000次循环后容量保持100%；0.2-Ah和1.1-Ah软包电池分别稳定运行2500和257次循环。

papers.title: Freezing-induced solid-liquid microphase separation for self-assembly of functional nucleic acid nanoparticles
papers.abstract: In nature, nuclear DNA complexed with histone form highly condensed chromatin via loop extrusion and microphase separation, yielding physically constrained solid-like structures. Inspired by this natural compaction, here we demonstrate that freezing-induced crystallization pressure and freeze-concentration effects trigger solid-liquid microphase separation for efficient DNA compression. Freezing compress various nucleic acids (single stranded DNA, molecular beacons, siRNA, plasmid DNA) into high-density states that self-assemble into nanoparticles (DNA-NPs, MB-NPs, siBcl-2-NPs, siPLK1-NPs, pEGFP-NPs). Molecular dynamics simulations reveal that ice crystal growth increases solute concentration, enhancing DNA intermolecular interactions to form supramolecular chains. Stress at advancing ice-liquid interfaces further orders and compacts these supramolecular chains into nanoparticles. In breast cancer cells, MB-NPs detect miRNA-21; siBcl-2-NPs downregulate Bcl-2 protein; siPLK1-NPs exhibited antitumor effects; and pEGFP-NPs mediate green fluorescent protein (GFP) expression. This freeze-induced self-assembly strategy replaces chemical synthesis with physical constraints, establishing a versatile platform for facile production of nucleic acid nanoparticles. Efficent delivery of various nucleic acids in vitro and in vivo remains challenging. Here, the authors use freezing-induced condensation and microphase separation to compress nucleic acids into functional nanoparticles, without excipients, validated the bioactivity in vitro and in vivo.

papers.title_zh: 冷冻诱导固-液微相分离用于功能核酸纳米颗粒的自组装
papers.summary_zh: 该工作受天然染色质凝聚启发，利用冷冻诱导的结晶压力和冷冻浓缩效应触发固-液微相分离，将多种核酸压缩为高密度状态并自组装成功能纳米颗粒，无需化学合成或辅料，在体外和体内验证了生物活性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究受天然核DNA与组蛋白通过环挤出和微相分离形成高度凝聚染色质的启发，提出冷冻诱导固-液微相分离策略实现高效DNA压缩。冷冻过程将多种核酸（单链DNA、分子信标、siRNA、质粒DNA）压缩为高密度状态，自组装形成纳米颗粒（DNA-NPs、MB-NPs、siBcl-2-NPs、siPLK1-NPs、pEGFP-NPs）。分子动力学模拟揭示冰晶生长增加溶质浓度，增强DNA分子间相互作用形成超分子链；推进的冰-液界面应力进一步使超分子链有序化和致密化形成纳米颗粒。在乳腺癌细胞中，MB-NPs检测miRNA-21；siBcl-2-NPs下调Bcl-2蛋白；siPLK1-NPs表现出抗肿瘤效果；pEGFP-NPs介导绿色荧光蛋白表达。该冷冻诱导自组装策略以物理约束替代化学合成，建立了便捷制备核酸纳米颗粒的通用平台。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：冷冻处理多种核酸（单链DNA、分子信标、siRNA、质粒DNA）诱导固-液微相分离和自组装；分子动力学模拟研究冰晶生长、溶质浓度变化、DNA分子间相互作用及冰-液界面应力对超分子链有序化和致密化的影响；在乳腺癌细胞中评估MB-NPs检测miRNA-21、siBcl-2-NPs下调Bcl-2蛋白、siPLK1-NPs抗肿瘤效果及pEGFP-NPs介导GFP表达。摘要未报告冷冻温度、速率、缓冲液条件和纳米颗粒表征细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作聚焦冷冻诱导自组装技术，与自组装技术主线相关，其物理约束驱动微相分离形成纳米颗粒的策略对框架材料组装有启发意义。但研究对象为核酸纳米颗粒，非框架材料或介孔材料，属于拓展推荐。其无辅料、通用性强的自组装方法值得关注，但需全文核查以评估与框架材料组装的关联性。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告冷冻温度、冷冻速率、缓冲液组成、纳米颗粒尺寸分布、表征手段、体内实验模型及分子动力学模拟参数等关键细节，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 冷冻诱导的结晶压力和冷冻浓缩效应触发固-液微相分离，可将单链DNA、分子信标、siRNA和质粒DNA等多种核酸压缩自组装为纳米颗粒。
分子动力学模拟揭示冰晶生长增加溶质浓度，增强DNA分子间相互作用形成超分子链，冰-液界面应力使超分子链有序致密化形成纳米颗粒。
在乳腺癌细胞中验证了功能：MB-NPs检测miRNA-21，siBcl-2-NPs下调Bcl-2蛋白，siPLK1-NPs表现抗肿瘤效果，pEGFP-NPs介导GFP表达。
该策略无需化学合成和辅料，以物理约束替代化学合成，建立了通用核酸纳米颗粒制备平台。

papers.title: A high-performance synthetic micro-mesoporous activated carbon obtained from virgin and recycled PVDC with exceptional biobutanol separation performance
papers.abstract: The effective recovery of biobutanol from fermentation vapor streams hinges on the development of highly selective adsorbents that can efficiently capture butanol in the presence of excess water. This paper addresses this challenge through the synthesis and characterization of tailored activated carbons. Using a high-purity polyvinylidene chloride (PVDC) precursor, in both virgin and recycled forms, a series of carbons were prepared by varying the duration of physical CO2 activation process (up to 26 h). The study establishes a clear link between these synthesis conditions and the resulting porous structure. All synthesized activated carbons displayed Type V water adsorption isotherms proving a high degree of hydrophobicity which further enhanced with increased activation time and burn-off. The nature of butanol adsorption was strongly linked to the pore structure; materials with shorter activation times and lower burn-off exhibited Type I isotherms indicative of micropore filling, while those with longer activation times and wider pores showed Type V isotherms, reflecting a cooperative adsorption mechanism. The derived activated carbons demonstrated a very high adsorption capacity for butanol vapor (0.9 g/g at 200 Pa and 40°C), significantly higher than values reported in literature for other adsorbents. Dynamic breakthrough experiments using a mixed butanol-water vapor stream validated the enhanced separation performance with a dynamic capacity very close to the equilibrium capacity. The material obtained from recycled PVDC showed excellent adsorption properties, superior to commercial benchmark materials, opening perspectives for the valorization of waste PVDC into a renewable, high grade functional porous solid.

papers.title_zh: 以原生及回收PVDC制备高性能合成微孔-介孔活性炭及其优异的生物丁醇分离性能
papers.summary_zh: 以原生和回收聚偏二氯乙烯为前驱体，通过CO2物理活化制备微孔-介孔活性炭，系统调控活化时间以优化孔结构。所得材料对丁醇蒸气吸附容量高达0.9 g/g（200 Pa，40°C），动态穿透实验中丁醇-水混合蒸气的动态容量接近平衡容量，回收PVDC基材料性能优于商业基准材料。
papers.research_details_zh: 本研究针对发酵蒸气中生物丁醇在过量水存在下高效选择性捕获的难题，以高纯度聚偏二氯乙烯（PVDC）为前驱体，分别采用原生和回收形式，通过改变CO2物理活化时间（最长26小时）制备了一系列活性炭。研究建立了合成条件与多孔结构之间的明确关联，并系统考察了孔结构对水蒸气和丁醇蒸气吸附行为的影响。所有样品的水吸附等温线均为Type V型，证明材料具有高度疏水性，且疏水性随活化时间和烧失率增加而增强。丁醇吸附机制与孔结构密切相关：较短活化时间和较低烧失率的材料呈现Type I等温线，以微孔填充为主；较长活化时间和较宽孔道的材料呈现Type V等温线，反映协同吸附机制。动态穿透实验采用丁醇-水混合蒸气验证了分离性能。该工作为废弃PVDC的高值化利用提供了新途径。
papers.methods_zh: 以原生和回收PVDC为前驱体，采用CO2物理活化法，通过改变活化时间（最长26小时）制备系列活性炭。表征手段包括水吸附等温线和丁醇蒸气吸附等温线测定（40°C，200 Pa条件）。性能测试采用丁醇-水混合蒸气的动态穿透实验，并将动态容量与平衡容量进行对比。摘要未报告具体的孔结构表征方法（如氮气吸附、比表面积测定等）及活化温度等详细条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 本研究属于介孔材料与多孔碳的交叉方向，核心价值在于通过PVDC前驱体和CO2活化条件调控微孔-介孔结构，建立孔结构与丁醇/水吸附选择性之间的构效关系。对介孔材料在分离领域的应用具有参考意义，尤其是回收聚合物高值化制备功能多孔固体的思路。但该工作不涉及MOF/COF/HOF或框架材料组装，与导电MOF、共轭框架等主线关联较弱，属于拓展推荐。若关注多孔碳的孔结构调控与蒸气分离，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征方法或数值。摘要未报告活化温度、升温程序、比表面积、孔容、孔径分布等关键孔结构参数，也未说明动态穿透实验的具体装置、流速、床层条件及循环稳定性。全文需核查：CO2活化的具体温度与时间序列、孔结构定量数据、丁醇/水选择性数值、回收PVDC的杂质影响及材料长期稳定性。
key_findings_zh: 所有合成活性炭的水吸附等温线均为Type V型，表明高度疏水性，且疏水性随活化时间和烧失率增加而增强。
丁醇蒸气吸附容量高达0.9 g/g（200 Pa，40°C），显著高于文献报道的其他吸附剂。
短活化时间、低烧失率材料呈Type I丁醇等温线（微孔填充），长活化时间、宽孔材料呈Type V等温线（协同吸附机制）。
动态穿透实验中丁醇-水混合蒸气的动态容量非常接近平衡容量，回收PVDC基材料吸附性能优于商业基准材料。

papers.title: A Scalable Spin‐Coating Strategy for Mesoporous Gold Thin Films toward miRNA Detection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Mesoporous gold (mAu) films promise biosensing and electrochemical sensing due to their electroactive surface area, conductivity, and biocompatibility. However, conventional fabrication approaches, including electrodeposition and templating, often require substrate‐specific processing and can be challenging to scale, limiting the broader integration of mAu films into practical sensing platforms. Here, we report scalable spin‐coating of mAu films on transparent substrates with tunable thickness and uniform mesoporous framework. Electrochemical analyses reveal that additional coating cycles progressively increase the electrochemically active surface area and reduce the interfacial charge‐transfer resistance, yielding a corresponding rise in the differential‐pulse voltammetric signal, consistent with a mesoporous architecture that promotes efficient redox access and analyte adsorption. To demonstrate biosensing capability, a label‐free electrochemical assay for the ovarian cancer‐associated microRNA (miRNA) hsa‐miR‐200c‐3p as a model target is developed. The sensor responds monotonically from 1 aM to 10 pM, with a linear calibration (R 2 = 0.9831), an LOD of 1.72 aM, and an LOQ of 2.98 aM without amplification. This study establishes spin‐coating as a scalable approach to mesoporous Au electrodes for ultrasensitive nucleic acid biosensing. By decoupling mesoporous‐metal fabrication from substrate conductivity, it enables high‐surface‐area electrodes on transparent, flexible, insulating supports and extension to RNA biomarkers for miniaturized point‐of‐care diagnostics; uniformity and long‐term stability remain challenges.

papers.title_zh: 面向miRNA检测的介孔金薄膜可规模化旋涂策略
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道了一种在透明基底上旋涂制备介孔金薄膜的可规模化方法，薄膜厚度可调且介孔骨架均匀。通过增加涂覆循环次数提升电化学活性面积并降低界面电荷转移电阻，进而增强差分脉冲伏安信号。以此构建的无标记电化学传感器可检测卵巢癌相关miRNA，检测范围覆盖1 aM至10 pM，无需扩增即实现超灵敏核酸检测。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对传统介孔金薄膜制备方法（如电沉积和模板法）常需基底特异性处理、难以规模化的问题，提出旋涂策略在透明基底上制备介孔金薄膜。设计核心是获得厚度可调、介孔骨架均匀的薄膜，并通过改变涂覆循环次数调控电化学性能。研究过程包括：旋涂制备薄膜，电化学分析评估电化学活性面积与界面电荷转移电阻随涂覆循环次数的变化，并记录差分脉冲伏安信号的响应趋势；随后以卵巢癌相关microRNA hsa-miR-200c-3p为模型靶标，构建无标记电化学检测体系，考察其响应范围、线性、检出限与定量限。该工作的意义在于将介孔金属制备与基底导电性解耦，使高比表面积电极可构建于透明、柔性、绝缘支撑体上，并拓展至RNA生物标志物检测，面向小型化即时诊断；但摘要指出均匀性与长期稳定性仍是挑战。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：旋涂法制备介孔金薄膜；电化学分析（评估电化学活性面积、界面电荷转移电阻、差分脉冲伏安信号）；构建无标记电化学检测体系并以hsa-miR-200c-3p为模型靶标进行响应测试，获得检测范围、线性校准、检出限和定量限。摘要未报告具体的电解液组成、电位窗口、扫描速率、电极预处理、表征仪器型号及长期稳定性测试方案。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料及电化学合成/检测主线相关，其价值在于提供了一种可规模化的介孔金属薄膜制备路径，并将介孔金电极拓展至核酸生物传感，且明确给出了无扩增条件下的超低检出限。局限在于摘要未涉及导电MOF/COF/HOF或框架材料组装，属于介孔金属而非框架材料体系；若关注介孔电极制备与电化学生物传感的交叉，值得全文精读以核查薄膜均匀性、稳定性及传感选择性等关键细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据所提供题目与摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告的实验条件（如电解液、电位窗口、扫描速率、电极预处理）、表征细节（如形貌与结构表征方法及仪器）、选择性/干扰实验、重现性、均匀性与长期稳定性数据、以及miRNA检测在实际样本中的验证等关键细节，均需查阅全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 增加涂覆循环次数可逐步提高电化学活性面积并降低界面电荷转移电阻，同时差分脉冲伏安信号相应升高，与介孔结构促进氧化还原可及性和分析物吸附一致。
所构建的无标记电化学传感器对hsa-miR-200c-3p在1 aM至10 pM范围内呈单调响应，线性校准R²=0.9831。
无需扩增条件下检出限为1.72 aM，定量限为2.98 aM。
旋涂法可将介孔金薄膜制备与基底导电性解耦，从而在透明、柔性、绝缘支撑体上获得高比表面积电极；均匀性和长期稳定性仍是挑战。

papers.title: Synthesis and morphology characterization of single-walled carbon nanotube-incorporated mesoporous silica
papers.abstract: Single-walled carbon nanotube (SWNT)-embedded mesoporous silica with two distinct morphologies (rod-like and fibrous) was fabricated via a hydrothermal route under varied synthesis conditions and SWNT loadings. Highly ordered mesoporous silica/SWNT nanorods form under static hydrothermal conditions, whereas fibrous nanocomposites are generated under continuous stirring. The incorporation of SWNTs during silicate self-assembly exerts pronounced impacts on the overall morphology and mesostructure of the resulting hybrid materials. Experimental observations confirm that SWNTs act as nucleation sites and accelerate silica precipitation. For static synthesis, the length of rod-like composites decreases from 1.5 μm (0 wt% SWNTs) to 0.8 μm (10 wt% SWNTs) as SWNT loading increases. Under stirring, the product morphology evolves from discrete small particles (0 wt% SWNTs) to continuous fibrous structures exceeding 50 μm in length (10 wt% SWNTs). All synthesized samples were comprehensively characterized by nitrogen physisorption, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS), Raman and thermogravimetric analysis (TGA).

papers.title_zh: 单壁碳纳米管嵌入介孔二氧化硅的合成与形貌表征
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过水热路线在不同合成条件和单壁碳纳米管负载量下制备了两种形貌的单壁碳纳米管嵌入介孔二氧化硅：静态水热条件下形成高度有序的介孔二氧化硅/单壁碳纳米管纳米棒，连续搅拌下则生成纤维状纳米复合材料。单壁碳纳米管在硅酸盐自组装过程中作为成核位点并加速二氧化硅沉淀，显著影响杂化材料的整体形貌与介观结构。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究关注单壁碳纳米管嵌入介孔二氧化硅杂化材料的合成与形貌调控。材料体系为单壁碳纳米管与介孔二氧化硅的纳米复合材料，设计策略是在硅酸盐自组装过程中引入单壁碳纳米管，并通过改变合成条件（静态水热与连续搅拌）及单壁碳纳米管负载量来调控形貌。研究过程包括：水热法制备系列样品，系统表征其形貌、介观结构与组成；观察单壁碳纳米管对硅酸盐自组装的影响。结果显示，静态水热条件下形成高度有序的介孔二氧化硅/单壁碳纳米管纳米棒，连续搅拌下生成纤维状纳米复合材料；实验观察确认单壁碳纳米管作为成核位点并加速二氧化硅沉淀。定量方面，静态合成中棒状复合材料长度随单壁碳纳米管负载量增加从1.5 μm（0 wt%）降至0.8 μm（10 wt%）；搅拌条件下产物形貌从离散小颗粒（0 wt%）演变为长度超过50 μm的连续纤维结构（10 wt%）。该工作揭示了碳纳米管掺入对介孔二氧化硅形貌与介观结构的显著调控作用。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：水热合成路线（静态水热条件与连续搅拌条件，改变单壁碳纳米管负载量）；表征方法包括氮气物理吸附、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、透射电子显微镜（TEM）、X射线衍射（XRD）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）、拉曼光谱和热重分析（TGA）。摘要未报告具体水热温度、时间、前驱体组成、pH、表面活性剂种类及单壁碳纳米管预处理等合成细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料及自组装主线直接相关，展示了碳纳米管掺入对介孔二氧化硅形貌与介观结构的调控，尤其是成核位点作用与形貌随负载量的演变规律，对理解无机-碳杂化自组装具有参考价值。局限在于摘要未涉及导电MOF/COF/HOF或框架材料，也未报告电化学或导电性能；若关注介孔二氧化硅/碳纳米管杂化形貌调控，值得全文精读以核查有序度、孔结构参数及单壁碳纳米管分散状态等细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据所提供题目与摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告的合成条件（水热温度、时间、前驱体与表面活性剂、pH、单壁碳纳米管预处理）、孔结构参数（比表面积、孔径、孔容）、有序度定量指标、单壁碳纳米管分散与负载效率、以及XPS/拉曼/TGA的具体分析结论等关键细节，均需查阅全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 静态水热条件下形成高度有序的介孔二氧化硅/单壁碳纳米管纳米棒，连续搅拌条件下生成纤维状纳米复合材料。
单壁碳纳米管在硅酸盐自组装过程中作为成核位点并加速二氧化硅沉淀。
静态合成中，棒状复合材料长度随单壁碳纳米管负载量增加从1.5 μm（0 wt%）降至0.8 μm（10 wt%）。
搅拌条件下，产物形貌从离散小颗粒（0 wt%）演变为长度超过50 μm的连续纤维结构（10 wt%）。

papers.title: Mortise‐and‐Tenon Molecular Joint Covalent Organic Frameworks With Tunable Topology for Photothermal‐Catalytic Cross‐Dehydrogenative Coupling
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The controllable regulation of dimensionality and interpenetration in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) is crucial for optimizing photocatalytic performance, yet the translation of 3D COFs from structural construction to functional customization remains challenging. Here, we successfully designed a series of mortise‐and‐tenon molecular joint COFs by rationally engineering a twisted tetraphthaldehyde ligand bearing π‐conjugated “clips”. Stepwise extension of the “clips” enables topological evolution from 2D to twofold interpenetrated 3D, and ultimately to noninterpenetrated 3D structure. Notably, DHP‐CuPor‐COF with noninterpenetrated 3D structure amplifies light‐harvesting efficiency and substrate accessibility, enabling superior photothermal conversion and catalytic performance over its 2D and twofold interpenetrated 3D counterparts. To the best of our knowledge, it delivers highly efficient photothermal‐catalytic C─X (X = O, S) bond formation for selective transformation of phenolic compounds via cross‐dehydrogenative coupling (CDC) reactions (conv., >90% and yield, >80%), markedly outperforming conventional thermal catalysis. The high efficiency arises from the synergistic of open 3D channels, abundant Cu‐porphyrin active sites and strong photothermal effect. This work provides an innovative strategy to tune the topological chemistry of COFs for advanced photocatalytic applications.

papers.title_zh: 榫卯分子接头共价有机框架：可调拓扑用于光热催化交叉脱氢偶联
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过理性设计带π共轭“夹子”的扭曲四醛配体，构建了一系列榫卯分子接头COF，实现拓扑从2D到二重互穿3D再到非互穿3D的逐步演化。非互穿3D的DHP-CuPor-COF增强光捕获效率与底物可及性，展现优于2D和二重互穿3D类似物的光热转换与催化性能，可高效实现酚类化合物的光热催化C─X（X=O、S）交叉脱氢偶联。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对COF中维度与互穿程度难以可控调控、3D COF从结构构建到功能定制仍具挑战的问题，提出榫卯分子接头策略。设计核心是理性构建带π共轭“夹子”的扭曲四醛配体，通过逐步延伸“夹子”实现拓扑演化：从2D到二重互穿3D，最终到非互穿3D结构。研究过程包括合成系列COF并比较其拓扑、光捕获、底物可及性、光热转换与催化性能。结果显示，具有非互穿3D结构的DHP-CuPor-COF放大光捕获效率与底物可及性，光热转换和催化性能优于2D及二重互穿3D对照。该COF可实现酚类化合物经交叉脱氢偶联（CDC）选择性转化形成C─X（X=O、S）键，转化率>90%、产率>80%，显著优于传统热催化；高效性源于开放3D通道、丰富的Cu-卟啉活性位点与强光热效应的协同。该工作为调控COF拓扑化学以推进光催化应用提供了新策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：理性设计并合成带π共轭“夹子”的扭曲四醛配体；构建系列榫卯分子接头COF（含2D、二重互穿3D与非互穿3D结构）；以DHP-CuPor-COF为催化剂进行光热催化交叉脱氢偶联反应，底物为酚类化合物，产物为C─X（X=O、S）键，并报告转化率与产率。摘要未报告具体溶剂热/溶剂条件、反应温度与时间、光照强度与光源、光热转换效率数值、循环稳定性及表征手段等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与共轭COF及框架材料组装主线高度相关，其价值在于提出通过榫卯分子接头与π共轭“夹子”逐步延伸来调控COF维度与互穿程度，并建立拓扑—光捕获—底物可及性—光热催化性能的关联，为框架材料的功能定制提供设计思路。局限在于摘要未涉及导电性、电化学合成或介孔性；若关注共轭COF拓扑调控与光热催化，值得全文精读以核查结构解析、光热机制证据及底物适用范围等细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据所提供题目与摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告的合成条件（溶剂、温度、时间、催化剂用量）、结构表征细节（如PXRD、气体吸附、拓扑解析）、光热转换效率数值、光源与光照条件、底物范围与选择性数据、循环稳定性及Cu-卟啉活性位点作用机制的直接证据等关键细节，均需查阅全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过逐步延伸配体上的π共轭“夹子”，实现COF拓扑从2D到二重互穿3D、再到非互穿3D的演化。
非互穿3D结构的DHP-CuPor-COF放大光捕获效率与底物可及性，其光热转换和催化性能优于2D及二重互穿3D类似物。
该COF可光热催化酚类化合物经交叉脱氢偶联选择性形成C─X（X=O、S）键，转化率>90%、产率>80%，显著优于传统热催化。
高效性归因于开放3D通道、丰富的Cu-卟啉活性位点与强光热效应的协同作用。

papers.title: Stitching Atom‐Precise Ag 6 NCs in Cyclodextrin Metal‐Organic Framework: Chirality Induction and Second Harmonic Generation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Cyclodextrin‐based metal–organic frameworks (CD‐MOFs) has attracted considerable attention owing to their high crystallinity, water solubility, and biocompatibility. However, integrating atomically precise metal nanoclusters (MNCs) into CD‐MOFs remains largely unexplored. Only a few reports describe encapsulating MNCs within CD‐MOFs, but none have crystallographically elucidated the structural aspects of MNCs‐embedded CD‐MOFs. Moreover, the site‐specific positioning of MNCs in MOF—highly desirable for developing active catalysts and modulating properties—remains an unsolved challenge. Herein, we report the atomically precise hybrid assembly of Ag 6 nanoclusters (NCs) within γ‐cyclodextrin (γ‐CD) MOFs. Ultrasmall Ag 6 NCs are immobilized within the porous alkali metal ion–coordinated (K + , Rb + , Cs + ) γ‐CD framework, affording a well‐defined metal nanocluster‐γ‐CD‐MOF architecture at the nanoscale. Single‐crystal X‐ray diffraction unambiguously resolves a series of Ag 6 NC–incorporated γ‐CD MOFs, denoted as Ag 6 /M + /γ‐CD (M = K, Rb, Cs). Incorporation of the Ag 6 NCs profoundly modulates their intrinsic photophysical properties, induces supramolecular chirality, and enables second‐harmonic generation (SHG). Furthermore, the Ag 6 /M + /γ‐CD systems exhibit thermally activated delayed fluorescence, as corroborated by detailed theoretical calculations. Notably, these hybrid frameworks display pronounced circularly polarized luminescence, arising from chirality transfer from the γ‐CD host and the spatially organized ligand shell surrounding the luminescent Ag 6 NC assemblies.

papers.title_zh: 在环糊精金属有机框架中缝合原子精确Ag6纳米簇：手性诱导与二次谐波产生
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将原子精确Ag6纳米簇组装进γ-环糊精MOF中，获得系列单晶结构明确的Ag6/M+/γ-CD杂化框架，并发现其可诱导超分子手性、产生二次谐波和圆偏振发光，同时具有热活化延迟荧光。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对原子精确金属纳米簇难以嵌入环糊精MOF且缺乏晶体学结构解析的问题，采用γ-环糊精与碱金属离子K+、Rb+、Cs+配位构建多孔框架，并将超小Ag6纳米簇固定其中，形成Ag6/M+/γ-CD系列杂化材料。通过单晶X射线衍射明确解析了Ag6纳米簇嵌入γ-CD-MOF的结构，实现了纳米尺度上明确的金属纳米簇-γ-CD-MOF构筑。该组装显著调控了Ag6纳米簇的本征光物理性质，诱导了超分子手性并赋予二次谐波产生能力。理论计算支持其热活化延迟荧光行为。该工作为原子精确纳米簇与环糊精MOF的杂化组装及手性光学功能开发提供了结构基础。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：将超小Ag6纳米簇固定于碱金属离子K+、Rb+、Cs+配位的γ-CD框架中，进行杂化组装；采用单晶X射线衍射解析Ag6/M+/γ-CD结构；通过光物理性质研究、超分子手性表征、二次谐波产生测试和圆偏振发光测试评估性能；并辅以详细理论计算佐证热活化延迟荧光。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联介孔导电MOF之外但属于框架材料组装与手性光学功能的重要方向，尤其涉及MOF限域组装原子精确纳米簇、结构解析和手性传递。其价值在于提供单晶级结构证据和多功能光学响应，但导电性、电化学合成及介孔性摘要未报告。对框架组装与手性MOF研究有参考价值，值得全文精读以核查结构细节和光物理机制。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。关键细节如Ag6纳米簇的具体配体、框架孔道尺寸、手性表征手段、二次谐波测试条件、圆偏振发光不对称因子、热活化延迟荧光机制细节及理论计算参数均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 单晶X射线衍射明确解析了Ag6纳米簇嵌入γ-CD-MOF的结构，形成Ag6/M+/γ-CD（M=K、Rb、Cs）系列。
Ag6纳米簇的引入显著调控了本征光物理性质，诱导超分子手性并实现二次谐波产生。
Ag6/M+/γ-CD体系表现出热活化延迟荧光，并具有由γ-CD主体手性转移和Ag6纳米簇配体壳层空间组织引起的显著圆偏振发光。

papers.title: Structural Softness–Rigidity Mediation Enables Multicolor Emission and Long‐Lived Phosphorescence in Hf/Zr Halides
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Multicolor fluorescence, typically favored by soft environments, and phosphorescence, which relies on rigid lattices to stabilize triplet excitons, are fundamentally incompatible and hard to coexist within a single material. Here, we report a crown–ether–directed lattice assembly that integrates [HfCl 6 ] 2‒ /[ZrCl 6 ] 2‒ octahedra and DB18C6@M(K + /Rb + ) supramolecular, yielding four unknown organic–inorganic hybrid Hf/Zr halides. Notably, (DB18C6@K) 2 (CH 3 CN) 2 HfCl 6 achieves an exceptional room‐temperature phosphorescence (RTP) quantum yield (Φ p ) of 54.43%, a long lifetime of 0.8 s, and a visually discernible afterglow persisting up to 6 s. Moreover, these materials exhibit excitation–dependent multicolor emission, producing green and blue–white outputs under 302 and 365 nm irradiation, respectively. This unique multimodal luminescence originates from the synergistic interplay between the balanced soft‐rigid lattice provided by the crown‐ether framework and heavy – atom Hf/Zr centers, which facilitates intersystem crossing, enabling both efficient RTP and tunable multichannel pathways. It has been confirmed by the high–pressure synchrotron angle–dispersive x–ray diffraction and Raman results. Overall, this work establishes a heavy–atom–based structural mediation which may offer a generalizable route to high‐efficiency, multichannel, and stimuli‐responsive RTP materials.

papers.title_zh: 结构软硬介导实现Hf/Zr卤化物多色发射与长寿命磷光

papers.title: Metal-organic frameworks for separation of organic compounds in liquid phase
papers.abstract: Abstract Liquid-phase separation underpins numerous sectors of modern chemical industry, yet achieving high selectivity for separation of mixtures of organic compounds remains a persistent challenge. Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), showing exceptional tunability in composition, topology and pore environment, hold unique promise to address this challenge. This review surveys recent progress in studies of MOFs for the selective extraction and purification of organic substrates in liquid phase, with a focus on elucidating the mechanism of selectivity. Function-directed design principles, encompassing tailored bonding interactions, programmable supramolecular environments and pore-confinement effects, are discussed as enabling precise control over transport processes. These concepts are examined across key application domains, including removal of pollutants in water treatment, the separation of structurally similar hydrocarbons in petrochemical refinery and the selective discrimination of daily pharmaceuticals. Opportunities for the next generation of MOF-based sorbents are outlined, highlighting challenges associated with scalability and long-term operational stability, and the growing roles of artificial intelligence (AI)-guided discovery in developing sustainable separation technologies are further projected.

papers.title_zh: 金属有机框架用于液相有机化合物分离
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统总结MOF在液相有机化合物选择性分离中的进展，聚焦选择性机制，讨论功能导向设计原则，包括定制键合相互作用、可编程超分子环境和孔道限域效应，并展望AI辅助发现与可持续分离技术。
papers.research_details_zh: 液相分离是现代化学工业的重要基础，但实现有机化合物混合物的高选择性分离仍是持续挑战。MOF因组成、拓扑和孔环境的高度可调性而被认为具有独特潜力。该综述调查了MOF在液相中选择性提取和纯化有机底物的近期进展，重点阐明选择性机制。作者讨论了功能导向设计原则，包括定制键合相互作用、可编程超分子环境和孔道限域效应，这些原则可实现对传输过程的精确控制。这些概念在关键应用领域中得到检验，包括水处理中污染物去除、石化精炼中结构相似烃类分离以及日常药物选择性识别。综述还概述了下一代MOF基吸附剂的机遇，强调可扩展性和长期运行稳定性相关挑战，并展望人工智能引导发现在新一代可持续分离技术中的日益重要作用。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要未报告具体实验方法。作为综述，其方法学为文献调查与机制归纳，围绕MOF在液相分离中的选择性机制、功能导向设计原则和应用领域进行讨论，并展望AI引导发现。摘要未报告具体合成、组装、表征或性能测试方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与框架材料研究主线高度相关，尤其涉及MOF孔环境调控、超分子环境和限域效应对分离选择性的影响。其价值在于提供机制层面的设计原则和应用全景，但摘要未报告介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成内容。对液相分离和MOF吸附剂设计有参考价值，值得全文精读以获取具体案例和设计策略。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。关键细节如具体MOF材料、分离选择性数值、孔道尺寸、稳定性数据、AI方法细节及不同应用领域的代表性案例均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: MOF的组成、拓扑和孔环境高度可调，可用于液相有机化合物的选择性提取和纯化。
功能导向设计原则包括定制键合相互作用、可编程超分子环境和孔道限域效应，可精确控制传输过程。
应用领域涵盖水处理污染物去除、石化精炼中结构相似烃类分离以及药物选择性识别。
下一代MOF吸附剂面临可扩展性和长期运行稳定性挑战，AI引导发现被展望用于可持续分离技术。

papers.title: Charge Storage and Dark Photocatalysis in Multivariate Ti‐Based Metal‐Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT “Dark photocatalysis” decouples electron storage from photoconversion, offering a promising route to buffer solar intermittency, however requiring precise control of light‐matter interactions. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) provide a platform to tailor these interactions at the molecular level through judicious selection of organic linkers and interconnected metal nodes. This study advances design principles for dark photocatalysis by integrating two linkers with complementary light‐interaction roles in a multivariate (MTV) COK‐47 series. Varying the ratio between biphenyl dicarboxylate ( biph ) and bipyridine dicarboxylate ( bipy ) linker shows that under continuous irradiation (365 nm), COK‐47 biph is the most photocatalytically active member, surpassing COK‐47 bipy by threefold. In contrast, COK‐47 bipy exhibits an eightfold increase in photocharging capacity, revealed by a multispectroscopic approach, evidencing the formation of Ti 3+ and reduced linker species as storage unit. The stored charges drive methyl viologen (MV) reduction and H 2 evolution in the dark. Notably, the mixed‐linker material COK‐47 50‐50 combines both advantages, delivering near‐maximal H 2 production under illumination while retaining substantial charge storage capability, achieving the highest MV reduction activity and second‐highest dark H 2 evolution in the series. These findings connect framework composition to light‐matter interaction, charge storage capacity, catalytic activity, and establish a design strategy for multifunctional dark photocatalytic materials.

papers.title_zh: 多变量钛基金属有机框架中的电荷存储与暗光催化
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在多变量COK-47钛基MOF中引入联苯与联吡啶两种连接体，通过调节比例解耦光催化与电荷存储功能。联苯型光照活性最高，联吡啶型储电能力提升八倍，50-50混合型兼顾光照产氢与暗态还原，建立了暗光催化设计策略。
papers.research_details_zh: 暗光催化可将电子存储与光转换解耦，用以缓冲太阳能间歇性，但需精确调控光-物质相互作用。MOF可通过选择有机连接体和互联金属节点在分子层面定制这些相互作用。本研究在多变量COK-47系列中整合两种具有互补光相互作用角色的连接体，推进暗光催化设计原则。通过改变联苯二甲酸酯（biph）与联吡啶二甲酸酯（bipy）的比例，系统考察框架组成对光催化活性与光充电能力的影响。在365 nm连续照射下，COK-47 biph光催化活性最高，为COK-47 bipy的三倍；而COK-47 bipy的光充电容量提升八倍，多光谱方法证实Ti3+和还原态连接体物种作为存储单元。存储电荷可在暗态驱动甲基紫精还原和产氢。混合连接体材料COK-47 50-50兼具两者优势，光照下产氢接近最大值，同时保留可观储电能力，在该系列中甲基紫精还原活性最高、暗态产氢第二高。

COK-47 bipy的光充电容量提升八倍，多光谱方法证实Ti3+和还原态连接体物种为存储单元。
存储电荷可在暗态驱动甲基紫精还原和H2析出。

papers.title: Regulated Co‐Solvation in Gel Polymer Electrolyte Enables Rapid and Selective Li + Ion Transport for High‐Rate Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The development of gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) suitable for high‐rate lithium metal batteries (LMBs) is urgently needed but remains inherently challenging. This difficulty originates from the competition between the polymer network and the liquid electrolyte for lithium ion (Li + ) coordination. Polymer‐dominated coordination traps Li + and slows transport, while solvent‐dominated solvation permits uncontrolled anion migration and causes concentration polarization. Here, we resolve this challenge by establishing a matched polymer–electrolyte co‐solvation state, which enables rapid and selective Li + transport via a cooperative mechanism. We implement this concept through a dual‐regulated weak‐coordination gel polymer electrolyte (DWGPE), which comprises a fluorinated polymer backbone that attenuates Li + binding, an amide‐functionalized crosslinker that immobilizes anions via hydrogen bonding, and a weakly solvating adiponitrile‐based liquid phase. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal a cooperative transport mechanism that integrates polymer‐assisted hopping and solvent‐mediated vehicular diffusion, while suppressing anion mobility. Consequently, Li||DWGPE||LFP coin cells sustain 10 000 cycles at 6 C with 65% capacity retention, corresponding to an ultralow capacity decay of 0.003% per cycle. Our DWGPE also operates stably with high‐voltage NCM811 cathodes and in ampere‐hour‐level pouch cells. This work establishes polymer–electrolyte co‐solvation as a design framework for high‐performance GPEs toward fast‐charging LMBs.

papers.title: Tiny Pores, Big Stories: Perforating MXenes for Through-Sheet Transport in Energy and Environmental Applications
papers.abstract: Conspectus Transport remains a central bottleneck limiting the practical performance of MXene electrodes and membranes. Although MXenes possess metallic conductivity, hydrophilicity, and rich surface chemistry, their two-dimensional (2D) layered architecture imposes barriers to ion and molecular diffusion. During assembly into electrodes and membranes, colloidal MXene nanosheets readily restack and force transport mainly through thin interlayer galleries. The as-formed slit channels lengthen diffusion pathways leading to sluggish kinetics. These limitations become increasingly important in compact, high-loading MXene structures, where long and tortuous transport pathways can further reduce active-site utilization and rate capability. This Account argues that in-plane pore engineering transforms MXenes from predominantly lamellar-type materials into through-sheet transport platforms. Introducing nanopores into the MXene basal planes creates transverse pathways that directly connect neighboring interlayer galleries, thereby shortening diffusion distances and increasing edge-site and basal-plane accessibility. Holey MXenes therefore represent more than simply porous MXenes; they are transport-engineered 2D materials in which nanoscale perforation provides an additional direction for the movement of ions and molecules while retaining the intrinsic advantages of the MXene framework. This concept is particularly relevant to densely assembled electrodes and membranes, where in-plane pathways enable rapid mass transport. We summarize our efforts toward the synthesis and structural engineering of holey MXenes, including oxidative perforation of MXene hydrogels, microwave-assisted ultrafast etching, controlled H2O2-mediated perforation, and radical-intensified selective etching (RISE) for the direct conversion of MAX phases into holey MXenes. Across these approaches, we identify a common oxidation-driven pathway involving localized oxidation, pore nucleation, and pore propagation. Importantly, controlled oxidation can introduce nanoholes while largely preserving the conductive MXene framework, whereas excessive oxidation leads to pore enlargement, conductivity loss, and structural degradation. We further demonstrate how through-sheet transport translates into improved performance in supercapacitors, batteries, ion capacitors, capacitive deionization, membrane separation, and water purification. In electrochemical systems, nanoholes facilitate ion access to otherwise less accessible regions of the nanosheets while increasing the density of exposed edge sites. In membranes, they provide transverse pathways that can shorten molecular transport distances across compact layered structures. These examples establish in-plane perforation as a versatile approach for coupling enhanced transport with MXene-specific electronic and surface-chemical functionality. At the same time, practical implementation requires precise and reproducible control over pore size, density, geometry, and edge chemistry, together with improved chemical stability, shelf life, and scalable processing. In-plane perforation also exposes additional reactive sites that can accelerate oxidation, creating an inherent trade-off between transport enhancement and structural stability. Establishing quantitative structure–transport–property relationships will therefore be essential for rational optimization. Overall, we anticipate that through-sheet transport will serve as a useful design principle for layered 2D materials, analogous to how hierarchical porosity transformed porous carbons, and accelerate their transformative role in sustainable energy and environmental technologies.
