papers.title_zh: 微小孔道，宏大故事：为MXene打孔以实现能源与环境应用中的跨片层传输
papers.summary_zh: 该综述提出面内造孔可将MXene从层状材料转变为跨片层传输平台。通过氧化穿孔、微波刻蚀、H2O2调控及RISE等方法在基面引入纳米孔，缩短扩散路径并提升边缘位点可及性，从而改善超级电容器、电池、膜分离等性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究聚焦MXene电极与膜中传输瓶颈问题：二维层状结构在组装时易重堆叠，离子和分子主要沿狭窄层间通道扩散，路径长且曲折，导致动力学迟缓、活性位点利用率低，尤其在高负载致密结构中更为严重。作者提出面内孔工程策略，将MXene从以层间传输为主的材料转变为具有跨片层传输通道的平台。通过氧化穿孔MXene水凝胶、微波辅助超快刻蚀、受控H2O2介导穿孔以及自由基强化选择性刻蚀（RISE）等方法，实现从MAX相直接转化为多孔MXene。研究识别出局部氧化、孔成核和孔扩展的共性氧化驱动路径，并指出适度氧化可在保留导电框架的同时引入纳米孔，而过度氧化会导致孔扩大、导电性损失和结构退化。该工作将面内穿孔确立为耦合增强传输与MXene电子及表面化学功能的有效策略，并强调孔尺寸、密度、几何和边缘化学精确控制的重要性。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的合成与结构工程方法包括：MXene水凝胶的氧化穿孔、微波辅助超快刻蚀、受控H2O2介导穿孔以及自由基强化选择性刻蚀（RISE）用于从MAX相直接转化为多孔MXene。性能验证涉及超级电容器、电池、离子电容器、电容去离子、膜分离和水净化等应用。摘要未报告具体表征手段、孔径数值、电化学测试条件及定量性能数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与介孔材料、孔工程和组装传输主线高度相关，提出面内造孔作为二维框架材料传输工程的设计原则，对理解介孔导电框架中孔结构与传输性能关系有参考价值。其局限在于为概念性综述，摘要未给出具体定量结构—传输—性能关系。值得全文精读以获取各合成方法的细节、孔结构参数和性能对比。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体孔径、孔密度、比表面积、电导率数值、电化学测试条件、膜性能数据及结构表征细节，这些关键信息需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 面内纳米孔可在MXene基面创建横向通道，直接连接相邻层间通道，缩短扩散距离并增加边缘位点和基面可及性。
多种合成方法共享氧化驱动路径：局部氧化、孔成核和孔扩展；适度氧化保留导电框架，过度氧化导致孔扩大、导电性损失和结构退化。
跨片层传输在超级电容器、电池、离子电容器、电容去离子、膜分离和水净化中转化为性能提升。
实际应用需精确可重复控制孔尺寸、密度、几何和边缘化学，并改善化学稳定性、储存寿命和可放大加工；面内穿孔暴露的反应位点会加速氧化，存在传输增强与结构稳定性的内在权衡。

papers.title: Optically Addressable Spins in a Metal–Organic Framework
papers.abstract: Abstract Molecular spins supporting optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) offer unique opportunities for quantum sensing and many-body physics by combining the sensitivity and spatial resolution offered by optical spin detection with the capacity for bottom-up assembly and chemical control. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are a promising architecture to leverage such opportunities since they offer control over spin placement, tunable porosity and large internal surface areas for efficient integration with sensing targets, and a richly tunable chemical space. However, optical spin readout has not been demonstrated in a MOF. Here, we report the first successful optical detection of spins in a MOF. We use a porphyrin-based aluminum MOF (Al-PMOF), which supports efficient triplet generation on the porphyrin chromophore ligands. Using electron paramagnetic resonance, we demonstrate that these triplet states support a spin coherence time (T2) on the order of a few microseconds at 50 K. Importantly, we successfully detect optically detected magnetic resonance of these triplets using near-infrared ODMR at 77 K. Optical spin readout in a MOF paves the way for next-generation quantum sensing applications that leverage bottom-up assembly.

papers.title_zh: 金属—有机框架中的光学可寻址自旋
papers.summary_zh: 该工作首次在MOF中实现光学自旋读出。利用卟啉基铝MOF（Al-PMOF）中卟啉配体的高效三重态生成，在50 K下测得T2约数微秒，并在77 K下通过近红外ODMR成功检测三重态，为基于自下而上组装的量子传感开辟道路。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究针对分子自旋量子传感中光学自旋读出尚未在MOF中实现的空白。MOF具有控制自旋位置、可调孔隙率和大内表面积等优势，利于与传感目标集成，但此前未展示光学自旋读出。作者选用卟啉基铝MOF（Al-PMOF），其卟啉发色团配体可高效产生三重态。通过电子顺磁共振证明这些三重态在50 K下具有数微秒量级的自旋相干时间T2。更重要的是，利用近红外ODMR在77 K下成功检测到这些三重态的光学检测磁共振信号。该工作首次在MOF中实现光学自旋读出，为利用自下而上组装的新一代量子传感应用奠定基础。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确使用的方法包括：电子顺磁共振（EPR）用于表征三重态自旋相干时间；近红外光学检测磁共振（ODMR）在77 K下检测三重态。材料为卟啉基铝MOF（Al-PMOF），利用卟啉发色团配体的高效三重态生成。摘要未报告合成方法、具体T2数值、ODMR频率及量子传感性能测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料与自旋量子传感交叉方向，虽非介孔导电MOF或共轭框架主线，但展示了MOF在光学可寻址自旋和量子传感中的潜力，对框架材料功能化组装有启发意义。其局限在于摘要未提供自旋相干机制细节和传感应用验证。若关注MOF量子功能化，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告Al-PMOF的具体合成条件、晶体结构表征、T2精确数值、ODMR谱图细节及量子传感性能数据，这些关键信息需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 首次在MOF中成功实现光学自旋检测，材料为卟啉基铝MOF（Al-PMOF）。
EPR表明三重态在50 K下支持数微秒量级的自旋相干时间T2。
在77 K下通过近红外ODMR成功检测到三重态的光学检测磁共振。

papers.title: Highly Sensitive Broadband Photodetectors Based on Donor–Acceptor 2D Conjugated Coordination Polymers
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Two‐dimensional (2D) semiconductors are highly desirable for broadband photodetection but are often constrained by their limited optical absorption and inefficient exciton dissociation. In this study, we report a donor–acceptor‐engineered 2D conjugated coordination polymer (c‐CP), Ni‐TABQ (TABQ = tetraaminobenzoquinone), as a narrow‐bandgap semiconductor. The TABQ ligands integrate electron‐rich amino donors and electron‐deficient quinone carbonyl acceptors within the same molecular backbone, endowing the Ni‐TABQ lattice with strong intramolecular charge‐transfer absorption and a built‐in driving force for charge separation. Benefiting from strong broadband absorption and high charge‐carrier mobility, the vapor‐phase‐grown Ni‐TABQ thin films enable photodetection from 350 to 1400 nm under a 3 V bias, with a measurable response tail above 1150 nm, further achieving a responsivity of up to 3.1 A W −1 , a specific detectivity of up to 6.58 × 10 10 Jones (625 nm at ∼85 µW cm −2 ), and a response time of ∼206 µs, while maintaining stable operation at 3 V over 8500 s of continuous cycling. These metrics compare favorably with state‐of‐the‐art broadband photodetectors based on standalone 2D materials, establishing donor–acceptor molecular engineering within the 2D metal‐organic lattice as an effective strategy for advancing high‐performance 2D optoelectronic devices.

papers.title_zh: 基于供体—受体二维共轭配位聚合物的高灵敏宽带光电探测器
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道供体—受体工程化二维共轭配位聚合物Ni-TABQ作为窄带隙半导体。TABQ配体整合氨基供体与醌羰基受体，赋予晶格强分子内电荷转移吸收和电荷分离驱动力。气相生长薄膜实现350至1400 nm光电探测，响应度达3.1 A W−1。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究针对二维半导体在宽带光电探测中光吸收有限和激子解离效率低的问题。作者设计供体—受体工程化的二维共轭配位聚合物Ni-TABQ（TABQ为四氨基苯醌），作为窄带隙半导体。TABQ配体在同一分子骨架中整合富电子氨基供体和缺电子醌羰基受体，赋予Ni-TABQ晶格强分子内电荷转移吸收和电荷分离的内建驱动力。得益于强宽带吸收和高载流子迁移率，气相生长的Ni-TABQ薄膜在3 V偏压下实现350至1400 nm光电探测，在1150 nm以上仍有可测响应尾部。器件实现高达3.1 A W−1的响应度、高达6.58×10^10 Jones的比探测率（625 nm，约85 µW cm−2）和约206 µs的响应时间，并在3 V下连续循环8500 s保持稳定运行。这些指标优于基于独立二维材料的最先进宽带光电探测器，确立供体—受体分子工程在二维金属—有机晶格中作为推进高性能二维光电器件的有效策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确使用气相生长法制备Ni-TABQ薄膜，并构建光电探测器进行性能测试。测试条件包括3 V偏压、350至1400 nm光谱范围、625 nm和约85 µW cm−2光照条件，以及8500 s连续循环稳定性测试。摘要未报告具体合成温度、前驱体、表征手段及载流子迁移率数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于共轭配位聚合物/框架材料与光电器件交叉方向，展示了供体—受体分子工程在二维金属—有机晶格中调控带隙、吸收和电荷分离的有效性，对共轭框架材料的电学和光电功能设计有参考价值。其局限在于摘要未提供载流子迁移率、激子解离机制和器件结构细节。若关注共轭配位聚合物光电应用，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告Ni-TABQ的具体合成条件、晶体结构、载流子迁移率数值、器件结构及激子解离机制等关键细节，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: Ni-TABQ薄膜在3 V偏压下实现350至1400 nm宽带光电探测，1150 nm以上仍有可测响应尾部。
器件响应度高达3.1 A W−1，比探测率高达6.58×10^10 Jones（625 nm，约85 µW cm−2），响应时间约206 µs。
器件在3 V下连续循环8500 s保持稳定运行。
供体—受体分子工程在二维金属—有机晶格中被确立为推进高性能二维光电器件的有效策略。

papers.title: Guanosine‐Quadruplex Hydrogels as Dynamic, Mechanically Tunable and Ion Conductive 3D Scaffolds for Cell Culture Applications
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hydrogels are widely used materials for biomedical applications. In particular, supramolecular hydrogels based on guanosine‐quadruplexes (GQ) have been utilized for drug delivery, biocatalysis, and biosensing. However, when applied as scaffolds for cell culture, existing GQ hydrogels suffer from important limitations: (i) scarcity of mild fabrication strategies, (ii) quick disintegration within few hours under physiological conditions, (iii) narrow tunability of their properties in relation to native tissues. These shortcomings hamper the broad use of GQ hydrogels in biomedicine. Herein, stable and versatile GQ hydrogels are developed as dynamic biomatrices for cell culture applications. The GQ matrices are easily fabricated under mild aqueous conditions, present improved stability and tunable mechanical properties within physiological ranges; fibrillar, porous microstructure, ion conductivity and cytocompatibility. Detailed characterization of GQ self‐assembly process driving hydrogelation is presented through various techniques. These matrices support the culture of diverse cell types in 2D and 3D, and showcase injectability and printability, making these scaffolds suitable for manufacturing soft medical devices. The results of this study expand the applicability potential of GQ hydrogels for advancing cell culture and in vitro tissue model technologies.

papers.title_zh: 鸟苷四链体水凝胶作为动态、力学可调且离子导电的三维支架用于细胞培养应用
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有鸟苷四链体水凝胶在细胞培养中制备条件苛刻、生理条件下数小时内快速崩解及性能可调性窄的局限，开发了温和水相制备的稳定多功能GQ水凝胶，具备改善的稳定性、生理范围内可调力学性能、纤维状多孔微结构、离子导电性和细胞相容性，支持多种细胞二维和三维培养，并展示可注射性和可打印性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于现有基于鸟苷四链体的超分子水凝胶作为细胞培养支架时面临的三大限制：缺乏温和制备策略、在生理条件下数小时内快速崩解、以及相对于天然组织的性能可调范围狭窄。研究体系为鸟苷四链体水凝胶基质。设计策略是在温和水相条件下制备稳定的多功能GQ水凝胶，作为细胞培养的动态生物基质。研究过程包括通过多种技术对驱动水凝胶化的GQ自组装过程进行详细表征，并评估所得基质的稳定性、力学性能、微结构、离子导电性和细胞相容性，随后测试其对多种细胞类型的二维和三维培养支持能力，以及可注射性和可打印性。其意义在于扩展了GQ水凝胶在推进细胞培养和体外组织模型技术方面的应用潜力，并使其适用于制造软医疗器械。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：在温和水相条件下制备GQ水凝胶；通过多种技术对GQ自组装过程驱动水凝胶化进行详细表征；评估水凝胶的稳定性、力学性能、纤维状多孔微结构、离子导电性和细胞相容性；进行多种细胞类型的二维和三维培养测试；展示可注射性和可打印性。摘要未报告具体表征技术名称、力学测试方法、电导率测试方法或打印参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究对超分子自组装水凝胶及框架材料组装主线具有拓展价值，尤其在温和组装、动态可调力学性能和离子导电性方面与自组装技术主题相关。其局限在于并非介孔导电MOF、共轭MOF/COF/HOF或电化学合成框架材料，而是鸟苷四链体超分子水凝胶。若关注生物医学支架、可注射/可打印软材料及离子导电水凝胶，值得全文精读；若仅关注MOF/COF/HOF电化学合成，则相关性有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体的稳定性时长、力学性能数值、离子电导率数值、细胞类型、表征技术细节、打印参数及自组装机制细节，这些关键信息仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: GQ水凝胶可在温和水相条件下轻松制备，具有改善的稳定性，并在生理范围内呈现可调的力学性能。
GQ基质具有纤维状、多孔微结构、离子导电性和细胞相容性。
这些基质支持多种细胞类型的二维和三维培养，并展示出可注射性和可打印性，适用于制造软医疗器械。
摘要未报告具体的稳定性时长、力学数值、电导率数值或细胞类型名称。

papers.title: Bridge‐Atom Connected Tiny‐Nanosheet Driven Delocalized Electron Transfer on Graphene for 2‐Electron Oxygen Reduction Reaction
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Metal‐free graphene‐based materials are promising alternatives to precious‐metal catalysts in the 2‐electron oxygen reduction reaction (2e − ORR). While previous research has highlighted the critical role of charge density at active sites, the precise controlling the charge transfer via structural engineering on metal‐free graphene remains elusive. In this work, we construct a semi‐continuous tiny graphene (SCTG) architecture by a novel isothermal molten‐self‐assembly strategy, which is composed of nanosized graphene sheets interconnected by a sparse number of bridge atoms. This unique arrangement offers dual advantages: the high density of edge atoms in the small graphene domains facilitates the generation and retention of delocalized electrons, while the minimal bridge atoms reduce electron dissipation pathways, ensuring efficient charge delivery to reactive sites. Notably, this configuration balances electron confinement and mobility—preserving necessary charge routes without enabling excessive leakage. As a result, the SCTG structure elevates the local charge density at catalytic sites to an optimal level, enhancing both oxygen adsorption and electron transfer kinetics. This culminates in a remarkable ORR selectivity of 100% and a production rate of 13.3 mol g −1 h −1 for H 2 O 2 . These findings offer valuable insight into how graphene‐based structures can be fine‐tuned for precise electron control in electrocatalysis.

papers.title_zh: 桥原子连接微小纳米片驱动石墨烯上离域电子转移用于二电子氧还原反应
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过新型等温熔融自组装策略构建了由纳米级石墨烯片通过稀疏桥原子互连的半连续微小石墨烯结构，利用小石墨烯域高密度边缘原子促进离域电子产生与保留，同时最少桥原子减少电子耗散路径，实现局部电荷密度优化，从而获得100%的ORR选择性和13.3 mol g−1 h−1的H2O2产率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于无金属石墨烯基材料在二电子氧还原反应中虽具潜力，但通过结构工程精确控制电荷转移仍具挑战，此前研究强调活性位点电荷密度的关键作用。研究体系为半连续微小石墨烯架构，由纳米级石墨烯片通过稀疏数量的桥原子互连构成。设计策略采用新型等温熔融自组装策略构建该结构，其双重优势在于：小石墨烯域中高密度边缘原子促进离域电子的产生和保留，而最少的桥原子减少电子耗散路径，确保电荷高效传递至反应位点。该构型平衡了电子限域与迁移性，保持必要电荷路径而不导致过度泄漏。研究过程包括构建SCTG结构并评估其ORR性能。其意义在于为石墨烯基结构在电催化中精确电子控制提供见解。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：采用新型等温熔融自组装策略构建半连续微小石墨烯架构；评估其二电子氧还原反应性能，包括ORR选择性和H2O2产率测定。摘要未报告具体前驱体、温度、表征技术、电化学测试条件或理论计算方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究对自组装技术及框架材料组装主线具有拓展价值，其等温熔融自组装策略和桥原子连接纳米片结构可为介孔材料及框架材料组装提供思路。局限在于研究对象为无金属石墨烯基材料，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭MOF/COF/HOF或其他框架材料，也不涉及电化学合成框架材料。若关注自组装驱动纳米结构用于电催化及电子转移调控，值得全文精读；若仅关注MOF/COF/HOF，则相关性有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体前驱体、合成温度、桥原子种类、表征技术、电化学测试条件及理论计算细节，这些关键信息仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: SCTG结构将催化位点局部电荷密度提升至最佳水平，增强氧吸附和电子转移动力学。
该结构实现100%的ORR选择性。
H2O2产率达到13.3 mol g−1 h−1。
该构型平衡电子限域与迁移性，保持必要电荷路径而不导致过度泄漏。

papers.title: A Hydrogen-Bonded Metal–Organic Framework for CO2 Capture and Natural Gas Upgrading
papers.abstract: Abstract Efficient separation of CO2/N2 (flue gas), CO2/CH4 (natural gas), and light hydrocarbons is important in industry but remains a critical challenge. The development of versatile adsorbents capable of addressing multiple industrially relevant gas separations is therefore highly desirable. Herein, we report the synthesis of a three-dimensional (3D) hydrogen-bonded organic framework (HOF), designated ZNU-69, constructed through the interlayer hydrogen-bonding self-assembly of two-dimensional (2D) metal–organic framework (MOF) layers. Single-component adsorption isotherms reveal that ZNU-69 exhibits preferential uptake of CO2, C2H6, and C3H8 over CH4 and N2. IAST selectivity calculations at 298 K and 1 bar yield values as high as 473 for CO2/N2 (15/85), 127 for CO2/CH4 (50/50), 596 for C3H8/CH4 (50/50), and 54 for C2H6/CH4 (50/50). Theoretical calculations elucidate the microscopic adsorption mechanism, revealing that the strong binding energies, along with multiple hydrogen-bonding and van der Waals interactions with the framework, are responsible for the observed affinity and selectivity. Dynamic breakthrough experiments and cyclic tests further confirm its excellent separation performance and robust regeneration stability. This work provides a strategy for designing multifunctional MOF/HOF hybrid adsorbents that synergistically combine high selectivity with broad applicability.

papers.title_zh: 一种用于CO2捕获和天然气升级的氢键金属有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道了通过二维MOF层间氢键自组装构建的三维氢键有机框架ZNU-69，其对CO2、C2H6和C3H8优先吸附，IAST选择性高达CO2/N2为473、CO2/CH4为127、C3H8/CH4为596、C2H6/CH4为54，动态穿透实验和循环测试证实优异分离性能与再生稳定性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于工业上CO2/N2、CO2/CH4及轻烃高效分离的重要性与挑战，亟需开发能应对多种工业相关气体分离的多功能吸附剂。研究体系为三维氢键有机框架ZNU-69，通过二维金属有机框架层间的氢键自组装构建。设计策略是构建MOF/HOF杂化吸附剂，协同结合高选择性与广泛适用性。研究过程包括合成ZNU-69，测定单组分吸附等温线，发现其对CO2、C2H6和C3H8相对于CH4和N2具有优先吸附；在298 K和1 bar下进行IAST选择性计算；通过理论计算阐明微观吸附机制，揭示强结合能及与框架的多重氢键和范德华相互作用是观察到的亲和力和选择性的原因；动态穿透实验和循环测试进一步证实优异分离性能和稳健再生稳定性。其意义在于为设计多功能MOF/HOF杂化吸附剂提供策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：通过二维MOF层间氢键自组装合成三维HOF ZNU-69；测定单组分吸附等温线；在298 K和1 bar下进行IAST选择性计算；开展理论计算以阐明微观吸附机制；进行动态穿透实验和循环测试以评估分离性能与再生稳定性。摘要未报告具体合成条件、活化方法、表征技术及理论计算细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究对框架材料主线具有核心推荐价值，直接涉及HOF与MOF的杂化组装，属于氢键有机框架和金属有机框架交叉领域，与框架材料组装主题高度相关。其局限在于摘要未报告导电性、介孔性或电化学合成相关信息，因此对介孔导电MOF及电化学合成方向的相关性有限。若关注MOF/HOF杂化吸附剂设计、气体分离及氢键自组装策略，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体合成条件、活化方法、表征技术、理论计算细节、穿透实验条件及循环测试次数，这些关键信息仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: ZNU-69对CO2、C2H6和C3H8相对于CH4和N2表现出优先吸附。
理论计算表明强结合能及与框架的多重氢键和范德华相互作用是观察到的亲和力和选择性的原因。
动态穿透实验和循环测试证实其优异的分离性能和稳健的再生稳定性。

papers.title: Nanocavity Confining Platinum Nanoclusters Enhances Photocatalytic Two‐Electron Oxygen Reduction for Wound Healing
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Photocatalytic two‐electron oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) toward H 2 O 2 synthesis is a compelling approach for clinical antibacterial applications. Yet its selectivity is hampered by the competing four‐electron ORR, which compromises both H 2 O 2 generation kinetics and antibacterial efficiency. Herein, we report a new nanoscale confinement strategy for the controllable synthesis of covalent organic frameworks (COFs) confining isolated platinum nanoclusters (NCs) to enhance Pauling‐type of O 2 adsorption to achieve two‐electron oxygen reduction for efficient antibacterial therapy. The resulting Tfp‐Db COFs@Pt NCs exhibits a significantly higher H 2 O 2 formation kinetics (3.12 × 10− 3 mol L −1 h −1 ) than Tfp‐Db COFs@Pt nanoparticles (1.55 × 10 −3 mol L −1 h −1 ), with 2e − ORR selectivity increased from 45.0% to 86.0%. Experimental and theoretical results reveal a two‐step single electron oxygen reduction pathway for H 2 O 2 photosynthesis over Tfp‐Db COFs@Pt NCs. The Tfp‐Db COFs@Pt NCs exhibits excellent sterilization efficiencies of 5.0 log 10 CFU mL −1 and 5.2 log 10 CFU mL −1 against S. aureus and E. coli , respectively, exceeding most reported materials. Furthermore, Tfp‐Db COFs@Pt NCs facilitate the regeneration of infectious wounds, with the efficiency of nearly 100% on day 10, outperforming previously reported bionanomaterials. Collectively, this work presents a new strategy for regulating the Pauling‐type of O 2 adsorption to enhance the photocatalytic H 2 O 2 formation for wound healing application.

papers.title_zh: 纳米空腔限域铂纳米簇增强光催化双电子氧还原用于伤口愈合
papers.summary_zh: 该工作采用纳米限域策略合成共价有机框架限域孤立铂纳米簇，通过增强Pauling型氧气吸附提升双电子氧还原选择性，实现高效光催化过氧化氢合成与抗菌伤口愈合。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对光催化双电子氧还原合成过氧化氢在临床抗菌应用中受竞争性四电子氧还原制约、选择性与动力学不足的问题，作者提出一种纳米尺度限域策略，可控合成共价有机框架限域孤立铂纳米簇。所构建的Tfp-Db COFs@Pt NCs通过增强Pauling型氧气吸附，促进双电子氧还原路径。实验与理论结果揭示了该体系经由两步单电子氧还原途径光合成过氧化氢。该材料展现出显著优于铂纳米颗粒对照的过氧化氢生成动力学与选择性，并对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌具有高效杀菌能力，同时促进感染伤口再生。该研究为调控氧气吸附构型以增强光催化过氧化氢合成并应用于伤口愈合提供了新策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：纳米尺度限域策略可控合成共价有机框架限域孤立铂纳米簇；以Tfp-Db COFs@Pt纳米颗粒作为对照；测定过氧化氢生成动力学与双电子氧还原选择性；结合实验与理论结果解析反应路径；开展针对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌的杀菌测试以及感染伤口再生评估。具体合成条件、表征手段与理论计算方法摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于共价有机框架与金属纳米簇复合的框架材料组装方向，展示了限域策略调控氧气吸附构型与氧还原选择性的设计思路，对介孔导电MOF、共轭COF及框架材料电化学合成主线具有方法学参考价值。其局限在于摘要未报告框架孔结构、导电性及限域尺度等关键参数，若关注COF限域催化与双电子氧还原机制，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目与摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告COF合成条件、孔结构表征、铂纳米簇尺寸与负载量、导电性数据、理论计算细节、活性位点结构证据、稳定性与生物安全性等关键细节，均需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: Tfp-Db COFs@Pt NCs的过氧化氢生成动力学为3.12×10^-3 mol L^-1 h^-1，显著高于Tfp-Db COFs@Pt纳米颗粒的1.55×10^-3 mol L^-1 h^-1。
双电子氧还原选择性由45.0%提升至86.0%。
实验与理论结果揭示Tfp-Db COFs@Pt NCs光合成过氧化氢经由两步单电子氧还原途径。
对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌的杀菌效率分别达5.0 log10 CFU mL^-1和5.2 log10 CFU mL^-1，第10天感染伤口再生效率接近100%。

papers.title: Construction of HPW/HP-UiO-66-NH2 Membranes with Tunable Mesopores for Oxidative Desulfurization Applications
papers.abstract: Abstract Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) have promising applications owing to their exceptional tunability and ultrahigh porosity. However, the intrinsic microporosity and powdery form cause large mass transfer resistance, pipeline clogging, and poor recyclability, which greatly restrict their engineering applications. In this work, a hierarchical porous UiO-66-NH2-anchored phosphotungstic acid catalytic membrane (denoted as m-HPW/HP-UNX, where X represents the volume of added water) was successfully fabricated via a cast-coating method using a casting solution blended with HPW/HP-UNX and poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF) solutions. Among them, hierarchical porous HP-UNX was synthesized through template-free competitive nucleation in H2O/acetic acid systems. This solvent-regulated strategy yields HP-UNX nanoparticles smaller than 20 nm, which possess a tunable mesoporous structure and –NH2 sites, making them ideal supports for anchoring bulky phosphotungstic acid (HPW). The resultant m-HPW/HP-UNX catalytic membrane retains the mesoporous structure of HP-UNX and resolves the separation difficulty of the powdery MOFs. Notably, m-HPW/HP-UN9 achieves a desulfurization efficiency of 92%, far exceeding the microporous samples UiO-66-NH2 and m-HPW/UiO-66-NH2. Moreover, the oxidative desulfurization efficiency of the membrane remains approximately 90% after cycles, demonstrating a favorable cycling stability. The strategy of introducing hierarchical pore structures into molding materials provides a feasible pathway for industrial applications of desulfurization catalysts.

papers.title_zh: 具有可调介孔的HPW/HP-UiO-66-NH2膜的构建及其氧化脱硫应用
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过无模板竞争成核策略合成具有可调介孔结构的HP-UiO-66-NH2纳米颗粒，并采用流延涂覆法制备HPW/HP-UNX催化膜，解决了粉体MOF传质阻力大、分离困难的问题，脱硫效率达92%且循环稳定性良好。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对MOF固有微孔性和粉体形态导致的传质阻力大、管道堵塞及回收性差等工程应用限制，设计了一种分级多孔UiO-66-NH2锚定磷钨酸催化膜。采用无模板竞争成核法在H2O/乙酸体系中合成HP-UNX纳米颗粒，通过溶剂调控策略获得尺寸小于20 nm、具有可调介孔结构和–NH2位点的HP-UNX，作为大尺寸磷钨酸的理想载体。将HPW/HP-UNX与聚偏氟乙烯溶液共混，通过流延涂覆法制备m-HPW/HP-UNX催化膜。所得膜保留了HP-UNX的介孔结构，并解决了粉体MOF的分离难题。该策略为将分级孔结构引入成型材料提供了可行路径，推动脱硫催化剂的工业应用。

papers.title: Cation-Dependent Salt Templating of Phenolic Resin-Derived Hierarchical Porous Carbon for High-Performance Supercapacitors
papers.abstract: Abstract High-surface-area porous carbon electrodes that feature a well-balanced pore distribution and facilitate rapid ion transport are crucial for enhancing electric double-layer capacitors. Conventional phenolic resin-derived carbons are usually dominated by micropores and show limited pore connectivity, which restricts electrolyte infiltration and rate performance. Herein, we report a cation-dependent salt-templating strategy by introducing equimolar ZnCl2, MgCl2, and MnCl2 into a resorcinol–hexamethylenetetramine hydrothermal system. The three divalent cations direct markedly different carbon-framework evolution. Zn2+ mainly promotes micropore formation and smaller carbon spheres, Mg2+ favors particle fusion and larger pores, whereas Mn2+ converts discrete microsphere assemblies into a continuous three-dimensional hierarchical porous network. Among the resulting samples, PC-Mn exhibits a specific surface area of 1459 m2 g–1, a total pore volume of 1.12 cm3 g–1, and a micropore surface area measuring 1105 m2 g–1, along with well-developed mesoporous channels ranging from 2 to 4 nm. When tested in 6 M KOH, PC-Mn reaches a capacitance of 270.15 F g–1 and maintains 182.49 F g–1 at a current density of 20 A g–1, achieving a capacitance retention of 95.6% following 10,000 cycles. Furthermore, the PC-Mn symmetric supercapacitor exhibits a specific capacitance of 252.04 F g–1 and an energy density of 21.24 Wh kg–1 at a power density of 20,123 W kg–1. These results demonstrate that regulating the divalent cation species in salt-templated phenolic resin systems provides an effective approach for tailoring hierarchical pore structures and improving the electrochemical performance of porous carbon electrodes.

papers.title_zh: 阳离子依赖的盐模板法调控酚醛树脂衍生分级多孔碳用于高性能超级电容器
papers.summary_zh: 该工作报道了阳离子依赖的盐模板策略，通过在间苯二酚-六亚甲基四胺水热体系中引入等摩尔ZnCl2、MgCl2和MnCl2，调控碳骨架演化，其中Mn2+形成连续三维分级多孔网络，PC-Mn比表面积达1459 m2 g–1，电容性能优异。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对传统酚醛树脂衍生碳以微孔为主、孔连通性有限、限制电解质浸润和倍率性能的问题，提出阳离子依赖的盐模板策略。在间苯二酚-六亚甲基四胺水热体系中分别引入等摩尔ZnCl2、MgCl2和MnCl2，三种二价阳离子引导显著不同的碳骨架演化：Zn2+主要促进微孔形成和更小碳球，Mg2+有利于颗粒融合和更大孔道，Mn2+则将离散微球组装体转化为连续三维分级多孔网络。所得PC-Mn具有1459 m2 g–1比表面积、1.12 cm3 g–1总孔容、1105 m2 g–1微孔表面积及2至4 nm介孔通道。在6 M KOH中，PC-Mn电容达270.15 F g–1，20 A g–1下保持182.49 F g–1，10,000次循环后电容保持率95.6%。对称超级电容器比电容252.04 F g–1，功率密度20,123 W kg–1时能量密度21.24 Wh kg–1。该结果表明调控二价阳离子种类可有效裁剪分级孔结构并提升多孔碳电极电化学性能。
papers.methods_zh: 在间苯二酚-六亚甲基四胺水热体系中引入等摩尔ZnCl2、MgCl2或MnCl2进行盐模板辅助水热合成；所得样品命名为PC-Mn等；在6 M KOH电解液中进行电化学测试，包括比电容、倍率性能和10,000次循环稳定性测试；组装对称超级电容器并测试比电容、能量密度和功率密度。摘要未报告具体水热温度、时间、碳化条件及表征手段。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作涉及介孔材料、模板组装及多孔碳电极，对介孔材料合成和孔结构调控有参考价值，但其材料体系为酚醛树脂衍生碳而非框架材料，与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料主线关联较弱。阳离子依赖盐模板策略可为分级孔结构设计提供借鉴，但摘要未涉及电化学合成或框架材料组装，建议作为拓展阅读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征手段、数值或机制。摘要未报告水热温度、时间、碳化条件、具体表征方法及电解液测试细节，需查阅全文核实。

PC-Mn在6 M KOH中电容达270.15 F g–1，20 A g–1下保持182.49 F g–1，10,000次循环后电容保持率95.6%

papers.title: Nanoparticle Packing-Dependent Charge Transfer Dynamics in Colloidal Binary Superparticles
papers.abstract: Abstract A key trend in nanoparticle self-assembly as “artificial atoms” is learning from molecular systems, yet progress lags behind molecular systems because current research primarily focuses on geometric structural mimicry while ignoring the electronic communication across arrangements intrinsic to molecules. Here, inspired by the characteristic topologies of molecular compounds, we introduce “packing-structure engineering” via a ligand solubility-matched microemulsion-confined co-assembly strategy to fabricate three typical mesoscopic packing-topology structural systems from Au nanoparticles and CdSe/CdS nanorods: metal-isolated-by-semiconductor-type, metal-interlaced-with-semiconductor-type, and semiconductor-isolated-by-metal-type. We demonstrate that packing topology acts as a fundamental independent order parameter─analogous to molecular connectivity topologies─fundamentally regulating intrinsic electron dynamics. Specifically, the metal-isolated-by-semiconductor configuration enables a transition from picosecond incoherent hot-electron transfer to instantaneous coherent plasmon-induced interfacial charge-transfer transition, comparable to contacting heterostructures. This behavior may arise from unique collective coupling modes and interparticle field enhancements. This offers a pathway for minimizing thermalization losses in the plasmonic donor. Extendable to diverse systems, it can unlock emergent optoelectronic properties and high-performance materials for applications in solar cells, photodetectors, photocatalysis, and sensing.

papers.title_zh: 胶体二元超颗粒中纳米颗粒堆积依赖的电荷转移动力学
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过配体溶解度匹配的微乳液限域共组装策略，构建了Au纳米颗粒与CdSe/CdS纳米棒组成的三种介观堆积拓扑超颗粒，发现堆积拓扑作为独立序参量调控本征电子动力学，其中金属被半导体隔离构型可实现从皮秒非相干热电子转移向瞬时相干等离激元诱导界面电荷转移跃迁的转变。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究受分子化合物特征拓扑启发，针对纳米颗粒自组装作为人工原子主要关注几何结构模拟而忽视排列间电子通信的问题，提出堆积结构工程。通过配体溶解度匹配的微乳液限域共组装策略，从Au纳米颗粒和CdSe/CdS纳米棒制备三种典型介观堆积拓扑结构体系：金属被半导体隔离型、金属与半导体交织型、半导体被金属隔离型。研究证明堆积拓扑作为类似分子连接拓扑的基本独立序参量，从根本上调控本征电子动力学。具体而言，金属被半导体隔离构型可实现从皮秒非相干热电子转移向瞬时相干等离激元诱导界面电荷转移跃迁的转变，与接触异质结构相当。该行为可能源于独特的集体耦合模式和颗粒间场增强，为最小化等离激元给体的热化损失提供了路径，可拓展至太阳能电池、光电探测器、光催化和传感等领域。
papers.methods_zh: 采用配体溶解度匹配的微乳液限域共组装策略，将Au纳米颗粒与CdSe/CdS纳米棒共组装为三种介观堆积拓扑超颗粒；通过对比三种堆积构型研究电荷转移动力学。摘要未报告具体配体种类、微乳液组成、组装条件、光谱表征手段及动力学测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作涉及纳米颗粒自组装、共组装策略及组装结构对电子动力学的调控，对自组装技术和框架材料组装方向有方法学借鉴意义，尤其是堆积拓扑作为序参量的概念可启发框架材料组装结构设计。但其材料体系为胶体纳米颗粒超颗粒，非MOF/COF/HOF框架材料，与介孔导电MOF主线关联较弱，建议作为自组装方法学拓展阅读。

papers.title: Ultrafast Aqueous Photoinduced Electron/Energy Transfer Reversible Addition–Fragmentation Chain Transfer Polymerization-Induced Self-Assembly: Wavelength-Dependent Morphologies and Scalable Nanoparticle Preparation
papers.abstract: Abstract Photoinduced electron/energy transfer–reversible addition–fragmentation chain transfer (PET-RAFT) polymerization offers a powerful route to oxygen-tolerant polymer synthesis under visible light, yet slow polymerization rates remain a persistent bottleneck for further development. Here, we report an aryloxy xanthate chain transfer agent (CTA) bearing a 2-naphthyloxy Z group that unlocks ultrafast aqueous PET-RAFT polymerization under orange light irradiation. The system achieves an apparent propagation rate constant (kpapp) of 0.89 min–1, reaching high monomer conversion (&gt;80%) within 2 min while maintaining good control over polymerization (Đ ≤ 1.2). Density functional theory (DFT) calculations indicate that the enhanced polymerization rate originates from the low fragmentation energy barrier of the CTA anionic radical. Leveraging this performance, we applied the system to photoinduced polymerization-induced self-assembly (photo-PISA), achieving ultrafast formation of well-defined polymeric nanoparticles within 1 min without prior deoxygenation and with tunable morphologies accessible by varying formulation conditions. Strikingly, photo-PISA exhibited a pronounced wavelength dependence: long-wavelength irradiation produced well-defined vesicles, whereas short-wavelength irradiation yielded irregular aggregates. This behavior is attributed to superior light penetration and spatial uniformity at longer wavelengths, establishing wavelength-tunable light-field uniformity as a handle for the accessible PISA morphology. These findings establish the 2-naphthyloxy xanthate CTA as a versatile platform for scalable and high-throughput photo-PISA, opening new avenues for the rapid and oxygen-tolerant fabrication of functional polymeric nanomaterials.

papers.title_zh: 超快水相光诱导电子/能量转移可逆加成-断裂链转移聚合诱导自组装：波长依赖性形貌与可规模化纳米颗粒制备
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道含2-萘氧基Z基团的芳氧基黄原酸酯CTA，实现橙光下超快水相PET-RAFT聚合，2分钟内转化率超80%且控制良好，并用于1分钟内无脱氧快速photo-PISA，获得波长依赖的囊泡或 irregular聚集体形貌。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对光诱导电子/能量转移-可逆加成-断裂链转移（PET-RAFT）聚合虽耐氧但聚合速率慢的瓶颈，设计了一种带有2-萘氧基Z基团的芳氧基黄原酸酯链转移剂（CTA），用于橙光照射下的超快水相PET-RAFT聚合。该体系表观增长速率常数kpapp达0.89 min–1，2分钟内单体转化率超过80%，同时保持较好聚合控制（Đ ≤ 1.2）。密度泛函理论计算表明，聚合速率提升源于CTA阴离子自由基较低的断裂能垒。作者进一步将该体系用于光诱导聚合诱导自组装（photo-PISA），在无需预先脱氧条件下1分钟内形成结构明确的聚合物纳米颗粒，并通过改变配方条件调控形貌。值得注意的是，photo-PISA表现出显著波长依赖性：长波长照射得到结构明确的囊泡，短波长照射则产生不规则聚集体，归因于长波长下更优的光穿透和空间均匀性。该工作将2-萘氧基黄原酸酯CTA确立为可规模化、高通量photo-PISA的通用平台，为快速耐氧制备功能聚合物纳米材料提供新途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：合成含2-萘氧基Z基团的芳氧基黄原酸酯链转移剂；在橙光照射下进行水相PET-RAFT聚合；测定表观增长速率常数kpapp、单体转化率和分散度Đ；采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算CTA阴离子自由基的断裂能垒；将该体系用于photo-PISA制备聚合物纳米颗粒；通过改变配方条件调控形貌；比较不同波长照射下的PISA形貌。摘要未报告具体表征仪器、粒径统计方法和其它测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装技术及框架材料之外的高分子纳米材料组装方向，对研究主线中的自组装方法学有拓展价值：其超快、耐氧、波长调控形貌的策略可为介孔材料或框架材料的前驱体组装与形貌控制提供借鉴。但该研究体系为聚合物纳米颗粒，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭COF/HOF或框架材料，与主线的材料类型关联有限。若关注光诱导自组装、PISA形貌调控和可规模化纳米颗粒制备，值得全文精读；若聚焦框架材料电化学合成，则相关性较低。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告CTA的具体合成步骤与产率、PET-RAFT聚合的详细条件、DFT计算模型与参数、photo-PISA的配方组成、纳米颗粒尺寸分布、形貌表征手段、波长具体数值、光强、氧含量控制方式及规模化制备的具体规模等关键细节，均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 芳氧基黄原酸酯CTA在橙光下实现超快水相PET-RAFT聚合，kpapp为0.89 min–1，2分钟内单体转化率超过80%，Đ ≤ 1.2。
DFT计算表明聚合速率提升源于CTA阴离子自由基的低断裂能垒。
photo-PISA可在1分钟内、无需预先脱氧形成结构明确的聚合物纳米颗粒，形貌可通过配方条件调控。
photo-PISA形貌呈波长依赖性：长波长照射得到结构明确的囊泡，短波长照射产生不规则聚集体，归因于长波长下更优的光穿透和空间均匀性。

papers.title: Carbonyl‐Site‐Mediated Oxygen Reduction in Fluorenone‐Based Covalent Organic Frameworks for Efficient Hydrogen Peroxide Photosynthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ) photosynthesis from molecular oxygen and water offers a sustainable route for decentralized oxidant generation, yet elucidating the molecular‐level active sites for oxygen activation in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) remains challenging. Herein, we report a fluorenone‐containing COF, FO‐Tp, as an efficient photocatalyst for H 2 O 2 production, delivering a rate nearly ten times higher than that of fluorene‐based COF, highlighting the crucial contribution of fluorenone carbonyls to photocatalytic oxygen reduction. The fluorenone carbonyls facilitate photogenerated‐electron trapping and the formation of persistent electron‐rich radical states with ketyl radical‐anion‐like character, enabling FO‐Tp to maintain excellent H 2 O 2 production under alkaline conditions (AQY = 30.40%, pH = 13, at 400 nm) and in concentrated salt solutions. Extended fluorenone‐based COFs validate the generality of this active‐site design, reaching 2478.1 µmol·g −1 h −1 in pure water and up to 38.6 mmol g −1 ·h −1 in a water/benzyl alcohol biphasic system. Spectroscopic experiments and density functional theory calculations jointly confirm the reduced fluorenone carbonyl as a thermodynamically favored and generalizable electron‐accumulating active site for oxygen reduction to H 2 O 2 . This work elucidates how the fluorenone carbonyl functions as a dynamic molecular active site and proposes a strategy for designing efficiently H 2 O 2 ‐producing COF photocatalysts by incorporating carbonyl activation.

papers.title_zh: 芴酮基共价有机框架中羰基位点介导的氧还原用于高效过氧化氢光合成
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道含芴酮的COF材料FO-Tp，其羰基位点可捕获光生电子并形成持久富电子类酮基自由基阴离子态，使H2O2产率较芴基COF提高近十倍，并在碱性、浓盐及双相体系中保持高效。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对共价有机框架（COF）中氧活化分子级活性位点难以阐明的问题，报道了一种含芴酮的COF——FO-Tp，作为高效光催化H2O2生产材料。与芴基COF相比，FO-Tp的H2O2产率提高近十倍，凸显芴酮羰基对光催化氧还原的关键贡献。机理上，芴酮羰基促进光生电子捕获，并形成具有类酮基自由基阴离子特征的持久富电子自由基态，使FO-Tp在碱性条件（AQY = 30.40%，pH = 13，400 nm）和浓盐溶液中仍保持优异H2O2生产性能。扩展的芴酮基COF验证了该活性位点设计的普适性，在纯水中达到2478.1 µmol·g−1·h−1，在水/苯甲醇双相体系中高达38.6 mmol·g−1·h−1。光谱实验与密度泛函理论计算共同确认，还原态芴酮羰基是热力学有利且可推广的电子累积活性位点，用于氧还原生成H2O2。该工作阐明了芴酮羰基作为动态分子活性位点的作用，并提出通过引入羰基活化设计高效产H2O2 COF光催化剂的策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：合成含芴酮的COF FO-Tp及扩展芴酮基COF；以芴基COF作为对照；进行光催化H2O2生产性能测试；在碱性条件、浓盐溶液、纯水及水/苯甲醇双相体系中评价性能；测定表观量子产率（AQY）；采用光谱实验和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算研究活性位点与电子累积机制。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器型号、光源细节、自由基捕获实验和稳定性测试等。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接属于共轭COF框架材料与光催化氧还原方向，对研究主线中共轭COF的活性位点设计和框架材料功能化具有较高参考价值。其羰基位点介导的电子累积机制、碱性及浓盐条件下的稳定性、双相体系高产率结果，可为框架材料在电化学合成与能源转化中的位点工程提供思路。局限在于摘要未涉及介孔结构、导电性和电化学合成条件。若关注COF光催化H2O2合成与羰基活性位点设计，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告FO-Tp的具体合成方法、拓扑结构、孔结构参数、比表面积、光吸收范围、能带位置、载流子寿命、自由基捕获证据、循环稳定性、pH依赖机制细节及DFT计算模型等关键信息，均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 含芴酮COF FO-Tp的H2O2产率比芴基COF提高近十倍，表明芴酮羰基对光催化氧还原有重要贡献。
FO-Tp在碱性条件（AQY = 30.40%，pH = 13，400 nm）和浓盐溶液中保持优异H2O2生产性能。
扩展芴酮基COF在纯水中达到2478.1 µmol·g−1·h−1，在水/苯甲醇双相体系中高达38.6 mmol·g−1·h−1。
光谱实验与DFT计算共同确认还原态芴酮羰基是热力学有利且可推广的电子累积活性位点，形成类酮基自由基阴离子态。

papers.title: Anderson‐Type Polyoxometalate‐Based Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Anderson‐type polyoxometalates (Anderson POMs) are a distinctive subclass of POMs characterized by a planar disk‐like geometry, moderate molecular dimensions, tunable central heteroatoms, and bilateral organic modification sites. These features endow them with high structural programmability; however, the high aqueous solubility, aggregation tendency, and limited accessible surface area of discrete clusters hinder their effective utilization. Covalent organic frameworks (COFs), featuring crystalline porosity, large surface areas, ordered channels, and designable frameworks, provide an ideal platform for immobilizing, confining, and functionally amplifying Anderson POMs. The resulting Anderson POM‐based COFs integrate molecular redox/catalytic sites with accessible pore environments, delivering enhanced stability, efficient mass/charge transport, and tunable host‐guest interactions. This review summarizes recent advances in Anderson POM‐based COFs, emphasizing how cluster geometry, linkage modes, and spatial distribution determine framework functionality. Three construction strategies, in‐situ synthesis, post‐synthetic modification, and electrostatic assembly, are discussed, followed by applications in energy storage, catalysis, adsorption, and sensing. Finally, key challenges in structural determination, stability, mechanistic understanding, and scalable fabrication are critically assessed, and future perspectives for the rational design of Anderson POM‐based COFs are outlined.

papers.title_zh: 安德森型多金属氧酸盐基共价有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦安德森型多金属氧酸盐与共价有机框架的复合体系，系统总结其结构可编程性、三种构筑策略及在能源存储、催化、吸附和传感中的应用，并评述结构解析、稳定性、机理与规模化制备等关键挑战。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是如何将具有平面圆盘几何、可调中心杂原子和双侧有机修饰位点的安德森型多金属氧酸盐，从高水溶性、易聚集且可及表面积有限的离散簇，转化为稳定且功能增强的框架材料。设计策略是利用共价有机框架的晶态孔隙、大比表面积、有序通道和可设计骨架，对安德森型多金属氧酸盐进行固定、限域和功能放大。综述围绕簇几何、连接方式和空间分布如何决定框架功能展开，讨论原位合成、后合成修饰和静电组装三种构筑策略，并总结所得材料在能源存储、催化、吸附和传感中的应用。其意义在于将分子氧化还原/催化位点与可及孔环境整合，提升稳定性、传质/电荷传输和主客体相互作用可调性，并指出结构测定、稳定性、机理理解和可放大制备方面的挑战与未来理性设计方向。

离散安德森型多金属氧酸盐存在高水溶性、聚集倾向和可及表面积有限的问题，限制其有效利用。
共价有机框架可固定、限域并功能放大安德森型多金属氧酸盐，所得材料整合分子氧化还原/催化位点与可及孔环境，带来增强的稳定性、高效传质/电荷传输和可调主客体相互作用。
三种构筑策略为原位合成、后合成修饰和静电组装；应用涵盖能源存储、催化、吸附和传感。

papers.title: Metal–Organic Framework MIL-101(Cr)-Based Sensor for the Selective Adsorption and Electrochemical Detection of Perfluorooctanesulfonate
papers.abstract: Abstract Perfluorooctanesulfonate (PFOS) is a highly persistent and toxic per- and polyfluoroalkyl substance (PFAS) widely recognized for its serious risks to both environmental and human health. In this work, an electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS)-based sensor was developed for PFOS detection by integrating a MIL-101(Cr) metal–organic framework (MOF) sensing layer on the working electrode and a nickel hexacyanoferrate (NiHCF)-modified counter electrode. This simple and practical two-electrode system utilizes the large pore size, high surface area, and chromium center of MIL-101(Cr) to enable strong electrostatic and host–guest interactions with PFOS, leading to pronounced changes in pore resistance upon adsorption. The fabricated sensor exhibits a linear relationship between PFOS concentrations and pore resistance, with the limit of detection reaching 10.13 ppt. Selectivity tests demonstrate that excess amounts of common PFAS analogs, humic acid, and inorganic salts do not significantly interfere with the PFOS signal. This was further validated by statistical analysis using one-way ANOVA followed by Dunnett’s test, which confirmed that most interference conditions are not significantly different from PFOS alone. The sensor also shows stable performance over repeated measurements and operates effectively within the pH range of 5–8. Lastly, sensing experiments involving real water samples verify the applicability of the device for the detection of PFOS in complex matrices.

papers.title_zh: 基于金属有机框架MIL-101(Cr)的传感器用于全氟辛烷磺酸的选择性吸附与电化学检测
papers.summary_zh: 该工作构建了基于MIL-101(Cr)传感层和镍六氰基铁酸盐修饰对电极的两电极电化学阻抗传感器，用于全氟辛烷磺酸检测，检出限达10.13 ppt，并验证了选择性、重复性和实际水样适用性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是全氟辛烷磺酸作为持久性有毒全氟和多氟烷基物质，对环境和人类健康风险严重，需要简便实用的检测方法。材料体系为在工作电极上集成MIL-101(Cr)金属有机框架传感层，并在对电极使用镍六氰基铁酸盐修饰，构成两电极电化学阻抗谱传感器。设计策略利用MIL-101(Cr)的大孔径、高比表面积和铬中心，与全氟辛烷磺酸产生强静电和主客体相互作用，吸附后引起孔电阻显著变化。研究过程包括建立全氟辛烷磺酸浓度与孔电阻的线性关系，测定检出限，开展选择性测试，使用单因素方差分析和Dunnett检验进行统计分析，评估重复测量稳定性和pH 5至8范围内的有效操作，并用真实水样验证复杂基质中的适用性。其意义在于提供一种简单、实用且灵敏的全氟辛烷磺酸电化学检测平台。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确的方法包括：构建基于MIL-101(Cr)传感层工作电极和镍六氰基铁酸盐修饰对电极的两电极电化学阻抗谱传感器；利用孔电阻变化检测全氟辛烷磺酸；进行选择性测试，考察常见全氟和多氟烷基物质类似物、腐殖酸和无机盐干扰；使用单因素方差分析和Dunnett检验进行统计分析；评估重复测量稳定性和pH 5至8范围操作；开展真实水样传感实验。摘要未报告具体合成条件、材料表征细节和完整电化学参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与金属有机框架、介孔材料及电化学检测主线相关，MIL-101(Cr)的大孔径和高比表面积被用于选择性吸附与阻抗传感。其实际价值在于提供框架材料用于环境污染物电化学检测的案例，但导电MOF、共轭框架和自组装并非核心。若关注MOF吸附与电化学传感的交叉，值得全文精读以核查材料制备、界面构筑和传感机制细节。

传感器在重复测量中表现稳定，并在pH 5至8范围内有效工作。
真实水样传感实验验证了该器件在复杂基质中检测全氟辛烷磺酸的适用性。

papers.title: Assembling Polyhedral Metal–Organic Framework Superstructures by Bidirectional Shear
papers.abstract: Abstract Colloidal superstructures with long-range order offer a gateway to emergent collective properties, yet achieving simultaneous translational and orientational control over anisotropic polyhedral building blocks remains a formidable challenge. Here, we show that bidirectional shear enables the assembly of polyhedral colloidal superstructures. Using Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework-8 (ZIF-8) particles in a polymer matrix, alternating bidirectional shear fields, coupled with dynamic coordination and hydrogen-bonding interactions, generate a viscoelastic regime that aligns particles into facet-specific ordered lattices. This mechanism couples translational and orientational ordering beyond that accessible by conventional shear processing. The resulting large-area composite superstructures exhibit high-saturation structural colors with reflectance intensities approaching 70%. The intrinsic microporosity of ZIF-8 further enables in situ encapsulation of fluorescent guests, yielding films with integrated structural color and fluorescence. These orthogonal optical responses provide a platform for multilevel anticounterfeiting. This work establishes bidirectional shear as a general strategy for assembling anisotropic colloids into multifunctional composite superstructures.

papers.title_zh: 通过双向剪切组装多面体金属有机框架超结构
papers.summary_zh: 该工作利用双向剪切在聚合物基质中组装ZIF-8多面体胶体超结构，通过动态配位和氢键作用实现面特异性有序排列，获得反射强度接近70%的结构色，并实现荧光客体原位封装用于多级防伪。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是具有长程有序的胶体超结构可带来集体性质，但对各向异性多面体构筑基元同时实现平移和取向控制仍是难题。材料体系为聚合物基质中的沸石咪唑酯骨架ZIF-8颗粒。设计策略是采用交替双向剪切场，结合动态配位和氢键相互作用，产生粘弹性区域，使颗粒排列成面特异性有序晶格。该机制将平移和取向有序耦合，超越传统剪切加工可达到的水平。研究过程包括制备大面积复合超结构，表征其高饱和结构色和反射强度，利用ZIF-8本征微孔性原位封装荧光客体，获得兼具结构色和荧光的薄膜，并展示正交光学响应用于多级防伪。其意义在于确立双向剪切作为组装各向异性胶体为多功能复合超结构的通用策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确的方法包括：使用ZIF-8颗粒在聚合物基质中进行组装；施加交替双向剪切场；利用动态配位和氢键相互作用形成粘弹性区域；表征大面积复合超结构的结构色和反射强度；利用ZIF-8本征微孔性原位封装荧光客体；构建集成结构色和荧光的薄膜并展示多级防伪。摘要未报告具体剪切参数、聚合物种类、ZIF-8粒径、荧光客体种类和定量光学数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与框架材料组装、自组装技术和金属有机框架主线相关，展示剪切场驱动各向异性多面体胶体有序组装，并获得结构色与荧光正交响应。其实际价值在于提供框架材料超结构组装和多功能复合薄膜策略，但未涉及导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成。若关注组装方法学和光学防伪，值得全文精读以核查剪切条件、界面作用和有序度表征。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要。摘要未报告具体剪切参数、聚合物基质种类、ZIF-8粒径分布、荧光客体种类、有序度定量表征和防伪性能细节，关键内容仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 交替双向剪切场结合动态配位和氢键相互作用，可在聚合物基质中使ZIF-8颗粒排列成面特异性有序晶格，实现平移和取向有序。
所得大面积复合超结构表现出高饱和结构色，反射强度接近70%。
ZIF-8的本征微孔性可实现荧光客体的原位封装，得到集成结构色和荧光的薄膜。
结构色和荧光提供正交光学响应，可作为多级防伪平台。

papers.title: A Universal Class of Cubic Crystalline Alkali Organic–Inorganic Glyme-Based Halides
papers.abstract: Abstract Halide salts have played a central role in lithium-ion battery development as components of liquid, polymer, ionic-liquid, and solid-state electrolytes, yet their high solubility has limited their exploration as electrode materials. Here, we demonstrate a universal self-assembly reaction between halide solid electrolytes and glyme-based solvents that produces a new family of alkali glyme-based halides, ABX6·mGn (A = Li, Na, K; B = Ta, Nb; X = Cl, Br; Gn = mono- to tetraglyme; m = number of Gn). They have a cubic structure similar to CsCl, with alkali cations at the center surrounded by fast-moving glyme molecules and BX6 octahedra at the corners. We demonstrated that, upon heating, these solvent-separated ion pair (SSIP) structures can transform into contact ion pair (CIP) phases, as shown for KTaCl6·1G4 with infinite 1D chain motifs. Combined thermal, EPR, and NMR measurements together with DFT studies were used to gain insight into charge distribution, glyme conformation, and rotation in order to rationalize their formation mechanism and solvation structures. Additionally, we found that the ionic conductivity of these solids is low (10–7–10–4 mS/cm). However, it increases to 1–10 mS/cm in the liquid state. K-based systems demonstrate the highest conductivity in both states. Furthermore, our electrochemical and in situ XRD investigations of KTaCl6 in potassium-ion cells with glyme-based electrolytes reveal that displacement and insertion reactions occur through low-voltage polarization via the formation of K2TaCl6. Our work advances the understanding of glyme-based halide complexes, paving the way for rich chemistry with potential applications in solid-state ionics and beyond.

papers.title_zh: 一类通用的立方晶态碱金属有机-无机甘醇醚基卤化物
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道了卤化物固态电解质与甘醇醚溶剂之间的通用自组装反应，生成新型碱金属甘醇醚基卤化物ABX6·mGn，具有类CsCl立方结构，并揭示其溶剂分离离子对向接触离子对的可逆转变及电化学行为。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于卤化物盐因高溶解度而难以作为电极材料探索，作者试图通过自组装策略构建新型碱金属甘醇醚基卤化物。材料体系为ABX6·mGn（A=Li、Na、K；B=Ta、Nb；X=Cl、Br；Gn为单至四甘醇醚；m为Gn数目），通过卤化物固态电解质与甘醇醚溶剂的自组装反应制备。结构上呈类CsCl立方结构，碱金属阳离子位于中心，被快速运动的甘醇醚分子包围，BX6八面体位于角位。以KTaCl6·1G4为例，加热后溶剂分离离子对结构可转变为具有无限一维链基元的接触离子对相。结合热学、EPR、NMR测量与DFT研究，探讨电荷分布、甘醇醚构象与旋转，以理解形成机制与溶剂化结构。意义在于推进对甘醇醚基卤化物配合物的理解，为固态离子学等应用提供新化学空间。

papers.title: Tailoring Fluorinated Chain Positioning in Anion Exchange Membranes for Boosted Ion and Water Transport Channels
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Anion exchange membranes (AEMs) have advanced anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers (AEMWEs) by achieving high ionic conductivity and controlled swelling, yet balancing hydration‐enhanced electrolytic performance and swelling‐induced dimensional instability remains a key challenge for scalable application. In this work, we advance beyond conventional cationic grafting modification strategies via the rational design of fluorinated alkyl side chains on hydrophobic polymer backbones, thereby enhancing amphiphilic self‐assembly. Such structural engineering facilitates the formation of interconnected pathways that enable efficient hydroxide ion and water transport. The resulting PTA fc P membrane exhibits a low swelling ratio of 14.38% and an OH − conductivity of 179.2 mS cm −1 at 80°C. Notably, the establishment of an efficient alkaline electrolyte transport network enables the PTA fc P‐based electrolyzer to achieve a current density of 7.5 A cm −2 . Furthermore, the electrolyzer incorporating a PTA fc P membrane demonstrates satisfactory durability over 2000 h of operation, exhibiting a voltage fade rate of only 17.9 µV h −1 at 0.5 A cm −2 , substantiating its application potential for industrial‐scale deployment.

papers.title_zh: 调控阴离子交换膜中氟化链位置以增强离子与水传输通道
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过在疏水聚合物骨架上理性设计氟化烷基侧链，增强两亲性自组装，构建互连的氢氧根离子与水传输通道，使PTA fc P膜兼具低溶胀率与高电导率，并在电解器中实现高电流密度与长时耐久性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于阴离子交换膜需平衡水合增强的电解性能与溶胀导致的尺寸不稳定性。作者超越传统阳离子接枝改性策略，在疏水聚合物骨架上理性设计氟化烷基侧链，以增强两亲性自组装，促进互连通道形成，从而实现高效的氢氧根离子和水传输。所得PTA fc P膜在80°C下溶胀率低至14.38%，OH−电导率达179.2 mS cm−1。基于该膜的电解器实现7.5 A cm−2的电流密度，并在0.5 A cm−2下稳定运行2000小时，电压衰减率仅17.9 µV h−1。该结构工程策略为工业规模阴离子交换膜水电解器应用提供了潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：在疏水聚合物骨架上设计氟化烷基侧链；两亲性自组装构建膜材料；溶胀率测试；OH−电导率测试；电解器性能测试，包括电流密度与耐久性测试。摘要未报告具体合成路线、膜制备条件、表征手段及电解器测试详细参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与自组装技术及聚合物膜材料相关，展示了通过氟化侧链定位调控两亲性自组装以优化离子与水传输通道。其局限在于摘要未报告介孔、共轭框架或MOF/COF/HOF特征。对关注自组装、离子传输膜及电化学器件的研究者具有参考价值，值得全文精读以核查结构-性能关系细节。

papers.title: Precise Modulation of CO 2 ‐to‐Ethanol Conversion by Fully‐Exposed Cu n Clusters Induced by Dangling Bonds in Lacunary Polyoxometalate
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The electrochemical CO 2 reduction toward ethanol under high current density remains challenging. Herein, WO x ‐supported fully exposed Cu clusters (FECCs) confined by hollow mesoporous carbon spheres (HMCS) (Cu‐WO x @HMCS) are fabricated through the “molecular defect confinement” strategy based on the [PW 9 O 34 ] 9− . The [PW 9 O 34 ] 9− features a tri‐lacunary configuration, single‐sided dangling bond characteristics, and excellent liquid‐phase stability, enabling precise anchoring of the {Cu II 6 } cluster to realize atomic dispersion at the molecular level, while enabling the controllable construction of the geometric size and electronic structure of FECCs via Cu─O─W bonds during pyrolysis. The Cu‐WO x @HMCS executes exceptional performance for CO 2 ‐to‐ethanol conversion, with Faradaic efficiencies of 80.6% and 75.3% at partial current densities of 322.4 and 677.7 mA cm −2 , respectively. Mechanism studies reveal the synergistic regulation: (1) The FECCs display a higher Fermi level compared to Cu nanoparticles, acting as a superior electron donor to promote CO 2 adsorption and conversion; moreover, the geometric size effect of FECCs increases the * CO coverage, favoring the C─C coupling. (2) The WO x supplies reactive * H, which favors the hydrogenation of * CO and * CHCOH, steering the asymmetric C─C coupling toward ethanol. This study enables atomic‐level design of catalysts by employing polyoxometalates, delivering a crucial method for precisely constructing fully exposed clusters and highly selective CO 2 RR‐to‐ethanol.

papers.title_zh: 缺位多金属氧酸盐中悬挂键诱导的全暴露Cun团簇精确调控CO2到乙醇转化
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于缺位多金属氧酸盐的分子缺陷限域策略，在空心介孔碳球中构建WO x负载的全暴露Cu团簇，实现高电流密度下CO2到乙醇的高选择性转化，并揭示几何与电子协同调控机制。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于高电流密度下电化学CO2还原制乙醇仍具挑战。作者采用分子缺陷限域策略，基于[PW9O34]9−构建WO x负载的全暴露Cu团簇，并限域于空心介孔碳球中，形成Cu-WO x@HMCS。该多金属氧酸盐具有三缺位构型、单侧悬挂键特征和优异液相稳定性，可实现{CuII6}团簇的精确锚定，在分子水平实现原子分散，并在热解过程中通过Cu─O─W键可控构建全暴露Cu团簇的几何尺寸与电子结构。Cu-WO x@HMCS在CO2到乙醇转化中表现优异，在322.4和677.7 mA cm−2的部分电流密度下，法拉第效率分别为80.6%和75.3%。机制研究揭示协同调控：全暴露Cu团簇比Cu纳米颗粒具有更高费米能级，作为更优电子供体促进CO2吸附与转化；其几何尺寸效应增加*CO覆盖度，有利于C─C偶联；WO x提供活性*H，有利于*CO和*CHCOH加氢，引导不对称C─C偶联朝向乙醇。该研究实现了利用多金属氧酸盐进行原子级催化剂设计。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：基于[PW9O34]9−的分子缺陷限域策略；热解过程构建Cu-WO x@HMCS；电化学CO2还原性能测试，包括法拉第效率与部分电流密度测量；机制研究，涉及费米能级分析、*CO覆盖度与C─C偶联路径。摘要未报告具体热解温度、时间、前驱体比例、表征手段及电化学测试详细条件。

papers.title: Acid–Base-Mediated Self-Assembly: Synthetic Access to High-Energy-Density Metal–Organic Frameworks and Host–Guest Energetic Materials
papers.abstract: Abstract Controlled condensed-state chemical reactions are critical for smart-material development. Reaction-driven self-assembly materials have been explored for decades across organic nanostructure, polymer, and biomaterial research. This strategy has recently enabled the design and synthesis of nitrogen-rich hydrogen-bonded organic frameworks and size-matched hydrogen-bonded hydroxylammonium frameworks. Nevertheless, energetic-material research lacks reports on tuning self-assembled structures of a single molecule via acid–base interactions. Herein, we present an acid–base-mediated, reaction-driven self-assembly strategy to fabricate the high-energy-density metal–organic framework KADNPP (potassium 2-((7-amino-3,6-dinitro-5-oxo-4,5-dihydropyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine-2-carbonyl)oxy)) and host–guest energetic material HGEM-8. KADNPP displays an exceptionally high measured density of 2.238 g cm–3 and remarkable thermal stability (Td = 376 °C). Meanwhile, HGEM-8 possesses a high density of 1.940 g cm–3 (single crystal X-ray diffraction: 1.982 g cm–3), excellent detonation performance (D = 9464 m s–1; P = 43.5 GPa), and superior solid-propellant performance (Isp = 293 s, calculated by NASA CEA). These results demonstrate the significant potential of the present synthetic strategy for constructing high-energy-density self-assembled energetic materials.

papers.title_zh: 酸碱介导自组装：高能量密度金属有机框架与主客体含能材料的合成途径
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出酸碱介导、反应驱动的自组装策略，制备高能量密度金属有机框架KADNPP与主客体含能材料HGEM-8。KADNPP实测密度达2.238 g cm-3，热分解温度376 °C；HGEM-8密度1.940 g cm-3，爆速9464 m s-1，爆压43.5 GPa，比冲293 s。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于含能材料领域尚缺乏通过酸碱相互作用调控单分子自组装结构的报道。作者以酸碱介导的反应驱动自组装为设计策略，构建了高能量密度金属有机框架KADNPP（钾2-((7-氨基-3,6-二硝基-5-氧代-4,5-二氢吡唑并[1,5-a]嘧啶-2-羰基)氧基)）与主客体含能材料HGEM-8。摘要指出该策略此前已用于富氮氢键有机框架及尺寸匹配的氢键羟铵框架，但用于单分子酸碱调控自组装尚属空白。研究通过酸碱相互作用调控自组装结构，获得KADNPP与HGEM-8两种材料，并对其密度、热稳定性、爆轰性能及固体推进剂性能进行了表征与计算。该工作展示了该合成策略在构建高能量密度自组装含能材料方面的潜力，为含能材料的自组装结构调控提供了新思路。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：酸碱介导的反应驱动自组装合成策略；制备金属有机框架KADNPP与主客体含能材料HGEM-8；测量密度与热分解温度；单晶X射线衍射测定HGEM-8密度；爆轰性能测试获得爆速与爆压；采用NASA CEA计算固体推进剂比冲。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器型号及详细测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料自组装与含能材料交叉方向，展示了酸碱介导自组装策略在金属有机框架及主客体含能材料构建中的实际应用，对框架材料组装方法学有参考价值。其局限在于含能材料方向与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架及电化学合成主线关联较弱，且摘要未涉及孔结构、导电性或电化学性能。若关注自组装策略普适性或含能框架材料，值得全文精读；若聚焦导电或介孔框架，则相关性有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征细节、数值或机制。KADNPP与HGEM-8的具体合成条件、结构表征细节、爆轰性能测试方法、单晶数据及NASA CEA计算参数等关键信息仍需查阅全文核实。

papers.title: Local Structure and Dynamics of Three-Dimensional Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Abstract Resolving and controlling the local dynamical properties of covalent organic frameworks (COFs) remains a central challenge, particularly when assembled from large, flexible building units. Here, we combine synchrotron X-ray pair distribution function (PDF) analyses with machine learning-accelerated molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to resolve the local structure and dynamics of two three-dimensional imine-linked COFs, COF-682 [(DHP)(TAM)]imine, assembled from 6,13-dihydropentacene (DHP) and tetrakis(4-aminophenyl)methane (TAM), and COF-612 [(HBC-LA12)(HAPT)2]imine, assembled from nanographene dodecabenzaldehyde hexakis[3,5-bis(p-formylphenyl)-4,6-dimethoxyphenyl]hexabenzocoronene (HBC-LA12) and 2,3,6,7,14,15-hexa(4-aminophenyl)triptycene (HAPT). Validated against the experimental PDFs through ensemble-averaged calculations, the simulations show that the exposed π-surface and V-shaped geometry of the DHP linker endow COF-682 with enhanced local flexibility through face-to-face and offset π-stacking interactions differing in both their average interplanar separation and their ring-plane tilt angle. In contrast, the extended nanographene linker rigidifies COF-612 by maintaining the planarity of its fused cores, while the linker pendant aryl rings equip both COFs with enhanced librational ability. The simulations further provide quantitative measures of the translational and reorientational mobility of the linkers, revealing how local COF dynamics may be tuned by balancing noncovalent interactions and different degrees of aromatic rigidity. The PDF-MD experimental-computational approach holds promise as a general method beyond conventional crystallography to gain insights into the local properties of COFs with the aim of directing their dynamic function.

papers.title_zh: 三维共价有机框架的局部结构与动力学
papers.summary_zh: 本文结合同步辐射X射线对分布函数分析与机器学习加速分子动力学模拟，解析两种三维亚胺连接COF（COF-682与COF-612）的局部结构与动力学。发现DHP连接体的暴露π面与V形几何通过面对面和偏移π堆叠增强COF-682局部柔性，而扩展纳米石墨烯连接体使COF-612刚性化。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于解析并控制由大而柔性构筑单元组装的三维共价有机框架的局部动力学性质。作者选取两种三维亚胺连接COF：COF-682 [(DHP)(TAM)]imine，由6,13-二氢并五苯（DHP）与四(4-氨基苯基)甲烷（TAM）组装；COF-612 [(HBC-LA12)(HAPT)2]imine，由纳米石墨烯十二苯甲醛六[3,5-双(p-甲酰基苯基)-4,6-二甲氧基苯基]六苯并蔻（HBC-LA12）与2,3,6,7,14,15-六(4-氨基苯基)三蝶烯（HAPT）组装。研究将同步辐射X射线PDF分析与机器学习加速MD模拟相结合，通过系综平均计算与实验PDF验证。模拟揭示DHP连接体的暴露π面与V形几何通过面对面和偏移π堆叠相互作用赋予COF-682增强的局部柔性，其平均面间距与环平面倾角均存在差异；扩展纳米石墨烯连接体通过保持稠合核平面性使COF-612刚性化，而连接体侧挂芳环赋予两种COF增强的摆动能力。模拟进一步定量给出连接体的平动与再取向迁移率，揭示通过平衡非共价相互作用与不同芳香刚性程度可调控COF局部动力学。该PDF-MD实验-计算联用方法有望成为超越传统晶体学的通用手段，用于洞察COF局部性质以指导其动态功能。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：同步辐射X射线对分布函数（PDF）分析；机器学习加速分子动力学（MD）模拟；通过系综平均计算与实验PDF进行验证；对两种三维亚胺连接COF（COF-682与COF-612）进行局部结构与动力学解析；定量测量连接体的平动与再取向迁移率。摘要未报告具体合成条件、PDF测试参数、MD力场细节及机器学习模型架构。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接聚焦共轭COF的局部结构与动力学，属于框架材料组装与结构解析主线，PDF-MD联用方法对理解框架材料局部柔性及动态功能具有方法学价值。其局限在于摘要未涉及介孔性、导电性或电化学合成，且研究对象为三维亚胺COF而非导电或介孔COF。对于关注COF局部动力学、结构-性能关系及先进表征方法的读者，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征细节、数值或机制。COF-682与COF-612的具体合成条件、PDF测试参数、MD模拟力场与机器学习模型细节、定量迁移率数值等关键信息仍需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: DHP连接体的暴露π面与V形几何通过面对面和偏移π堆叠相互作用赋予COF-682增强的局部柔性，两种堆叠模式在平均面间距与环平面倾角上均存在差异。
扩展纳米石墨烯连接体通过保持稠合核平面性使COF-612刚性化。
连接体侧挂芳环赋予COF-682与COF-612增强的摆动能力。

papers.title: A Locally Flexible Kinetic Valve for Temperature‐Programmed Guest Release and Hydrogen Isotope Separation in Metal–Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Controlling when an adsorbed guest leaves a porous solid is as important as controlling how much it takes up, yet desorption is almost always dictated by adsorption‐site energetics and the heating profile, leaving little room to program the release temperature. Here, we show that a locally flexible pore aperture can act as a kinetic valve that converts the temperature at which a guest is loaded into the temperature at which it is later released. In a pentoxy‐functionalized isoreticular MOF (C 5 ‐IRMOF), long alkoxy side chains line the aperture to form a strongly confined, thermally responsive gate while preserving a large internal cavity. Unlike its butoxy analogue (C 4 ‐IRMOF), a conventional microporous adsorbent, C 5 ‐IRMOF traps guests until thermally activated chain motions reopen the gate, releasing them abruptly at an unusually high temperature without any strong binding sites. Cryogenic thermal desorption spectroscopy reveals that the release maximum shifts with a near‐unity slope with respect to the initial exposure temperature, defining adsorption‐temperature‐programmed desorption as a distinct mode of pore function, while the same confinement enables kinetic quantum sieving of hydrogen isotopes up to 100 K. These results establish locally flexible side chains as a simple design handle for programming guest release in porous materials.

papers.title_zh: 金属有机框架中用于温度程序化客体释放与氢同位素分离的局部柔性动力学阀门
papers.summary_zh: 本文报道戊氧基功能化等网状MOF（C5-IRMOF）中局部柔性孔口作为动力学阀门，将客体装载温度转化为释放温度。长烷氧基侧链形成强限域热响应门，使客体在异常高温下突然释放，并实现高达100 K的氢同位素动力学量子筛分。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于多孔固体中客体脱附几乎完全由吸附位点能量与加热程序决定，缺乏编程释放温度的调控手段。作者以戊氧基功能化等网状MOF（C5-IRMOF）为材料体系，其长烷氧基侧链沿孔口排列形成强限域、热响应性门，同时保持大内部空腔。与丁氧基类似物C4-IRMOF（传统微孔吸附剂）不同，C5-IRMOF将客体捕获直至热激活链运动重新打开门，在异常高温下突然释放客体，且无需强结合位点。低温热脱附谱揭示释放最大值随初始暴露温度以接近1的斜率移动，定义了吸附温度程序化脱附这一独特孔功能模式。相同限域效应使氢同位素动力学量子筛分在高达100 K仍可实现。该结果确立局部柔性侧链作为编程多孔材料客体释放的简单设计手段。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成戊氧基功能化等网状MOF（C5-IRMOF）及其丁氧基类似物C4-IRMOF；低温热脱附谱（TDS）表征客体释放行为；通过改变初始暴露温度考察释放最大值位移；氢同位素分离测试在高达100 K条件下进行。摘要未报告具体合成条件、晶体结构表征、孔径分布数据及同位素分离选择性数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作聚焦MOF孔口局部柔性与客体释放动力学调控，属于框架材料组装与功能化主线，其动力学阀门概念对多孔框架材料的客体传输调控具有设计参考价值。局限在于摘要未涉及介孔性、导电性或电化学合成，且材料为传统IRMOF体系而非导电或共轭MOF。对于关注MOF孔功能编程、氢同位素分离及柔性框架动力学的读者，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征细节、数值或机制。C5-IRMOF与C4-IRMOF的具体合成条件、晶体结构、孔径数据、热脱附谱测试参数、氢同位素分离选择性及量子筛分机制细节等关键信息仍需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: C5-IRMOF中长烷氧基侧链沿孔口形成强限域热响应门，同时保持大内部空腔，与C4-IRMOF的传统微孔吸附行为不同。
C5-IRMOF将客体捕获直至热激活链运动重新打开门，在异常高温下突然释放客体，且无需强结合位点。
低温热脱附谱显示释放最大值随初始暴露温度以接近1的斜率移动，定义吸附温度程序化脱附为独特孔功能模式。
相同限域效应实现氢同位素动力学量子筛分，温度高达100 K。

papers.title: Differential Sedimentation and Cryo‐TEM Mapping Resolve Structural Heterogeneity in Conjugated Polymer Nanowires for Programmable Stretchable Electronics
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The performance of stretchable electronics based on semicrystalline conjugated polymers (CPs) is determined by the balance between crystalline order and interdomain connectivity provided by amorphous tie molecules, rather than by crystallinity alone. Solution‐state crystallization‐driven self‐assembly (CDSA) of CPs into nanowires (NWs) enables solution‐processable thin films without post‐deposition annealing to enhance crystallinity. In cast films, crystalline NWs provide charge‐transport pathways, whereas non‐aggregated amorphous chains bridge adjacent NW crystallites, sustain interdomain charge percolation, and accommodate mechanical deformation. Yet this assembly inevitably yields heterogeneous mixtures of crystalline NWs and amorphous chains, which resist single‐NW quantification and independent control. In this study, density‐driven differential sedimentation fractionates poly(3‐hexylthiophene) (P3HT) NWs into a sediment of crystalline NWs and a supernatant of shorter NWs and lower‐molecular‐weight chains. Cryo‐TEM quantitative morphological mapping resolves backbone tilt, width uniformity, and lamellar coherence at the single‐NW level, showing that local cofacial π–π packing is preserved in both fractions whereas long‐range order along the lamellar stacking direction is concentrated in the sediment. Recombining the fractions at controlled weight ratios tunes the mobility–stretchability trade‐off without chemical modification, and the strategy generalizes to coaxial p–n heterojunction hybrid NWs of P3HT‐ b ‐poly(2‐vinylpyridine)/CdSe quantum dots formed by CDSA, reframing structural heterogeneity as a programmable design parameter for stretchable electronics.
papers.recommendation: 同时命中导电/共轭框架、组装与结晶，建议优先检查其合成路径与孔结构证据。
papers.title_zh: 差速沉降与冷冻透射电镜图谱解析共轭聚合物纳米线结构异质性用于可编程可拉伸电子器件
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用密度驱动的差速沉降将P3HT纳米线分为晶态沉淀与含短纳米线及低分子量链的上清液，并通过冷冻透射电镜在单纳米线水平定量解析结构差异。重组不同比例组分可在不化学修饰条件下调控迁移率与可拉伸性平衡，并将该策略拓展至同轴p-n异质结杂化纳米线。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于半结晶共轭聚合物自组装不可避免地产出晶态纳米线与非聚集无定形链的异质混合物，难以单纳米线定量与独立控制，而可拉伸电子性能取决于晶态有序与无定形连接链提供的域间连通性平衡。材料体系为聚(3-己基噻吩)(P3HT)纳米线，通过溶液态结晶驱动自组装(CDSA)制备。设计策略采用密度驱动的差速沉降，将纳米线分为晶态纳米线沉淀和较短纳米线及低分子量链的上清液。研究过程使用冷冻透射电镜定量形貌图谱解析单纳米线水平的骨架倾斜、宽度均匀性和层状相干性，并将两组分按受控重量比重组以调控性能。意义在于将结构异质性重新定义为可编程设计参数，并推广至P3HT-b-聚(2-乙烯基吡啶)/CdSe量子点同轴p-n异质结杂化纳米线。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：溶液态结晶驱动自组装(CDSA)制备共轭聚合物纳米线；密度驱动的差速沉降进行组分分离；冷冻透射电镜(Cryo-TEM)定量形貌图谱解析单纳米线骨架倾斜、宽度均匀性和层状相干性；将分离组分按受控重量比重组以调控性能；将该策略拓展至同轴p-n异质结杂化纳米线体系。摘要未报告具体的沉降介质、离心条件、电镜加速电压、迁移率和可拉伸性数值及器件制备细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与自组装技术及框架材料组装主线高度相关，其核心价值在于提出一种无需化学修饰、通过物理分馏与重组调控共轭聚合物纳米线结构异质性的可编程策略，并建立单纳米线结构—性能关联。对理解共轭聚合物自组装薄膜中晶态与非晶态组分的协同作用具有参考意义。局限在于研究对象为P3HT纳米线而非介孔导电MOF或COF/HOF，且摘要未报告器件级电化学或拉伸性能数据。若关注自组装与可拉伸电子交叉方向，值得全文精读以核查分馏机制与器件验证细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体的沉降介质与离心参数、冷冻透射电镜制样与成像条件、迁移率和可拉伸性的定量数值、重组比例与性能的对应关系、器件结构与制备工艺、稳定性测试条件以及同轴异质结杂化纳米线的具体表征数据，这些关键细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 差速沉降成功将P3HT纳米线分为晶态纳米线沉淀与含较短纳米线和低分子量链的上清液两个组分。
冷冻透射电镜单纳米线定量形貌图谱显示，局部共面π–π堆积在两个组分中均得以保留，而沿层状堆积方向的长程有序集中于沉淀组分。
按受控重量比重组两组分可在不进行化学修饰的条件下调控迁移率–可拉伸性权衡。
该策略可推广至CDSA形成的P3HT-b-聚(2-乙烯基吡啶)/CdSe量子点同轴p-n异质结杂化纳米线。

papers.title: Hierarchically Porous Fe–N–C Electrocatalysts with Accessible Fe-Nx Sites for High-Performance Oxygen Reduction Reaction in Zn-Air Batteries
papers.abstract: Abstract Developing Fe–N–C electrocatalysts with high active site utilization remains a key challenge for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR), primarily because of the limited accessibility of Fe-Nx sites. Herein, a hierarchically porous Fe–N–C (HP-Fe–N–C) catalyst is constructed via a ZnO-templated strategy combined with urea-assisted secondary pyrolysis, enabling the simultaneous regulation of the pore structure and Fe-Nx site density. The ZnO template governs the formation of mesoporous architectures, and concurrently, the pyrolysis of urea releases gaseous species that facilitate the enlargement and interconnection of mesoporous channels. Notably, the balanced micromesoporous structure derived from the ZnO template facilitates efficient mass transport and enhances site accessibility, while urea regulates the nitrogen species to promote the formation of dense Fe-Nx moieties. As a result, the HP-Fe–N–C catalyst delivers a high half-wave potential of 0.90 V, along with near four-electron selectivity and excellent durability. The Zn-air battery assembled with the HP-Fe–N–C cathode achieves an open-circuit voltage of 1.52 V, a specific capacity of 745.6 mAh g–1, and favorable charge–discharge stability exceeding 800 h. This work reveals the balance between hierarchical porosity and active site density in the Fe–N–C catalyst for the high-performance ORR.

papers.title_zh: 具有可接近Fe-Nx位点的分级多孔Fe–N–C电催化剂用于锌空气电池高性能氧还原反应
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过ZnO模板结合尿素辅助二次热解构建分级多孔Fe–N–C催化剂，同步调控孔结构与Fe-Nx位点密度。ZnO模板主导介孔结构形成，尿素热解释放气体促进介孔通道扩大与互联并调控氮物种。催化剂半波电位达0.90 V，锌空气电池开路电压1.52 V、比容量745.6 mAh g–1、充放电稳定性超800 h。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于Fe–N–C电催化剂中Fe-Nx位点可接近性受限导致活性位利用率低，制约氧还原反应性能。材料体系为分级多孔Fe–N–C(HP-Fe–N–C)催化剂。设计策略采用ZnO模板法结合尿素辅助二次热解，以同时调控孔结构和Fe-Nx位点密度。研究过程表明，ZnO模板主导介孔架构形成，尿素热解释放气态物种促进介孔通道扩大与互联；由ZnO模板衍生的平衡微介孔结构有利于高效传质并增强位点可接近性，尿素则调控氮物种以促进致密Fe-Nx基团形成。意义在于揭示了分级孔隙率与活性位点密度之间的平衡对高性能氧还原反应的关键作用，并验证了其在锌空气电池中的实际应用潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：ZnO模板法构建分级多孔结构；尿素辅助二次热解调控孔结构与Fe-Nx位点密度；氧还原反应性能测试获得半波电位、四电子选择性和耐久性数据；组装锌空气电池并测试开路电压、比容量和充放电稳定性。摘要未报告ZnO模板用量、热解温度与时间、尿素比例、比表面积和孔径分布数值、Fe-Nx位点定量表征方法及电池测试的具体条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料及框架材料组装主线相关，其价值在于展示ZnO模板与尿素辅助热解协同调控分级多孔Fe–N–C催化剂孔结构和活性位点密度的策略，并给出完整的氧还原与锌空气电池性能数据。对介孔电催化剂设计中传质与位点可接近性平衡具有参考意义。局限在于材料为热解碳基Fe–N–C而非晶态框架材料，且摘要未报告孔结构定量参数与位点结构表征细节。若关注介孔电催化与能源器件，值得全文精读以核查孔结构—位点—性能关联证据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告ZnO模板用量与形貌、热解温度与时间、尿素添加比例、比表面积和孔径分布数值、Fe-Nx位点的定量表征方法与含量、四电子选择性的具体数值、耐久性测试条件以及锌空气电池测试的具体参数，这些关键细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: HP-Fe–N–C催化剂实现半波电位0.90 V，并具有近四电子选择性和优异耐久性。
以HP-Fe–N–C为正极组装的锌空气电池实现开路电压1.52 V、比容量745.6 mAh g–1，充放电稳定性超过800 h。
ZnO模板主导介孔架构形成，尿素热解释放气态物种促进介孔通道扩大与互联，二者共同平衡微介孔结构。
尿素调控氮物种促进致密Fe-Nx基团形成，分级孔隙率与活性位点密度的平衡有利于传质和位点可接近性。

papers.title: Donor‐Selective NiCo‐LDH Templating Directs Polymer Assembly for Enhanced Exciton Transport in Efficient Organic Solar Cells
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Organic solar cells (OSCs) have achieved remarkable progress, yet improving exciton utilization in polymer donors remains challenging due to their intrinsically limited exciton diffusion length ( L D ). Here, we report a donor‐selective templating strategy based on few‐layer‐like nickel–cobalt layered double hydroxide (NiCo‐LDH) nanosheets to regulate polymer donor assembly in OSCs. The hydroxyl‐rich NiCo‐LDH surface exhibits preferential affinity toward polymer donors and promotes ordered donor‐chain organization during film formation, while exerting limited influence on the acceptor component. This templating strategy enhances the molecular ordering of the donor phase and increases the L D of D18 from 10.7 to 18.9 nm, accompanied by the formation of more ordered donor fibrillar structures. The coordinated improvements in donor organization and exciton transport are further associated with enhanced exciton‐to‐charge conversion, more balanced carrier transport, and suppressed recombination. Consequently, D18:L8‐BO‐based OSCs achieve a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 21.36%, independently certified at 21.09%, together with improved stability under continuous illumination. Analogous donor‐biased interactions, enhanced exciton diffusion, regulated fibrillar organization, and improved photovoltaic performance are also observed in PM6 and D18‐Cl systems. These results highlight the broader applicability of chemically active 2D templating for coordinating polymer donor assembly and exciton transport toward high‐performance OSCs.

papers.title_zh: 供体选择性NiCo-LDH模板引导聚合物组装增强高效有机太阳能电池中的激子传输
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出基于少层状镍钴层状双氢氧化物(NiCo-LDH)纳米片的供体选择性模板策略，调控有机太阳能电池中聚合物供体组装。富羟基NiCo-LDH表面对聚合物供体具有优先亲和力，促进供体链有序组织，将D18的激子扩散长度从10.7 nm提升至18.9 nm。D18:L8-BO器件最高效率达21.36%，独立认证21.09%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于有机太阳能电池中聚合物供体本征激子扩散长度有限，制约激子利用率提升。材料体系为少层状镍钴层状双氢氧化物(NiCo-LDH)纳米片作为模板，聚合物供体包括D18、PM6和D18-Cl，受体为L8-BO。设计策略利用富羟基NiCo-LDH表面对聚合物供体的优先亲和力，在成膜过程中促进供体链有序组织，同时对受体组分影响有限。研究过程显示该模板策略增强供体相分子有序性，使D18激子扩散长度从10.7 nm增至18.9 nm，并形成更有序的供体纤维结构；供体组织与激子传输的协同改善进一步关联到激子到电荷转化增强、载流子传输更平衡和复合抑制。意义在于证明化学活性二维模板可协调聚合物供体组装与激子传输，并具有跨体系适用性。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：制备少层状NiCo-LDH纳米片作为模板；将其引入聚合物供体成膜过程以调控供体组装；测定D18激子扩散长度；表征供体纤维结构；测试有机太阳能电池光伏性能并获得光电转换效率及独立认证效率；进行连续光照稳定性测试；在PM6和D18-Cl体系中验证策略普适性。摘要未报告NiCo-LDH的合成条件、模板添加量、薄膜制备工艺、激子扩散长度测试方法及器件结构细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与自组装技术及框架材料组装主线相关，其价值在于展示化学活性二维层状双氢氧化物模板通过供体选择性相互作用调控聚合物供体组装，并建立供体有序性—激子扩散长度—光伏性能的关联。对理解模板引导聚合物组装与激子传输协同优化具有参考意义。局限在于模板为NiCo-LDH而非共轭MOF/COF/HOF，且摘要未报告模板与聚合物界面相互作用的具体机制证据。若关注模板组装与有机光伏交叉方向，值得全文精读以核查界面作用与普适性机制细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告NiCo-LDH纳米片的合成方法与层数表征、模板添加量、薄膜制备工艺、激子扩散长度的测试方法与拟合模型、器件结构、独立认证机构信息、稳定性测试的具体光照与温度条件以及PM6和D18-Cl体系的具体性能数值，这些关键细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: NiCo-LDH模板使D18的激子扩散长度从10.7 nm提升至18.9 nm，并形成更有序的供体纤维结构。
D18:L8-BO有机太阳能电池实现最高光电转换效率21.36%，独立认证效率21.09%，并在连续光照下稳定性改善。
供体组织与激子传输的协同改善关联到激子到电荷转化增强、载流子传输更平衡和复合抑制。
在PM6和D18-Cl体系中同样观察到供体偏向相互作用、激子扩散增强、纤维组织调控和光伏性能提升。

papers.title: Self‐Reconstructing, Conductive Bismuth Organic Framework Enables Effective Alloying and High‐Capacity Potassium‐Ion Anodes
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Conversion‐type anodes can deliver high capacities for potassium‐ion batteries (PIBs), but practical deployment is hindered by severe alloying‐induced volume expansion that destabilizes electrode interphases. Meanwhile, many porous host materials are electronically insulating and require substantial carbon additives, which dilute the active mass and reduce practical capacity and kinetics. Here, we report a high‐performing PIB anode based on thin 2D crystals of an intrinsically conductive bismuth metal–organic framework (MOF) built from π‐conjugated hexahydroxytriphenylene (HHTP) ligands. Electronic coupling between the HHTP ligands and Bi nodes yields markedly higher conductivity than analogous 3D carboxylate Bi‐MOFs. Atomically accessible Bi sites on the 2D sheets enable extensive, highly confined K–Bi alloying, which drives reversible framework disassembly during potassiation and reassembly upon depotassiation, as revealed by operando X‐ray diffraction (XRD). The electrode delivers high reversible capacity from efficient alloying/dealloying, complemented by ligand‐mediated pseudocapacitive storage at higher potentials. Confinement of the alloying reaction buffers strain and limits electrode expansion by fourfold compared with Bi powder. Bi‐HHTP outperforms 3D Bi‐MOFs and conductive Cu‐, Ni‐, and Co‐HHTP analogues across all tested current densities, establishing conductive Bi‐HHTP as a top‐performing MOF‐based anode for PIBs and providing design guidelines for future alloy‐type electrodes.

papers.summary_zh: 该工作报道了由π共轭HHTP配体构建的本征导电二维铋金属有机框架薄晶体，用作钾离子电池负极。其原子级可及的Bi位点可实现高度限域的K–Bi合金化，并伴随充放电过程中的可逆框架解组装与再组装，显著缓冲应变并提升容量与倍率性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对转化型负极在钾离子电池中因合金化体积膨胀导致界面失稳、以及多孔宿主材料电子绝缘需大量碳添加剂稀释活性质量的问题，设计了一种由π共轭六羟基三亚苯（HHTP）配体与Bi节点构建的本征导电二维铋金属有机框架薄晶体。HHTP配体与Bi节点间的电子耦合使其电导率显著高于类似三维羧酸Bi-MOF。二维片层上原子级可及的Bi位点可实现广泛且高度限域的K–Bi合金化，operando XRD揭示其在钾化时驱动可逆框架解组装、去钾化时再组装。电极通过高效合金化/去合金化提供高可逆容量，并在较高电位下辅以配体介导的赝电容存储。合金反应限域缓冲了应变，使电极膨胀较Bi粉降低四倍。Bi-HHTP在所有测试电流密度下均优于三维Bi-MOF及导电Cu-、Ni-、Co-HHTP类似物，确立了导电Bi-HHTP作为顶级MOF基钾离子电池负极的地位，并为未来合金型电极提供设计准则。

papers.title: Raman Self‐Tracking Copper Metal‐Organic Framework‐Based Nanoplatform for Cuproptosis Cancer Therapy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Cuproptosis represents a promising strategy for cancer therapy, yet its clinical translation is hampered by unexpected deactivation and off‐target toxicity of copper ions during their delivery to tumors. We developed a copper metal‐organic framework‐based nanoplatform (CuF) with H 2 O 2 responsiveness and Raman self‐tracking capability for cuproptosis‐mediated antitumor therapy. CuF was prepared by coordinating Cu 2+ with an alkyne‐bearing ligand, followed by PEGylation and incorporation of an iron‐based catalyst. CuF undergoes catalyst‐mediated oxidative cleavage of alkynyl bonds under tumor‐associated elevated H 2 O 2 levels, causing CuF degradation and Cu 2+ release. Released Cu 2+ causes copper overload in tumor cells, thereby inducing potent cuproptosis. Meanwhile, the resultant aldehydes and acids generated by the oxidative cleavage of alkynes can further synergistically potentiate cuproptosis. Consequently, CuF demonstrated high antitumor efficacy in a 4T1 tumor‐bearing mouse model (with a tumor inhibition rate of 91%). Moreover, alkynes in the metal‐organic framework (MOF) backbone provided an intrinsically enhanced Raman signal, enabling label‐free self‐tracking of CuF distribution and degradation in cells and tissue sections through Raman imaging. Overall, this work not only provides a new paradigm for cuproptosis‐based anticancer agents, but also offers a versatile strategy for engineering H 2 O 2 responsive materials and Raman imaging nanoplatforms.

papers.title_zh: 拉曼自追踪铜金属有机框架纳米平台用于铜死亡癌症治疗
papers.summary_zh: 该工作构建了具有过氧化氢响应和拉曼自追踪能力的铜金属有机框架纳米平台CuF，用于铜死亡介导的抗肿瘤治疗。CuF在肿瘤高H2O2下经催化剂介导氧化裂解炔键而降解并释放Cu2+，诱导铜过载与铜死亡，同时炔键提供本征增强拉曼信号实现无标记自追踪。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对铜死亡癌症治疗中铜离子递送易失活和脱靶毒性的问题，设计了一种铜金属有机框架基纳米平台CuF。CuF通过Cu2+与含炔配体配位制备，随后进行PEG化并引入铁基催化剂。在肿瘤相关的高H2O2水平下，CuF发生催化剂介导的炔键氧化裂解，导致框架降解并释放Cu2+。释放的Cu2+引起肿瘤细胞内铜过载，从而诱导强效铜死亡。同时，炔键氧化裂解产生的醛和酸可进一步协同增强铜死亡。在4T1荷瘤小鼠模型中，CuF表现出高抗肿瘤疗效，肿瘤抑制率达91%。此外，MOF骨架中的炔键提供本征增强拉曼信号，使CuF在细胞和组织切片中的分布与降解可通过拉曼成像实现无标记自追踪。该工作为铜死亡抗癌剂提供了新范式，也为工程化H2O2响应材料和拉曼成像纳米平台提供了通用策略。

papers.title: Structure Selection in Ionic Colloidal Crystals via Independent Charge Tuning
papers.abstract: Abstract Colloidal building blocks can assemble into many different crystal structures, yet selecting a specific lattice without redesigning the particles remains a central challenge in programmable self-assembly. Here we demonstrate that independent tuning of colloidal surface charge enables deterministic structure selection using a fixed pair of oppositely charged colloids. Micromolar additions of simple ionic surfactants independently adjust the surface charge of each colloidal species without significantly altering solution ionic strength, allowing the same building blocks to assemble into Th3P4-, CsCl-, Cu3Au-, and Li3Fe-like crystals, the last of which represents a previously unreported colloidal crystal structure. Experiments and molecular dynamics simulations reveal that structure selection is governed by the competition between Coulombic attraction and lattice-specific like-charge repulsion. Experiments across different particle-size ratios further demonstrate the generality of this approach, with additional surfactant-induced transitions between Th3P4-, AlB2-, and Cr3Si-like structures. These findings establish charge asymmetry as a general design parameter for ionic colloidal assembly.

papers.title: Supramolecular Elastomer Based Switchable Adhesives Regulated by Soft Confinement Induced Nano‐Rod Crystals
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Supramolecular adhesives enable on‐demand detachment due to their dynamic nature. However, such behavior usually at the cost of limited adhesive toughness. To promote the intrinsic compromise between adhesive toughness and switchability, we propose a soft‐confinement‐regulated nanorod crystallization strategy to construct a supramolecular elastomer (PTA‐PCL). The amphiphilic and soft poly (thioctic acid) (PTA) matrix forms a dynamically confined interface through hydrogen bonding, directing the oriented self‐assembly of hydrophobic polycaprolactone glycol (PCL‐OH) into nanorod crystals with an aspect ratio of 4.80 and thereby reinforcing the network. Meanwhile, thermally triggered phase transitions drive mesoscale evolution, allowing the adhesion state to be tuned by the dynamic confinement interface. Benefiting from this hierarchical structural design, the PTA‐PCL film exhibited robust adhesion (1609.31 J m − 2 ), switchable debonding (83.7 J m − 2 ; switching ratio = 14.5), and high toughness (3.35 MJ m − 3 ). Molecular dynamics simulations indicated partial compatibility and strong interfacial interactions between PTA and PCL‐OH, while the synergistic coupling between interfacial enrichment and crystallization reinforcement was confirmed by low‐field solid‐state NMR. Overall, this study presents a new strategy for inducing nanorod crystallization within soft networks, and the superior switchable adhesion and interfacial toughness make PTA‐PCL a promising candidate for advanced adhesive materials.

papers.title_zh: 由软限域诱导纳米棒晶调控的超分子弹性体基可切换粘合剂
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出软限域调控纳米棒结晶策略，构建超分子弹性体PTA-PCL。亲水软性PTA基质通过氢键形成动态限域界面，引导疏水PCL-OH定向自组装为长径比4.80的纳米棒晶，从而增强网络。热触发相变驱动介观尺度演化，使粘附状态可由动态限域界面调控。
papers.research_details_zh: 超分子粘合剂因其动态本质可实现按需脱粘，但通常以牺牲粘附韧性为代价。为缓解粘附韧性与可切换性之间的内在矛盾，作者提出软限域调控纳米棒结晶策略，构建超分子弹性体PTA-PCL。两亲性软聚硫辛酸（PTA）基质通过氢键形成动态限域界面，引导疏水性聚己内酯二醇（PCL-OH）定向自组装为长径比4.80的纳米棒晶，从而增强网络。同时，热触发相变驱动介观尺度演化，使粘附状态可通过动态限域界面进行调控。得益于这种层级结构设计，PTA-PCL薄膜表现出稳健粘附（1609.31 J m−2）、可切换脱粘（83.7 J m−2；切换比=14.5）和高韧性（3.35 MJ m−3）。分子动力学模拟表明PTA与PCL-OH之间具有部分相容性和强界面相互作用，低场固态NMR证实了界面富集与结晶增强之间的协同耦合。该研究提出了在软网络中诱导纳米棒结晶的新策略，优异的可切换粘附与界面韧性使PTA-PCL成为先进粘合材料的候选。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成超分子弹性体PTA-PCL；通过氢键形成动态限域界面引导PCL-OH定向自组装；热触发相变调控粘附状态；测试粘附性能（粘附能、脱粘能、韧性）；分子动力学模拟分析PTA与PCL-OH的相容性和界面相互作用；低场固态NMR确认界面富集与结晶增强的协同耦合。具体合成条件、表征参数和测试细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究涉及自组装技术和超分子材料，与框架材料组装主线有一定关联，但研究对象为超分子弹性体而非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料。其软限域诱导纳米棒结晶策略和动态界面调控思路对理解限域组装有参考价值，但电化学合成和框架材料方面关联有限。若关注自组装调控粘附性能可精读，否则可作为拓展阅读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，未核查全文。关键细节如PTA-PCL的具体合成条件、纳米棒晶的表征方法、粘附测试标准、分子动力学模拟参数、低场固态NMR实验条件等仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: PTA-PCL薄膜表现出稳健粘附（1609.31 J m−2）、可切换脱粘（83.7 J m−2；切换比=14.5）和高韧性（3.35 MJ m−3）。
PCL-OH在PTA基质中定向自组装为长径比4.80的纳米棒晶。
分子动力学模拟表明PTA与PCL-OH之间具有部分相容性和强界面相互作用。
低场固态NMR证实界面富集与结晶增强之间的协同耦合。

papers.title: Architecting Mesoporous Heterojunctions via Programmable Interfacial Engineering
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Mesoporous heterojunction materials (MHJs), integrating interconnected mesopore networks with electronically polarized heterointerfaces, have delivered unparalleled advantages across diverse frontier fields. Open mesopores expose otherwise buried junctions, shorten diffusion pathways, and create confined nanospaces, while heterointerfaces generate built‐in electric fields and interfacial barriers that steer carrier migration and reaction trajectories. Despite substantial advances in mesoporous materials and heterostructures, the mesopore‐enabled amplification of heterojunction functions has not been systematically articulated. This Review reframes MHJs through the concept of effective heterojunctions, emphasizing active interface accessibility and local electronic perturbation validity as central design criteria. The mechanistic roles of mesoporosity in interfacial barrier modulation, charge utilization, and microenvironment regulation are delineated, and their manifestations across representative MHJ configurations, synthetic strategies, and applications are systematically examined. Key challenges and opportunities are also outlined in artificial intelligence (AI)‐guided predictive design, effective junction quantification, operando characterization, and scalable synthesis. This Review aims to establish a clearer guiding principle to promote MHJs progression from experience‐based material integration toward precise interface programming.

papers.title_zh: 通过可编程界面工程构筑介孔异质结
papers.summary_zh: 该综述重新审视介孔异质结材料（MHJs），提出有效异质结概念，强调活性界面可及性和局部电子扰动有效性作为核心设计准则。系统阐述介孔性在界面势垒调制、电荷利用和微环境调控中的机制作用，并检视代表性MHJ构型、合成策略和应用。
papers.research_details_zh: 介孔异质结材料（MHJs）将互连介孔网络与电子极化异质界面相结合，在多个前沿领域展现出独特优势。开放介孔暴露原本埋藏的结、缩短扩散路径并创造受限纳米空间，而异质界面产生内建电场和界面势垒，引导载流子迁移和反应轨迹。尽管介孔材料和异质结构已取得重大进展，但介孔对异质结功能的放大作用尚未被系统阐述。该综述通过有效异质结概念重新构建MHJs框架，强调活性界面可及性和局部电子扰动有效性作为核心设计准则。文中 delineates 介孔性在界面势垒调制、电荷利用和微环境调控中的机制作用，并系统检视其在代表性MHJ构型、合成策略和应用中的表现。同时概述了人工智能引导的预测设计、有效结量化、操作表征和可扩展合成方面的关键挑战与机遇。该综述旨在建立更清晰的指导原则，推动MHJs从经验型材料集成向精确界面编程发展。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要未报告具体实验方法。作为综述，其方法为文献综述和概念框架构建，涉及对介孔异质结材料的构型、合成策略和应用进行系统检视，并提出有效异质结概念。具体综述范围、文献筛选标准和案例细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述直接涉及介孔材料和异质结界面工程，与介孔材料研究主线高度相关。其提出的有效异质结概念和界面编程原则对介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料的界面设计有借鉴意义。但综述不涉及具体实验数据，若需了解介孔异质结的设计原则和前沿方向值得精读，若关注具体框架材料合成则参考有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，未核查全文。关键细节如综述涵盖的具体材料体系、合成策略分类、应用领域案例、AI引导设计的具体方法等仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 提出有效异质结概念，强调活性界面可及性和局部电子扰动有效性作为MHJs核心设计准则。
介孔性在界面势垒调制、电荷利用和微环境调控中发挥机制作用。
系统检视了代表性MHJ构型、合成策略和应用。
指出AI引导预测设计、有效结量化、操作表征和可扩展合成是未来关键方向。

papers.title: Isoreticular Covalent Organic Frameworks with Complementary Redox Cores Enable High-Voltage All-COF Sodium Dual-Ion Batteries
papers.abstract: Abstract Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) have emerged as promising electrode materials for sodium-ion batteries, combining molecular-level tunability with crystalline porous architectures and structural robustness. However, high-voltage all-COF batteries remain rare, as constructing complementary low-potential anodes and high-potential cathodes remains challenging. Herein, an isoreticular redox-core tailoring strategy is employed to construct complementary n-type and p-type COF electrodes for sodium dual-ion batteries. Two highly crystalline two-dimensional COFs with closely related architectures were synthesized using electron-deficient triazine and electron-rich triphenylamine redox cores, respectively. Triazine-based Trz-COF functions as a low-potential n-type anode that predominantly operates within 0.01–1.4 V vs. Na+/Na, whereas triphenylamine-based TPA-COF serves as a high-potential p-type cathode that predominantly operates within 3.4–4.2 V vs. Na+/Na for reversible PF6– storage. In situ spectroscopic analyses and theoretical calculations reveal that variation of the redox-active core dictates the charge-storage behavior and electrode potential, while the preserved framework architecture maintains efficient ion transport. Pairing these COFs yields a high-voltage all-COF sodium dual-ion battery operating over 2.0–4.2 V with an average discharge voltage of 3.40 V, delivering 116 mAh g–1 and retaining 76 mAh g–1 after 1000 cycles at 0.5 A g–1. This study establishes redox-core tailoring within an isoreticular COF family as a molecular design strategy for regulating electrochemical function in crystalline organic frameworks and demonstrates its application to high-voltage all-COF sodium dual-ion batteries.

papers.title_zh: 具有互补氧化还原核心的同网状共价有机框架实现高压全COF钠双离子电池
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用同网状氧化还原核心裁剪策略，构建互补n型和p型COF电极用于钠双离子电池。以缺电子三嗪和富电子三苯胺为核心合成两种高结晶二维COF。Trz-COF作为低电位n型负极，TPA-COF作为高电位p型正极。配对后全COF电池在2.0–4.2 V工作，平均放电电压3.40 V。
papers.research_details_zh: 共价有机框架（COFs）作为钠离子电池电极材料具有分子级可调性、结晶多孔结构和结构稳健性。然而高压全COF电池仍罕见，因为构建互补的低电位负极和高电位正极具有挑战性。本文采用同网状氧化还原核心裁剪策略，构建互补的n型和p型COF电极用于钠双离子电池。分别使用缺电子三嗪和富电子三苯胺氧化还原核心合成了两种高结晶二维COF，具有密切相关的结构。三嗪基Trz-COF作为低电位n型负极，主要在0.01–1.4 V vs. Na+/Na范围内工作；三苯胺基TPA-COF作为高电位p型正极，主要在3.4–4.2 V vs. Na+/Na范围内工作，用于可逆PF6–存储。原位光谱分析和理论计算表明，氧化还原活性核心的变化决定了电荷存储行为和电极电位，而保留的框架结构维持了高效离子传输。配对这些COF得到高压全COF钠双离子电池，工作电压2.0–4.2 V，平均放电电压3.40 V，在0.5 A g–1下提供116 mAh g–1，1000次循环后保持76 mAh g–1。该研究确立了同网状COF家族内的氧化还原核心裁剪作为调控结晶有机框架电化学功能的分子设计策略，并展示了其在高压全COF钠双离子电池中的应用。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：采用同网状氧化还原核心裁剪策略合成两种高结晶二维COF（Trz-COF和TPA-COF）；电化学测试评估电极电位范围和电池性能（电压、容量、循环稳定性）；原位光谱分析；理论计算。具体合成条件、表征手段、电池组装细节和测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究直接涉及共轭COF的分子设计和电化学应用，与共轭框架材料研究主线高度相关。其同网状氧化还原核心裁剪策略为调控框架材料电化学功能提供了分子设计思路，高压全COF钠双离子电池展示了COF在能源存储中的应用潜力。若关注COF电化学合成和框架材料组装，值得精读。

全COF钠双离子电池工作电压2.0–4.2 V，平均放电电压3.40 V，在0.5 A g–1下提供116 mAh g–1，1000次循环后保持76 mAh g–1。

papers.title: Ultrathin b ‐Oriented Co‐Gallate MOF Membranes for Lithium Recovery: Precise Ion Sieving via Geometry‐Confined Dehydration
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Selective K + over Li + separation is indispensable for lithium recovery from salt‐lake brines, whereas simultaneous high‐efficiency separation of K + from interfering Na + and Mg 2+ cations remains challenging for pristine MOF membranes. Herein, an ultrathin b ‐oriented Co‐gallate MOF membrane is fabricated using a gas–liquid interfacial soft‐template approach. The membrane possesses 3D interconnected zigzag subnanochannels (≈3.7 Å) that impose geometry‐confined ion dehydration, hindering the transport of Li + , Na + , and Mg 2+ far more significantly than K + , as corroborated by molecular dynamics simulations. Under a concentration gradient driving force, the u b ‐CoG membrane achieves a prominent K + /Li + selectivity of 13.5, as well as excellent K + /Na + and K + /Mg 2+ sieving capability. The recorded K + /Li + selectivity stands as the highest value among MOF ion‐sieving membranes. This interfacial orientation strategy provides a promising pathway to advanced ion‐sieving membranes for multicomponent industrial brine lithium extraction.
