papers.title_zh: 用于锂回收的超薄b取向没食子酸钴MOF膜：通过几何限域脱水实现精确离子筛分
papers.summary_zh: 该工作采用气液界面软模板法制备超薄b取向没食子酸钴MOF膜，利用约3.7 Å三维互连锯齿状亚纳米通道对离子脱水施加几何限域，实现K+优先传输，K+/Li+选择性达13.5，并兼具优异的K+/Na+和K+/Mg2+筛分能力。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对盐湖卤水锂回收中K+与Li+、Na+、Mg2+等多组分离子高效分离的难题，本研究设计并制备了一种超薄b取向没食子酸钴MOF膜。该膜通过气液界面软模板方法构筑，具有三维互连的锯齿状亚纳米通道，孔径约3.7 Å。这种几何限域结构对Li+、Na+和Mg2+的脱水与传输产生显著阻碍，而对K+的传输阻碍较小，从而在浓度梯度驱动下实现选择性离子筛分。分子动力学模拟进一步佐证了该几何限域脱水机制。该策略为面向多组分工业卤水锂提取的先进离子筛分膜提供了新途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道采用气液界面软模板法制备超薄b取向没食子酸钴MOF膜；通过分子动力学模拟研究离子在亚纳米通道中的传输与脱水行为；在浓度梯度驱动力下评估膜的K+/Li+、K+/Na+和K+/Mg2+分离性能。其他合成条件、表征手段和测试细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于介孔/亚纳米通道导电或框架膜材料与离子筛分方向，展示了通过晶体取向和界面组装调控框架膜传质选择性的策略，对MOF膜的电化学合成与组装研究具有参考价值。其定量分离结果突出，但摘要未报告膜的电化学合成、导电性及长期稳定性，值得全文精读以核查机制与实用性。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。膜的具体合成参数、表征数据、电化学性能、稳定性测试及分子动力学模拟细节等关键信息仍需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 所制备的超薄b取向没食子酸钴MOF膜具有约3.7 Å的三维互连锯齿状亚纳米通道。
在浓度梯度驱动下，该膜的K+/Li+选择性达到13.5，并具有优异的K+/Na+和K+/Mg2+筛分能力。
该K+/Li+选择性为MOF离子筛分膜中已报道的最高值。
分子动力学模拟证实，几何限域脱水对Li+、Na+和Mg2+传输的阻碍远大于K+。

papers.title: Wafer‐Scale Multidimensional‐Topology COFs for Highly Reliable Neuromorphic Electronics
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid synthesis and scalable design strategies of high‐reliability multi‐dimensional and multi‐topological covalent organic frameworks (MDT COFs) are of great significance for meeting the diverse technological application requirements with highly differential specific demands, especially in neuromorphic electronics. Here, we introduce aniline into a sonochemical synthesis platform, where thermodynamic‐kinetic synergistic control expands topological diversity and substrate compatibility. We synthesized 37 COFs covering 1D to 3D, including 10 previously unreported frameworks. Relying on a parallel optimization strategy involving geometric‐electronic co‐engineering, a 3D TAPPFe‐Cu 3 COF‐based wafer‐scale memristor incorporating multiple metal and redox centers is designed and applied to shortest‐path optimization in the Shanghai metro network, exhibiting an 80.1% reduction in energy consumption, 78.6% faster synaptic weight reset, and a 9.36‐fold improvement in TDDB lifetime compared with state‐of‐the‐art COF‐based devices. This synthetic methodology and material design strategy provide a robust foundation for application‐tailored high‐reliability COFs, while opening new avenues for diversified utilization of MDT COFs.

papers.title_zh: 晶圆级多维拓扑COF用于高可靠神经形态电子器件
papers.summary_zh: 该工作将苯胺引入声化学合成平台，通过热力学-动力学协同控制拓展COF拓扑多样性，合成37种1D至3D COF，并基于3D TAPPFe-Cu3 COF构建晶圆级忆阻器，在最短路径优化中显著降低能耗、加快突触权重复位并提升TDDB寿命。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对神经形态电子器件对高可靠性、多维度和多拓扑COF的迫切需求，本研究将苯胺引入声化学合成平台，利用热力学-动力学协同控制策略拓展拓扑多样性和基底兼容性，合成了37种覆盖1D至3D的COF，其中10种为此前未报道的框架。基于几何-电子协同工程的并行优化策略，设计并制备了含多种金属和氧化还原中心的3D TAPPFe-Cu3 COF基晶圆级忆阻器，并将其应用于上海地铁网络最短路径优化。该器件相比当前最先进的COF基器件，能耗降低80.1%，突触权重复位速度提升78.6%，TDDB寿命提高9.36倍。该合成方法与材料设计策略为应用定制的高可靠COF提供了基础。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道采用声化学合成平台，引入苯胺并通过热力学-动力学协同控制合成多维拓扑COF；采用几何-电子协同工程的并行优化策略设计材料；制备3D TAPPFe-Cu3 COF基晶圆级忆阻器；以最短路径优化任务评估器件性能，并测试能耗、突触权重复位速度和TDDB寿命。其他表征与测试细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于共轭COF的合成方法学与器件应用方向，展示了声化学合成、拓扑多样性和晶圆级集成在神经形态电子学中的潜力，对框架材料的可扩展组装和电学性能调控具有参考价值。其定量器件指标突出，但摘要未报告COF的导电机制、合成条件及器件制备细节，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。COF的具体合成条件、结构表征、器件制备工艺、导电机制及稳定性测试细节等关键信息仍需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 通过声化学平台和热力学-动力学协同控制，合成了37种1D至3D COF，其中10种为此前未报道的框架。
基于3D TAPPFe-Cu3 COF构建了晶圆级忆阻器，并成功应用于上海地铁网络最短路径优化。
相比最先进COF基器件，该器件能耗降低80.1%，突触权重复位速度提升78.6%，TDDB寿命提高9.36倍。
几何-电子协同工程的并行优化策略实现了含多种金属和氧化还原中心的高性能COF器件设计。

papers.title: Microstructured Metal Electrodeposition at a Micellar Brush‐Decorated Interface
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Metal electrodeposition is usually interfered by stochastic ion arrival, local field amplification, and uncontrolled crystal growth, rendering it difficult to translate molecular‐level interfacial design into prescribed mesoscale architectures. Here, we report that surface‐emanated micellar brush with a forest‐like soft architecture can finely modulate the orientation and microstructure of metal electrodeposition. The poly( l ‐lactic acid)‐b‐poly(2‐vinylpyridine) micellar brush provides a hierarchically open nanoarray platform for continuous accumulation of metal ions through dynamical coordination with the pyridyl‐rich corona and sustained deposition of reduced metal at the inter‐micellar voids. Unlike conventional homopolymer coatings that mainly lead to flat deposition of Zn, such micellar‐brush layer promotes vertically aligned zinc blades through coupled ion funneling and oriented nanoconfinement. The resulting zinc anode reveals a low nucleation overpotential of ∼21 mV, a high Zn 2+ transference number of 0.79, a rapid rate of ∼24.2 µm h −1 at 10 mA cm −2 , and a polarization of only 18 mV upon reversible plating/stripping over 3000 h. The full cells integrated by vertically microstructured Zn anode with V 2 O 5 cathode retain 89.6% capacity after 1000 cycles at 1 A g −1 . This work establishes a general route to tailored metal microstructures through softly confined electrodeposition across a spatially directing and chemically associating polymer self‐assembly interfaces.
papers.recommendation: 同时命中电化学合成、组装与结晶，建议优先检查其合成路径与孔结构证据。
papers.title_zh: 胶束刷修饰界面上的微结构金属电沉积
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用聚左旋乳酸-b-聚(2-乙烯基吡啶)胶束刷构建森林状软界面，调控锌电沉积的取向与微结构，获得垂直排列锌片，并显著提升锌负极电化学性能与全电池循环稳定性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对金属电沉积中随机离子到达、局域场增强和不可控晶体生长导致难以将分子级界面设计转化为预设介观结构的问题，提出以表面发射的胶束刷作为软约束界面。材料体系为聚左旋乳酸-b-聚(2-乙烯基吡啶)胶束刷，其富吡啶冠层可通过动态配位持续富集金属离子，胶束间空隙则作为还原金属的沉积位点。与主要导致锌平坦沉积的传统均聚物涂层不同，该胶束刷层通过离子漏斗效应与定向纳米限域耦合，促进垂直排列锌片的形成。所得锌负极表现出低成核过电位、高锌离子迁移数、快速沉积速率和长时可逆镀覆/剥离稳定性，与五氧化二钒正极集成的全电池也保持较高容量保持率。该工作为通过空间导向且化学缔合的聚合物自组装界面实现软限域电沉积、定制金属微结构提供了通用路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及：采用聚左旋乳酸-b-聚(2-乙烯基吡啶)胶束刷修饰界面；通过动态配位富集金属离子并在胶束间空隙进行还原金属沉积；进行金属电沉积；测试锌负极成核过电位、锌离子迁移数、沉积速率、可逆镀覆/剥离极化；组装以五氧化二钒为正极的全电池并进行循环性能测试。其他合成细节、表征手段和测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与自组装技术、电化学合成及框架材料组装主线中的软界面调控和电沉积相关，但研究对象是聚合物胶束刷而非MOF/COF/HOF框架材料。其价值在于展示自组装软界面如何调控金属微结构并改善电化学性能，可为电化学沉积与界面组装提供思路；若关注框架材料本身，相关性有限，建议按拓展推荐选择性精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。胶束刷的具体合成条件、分子量、形貌表征、电化学测试细节、全电池组装参数及机制验证证据仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 胶束刷层促进垂直排列锌片形成，而传统均聚物涂层主要导致锌平坦沉积。
所得锌负极具有约21 mV的低成核过电位、0.79的高锌离子迁移数、10 mA cm−2下约24.2 µm h−1的沉积速率，以及3000 h可逆镀覆/剥离中仅18 mV的极化。
与五氧化二钒正极集成的全电池在1 A g−1下循环1000次后容量保持89.6%。
机制归因于富吡啶冠层动态配位富集金属离子与胶束间空隙定向纳米限域的耦合。

papers.title: Raman Self‐Tracking Copper Metal‐Organic Framework‐Based Nanoplatform for Cuproptosis Cancer Therapy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Cuproptosis represents a promising strategy for cancer therapy, yet its clinical translation is hampered by unexpected deactivation and off‐target toxicity of copper ions during their delivery to tumors. We developed a copper metal‐organic framework‐based nanoplatform (CuF) with H 2 O 2 responsiveness and Raman self‐tracking capability for cuproptosis‐mediated antitumor therapy. CuF was prepared by coordinating Cu 2+ with an alkyne‐bearing ligand, followed by PEGylation and incorporation of an iron‐based catalyst. CuF undergoes catalyst‐mediated oxidative cleavage of alkynyl bonds under tumor‐associated elevated H 2 O 2 levels, causing CuF degradation and Cu 2+ release. Released Cu 2+ causes copper overload in tumor cells, thereby inducing potent cuproptosis. Meanwhile, the resultant aldehydes and acids generated by the oxidative cleavage of alkynes can further synergistically potentiate cuproptosis. Consequently, CuF demonstrated high antitumor efficacy in a 4T1 tumor‐bearing mouse model (with a tumor inhibition rate of 91%). Moreover, alkynes in the metal‐organic framework (MOF) backbone provided an intrinsically enhanced Raman signal, enabling label‐free self‐tracking of CuF distribution and degradation in cells and tissue sections through Raman imaging. Overall, this work not only provides a new paradigm for cuproptosis‐based anticancer agents, but also offers a versatile strategy for engineering H 2 O 2 responsive materials and Raman imaging nanoplatforms.

papers.title_zh: 用于铜死亡癌症治疗的拉曼自追踪铜金属有机框架纳米平台
papers.summary_zh: 该研究构建含炔基配体的铜金属有机框架纳米平台CuF，利用肿瘤相关过氧化氢触发降解并释放铜离子，诱导铜死亡，同时借助炔基拉曼信号实现无标记自追踪，在4T1小鼠模型中显示高抑瘤效果。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对铜死亡癌症治疗中铜离子递送易失活和脱靶毒性的问题，开发了具有过氧化氢响应性和拉曼自追踪能力的铜金属有机框架纳米平台CuF。CuF通过铜离子与含炔基配体配位制备，随后进行聚乙二醇化和铁基催化剂引入。在肿瘤相关升高的过氧化氢水平下，CuF发生催化剂介导的炔基键氧化断裂，导致框架降解并释放铜离子。释放的铜离子造成肿瘤细胞内铜过载，诱导铜死亡；同时炔基氧化断裂产生的醛和酸可协同增强铜死亡效应。CuF在4T1荷瘤小鼠模型中表现出高抗肿瘤效果，抑瘤率为91%。此外，金属有机框架骨架中的炔基提供内在增强拉曼信号，可通过拉曼成像对CuF在细胞和组织切片中的分布与降解进行无标记自追踪。该工作为铜死亡抗癌剂、过氧化氢响应材料和拉曼成像纳米平台提供了策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及：铜离子与含炔基配体配位制备CuF；聚乙二醇化并引入铁基催化剂；利用肿瘤相关升高过氧化氢触发炔基键氧化断裂；在4T1荷瘤小鼠模型中评价抗肿瘤效果；利用金属有机框架骨架中炔基的内在增强拉曼信号，通过拉曼成像追踪CuF在细胞和组织切片中的分布与降解。其他合成条件、表征方法和测试细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于金属有机框架材料在生物医学中的应用，涉及MOF降解、刺激响应释放和拉曼成像，但与介孔导电MOF、共轭MOF/COF/HOF、框架材料电化学合成等主线关联较弱。其价值在于展示含炔基MOF作为响应性纳米平台和自追踪工具，可为功能框架材料设计提供参考；若关注能源电化学或导电框架，相关性有限，建议按高质量框架推荐选择性浏览。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。CuF的具体配体结构、催化剂种类、过氧化氢响应阈值、铜死亡机制验证、拉曼成像参数及动物实验细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: CuF通过铜离子与含炔基配体配位制备，并经聚乙二醇化和铁基催化剂引入。
在肿瘤相关升高过氧化氢条件下，CuF发生催化剂介导炔基键氧化断裂，导致降解和铜离子释放。
释放铜离子引起肿瘤细胞铜过载并诱导铜死亡，炔基氧化断裂产生的醛和酸可协同增强铜死亡。
CuF在4T1荷瘤小鼠模型中抑瘤率为91%，并可通过炔基拉曼信号实现无标记自追踪。

papers.title: Interface‐Induced Growth of Macroscopic, Free‐Standing, and Flexible Monolithic Pure MOF Membrane With Adaptive Porosity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Membrane‐based separation technologies have emerged as energy‐efficient and environmentally sustainable alternatives to traditional industrial separation processes. However, the development of high‐performance separation membranes faces fundamental material challenges, as amorphous polymeric materials typically exhibit poorly controlled pore size distributions while crystalline porous materials encounter intrinsic difficulties in forming continuous, defect‐free membranes at the macroscopic scale owing to inevitable crystal boundaries. Despite their exceptional structural tunability and separation potential, MOF membranes face fundamental challenges in defect‐free fabrication due to intrinsic crystallinity constraints. Integrating the structural precision of crystalline MOFs with the adaptivity of polymers, we successfully fabricated a macroscopic, free‐standing, and flexible monolithic pure MOF membrane through interface‐induced coordination of Co 2+ with the flexible multidentate amino acid ligand 2,6‐diaminopimelic acid (DAP). The flexible alkyl‐chain backbone suppresses long‐range crystallization and reduces interfacial strain during continuous membrane growth. Locally defined Co–amino‐acid coordination units preserve a framework scaffold, while conformationally flexible alkyl segments impart guest‐responsive latent free volume. The flexible Co‐DAP membrane exhibits guest‐responsive dynamic porosity, in which hydration generates water‐accessible transport pathways that regulate hydrated‐state molecular and ionic transport, enabling osmotically driven water/ion separation through coupled transport and interfacial electrostatic effects under conditions relevant to forward osmosis.

papers.title_zh: 界面诱导生长宏观、自支撑、柔性单片纯MOF膜及其自适应孔隙
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过界面诱导钴离子与柔性多齿氨基酸配体2,6-二氨基庚二酸配位，制备宏观、自支撑、柔性单片纯MOF膜，该膜具有客体响应动态孔隙，可实现水合态分子和离子传输及渗透驱动水/离子分离。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对高性能分离膜的材料挑战：无定形聚合物孔径分布控制差，而结晶多孔材料因晶界不可避免难以形成宏观连续无缺陷膜。尽管MOF膜具有结构可调性和分离潜力，但其固有结晶性导致无缺陷制备困难。该工作将结晶MOF的结构精确性与聚合物的适应性结合，通过界面诱导钴离子与柔性多齿氨基酸配体2,6-二氨基庚二酸配位，成功制备宏观、自支撑、柔性单片纯MOF膜。柔性烷基链骨架抑制长程结晶并降低连续膜生长过程中的界面应变。局部定义的钴-氨基酸配位单元保持框架支架，而构象灵活的烷基链段赋予客体响应潜自由体积。柔性Co-DAP膜表现客体响应动态孔隙：水合作用产生水可接近的传输通道，调节水合态分子和离子传输，在与正渗透相关条件下通过耦合传输和界面静电效应实现渗透驱动水/离子分离。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及：通过界面诱导Co2+与柔性多齿氨基酸配体2,6-二氨基庚二酸进行配位，制备宏观、自支撑、柔性单片纯MOF膜；利用柔性烷基链骨架抑制长程结晶并降低界面应变；研究膜的水合响应动态孔隙；评估水合态分子和离子传输；在与正渗透相关条件下测试渗透驱动水/离子分离。其他合成条件、表征手段和性能数值摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料组装与膜制备，涉及MOF膜的界面诱导生长、柔性配体设计和自适应孔隙，与框架材料组装主线相关。其价值在于展示如何通过柔性配体抑制结晶缺陷并赋予MOF膜客体响应传输性能，可为MOF膜和自适应多孔材料设计提供参考；但未涉及导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，建议按高质量框架推荐选择性精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。Co-DAP膜的具体合成条件、膜厚度、机械性能、孔径数据、分离选择性、通量及正渗透测试细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过界面诱导Co2+与柔性多齿氨基酸配体DAP配位，制备了宏观、自支撑、柔性单片纯MOF膜。
柔性烷基链骨架抑制长程结晶并降低连续膜生长中的界面应变，局部Co-氨基酸配位单元保持框架支架。
柔性Co-DAP膜具有客体响应动态孔隙，水合作用产生水可接近传输通道，调节水合态分子和离子传输。
该膜在与正渗透相关条件下通过耦合传输和界面静电效应实现渗透驱动水/离子分离。

papers.title: Sidechain Modulation of Responsive Metal‐Organic Framework Pore Chirality for Enhanced Enantioseparation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The selective separation of enantiomers is important for industrial technologies such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and agrochemicals. Chiral porous materials have been used as the stationary phase for the chromatographic separation of enantiomers; however, they lack synthetic and performance designability. Here we present a new chiral metal‐organic framework with excellent chromatographic enantioseparation performance for a family of aromatic chiral molecules. This material has been developed by diversifying the amino acid sidechains appended to an underlying common structural framework. The structure of the framework places the bulky isopropyl sidechain of L ‐valine in the one‐dimensional pore channels characteristic of the materials family, modulating the accessible space to emphasize the helical shape of the channels. The dimensions of the pores are adapted to those of guests, through conformational flexibility directed by the sidechain, creating appropriate adsorption sites for functionalized aromatic guests. This porous framework affords superior enantioseparation performance compared to the same underlying framework decorated with the shorter methyl sidechain. These results demonstrate that the structure and porosity of dynamic chiral metal‐organic frameworks can be tailored using amino acid‐derived linkers and enhance the enantiomeric separations through stimulation of conformational flexibility.

papers.title_zh: 响应性金属有机框架孔道手性的侧链调控用于增强对映体分离
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过氨基酸侧链调控手性金属有机框架的孔道手性，利用L-缬氨酸的异丙基侧链在一维孔道中塑造螺旋通道，增强了对芳香族手性分子的色谱对映体分离性能，优于短甲基侧链的同类框架。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对手性多孔材料在色谱对映体分离中缺乏合成与性能可设计性的问题，提出通过多样化氨基酸侧链来调控手性金属有机框架的孔道手性。材料体系基于同一底层结构框架，分别装饰L-缬氨酸的异丙基侧链和较短的甲基侧链。结构分析表明，体积较大的异丙基侧链位于该材料家族特征性的一维孔道中，调节了可及空间，突出了孔道的螺旋形状。侧链导向的构象柔性使孔道尺寸适应客体分子尺寸，为功能化芳香族客体创造了合适的吸附位点。该多孔框架对一系列芳香族手性分子表现出优异的色谱对映体分离性能，且优于短甲基侧链修饰的同类框架。研究意义在于证明动态手性金属有机框架的结构和孔隙率可通过氨基酸衍生连接体进行定制，并通过刺激构象柔性增强对映体分离。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成基于同一底层结构框架、分别装饰L-缬氨酸异丙基侧链和甲基侧链的手性金属有机框架；利用色谱法进行对映体分离性能测试；通过结构分析确认侧链在一维孔道中的位置及孔道螺旋形状的调制。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征手段、色谱参数及定量分离数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联手性框架材料的孔道工程与对映体分离应用，展示了通过氨基酸侧链调控孔道手性和构象柔性的设计策略，对介孔导电MOF及框架材料组装主线具有方法学参考价值。其局限在于摘要未提供定量分离性能数据及具体表征细节，建议全文精读以获取完整实验证据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段、色谱参数、定量分离数据及构象柔性的直接证据，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: L-缬氨酸的异丙基侧链位于一维孔道中，调节可及空间并突出孔道的螺旋形状。
侧链导向的构象柔性使孔道尺寸适应客体分子，为功能化芳香族客体创造合适吸附位点。
异丙基侧链修饰的框架对一系列芳香族手性分子的色谱对映体分离性能优于短甲基侧链修饰的同类框架。

papers.title: Self‐Assembly of a Colloidal Honeycomb Crystal in Silico for Topological Valley Photonics
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The quest to employ colloidal self‐assembly as a scalable means of fabricating photonic crystals with a complete photonic band gap at optical frequencies has proved challenging throughout the first quarter of the 21st century. Meanwhile, the field of topological photonics has emerged, presenting new, and largely unexploited, functionalities for self‐assembled colloidal materials. The robustness of topological photonic properties to defects that are practically unavoidable in self‐assembled colloidal structures appears to be especially attractive. Here, the self‐assembly of a colloidal honeycomb crystal is demonstrated in computer simulations, with an assembly strategy that not only suppresses the formation of real‐space topological defects observed in experiments but also results in topological photonic properties in reciprocal space. This assembly strategy promotes the emergence of long‐range order and allows for the breaking of spatial inversion symmetry with two distinct sub‐lattices. A sufficient dielectric contrast between the colloidal particles sitting on these two sub‐lattices is exploited to realize a valley‐Hall topological photonic phase, allowing for unidirectional propagation of circularly polarized light through waveguides composed of the designer crystals. The design rules are tested for their robustness to open the door to scalable fabrication of topological photonic devices via colloidal self‐assembly.

papers.title_zh: 胶体蜂窝晶体的计算机模拟自组装用于拓扑谷光子学
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过计算机模拟实现胶体蜂窝晶体的自组装，采用抑制实空间拓扑缺陷的组装策略，促进长程有序并打破空间反演对称性，利用两个亚晶格上胶体颗粒的介电对比实现谷霍尔拓扑光子相，支持圆偏振光单向传播。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对胶体自组装制备光学频率完全光子带隙光子晶体长期面临的挑战，以及拓扑光子学为自组装胶体材料提供的新功能机遇。研究体系为胶体蜂窝晶体，通过计算机模拟展示其自组装过程。组装策略不仅抑制了实验中观察到的实空间拓扑缺陷形成，还在倒空间产生拓扑光子性质。该策略促进长程有序的出现，并允许具有两个不同亚晶格的空间反演对称性破缺。利用位于两个亚晶格上的胶体颗粒之间足够的介电对比，实现谷霍尔拓扑光子相，使圆偏振光能够通过由设计晶体组成的波导单向传播。研究测试了设计规则对开放性的鲁棒性，为通过胶体自组装可规模化制备拓扑光子器件打开了大门。

papers.title: Internal Electric Field‐Regulated Dual‐Site Fe–Re Supramolecular Assembly for Photocatalytic CO 2 Reduction Toward Multicarbon Products
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Photocatalytic CO 2 reduction to multicarbon products remains challenging because C–C coupling is kinetically demanding and often limited by inefficient charge separation and poor control over reaction intermediates. Herein, a heterobimetallic supramolecular catalyst (Fe–Re SA) is constructed via electrostatic self‐assembly between a porphyrinic FeTCPP unit and a molecular Rebpy complex. Structural and spectroscopic analyses confirm that the Fe–N 4 and Re(I) carbonyl coordination environments remain preserved after assembly, while density functional theory (DFT)‐supported interfacial charge redistribution induces an internal electric field that promotes directional charge transfer and suppresses carrier recombination. In situ diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy (DRIFTS) reveals * CO‐related and C–C coupling‐related features, supporting a tandem catalytic mechanism in which the Re site catalyzes CO generation and the Fe‐centered porphyrin promotes subsequent C–C coupling. As a result, Fe–Re SA exhibits enhanced photocatalytic CO 2 reduction toward multicarbon products, achieving a C 2 H 4 formation rate of 4967 µmol g −1 h −1 with a total C 2 selectivity of 57.2% (C 2 H 4 selectivity of 47.5%) among carbon‐containing products. The catalyst also maintains decent activity under low CO 2 concentration (3% CO 2 in Ar) and under natural sunlight irradiation, highlighting its potential for practical solar‐driven CO 2 conversion.

papers.title_zh: 内电场调控的双位点Fe–Re超分子组装体用于光催化CO2还原制多碳产物

papers.title: Mesoporous Silica-Supported MOF Composites for CO2 Capture: Fabrication, Synergistic Effects, and Limitations
papers.abstract: The continuous rise in atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) concentration poses a severe challenge to the global climate, creating an urgent need for the development of efficient, stable, and economically viable carbon-capture technologies. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), with their ultra-high specific surface area and tunable pore architecture, have demonstrated significant potential for CO2 adsorption. However, single MOF materials are typically constrained by limitations such as high mass transfer resistance, poor hydrothermal stability, and difficulties in processing their powdered form. Coupling MOF with ordered mesoporous silica (MS) to construct hierarchical MOF@MS composite materials has been proven to be an effective strategy for overcoming these shortcomings. This review systematically summarizes the recent research progress on mesoporous silica-supported MOF composite materials for CO2 capture. First, an architecture-based taxonomy is established in which every composite is assigned according to five decision rules—nucleation site, synthesis sequence, spatial arrangement of the two phases, interfacial bonding, and the intended role of the mesoporous silica—and six architecture classes are distinguished; systems that lack either a crystalline MOF phase or a siliceous mesoporous phase (MOF-on-MOF hybrids, wood-supported MOF, and amine-loaded silica) are explicitly excluded from the comparative analysis. Second, the principles, advantages, and drawbacks of the individual preparation routes, including in situ growth, confined growth, layer-by-layer assembly, post-synthetic assembly, selective etching, physical mixing, and macroscopic shaping, are discussed in detail and mapped onto that taxonomy. Third, the multiple synergistic adsorption mechanisms between mesoporous silica and MOF are deeply analyzed, encompassing the optimization of mass transfer by hierarchical pore structures, the enhancement of active site accessibility and stability through interfacial bonding, and the improvement of CO2 selectivity via functional group modification. On this basis, this review objectively examines the core challenges and limitations currently faced in this field, such as pore blockage, weak interfacial interactions, performance degradation under realistic flue-gas conditions (containing moisture and impurities), and high costs associated with large-scale preparation. Finally, to address these issues, future research directions are proposed from five perspectives: developing novel stable composite materials, optimizing green scalable synthesis processes, deepening multi-scale theoretical simulations, establishing standardized evaluation systems oriented toward realistic operating conditions, and exploring multifunctional integrated and stimuli-responsive materials. This review aims to provide focused and systematic guidance for the rational design of next-generation MOF@MS adsorbents for CO2 capture with high performance, low cost, and enhanced stability by elucidating the specific structure–performance mechanisms and practical limitations that are frequently overlooked in general surveys.

papers.title_zh: 用于二氧化碳捕集的介孔二氧化硅负载MOF复合材料：制备、协同效应与局限
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了介孔二氧化硅负载MOF复合材料用于CO2捕集的研究进展，建立了基于结构的分类体系，归纳了多种制备路线与协同吸附机制，并客观分析了孔道堵塞、界面作用弱、实际烟气条件下性能下降及规模化成本高等核心挑战与未来方向。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题为单一MOF材料在CO2吸附中受传质阻力大、水热稳定性差及粉末加工困难等限制，如何通过与有序介孔二氧化硅耦合构建分级MOF@MS复合材料加以克服。设计策略是建立基于结构的分类学，依据成核位点、合成顺序、两相空间排布、界面键合及介孔硅预期角色五条决策规则，将复合材料划分为六类结构，并明确排除缺乏晶态MOF相或硅质介孔相体系。研究过程包括讨论原位生长、限域生长、层层组装、后合成组装、选择性刻蚀、物理混合和宏观成型等制备路线的原理、优势与不足，并映射到该分类体系；深入分析分级孔结构优化传质、界面键合增强活性位点可及性与稳定性、官能团修饰提升CO2选择性等协同吸附机制。意义在于为高性能、低成本、高稳定性下一代MOF@MS吸附剂的理性设计提供系统指导。
papers.methods_zh: 该文为综述，摘要未报告具体实验方法。摘要明确涉及的内容包括：基于成核位点、合成顺序、两相空间排布、界面键合及介孔硅预期角色五条决策规则建立结构分类学；讨论原位生长、限域生长、层层组装、后合成组装、选择性刻蚀、物理混合和宏观成型等制备路线；分析分级孔传质优化、界面键合与官能团修饰等协同吸附机制。具体合成条件、表征手段和性能测试方法摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与介孔材料、MOF框架材料及组装主线高度相关，其结构分类学和制备路线归纳对框架材料组装研究具有直接参考价值，协同机制分析有助于理解介孔—微孔分级结构设计。局限在于为综述而非原始研究，未提供新实验数据。建议全文精读以获取分类细节、各制备路线对比及实际工况限制的系统讨论。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属摘要级解读。分类体系的具体判定标准、六类结构的详细定义、各制备路线的对比数据、协同机制的具体证据、性能数值及实际烟气测试条件等关键细节均需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 建立了基于五条决策规则、区分六类结构的MOF@MS复合材料分类体系，并明确排除MOF-on-MOF杂化物、木材负载MOF和胺负载二氧化硅等缺乏晶态MOF相或硅质介孔相的体系。
系统归纳了原位生长、限域生长、层层组装、后合成组装、选择性刻蚀、物理混合和宏观成型等制备路线的原理、优势与不足，并将其映射到结构分类体系。
阐明了介孔二氧化硅与MOF之间的多重协同吸附机制，包括分级孔结构优化传质、界面键合增强活性位点可及性与稳定性、官能团修饰提升CO2选择性。
指出该领域核心挑战包括孔道堵塞、界面相互作用弱、含湿气和杂质的实际烟气条件下性能下降以及大规模制备成本高。

papers.title: Metal‐Templated Dynamic Reorganization of Macrocyclic Gold Complexes Toward an N ‐Doped Cycloparaphenylene Catenane
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Self‐assembly based on a single dynamic bond smoothly converges on its thermodynamic product, but this does not extend to an interlocked architecture composed of strained, fully π ‐conjugated rings such as [ n ]cycloparaphenylenes ([ n ]CPPs), because assembling such an architecture requires forming the interlocked topology and reorganizing the rigid backbone at the same time. Herein, we report that two dynamic processes designed to operate orthogonally, reversible Au(I)─C σ ‐bond exchange and exchangeable Cu(I)─N coordination, can be coupled to promote metal‐templated dynamic reorganization. This process leads to the formation of an interlocked metal‐complex precursor, which reductive elimination then converts into a [2]catenane composed of two mechanically interlocked, fully π‐conjugated, nitrogen‐doped [12]CPP‐based nanohoops. Computational analyses provide insight into possible Cu(I)‐templated intermediates involved in the formation of the interlocked structure. The embedded sp 2 nitrogen atoms further provide coordination sites for guest‐dependent biasing of the co‐conformational mechanical helical chirality. This work establishes dynamic metal‐templated reorganization as a strategy for constructing strained, topologically complex π‐conjugated architectures beyond the reach of conventional single‐interaction self‐assembly.

papers.title_zh: 金属模板化大环金配合物的动态重组构建氮掺杂环对亚苯基索烃
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将可逆Au(I)—C σ键交换与可交换Cu(I)—N配位两种正交动态过程耦合，实现金属模板化动态重组，先形成互锁金属配合物前体，再经还原消除转化为由两个机械互锁、全π共轭氮掺杂[12]CPP基纳米环构成的[2]索烃，并利用嵌入的sp2氮原子实现客体依赖的机械螺旋手性偏置。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于，基于单一动态键的自组装可顺利收敛至热力学产物，但难以扩展到由张力性、全π共轭环（如[n]环对亚苯基）构成的互锁结构，因为此类组装需同时形成互锁拓扑并重组刚性骨架。设计策略是让两种正交动态过程协同运作：可逆Au(I)—C σ键交换与可交换Cu(I)—N配位，以促进金属模板化动态重组。研究过程为：该过程先形成互锁金属配合物前体，随后通过还原消除转化为[2]索烃，该索烃由两个机械互锁、全π共轭、氮掺杂的[12]CPP基纳米环组成；计算分析为形成互锁结构过程中可能的Cu(I)模板中间体提供了见解。嵌入的sp2氮原子进一步为客体依赖的共构象机械螺旋手性偏置提供配位位点。该工作确立了动态金属模板化重组作为构建超出常规单相互作用自组装能力的张力性、拓扑复杂π共轭结构的策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及的方法包括：利用可逆Au(I)—C σ键交换与可交换Cu(I)—N配位两种正交动态过程进行金属模板化动态重组；通过还原消除将互锁金属配合物前体转化为[2]索烃；采用计算分析探究可能的Cu(I)模板中间体。具体合成条件、表征手段及手性偏置测试方法摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与共轭框架材料、自组装技术及框架材料组装主线相关，其正交动态过程耦合与金属模板化重组策略对构建拓扑复杂π共轭结构具有方法学启发。局限在于研究对象为离散索烃分子而非扩展框架材料，与介孔导电MOF/COF/HOF主线关联较间接。若关注动态金属模板组装与共轭纳米环拓扑构建，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属摘要级解读。两种动态过程的具体反应条件、互锁前体与[2]索烃的结构表征证据、计算中间体的具体构型、手性偏置的定量结果及产率等关键细节均需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 可逆Au(I)—C σ键交换与可交换Cu(I)—N配位两种正交动态过程可耦合，实现金属模板化动态重组。
该过程形成互锁金属配合物前体，经还原消除转化为由两个机械互锁、全π共轭、氮掺杂[12]CPP基纳米环构成的[2]索烃。
计算分析为形成互锁结构过程中可能的Cu(I)模板中间体提供了见解。
嵌入的sp2氮原子为客体依赖的共构象机械螺旋手性偏置提供配位位点。

papers.title: Fabrication of nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon with a three-dimensional bicontinuous double gyroid structure via P4VP-b-PTFEMA/resol self-assembly
papers.abstract: Abstract Double gyroid-structured porous carbons are attractive because their bicontinuous networks provide efficient transport pathways. However, the fabrication of such structures remains challenging owing to the narrow compositional window of the double gyroid phase and the difficulty in preserving the morphology during carbonization. In this study, nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon (NMC) with a double gyroid structure was fabricated through the self-assembly of poly(4-vinylpyridine)- block -poly(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl methacrylate) (P4VP- b -PTFEMA) and phenol-formaldehyde resol. By systematically varying the resol content, morphology transitions from lamellar to double gyroid and cylindrical structures were observed, enabling access to the otherwise narrow double gyroid-forming region. The double gyroid morphology was retained after carbonization at 900 °C, yielding NMCs with ordered bicontinuous nanostructures. Furthermore, the optimized composition was scaled up while maintaining the double gyroid framework, yielding a mesoporous NMC with a pore diameter of 7.1 nm. More importantly, the results of the present study demonstrate that the selective incorporation of low-molecular-weight resol can effectively manipulate the self-assembled morphology of block copolymer systems, enabling access to the double gyroid phase and stabilization of the bicontinuous nanostructure during carbonization. These findings provide new insights into morphology control in block copolymer/additive systems and demonstrate how self-assembled polymer nanostructures can be translated into complex porous carbon architectures.

papers.title_zh: 通过P4VP-b-PTFEMA/酚醛树脂自组装制备三维双连续双螺旋结构氮掺杂介孔碳
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过聚(4-乙烯基吡啶)-嵌段-聚(2,2,2-三氟乙基甲基丙烯酸酯)与酚醛树脂自组装制备氮掺杂介孔碳，系统改变树脂含量实现层状至双螺旋及柱状形貌转变，900摄氏度碳化后保留双螺旋形貌，优化组成放大后获得孔径7.1纳米的介孔氮掺杂碳。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于双螺旋结构多孔碳因双连续网络可提供高效传输通道而具吸引力，但其制备受限于双螺旋相狭窄的组成窗口以及碳化过程中形貌难以保持。材料体系为聚(4-乙烯基吡啶)-嵌段-聚(2,2,2-三氟乙基甲基丙烯酸酯)（P4VP-b-PTFEMA）与酚醛树脂（resol）的自组装体系。设计策略是通过系统改变resol含量调控自组装形貌，从而进入原本狭窄的双螺旋形成区域。研究过程为：随resol含量变化观察到从层状到双螺旋及柱状结构的形貌转变；在900摄氏度碳化后双螺旋形貌得以保留，得到具有有序双连续纳米结构的氮掺杂介孔碳；进一步在保持双螺旋骨架的前提下对优化组成进行放大，获得孔径为7.1纳米的介孔氮掺杂碳。结果表明，选择性引入低分子量resol可有效调控嵌段共聚物体系的自组装形貌，进入双螺旋相并在碳化过程中稳定双连续纳米结构。该发现为嵌段共聚物/添加剂体系的形貌控制提供新见解，并展示如何将自组装聚合物纳米结构转化为复杂多孔碳结构。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及的方法包括：以P4VP-b-PTFEMA与酚醛树脂resol进行自组装；通过系统改变resol含量调控形貌；在900摄氏度下碳化；对优化组成进行放大制备；获得孔径7.1纳米的介孔氮掺杂碳。具体自组装条件、形貌表征手段、碳化气氛及孔径测试方法摘要未报告。

papers.title: From Trial-and-Error to Closed-Loop Design: A Data-Driven Review on Biomass-Derived Carbon for Supercapacitors
papers.abstract: Supercapacitors are vital for sustainable energy storage, and biomass-derived carbons are promising electrode materials owing to their low cost, renewability, and inherent hierarchical porosity. However, their electrochemical performance arises from a complex interplay of pore architecture, graphitization degree, and heteroatom doping, making trial-and-error optimization inefficient. This review adopts a data-driven perspective, systematically covering the entire value chain (from precursor selection and carbonization to pore engineering, surface modification, and characterization) while emphasizing how each variable can be quantified as input features for machine learning (ML). We discuss the mechanistic roles of structure, graphitization, and surface chemistry in regulating ion transport, electron conduction, and charge storage, and summarize common characterization (Raman, XRD, XPS, FTIR, BET) and electrochemical (CV, GCD, EIS) techniques. Critically, we highlight several problematic practices: the misleading “green” activation narrative, scalability limits of templating, non-linear trade-offs in chasing ultra-high surface area and heavy doping, oversimplified interpretation of the Raman I D / I G ratio, and deceptive reliance on three-electrode data for device-level predictions. To overcome these, we advocate for a closed-loop, data-driven design framework that integrates standardized databases, active learning, and inverse design to guide the rational development of biomass-derived carbon electrodes. This framework integrates ML not as an add-on but as the central engine connecting precursor–process–structure–performance relationships. Realizing the full potential of biomass-derived carbons demands a cultural shift from pursuing idealized metrics toward reproducibility, scalability, and rigorous device-relevant validation. By merging closed-loop data-driven discovery with mechanistic understanding, the field can effectively bridge the gap between laboratory findings and practical supercapacitor technologies.

papers.title_zh: 从试错到闭环设计：生物质衍生碳用于超级电容器的数据驱动综述
papers.summary_zh: 该综述从数据驱动视角系统梳理生物质衍生碳超级电容器电极的全价值链，强调将前驱体、碳化、孔工程、表面改性等变量量化为机器学习输入特征，倡导整合标准化数据库、主动学习与逆向设计的闭环框架，以连接前驱体—工艺—结构—性能关系。
papers.research_details_zh: 该综述针对生物质衍生碳电极电化学性能受孔结构、石墨化程度和杂原子掺杂复杂交互影响、传统试错优化效率低的问题，采用数据驱动视角，系统覆盖从前驱体选择、碳化到孔工程、表面改性和表征的完整价值链，并强调每个变量如何量化为机器学习输入特征。文中讨论了结构、石墨化和表面化学在调控离子传输、电子传导和电荷存储中的机制作用，总结了常用表征与电化学技术。综述批判性指出若干问题实践，包括误导性的绿色活化叙事、模板法的可扩展性限制、追求超高比表面积和重掺杂的非线性权衡、拉曼ID/IG比的过度简化解释以及依赖三电极数据预测器件性能的欺骗性。据此倡导闭环数据驱动设计框架，将机器学习作为连接前驱体—工艺—结构—性能关系的核心引擎，而非附加工具。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的表征技术包括拉曼、XRD、XPS、FTIR和BET；电化学技术包括CV、GCD和EIS。综述采用数据驱动视角，讨论将前驱体选择、碳化、孔工程、表面改性等变量量化为机器学习输入特征，并倡导整合标准化数据库、主动学习和逆向设计的闭环框架。摘要未报告具体合成步骤、组装方法或性能测试参数。

papers.title: Sidechain Modulation of Responsive Metal‐Organic Framework Pore Chirality for Enhanced Enantioseparation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The selective separation of enantiomers is important for industrial technologies such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and agrochemicals. Chiral porous materials have been used as the stationary phase for the chromatographic separation of enantiomers; however, they lack synthetic and performance designability. Here we present a new chiral metal‐organic framework with excellent chromatographic enantioseparation performance for a family of aromatic chiral molecules. This material has been developed by diversifying the amino acid sidechains appended to an underlying common structural framework. The structure of the framework places the bulky isopropyl sidechain of L ‐valine in the one‐dimensional pore channels characteristic of the materials family, modulating the accessible space to emphasize the helical shape of the channels. The dimensions of the pores are adapted to those of guests, through conformational flexibility directed by the sidechain, creating appropriate adsorption sites for functionalized aromatic guests. This porous framework affords superior enantioseparation performance compared to the same underlying framework decorated with the shorter methyl sidechain. These results demonstrate that the structure and porosity of dynamic chiral metal‐organic frameworks can be tailored using amino acid‐derived linkers and enhance the enantiomeric separations through stimulation of conformational flexibility.

papers.title_zh: 响应性金属有机框架孔手性的侧链调控用于增强对映体分离
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过多样化氨基酸侧链构建新型手性金属有机框架，将L-缬氨酸的异丙基侧链置于一维孔道中，调控可及空间并强化孔道螺旋形状，实现对一系列芳香手性分子的优异色谱对映体分离，性能优于较短甲基侧链的同类框架。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究针对对映体选择性分离在制药、生物技术和农化等领域的重要性，以及手性多孔材料作为色谱固定相时缺乏合成与性能可设计性的问题，提出通过多样化连接在共同结构框架上的氨基酸侧链来开发新型手性金属有机框架。该框架将L-缬氨酸的庞大异丙基侧链置于该材料家族特征性的一维孔道中，调控可及空间以强调孔道的螺旋形状。孔道尺寸通过侧链导向的构象柔性适应客体分子尺寸，为功能化芳香客体创造合适的吸附位点。该多孔框架对一系列芳香手性分子展现出优异的色谱对映体分离性能，且优于以较短甲基侧链修饰的同一基础框架。结果表明，动态手性金属有机框架的结构和孔隙率可通过氨基酸衍生连接体调控，并通过激发构象柔性增强对映体分离。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及采用氨基酸衍生连接体构建手性金属有机框架，通过多样化氨基酸侧链（如L-缬氨酸异丙基侧链与较短甲基侧链对比）调控孔道结构，并采用色谱法进行对映体分离性能评价。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段、色谱参数及定量分离数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于手性金属有机框架的孔道工程与性能调控，与框架材料主线直接相关，涉及孔道手性、侧链调控和构象柔性等设计策略。其通过氨基酸侧链调节孔道可及空间和螺旋形状以增强对映体分离的思路，对框架材料的孔结构精准设计有参考价值。但摘要未涉及介孔、导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，若关注手性分离与MOF孔工程可精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征方法、色谱分离参数、定量分离结果及构象柔性的直接证据，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过氨基酸侧链多样化构建的新型手性金属有机框架对一系列芳香手性分子具有优异的色谱对映体分离性能。

该框架的对映体分离性能优于以较短甲基侧链修饰的同一基础框架。
动态手性金属有机框架的结构和孔隙率可通过氨基酸衍生连接体调控，构象柔性的激发增强了对映体分离。

papers.title: Solvent‐Free Synthesis of Covalent Organic Frameworks: Achievements and Challenges
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) represent a powerful class of ordered porous materials, yet conventional solvothermal synthetic routes often hinder their practical implementation. Solvent‐free strategies have emerged as attractive alternatives, not only for reducing the use of conventional solvents but also for creating distinct reaction environments for framework formation, crystallization, and materials processing. Mechanochemical activation, ionothermal media, melt‐ or flux‐assisted polymerization, and vapor‐assisted interfaces provide different modes of molecular transport and reaction regulation, thereby influencing bond formation, nucleation, crystal growth, and morphology evolution. This minireview summarizes recent advances in these strategies, with particular attention to their reaction characteristics, structural scope, and applicability to different COF systems. Selected approaches further enable the integration of framework construction with direct shaping into films, membranes, monoliths, foams, and platelets, as well as gram‐ to kilogram‐scale production. Finally, we outline remaining challenges in crystallization pathways, structural integrity, and reproducible scale‐up to guide the future industrial translation of COF technologies.

papers.title_zh: 共价有机框架的无溶剂合成：成就与挑战
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统总结了共价有机框架无溶剂合成策略的最新进展，涵盖机械化学活化、离子热介质、熔融或助熔剂辅助聚合及气相辅助界面等方法，并讨论了其在成键、成核、晶体生长与形貌演化中的作用，以及直接成型和规模化生产的潜力。
papers.research_details_zh: 传统溶剂热合成路线限制了共价有机框架的实际应用，无溶剂策略作为有吸引力的替代方案受到关注。该综述聚焦机械化学活化、离子热介质、熔融或助熔剂辅助聚合以及气相辅助界面等无溶剂策略，这些方法提供不同的分子传输和反应调控模式，从而影响成键、成核、晶体生长和形貌演化。文章特别关注这些策略的反应特征、结构适用范围以及对不同COF体系的适用性。部分方法还能将框架构建与直接成型为薄膜、膜、整块体、泡沫和片状材料相结合，并实现克级至千克级生产。最后，作者指出了结晶路径、结构完整性和可重复放大方面仍存在的挑战，以指导COF技术的未来工业转化。
papers.methods_zh: 该文为综述，摘要中明确提及的无溶剂合成策略包括机械化学活化、离子热介质、熔融或助熔剂辅助聚合以及气相辅助界面。摘要未报告具体的表征方法、性能测试方法或详细的合成条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与共轭COF及框架材料组装主线高度相关，系统梳理了无溶剂合成这一重要方向，对理解COF结晶与加工具有参考价值。其局限在于为综述性文章，不提供原始实验数据。值得全文精读以获取各策略的具体案例和条件。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段、性能数值及详细机制，这些关键细节需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 无溶剂策略不仅减少传统溶剂使用，还为框架形成、结晶和材料加工创造了独特的反应环境。
机械化学活化、离子热介质、熔融或助熔剂辅助聚合及气相辅助界面提供不同的分子传输和反应调控模式，影响成键、成核、晶体生长和形貌演化。
部分无溶剂方法可实现框架构建与直接成型为薄膜、膜、整块体、泡沫和片状材料的集成，并支持克级至千克级生产。
结晶路径、结构完整性和可重复放大仍是未来工业转化面临的主要挑战。

papers.title: Topology‐Directed Biomimetic Confinement in Covalent Organic Frameworks Couples Electrocatalytic Water Activation to Reactive Oxygen Species Evolution for Dual‐Potential Electrochemiluminescence
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Enzymatic confined microenvironments cooperatively modulate reactive oxygen species (ROS) dynamics to enhance biocatalytic efficiency. Drawing inspiration from this natural mechanism, we developed covalent organic frameworks (COFs) with programmable nanoscale confinement, achieved via topology‐directed assembly. This design enables precise spatiotemporal regulation of ROS generation and scavenging, thereby facilitating highly efficient and unprecedented dual‐potential electrochemiluminescence (ECL). The resulting confined COF architecture exhibits enhanced electronic coupling, attributable to dense π‐stacking, and a well‐ordered, continuous hydrogen‐bonding network templated by functionalized pore walls. By mimicking enzymatic proton‐coupled electron transfer (PCET), the confined environment not only promotes site‐specific ROS generation from electrocatalytic water oxidation but also directs ROS‐mediated redox consumption pathways toward selective population of emissive excited states. As a result, we report the first dual‐potential ECL emission in a COF‐based system, achieving cathodic and anodic ECL efficiencies of 40.5% and 21.2%, respectively, representing 11.3‐ and 8.2‐fold enhancements relative to analogous unconfined COFs. Moreover, size‐selective binding of UO 2 2+ within the confined pores provides direct experimental evidence for confinement‐enabled ROS regulation, yielding quantitative, analyte‐responsive ECL signals. Collectively, these findings establish a broadly applicable principle of confinement‐directed reactivity, grounded in mechanistic understanding and offering a rational, structure‐function‐guided strategy for the design of advanced functional materials.

papers.title_zh: 拓扑导向的共价有机框架仿生限域将电催化水活化与活性氧物种演化耦合用于双电位电化学发光
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过拓扑导向组装构建具有可编程纳米限域的COF，模拟酶促限域微环境调控活性氧生成与清除，首次在COF基体系中实现双电位电化学发光，阴极和阳极效率分别达40.5%和21.2%，较无限域COF提升11.3倍和8.2倍。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究受酶促限域微环境协同调控活性氧动态以增强生物催化效率的启发，通过拓扑导向组装开发了具有可编程纳米限域的共价有机框架。该设计可精确时空调控ROS的生成与清除，从而实现高效且前所未有的双电位电化学发光。所得限域COF结构因密集π堆叠而具有增强的电子耦合，并具有由功能化孔壁模板化的有序连续氢键网络。通过模拟酶促质子耦合电子转移，限域环境不仅促进电催化水氧化产生位点特异性ROS，还引导ROS介导的氧化还原消耗路径选择性布居发光激发态。结果首次在COF基体系中报道了双电位ECL发射，阴极和阳极ECL效率分别为40.5%和21.2%，相对类似无限域COF分别提升11.3倍和8.2倍。此外，限域孔内对UO2^2+的尺寸选择性结合为限域调控ROS提供了直接实验证据，产生定量的分析物响应ECL信号。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及通过拓扑导向组装构建COF，模拟酶促质子耦合电子转移，进行电催化水氧化和ROS介导的氧化还原，测试双电位电化学发光性能，并利用UO2^2+的尺寸选择性结合作为限域调控ROS的实验证据。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段和详细测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与共轭COF、框架材料组装及电化学合成主线高度相关，展示了拓扑导向组装构建限域COF并耦合电催化与ECL的创新策略，定量结果突出。值得全文精读以了解限域结构设计与机制细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征方法、ECL测试参数及限域结构细节，这些关键信息需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 首次在COF基体系中实现双电位ECL发射，阴极和阳极ECL效率分别为40.5%和21.2%。
限域COF的阴极和阳极ECL效率相对类似无限域COF分别提升11.3倍和8.2倍。
限域COF因密集π堆叠具有增强电子耦合，并具有功能化孔壁模板化的有序连续氢键网络。
限域孔内对UO2^2+的尺寸选择性结合为限域调控ROS提供了直接实验证据，产生定量分析物响应ECL信号。

papers.title: Elastic Ion‐Conducting Layer Enables Stable Si‐Based All‐Solid‐State Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Si‐based all‐solid‐state batteries with sulfide solid electrolytes are strong contenders for next‐generation high‐safety, high‐energy‐density batteries. However, Si‐based anodes inevitably suffer from irreversible delamination and side reactions at the rigid Si/solid electrolyte interface during cycling, making it challenging to achieve long cycle life. Here, we develop an elastic ion‐conducting layer on the Si surface that transforms the rigid interface into a conformal and recoverable elastic contact, achieving highly stable Si anode. The layer comprises a lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide‐containing block copolymer, whose hydrogen‐bond‐rich hard domains provide mechanical robustness and elasticity. Ion‐conductive soft segments, together with an in situ‐formed inorganic‐rich solid electrolyte interphase on the Si surface, construct a three‐dimensional ion transport network. This interfacial architecture simultaneously mitigates interfacial stress and accelerates lithium‐ion transport within the Si anode. Consequently, the full‐cell exhibits stable cycling over 10,000 cycles at a high rate of 5C (8.7 mA cm −2 ), and the 0.6 Ah pouch cell retains 91% capacity after 650 cycles. Such interfacial layer holds great promise for accelerating the commercialization of Si‐based all‐solid‐state batteries.

papers.title_zh: 弹性离子导电层实现稳定的硅基全固态电池
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在硅表面构建含双氟磺酰亚胺锂的嵌段共聚物弹性离子导电层，将刚性Si/固态电解质界面转变为共形可恢复的弹性接触，全电池在5C高倍率下稳定循环超过10000次，0.6 Ah软包电池650次循环后容量保持91%。
papers.research_details_zh: 硅基全固态电池采用硫化物固态电解质，是下一代高安全性、高能量密度电池的有力竞争者。然而硅基负极在循环过程中不可避免地遭受刚性Si/固态电解质界面的不可逆分层和副反应，难以实现长循环寿命。该研究在Si表面开发了一种弹性离子导电层，将刚性界面转变为共形且可恢复的弹性接触，从而实现高度稳定的Si负极。该层由含双氟磺酰亚胺锂的嵌段共聚物组成，其富含氢键的硬域提供机械稳健性和弹性。离子导电软段与Si表面原位形成的富无机物固态电解质界面共同构建三维离子传输网络。该界面结构同时缓解界面应力并加速Si负极内的锂离子传输。因此，全电池在5C高倍率（8.7 mA cm−2）下稳定循环超过10000次，0.6 Ah软包电池在650次循环后容量保持91%。该界面层有望加速硅基全固态电池的商业化。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及在Si表面构建含双氟磺酰亚胺锂的嵌段共聚物弹性离子导电层，利用氢键硬域提供弹性，离子导电软段与原位形成的富无机物SEI构建三维离子传输网络，并进行全电池和0.6 Ah软包电池的循环性能测试。摘要未报告具体合成步骤、表征手段和测试条件细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料等主线关联较弱，属于嵌段共聚物界面层用于硅基全固态电池的拓展方向。其定量循环数据突出，但框架材料相关性低，是否精读取决于对电池界面工程的兴趣。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征方法、界面层厚度及电池组装细节，这些关键信息需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 全电池在5C高倍率（8.7 mA cm−2）下稳定循环超过10000次。
0.6 Ah软包电池在650次循环后容量保持91%。
弹性离子导电层由含双氟磺酰亚胺锂的嵌段共聚物组成，其富含氢键的硬域提供机械稳健性和弹性。
离子导电软段与Si表面原位形成的富无机物固态电解质界面共同构建三维离子传输网络，同时缓解界面应力并加速锂离子传输。

papers.title: Sequentially Self-Assembled Supramolecular Nanocomplexes Enable Systemic Cas9 RNP Delivery and In Vivo Tumor Genome Editing
papers.abstract: In vivo genome editing utilizing Cas9/sgRNA ribonucleoproteins (RNPs) holds substantial therapeutic promise, yet rapid bloodstream clearance and degradation of RNPs have hindered its accumulation within the target site and effective gene editing. Herein, we report a supramolecular ternary complex platform where RNPs are co-assembled with tannic acid (TA) and phenylboronic acid (PBA)-conjugated polymers through sequential self-assembly. This ∼30 nm core-shell structure protects RNPs from enzymatic degradation and dissociates selectively at endosomal pH. Upon intravenous administration in subcutaneous tumor-bearing mice, the ternary complex exhibits prolonged blood circulation and preferential tumor accumulation, achieving 37.2% gene editing at tumor sites compared with only 1.5% for free RNPs. The platform successfully disrupts PLK1 in subcutaneous tumors, accompanied by significant tumor growth suppression. This is further applied to a KRASG13D-mutant tumor model, in which treatment delayed tumor growth. By integrating sequential supramolecular self-assembly with stimuli-responsive cargo release, this strategy presents a promising approach for systemic RNP delivery and tumor genome editing.

papers.title_zh: 顺序自组装超分子纳米复合物实现系统性Cas9 RNP递送与体内肿瘤基因组编辑
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过单宁酸与苯硼酸修饰聚合物的顺序自组装构建约30纳米核壳三元复合物，保护Cas9/sgRNA核糖核蛋白免受酶降解并在内体pH选择性解离，静脉注射后实现37.2%的肿瘤基因编辑效率，显著优于游离RNP的1.5%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对Cas9/sgRNA核糖核蛋白在体内应用时血液清除快和易降解的问题，设计了一种超分子三元复合物平台。该平台通过RNP与单宁酸及苯硼酸修饰聚合物的顺序自组装形成约30纳米的核壳结构。该结构可保护RNP免受酶降解，并在内体pH条件下选择性解离。在皮下肿瘤荷瘤小鼠静脉给药后，三元复合物表现出延长的血液循环和优先的肿瘤富集，在肿瘤部位实现37.2%的基因编辑，而游离RNP仅为1.5%。该平台成功破坏了皮下肿瘤中的PLK1，伴随显著的肿瘤生长抑制。进一步应用于KRASG13D突变肿瘤模型，治疗延迟了肿瘤生长。该策略整合了顺序超分子自组装与刺激响应性货物释放，为系统性RNP递送和肿瘤基因组编辑提供了有前景的方法。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：通过顺序自组装构建RNP、单宁酸和苯硼酸修饰聚合物的三元复合物；在皮下肿瘤荷瘤小鼠中进行静脉给药；评估血液 circulation、肿瘤积累和基因编辑效率；在皮下肿瘤中破坏PLK1并监测肿瘤生长；在KRASG13D突变肿瘤模型中评估治疗效果。摘要未报告具体的表征手段、合成细节和统计方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于自组装技术范畴，展示了超分子顺序自组装在生物医学递送中的应用，与框架材料组装主线关联较弱，但为自组装策略提供了刺激响应性释放的实例。其局限在于未涉及介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成。对于关注自组装技术的研究者值得浏览，但若聚焦框架材料则全文精读价值有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，未核实全文。关键细节如自组装的具体步骤、复合物的表征数据、基因编辑的检测方法、血液循环和肿瘤积累的定量数据、PLK1破坏的验证方法以及KRASG13D模型的详细结果均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 三元复合物在肿瘤部位实现37.2%的基因编辑效率，游离RNP仅为1.5%
复合物为约30纳米核壳结构，可保护RNP免受酶降解并在内体pH选择性解离
在皮下肿瘤中成功破坏PLK1并显著抑制肿瘤生长
在KRASG13D突变肿瘤模型中治疗延迟了肿瘤生长

papers.title: Ethylene-bridged Periodic Mesoporous Organosilica Nanoparticles: controlling architecture through mechanistic investigations
papers.abstract: The synthesis of periodic mesoporous organosilica nanoparticles via the hydrolysis and condensation of 1,2-bis(triethoxysilyl)ethane (BTEE), with porosity templated by cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB) as surfactant and sodium salicylate (NaSal) as co-surfactant, has been investigated. In addition to the cubic alignment of spherical pores typically observed for such nanoparticles, the addition of NaSal prior to the initiation of BTEE hydrolysis led to the formation of nanoparticles with 2D hexagonal cylindrical pore geometry. By delaying the addition of NaSal until after the nucleation of nanoparticles with cubic porosity, multipodal nanostructures were obtained, in which the spherical cores exhibited cubic pore symmetry while the pods exhibited 2D hexagonal symmetry. All materials were carefully characterized by multiple techniques including SAXS, electron microscopy and gas physisorption experiments with N 2 and Ar as adsorbates. In particular, we showed that it is necessary to use quenched solid density functional theory (QSDFT) with appropriate kernels to correctly model the pore diameters, which were corrected from 2.8 nm with the incorrect but widely used BJH method to 4.8 nm with QSDFT in the case of spherical pores. The mechanism by which pores with different geometries evolved using a single organosilane precursor, together with the transition from spherical particles to multipodal systems following delayed addition of NaSal, was explored via conductivity, light scattering, and electron microscopy. These studies revealed that no additional growth of the cores occurred after addition of the NaSal, with the pods growing from small embryos initially formed at specific regions on the surface of the initially-formed cores.

papers.title_zh: 乙烯桥连周期性介孔有机硅纳米颗粒：通过机理研究控制结构
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过1,2-双(三乙氧基硅基)乙烷水解缩合，以CTAB为模板剂、水杨酸钠为助表面活性剂，发现NaSal添加时机可调控孔几何：提前加入形成2D六方柱状孔，延迟加入则得到多足纳米结构，并指出需用QSDFT而非BJH正确评估孔径。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究探讨了通过1,2-双(三乙氧基硅基)乙烷水解和缩合合成周期性介孔有机硅纳米颗粒，以十六烷基三甲基溴化铵为表面活性剂模板，水杨酸钠为助表面活性剂。除了通常观察到的球形孔立方排列外，在BTEE水解引发前加入NaSal可形成具有2D六方圆柱孔几何的纳米颗粒。将NaSal添加延迟至具有立方孔结构的纳米颗粒成核后，则获得多足纳米结构，其中球形核显示立方孔对称性，而足显示2D六方对称性。所有材料通过SAXS、电子显微镜和以N2和Ar为吸附质的气体物理吸附实验进行表征。特别指出，必须使用淬火固体密度泛函理论及适当核函数才能正确模拟孔径，球形孔的孔径从广泛使用的BJH方法的2.8纳米校正为QSDFT的4.8纳米。通过电导率、光散射和电子显微镜探索了单一有机硅前驱体形成不同几何孔以及延迟添加NaSal后从球形颗粒向多足系统转变的机理。这些研究揭示，添加NaSal后核不再生长，足从最初在核表面特定区域形成的小胚胎生长而来。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：以BTEE为前驱体、CTAB为表面活性剂、NaSal为助表面活性剂进行水解缩合合成；通过SAXS、电子显微镜和以N2和Ar为吸附质的气体物理吸附实验进行表征；使用QSDFT和BJH方法分析孔径；通过电导率、光散射和电子显微镜研究机理。摘要未报告具体的温度、浓度、反应时间等合成条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于介孔材料范畴，涉及周期性介孔有机硅纳米颗粒的孔结构调控和机理研究，与介孔材料主线直接相关。其局限在于未涉及导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成。对于关注介孔材料合成机理和孔径评估方法的研究者具有参考价值，值得全文精读以获取详细合成条件和机理证据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，未核实全文。关键细节如具体合成条件、NaSal浓度、反应时间、SAXS和电镜的具体数据、QSDFT核函数选择依据以及机理研究的详细结果均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: NaSal添加时机决定孔几何：BTEE水解前加入形成2D六方柱状孔，成核后延迟加入得到多足纳米结构
多足结构中球形核为立方孔对称性，足为2D六方对称性
球形孔孔径用BJH法为2.8纳米，用QSDFT校正为4.8纳米
添加NaSal后核不再生长，足从核表面特定区域的小胚胎生长

papers.title: Precise molecular sieving in polycrystalline covalent organic framework membranes
papers.abstract: Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) unlock opportunities to unite rapid mass transport with molecular-level sieving through membranes. However, achieving long-range crystallographic order within these membranes remains a central challenge that limits their separation precision. Here, we report a monomer-driven strategy for the ambient-condition fabrication of COF polycrystalline membranes featuring definite lattice order and polyhedral textures, reminiscent of benchmark metal-organic framework counterparts. Using a rigid, π-conjugated pyrene-centered tetraamine, we enable nonepitaxial intergrowth of faceted COF crystals on a porous support, yielding a 350-nanometer-thick membrane with a record-high Brunauer-Emmett-Teller surface area of 2121 square meters per gram among COF separation membranes of comparable pore size. The resulting COF membrane preserves its crystallographic order and polyhedral texture even after 1 month of solvent exposure while uniquely combining increased surface stiffness with high tensile ductility. Notably, we demonstrate its superior liquid-phase molecular selectivity, outperforming COF analogs with considerably smaller pore apertures, and elucidate an unambiguous correlation between crystallographic order and permselectivity. This work positions crystallographic ordering as a guiding principle for COF membranes, opening more possibilities at the intersection of framework materials and separation technologies.

papers.title_zh: 多晶共价有机框架膜中的精确分子筛分
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用单体驱动策略在常温下制备具有明确晶格有序和多面体织构的COF多晶膜，以刚性π共轭芘中心四胺实现非外延共生，得到350纳米厚膜，BET比表面积达2121平方米每克，并揭示晶格有序与渗透选择性之间的明确关联。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对COF膜中实现长程晶体有序性这一核心挑战，报道了一种单体驱动策略，在常温条件下制备具有明确晶格有序和多面体织构的COF多晶膜，类似于基准MOF对应物。使用刚性π共轭芘中心四胺，在多孔载体上实现多面COF晶体的非外延共生，得到350纳米厚的膜，其BET比表面积在可比孔径的COF分离膜中创纪录地达到2121平方米每克。所得COF膜在溶剂暴露1个月后仍保持晶体学有序和多面体织构，同时独特地结合了增加的表面刚度和高拉伸延展性。值得注意的是，该膜表现出优异的液相分子选择性，优于孔径显著更小的COF类似物，并阐明了晶体学有序与渗透选择性之间的明确关联。该工作将晶体学有序性定位为COF膜的指导原则，为框架材料与分离技术的交叉领域开辟了更多可能性。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：使用刚性π共轭芘中心四胺作为单体，在常温条件下通过单体驱动策略在多孔载体上非外延共生生长COF多晶膜；测量膜厚度、BET比表面积；进行溶剂暴露稳定性测试；评估表面刚度、拉伸延展性和液相分子选择性。摘要未报告具体的合成溶液组成、反应时间、表征仪器型号和分离测试的具体条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于共轭COF框架材料范畴，涉及COF膜的制备、晶体学有序调控和分子筛分性能，与共轭COF/COF主线高度相关。其局限在于未涉及导电MOF、介孔材料或电化学合成。对于关注COF膜和框架材料组装的研究者，该工作提供了晶格有序与分离性能关联的重要见解，值得全文精读。

papers.title: Epitaxial Growth of Metal–Organic Framework Thin‐Film Scintillators for Temperature‐Adaptive, High‐Resolution X‐Ray Imaging
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Solution‐processed scintillators are attractive for large‐area X‐ray imaging. However, their performance in thin‐film architectures is constrained by low effective density, severe light scattering, and insufficient thermal stability. Here, we report a solution‐processed epitaxial growth strategy to fabricate large‐area, monolithic metal–organic framework (MOF) thin‐film scintillators for temperature‐adaptive, high‐resolution X‐ray imaging. Mechanistic investigation reveals that surface hydroxyl‐mediated, molecularly oriented epitaxial growth reconstructs the interfacial energy landscape, enabling optically continuous, densely packed terbium–terephthalate (Tb‐BDC) films on solid substrates. The Tb‐BDC scintillator demonstrates a light yield of 44,380 photons MeV −1 and exceptional thermal stability in scintillation performance. At 513 K, it retains 95.2% of its room‐temperature radioluminescence intensity, surpassing the 42.6% retained by commercial Gd 2 O 2 S:Tb. Furthermore, it maintains 93.7% of its initial radioluminescence intensity following cumulative X‐ray irradiation up to 67.4 Gy. Notably, its radioluminescence intensity remains within 3.6% of the pristine value after 24 h immersion in water. By integrating self‐supervised machine learning‐assisted image reconstruction, temperature‐adaptive X‐ray imaging with a spatial resolution of 21.7 lp mm −1 is achieved. This work establishes an epitaxial microstructural design paradigm for solution‐processed scintillator screens operating under demanding thermal conditions.

papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：溶液加工外延生长策略制备大面积整体式MOF薄膜闪烁体；表面羟基介导的分子取向外延生长机理研究；在固体基底上制备光学连续、致密堆积的Tb-BDC薄膜；辐射发光强度测试以评估热稳定性、抗X射线辐照稳定性和耐水性；光产额测定；以及自监督机器学习辅助图像重建用于温度自适应X射线成像。摘要未报告具体前驱体浓度、溶剂、温度程序、表征仪器型号等细节。

papers.title: Uniform High-Level Block Copolymer Architectures via Hybrid Self-Seeding
papers.abstract: Abstract The construction of hierarchical architectures with precisely controlled dimensions and morphologies remains a key challenge in block copolymer self-assembly. Here we introduce hybrid self-seeding, a streamlined strategy that employs either the coassembly of a crystallizable homopolymer with two block copolymers or the direct self-seeding of mixed one-dimensional (1D) and two-dimensional (2D) seed fragments. By orchestrating sequential nucleation events where the homopolymer nucleates first, followed by block copolymers with decreasing propensity for 1D growth, we achieve precise morphological control in a single process. This method yields uniform scarf-like micelles (up to 34 μm), yucca flaccida-like architectures, and long ribbon-like morphologies. Electron diffraction confirms homoepitaxial growth across morphological domains, linking the structural memory effect to crystal lattice continuity. Our approach establishes a generalizable platform for higher-level soft matter.

papers.title: Template‐Encoded Assembly and Adaptive Function in Selenium‐Based Molybdenum Chalcoxide Rings
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Controlling both structure and function in inorganic self‐assembly remains a major challenge. Here we establish a programmable strategy for constructing selenium‐based molybdenum chalcoxides using the [Mo 2 O 2 Se 2 ] 2+ dimer as a universal building block. The template‐directed assembly process produces a complete family of ring architectures ( n = 8–16), with nuclearity encoded by the template's geometry and acidity. Selenium incorporation introduces electronic softness that imparts unusual structural flexibility and enables adaptive behaviour. NMR titration experiments reveal host–guest exchange in solution, demonstrating dynamic recognition in these purely inorganic rings. This family of clusters also displays tuneable electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution activity (HER), following the trend Mo 8 > Mo 12 > Mo 10 and consistently outperforming their sulphur analogues. Together, these results define a design framework in which modular assembly, dynamic function, and catalytic activity arise from a common chalcogen‐dependent structural logic, opening new avenues for responsive inorganic molecular materials.

papers.title: Induced Restructuring of a Supramolecular Metal‒Organic Framework Into a Cu─Zn Alloy Catalyst for Reverse Water–Gas Shift
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In Cu–Zn catalysts used for the reverse water–gas shift (RWGS) reaction, Cu and Zn phases remain dispersed, while the Cu–Zn interphase is widely regarded as the catalytically active site. Herein, we engineered a ZnO‐decorated Cu‐rich Cu–Zn alloy using a mixed Cu/Zn oxalate‐based supramolecular metal–organic framework precursor with compositionally homogeneous Cu/Zn mixing. The resulting Cu–Zn catalyst (Cu–Zn|C‐oxo|R) maintained >99% CO selectivity and, at 550°C, delivered a Cu‐normalized CO space–time yield (STY) of 1580 mmol CO g Cu −1 h −1 , higher than those of the Cu‐only and commercial Cu–Zn–Al benchmarks. Under a high space velocity test, the Cu–Zn|C‐oxo|R catalyst remained stable for >50 h at 550°C. Operando Cu K‐edge x‐ray absorption spectroscopy shows that Cu is reduced to a predominantly metallic local environment that persists under RWGS conditions. Complementary in situ x‐ray diffraction and electron microscopy identify Cu‐rich Cu–Zn alloy domains in contact with ZnO, while in situ diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy is consistent with an associative formate‐mediated RWGS pathway at these interfaces. Density functional theory calculations further revealed that these interfacial sites favor the formate reaction pathway, providing a molecular‐level rationale for the enhanced catalytic activity.

papers.title_zh: 超分子金属有机框架诱导重构为Cu─Zn合金催化剂用于逆水煤气变换
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以混合Cu/Zn草酸盐超分子金属有机框架为前驱体，经诱导重构制备ZnO修饰的富Cu Cu─Zn合金。该催化剂在逆水煤气变换中保持>99% CO选择性，550°C下Cu归一化CO时空产率达1580 mmol CO g Cu−1 h−1，并稳定运行超过50小时。

papers.title: Pore Compartmentalization of CO 2 and H 2 O in a Redox‐Active Adsorbent
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Achieving sustainable carbon capture under realistic, humid conditions remains a central challenge for decarbonization technologies. Here we report an ultramicroporous oxofluorovanadate metal‐organic framework, Ni(pyrazine) 2 (VOF 4 ), that dynamically regulates competitive adsorption through reversible redox chemistry. Under humid dilute CO 2 streams (4 vol%), water chemisorbs at vanadium centers in the form of hydroxide ligands and induces a reversible V(+4)|V(+5) transformation to an isoreticular phase, Ni(pyrazine) 2 (VO(OH)F 4 ), while CO 2 is engaged in strong physisorption within pyrazine‐lined pore regions. This redox‐driven compartmentalization of H 2 O and CO 2 results in a dynamic breakthrough CO 2 capacity of 2.04 ± 0.07 mmol/g, sustained for up to 50 cycles and showing resilience under intense humidification or steam exposure. These findings establish redox‐adaptive adsorption in BVR‐X as a unique design paradigm, enabling scalable and durable carbon capture under realistic operating conditions.

papers.title_zh: 氧化还原活性吸附剂中CO2与H2O的孔道分区
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道了一种超微孔氧氟钒酸盐金属有机框架Ni(pyrazine)2(VOF4)，通过可逆氧化还原化学动态调控CO2与H2O的竞争吸附。在潮湿稀CO2流中，水在钒中心化学吸附并诱导V(+4)|V(+5)可逆转变，CO2则在吡嗪衬里孔区强物理吸附，实现动态穿透CO2容量2.04 ± 0.07 mmol/g，可维持50次循环。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对实际潮湿条件下碳捕获的可持续性挑战，提出利用氧化还原自适应吸附实现CO2与H2O的孔道分区。材料为超微孔氧氟钒酸盐金属有机框架Ni(pyrazine)2(VOF4)。在含4 vol% CO2的潮湿稀气流中，水以氢氧根配体形式在钒中心化学吸附，诱导可逆的V(+4)|V(+5)转变，形成同构相Ni(pyrazine)2(VO(OH)F4)，而CO2在吡嗪衬里的孔区域发生强物理吸附。这种氧化还原驱动的分区使动态穿透CO2容量达到2.04 ± 0.07 mmol/g，可维持多达50次循环，并在强烈加湿或蒸汽暴露下保持耐受性。该工作确立了BVR-X中的氧化还原自适应吸附为一种独特设计范式，有望实现实际工况下可规模化且持久的碳捕获。

papers.title: A Polycatenane‑Topological Covalent Organic Polymer for High‑Performance Photocatalytic H 2 O 2 Production
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The introduction of polycatenane junctions into dative B←N bond‐linked covalent organic polymers (COPs) poses a significant synthetic challenge for the synergistic optimization of both geometric stabilization and molecular functionality. Herein, we strategically employ tritopic borate ligands bearing terminal –Br substituents, rather than their ditopic counterparts, as precursors to construct a single‐crystalline COP ( JNP‐7 ) featuring polycatenane‐like topological junctions. Specifically, B‐centered Lewis acceptors and N‐donor units initially assemble into 1D nanoribbons via dative B←N linkages. By leveraging inter‐nanoribbon halogen···halogen interactions between the semi‐interlocked Br‐containing motifs, the architecture is further extended into 2D arrays, thereby elevating the geometric dimensionality of JNP‐7 . Critically, the resulting polycatenated halogen‐bonded network imparts exceptional structural rigidity, and the dative B←N motifs are found to concurrently promote visible‐light harvesting and facilitate charge‐carrier migration. Consequently, JNP‐7 enables highly efficient H 2 O 2 production via both the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) and water oxidation reaction (WOR) under ambient sunlight, operating without sacrificial agents, photosensitizers, or metal cocatalysts, and outperforming state‐of‐the‐art covalent organic frameworks (COFs) and metal‐organic frameworks (MOFs) in terms of photocatalytic activity and apparent quantum yield (AQY). By aligning molecular topology with catalytic function, this work establishes a generalizable framework for the rational development of topologically sophisticated, high‐performance COP systems.

papers.title_zh: 一种用于高性能光催化过氧化氢生产的聚索烃拓扑共价有机聚合物
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用含端溴取代基的三齿硼酸配体构建了具有聚索烃拓扑结点的单晶共价有机聚合物JNP-7，通过B←N配位键组装一维纳米带并借助卤素···卤素相互作用扩展为二维网络，在无牺牲剂、光敏剂和金属助催化剂条件下实现高效光催化H2O2生产。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在解决将聚索烃结点引入B←N键连接的共价有机聚合物中以实现几何稳定性和分子功能协同优化的合成难题。设计策略是选用带端溴取代基的三齿硼酸配体而非双齿对应物作为前驱体，构建具有聚索烃类拓扑结点的单晶COP（JNP-7）。组装过程为：B中心Lewis受体与N给体单元首先通过B←N配位键组装成一维纳米带，再利用含半互锁溴基序的纳米带间卤素···卤素相互作用将结构扩展为二维阵列，从而提升JNP-7的几何维度。所得聚索烃卤键网络赋予材料优异的结构刚性，B←N基序同时促进可见光捕获和电荷载流子迁移。JNP-7在环境太阳光下通过氧还原反应和水氧化反应高效生产H2O2，无需牺牲剂、光敏剂或金属助催化剂，其光催化活性和表观量子产率优于现有COF和MOF。该工作通过将分子拓扑与催化功能对齐，为合理开发拓扑复杂的高性能COP体系建立了通用框架。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：使用带端溴取代基的三齿硼酸配体作为前驱体进行合成；通过B←N配位键组装一维纳米带；利用纳米带间卤素···卤素相互作用扩展为二维阵列；获得单晶COP（JNP-7）。性能测试方面，在环境太阳光下评估光催化H2O2生产，涉及氧还原反应（ORR）和水氧化反应（WOR），并测定光催化活性和表观量子产率（AQY）。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段和测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF/COP框架材料的拓扑设计与光催化应用主线，展示了通过配位键与卤键协同组装构建聚索烃拓扑的策略，对框架材料组装和功能化具有参考价值。其无牺牲剂、无光敏剂、无金属助催化剂的H2O2生产体系在能源光催化领域有潜在意义。摘要未报告具体合成条件和定量性能数据，建议全文精读以获取详细实验方案和性能对比。

key_findings_zh: 三齿硼酸配体（而非双齿对应物）成功构建了具有聚索烃类拓扑结点的单晶共价有机聚合物JNP-7。
B←N配位键驱动一维纳米带组装，纳米带间卤素···卤素相互作用进一步将结构扩展为二维阵列，提升几何维度。
聚索烃卤键网络赋予JNP-7优异结构刚性，B←N基序同时促进可见光捕获和电荷载流子迁移。
JNP-7在环境太阳光下无需牺牲剂、光敏剂或金属助催化剂即可通过ORR和WOR高效生产H2O2，光催化活性和表观量子产率优于现有COF和MOF。

papers.title: Micro–Nano Hierarchical Structure From In Situ Functionalized MOFs Enables High‐Performance High‐Voltage Electrolytes
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Ideal solid‐state electrolytes (SSEs) should simultaneously possess excellent ionic conductivity, mechanical strength, electrochemical stability, and cathode compatibility. Here, inspired by the hierarchical architecture of organisms like the lotus leaf, a micro–nano hierarchical composite electrolyte was fabricated via in situ growth of a bifunctional metal–organic framework (F&OH‐ZIF‐8) on a cellulose acetate (CA) substrate. The micro‐ and nano‐sized F&OH‐ZIF‐8 crystals have the same composition but exhibit different size‐dependent advantages. The micro‐sized crystals provide greater structural continuity and mechanical support, whereas the nano‐sized crystals offer more accessible polar sites and interfacial regions for Li + coordination and transport. Their cooperative integration suppresses dendrite penetration and stabilizes the electrode/electrolyte interphases while facilitating Li + transport. An outstanding SSE with a room‐temperature ionic conductivity of 2.9 × 10 −3 S cm −1 , a lithium‐ion transference number of 0.61, and a wide electrochemical stability window extending to 5.5 V was obtained by this strategy, resulting in Li||NCM811 full cells achieving a high‐capacity retention of 80.9% after 300 cycles at 1C under a high cut‐off voltage of 4.6 V. This strategy of transforming existing commercialized ordinary membrane materials into more valuable electrolyte membranes has extremely high practical significance.

papers.title_zh: 原位功能化MOF构建微纳分级结构实现高性能高压电解质

papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在开发同时具备优异离子电导率、机械强度、电化学稳定性和正极兼容性的理想固态电解质。设计策略受荷叶等生物分级结构启发，在醋酸纤维素（CA）基底上原位生长双功能金属有机框架F&OH-ZIF-8，构建微纳分级复合电解质。微米级和纳米级F&OH-ZIF-8晶体具有相同组成但展现尺寸依赖的不同优势：微米晶体提供更大的结构连续性和机械支撑，纳米晶体提供更多可接触极性位点和界面区域用于Li+配位与传输。二者的协同整合抑制枝晶穿透并稳定电极/电解质界面，同时促进Li+传输。所得固态电解质室温离子电导率达2.9×10⁻³ S cm⁻¹，锂离子迁移数为0.61，电化学稳定窗口扩展至5.5 V。Li||NCM811全电池在4.6 V高截止电压下1C循环300次后容量保持率达80.9%。该策略将现有商业化普通膜材料转化为更高价值的电解质膜，具有极高实用意义。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：在醋酸纤维素（CA）基底上原位生长双功能金属有机框架F&OH-ZIF-8，构建微纳分级复合电解质。表征和测试方面，测量了室温离子电导率、锂离子迁移数和电化学稳定窗口；组装Li||NCM811全电池并在4.6 V高截止电压下以1C倍率进行300次循环测试容量保持率。摘要未报告具体合成条件、ZIF-8功能化细节和表征手段。

papers.title: Triadic σ–π Coordination Programs Cuδ+ Sites to Drive Sequential Dual-N Species C–N Coupling for Efficient Urea Electrosynthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract Electrocatalytic CO2/NO3– coreduction to urea through C–N coupling (EcnRR) offers a low-carbon route that couples carbon utilization with nitrate valorization. However, its efficiency is limited by poor spatiotemporal synchronization of C- and N-derived intermediates, site competition and local repulsion at single active sites, and insufficient control over the NO3– reduction reaction (NtrRR) hydrogenation. Here, we construct a series of secondary-coordination-tunable single-atom Cu–alkynyl–X sites in conjugated microporous polymers (Cu–X–CMPs, X = N, C, S), where X → Cu σ coordination and an alkynyl π channel work together through triadic σ–π coupling to electronically program low-valent Cu atomic sites (Cuδ+). Experiments and theory show that N-coordinated Cu stabilizes the Cuδ+ working state, enhances local interfacial polarization, and reorganizes the interfacial hydrogen-bond network. These effects improve proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) compatibility and increase the synchronized local coverages of *CO and *NHx near the active site. More importantly, Cu–N–CMPs establishes a sequential dual-N-species C–N coupling pathway initiated by *NH and completed by *NH2, with *CONH identified as the key intermediate in the first coupling step. As a result, Cu–N–CMPs delivers a Cu-site-normalized TOF of 1321.2 h–1 at −0.6 VRHE. In the membrane electrode assembly (MEA) electrolyzer, it further delivers a urea formation rate of 92.8 mmol gcat.–1 h–1 with 77.6% FEurea and stable operation for 85 h. This work demonstrates that Cu site electronic programming can coordinate sequential dual-N species C–N coupling, providing a transferable atomic-site engineering strategy for complex multi-intermediate electrocatalysis.

papers.summary_zh: 该工作构建了次级配位可调的Cu–炔基–X单原子位点共轭微孔聚合物，通过三元σ–π耦合稳定Cuδ+工作态，实现顺序双氮物种C–N偶联，在MEA中尿素产率达92.8 mmol gcat.–1 h–1、FEurea 77.6%，稳定运行85小时。

papers.title: Electrochemically Supported Asymmetric Synthesis on Chiral Encoded Pt and Pt–Ir Surfaces
papers.abstract: Conspectus In recent years, we studied the design of chiral-encoded metal surfaces via electrodeposition as a platform for heterogeneous asymmetric synthesis, where stereochemical information is intrinsically embedded within metallic architectures together with mesoporous structures. By using lyotropic liquid crystal templating and chiral molecular imprinting, it is possible to elaborate chiral-encoded mesoporous metal electrodes by electrodeposition, particularly Pt or Pt–Ir systems, with chiral recognition sites that enable ligand-free enantioselective transformations. These designer materials exhibit high surface area, efficient mass transport, and structural robustness, overcoming key limitations of traditional enantioselective catalysis such as poor recyclability and limited stability. Our studies demonstrate that the chiral interfaces enable highly enantioselective electrosynthesis of chiral compounds, achieving up to 95% ee with excellent durability. In addition, we implemented several concepts to enhance the enantiomeric excess, for example, pulsed electrosynthesis, and self-assembled monolayer protection of chiral-imprinted metal surfaces for highly enantioselective electrosynthesis. Furthermore, we also extended the concept to heterogeneous catalysis for asymmetric synthesis of chiral molecules, in particular, pharmaceutically relevant compounds, eventually achieving up to 95% ee with excellent durability and compatibility with flow-based systems. We also integrated these materials into autonomous systems, developing chiral metal microswimmers that combine self-propulsion with enantioselective catalysis, thus enabling self-mixing. Despite ongoing challenges in stabilizing the imprinted chiral information, the broadening of this concept to other metals, such as multimetallic and non-noble systems, offers promising solutions. Taken together, these advancements establish this approach to create chiral-encoded metal surfaces as a versatile concept for the next generation of chiral-imprinted metals for sustainable asymmetric synthesis.

papers.title_zh: 手性编码Pt与Pt–Ir表面上的电化学支持不对称合成
papers.summary_zh: 该综述总结了通过电沉积构建手性编码介孔金属表面的策略，利用溶致液晶模板与手性分子印迹在Pt或Pt–Ir中嵌入手性识别位点，实现无配体对映选择性电合成，ee最高达95%，并拓展至流动体系与自主系统。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究聚焦于将立体化学信息本征嵌入金属结构并同时构建介孔结构，以电沉积为平台制备手性编码金属表面用于多相不对称合成。策略上采用溶致液晶模板与手性分子印迹相结合，制备手性编码介孔金属电极，特别是Pt或Pt–Ir体系，使其具备手性识别位点，从而无需外加配体即可实现对映选择性转化。这类设计材料具有高比表面积、高效传质和结构稳健性，可克服传统对映选择性催化回收性差、稳定性有限等关键局限。研究展示手性界面可实现高对映选择性电合成，ee最高达95%且耐久性优异。为提升ee，作者还实施了脉冲电合成及自组装单层保护手性印迹金属表面等概念，并将该概念拓展至多相催化合成手性分子，尤其是药物相关化合物，最终实现最高95% ee，并具备优异耐久性与流动体系兼容性。此外，还将材料集成至自主系统，开发出兼具自推进与对映选择性催化功能的手性金属微泳器，实现自混合。尽管稳定印迹手性信息仍存挑战，但将该概念拓展至多金属及非贵金属体系提供了有前景的解决方向。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：电沉积制备手性编码金属表面；溶致液晶模板法构建介孔结构；手性分子印迹引入手性识别位点；脉冲电合成；自组装单层保护手性印迹金属表面；对映选择性电合成与多相催化测试；流动体系兼容性评估；以及构建手性金属微泳器自主系统。摘要未报告具体电解液、电位、温度及表征手段细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与介孔材料、自组装技术及电化学合成主线高度相关，其溶致液晶模板、手性分子印迹与电沉积结合的策略对框架材料组装及手性介孔电极设计具有方法学参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告具体材料组成、孔结构参数及稳定性定量数据。建议全文精读以获取可迁移的合成与表征细节。

key_findings_zh: 通过溶致液晶模板与手性分子印迹电沉积，可制备具有手性识别位点的手性编码介孔Pt或Pt–Ir电极，实现无配体对映选择性转化。
手性界面可实现高对映选择性电合成，ee最高达95%，并具有优异耐久性。
脉冲电合成与自组装单层保护手性印迹金属表面等策略可进一步提升对映体过量。
该概念可拓展至多相催化合成药物相关手性分子，并兼容流动体系；手性金属微泳器可结合自推进与对映选择性催化实现自混合。

papers.title: Chiral Heterojunctions for Spin‐Enhanced Photoreforming of Plastic Waste
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Manipulating the spin state of charge carriers via the chiral‐induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect enhances charge carrier dynamics and lowers kinetic barriers, thereby advancing the photocatalytic upcycling of plastics into renewable chemicals. Here, a chiral‐ligand‐induced interfacial assembly strategy was developed to construct heterojunctions for waste plastics photoreforming. Enantiopure cysteine grafted onto MOF‐808 directs the uniform growth of a TpPa‐COF shell enabling self‐adaptive lattice matching. The heterojunctions exploit the CISS effect to regulate the spin alignment of photogenerated charge carriers. Spin‐polarized electrons are funneled to Pt single atoms, delivering an H 2 evolution rate of 1255.74 µmol g −1 h −1 . During oxidation of polyethylene terephthalate‐derived ethylene glycol, spin‐polarized holes on Pt clusters favor the parallel spin alignment of *OH intermediates, directing the reaction pathway on chiral catalysts toward C2‐retained glycolic acid (865.96 µmol g −1 h −1 ; 90.53% selectivity). In contrast, antiparallel spin alignment on achiral counterparts drives C‐C bond cleavage, yielding the C1 product formic acid. Scalable synthesis, outdoor testing, and techno‐economic analysis demonstrate the practical viability of this approach for solar‐driven waste plastic upcycling.

papers.title_zh: 用于自旋增强塑料废弃物光重整的手性异质结
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过手性配体诱导界面组装构建MOF-808与TpPa-COF异质结，利用CISS效应调控光生载流子自旋，将自旋极化电子导向Pt单原子实现1255.74 µmol g−1 h−1析氢，并高选择性生成乙醇酸。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对塑料废弃物光重整中电荷载流子动力学与反应动力学壁垒问题，提出通过手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应操控电荷载流子自旋态以提升光催化塑料升级回收。设计上采用手性配体诱导的界面组装策略构建异质结：将对映纯半胱氨酸接枝于MOF-808上，引导TpPa-COF壳层均匀生长，实现自适应晶格匹配。该异质结利用CISS效应调控光生电荷载流子的自旋排列。自旋极化电子被导向Pt单原子，实现H2析出速率1255.74 µmol g−1 h−1。在氧化聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯衍生的乙二醇过程中，Pt团簇上的自旋极化空穴有利于*OH中间体的平行自旋排列，使手性催化剂上的反应路径导向保留C2的乙醇酸（865.96 µmol g−1 h−1；90.53%选择性）。相反，非手性对应物上的反平行自旋排列驱动C–C键断裂，生成C1产物甲酸。可放大合成、户外测试与技术经济分析表明该方法对太阳能驱动废塑料升级回收具有实际可行性。

papers.title: Experimental and DFT Cross-Validation: Synergistic Adsorption Mechanisms and Water Stability Improvement of Core-Shell Hierarchically Porous Multimetallic MIL-100(Fe)@hollow Ni/Co-BTC Composites for Perfluorooctanoic Acid Removal
papers.abstract: Abstract Efficient perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) capture requires synergistic optimization of adsorption kinetics and capacity. Defect-free metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) with well-defined hierarchical pores are key to addressing this challenge, yet single-component MOFs face inherent limitations including monotonous pores, insufficient unsaturated metal sites, and poor water stability, which restrict their practical application. To overcome these drawbacks, this study designed and synthesized a core-shell structured dual-MOF composite, MIL-100(Fe)-on-(Ni/Co-BTC) (abbreviated as M-on-(NCB)), via a polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP)-assisted hydrothermal strategy. The composite integrates a hollow Ni/Co-BTC core and a micro–mesoporous MIL-100(Fe) shell: the hollow core constructs diffusion pathways for target molecules and reduces mass transfer resistance; the shell provides high-density Fe active sites, enhances hydrophobicity, and acts as a protective barrier to significantly improve the water stability of the fragile Ni/Co-BTC framework. Systematic characterizations confirm the well-defined core-shell structure, distinct hierarchical pore distribution, uniform elemental composition, and intact hollow core of the composite. Benefiting from structural synergy and multiple adsorption mechanisms, M-on-(NCB) exhibits remarkably superior PFOA adsorption performance relative to single-component MOFs and their physical mixtures. A cross-validation system combining experimental characterizations and density functional theory (DFT) calculations fully elucidates the adsorption mechanism: spectroscopic and zeta potential analyses verify the synergistic roles of electrostatic attraction, ligand exchange, hydrophobic interactions, and pore filling; DFT calculations reveal the nature and strength of each interaction from an electronic structure perspective, confirming that coordination interactions dominate the adsorption process, with electrostatic attraction, hydrogen bonding, and π–CF hydrophobic interactions synergistically enhancing binding. The composite also possesses excellent water stability and cyclic reusability. This work develops a highly efficient and stable PFOA adsorbent via structural innovation, clarifies the adsorption mechanism through experimental–theoretical cross-validation, and proposes a generalizable “structural–functional complementary integration” strategy for MOF-based composite design, providing theoretical support and technical reference for efficient remediation of persistent organic pollutants (POPs).

papers.title_zh: 实验与DFT交叉验证：核壳分级多孔多金属MIL-100(Fe)@中空Ni/Co-BTC复合材料对全氟辛酸去除的协同吸附机制及水稳定性提升
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过PVP辅助水热策略构建了以中空Ni/Co-BTC为核、微介孔MIL-100(Fe)为壳的双MOF复合材料，用于高效捕获全氟辛酸。实验与DFT交叉验证揭示了配位作用主导、多种机制协同的吸附机理，并显著提升了水稳定性与循环复用性。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对全氟辛酸高效捕获需协同优化吸附动力学与容量的需求，以及单组分MOF孔道单一、不饱和金属位点不足、水稳定性差等固有局限，本研究设计并合成了核壳结构双MOF复合材料MIL-100(Fe)-on-(Ni/Co-BTC)（简称M-on-(NCB)），采用聚乙烯吡咯烷酮辅助水热策略制备。复合材料整合了中空Ni/Co-BTC核与微介孔MIL-100(Fe)壳：中空核构建目标分子扩散通道并降低传质阻力；壳层提供高密度Fe活性位点、增强疏水性并作为保护屏障显著改善脆弱Ni/Co-BTC骨架的水稳定性。系统表征确认了明确的核壳结构、分级孔分布、均匀元素组成及完整中空核。得益于结构协同与多重吸附机制，M-on-(NCB)对PFOA的吸附性能显著优于单组分MOF及其物理混合物。该工作通过结构创新开发了高效稳定的PFOA吸附剂，并提出可推广的“结构-功能互补集成”策略。
papers.methods_zh: 采用聚乙烯吡咯烷酮辅助水热策略合成核壳结构双MOF复合材料M-on-(NCB)。通过系统表征确认核壳结构、分级孔分布、元素组成及中空核完整性。采用光谱分析和zeta电位分析验证吸附机制。结合密度泛函理论计算从电子结构角度揭示各相互作用的性质与强度。评估了PFOA吸附性能、水稳定性及循环复用性，但摘要未报告具体表征技术名称、测试条件及性能数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于介孔导电MOF及框架材料组装主线的重要拓展，展示了核壳双MOF分级多孔结构的设计策略与实验-理论交叉验证的机制研究方法。其“结构-功能互补集成”思路对框架材料组装和介孔材料设计具有参考价值。但摘要未报告具体吸附容量、动力学参数及循环稳定性数值，若关注定量性能与机制细节，建议全文精读。

papers.title: N-Heterocyclic Organobase-Mediated Interfacial Polymerization for the Rapid Synthesis of Highly Crystalline COF Membranes
papers.abstract: Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are ideal candidates for constructing high-performance molecular separation membranes. Interfacial polymerization (IP) represents an important approach for fabricating continuous COF membranes. This study presents an N-heterocyclic organobase-mediated IP (N-het-IP) strategy to rapidly fabricate highly crystalline, continuous COF membranes at the interface. The key of the N-het-IP strategy lies in the presynthesized aqueous-phase tertiary amine intermediates derived from the N-heterocyclic organobase (such as piperazine) and aldehyde monomers (such as Tp). The tertiary amine intermediates with a Tp core and N-heterocyclic segments take part in the dynamic amine exchange reaction with organic-phase amine monomers, inducing interfacial membrane formation and COF crystalline transformation within 30 min under mild conditions. Simultaneously, the interfacial assembly of the tertiary amine intermediates constructs an amphiphilic interfacial microenvironment, regulating self-arrangement and suppressing disordered stacking, thereby yielding highly crystalline, continuous, and defect-free COF membranes. Moreover, the N-het-IP strategy exhibits broad universality, being compatible with various N-heterocyclic organobases and amine monomers of diverse COF membranes. Constructed via the N-het-IP strategy, the resulting COF membrane exhibits moderately high permeance and enables precise molecular sieving of dyes. The N-het-IP strategy provides a facile and efficient method to synergize the rapid synthesis and continuous assembly of COF membranes, paving the way for the development of COF membranes tailored for on-demand molecular separations.

papers.title_zh: N-杂环有机碱介导的界面聚合快速合成高结晶COF膜

papers.research_details_zh: 共价有机框架是构建高性能分子分离膜的理想候选材料，界面聚合是制备连续COF膜的重要方法。本研究提出N-杂环有机碱介导的界面聚合策略，用于在界面快速制备高结晶、连续COF膜。该策略的关键在于预合成由N-杂环有机碱（如哌嗪）与醛单体（如Tp）衍生的水相叔胺中间体。具有Tp核心和N-杂环片段的叔胺中间体与有机相胺单体发生动态胺交换反应，在温和条件下30分钟内诱导界面成膜和COF结晶转变。同时，叔胺中间体的界面组装构建了两亲性界面微环境，调控自排列并抑制无序堆叠，从而获得高结晶、连续、无缺陷的COF膜。该策略具有广泛普适性，兼容多种N-杂环有机碱和多种COF膜的胺单体。所制备COF膜表现出中等偏高渗透通量并可实现染料的精确分子筛分。

papers.title: Self‐Assembled Y 2 O 3 /Y(OH) 3 Heterojunction Nanosheets Hydrogel for Efficient Metal Resources Recovery
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hydrogels are innovative and efficient adsorbent for metal resource recovery owing to their three‐dimensional porous network, abundant functional groups, and exceptional hydrophilicity. However, the fabrication of stable metal oxide hydrogels in aqueous media is severely hindered by rapid metal ion hydrolysis and unstable oxide‐water interfaces, leading to structural disintegration. Here, we developed a two‐step, solvent‐mediated self‐assembly strategy to fabricate a robust 3D Y 2 O 3 /Y(OH) 3 heterogeneous nanosheets hydrogel (3D‐YHNH) for metal resource recovery. The 3D‐YHNH shows exceptional adsorption performance, exhibits high capacities of 594.5 mg g −1 for CrO 4 2− and 155.3 mg g −1 for Au(III), coupled with ultra‐rapid adsorption equilibrium kinetics achieved in 2 min. The 3D‐YHNH demonstrated exceptional durability, retaining 99.2% of its initial capacity after 100 consecutive cycles. Combined experimental results and DFT calculations reveal that the exposure of active sites and formation of interfacial defects within 3D‐YHNH generate substantial structural positive charges, resulting in enhanced electrostatic interactions with CrO 4 2− anions. Successful demonstration of kilogram‐scale preparation, together with concentration factors up to 572.6 of Cr(VI) from wastewater and 48.20 of Au(III) from kilogram‐scale e‐waste, suggests that 3D‐YHNH is compatible with industrial deployment. This finding paves the way for sustainable technologies for recovering valuable metals, directly supporting circular economy initiatives.

papers.title_zh: 自组装Y2O3/Y(OH)3异质结纳米片水凝胶用于高效金属资源回收

papers.title: Structure–Dynamics-Property Relationship Reveals the Origin of Porous Integrity in Imine-Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Abstract Molecular flexibility encoded in low-frequency lattice dynamics is increasingly recognized as a key determinant of the properties of porous materials, particularly metal–organic frameworks, but remains largely unexplored in covalent organic frameworks (COFs). Here, we establish a structure–dynamics–property relationship for chemically related COFs by combining three-dimensional electron diffraction, low-frequency vibrational spectroscopy, and first-principles calculations. Using 3D electron diffraction, we determined the crystal structure of the collapsed reduced framework COF-300-AR, revealing a bent linker conformation. Terahertz and low-frequency Raman spectroscopy, together with solid-state density functional theory and local mode analysis, resolve the lattice dynamics of contracted COF-300-H2O, COF-320A, and collapsed COF-300-AR and quantify linker flexibility through imine/amine torsions. Normal-mode decomposition and torsional potential energy surfaces show that these coordinates are comparatively stiff in the imine-based frameworks, preserving near-planar linker conformations that support guest-responsive structures. In contrast, COF-300-AR exhibits a shallower, multiwell torsional potential that enables bent linker conformations, favoring collapsed packing. Gas-phase local-mode analysis reproduces this relative trend in torsional softness, suggesting that linker flexibility can be screened before a crystal structure is available. The negligible gas uptake of COF-300-AR is therefore linked to the coupling of local amine flexibility with packing constraints in the interpenetrated framework. More broadly, these results demonstrate how low-frequency dynamics can identify molecular coordinates governing the structural integrity and porosity in flexible COFs.
