papers.title: Boosting Photoelectrochemical Water Oxidation of BiVO 4 Photoanodes With an Iron‐Based Metal–Organic Framework as a Hole Transport Layer
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Sluggish bulk hole transport fundamentally limits the performance of bismuth vanadate (BiVO 4 ) photoanodes in photoelectrochemical (PEC) water splitting. Herein, we report a BiVO 4 /Fe‐MOF/NiFeOOH trilayer photoanode, wherein an iron‐based bipyridine dicarboxylate metal–organic framework (FeBPDCA), grown on BiVO 4 via coordination‐assisted in situ synthesis, serves as a dedicated hole‐transport layer. The Fe‐MOF layer provides a favorable band alignment and a built‐in electric field at the BiVO 4 /Fe‐MOF interface to drive directional bulk hole extraction, while NiFeOOH acts as a surface water‐oxidation cocatalyst. Experimental characterization and density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that the Fe‐MOF primarily accelerates bulk hole extraction, whereas NiFeOOH suppresses surface recombination through rapid water oxidation, together boosting both bulk charge‐separation efficiency ( η bulk ) and surface charge‐transfer efficiency ( η trans ) up to 97%. The optimized photoanode achieves a high photocurrent density of 7.15 mA cm −2 at 1.23 V vs. RHE, with an onset potential of 0.24 V and a maximum applied bias photon‐to‐current efficiency (ABPE) of 2.56%. This work demonstrates that deliberate tuning of MOF energy levels through metal node and ligand selection enables the simultaneous engineering of favorable band alignment and efficient charge separation at semiconductor/MOF junctions, providing a practical design strategy for photoanodes where bulk charge extraction is the primary efficiency bottleneck.

papers.title: Tracing Covalent Organic Framework Assembly through Kinetic Deceleration
papers.abstract: Abstract The formation mechanisms of covalent organic frameworks (COFs) have long been hypothesized but rarely substantiated by direct experimental evidence. Gaining mechanistic insights into this process is essential for the rational design and scalable synthesis of COFs. In this study, we employed the Schiff-base condensation, known for its high reactivity, to construct a series of β-ketoenamine COFs under mild, acid-free conditions. By intentionally slowing down the reaction kinetics, we successfully captured and structurally characterized millimeter-sized single crystals of an intermediate supramolecular assembly (ISA), which serves as a key intermediate in the COF assembly pathway. Systematic studies of structurally related systems further reveal that the intrinsic reactivity of the monomers plays a decisive role in guiding framework evolution. Notably, crystalline COFs can be synthesized without catalysts or modulators, establishing a green, sustainable synthetic route. Overall, this work provides fundamental insights into COF growth mechanisms, enabling greener, scalable routes to high-quality crystalline COFs.

papers.title_zh: 通过动力学减速追踪共价有机框架的组装过程
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用高活性席夫碱缩合反应，在温和无酸条件下合成β-酮烯胺COF，通过有意减缓反应动力学，成功捕获并表征了毫米级中间体超分子组装单晶，揭示单体本征反应性对框架演化的决定性作用，并实现无催化剂、无调节剂绿色合成晶态COF。
papers.research_details_zh: 共价有机框架的形成机制长期停留在假设层面，缺乏直接实验证据，制约其理性设计与规模化合成。本研究以高反应活性的席夫碱缩合为模型反应，在温和、无酸条件下构建了一系列β-酮烯胺COF。核心策略是刻意降低反应动力学速率，从而在组装路径中捕获关键中间体——中间体超分子组装，并获得毫米级单晶进行结构表征。通过对结构相关体系的系统研究，进一步揭示单体的本征反应性在引导框架演化中起决定性作用。值得注意的是，该工作证明无需催化剂或调节剂即可合成晶态COF，建立了一条绿色可持续的合成路线。整体而言，该研究为COF生长机制提供了基础性见解，为高质量晶态COF的绿色可规模化制备开辟了新途径。
papers.methods_zh: 采用席夫碱缩合反应，在温和、无酸条件下合成一系列β-酮烯胺COF。通过有意减缓反应动力学捕获中间体超分子组装，并对其进行结构表征获得毫米级单晶。对结构相关体系进行系统研究以揭示单体反应性的影响。摘要未报告具体表征手段、性能测试及定量数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF的组装机制与绿色合成主线，其动力学减速捕获中间体的策略对框架材料组装路径研究具有方法论价值，无催化剂合成路线对可规模化制备有实际意义。但摘要未提供具体表征细节与性能数据，建议全文精读以获取机制证据与合成条件。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告具体表征手段、晶体学数据、反应条件参数、产率及性能测试结果，关键实验细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过减缓反应动力学，成功捕获并结构表征了毫米级中间体超分子组装单晶，该中间体是COF组装路径中的关键步骤。
单体的本征反应性对框架演化起决定性作用。
无需催化剂或调节剂即可合成晶态COF，建立绿色可持续合成路线。

papers.title: Spatially Defined Chemical Functionalization of Ordered Block Copolymer Materials
papers.abstract: Abstract The independent manipulation of chemical functionality over the equilibrium morphology in conventional block copolymer (BCP) self-assembly is intrinsically hindered due to the tight composition–structure coupling. Here, we report a synthesis strategy that breaks this constraint by employing self-assembled ABC triblock terpolymer base materials with a gyroid nanoarchitecture and one cross-linked end block as robust 3D templates for the spatially defined in-gel functionalization of the tethered non-cross-linked blocks. We demonstrate this generalizable concept with selective amine attachment in the C end block for selective metal ion coordination, uptake, and nanostructure-directed metal nanoparticle synthesis. Additionally, phase-confined sulfonation is achieved selectively on both the middle B and end C blocks, respectively, producing, to the best of our knowledge, the first monolithic gyroidal hydrogels exhibiting tunable swelling up to 600 vol % and nanoconfined hydration while maintaining structural integrity. Combined sequential and block-selective functionalization generates a nanostructured, pH-responsive polyampholyte material bearing blocked cationic and anionic polymer chains tethered to the continuous and cross-linked gyroidal network. The achieved decoupling of structural and chemical versatility in these cross-linked BCP gels provides a modular platform and design paradigm for studying nanoconfined synthesis, nanoarchitected ion-exchange membranes, and stimuli-responsive smart materials.

papers.title_zh: 有序嵌段共聚物材料的空间限定化学功能化
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用具有双连续螺旋纳米结构和一端交联的ABC三嵌段共聚物自组装材料作为三维模板，实现非交联嵌段的空间限定凝胶内功能化，突破组成-结构强耦合限制，获得可调溶胀达600体积%的螺旋水凝胶及pH响应聚两性电解质材料。
papers.research_details_zh: 传统嵌段共聚物自组装中，化学功能性与平衡形貌的独立调控因组成-结构强耦合而难以实现。本研究报道一种合成策略突破该限制：采用自组装ABC三嵌段共聚物基材，其具有螺旋纳米结构且一端嵌段交联，作为稳健的三维模板，对系连的非交联嵌段进行空间限定的凝胶内功能化。以C端嵌段选择性胺基附着为例，实现选择性金属离子配位、摄取及纳米结构导向的金属纳米颗粒合成。此外，在中B端和C端嵌段上分别实现相限域磺化，制备出据所知首个整体螺旋水凝胶，可调溶胀达600体积%，并在保持结构完整性的同时实现纳米限域水合。顺序和嵌段选择性功能化相结合，生成具有阻塞阳离子和阴离子聚合物链的纳米结构pH响应聚两性电解质材料。该结构-化学多功能性解耦为纳米限域合成、纳米结构离子交换膜及刺激响应智能材料提供模块化平台和设计范式。
papers.methods_zh: 采用自组装ABC三嵌段共聚物基材，具有螺旋纳米结构且一端嵌段交联，作为三维模板进行凝胶内功能化。通过选择性胺基附着实现金属离子配位、摄取和金属纳米颗粒合成；通过相限域磺化在中B端和C端嵌段分别功能化。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段及性能测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装技术与框架材料组装的交叉领域，其空间限定功能化策略对纳米结构材料的化学修饰具有方法论借鉴意义，螺旋水凝胶和聚两性电解质材料在离子交换膜和刺激响应材料方面有潜在价值。但该研究不涉及MOF/COF/HOF框架材料，与介孔导电MOF主线关联较弱，建议作为拓展阅读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段、金属离子种类、纳米颗粒尺寸及性能测试数据，关键实验细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 利用一端交联的ABC三嵌段共聚物螺旋纳米结构作为三维模板，实现非交联嵌段的空间限定凝胶内功能化，突破组成-结构耦合限制。
在C端嵌段实现选择性胺基附着，用于金属离子配位、摄取及纳米结构导向金属纳米颗粒合成。
在中B端和C端嵌段分别实现相限域磺化，制备出首个整体螺旋水凝胶，可调溶胀达600体积%，保持结构完整性。
顺序和嵌段选择性功能化生成纳米结构pH响应聚两性电解质材料，具有阻塞阳离子和阴离子聚合物链。

papers.title: Spatially Decoupled Polysulfide Trapping and Catalytic Conversion in Pyridine‐Rich Covalent Organic Framework for Li‐S Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The lithium polysulfide (LiPS) shuttle and sluggish redox kinetics remain major challenges for rechargeable Li‐S batteries. Herein, a Lewis‐basic pyridine‐rich covalent organic framework (PCOF) is developed as a dual‐functional host that enables effective LiPS trapping and catalytic conversion. Elemental sulfur‐loaded PCOF (S@PCOF) and atomically Co‐coordinated PCOF‐derived framework (Co@PCOF) are synthesized and integrated to construct a Li‐S cathode with spatially separated active sites. PCOF exhibits stronger binding affinity and faster binding kinetics for LiPS than pyridine‐free COF (BCOF) with an identical imine content, highlighting the role of pyridine groups in LiPS trapping. Moreover, density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal a lower energy barrier for the potential‐determining step (Li 2 S 2 → Li 2 S) on PCOF than on BCOF, originating from its higher p ‐band center. The Co@PCOF‐integrated PCOF cathode delivers the highest Li 2 S nucleation and dissolution capacities with accelerated kinetics, enabling highly reversible sulfur redox reactions. Full cells employing the S@PCOF+Co@PCOF cathode exhibit a high discharge capacity (952 mAh g −1 ), superior Coulombic efficiency (98%), excellent long‐term cycling stability, and robust rate performance across various C‐rates. This work provides a rational design strategy for spatially separating LiPS trapping and catalytic sites in pyridine‐rich COF cathodes, offering new insights into the development of high‐performance Li‐S batteries.

papers.title_zh: 富吡啶共价有机框架中空间解耦的多硫化物捕获与催化转化用于锂硫电池
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发富吡啶共价有机框架作为双功能宿主，通过空间分离的活性位点实现锂多硫化物有效捕获与催化转化。PCOF比无吡啶BCOF具有更强结合亲和力和更快结合动力学，DFT揭示其更低能垒源于更高p带中心，全电池放电容量达952 mAh/g，库仑效率98%。
papers.research_details_zh: 锂多硫化物穿梭和缓慢氧化还原动力学是锂硫电池的主要挑战。本研究开发一种路易斯碱性富吡啶共价有机框架作为双功能宿主，实现有效的锂多硫化物捕获和催化转化。合成载硫PCOF和原子级钴配位的PCOF衍生框架，并将二者集成构建具有空间分离活性位点的锂硫正极。PCOF对锂多硫化物表现出比具有相同亚胺含量的无吡啶COF更强的结合亲和力和更快的结合动力学，凸显吡啶基团在锂多硫化物捕获中的作用。密度泛函理论计算揭示，PCOF上潜在决速步的能垒低于BCOF，源于其更高的p带中心。Co@PCOF集成的PCOF正极具有最高的Li2S成核和溶解容量及加速动力学，实现高度可逆的硫氧化还原反应。采用S@PCOF+Co@PCOF正极的全电池表现出高放电容量、优异库仑效率、出色长期循环稳定性和稳健倍率性能。该工作为富吡啶COF正极中空间分离锂多硫化物捕获和催化位点提供了理性设计策略。
papers.methods_zh: 合成富吡啶共价有机框架及无吡啶对照BCOF，制备载硫PCOF和原子级钴配位的PCOF衍生框架Co@PCOF，集成构建空间分离活性位点的锂硫正极。采用密度泛函理论计算能垒和p带中心。进行Li2S成核和溶解容量测试、全电池放电容量、库仑效率、循环稳定性和倍率性能测试。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段及测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF在电化学能源存储中的应用主线，其空间解耦捕获与催化位点的设计策略对COF基电催化剂和电池材料具有实际参考价值。吡啶基团增强多硫化物结合及p带中心调控机制的揭示对COF结构-性能关系研究有启发意义。建议全文精读以获取合成细节和电化学测试条件。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段、DFT计算参数、电解液组成及电化学测试条件，关键实验细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: PCOF对锂多硫化物表现出比具有相同亚胺含量的无吡啶BCOF更强的结合亲和力和更快的结合动力学，凸显吡啶基团在捕获中的作用。
DFT计算揭示PCOF上潜在决速步的能垒低于BCOF，源于其更高的p带中心。
Co@PCOF集成的PCOF正极具有最高的Li2S成核和溶解容量及加速动力学，实现高度可逆硫氧化还原。
全电池采用S@PCOF+Co@PCOF正极，放电容量达952 mAh/g，库仑效率98%，具有优异长期循环稳定性和稳健倍率性能。

papers.title: Redox Reactions in Molten Indium Halide Salts Enable the Synthesis and Shape Control of In-Pnictide Nanocrystals
papers.abstract: Abstract Molten indium halide salts enable high-temperature and oxygen-free processing and production of III–V nanocrystals, but their redox chemistry can also induce nanocrystal decomposition. Here we show that redox potential of indium halide melts controls the chemical stability of InP, InAs, and InSb nanocrystals. Raman probes of halide speciation and powder XRD of recovered solids reveal that iodide melts, such as KInI4, can oxidize indium pnictide nanocrystals, coupling salt reduction to oxidative pnictide loss, whereas bromide melts, such as KInBr4, resist reduction and stabilize InP and InAs nanocrystals. This redox-tuned stability enables composition-preserving annealing that smooths (111) facets, converting round or tetrapod-like InP and InAs particles into highly faceted tetrahedra, and promotes atomically aligned self-assembly and preferential substrate orientation. Controlled ripening in KInBr4 yields larger III–V colloids inaccessible by synthesis conducted in conventional organic solvents. Furthermore, combining molten-salt annealing with monolayer ZnS growth by colloidal atomic layer deposition (c-ALD) produces significant photoluminescence enhancement, underscoring the chemical benefits of redox-tuned molten salt solvents for the synthesis of novel III–V nanocrystals. Finally, we demonstrate a strategy to enhance the reactivity of reduced indium halide salts through halide coordination with a strong Lewis acid, enabling direct synthesis of InP and InAs nanocrystals. Reaction environments with highly reactive reduced indium salt engineered in molten salts also reveal that under certain reaction conditions, unprecedented 2D InP nanoplatelets can be synthesized.

papers.title_zh: 熔融卤化铟盐中的氧化还原反应实现In-磷族纳米晶体的合成与形貌控制
papers.summary_zh: 该研究揭示熔融卤化铟盐的氧化还原电位可调控InP、InAs和InSb纳米晶体的化学稳定性，碘化物熔盐会氧化磷族纳米晶体，而溴化物熔盐可稳定纳米晶体，从而实现组成保持的退火、形貌控制和自组装。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究关注熔融卤化铟盐在高温无氧条件下合成III–V纳米晶体时，其氧化还原化学可能导致纳米晶体分解的问题。研究体系为InP、InAs和InSb纳米晶体在KInI4和KInBr4等熔融卤化铟盐中的稳定性与形貌演变。设计策略是利用卤化物熔盐的氧化还原电位差异来调控纳米晶体的化学稳定性。研究过程包括通过拉曼光谱探测卤化物物种形态，粉末XRD分析回收固体，发现碘化物熔盐可将盐还原与磷族元素氧化损失耦合，而溴化物熔盐抗还原并能稳定InP和InAs。该氧化还原调控的稳定性使得组成保持退火成为可能，可将圆形或四足状InP和InAs颗粒转化为高度面化的四面体，并促进原子级对齐自组装和优先基底取向。在KInBr4中控制熟化可得到传统有机溶剂中无法合成的大尺寸III–V胶体。将熔盐退火与胶体原子层沉积（c-ALD）生长单层ZnS结合，显著增强光致发光。此外，通过强路易斯酸配位卤化物增强还原态卤化铟盐的反应性，可直接合成InP和InAs纳米晶体，并在特定条件下合成出前所未有的二维InP纳米片。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：熔融卤化铟盐高温无氧处理；拉曼光谱探测卤化物物种形态；粉末XRD分析回收固体；组成保持退火；控制熟化；胶体原子层沉积（c-ALD）生长单层ZnS；强路易斯酸配位卤化物增强还原态卤化铟盐反应性。摘要未报告具体温度、时间、前驱体浓度等实验条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究对框架材料组装和电化学合成主线有间接参考价值：熔融盐氧化还原调控纳米晶体稳定性、形貌和自组装的策略，可为介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料的熔盐合成或后处理提供思路。但该研究聚焦III–V半导体纳米晶体，不涉及MOF/COF/HOF框架，局限明显。若关注熔盐介质中的组装与氧化还原调控，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，未使用摘要外信息。摘要未报告具体实验温度、时间、前驱体浓度、产率、粒径分布等关键细节，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 碘化物熔盐如KInI4可氧化InP、InAs和InSb纳米晶体，将盐还原与磷族元素氧化损失耦合；溴化物熔盐如KInBr4抗还原并能稳定InP和InAs纳米晶体。
氧化还原调控的稳定性可实现组成保持退火，将圆形或四足状InP和InAs颗粒转化为高度面化的四面体，并促进原子级对齐自组装和优先基底取向。
在KInBr4中控制熟化可得到传统有机溶剂中无法合成的大尺寸III–V胶体；熔盐退火与单层ZnS c-ALD结合可显著增强光致发光。
通过强路易斯酸配位卤化物增强还原态卤化铟盐反应性，可直接合成InP和InAs纳米晶体，并在特定条件下合成出前所未有的二维InP纳米片。

papers.title: Proton-Mediated Host–Guest Interactions Direct Nucleation and Morphology Evolution in Molecular Sieve Crystallization
papers.abstract: Abstract The crystallization of aluminophosphate (AlPO4-n) and silicoaluminophosphate (SAPO-n) molecular sieves under acidic conditions represents a significant mechanistic departure from well-established alkaline routes for zeolites. Here, we elucidate how protons actively gate the nucleation and growth of AlPO4-n /SAPO-n frameworks. By integrating ultrafast operando two-dimensional (2D) solid-state NMR (acquiring high-quality 1H–27Al HMQC spectra in just 30 seconds) with density functional theory (DFT) simulations, we resolve a proton-mediated dual-channel gating mechanism: under acidic conditions, protons lower the kinetic barrier for P–O–Al condensation from 0.63 to 0.25 eV while simultaneously increasing the thermodynamic driving force for framework assembly, thereby markedly accelerating nucleation. Operando NMR further reveals an alternating dominance between water/hydroxyl-driven hydrolysis and OSDA-driven templating, a dynamic gating that directs the conversion of amorphous precursors into ordered nuclei via a reversibly formed interfacial intermediate. Moreover, the protonation effect enables selective facet stabilization by acetate species, steering crystal morphology from cubic to nanoscale sheet-like or rod-like architectures across diverse topologies (AFI, CHA, AEI). Our findings redefine acidity from a passive reaction medium into an active director of zeolite crystallization pathways, establishing it as a designable parameter in nucleation theory and providing a rational basis for engineering molecular sieves with controlled morphologies and framework topologies.

papers.title_zh: 质子介导的主客体相互作用指导分子筛结晶中的成核与形貌演化
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过超快原位二维固体NMR与DFT模拟，揭示酸性条件下质子介导的双通道门控机制，质子降低P–O–Al缩合动力学能垒并增加框架组装热力学驱动力，从而加速成核并调控分子筛形貌。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究关注酸性条件下铝磷酸盐（AlPO4-n）和硅铝磷酸盐（SAPO-n）分子筛结晶机制与经典碱性沸石合成路线的显著差异。研究体系为AlPO4-n和SAPO-n分子筛框架，涉及AFI、CHA、AEI等多种拓扑结构。设计策略是整合超快原位二维固体NMR（30秒内获取高质量1H–27Al HMQC谱）与DFT模拟，解析质子如何主动门控成核与生长。研究过程揭示了质子介导的双通道门控机制：酸性条件下质子将P–O–Al缩合动力学能垒从0.63 eV降至0.25 eV，同时增加框架组装的热力学驱动力，显著加速成核。原位NMR进一步揭示水/羟基驱动的水解与OSDA驱动的模板化之间存在交替主导，这种动态门控通过可逆形成的界面中间体引导无定形前驱体转化为有序晶核。此外，质子化效应使乙酸物种能够选择性稳定晶面，在多种拓扑结构中将晶体形貌从立方体调控为纳米片状或棒状。该研究将酸性从被动反应介质重新定义为沸石结晶路径的主动导向因素，使其成为成核理论中的可设计参数。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：超快原位二维固体NMR（30秒内获取高质量1H–27Al HMQC谱）；密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟；原位NMR监测结晶过程；乙酸物种选择性晶面稳定。摘要未报告具体合成温度、时间、前驱体配比等实验条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究对框架材料组装主线有重要参考价值：质子介导的主客体相互作用、双通道门控成核机制以及形貌调控策略，可启发介孔导电MOF、共轭MOF/COF/HOF的结晶与组装设计。但该研究聚焦无机分子筛，不涉及有机框架或导电框架，局限明显。若关注成核机制与形貌调控，值得全文精读。

papers.title: Synergistic Linkage Engineering in Donor–Acceptor Covalent Organic Frameworks for NIR-II Absorption and Efficient Photothermal Conversion
papers.abstract: Abstract Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are emerging crystalline porous polymers with precisely defined structures and tunable optoelectronic properties. However, developing COFs that simultaneously achieve NIR-II light absorption and controlled excited-state dynamics remains challenging, limiting their applications in advanced photothermal energy conversion. Herein, we report a strategy that synergistically integrates linkage engineering and donor–acceptor modulation to intrinsically regulate the photophysical behavior of COFs, as demonstrated by the synthesis of a novel donor–acceptor azo-linked COF (Azo-COF-DA). Compared with its imine-linked analogue (Im-COF-DA), Azo-COF-DA exhibits remarkable NIR-II absorption (1500 nm vs 650 nm) and a significantly narrowed bandgap (1.16 eV vs 2.34 eV), highlighting the critical role of azo linkages in maximizing electronic delocalization. Comprehensive spectroscopic and theoretical analyses reveal significantly enhanced vibronic coupling in Azo-COF-DA upon photoexcitation, thereby promoting efficient nonradiative relaxation. Consequently, Azo-COF-DA achieves a temperature increase 10.8-fold higher than that of Im-COF-DA, translating this superior photothermal conversion into a record COF-based thermoelectric output voltage of 262 mV under one-sun irradiation. Furthermore, an integrated solar-driven water evaporation–thermoelectric generator simultaneously achieves a water evaporation rate of 1.44 kg m–2 h–1 and a voltage output of 116 mV. This work reveals the importance of linkage replacement in governing π-electronic delocalization and excited-state relaxation, providing transferable structural design guidelines for tailoring excited-state dynamics in porous organic materials toward high-performance NIR-II photothermal applications.

papers.title_zh: 供体–受体共价有机框架中的协同连接工程实现NIR-II吸收与高效光热转换
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过连接工程与供体–受体调制协同策略，合成新型偶氮连接供体–受体COF（Azo-COF-DA），实现NIR-II吸收（1500 nm）、窄带隙（1.16 eV）和高效非辐射弛豫，光热温升较亚胺连接类似物高10.8倍，并创COF基热电器件输出电压纪录262 mV。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究关注共价有机框架（COF）同时实现NIR-II光吸收和受控激发态动力学这一挑战，该挑战限制了COF在先进光热能量转换中的应用。研究体系为新型供体–受体偶氮连接COF（Azo-COF-DA）与其亚胺连接类似物（Im-COF-DA）。设计策略是协同整合连接工程与供体–受体调制，本征调控COF的光物理行为。研究过程包括合成Azo-COF-DA和Im-COF-DA，对比其光物理性质。Azo-COF-DA表现出显著的NIR-II吸收（1500 nm vs 650 nm）和显著窄化的带隙（1.16 eV vs 2.34 eV），突显偶氮连接在最大化电子离域中的关键作用。综合光谱和理论分析揭示Azo-COF-DA在光激发下具有显著增强的振动耦合，从而促进高效非辐射弛豫。因此，Azo-COF-DA的温升较Im-COF-DA高10.8倍，将优异光热转换转化为创纪录的COF基热电器件输出电压262 mV（单太阳照射下）。此外，集成太阳能驱动水蒸发–热电器件同时实现1.44 kg m–2 h–1的水蒸发速率和116 mV的电压输出。该研究揭示了连接替换在调控π电子离域和激发态弛豫中的重要性，为多孔有机材料中激发态动力学调控提供可转移的结构设计指南。

papers.title: Ultrastable Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Framework for Efficient CO 2 /CH 4 Separation in Humid Environments
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Selective CO 2 removal during methane purification is critical for energy‐efficient utilization. The development of porous adsorbents integrating ultrahigh structural stability, excellent separation capability, and moisture resistance represents a desirable yet challenging objective for upgrading natural gas. Unlike conventional synthesis strategies for hydrogen‑bonded organic frameworks (HOFs) that utilize strong hydrogen‐bonding groups such as carboxylic acid groups and 2,4‐diaminotriazine, this study employs aldehyde functionalities to construct a novel HOF (HFPTP‐HOF) with exceptional moisture resistance and ultrahigh stability. At 298 K and 1 atm, the material exhibits an IAST selectivity of 18.61 for equimolar CO 2 /CH 4 mixtures, representing the highest values among reported HOF materials. Dynamic breakthrough experiments confirm its ability to produce 99.99% pure CH 4 . More notably, the HOF adopts a distinctive interlayer stacking structure formed by synergistic interligand multiple C–H⋯O hydrogen bonding and interdigitation. This interlayer stacking architecture imparts remarkable stability to HFPTP‐HOF by encapsulating the hydrogen bonds responsible for framework formation within a hydrophobic barrier, which allows it to retain structural integrity even when immersed in 12 M hydrochloric acid at 50°C, 20 M sodium hydroxide at 100°C or boiling water for 7 days. To our knowledge, this stability exceeds those of all reported HOFs. In addition, within the HOF's pore channels, aldehyde groups and hydrophobic benzene rings are distributed on opposite sides of the pores. This spatial arrangement effectively prevents water molecule clustering within the pores, enabling HFPTP‐HOF to maintain outstanding CO 2 /CH 4 separation performance even under 90% RH. Overall, this work provides new insights into the design and synthesis of HOFs that combine ultrahigh stability with exceptional humidity‑resistant separation efficiency.

papers.title_zh: 超稳定氢键有机框架用于潮湿环境中高效CO2/CH4分离
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以醛基功能团构建新型氢键有机框架HFPTP-HOF，突破传统HOF依赖羧酸或二氨基三嗪的合成策略。材料在298 K、1 atm下对等摩尔CO2/CH4的IAST选择性达18.61，为已报道HOF最高值，动态穿透实验可产出99.99%纯CH4，并在90%相对湿度下保持优异分离性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 天然气提纯中高效脱除CO2对节能利用至关重要，但兼具超高结构稳定性、优异分离能力和抗湿性的多孔吸附剂开发极具挑战。传统氢键有机框架（HOF）合成多依赖羧酸基团和2,4-二氨基三嗪等强氢键基团，本研究另辟蹊径，采用醛基功能团构建新型HOF（HFPTP-HOF）。该材料形成独特的层间堆叠结构，由配体间多重C–H⋯O氢键协同互穿作用构成。这种层间堆叠架构将框架形成所需的氢键封装在疏水屏障内，赋予材料卓越稳定性。在孔道内，醛基和疏水苯环分布于孔道两侧，该空间排布有效阻止水分子在孔内聚集。研究通过静态吸附、IAST选择性计算、动态穿透实验及极端条件稳定性测试评估性能，为兼具超高稳定性和优异抗湿分离效率的HOF设计合成提供了新思路。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：采用醛基功能团构建HFPTP-HOF的合成策略；通过IAST计算等摩尔CO2/CH4混合物的选择性；开展动态穿透实验验证CH4纯化能力；进行极端条件稳定性测试，即将材料浸泡于50°C的12 M盐酸、100°C的20 M氢氧化钠或沸水中7天；以及在90%相对湿度下评估CO2/CH4分离性能。摘要未报告具体的表征手段（如PXRD、BET、单晶结构解析等）和详细的合成条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作对氢键有机框架（HOF）的设计合成具有重要参考价值，尤其是以醛基替代传统强氢键基团构建框架的策略，以及通过层间堆叠封装氢键实现超常稳定性的机制，对框架材料组装和稳定性调控研究有直接启发。其抗湿分离性能对实际天然气提纯应用意义显著。局限性在于摘要未提供孔结构参数、吸附等温线细节和长期循环稳定性数据。鉴于其报道的稳定性与选择性均为已报道HOF最高水平，值得全文精读以获取完整设计逻辑与表征证据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告的实验条件（如具体合成温度、溶剂、反应时间）、表征手段（如PXRD、BET比表面积、单晶结构）、吸附等温线数据、循环稳定性、选择性计算细节及穿透实验条件等关键信息，均需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 在298 K和1 atm下，HFPTP-HOF对等摩尔CO2/CH4混合物的IAST选择性为18.61，为已报道HOF材料中的最高值。
动态穿透实验证实该材料可产出99.99%纯度的CH4。
HFPTP-HOF在50°C的12 M盐酸、100°C的20 M氢氧化钠或沸水中浸泡7天后仍保持结构完整性，其稳定性超过所有已报道HOF。
在90%相对湿度下，HFPTP-HOF仍保持出色的CO2/CH4分离性能，归因于孔道内醛基与疏水苯环分列两侧的空间排布有效阻止水分子聚集。

papers.title: Rigid-Flexible Coupling Pore Engineering in Covalent Organic Frameworks Enables the Selective Identification of Nucleotide Analogues
papers.abstract: Abstract Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) offer programmable pore architectures and tunable host–guest interactions, yet their rigid channels limit the selective recognition of structurally similar biomolecules─a longstanding challenge in sensor design. Inspired by enzymatic pockets that combine rigid active sites with flexible secondary coordination spheres, we report a rigid-flexible coupling pore engineering strategy that integrates spatially proximal rigid Fe single-atom switches and dynamic alkoxy chains within a light-emitting hydrazone COF scaffold. By strategically varying the alkoxy chain length from methoxy to heptyloxy, we demonstrate that elongated flexible chains modulate the coordination geometry of Fe single-atom sites through steric hindrance effect and enable adaptive binding of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) over its analogues adenosine monophosphate and adenosine diphosphate. This selective recognition, driven by synergistic coordination from the rigid Fe single-atom and multiple weak interactions (including hydrogen bond, C–H···π, and hydrophobic interactions) from the flexible heptyloxy chain, suppresses the photoinduced electron transfer from the COF skeleton to the Fe sites and ultimately triggers a fluorescence turn-on response exclusively for ATP, with a wide quantitative range from 10 nM to 50 μM and a limit of detection as low as 8.99 nM. This work establishes a biomimetic paradigm for designing COF-based sensors with tailored specificity toward structurally similar nucleotides.

papers.title_zh: 共价有机框架中的刚柔耦合孔工程实现核苷酸类似物的选择性识别
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出刚柔耦合孔工程策略，在发光腙基COF中集成刚性Fe单原子开关与动态烷氧基链，通过调控链长实现ATP对AMP和ADP的选择性荧光开启识别，检测限低至8.99 nM。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对COF刚性孔道难以选择性识别结构相似生物分子的长期挑战，该研究受酶口袋中刚性活性位点与柔性二级配位球协同作用的启发，提出刚柔耦合孔工程策略。研究体系为发光腙基COF骨架，其中空间邻近地集成刚性Fe单原子开关和动态烷氧基链。通过将烷氧基链长从甲氧基系统性变化至庚氧基，作者考察了柔性链对Fe单原子位点配位几何的调控作用。结果表明，延长的柔性链通过位阻效应调节Fe位点配位几何，并实现对ATP相对于AMP和ADP的适应性结合。该识别由刚性Fe单原子的协同配位与柔性庚氧基链的多种弱相互作用共同驱动，抑制了从COF骨架到Fe位点的光诱导电子转移，最终触发仅对ATP的荧光开启响应。该工作为设计针对结构相似核苷酸具有定制特异性的COF传感器建立了仿生范式。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成发光腙基COF骨架并集成刚性Fe单原子开关与动态烷氧基链；通过将烷氧基链长从甲氧基变化至庚氧基进行孔工程调控；利用荧光开启响应进行ATP、AMP和ADP的识别性能测试，获得10 nM至50 μM的定量范围和8.99 nM的检测限。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、表征手段及配位结构解析方法。

papers.title: Multi-Chamber Dynamic Molecular Crystal Microcapsules for Payload Encapsulation and Controlled Release
papers.abstract: Abstract Crystalline self-assembly offers a powerful route to ordered organic materials with well-defined structures and morphologies. Despite substantial advances in controlling crystal habit, organic single crystals with precisely engineered architectures, particularly those with fully enclosed internal cavities, remain exceptionally rare and challenging to fabricate. Here, we report a one-pot strategy that uses an optimized aqueous multisurfactant crystal growth approach to produce microcapsules with programmable numbers and sizes of sealed internal compartments. A simple model captures the qualitative aspects of this phenomenon by positing diffusion-limited growth coupled with asymmetric surfactant inhibition. The microcapsule voids are contained within a single crystal domain, enabling encapsulation and long-term storage of diverse components, including water-soluble dyes, hydrogen peroxide, and nanoparticles, within separate chambers of a multichambered crystalline microcapsule. The encapsulated species remain fully isolated and leak-tight for over 200 days. Visible-light irradiation (400–580 nm) causes photoactive molecules within the crystal matrix to undergo [2 + 2] photocycloaddition, inducing photomechanical disintegration at specific locations. This capability enables on-demand release of stored contents ranging from inorganic nanoparticles to small molecules. For example, the triggered release of H2O2 or Fe3+ gives rise to chemiluminescent reactions in localized regions near the ruptured crystals. This work establishes a new design paradigm for dynamic photoresponsive molecular crystals with programmable internal architectures and emergent functionalities.

papers.title_zh: 用于载荷封装与可控释放的多腔动态分子晶体微胶囊
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过优化水性多表面活性剂晶体生长一锅法，制备具有可编程数量与尺寸密封内腔的有机单晶微胶囊，实现多种载荷长期隔离存储及可见光触发按需释放。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对具有精确工程化结构、尤其完全封闭内腔的有机单晶极为罕见且难以制备的问题，该研究报道了一种一锅法策略，采用优化的水性多表面活性剂晶体生长方法，制备具有可编程数量和尺寸密封内腔的微胶囊。作者提出一个简单模型，通过假设扩散限制生长与非对称表面活性剂抑制相结合，定性解释该现象。微胶囊空腔位于单一晶畴内，可在多腔晶体微胶囊的不同腔室中封装并长期存储多种组分，包括水溶性染料、过氧化氢和纳米颗粒。封装的物种保持完全隔离且防漏超过200天。可见光照射（400–580 nm）使晶体基质内的光活性分子发生[2+2]光致环加成，在特定位置诱导光机械崩解，从而实现从无机纳米颗粒到小分子的按需释放。例如，触发释放H2O2或Fe3+可在破裂晶体附近局部区域引发化学发光反应。该工作为具有可编程内部结构和涌现功能的动态光响应分子晶体建立了新设计范式。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：优化水性多表面活性剂晶体生长一锅法；提出扩散限制生长与非对称表面活性剂抑制相结合的定性模型；封装水溶性染料、过氧化氢和纳米颗粒并进行长期隔离存储测试；采用可见光照射（400–580 nm）触发[2+2]光致环加成与光机械崩解；通过化学发光反应验证H2O2或Fe3+的触发释放。摘要未报告具体表面活性剂种类、晶体结构解析及释放动力学定量数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于晶体自组装与动态分子晶体领域，与自组装技术研究主线相关，其多腔微胶囊设计与光触发释放策略对框架材料及介孔材料的封装与控释功能设计具有借鉴意义。研究展示了明确的长期隔离存储与光响应释放性能，但摘要未报告晶体结构细节与释放动力学。建议对自组装与控释方向感兴趣的读者全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未使用外部常识补造。摘要未报告的具体表面活性剂种类、晶体结构解析、释放动力学定量数据及光机械崩解机制细节仍需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 一锅法水性多表面活性剂晶体生长可制备具有可编程数量和尺寸密封内腔的微胶囊。
微胶囊空腔位于单一晶畴内，封装的水溶性染料、过氧化氢和纳米颗粒保持完全隔离且防漏超过200天。
可见光照射（400–580 nm）触发晶体基质内[2+2]光致环加成，诱导光机械崩解并实现按需释放。
触发释放H2O2或Fe3+可在破裂晶体附近局部区域引发化学发光反应。

papers.title: Energy‐Level Engineering with Co‐Sensitization of Organic Molecules on NiO x for Sn‐Based Perovskite Solar Cells
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT A cooperative self‐assembly of organic small molecules made of diester/diacid‐bithiophene units [BT 2D ‐CE ( 1 ), BT 2D ‐CA ( 2 )] with hexylpyridine‐ or phosphonic acid‐functionalized dithienopyrrole units [DTP 2D ‐Py ( 3 ), DTP 2D ‐PA ( 4 )] was induced atop Nickel Oxide (NiO x ) hole‐transport‐layer for lead‐free tin‐based perovskite solar cells. The pyridine functionality of DTP 2D ‐Py ( 3 ) in conjunction with the carboxyl group of BT 2D ‐CA ( 2 ) altered the NiO x /Perovskite interfacial energetics and accelerates selective hole extraction by passivating the buried interfacial defects, resulting in a power conversion efficiency of 8.1% due to enhanced photovoltage (0.560 to 0.593 V), alongside remarkable operational stability. The crucial role of synergistic energy‐level modulation, especially the Fermi level, was unraveled using ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy, demonstrating that combining complementary conjugated organic backbones with targeted functionalities offers versatility for enhancement of overall device performance and stability.

papers.title_zh: NiOx上有机分子共敏化的能级工程用于锡基钙钛矿太阳能电池
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过二酯/二酸-联噻吩单元与己基吡啶或膦酸功能化二噻吩并吡咯单元在NiOx上的协同自组装，调控界面能级并钝化缺陷，使锡基钙钛矿电池效率达8.1%。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究针对无铅锡基钙钛矿太阳能电池的界面能级调控与缺陷钝化问题，采用由二酯/二酸-联噻吩单元[BT2D-CE (1)、BT2D-CA (2)]与己基吡啶或膦酸功能化二噻吩并吡咯单元[DTP2D-Py (3)、DTP2D-PA (4)]组成的有机小分子，在NiOx空穴传输层上进行协同自组装。其中DTP2D-Py (3)的吡啶官能团与BT2D-CA (2)的羧基共同改变NiOx/钙钛矿界面能级，并通过钝化埋底界面缺陷加速选择性空穴提取。结果获得8.1%的功率转换效率，光电压从0.560 V提升至0.593 V，并具有显著的操作稳定性。作者利用紫外光电子能谱揭示了协同能级调控尤其是费米能级的关键作用，表明将互补共轭有机骨架与目标官能团结合可为提升器件整体性能与稳定性提供通用性策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成二酯/二酸-联噻吩单元与己基吡啶或膦酸功能化二噻吩并吡咯单元有机小分子；在NiOx空穴传输层上诱导协同自组装；制备无铅锡基钙钛矿太阳能电池并测试功率转换效率、光电压和操作稳定性；采用紫外光电子能谱表征界面能级调控。摘要未报告具体自组装条件、薄膜表征细节及稳定性测试条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作涉及共轭有机分子在金属氧化物上的自组装与界面能级工程，与自组装技术及共轭材料研究主线部分相关，但其核心应用为钙钛矿太阳能电池，与介孔导电MOF及框架材料组装电化学合成主线关联有限。研究提供了明确的效率与光电压定量数据及能级调控证据。对界面自组装与能级工程感兴趣的读者可选择性精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未使用外部常识补造。摘要未报告的具体自组装条件、薄膜表征细节、稳定性测试条件及器件制备工艺参数仍需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: DTP2D-Py的吡啶官能团与BT2D-CA的羧基协同改变NiOx/钙钛矿界面能级并钝化埋底界面缺陷。
协同自组装使锡基钙钛矿太阳能电池功率转换效率达到8.1%，光电压从0.560 V提升至0.593 V。
器件表现出显著的操作稳定性。
紫外光电子能谱揭示协同能级调控尤其是费米能级的关键作用。

papers.title: Mechanochemical Encapsulation of Enzymes in a Highly Hydrophilic HOF: Harnessing Pore Microenvironment for Enhanced Biocatalysis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Enzymes immobilized within hydrogen‐bonded organic frameworks (HOFs) often suffer from reduced catalytic activity due to mass transfer limitations and pore channel blocking by residual organic solvents from conventional solution‐phase synthesis. In addition, the correlation of HOF pore hydrophilicity‐hydrophobicity with enzymatic reactivity has rarely been underscored. Here, we report a mechanochemistry‐mediated HOF assembly strategy that enables non‐destructive, in situ enzyme encapsulation while generating an open porous network free from solvent‐induced pore blockage. Using a series of isostructural HOFs assembled from [1,1′:4′,1″‐terphenyl]‐3,3″,5,5″‐tetracarboxylic acid (H 4 TPTCA) bearing different substituents (‐NH 2 , ‐H, ‐CH 3 ), we demonstrate that mechanochemical synthesis affords enzyme@HOF biocomposites with up to a 449‐fold enhancement in catalytic rate compared to the conventional solution‐phase method. Notably, the introduction of ‐NH 2 groups substantially improves pore‐wall water adsorption capability, leading to 1.45–2.78 times and 116.1–330.3 times higher activity than the ‐H and ‐CH 3 analogues, respectively. Leveraging the high activity and stability of mechanochemical enzyme@HOF biocatalysts, we construct a sandwich‐type electrochemical immunosensor for carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) that achieves a wide linear range and a detection limit as low as 15.6 fg mL −1 . This work establishes a green mechanochemical route to highly active enzyme@HOF biocatalysts and highlights the critical role of hydrophilic pore environments in preserving enzymatic function.

papers.title_zh: 机械化学法将酶封装于高亲水性HOF中：利用孔道微环境增强生物催化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作采用机械化学组装策略，将酶无损原位封装于系列同构HOF中，避免溶剂堵塞孔道，催化速率较溶液法提升最高449倍；氨基修饰增强孔壁亲水性，显著提高活性，并构建了CEA电化学免疫传感器。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对HOF固定化酶常因传质受限和传统溶液相合成残留有机溶剂堵塞孔道而导致催化活性下降的问题，同时指出HOF孔道亲疏水性与酶反应活性的关联此前鲜有强调。作者以[1,1′:4′,1″-三联苯]-3,3″,5,5″-四羧酸（H4TPTCA）为构筑单元，引入-NH2、-H、-CH3不同取代基，构建系列同构HOF，并采用机械化学介导的组装策略实现酶的无损原位封装，形成无溶剂诱导孔道堵塞的开放多孔网络。通过对比机械化学法与常规溶液相法，系统考察取代基对孔壁水吸附能力及酶催化活性的影响，并利用机械化学酶@HOF生物复合材料的高活性与稳定性构建夹心型电化学免疫传感器，用于癌胚抗原（CEA）检测。该研究确立了绿色机械化学路线制备高活性酶@HOF生物催化剂，并揭示亲水性孔道环境对维持酶功能的关键作用。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：机械化学介导的HOF组装策略用于酶的原位封装；以H4TPTCA为构筑单元并引入-NH2、-H、-CH3取代基构建系列同构HOF；与常规溶液相法进行催化速率对比；评估孔壁水吸附能力与酶活性关系；构建夹心型电化学免疫传感器并测试CEA检测的线性范围与检测限。摘要未报告具体表征手段、合成温度、时间、酶种类及电化学测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联介孔/多孔框架材料的组装与生物催化应用，提出机械化学封装策略解决孔道堵塞与传质问题，并建立孔道亲疏水性与酶活性的结构—性能关系，对HOF及框架材料的功能化组装具有实际参考价值。其电化学免疫传感应用亦与电化学合成/测试主线相关。局限在于摘要未提供孔结构、酶负载量及稳定性细节，建议全文精读以核查机制与普适性。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据所提供题目与摘要，属摘要级解读。摘要未报告的实验条件、表征方法、酶种类、孔结构参数、稳定性数据及电化学测试细节等关键信息，仍需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 机械化学合成所得酶@HOF生物复合材料催化速率较常规溶液相法最高提升449倍。
引入-NH2基团显著改善孔壁水吸附能力，其活性分别比-H和-CH3类似物高1.45–2.78倍和116.1–330.3倍。
基于机械化学酶@HOF生物催化剂构建的夹心型电化学免疫传感器用于CEA检测，实现宽线性范围和低至15.6 fg mL−1的检测限。
亲水性孔道环境对保持酶功能具有关键作用。

papers.title: In-situ monitoring of surfactant-assisted ZIF-8 synthesis and self-assembly using small angle neutron scattering
papers.abstract: Metal organic frameworks can be fabricated to have structure across multiple length scales, from angstroms, where the metal nodes and organic linkers self-assemble to form molecular building units, to microns, where the MOF nanoparticles self-assemble with respect to each other to form superstructures. MOF-based photonic crystals are an example of a hierarchical MOF superstructure, where constant change in their dielectric constant causes the formation of a photonic band gap, and as such results in a material with structural colour. Our work looks at fabricating ZIF-8 (a Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework) based photonic crystals, using cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB) to stabilise the ZIF colloidal nanoparticles and encourage self-assembly. The self-assembly process has not been studied in-situ across different time- and length-scales, and understanding the mechanisms that drive the formation of these hierarchical structures could access new MOF-based photonic structures. The aim of this proposal is to investigate the role of the surfactant, CTAB, on the formation of ZIF colloidal nanoparticles and then its role during the self-assembly of groups of these colloidal nanoparticles in solution, using SANS contrast matching experiments. In-situ SANS contrast matching experiments will allow us to see the interaction between the surfactant and nanoparticles, which we expect to become more prominent as the process evolves.

papers.title_zh: 利用小角中子散射原位监测表面活性剂辅助的ZIF-8合成与自组装
papers.summary_zh: 该工作拟用CTAB稳定ZIF-8胶体纳米颗粒并促进其自组装，通过原位SANS对比匹配实验研究表面活性剂在ZIF-8纳米颗粒形成及胶体颗粒自组装为分级超结构过程中的作用，以理解驱动MOF基光子晶体形成的机制。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究关注金属有机框架可在多尺度上构筑结构：从埃尺度金属节点与有机配体自组装形成分子构筑单元，到微米尺度MOF纳米颗粒彼此自组装形成超结构。MOF基光子晶体是分级MOF超结构的例子，其介电常数持续变化产生光子带隙，从而呈现结构色。该工作旨在制备基于ZIF-8（沸石咪唑酯框架）的光子晶体，使用十六烷基三甲基溴化铵（CTAB）稳定ZIF胶体纳米颗粒并促进自组装。由于该自组装过程尚未在不同时间和长度尺度上被原位研究，理解驱动这些分级结构形成的机制有望获得新的MOF基光子结构。研究目标是通过SANS对比匹配实验，探究CTAB在ZIF胶体纳米颗粒形成中的作用，以及其在这些胶体纳米颗粒于溶液中自组装过程中的作用，预期表面活性剂与纳米颗粒的相互作用会随过程演化而更加显著。

papers.title: Hypertemperature‐Detonated Biomimetic Semiconductor Stromal Bombs for Enhanced Immunotherapy in Pancreatic Cancer
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by “copper avidity”, which easily leads to the dysregulation of copper ion homeostasis. It is possible to develop targeted nanodrugs that selectively kill cancer cells via cuproptosis. However, the dense stroma of PDAC acts as an airtight wall, which not only limits the penetration and distribution of therapeutic agents but also promotes immunosuppressive mechanisms via its hypoxia‐promoting effects, often leading to treatment failure. Thus, we developed a near‐infrared (NIR)‐responsive semiconductor polymer‐metal‒organic framework (MOF) nanoreactor (SPNMCH) that was loaded with copper sulfide nanoclusters (CuS x NCs) and hyaluronidase (HAase). This biomimetic semiconductor “bomb” extensively demolishes the wall (by highly activating HAase) and precisely eliminates tumor cells (through its active copper uptake to induce cuproptosis). Simultaneously, the synergistic effects of increased oxygen delivery and cuproptosis elicit robust antitumor immune responses to inhibit tumor progression and distant metastasis, and strong immune memory effects as observed in four mouse cancer models. Additionally, SPNMCH can be combined with anti‐programmed death receptor 1 (PD‐1) antibodies to further promote T cell‐mediated antitumor immunity. This study reveals a promising strategy for establishing a “hot” tumor immune niche in PDAC to promote the response to immunotherapy.

papers.title_zh: 高温引爆仿生半导体基质炸弹用于增强胰腺癌免疫治疗
papers.summary_zh: 该研究构建近红外响应半导体聚合物-MOF纳米反应器SPNMCH，共载硫化铜纳米簇与透明质酸酶，通过降解致密基质、诱导铜死亡并改善缺氧，协同激活抗肿瘤免疫，在四种小鼠模型中抑制肿瘤进展与转移。
papers.research_details_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌具有铜亲和特征，易导致铜离子稳态失调，为利用铜死亡选择性杀伤肿瘤提供可能；但其致密基质限制药物渗透并加剧免疫抑制。针对这一问题，作者设计近红外响应半导体聚合物-金属有机框架纳米反应器SPNMCH，负载硫化铜纳米簇和透明质酸酶。该仿生半导体炸弹通过高度激活透明质酸酶广泛破坏基质屏障，并借助活性铜摄取精准消除肿瘤细胞以诱导铜死亡。同时，氧气递送增加与铜死亡产生协同效应，激发强抗肿瘤免疫反应，抑制肿瘤进展和远处转移，并在四种小鼠癌症模型中观察到强免疫记忆效应。SPNMCH还可与抗PD-1抗体联用，进一步促进T细胞介导的抗肿瘤免疫。研究提出在PDAC中建立热肿瘤免疫微环境以促进免疫治疗响应的策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及：构建近红外响应半导体聚合物-金属有机框架纳米反应器SPNMCH；负载硫化铜纳米簇和透明质酸酶；利用近红外响应、透明质酸酶激活、铜摄取诱导铜死亡、氧气递送增加及免疫激活等机制；在四种小鼠癌症模型中评价抗肿瘤进展、远处转移和免疫记忆效应；并与抗PD-1抗体联合治疗。具体合成条件、表征手段和性能测试细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于MOF基纳米反应器与半导体聚合物复合的框架材料应用，涉及MOF负载无机纳米簇和酶，并用于生物医学电化学相关微环境调控。对介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料及框架组装主线仅有间接参考价值，主要启发在于MOF作为纳米反应器载体与刺激响应组装。若关注生物医学方向可精读，若聚焦导电MOF或电化学合成则相关性有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容整理。摘要未报告SPNMCH的具体合成条件、MOF组成、孔结构、导电性、近红外响应机制细节、铜死亡证据、免疫细胞类型与定量数据、四种小鼠模型的具体肿瘤类型及统计结果，仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: SPNMCH为近红外响应半导体聚合物-MOF纳米反应器，共载硫化铜纳米簇和透明质酸酶。
该体系通过高度激活透明质酸酶破坏致密基质，并通过活性铜摄取诱导铜死亡。
氧气递送增加与铜死亡协同激发抗肿瘤免疫，抑制肿瘤进展和远处转移，并在四种小鼠癌症模型中观察到强免疫记忆效应。
SPNMCH与抗PD-1抗体联用可进一步促进T细胞介导的抗肿瘤免疫。

papers.title: Functionalization and Metal Ion Encapsulation Within a Triaxial Supramolecular Weave
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Molecular weaving has attracted much interest in recent years. Supramolecular organic weaves offer many benefits, such as error correction, but their functionalization is challenging, as even minor modifications to the building blocks can disrupt self‐assembly. In this study, we demonstrate that a triaxially woven supramolecular organic framework formed by the self‐assembly of an oligoproline–perylene monoimide conjugate tolerates pre‐assembly functionalization and enables homogeneous incorporation of acetyl, pivaloyl, and thiophene moieties without altering the woven structure. Thiophene functionalization enabled the binding of toxic and noble‐metal ions from aqueous solution within the weave's confined pores. These results establish first examples of functionalized supramolecular organic weaves and highlight the value of modular peptide‐based woven frameworks for targeted guest encapsulation.

papers.title_zh: 三轴超分子编织结构内的功能化与金属离子封装
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在由寡聚脯氨酸-苝单酰亚胺偶联物自组装形成的三轴超分子有机编织框架中，实现了预组装功能化，均一引入乙酰基、特戊酰基和噻吩基团而不破坏编织结构，并利用噻吩功能化从水溶液中结合有毒及贵金属离子。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于超分子有机编织框架虽具有纠错等优势，但其功能化极具挑战，因为对构筑基元的微小修饰即可能破坏自组装。本文以寡聚脯氨酸-苝单酰亚胺偶联物为构筑基元，通过自组装形成三轴超分子有机框架。设计策略是在组装前对构筑基元进行功能化，再考察其是否仍能形成编织结构。研究过程包括引入乙酰、特戊酰和噻吩三种功能基团，并验证所得框架是否保持均一编织结构；进一步利用噻吩功能化框架的受限孔道，从水溶液中结合有毒和贵金属离子。该工作首次建立了功能化超分子有机编织结构的实例，凸显了模块化肽基编织框架在靶向客体封装方面的价值。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：寡聚脯氨酸-苝单酰亚胺偶联物的自组装；预组装功能化策略，引入乙酰、特戊酰和噻吩基团；对编织结构保持性的验证；以及利用噻吩功能化框架从水溶液中结合有毒和贵金属离子。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段、金属离子种类、结合容量或选择性数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联超分子有机框架的自组装与功能化主线，展示了在编织框架中引入功能基团并用于金属离子封装的策略，对框架材料组装及后功能化具有参考价值。其局限在于摘要未提供金属离子种类、结合量、选择性及结构表征细节，若关注超分子编织框架的功能化与客体封装，值得全文精读以核查实验细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征方法、金属离子种类、结合容量、选择性及稳定性等关键细节，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 三轴超分子有机编织框架可耐受预组装功能化，均一引入乙酰、特戊酰和噻吩基团而不改变编织结构。
噻吩功能化使编织框架能够从水溶液中结合有毒和贵金属离子。
该工作首次报道了功能化超分子有机编织结构。
模块化肽基编织框架对靶向客体封装具有价值。

papers.title: Nonmonotonic Charging, Overscreening, and Ion Competition in the Electric Double Layer of Platinum Quantified by X-ray Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Abstract The electric double layer (EDL) is an integral part of the local reaction environment in electrocatalysis. Indeed, the strong electric fields and modified interfacial water structure accompanying ion accumulation in the EDL have been shown to impact the performance of nearly every electrocatalytic reaction. However, quantifying interfacial ion accumulation experimentally is a long-standing challenge, leaving the atomic-level picture of electrolyte effects in electrocatalysis incomplete. Here, we address this challenge using an interface-sensitive in situ X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy approach based on a mesoporous Pt electrode to track interfacial ion concentration at the Pt-electrolyte interface in acidic media. We show that the EDL structure of the Pt electrode has a complex dependence on the applied potential and electrolyte composition. From a systematic analysis of ten electrolytes (including ions such as ClO4–, SO42–, K+, and Ca+), we show that adsorbates alter the surface free charge, resulting in nonmonotonic charging and overscreening. For nonadsorbing anions, we show that the concentration-dependent surface free charge follows classical Gouy–Chapman theory. At negatively charged surfaces, cations and protons compete to screen the surface free charge in the EDL, with a strong dependence on ion valency.

papers.title_zh: X射线光谱定量铂电极双电层中的非单调充电、过屏蔽与离子竞争
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用基于介孔铂电极的界面敏感原位X射线荧光光谱，追踪酸性介质中Pt-电解质界面的离子浓度，揭示双电层结构对施加电位和电解质组成的复杂依赖，发现吸附物导致非单调充电和过屏蔽，并观察到阳离子与质子的竞争屏蔽。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于电催化中双电层是局部反应环境的重要组成部分，但实验定量界面离子积累长期是挑战，导致电解质效应的原子级图像不完整。本文采用基于介孔铂电极的界面敏感原位X射线荧光光谱方法，在酸性介质中追踪Pt-电解质界面的离子浓度。研究系统分析了十种电解质，包括ClO4–、SO42–、K+和Ca+等离子。结果显示，Pt电极的双电层结构对施加电位和电解质组成具有复杂依赖；吸附物改变表面自由电荷，导致非单调充电和过屏蔽；对于非吸附性阴离子，浓度依赖的表面自由电荷遵循经典Gouy-Chapman理论；在带负电表面，阳离子和质子竞争屏蔽双电层中的表面自由电荷，且强烈依赖离子价态。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法为：基于介孔铂电极的界面敏感原位X射线荧光光谱，用于追踪酸性介质中Pt-电解质界面的离子浓度；系统分析十种电解质，包括ClO4–、SO42–、K+和Ca+等离子。摘要未报告具体电位窗口、电解质浓度、X射线光谱参数及介孔Pt电极制备细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料及电化学界面研究相关，利用介孔Pt电极增强界面敏感X射线荧光光谱信号，为理解电催化中双电层离子积累提供实验定量手段。其局限在于摘要未报告具体电位、浓度及电极结构参数，若关注介孔电极在电化学界面表征中的应用，值得全文精读以核查方法学细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，摘要未报告具体电位窗口、电解质浓度、X射线光谱参数、介孔Pt电极制备及定量误差等关键细节，需全文核查。

papers.title: Inter‐Cage Na + Enabling Single‐Atom Co for In Situ Delivery of Bio‐Based Vinyl Backbone to Access 3,4‐Unsubstituted Quinolines
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The multi‐step access to versatile N‐heterocyclic scaffolds is highly dependent on non‐renewable fossil‐based feedstock over different catalysts for each step. Here, a mesoporous NaY zeolite‐encapsulated atomically dispersed cobalt catalyst (Co@NaY‐M) is deliberately designed to be robust for single‐step, three‐component upgrading of biomass‐derived lactic acid, aldehydes, and anilines into 3,4‐unsubstituted quinolines via cascade dehydrogenation, annulation–aromatization, and decarboxylation. Na + co‐dopant in zeolitic hexagonal prism adjacent to single‐atom Co in the supercage acts as an electron promoter to pull electrons from Co. The electron‐deficient Co improves formed intermediate adsorption/activation, significantly declining energy barriers in cascade lactic‐acid‐to‐vinyl‐intermediate dehydrogenation, and 4‐substituted quinoline decarboxylation. Meanwhile, the presence of Na + strengthens interactions between Co and zeolitic carrier to improve the single‐atom stability. Co@NaY‐M has broad substrate scope for various 3,4‐unsubstituted quinolines with good compatibility to diverse functional groups in yields reaching 98% (>80 examples) and can be scaled up (11.24 g). Importantly, the developed methodology enables direct synthesis of various clinical drugs. Life‐cycle/techno‐economic investigations indicate that this protocol markedly lessens environmental footprints and is more price‐competitive compared to conventional quinoline synthesis methods. The precise modulation of neighboring zeolitic sites provides an effective avenue to directly access high‐value nitrogenous heterocycles from abundant renewables via oriented multiple reactions.

papers.title_zh: 笼间Na+赋能单原子Co用于原位递送生物基乙烯基骨架以获取3,4-未取代喹啉
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计介孔NaY沸石封装原子分散钴催化剂Co@NaY-M，用于生物质衍生乳酸、醛和苯胺的一步三组分升级为3,4-未取代喹啉，Na+作为电子促进剂从Co拉电子，提高中间体吸附活化并增强单原子稳定性，产率可达98%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于多种N-杂环骨架的多步合成高度依赖非可再生化石原料，且每步需不同催化剂。本文设计介孔NaY沸石封装原子分散钴催化剂Co@NaY-M，用于生物质衍生乳酸、醛和苯胺的一步三组分升级，经级联脱氢、环化-芳构化和脱羧反应制备3,4-未取代喹啉。设计策略中，位于沸石六方棱柱、邻近超笼中单原子Co的Na+共掺杂剂作为电子促进剂，从Co拉电子；缺电子Co改善所形成中间体的吸附/活化，显著降低乳酸到乙烯基中间体脱氢及4-取代喹啉脱羧的能垒；同时Na+增强Co与沸石载体相互作用，提高单原子稳定性。Co@NaY-M对多种3,4-未取代喹啉具有广泛底物范围，兼容多种官能团，产率可达98%（超过80个例子），并可放大至11.24 g。该方法还可直接合成多种临床药物。生命周期/技术经济研究表明，该方案显著降低环境足迹，且相比传统喹啉合成方法更具价格竞争力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：设计介孔NaY沸石封装原子分散钴催化剂Co@NaY-M；以生物质衍生乳酸、醛和苯胺为底物进行一步三组分级联反应；通过脱氢、环化-芳构化和脱羧制备3,4-未取代喹啉；进行底物范围考察、放大实验（11.24 g）、临床药物直接合成以及生命周期/技术经济研究。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段及催化反应参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料及单原子催化相关，展示介孔NaY沸石封装单原子Co并利用笼间Na+调控电子结构，用于生物质升级合成高价值N-杂环。其局限在于摘要未报告具体合成、表征及催化条件，若关注介孔沸石封装单原子催化剂的设计与级联催化，值得全文精读以核查结构-性能关系细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征方法、催化反应参数、底物范围细节及稳定性数据等关键信息，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Co@NaY-M对多种3,4-未取代喹啉具有广泛底物范围，产率可达98%，超过80个例子，并可放大至11.24 g。
Na+共掺杂剂作为电子促进剂从单原子Co拉电子，缺电子Co改善中间体吸附/活化，显著降低级联脱氢和脱羧能垒。
Na+增强Co与沸石载体相互作用，提高单原子稳定性。

papers.title: The Host‐Guest Assemblies of Metal–Organic Frameworks and Protic Ionic Liquids With ZIF‐8 and [Dema][TfO] – Structural Response and Ionic Conductivity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The synergy between ionic liquids (ILs) and metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) has attracted considerable attention because of future applications as a tailor‐made hybrid ionic conductor. The incorporation of ILs into MOFs cages has led to the development of a novel type of solid electrolytes (ILs@MOF), characterized by exceptional thermal stability and high conductivity for large ionic species. In this study, an efficient capillary method was employed to introduce a classical protic IL, [Dema][TfO], into ZIF‐8 pores, consisting of sodalite‐type cages (Zn(MeIm) 2 ). Our investigation focuses on the influence of varying ILs content on the free (pore) volume, thermal stability, microstructure, and ionic conductivity. The uptake of [Dema][TfO] results in a ZIF‐8 cage expansion, accompanied by a decrease of the decomposition temperature. Upon infiltration of [Dema][TfO] into the ZIF‐8 pores, the preexisting hydrogen bonds within the IL are broken due to confinement effects. Notably, when ZIF‐8 pores are entirely saturated with [Dema][TfO], the composite material exhibits an ionic conductivity of 1.09(6) mS·cm −1 (at 160°C under anhydrous conditions) with an activation energy of 0.45(3) eV, which is better than other ILs@MOF conductive composites. These findings reveal ILs@MOF hybrid composites are versatile systems to compose protic conductors, attributable to their elevated ionic conductivity.

papers.title_zh: 金属有机框架与质子型离子液体的主客体组装：以ZIF-8和[Dema][TfO]为例的结构响应与离子导电性
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用毛细管法将质子型离子液体[Dema][TfO]引入ZIF-8孔道，系统考察了离子液体含量对孔体积、热稳定性、微结构和离子导电性的影响。完全饱和时复合材料在160°C无水条件下离子导电率达1.09(6) mS·cm⁻¹，活化能为0.45(3) eV，优于其他ILs@MOF导电复合材料。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在利用离子液体与金属有机框架的协同效应构建定制化混合离子导体。材料体系为经典质子型离子液体[Dema][TfO]与具有方钠石型笼状结构的ZIF-8（Zn(MeIm)₂）。设计策略是采用高效毛细管法将离子液体引入ZIF-8孔道，形成ILs@MOF主客体复合材料。研究过程聚焦于不同离子液体含量对自由孔体积、热稳定性、微结构及离子导电性的影响。研究发现离子液体的引入导致ZIF-8笼发生膨胀，同时分解温度降低；限域效应使离子液体内部原有氢键断裂。该工作揭示了ILs@MOF杂化复合材料可作为质子导体的通用平台，其高离子导电性归因于限域效应与主客体协同作用。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的合成方法为毛细管法，用于将质子型离子液体[Dema][TfO]引入ZIF-8孔道。表征与测试方面，摘要提及考察了离子液体含量对自由孔体积、热稳定性、微结构和离子导电性的影响，并报告了离子导电率和活化能数据。摘要未报告具体的表征技术名称（如PXRD、TGA、NMR等）及详细的性能测试条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接涉及介孔/微孔MOF与离子液体的主客体组装及离子导电性能，对框架材料组装和电化学合成主线具有参考价值。其毛细管法引入离子液体的策略和限域效应机制可为导电MOF复合材料设计提供思路。但该研究使用ZIF-8（微孔方钠石型笼），并非严格意义上的介孔导电MOF，且未涉及共轭框架或电化学合成。建议关注其主客体组装策略和导电性能数据，全文精读价值中等。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据提供的题目和摘要内容。摘要未报告具体的表征技术、合成条件细节（如温度、时间、离子液体负载量梯度）、电化学测试方法及长期稳定性数据，这些关键细节需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 当ZIF-8孔道被[Dema][TfO]完全饱和时，复合材料在160°C无水条件下离子导电率为1.09(6) mS·cm⁻¹，活化能为0.45(3) eV，优于其他ILs@MOF导电复合材料。
[Dema][TfO]的引入导致ZIF-8笼发生膨胀，同时复合材料分解温度降低。
离子液体渗入ZIF-8孔道后，限域效应导致离子液体内部原有氢键断裂。
不同离子液体含量对自由孔体积、热稳定性、微结构和离子导电性均有影响。

papers.title: Water Helicity‐Modulated Hierarchical Inverse Chirality Transfer in Supramolecular Assembly
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Water helicity is ubiquitous in biological architectures (e.g., proteins and enzymes) and plays a crucial role in hierarchical chirality transfer. However, achieving water helicity‐modulated hierarchical inverse chirality transfer (e.g., molecular chirality to water helicity and ultimately to nanoscale chirality opposite to that of water) remains a fundamental challenge, owing to the intricate coupling between water conformation and structural hierarchies. Here we demonstrate that a helical water can be constructed and mediate inverse chirality transfer by rationally designing l ‐phenylalanine derivative (LPPF) featuring a geometrically matched carboxyl pocket for water. A two‐step inversion cascade of chirality emerges: the L‐configured molecular stereocenter dictates an M‐helical arrangement of water in carboxyl pocket, which in turn templates the P‐helicity of LPPF nanofibers. This process only requires trace amounts of water, and its absence results in achiral nanobelts and circular dichroism (CD) silence. Besides, the helical water has a crucial influence on the function of P‐nanofibers as indicative by the transformation of spin selectivity from up to down upon in situ removal of helical water. Our findings provide deeper insight into the complexity of chirality transfer by revealing a water‐helicity‐modulated inverse transfer mechanism.

papers.title_zh: 水螺旋性调控的超分子组装中层级逆手性转移
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过设计具有几何匹配羧基口袋的L-苯丙氨酸衍生物（LPPF），构建了螺旋水并实现了逆手性转移。L型分子立体中心决定羧基口袋中水的M螺旋排列，进而模板化LPPF纳米纤维的P螺旋。该过程仅需痕量水，去除螺旋水后自旋选择性从向上转变为向下。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在解决水螺旋性调控层级逆手性转移这一 fundamental challenge，即从分子手性到水螺旋性再到与水的螺旋性相反的纳米级手性。材料体系为合理设计的L-苯丙氨酸衍生物（LPPF），其具有与水的几何匹配的羧基口袋。设计策略是利用LPPF的羧基口袋构建螺旋水，并通过水螺旋性介导逆手性转移。研究过程揭示了两步反转级联：L型分子立体中心决定羧基口袋中水的M螺旋排列，水的M螺旋进而模板化LPPF纳米纤维的P螺旋。该过程仅需痕量水，水的缺失导致形成非手性纳米带和圆二色（CD）沉默。此外，螺旋水对P纳米纤维的功能有重要影响，原位去除螺旋水后自旋选择性从向上转变为向下。该发现揭示了水螺旋性调控的逆转移机制，深化了对层级手性转移复杂性的理解。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：设计合成L-苯丙氨酸衍生物（LPPF）；通过圆二色（CD）光谱表征手性（提及CD沉默）；通过自旋选择性测量表征功能（提及自旋选择性从向上转变为向下）；通过原位去除螺旋水研究其功能影响。摘要未报告具体的组装条件、水含量定量、结构表征技术（如XRD、NMR、显微技术）及自旋选择性测试的具体方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作涉及超分子组装和手性转移机制，对自组装技术主线有参考价值。其水螺旋性调控的逆手性转移概念为框架材料组装中的手性传递提供了新视角。但该研究体系为有机小分子衍生物的自组装，不涉及MOF/COF/HOF框架材料或电化学合成。建议关注其层级手性转移机制和自旋选择性调控策略，全文精读价值中等偏低。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据提供的题目和摘要内容。摘要未报告LPPF的具体合成步骤、组装条件、水的定量数据、螺旋水结构表征细节、自旋选择性数值及CD光谱具体参数，这些关键细节需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: L型分子立体中心决定羧基口袋中水的M螺旋排列，水的M螺旋模板化LPPF纳米纤维的P螺旋，形成两步反转级联。
该手性转移过程仅需痕量水，水的缺失导致形成非手性纳米带和圆二色（CD）沉默。
螺旋水对P纳米纤维的功能有重要影响，原位去除螺旋水后自旋选择性从向上转变为向下。
摘要未报告手性转移效率、螺旋水结构的具体表征参数及自旋选择性数值。

papers.title: Ultrastable Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Framework for Efficient CO 2 /CH 4 Separation in Humid Environments
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Selective CO 2 removal during methane purification is critical for energy‐efficient utilization. The development of porous adsorbents integrating ultrahigh structural stability, excellent separation capability, and moisture resistance represents a desirable yet challenging objective for upgrading natural gas. Unlike conventional synthesis strategies for hydrogen‑bonded organic frameworks (HOFs) that utilize strong hydrogen‐bonding groups such as carboxylic acid groups and 2,4‐diaminotriazine, this study employs aldehyde functionalities to construct a novel HOF (HFPTP‐HOF) with exceptional moisture resistance and ultrahigh stability. At 298 K and 1 atm, the material exhibits an IAST selectivity of 18.61 for equimolar CO 2 /CH 4 mixtures, representing the highest values among reported HOF materials. Dynamic breakthrough experiments confirm its ability to produce 99.99% pure CH 4 . More notably, the HOF adopts a distinctive interlayer stacking structure formed by synergistic interligand multiple C–H⋯O hydrogen bonding and interdigitation. This interlayer stacking architecture imparts remarkable stability to HFPTP‐HOF by encapsulating the hydrogen bonds responsible for framework formation within a hydrophobic barrier, which allows it to retain structural integrity even when immersed in 12 M hydrochloric acid at 50°C, 20 M sodium hydroxide at 100°C or boiling water for 7 days. To our knowledge, this stability exceeds those of all reported HOFs. In addition, within the HOF's pore channels, aldehyde groups and hydrophobic benzene rings are distributed on opposite sides of the pores. This spatial arrangement effectively prevents water molecule clustering within the pores, enabling HFPTP‐HOF to maintain outstanding CO 2 /CH 4 separation performance even under 90% RH. Overall, this work provides new insights into the design and synthesis of HOFs that combine ultrahigh stability with exceptional humidity‑resistant separation efficiency.

papers.title_zh: 超稳定氢键有机框架用于潮湿环境中高效CO₂/CH₄分离
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用醛基功能团构建了新型氢键有机框架HFPTP-HOF，具有优异耐湿性和超高稳定性。在298 K和1 atm下，等摩尔CO₂/CH₄混合物的IAST选择性达18.61，为已报道HOF材料中最高值。动态穿透实验证实可产出99.99%纯度CH₄，且在90% RH下仍保持优异分离性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在开发兼具超高结构稳定性、优异分离能力和耐湿性的多孔吸附剂，用于天然气升级中的选择性CO₂脱除。材料体系为新型氢键有机框架HFPTP-HOF，与利用羧酸基团和2,4-二氨基三嗪等强氢键基团的传统HOF合成策略不同，该研究采用醛基功能团构建HOF。设计策略是利用配体间多重C–H⋯O氢键和互穿作用形成独特的层间堆叠结构，该结构将框架形成所需的氢键封装在疏水屏障内。研究过程包括：在298 K和1 atm下测试等摩尔CO₂/CH₄混合物的IAST选择性；进行动态穿透实验验证CH₄纯度；测试材料在12 M盐酸（50°C）、20 M氢氧化钠（100°C）和沸水中7天的结构稳定性；在90% RH下测试CO₂/CH₄分离性能。该工作为设计兼具超高稳定性和优异耐湿分离效率的HOF提供了新思路。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：采用醛基功能团构建HFPTP-HOF；通过IAST计算等摩尔CO₂/CH₄混合物的选择性；进行动态穿透实验验证CH₄纯度；将材料浸泡在12 M盐酸（50°C）、20 M氢氧化钠（100°C）和沸水中7天测试稳定性；在90% RH下测试分离性能。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、结构表征技术（如单晶XRD、PXRD、BET等）及吸附等温线测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接涉及氢键有机框架（HOF）的设计合成与气体分离应用，对框架材料组装主线具有重要参考价值。其利用醛基构建HOF的策略、层间堆叠结构设计及疏水屏障概念为超稳定HOF的构建提供了新思路。CO₂/CH₄分离数据和耐湿性能对能源气体纯化具有实际意义。建议全文精读，重点关注其合成策略、结构表征和稳定性机制。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据提供的题目和摘要内容。摘要未报告HFPTP-HOF的具体合成步骤、配体结构、单晶结构数据、BET比表面积、吸附等温线、穿透实验条件及长期循环稳定性数据，这些关键细节需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 在298 K和1 atm下，HFPTP-HOF对等摩尔CO₂/CH₄混合物的IAST选择性为18.61，为已报道HOF材料中最高值。
动态穿透实验证实该材料能够产出99.99%纯度的CH₄。
HFPTP-HOF在12 M盐酸（50°C）、20 M氢氧化钠（100°C）或沸水中浸泡7天后仍保持结构完整性，稳定性超过所有已报道HOFs。
在90% RH下，HFPTP-HOF仍保持优异的CO₂/CH₄分离性能，归因于醛基和疏水苯环分布在孔道两侧，有效阻止水分子在孔内聚集。

papers.title: Radical Negative‐Feedback in High Entropy UiO‐67 to Break the Activity–Stability Trade‐Off in Photocatalytic Oxygenation of CH 4
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The activity–stability trade‐off has long been a Gordian knot for metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) photocatalyst. Here, a high‐entropy UiO‐67 MOF (HE‐UiO‐67) constructed with 2,2'‐bipyridine‐5,5'‐dicarboxylic acid as the linker and ZrCeHfSnFe metal nodes was designed to induce a hydroxyl radical (•OH) negative‐feedback mechanism to disentangle the trade‐off in methane oxygenation with H 2 O 2 . When the •OH concentration generated at Fe sites exceeds the tolerance threshold of adjacent Ce─O bonds, the Ce centers are reconstructed by ligand abstraction into the unsaturated Ce sites for driving the interfacial H 2 O 2 conversion into low oxidative O 2 or •OOH species in high‐entropy metal nodes, thereby blocking the MOFs damage. This unique radical negative feedback process in HE‐UiO‐67 can maximize the concentration of radicals while maintain the stable operation for over 100 h in an ambient pressure flow‐phase system, substantially exceeding most of the previous reports. Under visible light irradiation, HE‐UiO‐67 photocatalyst exhibits an outstanding liquid oxygenate yield of up to 9732 µmol g −1 h −1 with a selectivity of 93.5%. Overall, this study opens up a promising strategy for designing efficient and durable photocatalysts to break the activity–stability trade‐off in CH 4 oxygenation.

papers.title_zh: 高熵UiO-67中的自由基负反馈打破甲烷光催化氧化中的活性—稳定性权衡
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计高熵UiO-67，以2,2'-联吡啶-5,5'-二羧酸为连接体、ZrCeHfSnFe为金属节点，通过羟基自由基负反馈机制在甲烷氧化中兼顾高活性与稳定性，实现9732微摩尔每克每小时液相含氧产物收率和93.5%选择性，并稳定运行超100小时。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究针对金属有机框架光催化剂长期存在的活性—稳定性权衡问题，设计了一种高熵UiO-67材料。其以2,2'-联吡啶-5,5'-二羧酸为连接体，金属节点包含Zr、Ce、Hf、Sn、Fe。研究提出羟基自由基负反馈机制：当Fe位点产生的羟基自由基浓度超过相邻Ce—O键的耐受阈值时，Ce中心通过配体抽提发生重构，形成不饱和Ce位点，从而驱动界面过氧化氢转化为低氧化性的氧气或过氧羟基物种，阻止框架损伤。该机制使材料在常压流动相体系中稳定运行超过100小时，并在可见光照射下实现高达9732微摩尔每克每小时的液相含氧产物收率和93.5%的选择性。该工作为设计高效耐用的甲烷氧化光催化剂提供了新策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：以2,2'-联吡啶-5,5'-二羧酸为连接体，ZrCeHfSnFe为金属节点构建高熵UiO-67；在常压流动相体系中以过氧化氢为氧化剂进行甲烷光催化氧化；在可见光照射下评价液相含氧产物收率和选择性；通过羟基自由基浓度与Ce—O键耐受阈值的关系提出负反馈机制。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段和性能测试细节。

papers.title: Inducing Orientation Polarisation via Regional Isomerisation in Covalent Organic Frameworks for Enhanced O 2 Photoactivation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Boosting the O 2 photoactivation for efficient generation of reactive oxygen species is crucial to the synthesis of high‐value chemicals. Inducing strong dipole interaction is an effective strategy to strengthen the built‐in electric field (BIEF). However, it remains a great challenge to realize the precise regulation of polarisation orientation. Herein, a strategy to precisely control the polarity orientation of covalent organic frameworks (COFs) by regulating the regioisomerism of building blocks is proposed. Specifically, we integrated three regioisomeric thiophene derivatives into COF skeletons for H 2 O 2 photosynthesis. Experimental and theoretical results show that the presence of adjacent S atoms in TTDA‐TAPT‐COF facilitates oriented dipole alignment, significantly enhancing the BIEF strength. Furthermore, this unique structure forms concave‐convex pore walls with adjacent double‐S atomic binding sites, inducing a switch of the O 2 adsorption configuration from Pauling‐type to Yeager‐type, thereby significantly enhancing H 2 O 2 photosynthesis. This work reveals the decisive role of regional isomerisation in tuning polarity orientation and BIEF, and this strategy is expected to be extended to other photocatalytic reactions involving oxygen activation, such as organic oxidation and pollutant degradation.

papers.title_zh: 通过区域异构化诱导共价有机框架中的取向极化以增强氧气光活化
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过调控构筑单元的区域异构，在共价有机框架中精确控制极性取向，TTDA-TAPT-COF中相邻硫原子促进偶极定向排列，增强内建电场，并将氧气吸附构型从Pauling型切换为Yeager型，显著提升过氧化氢光合成。
papers.research_details_zh: 该研究针对共价有机框架中极化取向精确调控的难题，提出通过构筑单元区域异构化控制极性取向的策略。研究将三种区域异构的噻吩衍生物整合到COF骨架中用于过氧化氢光合成。实验与理论结果表明，TTDA-TAPT-COF中相邻硫原子的存在促进偶极定向排列，显著增强内建电场强度。此外，该独特结构形成具有相邻双硫原子结合位点的凹凸孔壁，诱导氧气吸附构型从Pauling型切换为Yeager型，从而显著增强过氧化氢光合成。该工作揭示了区域异构化在调控极性取向和内建电场中的决定性作用，并有望推广至其他涉及氧气活化的光催化反应，如有机氧化和污染物降解。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：将三种区域异构的噻吩衍生物整合到COF骨架中；通过实验与理论结果研究区域异构对极性取向和内建电场的影响；用于过氧化氢光合成；分析氧气吸附构型变化。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段、光催化测试条件和定量性能数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于共轭COF框架材料主线，涉及框架组装、极性调控和光催化氧气活化，对理解COF结构—性能关系有直接价值。其区域异构化策略可启发框架材料内建电场调控，但摘要未报告介孔性、导电性及电化学合成信息，若关注介孔导电MOF或电化学方向，相关性有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征、数值、机制或结论。关键细节如具体合成方法、孔结构参数、内建电场强度数值、过氧化氢产率、氧气吸附能计算及光催化测试条件等均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: TTDA-TAPT-COF中相邻硫原子促进偶极定向排列，显著增强内建电场强度。
该结构形成凹凸孔壁和相邻双硫原子结合位点，诱导氧气吸附构型从Pauling型切换为Yeager型。
区域异构化对极性取向和内建电场具有决定性调控作用，显著增强过氧化氢光合成。

papers.title: Hierarchical Confinement and Oxygen‐Vacancy Catalysis for Highly Reversible Room‐Temperature Sodium‐Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Room‐temperature sodium‐sulfur (RT Na‐S) batteries are attractive for grid‐scale energy storage owing to their high theoretical energy density and elemental abundance, yet their practical application remains severely challenged by sluggish sulfur redox kinetics and the shuttle of sodium polysulfides. Herein, we establish a molten‐salt‐assisted strategy to construct a multifunctional cathode host (PNCNs@CeO 2‐x ), where oxygen‐deficient CeO 2‐x nanoparticles are confined within a hierarchically porous carbon framework and encapsulated by graphene‐like carbon nanosheets. This deliberately orchestrated architecture unifies spatial confinement and oxygen‐vacancy‐enabled catalysis to form conductive microreaction domains featuring continuous ion/electron transport pathways and abundant active interfaces. Through in situ characterizations and machine‐learning‐assisted molecular dynamics simulations, we demonstrate that oxygen vacancies in CeO 2‐x induce favorable charge redistribution, strengthen Na 2 S x adsorption, lower the energy barrier for Na 2 S 2 /Na 2 S conversion, and promote a highly reversible solid–liquid–solid conversion process, thereby effectively suppressing polysulfide dissolution. Consequently, the PNCNs@CeO 2‐x ‐S cathode exhibits an impressive reversible capacity of 1167 mAh g −1 at 0.1 A g −1 and outstanding cycling stability, maintaining 86.2% capacity retention after 9000 cycles at 5 A g −1 . This work establishes a confinement‐catalysis design paradigm for regulating sulfur electrochemistry for long‐life RT Na‐S batteries.

papers.title_zh: 分级限域与氧空位催化实现高可逆室温钠硫电池
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过熔盐辅助策略构建了氧缺陷CeO2-x限域于分级多孔碳并包覆石墨烯类碳纳米片的多功能正极宿主，统一空间限域与氧空位催化，形成连续离子电子传输的微反应域，显著抑制多硫化物溶解并实现超长循环稳定性。
papers.research_details_zh: 室温钠硫电池因高理论能量密度和元素丰度而受关注，但硫氧化还原动力学迟缓和多硫化物穿梭严重制约实际应用。本研究采用熔盐辅助策略构建多功能正极宿主PNCNs@CeO2-x，将氧缺陷CeO2-x纳米颗粒限域于分级多孔碳骨架内并由石墨烯类碳纳米片包覆。该结构统一空间限域与氧空位催化，形成具有连续离子/电子传输路径和丰富活性界面的导电微反应域。通过原位表征和机器学习辅助分子动力学模拟，揭示氧空位诱导电荷重分布、增强Na2Sx吸附、降低Na2S2/Na2S转化能垒并促进高可逆固-液-固转化过程，从而有效抑制多硫化物溶解。该工作为调控硫电化学以实现长寿命室温钠硫电池建立了限域-催化设计范式。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道采用熔盐辅助策略构建PNCNs@CeO2-x宿主；通过原位表征和机器学习辅助分子动力学模拟研究机制；电化学测试包括0.1 A g-1下的可逆容量测试和5 A g-1下的长循环稳定性测试。其他合成细节、表征手段和测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作涉及分级多孔碳框架、氧空位催化及限域-催化协同设计，与介孔材料、框架材料组装及电化学应用主线相关。其分级限域与缺陷催化策略对设计高性能电化学宿主材料有参考价值。但摘要未报告MOF/COF/HOF框架的具体参与，属于碳基分级多孔材料范畴，与介孔导电MOF直接关联有限，建议根据对分级多孔碳和缺陷催化兴趣决定是否精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，未核实全文。关键细节如熔盐辅助合成的具体条件、CeO2-x氧空位浓度、原位表征技术类型、机器学习辅助分子动力学模拟参数、多硫化物吸附能数值及固-液-固转化机制的直接证据等均需全文核查。

papers.title: Tamper‐Responsive Physical Unclonable Functions via Graphene‐Interlayered Block Copolymer Random Structures
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Microscopically engineered materials inherently harbor unique structural signatures arising from the stochastic fabrication. Physical unclonable functions (PUFs) exploit structural randomness to generate unique cryptographic responses, establishing hardware‐based security. However, conventional PUF architectures rely on static configurations to guarantee authentication reproducibility, and the intrinsic rigidity permits unauthorized reverse‐engineering without detectable traces. A tamper‐responsive physical unclonable function (TR‐PUF) platform is presented, integrating a high‐entropy source with a reactive two‐dimensional material interlayer to actively defend cryptographic keys. The entropy source relies on fingerprint‐like nanopatterns derived from thermodynamic fluctuations during block copolymer self‐assembly, while a reduced graphene oxide interlayer leverages out‐of‐plane chemical and mechanical sensitivity enabling device responsiveness to external intrusions. Systematic characterization confirms robust fundamental cryptographic performance, with near‐ideal uniqueness and uniformity. Also, the tamper‐responsive capability is demonstrated across three representative intrusion scenarios, where simulated high‐resolution probing, chemical, or mechanical attempts to access the internal architecture trigger spontaneous and irreversible key invalidation via localized degradation. Furthermore, broad applicability is validated through rigorous environmental survivability assessment under low Earth orbit simulated conditions, alongside seamless integration across diverse form factors. The autonomous hardware protection framework opens possibilities for securing electronic components across next‐generation hardware architectures in strategic fields like space missions and military applications.

papers.title_zh: 基于石墨烯插层嵌段共聚物随机结构的防篡改物理不可克隆函数
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出防篡改物理不可克隆函数平台，以嵌段共聚物自组装热力学涨落形成的指纹状纳米图案为高熵源，还原氧化石墨烯插层提供面外化学机械敏感性，实现近理想唯一性和均匀性，并在三种入侵场景下触发不可逆密钥失效。
papers.research_details_zh: 物理不可克隆函数利用结构随机性生成唯一密码响应，建立硬件安全，但传统架构依赖静态配置且刚性结构易被逆向工程而无痕迹。本研究提出防篡改物理不可克隆函数平台，整合高熵源与反应性二维材料插层以主动防御密钥。熵源基于嵌段共聚物自组装过程中热力学涨落形成的指纹状纳米图案，还原氧化石墨烯插层利用面外化学和机械敏感性使器件响应外部入侵。系统表征确认稳健的密码学性能，具有近理想唯一性和均匀性。在三种代表性入侵场景中，模拟高分辨率探测、化学或机械尝试访问内部结构均触发自发不可逆的密钥失效，通过局部降解实现。此外，通过低地球轨道模拟条件下的严格环境生存性评估验证广泛适用性，并实现跨多种形态因子的无缝集成。该自主硬件保护框架为太空任务和军事应用等战略领域的下一代硬件架构安全开辟可能。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道利用嵌段共聚物自组装形成指纹状纳米图案，还原氧化石墨烯作为反应性二维材料插层；系统表征确认密码学性能；在三种代表性入侵场景下演示防篡改能力；通过低地球轨道模拟条件进行环境生存性评估；验证跨多种形态因子的集成。具体自组装条件、表征技术和测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作涉及嵌段共聚物自组装、二维材料插层及随机结构工程，与自组装技术和框架材料组装主线中的自组装方法学相关。其利用自组装随机性构建功能器件的思路对自组装技术研究有启发意义。但该工作聚焦硬件安全应用，与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料及电化学合成无直接关联，建议根据对自组装随机结构及防篡改器件兴趣决定是否精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，未核实全文。关键细节如嵌段共聚物具体种类和自组装条件、还原氧化石墨烯插层制备方法、密码学性能定量指标、三种入侵场景的具体模拟方式和局部降解机制、低地球轨道模拟条件参数等均需全文核查。

papers.title: A 3D Metal–Organic Framework Protective Layer with Size-Selective Channels and Zincophilic Sites for Highly Stable Zinc Metal Anodes
papers.abstract: Abstract Aqueous zinc-ion batteries possess intrinsic operational safety, low cost and scalable application potential, making them promising candidates for large-scale energy storage. However, Zn metal anodes still suffer from severe dendrite proliferation, hydrogen evolution, interfacial corrosion, and inevitable by-product accumulation. The uncontrolled ion flux and distorted electric field further deteriorate the electrochemical durability and cycling lifespan. Targeting these challenges, a multifunctional interfacial protection strategy is proposed to regulate ion transport behavior and suppress parasitic reactions via constructing a 3D Zn(btec) metal–organic framework protective layer on Zn foil through a facile doctor-blade coating method. The as-designed Zn(btec) features uniform subnanometer channels of approximately 5 Å and carboxylate-rich pore walls, which jointly regulate Zn2+-dominated interfacial transport through spatial confinement and pore-wall electrostatic/coordination interactions, thereby suppressing local Zn2+ accumulation and guiding uniform Zn nucleation/deposition. Benefiting from such structural advantages, the Zn(btec)@Zn anode achieves ultra-long stable cycling over 1100 h at 4 mA cm–2 and 1 mAh cm–2 in symmetric cells, and maintains a high Coulombic efficiency of 99.8% beyond 3000 cycles in asymmetric cells. Combined experimental characterizations, finite-element simulations and theoretical calculations verify that the Zn(btec) interphase homogenizes interfacial electric field and Zn2+ flux and reduces interfacial activation energy. When matched with MnO2 or CaV6O16·2.7H2O (CaVO) cathodes, the protected Zn anode enables full cells with improved rate capability and cycling stability. Moreover, the assembled flexible pouch-cell module with an output voltage of 5.4 V can steadily drive a 5 V LED, demonstrating favorable application prospect. This work offers a multifunctional MOF interfacial engineering strategy integrating ion sieving, zincophilic regulation and side-reaction inhibition, and provides the insights into the rational design of highly reversible Zn metal anodes for advanced zinc-ion batteries.

papers.title_zh: 具有尺寸选择性通道和亲锌位点的三维金属有机框架保护层用于高稳定锌金属负极
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过刮刀涂布法在锌箔上构建三维Zn(btec)金属有机框架保护层，其约5 Å亚纳米通道和富羧基孔壁通过空间限域和孔壁静电配位协同调控Zn2+界面传输，抑制局部积累并引导均匀成核沉积，实现超长稳定循环。
papers.research_details_zh: 水系锌离子电池因本征安全性、低成本和可规模化应用潜力而成为大规模储能候选，但锌金属负极面临枝晶增殖、析氢、界面腐蚀和副产物积累等问题，不受控的离子通量和畸变电场进一步恶化电化学耐久性和循环寿命。针对这些挑战，本研究提出多功能界面保护策略，通过简便的刮刀涂布法在锌箔上构建三维Zn(btec)金属有机框架保护层。所设计的Zn(btec)具有约5 Å的均匀亚纳米通道和富羧基孔壁，通过空间限域和孔壁静电/配位相互作用共同调控Zn2+主导的界面传输，抑制局部Zn2+积累并引导均匀锌成核/沉积。结合实验表征、有限元模拟和理论计算验证Zn(btec)界面层均化界面电场和Zn2+通量并降低界面活化能。与MnO2或CaV6O16·2.7H2O正极匹配时，保护锌负极实现全电池倍率性能和循环稳定性提升。组装的柔性软包电池模块输出电压5.4 V可稳定驱动5 V LED，展示良好应用前景。该工作提供整合离子筛分、亲锌调控和副反应抑制的多功能MOF界面工程策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道通过简便刮刀涂布法在锌箔上构建三维Zn(btec)金属有机框架保护层；采用实验表征、有限元模拟和理论计算验证界面机制；电化学测试包括对称电池在4 mA cm-2和1 mAh cm-2下的循环测试、不对称电池库仑效率测试、与MnO2或CaVO正极匹配的全电池测试及柔性软包电池模块演示。具体表征技术、模拟参数和测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接涉及金属有机框架作为保护层、亚纳米通道离子筛分及亲锌位点调控，与框架材料组装和电化学应用主线高度相关。其通过刮刀涂布法实现MOF界面层构建，为MOF在电化学器件中的组装应用提供实例。但该工作聚焦锌离子电池负极保护，与介孔导电MOF、共轭MOF/COF/HOF及电化学合成MOF的直接关联有限，建议根据对MOF界面工程和锌电池兴趣决定是否精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要，未核实全文。关键细节如Zn(btec)的具体合成条件、刮刀涂布工艺参数、MOF层厚度和形貌表征、有限元模拟模型设置、理论计算方法和参数、全电池具体性能数值及柔性软包电池组装细节等均需全文核查。

papers.title: Hydrophobic Group‐Directed Self‐Assembly of Gradient Porous Antireflective and Superhydrophilic Coatings on Photovoltaic Glass
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Coatings for photovoltaic glass urgently require antireflection, self‐cleaning, and durability. Herein, we leveraged the surface free energy minimization effect of n ‐butyl hydrophobic groups in n ‐butyl glycidyl ether (BGE) to design a directed induction strategy, and successfully fabricated a gradient porous superhydrophilic and antireflective coating (BTKS‐3). This effect drove the spontaneous migration of hydrophobic groups to the surface, creating a vertical concentration gradient that modulated the local chemical environment and solvent evaporation behavior during film formation, ultimately directing the formation of a gradient porous architecture. As a result, a gradient porous architecture formed spontaneously, going from a dense bottom layer to a porous top layer. Such a gradient enables stepwise refractive index matching from the glass substrate to air, boosting transmittance to 94.61%, which significantly outperforms bare glass and commercial antireflective coatings. Meanwhile, surface hydroxyl groups and nanoscale roughness endow the coating with superhydrophilicity (contact angle < 10°) and self‐cleaning ability, along with good abrasion resistance and UV stability. Over, this work achieves synergistic optimization of optical, self‐cleaning, and durability properties, offering a new paradigm for high‐performance functional coatings on photovoltaic glass.

papers.title_zh: 疏水基团导向自组装制备光伏玻璃用梯度多孔减反射与超亲水涂层
papers.summary_zh: 利用正丁基缩水甘油醚中疏水正丁基的表面自由能最小化效应，诱导自发形成从致密底层到多孔顶层的梯度多孔结构，实现折射率阶梯匹配，使透光率达94.61%，并兼具超亲水自清洁、耐磨和紫外稳定性。
papers.research_details_zh: 光伏玻璃涂层亟需同时满足减反射、自清洁和耐久性。本文以正丁基缩水甘油醚（BGE）中的正丁基疏水基团为设计核心，利用其表面自由能最小化效应构建定向诱导策略，制备了梯度多孔超亲水减反射涂层BTKS-3。该效应驱动疏水基团自发向表面迁移，形成垂直浓度梯度，进而调控成膜过程中的局部化学环境和溶剂蒸发行为，最终自发导向梯度多孔结构的形成，即从致密底层过渡到多孔顶层。这种梯度结构使折射率从玻璃基底到空气逐步匹配，显著提升透光率。同时表面羟基和纳米级粗糙度赋予涂层超亲水性和自清洁能力，并具备良好的耐磨性和紫外稳定性。该工作实现了光学、自清洁和耐久性能的协同优化，为光伏玻璃高性能功能涂层提供了新范式。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告采用正丁基缩水甘油醚（BGE）中的正丁基疏水基团作为导向单元，通过表面自由能最小化效应驱动疏水基团自发向表面迁移，调控成膜过程中的局部化学环境和溶剂蒸发行为，从而自发形成梯度多孔结构。摘要提及对涂层进行了透光率测试、接触角测试、耐磨性测试和紫外稳定性测试。具体合成步骤、表征手段和测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装技术与介孔/多孔材料交叉方向，其疏水基团导向自发梯度多孔结构的策略对框架材料组装和介孔涂层设计具有方法学参考价值。但该涂层为有机-无机杂化体系而非MOF/COF/HOF框架材料，与介孔导电MOF和共轭框架材料主线关联有限。若关注自组装诱导梯度孔结构的通用策略，值得全文精读；若聚焦框架材料电化学合成，则相关性较低。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。涂层的具体化学组成、合成条件、梯度孔结构的表征证据（如截面形貌、孔径分布）、透光率测试条件、耐磨和紫外稳定性测试标准等关键细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 梯度多孔结构使透光率提升至94.61%，显著优于裸玻璃和商业减反射涂层
涂层接触角小于10°，具有超亲水性和自清洁能力
涂层表现出良好的耐磨性和紫外稳定性
疏水基团表面迁移形成的垂直浓度梯度是梯度多孔结构自发形成的关键

papers.title: Ligand π‐Conjugation Area Modulates Hydrogen Evolution Performance in Metal–Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) combine permanent porosity, tunable compositions, ordered structures, and well‐defined coordination environments, making them versatile platforms for electrocatalyst design. Although ligand engineering has been widely explored for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER), few studies have treated ligand π‐conjugation area as a defined molecular variable and systematically examined its relationship with HER performance. Here, we use a conjugated‐ligand engineering strategy to systematically vary ligand π‐conjugation area while maintaining comparable metal coordination environments. Pyromellitic dianhydride (PMDA), naphthalene‐1,4,5,8‐tetracarboxylic dianhydride (NTDA), and perylene‐3,4,9,10‐tetracarboxylic dianhydride (PTCDA), featuring benzene‐, naphthalene‐, and perylene‐based aromatic cores with 6, 10, and 20 π electrons, respectively, are used as precursors to the corresponding tetracarboxylate ligands to construct related Ni‐ and Co‐based MOFs with six‐coordinate metal centers. Across both metal series, increasing ligand π‐conjugation area consistently lowers overpotentials and Tafel slopes, decreases charge‐transfer resistance and mass‐transport‐related impedance, and increases electrochemically active surface area. This systematic ligand variation is accompanied by metal‐center binding‐energy shifts and bandgap narrowing. These results establish a clear structure–performance relationship between ligand π‐conjugation area and HER performance across the investigated MOF series, highlighting conjugated‐ligand engineering as an effective strategy for MOF electrocatalyst design.

papers.title_zh: 配体π共轭面积调控金属有机框架的析氢性能
papers.summary_zh: 以苯、萘、苝为芳香核的三种四羧酸配体构建Ni基和Co基MOF，系统改变配体π共轭面积而保持金属配位环境可比，发现π共轭面积增大持续降低过电位和Tafel斜率，建立配体π共轭面积与析氢性能的结构-性能关系。
papers.research_details_zh: MOF兼具永久孔隙率、可调组成、有序结构和明确配位环境，是电催化剂设计的通用平台。尽管配体工程在析氢反应中已被广泛探索，但少有研究将配体π共轭面积作为明确的分子变量并系统考察其与HER性能的关系。本文采用共轭配体工程策略，在保持金属配位环境可比的前提下系统改变配体π共轭面积。以均苯四甲酸二酐（PMDA）、萘-1,4,5,8-四甲酸二酐（NTDA）和苝-3,4,9,10-四甲酸二酐（PTCDA）为前驱体，分别对应苯、萘、苝芳香核，含6、10和20个π电子，制备相应四羧酸配体并构建具有六配位金属中心的Ni基和Co基MOF。在两种金属系列中，配体π共轭面积增大一致地降低过电位和Tafel斜率，降低电荷转移电阻和传质相关阻抗，并增加电化学活性表面积。该系统性配体变化伴随金属中心结合能位移和带隙窄化。结果建立了所研究MOF系列中配体π共轭面积与HER性能之间的清晰结构-性能关系，凸显共轭配体工程作为MOF电催化剂设计的有效策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告以PMDA、NTDA和PTCDA为前驱体制备对应四羧酸配体，构建Ni基和Co基MOF，金属中心为六配位。电化学测试包括过电位、Tafel斜率、电荷转移电阻、传质相关阻抗和电化学活性表面积测量。摘要提及金属中心结合能位移和带隙窄化。具体合成条件、表征手段和电化学测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭MOF和框架材料电催化方向，将配体π共轭面积作为明确分子变量系统调控HER性能，对共轭配体工程和MOF电催化剂设计具有实际指导价值。研究涵盖Ni和Co两个金属系列，结构-性能关系较为系统。但摘要未涉及介孔结构或电化学合成方法，与介孔导电MOF主线的关联主要体现在共轭配体设计策略层面。值得全文精读以获取具体合成和电化学数据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。MOF的具体合成条件、晶体结构表征、孔径数据、电化学测试条件（电解液、参比电极、扫描速率等）、过电位和Tafel斜率的具体数值、结合能位移和带隙窄化的定量数据等关键细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 在Ni基和Co基两个MOF系列中，配体π共轭面积增大一致降低过电位和Tafel斜率
π共轭面积增大降低电荷转移电阻和传质相关阻抗，并增加电化学活性表面积
配体π共轭面积变化伴随金属中心结合能位移和带隙窄化
建立了配体π共轭面积与HER性能之间的结构-性能关系

papers.title: Direct Light Storage with Controlled Dark Release in a Bipyridine-Based Covalent Triazine Framework
papers.abstract: Abstract Utilizing bifunctional materials capable of direct light-to-charge storage offers an attractive strategy to overcome solar intermittency and enable reliable power supply under dark conditions. Reported bifunctional materials are predominantly based on metal oxides and metal–organic compounds, whereas fully organic systems remain rare despite their rich structural diversity and tunability, which enable systematic structure–property–function investigations. Here, we reveal the light-induced, reversible electron storage properties of a two-dimensional (2D) 2,2′-bipyridine (bpy)-based crystalline covalent triazine framework (CTF), CTF-Bpy. Mechanistic studies suggest that the photoreduction of CTF-Bpy primarily proceeds through a proton-coupled, one-electron reduction of the bpy units, yielding bpyH• and bpyH2•+ as the identified reduction products. Photoanodes based on CTF-Bpy show a stable photoinduced open-circuit potential (photo-OCP) of −0.92 V vs Ag/AgCl, which is so far the most negative potential reported for an organic bifunctional material. Under oxygen-free conditions, photogenerated electrons remain stable and can be controllably released on-demand in the dark, either by electrical discharge (for aqueous solar battery applications) or by reducing O2 to H2O2. Moreover, this work establishes CTF-Bpy as the first photochargeable covalent organic framework (COF) with stored electrons sufficiently reducing to drive H2 evolution in the dark in the presence of a Pt cocatalyst, highlighting the promise of using COFs for "dark photocatalysis". The systematic investigation of the light-induced electron storage in CTF-Bpy with a set of spectroscopic and (spectro-)electrochemical techniques provides a framework for studying optoionic materials and guiding their rational design for tailored dark photocatalysis.

papers.title_zh: 联吡啶基共价三嗪框架中可控暗释放的直接光存储
papers.summary_zh: 首次报道二维2,2'-联吡啶基晶体共价三嗪框架CTF-Bpy的光诱导可逆电子存储，光阳极光致开路电位达−0.92 V vs Ag/AgCl，为有机双功能材料最负电位，暗条件下可可控释放电子驱动析氢和O2还原。
papers.research_details_zh: 利用可直接进行光-电荷存储的双功能材料是克服太阳能间歇性和实现暗条件下可靠供电的诱人策略。已报道的双功能材料主要基于金属氧化物和金属有机化合物，而全有机体系尽管结构多样性和可调性丰富，仍较为罕见。本文揭示了二维2,2'-联吡啶基晶体共价三嗪框架CTF-Bpy的光诱导可逆电子存储特性。机理研究表明CTF-Bpy的光还原主要通过联吡啶单元的质子耦合单电子还原进行，鉴定出bpyH•和bpyH2•+为还原产物。基于CTF-Bpy的光阳极表现出稳定的光致开路电位−0.92 V vs Ag/AgCl，这是迄今有机双功能材料报道的最负电位。在无氧条件下，光生电子保持稳定，可在暗条件下按需可控释放，或通过电放电（用于水系太阳能电池）或通过将O2还原为H2O2。此外，该工作确立了CTF-Bpy为首个光可充电共价有机框架，其存储电子在Pt助催化剂存在下足以在暗条件下驱动H2析出，凸显了利用COF进行暗光催化的前景。对联吡啶基CTF-Bpy光诱导电子存储的系统研究，结合一系列光谱和（光谱）电化学技术，为研究光离子材料并指导其理性设计以实现定制暗光催化提供了框架。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告采用二维2,2'-联吡啶基晶体共价三嗪框架CTF-Bpy作为研究体系，使用一系列光谱和（光谱）电化学技术系统研究其光诱导电子存储行为。性能测试包括光致开路电位测量、暗条件下电子可控释放测试（电放电和O2还原为H2O2）、以及Pt助催化剂存在下的暗析氢实验。具体合成方法、光谱和电化学测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF和框架材料光-电-催化交叉方向，首次报道光可充电COF并实现暗光催化析氢，对共轭框架材料的光电功能开发具有重要参考价值。CTF-Bpy的联吡啶单元作为电子存储位点的机制研究较为深入，−0.92 V的photo-OCP为有机双功能材料树立了新标杆。但该工作未涉及介孔结构调控或电化学合成方法，与介孔导电MOF主线关联有限。作为高质量框架推荐，值得全文精读以获取合成细节和机理证据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据题目和摘要内容。CTF-Bpy的具体合成条件、晶体结构表征、孔隙率数据、光谱和电化学测试的具体条件、光致开路电位测试的详细参数、暗释放实验的定量数据、暗光催化析氢的产氢速率等关键细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: CTF-Bpy光阳极表现出稳定的光致开路电位−0.92 V vs Ag/AgCl，为迄今有机双功能材料报道的最负电位
光还原主要通过联吡啶单元的质子耦合单电子还原进行，鉴定出bpyH•和bpyH2•+为还原产物
无氧条件下光生电子稳定，可在暗条件下按需可控释放，用于电放电或还原O2为H2O2
CTF-Bpy是首个光可充电COF，其存储电子在Pt助催化剂存在下可在暗条件下驱动H2析出

papers.title: Molecularly Engineered Metal–Organic Framework With Synergistically Boosting Piezoelectric Polarization and Exciton Directional Separation Enables Efficient Piezo‐Photocatalytic Atom Transfer Radical Polymerization
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Photoinduced atom transfer radical polymerization (ATRP) is often limited by the shallow penetration of visible light, and current strategies to address this limitation mainly focus on developing catalytic systems responsive to near‐infrared (NIR) light. In contrast, ultrasound‐driven polymerization offers deeper penetration but limited spatiotemporal control. To address these challenges, we pioneer the integration of piezo‐photocatalysis into ATRP by developing a donor–acceptor (D–A) metal–organic framework (MOF) catalyst (B‐Zr‐C) via incorporating electron‐acceptor N‐(4′‐carboxyphenyl)‐1,8‐naphthalimide (CPNI) into NH 2 ‐UiO‐66, which enables synergistically enhanced piezoelectric polarization and exciton separation. Multiscale characterizations verify that the introduction of CPNI prolongs the charge‐separated state lifetime and effectively increases the polarity of the MOF, as evidenced by significant increases in the piezoelectric coefficient d 33 , piezoelectric potential difference, and dipole moment. Under blue light and ultrasound, the piezo‐photocatalytic copper‐mediated ATRP apparent rate constant of B‐Zr‐C(1:1) is ∼fourfold higher than that under light alone, achieving high monomer conversion (> 90%, Đ < 1.11) in seven polar solvents and even producing ultrahigh‐molecular‐weight (UHMW) polymers ( M n > 1100 kg·mol −1 , Đ < 1.30). The piezo‐photocatalytic system retains 64% conversion through a 1.5 mm chicken‐skin barrier (vs. < 10% for blue light alone), together with outstanding spatiotemporal controllability, chain‐end fidelity, and reusability.
