papers.title_zh: 分子工程化金属有机框架协同增强压电极化与激子定向分离实现高效压电光催化原子转移自由基聚合
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将压电光催化引入ATRP，通过将电子受体CPNI引入NH2-UiO-66构建D-A型MOF催化剂B-Zr-C，协同增强压电极化和激子分离，在蓝光与超声下实现高效聚合，穿透性强且时空可控。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对光诱导ATRP受可见光穿透深度限制、近红外策略和超声驱动聚合各有不足的问题，研究者首次将压电光催化整合到ATRP中。设计策略是将电子受体N-(4'-羧基苯基)-1,8-萘酰亚胺（CPNI）引入NH2-UiO-66，构建供体-受体（D-A）型MOF催化剂B-Zr-C。多尺度表征证实CPNI的引入延长了电荷分离态寿命并有效提高MOF极性，表现为压电系数d33、压电电势差和偶极矩显著增加。在蓝光和超声条件下，B-Zr-C(1:1)的压电光催化铜介导ATRP表观速率常数约为仅光照条件下的四倍，在七种极性溶剂中实现高单体转化率（>90%，Đ<1.11），甚至可制备超高分子量聚合物（Mn>1100 kg·mol−1，Đ<1.30）。该压电光催化体系在1.5 mm鸡皮屏障下仍保持64%转化率（仅蓝光时<10%），并具有优异的时空可控性、链端保真度和可重复使用性。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：将电子受体CPNI引入NH2-UiO-66合成D-A型MOF催化剂B-Zr-C；采用多尺度表征验证电荷分离态寿命、MOF极性、压电系数d33、压电电势差和偶极矩的变化；在蓝光和超声条件下进行压电光催化铜介导ATRP，测试表观速率常数、单体转化率、分子量分布、鸡皮屏障穿透性、时空可控性、链端保真度和可重复使用性。具体表征手段和测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作对介孔导电MOF及框架材料在电化学合成与自组装相关聚合方向具有参考价值，展示了通过分子工程调控MOF压电与激子行为以提升催化聚合性能的策略。其局限在于摘要未报告MOF的孔结构、导电性及具体表征细节，且研究聚焦ATRP而非直接电化学合成。若关注框架材料在聚合催化中的压电光协同机制，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征手段、数值或机制。MOF的孔结构、导电性、具体合成条件、表征仪器参数及聚合反应详细条件等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: CPNI引入NH2-UiO-66后显著提高MOF极性，压电系数d33、压电电势差和偶极矩均显著增加，电荷分离态寿命延长。
在蓝光和超声下，B-Zr-C(1:1)的压电光催化铜介导ATRP表观速率常数约为仅光照条件下的四倍。
在七种极性溶剂中实现高单体转化率（>90%，Đ<1.11），并可制备超高分子量聚合物（Mn>1100 kg·mol−1，Đ<1.30）。
在1.5 mm鸡皮屏障下保持64%转化率（仅蓝光时<10%），并具有优异的时空可控性、链端保真度和可重复使用性。

papers.title: Rare‐Earth Multivariate Metal–Organic Frameworks: Cationic Radius Biased Compositional Control and Property Tuning
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The synthesis of a multivariate metal–organic framework (MTV‐MOF) family, [Ln(DNNDI) 1.5 ] n ( UoB‐116 ), is reported (DNNDI: N , N' ‐bis(dinicotinate)‐1,4,5,8‐naphthalenetetracarboxydiimide). UoB‐116(Ln) is formed by 15 different metals (Ln = Y, La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, and Lu), all of which were shown to be isoreticular. The uniformity of the framework structure facilitated the synthesis of MTV‐MOFs with 2, 4, 12, 15, or 16 (including In(III)) different metals. Single crystal structures of each unimetallic MOFs and MTV‐MOFs with 12 or 16 metals were determined, confirming the isoreticular nature of this family of MOFs. Energy Dispersive X‐ray (EDX) analysis confirmed distribution of each metal throughout crystals of the MTV‐MOFs and compositional analysis indicated increased concentration of lanthanides with smaller cationic radius. A protocol was developed to control relative composition in bimetallic systems, UoB‐116(La 1‐x Lu x ) and UoB‐116(Dy 1‐x La x ) ( x = 0–1). In the case of UoB‐116(Dy 1‐x La x ) it is shown that the porosity, magnetism and UV–visible properties can be tuned through metal cation composition.

papers.title_zh: 稀土多变量金属有机框架：阳离子半径偏置的组成控制与性质调控
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报告了多变量MOF家族[Ln(DNNDI)1.5]n（UoB-116），由15种稀土金属形成同构框架，并合成含2、4、12、15或16种金属的MTV-MOF，发现较小阳离子半径的镧系元素浓度增加，且双金属体系可调控孔隙率、磁性和紫外-可见性质。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究报道了多变量金属有机框架（MTV-MOF）家族[Ln(DNNDI)1.5]n（UoB-116）的合成，其中DNNDI为N,N'-双(二吡啶甲酸)-1,4,5,8-萘四甲酸二酰亚胺。UoB-116(Ln)由15种不同金属（Ln = Y、La、Ce、Pr、Nd、Sm、Eu、Gd、Tb、Dy、Ho、Er、Tm、Yb和Lu）形成，均显示为同构结构。框架结构的均一性促进了含2、4、12、15或16种（包括In(III)）不同金属的MTV-MOF的合成。单晶结构解析确定了每种单金属MOF以及含12或16种金属的MTV-MOF的结构，证实了该MOF家族的同构性质。EDX分析确认了每种金属在MTV-MOF晶体中的分布，组成分析表明较小阳离子半径的镧系元素浓度增加。研究者开发了控制双金属体系UoB-116(La1-xLux)和UoB-116(Dy1-xLax)（x=0–1）相对组成的方案。在UoB-116(Dy1-xLax)中，孔隙率、磁性和紫外-可见性质可通过金属阳离子组成进行调控。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：合成UoB-116(Ln)系列及含多种金属的MTV-MOF；通过单晶结构解析确定单金属MOF及含12或16种金属的MTV-MOF结构；采用EDX分析金属在晶体中的分布；进行组成分析以确定不同阳离子半径金属的相对浓度；开发双金属体系UoB-116(La1-xLux)和UoB-116(Dy1-xLax)的组成控制方案；测试孔隙率、磁性和紫外-可见性质。具体合成条件、表征仪器参数和测试细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作对多变量MOF及稀土框架材料的组成控制和性质调控具有参考价值，展示了通过阳离子半径偏置实现金属分布调控并进而调节孔隙率、磁性和光学性质的策略。其局限在于摘要未报告具体孔隙率数值、磁性数据及紫外-可见光谱细节，且未涉及介孔或导电MOF。若关注框架材料的多变量合成与性质调控，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征手段、数值或机制。具体合成条件、单晶结构参数、EDX定量数据、孔隙率数值、磁性测量条件和紫外-可见光谱数据等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: UoB-116(Ln)由15种不同稀土金属形成同构框架，并成功合成含2、4、12、15或16种金属的MTV-MOF。
EDX分析确认各金属在MTV-MOF晶体中分布，组成分析表明较小阳离子半径的镧系元素浓度增加。
开发了控制双金属体系UoB-116(La1-xLux)和UoB-116(Dy1-xLax)（x=0–1）相对组成的方案。
在UoB-116(Dy1-xLax)中，孔隙率、磁性和紫外-可见性质可通过金属阳离子组成进行调控。

papers.title: Biomimetic Confined Crystallization of Large‐Sized Single‐Crystalline Multicomponent Mesoporous Metal Oxides
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The performance of mesoporous metal oxides (MMOs) depends strongly on the composition, crystallinity, and size. However, soft‐templating synthesis of multicomponent systems is typically constrained by poor structural control arising from phase separation, uncontrolled nucleation, and structural collapse. Inspired by biomineralization, this study proposes a biomimetic confined crystallization strategy based on constructing a 3D continuous poly(acrylic acid) matrix. This matrix forms a flexible organic–inorganic network that stabilizes intermediate species, regulates crystallization kinetics, suppresses burst nucleation, and promotes integrated crystal growth, thereby playing a role analogous to the organic framework in natural biomineralization. In addition, the template directs mesostructure formation through its space‐occupying effect and decomposition‐induced gas evolution. As a result, large‐sized single‐crystalline multicomponent MMOs were successfully synthesized. More importantly, this strategy enables precise and tunable control of crystallinity and particle size and can be readily extended to more than ten multicomponent systems. As a representative example, La 2 FeCuO 6 exhibits a Faradaic efficiency of 98.2% for electrocatalytic nitrate reduction, benefiting from the synergistic effects of optimized electronic structure, mesoporosity, and single crystallinity. Overall, this work establishes a biomimetic route to overcome the intrinsic limitations of conventional soft‐templating approaches, particularly phase separation, polycrystallization, and the difficulty of achieving large‐sized crystal growth under high‐temperature calcination.

papers.title_zh: 仿生限域结晶制备大尺寸单晶多组分介孔金属氧化物
papers.summary_zh: 该工作受生物矿化启发，构建三维连续聚丙烯酸基质，通过仿生限域结晶策略抑制相分离与爆发成核，成功合成大尺寸单晶多组分介孔金属氧化物，并可拓展至十余种体系，代表性材料La2FeCuO6在电催化硝酸盐还原中法拉第效率达98.2%。
papers.research_details_zh: 介孔金属氧化物的性能强烈依赖组成、结晶度和尺寸，但多组分体系的软模板合成通常受相分离、不可控成核和结构坍塌制约，导致结构控制困难。本研究受生物矿化启发，提出基于三维连续聚丙烯酸基质的仿生限域结晶策略。该基质形成柔性有机-无机网络，稳定中间物种、调控结晶动力学、抑制爆发成核并促进整体晶体生长，其作用类似天然生物矿化中的有机框架。同时，模板通过占位效应和分解产气引导介观结构形成。由此成功合成大尺寸单晶多组分介孔金属氧化物，并实现对结晶度和颗粒尺寸的精确可调控制，且可拓展至十余种多组分体系。代表性材料La2FeCuO6因优化电子结构、介孔性和单晶性的协同效应，在电催化硝酸盐还原中法拉第效率达98.2%。该工作建立了仿生路线，克服传统软模板法在高温煅烧下相分离、多晶化和难以实现大尺寸晶体生长等固有局限。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：基于三维连续聚丙烯酸基质构建柔性有机-无机网络的仿生限域结晶合成策略；利用模板占位效应和分解产气引导介观结构形成；对产物结晶度和颗粒尺寸进行调控；将策略拓展至十余种多组分体系；以La2FeCuO6为代表性材料进行电催化硝酸盐还原性能测试，报告法拉第效率为98.2%。摘要未报告具体前驱体、煅烧温度、表征手段及电化学测试条件等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料、自组装及框架材料组装主线高度相关，其仿生限域结晶策略为多组分介孔金属氧化物的结构控制提供了新思路，尤其对克服软模板法相分离和多晶化问题有实际参考价值。代表性材料的电催化硝酸盐还原性能提示介孔单晶在电催化中的潜力。但摘要未报告具体合成参数、表征证据和电化学测试细节，建议结合全文评估其普适性和机制证据。

key_findings_zh: 三维连续聚丙烯酸基质可稳定中间物种、调控结晶动力学、抑制爆发成核并促进整体晶体生长，实现仿生限域结晶。
成功合成大尺寸单晶多组分介孔金属氧化物，并实现对结晶度和颗粒尺寸的精确可调控制，可拓展至十余种多组分体系。
代表性材料La2FeCuO6在电催化硝酸盐还原中法拉第效率达98.2%，归因于优化电子结构、介孔性和单晶性的协同效应。
该策略克服传统软模板法在高温煅烧下的相分离、多晶化和大尺寸晶体生长困难等固有局限。

papers.title: Boosting C–S Coupling for Selective Hydroxymethanesulfonate Electrosynthesis over Bimetallic Cu–Ni Sites within Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Abstract Electrocatalytic C–S coupling via CO2/SO32– co-reduction represents a promising route for sustainable hydroxymethanesulfonate (HMS) synthesis, yet it still suffers from sluggish C–S coupling kinetics and severe competing side reactions. Herein, we develop bimetallic Cu–Ni sites within a covalent organic framework (CuNi-COF) catalyst for efficient and selective HMS electrosynthesis. Mechanistic investigations reveal that bimetallic Cu–Ni sites can synergistically reduce CO2 to *CHOH and promote C–S coupling of *CHOH with *SO3, while inhibiting the competing hydrogen evolution reaction, thereby resulting in a high efficiency for selective HMS synthesis. Impressively, CuNi-COF achieves the exceptional HMS yield rate of 32.8 μmol cm–2 h–1 and a Faradaic efficiency of 27.3% in a membrane electrode assembly electrolyzer, along with outstanding long-term stability for over 100 h of electrolysis. Techno-economic analysis further demonstrates the considerable economic viability of the CuNi-COF-driven electrocatalytic C–S coupling method for industrial-scale HMS production.

papers.title_zh: 共价有机框架内双金属Cu-Ni位点促进C-S偶联用于选择性羟甲基磺酸盐电合成
papers.summary_zh: 该工作开发了共价有机框架内双金属Cu-Ni位点催化剂CuNi-COF，用于CO2/SO3^2-共还原电催化合成羟甲基磺酸盐。双金属位点协同将CO2还原为*CHOH并促进其与*SO3的C-S偶联，同时抑制析氢副反应，在膜电极电解器中实现32.8 μmol cm-2 h-1的产率和27.3%的法拉第效率，稳定运行超100小时。
papers.research_details_zh: 电催化C-S偶联通过CO2/SO3^2-共还原为可持续合成羟甲基磺酸盐提供了有前景的路线，但仍受C-S偶联动力学缓慢和严重竞争副反应制约。本研究开发了共价有机框架内双金属Cu-Ni位点催化剂CuNi-COF，用于高效选择性HMS电合成。机理研究揭示，双金属Cu-Ni位点可协同将CO2还原为*CHOH，并促进*CHOH与*SO3的C-S偶联，同时抑制竞争性析氢反应，从而实现高效选择性HMS合成。CuNi-COF在膜电极组装电解器中实现HMS产率32.8 μmol cm-2 h-1和法拉第效率27.3%，并具有超过100小时电解的优异长期稳定性。技术经济分析进一步表明，CuNi-COF驱动的电催化C-S偶联方法在工业规模HMS生产中具有可观的经济可行性。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：在共价有机框架中构建双金属Cu-Ni位点催化剂CuNi-COF；通过机理研究探究CO2/SO3^2-共还原路径及C-S偶联机制；在膜电极组装电解器中进行HMS电合成性能测试，报告产率、法拉第效率和长期稳定性；开展技术经济分析评估工业规模经济可行性。摘要未报告COF具体结构、合成条件、表征手段及电解电压等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于共轭COF及电化学合成主线，展示了COF作为电催化剂载体稳定双金属位点并调控C-S偶联选择性的能力，对框架材料在电催化C-S键构建中的应用有直接参考价值。其膜电极电解器和百小时稳定性数据增强了面向工业应用的可行性。但摘要未报告COF结构、位点配位环境和反应机理的具体证据，建议全文精读以评估机制可靠性和材料设计普适性。

papers.title: Oxygen Enrichment on Carbon Nanoreactors and *OOH Modulation on Sn 1 Sites Cooperatively Promote Industrial‐Scale H 2 O 2 Electrosynthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Industrial‑scale H 2 O 2 electrosynthesis faces two major challenges: oxygen depletion at the catalytic interface, which causes diffusion limitations, and a strong dependence of product selectivity on the adsorption behavior of the *OOH intermediate. Constructing an O 2 ‑enriched microenvironment alleviates transport issues, while tuning *OOH adsorption prevents excessive O─O bond cleavage; their synergy is expected to boost ORR performance. Guided by theory, we developed a Sn single‑atom‐anchored hollow mesoporous carbon nanoreactor (Sn 1 /HMCS). The hollow mesoporous carbon nanoreactor facilitates an oxygen‑enriched microenvironment at the catalytic interface via spontaneous O 2 adsorption and diffusion, while the N/O‑coordinated Sn sites enable optimal *OOH adsorption regulation, delivering ∼100% H 2 O 2 selectivity. The adaptive matching between the spontaneous oxygen supply kinetics and the electrocatalytic reaction allows the system to maintain both optimal thermodynamic potential and high selectivity at industrially relevant high‑current conditions. Assembling Sn 1 /HMCS in a solid‑electrolyte cell delivered an industrial‑scale system for high‑purity H 2 O 2 with low energy consumption and excellent stability. At 500 mA cm − 2 , it produced ∼4.51 wt% H 2 O 2 at a rate of 31.8 mol g catalyst − 1 h − 1 , with stable operation over 300 h. This work provides a practical way to prepare catalysts meeting industrial‑scale current density requirements and facilitates the development of economically feasible H 2 O 2 electrosynthesis schemes.

papers.title_zh: 碳纳米反应器上的氧富集与Sn1位点上的*OOH调控协同促进工业级H2O2电合成
papers.summary_zh: 该工作针对工业级H2O2电合成中界面氧耗尽和*OOH吸附调控难题，开发了Sn单原子锚定中空介孔碳纳米反应器Sn1/HMCS。中空介孔碳通过自发O2吸附和扩散形成氧富集微环境，N/O配位Sn位点优化*OOH吸附，实现约100% H2O2选择性，在500 mA cm-2下产率31.8 mol g catalyst-1 h-1，稳定运行300小时。
papers.research_details_zh: 工业级H2O2电合成面临两大挑战：催化界面氧耗尽导致扩散限制，以及产物选择性强烈依赖*OOH中间体吸附行为。构建O2富集微环境可缓解传输问题，调控*OOH吸附可防止O-O键过度断裂，二者协同有望提升ORR性能。在理论指导下，研究者开发了Sn单原子锚定中空介孔碳纳米反应器Sn1/HMCS。中空介孔碳纳米反应器通过自发O2吸附和扩散在催化界面形成氧富集微环境，而N/O配位Sn位点实现最优*OOH吸附调控，使H2O2选择性接近100%。自发供氧动力学与电催化反应的自适应匹配使系统在工业相关高电流条件下同时保持最优热力学电位和高选择性。将Sn1/HMCS组装于固态电解质电池中，构建了低能耗、高稳定性、高纯度H2O2的工业级系统。在500 mA cm-2下，以31.8 mol g catalyst-1 h-1的速率产生约4.51 wt% H2O2，稳定运行超过300小时。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：在理论指导下设计Sn单原子锚定中空介孔碳纳米反应器Sn1/HMCS；利用中空介孔碳的自发O2吸附和扩散构建氧富集微环境；通过N/O配位Sn位点调控*OOH吸附；将Sn1/HMCS组装于固态电解质电池中构建工业级H2O2电合成系统；在500 mA cm-2下测试产率、浓度、选择性和稳定性。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段及理论计算方法等细节。

papers.title: Liquid–Solid Interfacial Fusion Assembly Enables Programmable Chain Density for Controlling Polymer–Mineral Interactions
papers.abstract: Abstract Biomineralization offers key insights into nature’s design of hierarchical materials with exceptional properties. However, progress is hindered by limited molecular-level understanding of organic–inorganic interfacial interactions, particularly how organic matrix structure directs mineral formation and organization. Herein, we synthesize a series of poly(methacrylic acid)x-block-poly(benzyl methacrylate)y (Mx-By) nanoparticles with varying block lengths via polymerization-induced self-assembly, followed by their fusion onto mesoporous silica surfaces through liquid–solid interfacial fusion assembly. This approach yields silica-copolymer core–shell composite nanoparticles with tunable interfacial structures. We show that the packing density of copolymer chains on the fused layer is governed by the degree of polymerization of the hydrophobic block (By). This tunability provides a model platform to systematically investigate how surface chain density dictates polymer–mineral interactions. It is demonstrated that the surface chain density plays a decisive role in controlling the spatial distribution of guest species within mineral phases. We reveal the underlying mechanism behind this interesting phenomenon, which is widespread in natural biominerals. This work not only offers new insights into biomineralization but also provides new design rules for engineering composite crystals with tunable internal compositions and structures.

papers.title_zh: 液-固界面融合组装实现可编程链密度以调控聚合物-矿物相互作用
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过聚合诱导自组装合成不同嵌段长度的聚甲基丙烯酸-b-聚甲基丙烯酸苄酯纳米颗粒，并利用液-固界面融合组装将其融合到介孔二氧化硅表面，获得界面结构可调的二氧化硅-共聚物核壳复合纳米颗粒，证明疏水嵌段聚合度决定融合层链堆积密度，进而控制客体物种在矿物相中的空间分布。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对生物矿化中有机-无机界面相互作用的分子级理解不足，特别是机质结构如何指导矿物形成与组织的问题。作者合成了一系列聚甲基丙烯酸x-嵌段-聚甲基丙烯酸苄酯y（Mx-By）纳米颗粒，嵌段长度可变，制备方法为聚合诱导自组装。随后通过液-固界面融合组装将这些纳米颗粒融合到介孔二氧化硅表面，得到具有可调界面结构的二氧化硅-共聚物核壳复合纳米颗粒。研究显示，融合层上共聚物链的堆积密度由疏水嵌段By的聚合度控制。该可调性提供了模型平台，用于系统研究表面链密度如何决定聚合物-矿物相互作用。结果表明，表面链密度在控制客体物种在矿物相内空间分布方面起决定性作用，并揭示了这一在天然生物矿物中广泛存在的现象背后的机制。该工作为生物矿化提供新认识，也为工程化具有可调内部组成和结构的复合晶体提供设计规则。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：通过聚合诱导自组装合成一系列不同嵌段长度的聚甲基丙烯酸x-嵌段-聚甲基丙烯酸苄酯y（Mx-By）纳米颗粒；通过液-固界面融合组装将纳米颗粒融合到介孔二氧化硅表面，形成二氧化硅-共聚物核壳复合纳米颗粒；通过改变疏水嵌段By的聚合度调控融合层共聚物链堆积密度；利用所得平台研究表面链密度对聚合物-矿物相互作用及客体物种空间分布的影响。摘要未报告具体表征手段和性能测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文与介孔材料、自组装技术及框架材料组装主线中的界面组装和介孔二氧化硅表面修饰相关，提供了一种通过液-固界面融合组装调控聚合物链密度并研究聚合物-矿物相互作用的模型平台。其价值在于将聚合诱导自组装与介孔二氧化硅表面融合结合，用于理解生物矿化中的有机-无机界面调控。但该文不涉及导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，与核心框架材料方向关联有限，属于拓展参考，是否精读取决于对聚合物-矿物界面和生物矿化模型体系的兴趣。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体表征方法、链密度数值、客体物种种类、矿物相组成、机制验证实验细节及定量构效关系，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 融合层上共聚物链的堆积密度由疏水嵌段By的聚合度控制。
表面链密度在控制客体物种于矿物相内的空间分布方面起决定性作用。
揭示了表面链密度调控客体物种空间分布这一在天然生物矿物中广泛存在的现象背后的机制。
摘要未报告具体数值型定量结果。

papers.title: Supramolecular‐Reinforced Multifunctional Integrated Adaptive Coatings for Marine Protection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Marine protective coatings often fail prematurely under the coupled effects of mechanical damage, UV irradiation, microbial fouling, and corrosion, because conventional barrier‑type systems lack adaptive interfacial regulation and integrated protective functions. Herein, a GO‑HHU‑CuPN‑EP coating is fabricated via a room‑temperature aqueous supramolecular self‑assembly strategy. In this coating, cerium‐based MOF nanocrystals (HHU) are grown in situ on GO nanosheets, followed by the surface assembly of a copper–tannic acid metal‐phenolic network (CuPN). The resulting hierarchical structure suppresses GO restacking and forms a tortuous diffusion barrier, while the CuPN acts as an interfacial regulator that improves filler‐matrix compatibility and environmental adaptability. The regulated interface enables efficient stress transfer, controlled inhibitor release, and photothermal defect confinement, while also improving weather resistance and antibacterial activity. As a result, the coating achieves a tensile strength of 27.4 MPa, an adhesion force of 7.4 MPa, an antibacterial rate of 96.2%, and an impedance modulus above 10 9.5 Ω·cm 2 after 100 d of immersion. These results establish supramolecular interfacial regulation as a coordinated strategy for integrating structural reinforcement and adaptive protection in durable marine coatings.

papers.title_zh: 超分子增强的多功能集成自适应涂层用于海洋防护
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过室温水相超分子自组装策略制备GO-HHU-CuPN-EP涂层，其中铈基MOF纳米晶在GO纳米片上原位生长，随后表面组装铜-单宁酸金属酚网络。该分级结构抑制GO重堆叠并形成曲折扩散屏障，CuPN作为界面调节剂改善填料-基体相容性和环境适应性，实现结构增强与自适应防护集成。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对海洋防护涂层在机械损伤、紫外照射、微生物污损和腐蚀耦合作用下易过早失效的问题，因为传统屏障型体系缺乏自适应界面调控和集成防护功能。作者通过室温水相超分子自组装策略制备GO-HHU-CuPN-EP涂层。在该涂层中，铈基MOF纳米晶（HHU）在GO纳米片上原位生长，随后表面组装铜-单宁酸金属酚网络（CuPN）。所得分级结构抑制GO重堆叠并形成曲折扩散屏障，CuPN作为界面调节剂改善填料-基体相容性和环境适应性。调控后的界面实现有效应力传递、可控抑制剂释放和光热缺陷封闭，同时提高耐候性和抗菌活性。结果，涂层达到27.4 MPa拉伸强度、7.4 MPa附着力、96.2%抗菌率，以及浸泡100天后阻抗模量高于10^9.5 Ω·cm2。这些结果确立了超分子界面调控作为集成结构增强和自适应防护的协同策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：室温水相超分子自组装策略制备GO-HHU-CuPN-EP涂层；铈基MOF纳米晶（HHU）在GO纳米片上原位生长；随后表面组装铜-单宁酸金属酚网络（CuPN）；对涂层进行拉伸强度、附着力、抗菌率测试；以及浸泡100天后的阻抗模量测试。摘要未报告具体表征手段、合成配比和完整电化学测试条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文与框架材料组装和自组装技术主线相关，涉及铈基MOF纳米晶在GO上的原位生长及超分子金属酚网络表面组装，属于MOF基复合涂层的界面组装与功能集成。其价值在于展示MOF纳米晶与二维材料、金属酚网络和环氧基体结合，实现海洋防护中的结构增强与自适应防护。但该文不涉及介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，与核心方向关联有限，可作为框架材料组装和多功能涂层拓展参考。

papers.title: Hydrogen-bond-assisted self-assembly of donor-acceptor structures for metal-free oxygen activation
papers.abstract: Molecular oxygen (O 2 ) is a potential green oxidant. It is not only widely used for the selective oxidation of organic compounds, but also can synthesize hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ) through the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) process in water. However, the spin prohibition of O 2 limits its application, and it requires an activation process to improve its reactivity. Among various catalysts for photocatalytic oxygen activation, covalent organic frameworks (COFs) with donor-acceptor (D-A) structures have shown promising potential. However, the construction of D-A structures through covalent bonds poses challenges in catalyst synthesis and expansion. In this work, we propose a hydrogen bond-assisted self-assembly method for COFs catalysts. The results show that after the self-assembly modification of K-TPBP with 9-anthracenemethanol, it exhibits better O 2 activation performance, and its H 2 O 2 production performance is doubled compared with the original catalyst. At the same time, the modified catalyst showed better reactivity in the selective aerobic oxidation of sulfides. Further insight into the mechanism revealed that the D-A structure analogs achieved via self-assembly modification effectively strengthen the built-in electric field on the catalyst surface and facilitate charge transfer and dispersion within the catalyst, highlighting its beneficial effect on the reaction.

papers.title_zh: 氢键辅助自组装构建供体-受体结构用于无金属氧气活化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出氢键辅助自组装方法构建COF催化剂，以9-蒽甲醇对K-TPBP进行自组装修饰后，其O2活化性能提升，H2O2产生性能相比原始催化剂翻倍，并在硫化物选择性有氧氧化中表现更好。机制上，自组装修饰形成的供体-受体结构类似物增强催化剂表面内建电场，促进电荷转移和分散。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对分子氧作为绿色氧化剂的应用受自旋禁阻限制、需要活化过程提高反应性的问题。在光催化氧气活化催化剂中，具有供体-受体（D-A）结构的共价有机框架（COF）显示出潜力，但通过共价键构建D-A结构在催化剂合成和扩展方面存在挑战。本工作提出一种氢键辅助自组装方法用于COF催化剂。结果显示，K-TPBP经9-蒽甲醇自组装修饰后，表现出更好的O2活化性能，其H2O2产生性能相比原始催化剂翻倍。同时，修饰后催化剂在硫化物选择性有氧氧化中表现出更好的反应性。进一步机制研究表明，通过自组装修饰实现的D-A结构类似物有效增强催化剂表面内建电场，并促进催化剂内电荷转移和分散，突出其对反应的有益影响。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：提出氢键辅助自组装方法用于COF催化剂；以9-蒽甲醇对K-TPBP进行自组装修饰；评价O2活化性能、H2O2产生性能以及硫化物选择性有氧氧化反应性；通过机制研究探讨自组装修饰形成的D-A结构类似物对表面内建电场、电荷转移和分散的影响。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段和性能测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该文与共轭COF、自组装技术及框架材料组装主线高度相关，提出氢键辅助自组装构建D-A结构类似物，避免传统共价键构建D-A结构的合成挑战，并用于光催化氧气活化和硫化物有氧氧化。其价值在于展示自组装修饰调控COF内建电场和电荷转移，为无金属氧气活化提供新策略。但该文不涉及介孔导电MOF、介孔材料或电化学合成，是否精读取决于对COF自组装和光催化氧气活化机制的兴趣。

papers.title: Biomimetic Confined Crystallization of Large‐Sized Single‐Crystalline Multicomponent Mesoporous Metal Oxides
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The performance of mesoporous metal oxides (MMOs) depends strongly on the composition, crystallinity, and size. However, soft‐templating synthesis of multicomponent systems is typically constrained by poor structural control arising from phase separation, uncontrolled nucleation, and structural collapse. Inspired by biomineralization, this study proposes a biomimetic confined crystallization strategy based on constructing a 3D continuous poly(acrylic acid) matrix. This matrix forms a flexible organic–inorganic network that stabilizes intermediate species, regulates crystallization kinetics, suppresses burst nucleation, and promotes integrated crystal growth, thereby playing a role analogous to the organic framework in natural biomineralization. In addition, the template directs mesostructure formation through its space‐occupying effect and decomposition‐induced gas evolution. As a result, large‐sized single‐crystalline multicomponent MMOs were successfully synthesized. More importantly, this strategy enables precise and tunable control of crystallinity and particle size and can be readily extended to more than ten multicomponent systems. As a representative example, La 2 FeCuO 6 exhibits a Faradaic efficiency of 98.2% for electrocatalytic nitrate reduction, benefiting from the synergistic effects of optimized electronic structure, mesoporosity, and single crystallinity. Overall, this work establishes a biomimetic route to overcome the intrinsic limitations of conventional soft‐templating approaches, particularly phase separation, polycrystallization, and the difficulty of achieving large‐sized crystal growth under high‐temperature calcination.

papers.title_zh: 大尺寸单晶多组分介孔金属氧化物的仿生限域结晶
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出基于三维连续聚丙烯酸基质的仿生限域结晶策略，抑制爆发成核与相分离，成功合成大尺寸单晶多组分介孔金属氧化物，可拓展至十余种体系，La2FeCuO6在电催化硝酸盐还原中法拉第效率达98.2%。
papers.research_details_zh: 介孔金属氧化物的性能取决于组成、结晶度和尺寸，但多组分体系的软模板合成常受相分离、不可控成核和结构坍塌制约，导致结构控制差。受生物矿化启发，该研究构建三维连续聚丙烯酸基质，形成柔性有机-无机网络，用以稳定中间物种、调控结晶动力学、抑制爆发成核并促进一体化晶体生长，其作用类似天然生物矿化中的有机框架。同时，模板通过占位效应和分解产气引导介观结构形成。由此成功合成大尺寸单晶多组分介孔金属氧化物，并实现对结晶度和粒径的精确可调控制，且可拓展至十余种多组分体系。以La2FeCuO6为代表，得益于优化电子结构、介孔性和单晶性的协同效应，其电催化硝酸盐还原法拉第效率达98.2%。该工作建立了仿生路线，以克服传统软模板法在高温煅烧下相分离、多晶化和难以实现大尺寸晶体生长等固有局限。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：基于三维连续聚丙烯酸基质构建柔性有机-无机网络的仿生限域结晶合成策略；利用模板占位效应和分解产气引导介观结构形成；对产物结晶度和粒径进行调控；将策略拓展至十余种多组分体系；以La2FeCuO6为代表进行电催化硝酸盐还原性能测试并获得法拉第效率。摘要未报告具体表征手段、合成温度、时间、前驱体种类及电化学测试条件等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料、自组装及框架材料组装主线相关，其仿生限域结晶策略为多组分介孔金属氧化物的结构控制提供了新思路，并展示了介孔性与单晶性协同提升电催化性能的潜力。局限在于摘要未报告具体表征与合成参数，且材料本身非MOF/COF/HOF框架。若关注介孔材料结晶控制与电催化应用，值得全文精读以核查机制与普适性细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体表征手段、合成温度与时间、前驱体、聚丙烯酸基质分子量、介孔孔径与比表面积、晶体尺寸数值、十余种体系的具体组成、电化学测试条件及稳定性等关键细节，均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 三维连续聚丙烯酸基质可稳定中间物种、调控结晶动力学、抑制爆发成核并促进一体化晶体生长，从而抑制相分离和多晶化。
成功合成大尺寸单晶多组分介孔金属氧化物，并实现对结晶度和粒径的精确可调控制，可拓展至十余种多组分体系。
代表性材料La2FeCuO6在电催化硝酸盐还原中法拉第效率达98.2%，归因于优化电子结构、介孔性和单晶性的协同效应。

papers.title: A Cu 2 S/NiOOH Heterojunction Enables Highly Selective Ammonia‐to‐Nitrite Electrooxidation at Industrially Relevant Current Densities
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Electrocatalytic ammonia oxidation reaction (AOR) offers a green route to nitrite (NO 2 − ) synthesis while coupling hydrogen evolution reaction. However, maintaining NO 2 − selectivity at high current density remains challenging due to the narrow thermodynamic windows for NO 2 − and nitrate (NO 3 − ) formation and competition of oxygen evolution reaction at high anodic potentials. Herein, we report a Cu 2 S/NiOOH heterojunction that sustains high NO 2 − selectivity over a wide oxidative window at industrially relevant current densities. Operando Raman spectroscopy, X‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy and density functional theory calculations reveal that the heterointerface induces interfacial electronic redistribution within the Ni–O framework, strengthens NH 3 adsorption, and rebalances AOR energetics, favoring NO 2 − release over oxidation. Consequently, in a membrane electrode assembly‐based flow cell, Cu 2 S/NiOOH delivers a Faradaic efficiency for NO 2 − (FE(NO 2 − )) exceeding 90% at 800 mA cm − 2 with a high production rate of 383.2 mg cm −2 h −1 . These results highlight the potential of Cu 2 S/NiOOH for NO 2 − electrosynthesis at industrial production rate.

papers.title_zh: Cu2S/NiOOH异质结在工业级电流密度下实现高选择性氨到亚硝酸盐电氧化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作报道Cu2S/NiOOH异质结在宽氧化窗口和工业级电流密度下维持高亚硝酸盐选择性，界面电子重分布增强NH3吸附并重平衡AOR能量学，在膜电极流动池中800 mA cm-2下FE(NO2-)超过90%，产率达383.2 mg cm-2 h-1。
papers.research_details_zh: 电催化氨氧化反应可绿色合成亚硝酸盐并耦合析氢反应，但在高电流密度下维持亚硝酸盐选择性困难，原因在于亚硝酸盐与硝酸盐形成的热力学窗口窄，且高阳极电位下析氧反应竞争。该研究报道Cu2S/NiOOH异质结，可在宽氧化窗口和工业级电流密度下维持高亚硝酸盐选择性。通过原位拉曼光谱、X射线光电子能谱和密度泛函理论计算揭示，异质界面诱导Ni-O框架内界面电子重分布，增强NH3吸附并重平衡AOR能量学，使反应更倾向于释放亚硝酸盐而非进一步氧化。在基于膜电极组件的流动池中，Cu2S/NiOOH在800 mA cm-2下亚硝酸盐法拉第效率超过90%，产率高达383.2 mg cm-2 h-1。该结果凸显Cu2S/NiOOH在工业级产率下进行亚硝酸盐电合成的潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：构建Cu2S/NiOOH异质结电催化剂；采用原位拉曼光谱、X射线光电子能谱和密度泛函理论计算研究界面电子结构与反应能量学；在基于膜电极组件的流动池中进行电催化氨氧化性能测试，评估亚硝酸盐法拉第效率和产率。摘要未报告具体合成方法、电解液组成、温度、稳定性测试及对照样品等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与电化学合成主线相关，展示了异质结界面工程在工业级电流密度下调控电催化选择性的价值，其原位光谱与DFT结合的分析思路可借鉴于框架材料电催化研究。局限在于材料为Cu2S/NiOOH无机异质结，非MOF/COF/HOF或介孔框架材料。若关注电合成与界面电子调控机制，值得全文精读以核查稳定性与选择性边界条件。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体合成方法、电解液与pH、温度、长期稳定性、对照样品性能、原位拉曼具体峰位及DFT计算模型等关键细节，均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Cu2S/NiOOH异质结可在宽氧化窗口和工业级电流密度下维持高亚硝酸盐选择性。
原位拉曼、XPS和DFT表明异质界面诱导Ni-O框架内界面电子重分布，增强NH3吸附并重平衡AOR能量学， favoring NO2-释放而非进一步氧化。
在膜电极组件流动池中，800 mA cm-2下FE(NO2-)超过90%，产率达383.2 mg cm-2 h-1。

papers.title: Engineering van der Waals Heterojunctions Within a 2D Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Framework for Boosting CO 2 Electroreduction
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Unlike conventional strategies that regulate charge transport in framework electrocatalysts by modifying covalent skeletons or compositions, we demonstrate efficient directional electron transfer by constructing interlayer van der Waals donor–acceptor (D–A) heterojunctions within a hydrogen‐bonded organic frameworks (HOFs). The porphyrin‐based HOF, PFC‐45‐Co, is assembled from electron‐donating 5,10,15,20‐tetra(4‐carboxyphenyl)porphyrin (Co‐TPyP) and electron‐accepting cobalt 5,10,15,20‐tetra(4‐carboxyphenyl)porphyrin (Co‐TCPP) through strong O─H···N hydrogen bonds, while periodic alternating interlayer π–π stacking generates vertical D–A heterojunctions. Mechanistic studies show that close π–π contacts enable through‐space charge transport, and the D–A energy offset drives electron transfer from Co‐TPyP to Co‐TCPP, producing electron‐enriched Co‐TCPP sites that promote CO 2 activation and suppress hydrogen evolution. As a result, PFC‐45‐Co outperforms the single‐component HOF PFC‐72‐Co in both neutral and acidic media. In neutral electrolyte, PFC‐45‐Co delivers a CO Faradaic efficiency (FE CO ) of 98.4% at −0.9 V versus reversible hydrogen electrode (vs. RHE) and a CO partial current density ( j CO ) of 31.3 mA cm −2 at −1.2 V versus RHE. In acidic media, it maintains FE CO values of 92%–99% and achieves j CO of 111.1 mA cm −2 at −1.6 V versus RHE. This work establishes interlayer van der Waals D–A heterojunctions as an effective motif for regulating charge transfer in HOF electrocatalysts.

papers.title_zh: 在二维氢键有机框架中构建范德华异质结以促进CO2电还原
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过在卟啉基氢键有机框架PFC-45-Co层间构建给体-受体范德华异质结，实现定向电子转移，显著提升CO2电还原性能，在中性和酸性介质中均优于单组分HOF，并抑制析氢反应。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对框架电催化剂中电荷传输调控依赖共价骨架或组成修饰的传统策略，提出在氢键有机框架内构建层间范德华给体-受体异质结的新思路。PFC-45-Co由给电子的Co-TPyP与受电子的Co-TCPP通过强O─H···N氢键组装，周期性交替的层间π–π堆叠形成垂直D–A异质结。机理研究表明，紧密π–π接触实现空间电荷传输，D–A能级差驱动电子从Co-TPyP转移至Co-TCPP，产生富电子Co-TCPP位点，促进CO2活化并抑制析氢。该策略使PFC-45-Co在中性和酸性介质中均优于单组分HOF PFC-72-Co，确立了层间范德华D–A异质结作为调控HOF电催化剂电荷转移的有效基元。

papers.title: COFFlow: Building-Block-Based Generative Modeling for Two-Dimensional Covalent Organic Framework Discovery
papers.abstract: Abstract Two-dimensional covalent organic frameworks (2D COFs) are promising porous materials with vast yet largely unexplored design space arising from diverse building blocks (BBs) and crystal topologies. Efficient crystal structure prediction (CSP) and inverse design of 2D COFs therefore remain highly challenging. Here, we develop COFFlow, a flow-matching-based generative framework for CSP of 2D COFs. A COF-specific deconstruction algorithm is introduced to consistently decompose periodic COFs into experimentally relevant BBs across diverse topologies, enabling direct generative assembly of periodic frameworks from BB representations. Systematic evaluations demonstrate that COFFlow can reliably and efficiently generate structurally consistent and chemically valid 2D COFs. Beyond the commonly used match rate (MR), we further introduce validity rate (VR) to assess the chemical validity of generated structures. The models exhibit nontrivial extrapolation capability toward unseen BBs and crystal topologies, although preserving chemical validity under strong distribution shifts remains challenging. To demonstrate the practical utility of the framework, we integrated COFFlow with data-driven screening and inverse design of 2D COFs for methane storage. Using deliverable capacity as the target metric for adsorbed natural gas application, we identified several previously unreported 2D COFs with performance among the highest reported to date. More broadly, this work establishes a scalable framework for AI-driven discovery and design of reticular materials.

papers.title_zh: COFFlow：基于构建块的生成式建模用于二维共价有机框架发现
papers.summary_zh: 该工作开发了基于流匹配的生成框架COFFlow，用于二维COF的晶体结构预测与逆向设计，引入COF专用解构算法和有效性率指标，并成功筛选出用于甲烷存储的高性能未报道2D COF。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对二维共价有机框架设计空间巨大、晶体结构预测与逆向设计困难的问题，开发了基于流匹配的生成框架COFFlow。该框架引入COF专用解构算法，可将周期性COF一致地分解为跨多种拓扑的实验相关构建块，实现从构建块表示直接生成组装周期性框架。系统评估表明COFFlow能可靠高效地生成结构一致且化学有效的2D COF。除常用匹配率外，作者引入有效性率评估生成结构的化学有效性。模型对未见构建块和晶体拓扑表现出非平凡外推能力，但在强分布偏移下保持化学有效性仍具挑战。作者将COFFlow与数据驱动筛选和逆向设计结合用于甲烷存储，以可交付容量为目标指标，识别出若干性能居已报道最高之列的未报道2D COF。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：开发基于流匹配的生成框架COFFlow；引入COF专用解构算法将周期性COF分解为实验相关构建块；采用匹配率和有效性率评估生成结构；进行外推能力测试；将COFFlow与数据驱动筛选和逆向设计结合，以可交付容量为目标指标筛选甲烷存储用2D COF。摘要未报告具体模型架构、训练数据规模及计算细节。

papers.title: Programmable Carrier‐Free All‐Enzyme Beads for Modular Continuous‐Flow Biocatalysis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Carrier‐free enzyme materials offer maximal catalytic density but are typically limited to monolithic or amorphous architectures with restricted process compatibility. Here, we introduce programmable carrier‐free all‐enzyme beads as structurally defined, porous biocatalytic particles for modular continuous‐flow operation. The beads are generated via droplet‐based self‐assembly of complementary enzyme building blocks, followed by cryogenic consolidation, yielding mechanically robust and monodisperse protein particles that retain full catalytic competence after drying and rehydration. Using mechanistically distinct model systems, including cofactor‐independent decarboxylation and metal‐dependent C─C bond formation, we demonstrate stable long‐term continuous‐flow operation exceeding 80 h and compatibility with biphasic solvent systems at elevated substrate concentrations. Beyond single‐enzyme catalysis, the bead architecture accommodates binary cofactor‐regenerating assemblies, integrated ternary cascades with dual cofactor recycling, and modular combinations of distinct bead populations enabling sequential nucleotide phosphorylation. Notably, flow‐induced restructuring leads to adaptive consolidation of packed beds, enhancing effective catalytic volume without compromising mass transport. By uniting structural programmability, high catalytic density, architectural modularity, and adaptive behavior under flow, carrier‐free all‐enzyme beads bridge molecular enzyme engineering and reactor design, expanding the materials toolbox for scalable and reconfigurable continuous biocatalysis.

papers.title_zh: 可编程无载体全酶珠用于模块化连续流生物催化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过液滴自组装与低温固结制备可编程无载体全酶珠，实现结构明确的多孔生物催化颗粒，支持模块化连续流操作，展示超过80小时稳定运行及多种级联反应兼容性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对无载体酶材料虽具最大催化密度但通常限于整体或无定形结构、工艺兼容性受限的问题，提出可编程无载体全酶珠作为结构明确的多孔生物催化颗粒，用于模块化连续流操作。珠子通过互补酶构建块的液滴自组装，随后低温固结生成，得到机械稳健且单分散的蛋白质颗粒，干燥和再水化后保留完整催化能力。使用机制不同的模型体系，包括不依赖辅因子的脱羧和金属依赖的C─C键形成，展示超过80小时的稳定长期连续流操作，并兼容高底物浓度下的双相溶剂体系。除单酶催化外，珠结构可容纳二元辅因子再生组装、集成双辅因子回收的三元级联，以及不同珠群体的模块化组合实现顺序核苷酸磷酸化。流动诱导重构导致填充床自适应固结，增强有效催化体积而不损害传质。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：通过液滴自组装互补酶构建块，随后低温固结制备无载体全酶珠；使用不依赖辅因子的脱羧和金属依赖的C─C键形成模型体系测试连续流操作；评估干燥和再水化后催化能力；测试双相溶剂体系兼容性；构建二元辅因子再生、三元级联及模块化珠组合。摘要未报告具体酶种类、液滴生成方法及表征手段。

papers.title: Switchable Altermagnetism in a Layered van der Waals Metal–Organic Framework Driven by Spin-Crossover
papers.abstract: Abstract Dynamical control of altermagnetism is a key requirement for translating its unique spin-dependent functionalities into practical spintronic devices, yet effective switching mechanisms remain largely unexplored. Here, we open an unprecedented, versatile, and programmable route based on spin-crossover to switch altermagnetism on demand in molecular materials. Using density functional theory calculations, we demonstrate an altermagnetic ground state in the layered van der Waals metal–organic frameworks MnX2(tdz)2 (X = Cl, Br; tdz = thiadiazole), stabilized by anisotropic interlayer exchange interactions, which gives rise to a characteristic d-wave momentum-space spin splitting and an associated spin-splitter transport response. Our findings reveal that under hydrostatic pressure, a high-spin-to-low-spin transition reconfigures the Mn d-orbital occupation, thus modifying the magnetic exchange network and stabilizing a different antiferromagnetic ground state whose symmetry suppresses the nonrelativistic spin splitting. Crucially, spin-crossover switches altermagnetism not by directly altering the electronic structure but by changing the symmetry of the magnetic ground state. These results establish molecular spin-crossover altermagnets as a platform for externally reconfigurable spintronic devices.

papers.title_zh: 自旋交叉驱动的层状范德华金属有机框架中可切换交错磁体
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过密度泛函理论预测层状范德华MOF MnX2(tdz)2具有交错磁基态，并揭示静水压诱导的高自旋到低自旋转变可通过改变磁基态对称性来关闭非相对论自旋劈裂，从而按需切换交错磁性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是如何在分子材料中实现交错磁性的动态调控，以推动自旋电子学器件应用。材料体系为层状范德华金属有机框架MnX2(tdz)2（X=Cl、Br；tdz=噻二唑）。设计策略是利用自旋交叉效应改变Mn的d轨道占据，从而重构磁交换网络。研究过程采用密度泛函理论计算，首先证明该MOF存在由各向异性层间交换作用稳定的交错磁基态，表现为特征d波动量空间自旋劈裂及自旋分裂器输运响应；随后施加静水压，发现高自旋到低自旋转变会稳定另一种反铁磁基态，其对称性抑制非相对论自旋劈裂。意义在于确立了分子自旋交叉交错磁体作为外部可重构自旋电子学器件的平台，并指出切换机制源于磁基态对称性变化而非直接改变电子结构。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确使用密度泛函理论计算来研究MnX2(tdz)2（X=Cl、Br）的磁基态和电子结构。通过计算识别出交错磁基态、d波动量空间自旋劈裂以及自旋分裂器输运响应。进一步在静水压条件下模拟高自旋到低自旋转变，分析Mn d轨道占据、磁交换网络和磁基态对称性的变化。摘要未报告具体的泛函、赝势、压力数值、交换耦合常数或输运计算参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料与自旋电子学交叉方向，对介孔导电MOF和共轭框架材料主线有间接启发：它展示了MOF作为可调控磁性平台的潜力，但未涉及介孔、导电性或电化学合成。其价值在于提供自旋交叉调控磁基态对称性的设计思路，局限是纯理论预测且摘要未报告实验验证。若关注框架材料的功能化磁性调控，值得全文精读以核查计算细节和潜在实验方案。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，所有结论均来自摘要明确报告的内容。摘要未报告具体泛函、压力数值、交换耦合常数、输运计算参数、实验合成与表征细节，以及是否存在实验验证。全文需核查计算方法的可靠性、压力范围、自旋交叉转变的定量描述、d波自旋劈裂的具体动量空间分布，以及该机制在其它MOF中的普适性。
key_findings_zh: MnX2(tdz)2（X=Cl、Br）具有由各向异性层间交换作用稳定的交错磁基态，并表现出特征d波动量空间自旋劈裂和自旋分裂器输运响应。
静水压诱导高自旋到低自旋转变，重构Mn的d轨道占据并改变磁交换网络，稳定另一种反铁磁基态。
该反铁磁基态的对称性抑制了非相对论自旋劈裂，从而实现交错磁性的关闭。
自旋交叉切换交错磁性的机制不是直接改变电子结构，而是改变磁基态的对称性。

papers.title: Metal–Organic Framework‐Confined Iron Pincer Complex for Highly Efficient and Selective Borylation of Methane and Ethane
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT We report the design and development of a heterogeneous NNP‐pincer ligand, 6‐((diisopropylphosphaneyl)amino)‐(2,2′‐bipyridine), which is integrated within a porous zirconium metal–organic framework (mNNP‐UiO‐67) to synthesize highly active earth‐abundant metal catalysts for alkane functionalization. The mNNP‐UiO‐67 MOF‐supported mononuclear iron(II)‐dihydride (mNNP‐UiO‐FeH 2 ) exhibits high efficiency in catalyzing selective monoborylation of methane and ethane. mNNP‐UiO‐FeH 2 ‐catalyzed borylation of methane using pinacolborane (HBpin) produces CH 3 Bpin in 76% yield, while significantly suppressing the formation of thermodynamically favored over‐borylated products. The catalyst remains active over six recycling cycles, achieving a cumulative turnover number (TON) of 10,793, a methane utilization efficiency of 5.5%, and a space‐time productivity of 13.5 gL −1 h −1 . The catalyst is also effective for ethane activation, yielding 36% of C 2 H 5 Bpin with 100% selectivity and a TON of 774. In stark contrast, the analogous homogeneous control is barely active, giving a TON of only 8 in methane borylation due to its rapid decomposition. Experimental results indicate that the stabilization of NNP‐Fe II H 2 active sites and the catalytic intermediates such as NNP‐Fe 0 and NNP‐Fe II H(Bpin) within the MOF through active‐site isolation is crucial for the remarkably high activity and selectivity. Mechanistic studies suggest the σ ‐bond metathesis between the Fe─Bpin bond of NNP‐Fe II H(Bpin) and the C─H bond of methane as turnover‐limiting in the catalytic cycle.

papers.title_zh: 金属有机框架限域铁钳形配合物用于甲烷和乙烷的高效选择性硼化
papers.summary_zh: 该工作将NNP钳形配体集成到多孔锆基MOF UiO-67中，构建限域单核铁二氢化物催化剂，实现甲烷和乙烷的高效选择性单硼化，甲烷硼化产率76%，六次循环累积TON达10793，乙烷硼化选择性100%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是如何利用MOF限域策略稳定地球丰产金属催化剂，实现烷烃的高效选择性硼化。材料体系为将NNP钳形配体6-((二异丙基膦基)氨基)-(2,2'-联吡啶)集成到多孔锆金属有机框架UiO-67中，形成mNNP-UiO-67，再负载单核铁(II)二氢化物得到mNNP-UiO-FeH2。设计策略是通过MOF的活性位点隔离来稳定NNP-FeIIH2活性位及催化中间体。研究过程包括催化甲烷和乙烷与频哪醇硼烷的硼化反应，并与均相类似物对比。结果表明mNNP-UiO-FeH2催化甲烷硼化生成CH3Bpin产率76%，显著抑制过硼化产物；催化剂可循环六次，累积TON 10793，甲烷利用效率5.5%，时空产率13.5 gL-1h-1；乙烷活化生成C2H5Bpin产率36%，选择性100%，TON 774。均相对照几乎无活性，甲烷硼化TON仅8，因其快速分解。机理研究提示NNP-FeIIH(Bpin)的Fe-Bpin键与甲烷C-H键之间的σ键复分解为周转限制步骤。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告了NNP钳形配体6-((二异丙基膦基)氨基)-(2,2'-联吡啶)的合成及其集成到多孔锆金属有机框架UiO-67中，形成mNNP-UiO-67，再合成MOF负载的单核铁(II)二氢化物mNNP-UiO-FeH2。催化测试包括甲烷和乙烷与频哪醇硼烷的硼化反应，评估产率、选择性、循环稳定性、TON、甲烷利用效率和时空产率。机理研究通过实验和理论提示σ键复分解为周转限制步骤。摘要未报告具体表征手段、反应温度、压力、溶剂和配体负载量。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接属于金属有机框架催化方向，对MOF限域稳定活性位点的设计策略有重要参考价值。其亮点在于利用MOF骨架隔离均相催化剂，显著提升稳定性和活性，并实现烷烃选择性单硼化。局限是摘要未报告介孔性、导电性或电化学合成相关内容，也未涉及共轭MOF/COF/HOF。若关注MOF限域催化与地球丰产金属催化，值得全文精读以核查表征细节和机理证据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，所有结论均来自摘要明确报告的内容。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段（如XRD、BET、XAS等）、反应温度、压力、溶剂、配体负载量、MOF的孔结构参数以及理论计算细节。全文需核查MOF限域结构的直接证据、活性位点结构表征、循环稳定性测试条件、均相对照分解机制，以及σ键复分解周转限制步骤的实验验证。
key_findings_zh: mNNP-UiO-FeH2催化甲烷硼化生成CH3Bpin产率76%，并显著抑制热力学有利的过硼化产物。
催化剂可循环六次，累积TON达10793，甲烷利用效率5.5%，时空产率13.5 gL-1h-1。
乙烷活化生成C2H5Bpin产率36%，选择性100%，TON 774。
均相对照几乎无活性，甲烷硼化TON仅8，因其快速分解；MOF限域通过活性位点隔离稳定NNP-FeIIH2及中间体NNP-Fe0和NNP-FeIIH(Bpin)。

papers.title: Low-Voltage Electrophoretic Deposition in Water with Metal–Organic Framework Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Abstract Electrophoretic deposition (EPD) constitutes a major industrial method for solution-processed fabrication of thin films and coatings. Conventional protocols require high applied voltages (50–1000 V) that induce parasitic electrochemical reactions, limit substrate compatibility, and create safety hazards. Here, we demonstrate that intrinsic surface charge density of size-controlled metal–organic framework (MOF) nanoparticles, together with particle size and solvent properties, governs electrophoretic mobility and enables high-quality EPD in aqueous media at 1 V, well below the threshold for water electrolysis. Compact, uniform films of MOF nanoparticles with thicknesses &gt;10 μm deposit in 30 min, due to higher ζ-potentials and electrophoretic mobilities that improve with smaller particle sizes, whereas nonporous colloids require hours. Deposition occurs on a wide range of conductive substrates, enabling real-time monitoring of film thickness with quartz crystal microbalance devices and, as a result, the formation of redox-intercalation thin films with programmable capacitance and ion-insertion kinetics. These results provide an energy-efficient, safer, and rapid method for uniform thin-film assembly with thicknesses controlled to nanometer resolution.

papers.title_zh: 水相中金属有机框架纳米粒子的低电压电泳沉积
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用尺寸可控MOF纳米粒子的本征表面电荷密度，在1 V水相中实现高质量电泳沉积，远低于水电解阈值。30分钟内可沉积厚度超过10微米、致密均匀的MOF薄膜，并可通过石英晶体微天平实时监控膜厚，进而构建电容和离子嵌入动力学可编程的氧化还原插层薄膜。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对传统电泳沉积需50至1000 V高电压、易引发电化学副反应、限制基底兼容性并带来安全隐患的问题，提出利用尺寸可控MOF纳米粒子的本征表面电荷密度，结合粒径和溶剂性质调控电泳迁移率，从而在水相中实现1 V低电压电泳沉积。摘要指出，较小粒径带来更高ζ电位和电泳迁移率，使MOF纳米粒子在30分钟内形成厚度大于10微米、致密均匀的薄膜，而非多孔胶体则需数小时。沉积可在多种导电基底上进行，并借助石英晶体微天平实时监测膜厚，形成具有可编程电容和离子嵌入动力学的氧化还原插层薄膜。该工作为均匀薄膜组装提供了节能、安全和快速的方法，厚度可控制在纳米分辨率。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及水相电泳沉积，施加电压为1 V；使用尺寸可控的MOF纳米粒子，并考察粒径、本征表面电荷密度和溶剂性质对电泳迁移率的影响；通过ζ电位和电泳迁移率分析沉积行为；在多种导电基底上进行沉积；采用石英晶体微天平实时监测薄膜厚度；形成氧化还原插层薄膜并评估其电容和离子嵌入动力学。其他合成与表征细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联框架材料组装与电化学合成主线，展示MOF纳米粒子在低电压水相电泳沉积中的组装策略，并强调膜厚实时监控与电化学功能调控，对介孔导电MOF及框架材料薄膜器件化具有参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告MOF具体组成、孔结构、导电性及电化学性能数值，是否值得全文精读取决于对低电压沉积和MOF薄膜电化学应用的关注程度。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。MOF具体组成、粒径分布、ζ电位数值、溶剂条件、基底种类、薄膜孔隙率、导电性、电容和离子嵌入动力学定量数据等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 在1 V水相中实现MOF纳米粒子电泳沉积，低于水电解阈值。
30分钟内可沉积厚度大于10微米、致密均匀的MOF薄膜。

可在多种导电基底上沉积，并通过石英晶体微天平实时监测膜厚，形成电容和离子嵌入动力学可编程的氧化还原插层薄膜。

papers.title: Ammonia‐Gated Guanyl Hydrazone Photoisomerization Enables Sequential Solid‐State Optical Response in Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Light‐driven molecular switches enable precise and noninvasive regulation of molecular structure and function, and thus represent fundamental building blocks for stimuli‐responsive photofunctional materials. However, translating molecular‐level photoswitching into sequence‐dependent macroscopic outputs in the solid state remains a formidable challenge. In this study, we report a supramolecular strategy that integrates guanyl hydrazone switches into hydrogen‐bonded organic frameworks (HOFs) to overcome this limitation. A tetrasulfonate‐substituted tetraphenylethylene anion ( TPE 4 − ) is employed as the host scaffold, while guanyl hydrazone ( G2 ) functions as the photoresponsive guest, affording a functional framework through cooperative assembly. This system leverages a reversible crystalline–amorphous phase transformation, triggered by acid–base stimuli, to gate the solid‐state photoisomerization of G2 . Upon activation, the configurational switching of G2 induces a cascade reorganization of the TPE 4 − packing motifs, leading to pronounced and sequence‐dependent modulation of both fluorescence and macroscopic coloration. In addition, the applicability of this system in information encryption has been demonstrated. This work expands the design paradigm of hydrazone‐based photoswitches in the solid state and provides a supramolecular strategy for constructing intelligent optical materials with high information density and enhanced security.

papers.title_zh: 氨门控脒基腙光异构化实现氢键有机框架中的顺序固态光学响应
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将脒基腙开关集成到氢键有机框架中，利用酸碱刺激触发的可逆晶态—非晶态相变门控固态光异构化。活化后G2构型切换诱导TPE4−堆积级联重组，实现荧光和宏观颜色的顺序依赖调制，并展示信息加密应用。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对分子级光开关难以在固态转化为序列依赖宏观输出的挑战，提出超分子策略，将脒基腙开关引入氢键有机框架。摘要明确以四磺酸取代四苯乙烯阴离子TPE4−作为主体支架，脒基腙G2作为光响应客体，通过协同组装形成功能框架。该系统利用酸碱刺激触发的可逆晶态—非晶态相变来门控G2的固态光异构化。活化后，G2的构型切换诱导TPE4−堆积基序的级联重组，导致荧光和宏观颜色的显著且序列依赖的调制。摘要还指出该体系在信息加密中具有应用展示。该工作拓展了腙基光开关在固态中的设计范式，并提供构建高信息密度和增强安全性智能光学材料的超分子策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用超分子协同组装策略，以四磺酸取代四苯乙烯阴离子TPE4−为主体支架，脒基腙G2为光响应客体，构建氢键有机框架。通过酸碱刺激触发可逆晶态—非晶态相变，门控G2的固态光异构化；光照诱导G2构型切换，并观察TPE4−堆积重组、荧光和宏观颜色变化。摘要还提及信息加密应用展示。具体合成条件、表征手段和性能测试细节摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于氢键有机框架与自组装技术交叉方向，展示通过主客体协同组装和相变门控实现固态光响应，对框架材料组装及刺激响应光学材料设计有参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告框架结构、光异构化波长、量子产率、响应速度和加密性能等关键数据，是否值得全文精读取决于对HOF光功能化和信息加密应用的关注程度。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。HOF具体结构、组装条件、酸碱刺激范围、光异构化波长与效率、荧光变化定量数据、相变可逆性、信息加密演示细节等仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过酸碱刺激触发的可逆晶态—非晶态相变，实现G2固态光异构化的门控。
G2构型切换诱导TPE4−堆积基序级联重组，产生荧光和宏观颜色的序列依赖调制。
该体系展示了在信息加密中的应用。
摘要未报告相应定量光学数据、相变条件及循环稳定性数据。

papers.title: Engineering van der Waals Heterojunctions Within a 2D Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Framework for Boosting CO 2 Electroreduction
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Unlike conventional strategies that regulate charge transport in framework electrocatalysts by modifying covalent skeletons or compositions, we demonstrate efficient directional electron transfer by constructing interlayer van der Waals donor–acceptor (D–A) heterojunctions within a hydrogen‐bonded organic frameworks (HOFs). The porphyrin‐based HOF, PFC‐45‐Co, is assembled from electron‐donating 5,10,15,20‐tetra(4‐carboxyphenyl)porphyrin (Co‐TPyP) and electron‐accepting cobalt 5,10,15,20‐tetra(4‐carboxyphenyl)porphyrin (Co‐TCPP) through strong O─H···N hydrogen bonds, while periodic alternating interlayer π–π stacking generates vertical D–A heterojunctions. Mechanistic studies show that close π–π contacts enable through‐space charge transport, and the D–A energy offset drives electron transfer from Co‐TPyP to Co‐TCPP, producing electron‐enriched Co‐TCPP sites that promote CO 2 activation and suppress hydrogen evolution. As a result, PFC‐45‐Co outperforms the single‐component HOF PFC‐72‐Co in both neutral and acidic media. In neutral electrolyte, PFC‐45‐Co delivers a CO Faradaic efficiency (FE CO ) of 98.4% at −0.9 V versus reversible hydrogen electrode (vs. RHE) and a CO partial current density ( j CO ) of 31.3 mA cm −2 at −1.2 V versus RHE. In acidic media, it maintains FE CO values of 92%–99% and achieves j CO of 111.1 mA cm −2 at −1.6 V versus RHE. This work establishes interlayer van der Waals D–A heterojunctions as an effective motif for regulating charge transfer in HOF electrocatalysts.

papers.title_zh: 在二维氢键有机框架内构建范德华异质结以促进CO2电还原
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在卟啉基氢键有机框架PFC-45-Co中构建层间范德华供体—受体异质结，通过空间电荷传输和D–A能级偏移驱动电子从Co-TPyP向Co-TCPP转移，形成富电子Co-TCPP位点，促进CO2活化并抑制析氢，在中性和酸性介质中均优于单组分HOF。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究不同于通过修饰共价骨架或组成调控框架电催化剂电荷传输的传统策略，提出在氢键有机框架内构建层间范德华供体—受体异质结以实现定向电子转移。摘要明确卟啉基HOF PFC-45-Co由给电子5,10,15,20-四(4-羧基苯基)卟啉Co-TPyP和受电子钴5,10,15,20-四(4-羧基苯基)卟啉Co-TCPP通过强O─H···N氢键组装，周期性交替层间π–π堆叠产生垂直D–A异质结。机理研究表明，紧密π–π接触实现空间电荷传输，D–A能级偏移驱动电子从Co-TPyP转移到Co-TCPP，产生富电子Co-TCPP位点，促进CO2活化并抑制析氢。结果PFC-45-Co在中性和酸性介质中均优于单组分HOF PFC-72-Co。中性电解液中，−0.9 V vs. RHE时CO法拉第效率为98.4%，−1.2 V vs. RHE时CO分电流密度为31.3 mA cm−2；酸性介质中FE_CO保持92%–99%，−1.6 V vs. RHE时j_CO达111.1 mA cm−2。该工作确立层间范德华D–A异质结为调控HOF电催化剂电荷转移的有效基元。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确采用超分子组装构建卟啉基HOF PFC-45-Co，由Co-TPyP和Co-TCPP通过O─H···N氢键组装，并形成层间π–π堆叠D–A异质结。通过机理研究分析空间电荷传输和D–A能级偏移驱动的电子转移。电化学性能在中性和酸性电解液中测试，以CO法拉第效率、CO分电流密度和析氢抑制为指标，并与单组分HOF PFC-72-Co对比。具体合成条件、结构表征和原位机理手段摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭/氢键有机框架、框架材料组装及电化学合成主线，展示在HOF内构建层间范德华D–A异质结以调控电荷传输和CO2电还原性能，对导电框架电催化剂设计具有参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告HOF孔结构、导电率、活性位点密度和长期稳定性等关键数据，是否值得全文精读取决于对HOF电催化及异质结电荷调控的关注程度。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。HOF晶体结构、孔道参数、合成条件、导电性、原位表征证据、电化学测试细节、稳定性及酸性介质中具体pH等仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: PFC-45-Co由Co-TPyP和Co-TCPP通过O─H···N氢键组装，层间π–π堆叠形成垂直D–A异质结。
D–A能级偏移驱动电子从Co-TPyP转移到Co-TCPP，产生富电子Co-TCPP位点，促进CO2活化并抑制析氢。
中性电解液中，−0.9 V vs. RHE时FE_CO为98.4%，−1.2 V vs. RHE时j_CO为31.3 mA cm−2。
酸性介质中FE_CO为92%–99%，−1.6 V vs. RHE时j_CO为111.1 mA cm−2，性能优于单组分HOF PFC-72-Co。

papers.title: Cyclodextrin‐Directed Assembly of Dynamic Polyoxometalate Pseudo‐Rotaxanes
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Cyclodextrins (CDs) are widely used as host molecules in supramolecular chemistry, yet their capacity to actively direct structural reorganization of inorganic clusters remains largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that α ‐CD can direct inorganic cluster reorganization during self‐assembly, enabling the synthesis of previously inaccessible azobenzene‐functionalized polyoxometalate (POM) pseudo‐rotaxanes, in which the macrocycle not only encapsulates the organic axle but also governs the structural evolution of the inorganic core. Upon complexation with α ‐CD, a flat arsonate‐functionalized {Mo 6 } cluster reorganizes into a bent analogue, yielding a dynamic pseudo ‐rotaxane assembly ( 1a @ α ‐CD). Fine pH modulation subsequently induces a CD‐mediated transformation into an inverted‐Keggin {Mo 12 } pseudo ‐rotaxane threaded by four α ‐CD units. NMR/ITC titration, DOSY/NOESY analyses, and single‐crystal x‐ray diffraction collectively reveal dual threading pathways and delineate the dynamic {Mo 6 } to {Mo 12 } reorganization process. Crucially, α ‐CD suppresses precipitation of hydrophobic ligands under strongly acidic conditions and stabilizes transient coordination states, thereby enabling cluster growth pathways inaccessible under identical synthetic conditions in the absence of α ‐CD. These findings demonstrate that CDs can actively direct inorganic self‐assembly through host‐guest interactions, providing a supramolecular route to previously inaccessible POM pseudo ‐rotaxanes and opening new opportunities for adaptive hybrid architectures.

papers.title_zh: 环糊精导向的动态多金属氧酸盐准轮烷组装
papers.summary_zh: 该研究证明α-环糊精可在自组装过程中主动导向无机簇结构重组，合成出此前难以获得的偶氮苯功能化多金属氧酸盐准轮烷，并揭示从{Mo6}到{Mo12}的动态转化路径及双重穿线机制。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于环糊精虽广泛用作超分子主体，但其主动导向无机簇结构重组的能力尚未被充分探索。作者以α-环糊精为主体，以偶氮苯功能化的多金属氧酸盐为客体，发现α-环糊精不仅能包结有机轴，还能调控无机核的结构演化。与α-环糊精络合后，扁平的砷酸功能化{Mo6}簇重排为弯曲类似物，形成动态准轮烷组装体1a@α-CD。精细pH调控进一步诱导环糊精介导的转化，生成由四个α-环糊精穿线的倒Keggin型{Mo12}准轮烷。该工作表明环糊精可通过主客体相互作用主动导向无机自组装，为构建自适应杂化结构提供了超分子路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：自组装合成、pH调控转化、NMR/ITC滴定、DOSY/NOESY分析以及单晶X射线衍射。摘要未报告具体合成温度、浓度、溶剂体系、产率及电化学或导电性测试等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于超分子导向的无机簇自组装，与框架材料组装和动态结构调控主线相关，展示了主体分子主动导向无机核结构演化的策略。但其体系为多金属氧酸盐准轮烷，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或电化学合成，直接借鉴有限。若关注主客体导向组装与动态转化机制，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属于摘要级解读。具体合成条件、产率、晶体学参数、热力学常数、pH范围及稳定性数据等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: α-环糊精可导向扁平砷酸功能化{Mo6}簇重排为弯曲类似物，形成动态准轮烷1a@α-CD。
精细pH调控可诱导环糊精介导的转化，生成由四个α-环糊精穿线的倒Keggin型{Mo12}准轮烷。
NMR/ITC滴定、DOSY/NOESY分析和单晶X射线衍射共同揭示了双重穿线路径及{Mo6}到{Mo12}的动态重组过程。
α-环糊精可抑制强酸性条件下疏水配体的沉淀并稳定瞬态配位状态，从而开启无α-环糊精时无法实现的簇生长路径。

papers.title: Stepped‐Dimensional 2D/3D Tin‐Based Perovskites for High‐Efficiency Light‐Emitting Diodes
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tin (Sn)‐based perovskite near‐infrared (NIR) light‐emitting diodes (LEDs) show great potential for applications in night vision, biomedical sensing, and optical communications. However, their performance remains limited by uncontrolled crystallization and the facile oxidation of Sn 2+ . Here, we demonstrate a versatile buried‐interlayer strategy to effectively regulate the crystallization and suppress the Sn 2+ oxidation by constructing a two‐dimensional/three‐dimensional (2D/3D) heterodimensional structure. We reveal that strong interactions between the buried ligand layer, the perovskite precursor, and the underlying hole‐transport layer promote rapid nucleation, retard crystal growth, and induce a vertical dimensional gradient, leading to reduced defect density and enhanced radiative recombination. As a result, NIR Sn‐based perovskite LEDs achieve a record external quantum efficiency of 13.7% with a radiance of 103 W sr −1 m −2 . Furthermore, the buried‐interlayer strategy enables dual‐functional Sn‐based perovskite devices capable of both efficient light emission and photodetection, which are successfully integrated into a compact heart‐pulse monitoring system. Our work suggests a synergistic crystallization and dimensional‐regulation strategy for achieving high‐performance Sn‐based perovskite optoelectronic devices.

papers.title_zh: 阶梯维度2D/3D锡基钙钛矿用于高效发光二极管
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用埋入中间层策略构建2D/3D异维结构，调控锡基钙钛矿结晶并抑制Sn2+氧化，使近红外LED外量子效率达13.7%，并实现发光与光电探测双功能及心率监测集成。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于锡基钙钛矿近红外LED受限于不可控结晶和Sn2+易氧化。作者提出一种通用的埋入中间层策略，通过构建二维/三维异维结构来调控结晶并抑制Sn2+氧化。埋入配体层、钙钛矿前驱体与底层空穴传输层之间的强相互作用促进快速成核、延缓晶体生长并诱导垂直维度梯度，从而降低缺陷密度并增强辐射复合。所得近红外锡基钙钛矿LED获得13.7%的纪录外量子效率和103 W sr−1 m−2的辐射亮度。该策略还使器件兼具高效发光和光电探测功能，并成功集成到紧凑型心率监测系统中。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：埋入中间层策略构建2D/3D异维结构、结晶调控、Sn2+氧化抑制、LED器件制备与性能测试、光电探测测试以及心率监测系统集成。摘要未报告具体前驱体配比、退火条件、器件结构层参数及表征手段细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作聚焦锡基钙钛矿发光二极管，与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架、框架材料组装及电化学合成主线关联较弱，仅在结晶调控和维度调控策略上具有方法学参考价值。若关注异维结构构建与缺陷抑制策略，可选择性阅读；对框架材料电化学方向直接价值有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属于摘要级解读。具体前驱体组成、埋入层材料、退火温度、器件结构、稳定性数据及表征细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 埋入中间层策略构建2D/3D异维结构，可调控结晶并抑制Sn2+氧化。
近红外锡基钙钛矿LED实现13.7%的纪录外量子效率和103 W sr−1 m−2的辐射亮度。
埋入配体层、前驱体与空穴传输层间的强相互作用促进快速成核、延缓晶体生长并诱导垂直维度梯度，降低缺陷密度并增强辐射复合。
该策略使器件兼具高效发光和光电探测双功能，并成功集成到紧凑型心率监测系统中。

papers.title: Interface-guided twisted stacking of two-dimensional organic molecular crystals for polarization-reoriented emission
papers.abstract: Abstract The controlled vertical assembly of organic molecular crystals remains challenging because weak intermolecular interactions often lead to random nucleation and unpredictable stacking orientations. Here we report an interface-guided vapor-phase assembly strategy for constructing stacked two-dimensional organic molecular crystals with controlled stacking geometry and layer thickness. This approach enables two distinct stacking modes: lattice-matched parallel heterostacking in DPQ-DPFQ crystals (P-OCs) and energetically favored 80° twisted homostacking in DPFQ bilayers (T-OCs), with T-OCs accounting for 54.3 ± 3.8% of the counted crystals across six independent substrates under optimized growth conditions. The fixed-angle twisted stacking couples misaligned optical axes from adjacent layers, producing lateral and vertical waveguide resonance coupling and thickness-programmed polarization reorientation. By increasing the upper layer thickness from 530 to 935 nm, the output polarization angle is continuously shifted from 45° to 74°. This work establishes molecular interface-guided twisting as a structural strategy for encoding passive polarization outputs in organic crystalline photonic materials.

papers.title_zh: 界面导向的二维有机分子晶体扭转堆叠用于偏振重定向发射
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道界面导向气相组装策略，构建堆叠二维有机分子晶体，实现平行异质堆叠和80度扭转同质堆叠两种模式，并通过层厚调控使输出偏振角从45度连续偏移至74度。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题在于有机分子晶体的可控垂直组装因分子间弱相互作用常导致随机成核和不可预测的堆叠取向。作者报道一种界面导向气相组装策略，用于构建具有可控堆叠几何和层厚的堆叠二维有机分子晶体。该方法实现两种堆叠模式：DPQ-DPFQ晶体中的晶格匹配平行异质堆叠（P-OCs）和DPFQ双层中能量 favored 的80度扭转同质堆叠（T-OCs），在优化生长条件下T-OCs占六个独立基底上计数晶体的54.3 ± 3.8%。固定角度扭转堆叠耦合相邻层错位的光轴，产生横向和垂直波导共振耦合以及厚度编程的偏振重定向。将上层厚度从530 nm增至935 nm，输出偏振角从45度连续偏移至74度。该工作确立了分子界面导向扭转作为有机晶态光子材料中编码被动偏振输出的结构策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：界面导向气相组装策略、优化生长条件、晶体计数统计、层厚调控以及偏振发射测试。摘要未报告具体基底类型、生长温度、气相源参数、晶体表征手段及波导耦合的详细测试条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于有机分子晶体的界面导向组装与堆叠取向调控，与自组装技术和框架材料组装主线有一定方法学关联，尤其在界面导向成核和堆叠几何控制方面具有参考价值。但其体系为有机分子晶体光子材料，不涉及MOF、COF、HOF或电化学合成。若关注界面导向组装与偏振光学调控，可全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属于摘要级解读。具体基底材料、生长条件、晶体结构解析、波导耦合机制及偏振测试细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 界面导向气相组装可实现两种堆叠模式：DPQ-DPFQ晶体中的晶格匹配平行异质堆叠和DPFQ双层中的80度扭转同质堆叠。
在优化生长条件下，T-OCs占六个独立基底上计数晶体的54.3 ± 3.8%。
固定角度扭转堆叠耦合相邻层错位光轴，产生横向和垂直波导共振耦合及厚度编程的偏振重定向。
上层厚度从530 nm增至935 nm时，输出偏振角从45度连续偏移至74度。

papers.title: Janus Covalent Organic Framework Films With Macroscopic Directional Carrier Migration for Switchable Gas Sensing
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Macroscopic directional migration of photogenerated carriers in covalent organic framework (COF)‐based heterojunction films is typically hindered by random carrier diffusion and interfacial structural disorder. In this study, we report for the first time the construction of sequence‐controlled Janus COF films from lattice‐matched isoreticular COFs (COF‐366/COF‐366‐OH). The intimate interfacial assembly and the energy‐level offset induce a built‐in electric field that drives electrons and holes to migrate directionally toward opposite sides across the entire film. This asymmetric charge distribution endows the two sides of the film with distinct redox activities, enabling switchable and highly sensitive detection of both oxidizing and reducing gases by simply flipping the film. Such a unique feature is unprecedented for a single film. Moreover, the response of Janus COF film surpasses that of single‐component counterparts by 5.2‐fold for NO 2 and 5.3‐fold for NH 3 . This work offers a general strategy for macroscopic directional carrier migration in COF films and paves a new route for advanced sensing materials.

papers.title_zh: 具有宏观定向载流子迁移的Janus共价有机框架薄膜用于可切换气体传感
papers.summary_zh: 该研究首次构建了由晶格匹配的同构COF（COF-366/COF-366-OH）组成的序列可控Janus COF薄膜，利用界面紧密组装和能级偏移产生的内建电场驱动电子与空穴在整个薄膜中定向迁移至相反两侧，实现可切换的高灵敏氧化性与还原性气体检测，响应较单组分提升5倍以上。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对COF基异质结薄膜中光生载流子因随机扩散和界面结构无序而难以实现宏观定向迁移的问题，首次提出构建序列可控的Janus COF薄膜。材料体系选用晶格匹配的同构COF（COF-366与COF-366-OH），通过紧密的界面组装和能级偏移形成内建电场，驱动电子和空穴在整个薄膜中分别向相反两侧定向迁移。这种不对称电荷分布赋予薄膜两侧不同的氧化还原活性，使得仅通过翻转薄膜即可实现对氧化性和还原性气体的可切换、高灵敏检测。该特征在单一薄膜中前所未有。研究意义在于为COF薄膜中宏观定向载流子迁移提供了通用策略，并为先进传感材料开辟了新路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：构建序列可控Janus COF薄膜，采用晶格匹配的同构COF（COF-366/COF-366-OH）进行界面组装；通过能级偏移形成内建电场；通过翻转薄膜进行可切换气体传感测试，检测氧化性气体NO2和还原性气体NH3，并比较Janus薄膜与单组分对应物的响应。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征手段及器件制备细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF薄膜的组装与功能化主线，首次在单一COF薄膜中实现宏观定向载流子迁移和可切换气体传感，对框架材料组装及电化学/传感应用具有重要参考价值。其策略可推广至其他框架薄膜体系。局限在于摘要未报告合成细节、稳定性及选择性数据，值得全文精读以评估普适性。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征手段、器件结构、选择性、稳定性及响应/恢复时间等关键细节，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 首次构建了由晶格匹配同构COF（COF-366/COF-366-OH）组成的序列可控Janus COF薄膜。
界面紧密组装与能级偏移诱导内建电场，驱动电子和空穴在整个薄膜中定向迁移至相反两侧。
不对称电荷分布赋予薄膜两侧不同氧化还原活性，通过翻转薄膜即可可切换、高灵敏检测氧化性和还原性气体。
Janus COF薄膜对NO2的响应较单组分对应物提升5.2倍，对NH3提升5.3倍。

papers.title: Nanoparticle-Mediated Synthesis of Single-Crystal Covalent Organic Frameworks of Uniform Size and Shape
papers.abstract: Abstract The synthesis of highly crystalline covalent organic frameworks (COFs) has recently been achieved, but strategies to obtain monodispersed single crystals of uniform size and shape remain elusive. Here, we show that simply adding silica nanoparticles (SiNPs) to a conventional solvothermal synthesis directs imine-based COFs (e.g., COF-300) to grow into monodispersed, polyhedral single-crystal microparticles. Our experiments suggest dual functions of these nanoparticles. They promote burst nucleation of COFs via monomer adsorption and, then, by adhering to the crystal surface, prevent crystal aggregation and nonclassical crystallization pathways. This nanoparticle-mediated strategy is compatible with common small-molecule modulation to tune COF morphologies and shapes while maintaining low size dispersity. The method also extends to other three-dimensional (3D) imine COFs, such as LZU-111 and LZU-79. Notably, the obtained microcrystals show excellent colloidal stability and can assemble into superstructures reflecting their anisotropic shape. This work paves the way for COF-based crystalline materials and applications where size and shape uniformity are essential.

papers.title: Mechanical Programming of Hollow DNA Nanocapsules Rewires In Vivo Trafficking
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT DNA nanostructures are programmable, biocompatible platforms for biomedicine; however, their mechanical properties are coupled to sequence and structural dimensions, limiting control over stiffness. Here, we report a paradigm shift from static design to mechanical engineering of DNA nanostructures. Using a nanoemulsion interfacial‐confined coordination assembly strategy, hollow DNA nanocapsules (HDCs) were constructed with mechanical properties decoupled from chemical identity, without hard templates. By tuning the nanoemulsion‐to‐DNA‐solution ratio, HDCs with sizes (∼160 nm) and surface charges (∼‐20 mV), yet adjustable shell thicknesses (8–72 nm) and Young's moduli (8–180 MPa), were achieved while preserving DNA function and enabling DNA to serve as scaffold and therapeutic cargo. Proteomic profiling revealed stiffness‐dependent remodeling of protein corona: soft HDCs enriched dysopsonins, whereas hard HDCs recruited complement and coagulation factors, producing a “corona switch” modulating pharmacokinetics and biodistribution. Consequently, soft HDCs exhibited prolonged circulation ( t 1/2 = 8.8 h vs 4.5 h), enhanced tumor accumulation (1.9‐fold higher at 8 h), reduced hepatic sequestration, and increased kidney distribution versus hard HDCs. As a proof of concept, antisense‐based HDCs provided evidence that mechanical softening improved in vivo therapeutic performance. This work establishes mechanical modulus as a programmable parameter and provides a framework for regulating protein corona formation and systemic fate.

papers.title_zh: 中空DNA纳米胶囊的力学编程重编程体内运输
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用纳米乳液界面限域配位组装策略，无硬模板构建了中空DNA纳米胶囊（HDCs），实现力学性能与化学身份解耦。通过调节纳米乳液与DNA溶液比例，获得尺寸约160 nm、表面电荷约-20 mV、壳厚度8–72 nm、杨氏模量8–180 MPa的HDCs，并揭示刚度依赖的蛋白冠重塑调控药代动力学和组织分布。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对DNA纳米结构力学性能与序列和结构尺寸耦合、刚度难以独立调控的问题，提出从静态设计转向力学工程的范式转变。采用纳米乳液界面限域配位组装策略，无硬模板构建中空DNA纳米胶囊（HDCs）。通过调节纳米乳液与DNA溶液的比例，在保持DNA功能和使DNA作为支架及治疗货物的情况下，获得尺寸约160 nm、表面电荷约-20 mV、壳厚度可调（8–72 nm）和杨氏模量可调（8–180 MPa）的HDCs。蛋白质组学分析揭示刚度依赖的蛋白冠重塑：软HDCs富集失调蛋白，硬HDCs招募补体和凝血因子，产生“冠开关”调节药代动力学和生物分布。软HDCs表现出延长循环（t1/2 = 8.8 h vs 4.5 h）、增强肿瘤积累（8 h时高1.9倍）、减少肝脏隔离和增加肾脏分布。作为概念验证，反义HDCs证明力学软化改善体内治疗性能。该工作确立力学模量为可编程参数，并提供调控蛋白冠形成和系统命运的框架。

papers.title: Non-Canonical Peptide Self-Assembly for Mitochondria-Specific Cargo Delivery
papers.abstract: Abstract Targeting mitochondria is a promising strategy for precision tumor therapy, yet ligand-free mitochondrial drug delivery remains challenging. Here, we report a minimalist, intrinsically mitochondria-targeting noncanonical tetrapeptide, X-GNNpY, comprising one glycine, two (S)-2-amino-3-(naphthalen-1-yl)-propanoic acid residues (N), and one phosphorylated tyrosine (pY). Without external targeting ligands, X-GNNpY selectively accumulates in tumor-cell mitochondria through enzyme-instructed self-assembly. Conjugating chlorambucil (CLB) yields CLB-GNNpY, which efficiently redirects CLB to mitochondria. CLB-GNNpY exhibits good cellular selectivity, induces mitochondrial stress and immunogenic cell death, promotes M1-like macrophage polarization, and markedly enhances antitumor phagocytosis. This proof-of-concept study establishes noncanonical peptide self-assembly as a ligand-free supramolecular strategy for mitochondrial drug delivery and immune modulation in tumor therapy.

papers.title: Hydrogen‐Bond Encoding in a Structurally Minimal Cyclochiral Monomer Enables Assembly of Large Cavities Displaying Supramolecular Isomerism
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Large, well‐defined molecular cavities are typically constructed from rigid covalent scaffolds, which can limit structural adaptability and increase synthetic complexity. Here, we introduce a hydrogen‐bond encoded supramolecular strategy that enables structurally minimal, flexible monomers to assemble into discrete fullerene‐binding capsules. The monomer combines intra‐ and intermolecular hydrogen‐bonding motifs that restrict conformational freedom, induce cyclochirality, and guide controlled self‐assembly into oligomeric or cyclic aggregates. Spectroscopic and crystallographic analyses show that guest‐induced self‐sorting with fullerenes drives the formation of homochiral tetrameric capsules with high binding affinity and distinct structural isomerism. X‐ray structures confirm compact host–guest complexes stabilized by cooperative hydrogen bonding and C─H···π interactions. This work demonstrates that minimal monomer design can encode complex supramolecular behaviour, providing an adaptive platform for molecular recognition, catalysis, and materials science.

papers.title: Selective Laser Sintering and Graphitization for Mono‐Matrix Unibody Fabrication of Integrated Stereo‐Circuit and Stereo‐Fluidic Wearable Electronics
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Wearable integrated electronic devices for biomedical, robotics, and sensing applications require greater compactness and functional complexity while maintaining wearability. However, seamlessly integrating electronic and microfluidic components remain challenging due to fabrication heterogeneity, material mismatches, and complex assembly requirements. In this study, we present an innovative selective laser sintering and graphitization (SLSG) 3D printing technology that enables seamless integration of 3D circuits (stereo‐circuits) and 3D fluidic channels (stereo‐fluidics). SLSG achieves unibody, autonomous mono‐matrix fabrication through adaptive photonic modulation of carbon‐rich precursors (e.g., polyetheretherketone (PEEK) powder), simultaneously creating insulating sintered structures and conductive graphitized patterns with conductivity up to 1,895 S/m, yielding 7.64‐fold higher electrochemical performance than classic glassy carbon electrodes (GCEs). Using SLSG, we fabricated a watch‐type wearable unibody multimodal microfluidic biosensor (UMMB) with integrated electrochemical biosensors for on‐body sweat metabolite monitoring. UMMB incorporates stereo‐circuits for sensing and signal routing, plus stereo‐fluidic channels for sweat respiration, achieving effective lactate and glucose sensing. The device demonstrates excellent sensitivities of 29.43 and 16.86 µA/mM for detecting lactate and glucose, respectively, while exhibiting nondetectable interference or circuit‐fluidic crosstalk. This novel SLSG 3D printing technology introduces a transformative unibody approach to fabricate multifunctional bioelectronic‐fluidic platform for integrated point‐of‐care devices, wearable sensors/biosensors, actuators, advanced theranostics, and personalized biomedical devices.

papers.title_zh: 选择性激光烧结与石墨化用于一体化立体电路与立体微流控可穿戴电子器件的单基质整体制造
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出选择性激光烧结与石墨化3D打印技术，以富碳前驱体为单一基质，同时构建绝缘烧结结构与导电石墨化图案，实现立体电路与立体微流控通道的无缝一体化制造，并制成可穿戴多模态微流控生物传感器用于汗液代谢物监测。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对可穿戴集成电子器件中电子与微流控组件因制造异质性、材料失配和复杂组装难以无缝集成的问题，该研究提出选择性激光烧结与石墨化3D打印技术。以富碳前驱体如聚醚醚酮粉末为原料，通过自适应光子调制，在单一基质中同时形成绝缘烧结结构和导电石墨化图案，实现整体自主制造。所得导电图案电导率最高达1895 S/m，电化学性能较经典玻碳电极提高7.64倍。利用该技术制备了手表型可穿戴整体多模态微流控生物传感器，集成电化学生物传感器用于体表汗液代谢物监测，包含用于传感和信号传输的立体电路以及用于汗液呼吸的立体微流控通道，实现对乳酸和葡萄糖的有效传感。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：选择性激光烧结与石墨化3D打印技术；以富碳前驱体如聚醚醚酮粉末为原料进行自适应光子调制；制备绝缘烧结结构与导电石墨化图案；电导率测试；电化学性能测试并与玻碳电极对比；制造手表型可穿戴整体多模态微流控生物传感器；集成电化学生物传感器进行体表汗液乳酸和葡萄糖传感测试；干扰和电路—微流控串扰评估。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料组装与电化学合成主线之外的拓展方向，但其单基质整体制造、激光诱导石墨化、导电图案与微流控一体化集成策略对导电框架材料的器件化组装和电化学界面构建具有方法学参考价值。局限在于材料体系为聚醚醚酮碳前驱体，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料。若关注激光直写导电材料与微流控电化学集成，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要级信息，未核查全文。摘要未报告SLSG的具体激光参数、石墨化机制细节、PEEK粉末粒径、器件长期稳定性、汗液实际检测条件及生物相容性等关键细节，均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: SLSG技术通过自适应光子调制富碳前驱体，在单一基质中同时形成绝缘烧结结构和导电石墨化图案，实现整体自主制造。
导电石墨化图案电导率最高达1895 S/m，电化学性能较经典玻碳电极提高7.64倍。
所制手表型可穿戴整体多模态微流控生物传感器对乳酸和葡萄糖的灵敏度分别为29.43和16.86 µA/mM。
该器件表现出不可检测的干扰或电路—微流控串扰。

papers.title: Hierarchical Ce-UiO-66 with tailored mesopores for efficient upgrading of biomass-derived carboxylic acids via ketonization
papers.abstract: The catalytic ketonization of bulky biomass-derived carboxylic acids is often restricted by internal diffusion resistance and insufficient accessible active sites over conventional CeO 2 and strictly microporous catalysts. In this study, hierarchically porous Ce-UiO-66 materials were synthesized using F127 as a soft template to optimize pore architecture and enhance mass transport. Compared with the original microporous Ce-UiO-66, the modified materials successfully introduced ∼ 8 nm mesopores, with the mesopore volume remarkably expanding to 0.312 cm 3 /g. This well-developed micro-mesoporous network not only overcomes mass transfer barriers, but also promotes the formation of abundant active sites, Ce 3+ species, and oxygen vacancies while improving thermal stability. Among all samples, Ce-UiO-(100), synthesized with 100 mg F127 in 6 mL H 2 O, displayed the highest Ce 3+ proportion (41.3 %) and the optimal thermal stability, attributed to optimal templating conditions that balance crystallinity and defect formation. Catalytic conversion of n-octanoic acid at 500 ℃ demonstrated that Ce-UiO-66 outperformed conventional CeO 2 , and mesoporosity further enhanced activity. Ce-UiO-(100) achieved the highest conversion (85.7 %) along with superior ketone and hydrocarbon yields, mainly producing 8-pentadecanone and 2-nonanone. The improved performance is attributed to a dual synergy: hierarchical micro-mesoporous channels alleviate steric hindrance for accelerated mass transfer, while Ce 3+ -O V Lewis acid-base pairs efficiently drive C–C coupling. This study offers novel insights into the rational design of catalysts for the deoxygenation of biomass-derived carboxylic acids via ketonization.
institutions: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences

papers.title_zh: 具有定制介孔的分级Ce-UiO-66用于生物质衍生羧酸经酮化反应高效升级
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以F127为软模板合成分级多孔Ce-UiO-66，引入约8 nm介孔并将介孔体积扩至0.312 cm3/g，通过微—介孔网络改善传质并促进Ce3+和氧空位形成，在正辛酸酮化反应中转化率达85.7%，优于传统CeO2和纯微孔Ce-UiO-66。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对大体积生物质衍生羧酸在传统CeO2和严格微孔催化剂上酮化反应受内扩散阻力和可接近活性位点不足限制的问题，该研究以F127为软模板合成分级多孔Ce-UiO-66材料，优化孔结构并增强传质。与原始微孔Ce-UiO-66相比，改性材料成功引入约8 nm介孔，介孔体积显著扩展至0.312 cm3/g。发达的微—介孔网络不仅克服传质障碍，还促进丰富活性位点、Ce3+物种和氧空位的形成，同时提高热稳定性。在所用样品中，以6 mL水中100 mg F127合成的Ce-UiO-(100)表现出最高Ce3+比例41.3%和最佳热稳定性。500 ℃下正辛酸催化转化表明Ce-UiO-66优于传统CeO2，介孔化进一步提升活性。Ce-UiO-(100)获得最高转化率85.7%以及优异的酮和烃产率，主要产物为8-十五酮和2-壬酮。性能提升归因于双重协同：分级微—介孔通道缓解位阻加速传质，Ce3+-OV路易斯酸碱对高效驱动C–C偶联。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以F127为软模板合成分级多孔Ce-UiO-66；通过改变F127用量调控孔结构，其中Ce-UiO-(100)为6 mL水中加入100 mg F127；表征介孔尺寸、介孔体积、Ce3+比例和热稳定性；在500 ℃下进行正辛酸催化酮化反应；与原始微孔Ce-UiO-66和传统CeO2对比催化性能；分析酮和烃产率及主要产物。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联介孔材料与框架材料主线，展示通过软模板在MOF中构建分级微—介孔结构以提升大分子底物传质和催化活性，对介孔导电MOF及框架材料的孔结构工程、缺陷调控和催化应用具有参考价值。局限在于Ce-UiO-66为绝缘MOF，未涉及导电性或电化学合成。若关注MOF介孔工程与生物质升级，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要级信息，未核查全文。摘要未报告F127模板去除条件、比表面积、孔径分布全貌、Ce3+和氧空位的具体表征手段、酮化反应选择性数值、催化剂循环稳定性及失活机制等关键细节，均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 以F127为软模板成功在Ce-UiO-66中引入约8 nm介孔，介孔体积扩展至0.312 cm3/g。
Ce-UiO-(100)具有最高Ce3+比例41.3%和最佳热稳定性。
500 ℃正辛酸酮化反应中Ce-UiO-(100)转化率达85.7%，主要产物为8-十五酮和2-壬酮。
性能提升源于分级微—介孔通道加速传质与Ce3+-OV路易斯酸碱对驱动C–C偶联的双重协同。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Integration: Design Principles for Advanced Liquid Crystal Elastomers With Spatially Programmable Properties and Functionalities
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Liquid crystal elastomers (LCEs) uniquely merge liquid crystal anisotropy with rubbery elasticity, positioning them as cornerstone materials for soft actuators. As the field is progressing from laboratory demonstrations toward practical applications in soft robotics and biomedical devices, it is moving beyond the simple, uniform deformations toward advanced spatially programmable properties and integrated functionalities. The design principles underlying these advances lie in heterogeneous integration, defined as the intentional spatial design of chemical, structural, or orientational differences across a unified LCE system, permitting precise programming of differentiated actuation directions, mechanical gradients, and sequential responsiveness unattainable in homogeneous LCEs. Heterogeneous integration pervades almost all advances in alignment techniques, network engineering, and device assembly. This review categorizes the diverse achievements into three hierarchical strategies: heterogeneity in orientation, heterogeneity in polymer network architecture, and heterogeneous modular assembly. We systematically summarize the mechanistic origins, achievable precision, and functional outputs of each approach. Furthermore, we outline future directions from discrete patterning to continuous gradients, from single‐dimensional to multidimensional integration, and from static programming to adaptive evolution. This review establishes a coherent conceptual blueprint to guide the rational design of next‐generation intelligent LCE systems.

papers.title_zh: 异质集成：具有空间可编程性质和功能性的先进液晶弹性体设计原则
papers.summary_zh: 该综述提出异质集成为液晶弹性体空间可编程性质与功能化的核心设计原则，将相关进展归纳为取向异质性、聚合物网络结构异质性和异质模块化组装三类层级策略，系统总结其机制起源、可实现精度与功能输出，并展望从离散图案到连续梯度等未来方向。
papers.research_details_zh: 液晶弹性体独特地结合液晶各向异性与橡胶弹性，是软执行器的基石材料。随着该领域从实验室演示走向软机器人和生物医学器件实际应用，研究正从简单均匀变形转向先进的空间可编程性质和集成功能。其设计原则在于异质集成，即在统一液晶弹性体系统中有意进行化学、结构或取向差异的空间设计，从而精确编程均质液晶弹性体无法实现的差异化驱动方向、力学梯度和顺序响应性。异质集成几乎贯穿取向技术、网络工程和器件组装的所有进展。该综述将多样成果归纳为三类层级策略：取向异质性、聚合物网络结构异质性和异质模块化组装，系统总结每种方法的机制起源、可实现精度和功能输出。此外，展望了从离散图案到连续梯度、从单维到多维集成、从静态编程到自适应演化的未来方向，为下一代智能液晶弹性体系统的理性设计建立连贯的概念蓝图。
papers.methods_zh: 该文为综述，摘要未报告具体实验合成、组装、表征或性能测试方法。摘要明确出现的内容为对液晶弹性体异质集成相关成果的分类归纳与机制、精度和功能输出的系统总结，以及未来方向展望。具体文献筛选标准、覆盖范围及各类策略的详细案例摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料主线关联较弱，但其异质集成、空间可编程组装和异质模块化组装概念对框架材料的有序组装与功能集成具有概念借鉴意义。局限在于材料体系为液晶弹性体，不涉及框架材料或电化学合成。若关注软执行器与可编程组装设计原则，可全文精读；若聚焦框架材料，则相关性有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要级信息，未核查全文。摘要未报告具体液晶弹性体化学组成、取向技术参数、网络工程方法、器件性能数值、精度量化指标及所引案例细节，均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 异质集成被定义为在统一液晶弹性体系统中有意空间设计化学、结构或取向差异，以实现差异化驱动方向、力学梯度和顺序响应性。
该综述将液晶弹性体异质集成策略归纳为三类层级策略：取向异质性、聚合物网络结构异质性和异质模块化组装。
综述系统总结了每种策略的机制起源、可实现精度和功能输出。
未来方向包括从离散图案到连续梯度、从单维到多维集成、从静态编程到自适应演化。

papers.title: Unlocking d–p Orbital Coupling via Built‐in Electric Fields for High‐Performance Hydrazine Hydrate Fuel Cell
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Direct hydrazine fuel cells (DHzFCs) offer a promising carbon‐free liquid‐fuel route for power generation, yet progress is limited by sluggish hydrazine oxidation reaction (HzOR) kinetics and the high cost of Pt catalysts. In this work, we tune the built‐in electric field (BIEF) at the Pt@MOF interface via linker‐directed defect engineering. Partial substitution of 1,1′‐ferrocenedicarboxylic acid (Fc) with ferrocene–carboxylic acid (Fc') generates graded ligand‐defect and undercoordinated Ni─O environments, thereby regulating Pt anchoring and interfacial charge redistribution. The optimized Pt@NiFc 0.95 Fc' 0.05 ‐MOF delivers 1000 mA cm–2 for HER (180 mV, overpotential) and 2000 mA cm–2 for HzOR (346 mV, working potential), outperforming Pt/C while achieving 99% hydrazine conversion. The assembled direct hydrazine hydrate–hydrogen peroxide fuel cell (DHHPFC) delivers a peak power density of 441 mW cm −2 at 80°C. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations and experimental analyses reveal that the oxygen‐mediated Pt─O─Ni interfacial electronic pathway, enhanced apparent BIEF, and accelerated interfacial charge transfer in Pt@NiFc 0.95 Fc' 0.05 ‐MOF, accounts for the improved catalytic and fuel‐cell performance. This work establishes a linker‐defect strategy for constructing Pt‐utilization‐efficient interfaces for hydrazine energy conversion.

papers.title_zh: 通过内建电场解锁d–p轨道耦合实现高性能水合肼燃料电池
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过配体缺陷工程调控Pt@MOF界面内建电场，以部分Fc'取代Fc构建梯度配体缺陷和不饱和Ni─O环境，优化Pt锚定与界面电荷再分布。最优材料在HER和HzOR中均优于Pt/C，组装的水合肼-过氧化氢燃料电池峰值功率密度达441 mW cm⁻²。
papers.research_details_zh: 直接水合肼燃料电池（DHzFCs）作为无碳液体燃料发电路线具有前景，但受限于肼氧化反应（HzOR）动力学迟缓和Pt催化剂高成本。本研究在Pt@MOF界面通过配体导向缺陷工程调控内建电场（BIEF）。具体策略是用二茂铁羧酸（Fc'）部分取代1,1'-二茂铁二甲酸（Fc），在NiFc-MOF中生成梯度配体缺陷和不饱和Ni─O环境，从而调节Pt锚定和界面电荷再分布。优化后的Pt@NiFc0.95Fc'0.05-MOF在HER中达到1000 mA cm⁻²（过电位180 mV），在HzOR中达到2000 mA cm⁻²（工作电位346 mV），优于Pt/C并实现99%肼转化率。组装的水合肼-过氧化氢燃料电池（DHHPFC）在80°C下峰值功率密度为441 mW cm⁻²。DFT计算和实验分析表明，氧介导的Pt─O─Ni界面电子通路、增强的表观BIEF以及加速的界面电荷转移是性能提升的原因。该工作建立了配体缺陷策略以构建高效利用Pt的界面用于肼能源转化。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：通过配体导向缺陷工程，用二茂铁羧酸（Fc'）部分取代1,1'-二茂铁二甲酸（Fc）合成Pt@NiFc0.95Fc'0.05-MOF；进行HER和HzOR电化学性能测试；组装水合肼-过氧化氢燃料电池并测试峰值功率密度；采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算结合实验分析研究界面电子结构和电荷转移。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段和测试参数等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于MOF基框架材料在电催化与燃料电池中的应用，核心策略为配体缺陷工程调控MOF界面内建电场以优化Pt催化位点，与介孔导电MOF及框架材料电化学合成主线相关。其配体缺陷调控界面电子结构的思路对框架材料组装和电化学应用有参考价值。但该研究侧重Pt@MOF催化界面而非MOF本征导电性或介孔结构，与介孔导电MOF主线关联有限。摘要未报告MOF孔结构或导电性数据，建议根据对MOF界面催化兴趣决定是否精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告MOF的孔结构、比表面积、导电性、合成条件、表征手段细节及DFT计算具体参数等关键信息，这些细节需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 优化后的Pt@NiFc0.95Fc'0.05-MOF在HER中达到1000 mA cm⁻²（过电位180 mV），在HzOR中达到2000 mA cm⁻²（工作电位346 mV），优于Pt/C，肼转化率达99%。
组装的水合肼-过氧化氢燃料电池在80°C下峰值功率密度为441 mW cm⁻²。
DFT计算和实验分析揭示氧介导的Pt─O─Ni界面电子通路、增强的表观内建电场和加速的界面电荷转移是性能提升的原因。
配体缺陷工程通过Fc'部分取代Fc生成梯度配体缺陷和不饱和Ni─O环境，调控Pt锚定和界面电荷再分布。

papers.title: Gas-permeable and stretchable nanoscale anisotropic conductive film for room-temperature, pressure-free interconnections
papers.abstract: As stretchable electronics advance in functionality and application scope, interconnection technologies have become critical. Devices in wearable and soft-robotic systems require thinness, stretchability, gas permeability, and damage-free bonding conditions. Accordingly, interconnection technologies must exhibit similar properties without compromising device performance. Conventional interconnection approaches rarely satisfy these requirements simultaneously owing to constraints such as typical thickness of several micrometers, low gas permeability, and the requirement for harsh bonding conditions (heat, pressure, or ultraviolet). This study presents an ultrathin, highly stretchable, gas-permeable nanoscale anisotropic conductive film (ACF) enabling damage-free bonding. The proposed ACF consists of patterned disks of silver nanowires infiltrated with styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer. The resulting nanoscale film (∼300-nanometer thickness) exhibits mechanical and electrical stretchability exceeding 500% strain with a water vapor transmission rate of 1200 grams per square meter per day. A bonding process based on liquid volatilization enables conformal adhesion to uneven surfaces without heat or external pressure, allowing device-to-skin and device-to-device interconnections. Light-emitting diodes integrated with stretchable wiring (500-micrometer pitch) using the proposed ACF maintained electrical conduction and interwire insulation even under 500% strain.
