papers.title_zh: 氢键有机框架光催化剂用于氮原子插入构建异喹啉
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过氢键自组装制备HOF纳米材料，在可见光和1 atm O2条件下高效催化氮原子插入反应合成异喹啉，八次循环无明显活性损失；HOF的高氧化电位使其耐受缺电子底物，光生电子还原O2生成的O2•–是C=C键断裂的关键活性氧物种。
papers.research_details_zh: 向双键中插入氮原子是构建异喹啉骨架的高效策略。目前已报道的光催化策略受限于均相光敏剂氧化电位低，仅适用于缺电子底物。本文通过氢键自组装制备了一种HOF纳米材料，表现出良好的催化活性和可回收性。在可见光照射和1 atm O2条件下，HOF高效促进氮插入反应合成异喹啉，八次回收后无明显活性损失。由于HOF具有高氧化电位，可耐受缺电子底物。进一步研究证实，由光生电子还原O2生成的O2•–是C=C键断裂的关键活性氧物种。该工作为通过氮原子插入合成异喹啉提供了一种高效且可回收的HOF纳米光催化剂。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及：通过氢键自组装制备HOF纳米材料；在可见光照射和1 atm O2条件下进行光催化氮原子插入反应合成异喹啉；进行循环回收实验（八次）；研究底物适用范围（缺电子底物）；通过进一步研究确认O2•–为关键活性氧物种。摘要未报告具体单体结构、自组装条件、表征手段及光催化性能数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接属于HOF框架材料与自组装技术主线，其氢键自组装制备HOF纳米光催化剂、高氧化电位调控底物适用范围及活性氧物种机制，对共轭框架材料的光催化应用有实际参考价值。摘要未涉及介孔结构、导电性或电化学合成，但HOF的可回收性与氮插入反应设计值得全文精读以获取单体与组装细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告HOF单体结构、自组装条件、孔结构/比表面积、表征手段、光催化产率及氧化电位数值等关键信息，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 通过氢键自组装制备HOF纳米材料，在可见光和1 atm O2条件下高效催化氮原子插入反应合成异喹啉，八次回收后无明显活性损失。
HOF的高氧化电位使其能够耐受缺电子底物，突破均相光敏剂低氧化电位的限制。
光生电子还原O2生成的O2•–是C=C键断裂的关键活性氧物种。

papers.title: Deterministic Patterning and Alignment of Tellurium Quantum Wires Using Nanoscale Templates
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tellurium (Te) is an intriguing one‐dimensional (1D) semiconductor that has recently attracted considerable interest as a p ‐type channel material. However, scalable synthesis methods have lacked control over the orientation and patterning of the Te atomic chains, thus limiting its practical use. Guided by theory, we overcome this challenge using nanowire‐shaped templates to achieve oriented, single‐crystal growth of Te on amorphous substrates. Strong alignment of Te atomic chains is achieved as template widths are reduced to sub‐20 nm. This high structural order, confirmed by 4D scanning transmission electron microscopy, enables the observation of pristine quantum transport phenomena for deterministically patterned Te. Field‐effect transistors exhibit well‐defined conductance plateaus at 77 K due to the population of individual 1D subbands. Furthermore, Coulomb blockade emerges at 1.7 K, with the Te channel acting as a gate‐tunable quantum dot. This synthesis approach provides a scalable pathway for integration of Te‐based quantum materials for future electronic and quantum technologies.

papers.title_zh: 利用纳米模板实现碲量子线的确定性图案化与取向排列
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用纳米线形模板，在非晶基底上实现碲的单晶定向生长与确定性图案化。当模板宽度降至20纳米以下时，碲原子链高度取向。4D扫描透射电镜确认结构有序，场效应晶体管在77K呈现一维子带电导平台，1.7K出现库仑阻塞，表明碲通道可作为栅极可调量子点。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对碲作为一维p型半导体沟道材料时，可规模化合成方法缺乏对碲原子链取向与图案化控制的问题。在理论指导下，采用纳米线形模板，在非晶基底上实现碲的定向单晶生长。当模板宽度减小至20纳米以下时，碲原子链获得强取向排列。通过4D扫描透射电子显微镜确认了高结构有序性，并据此观察到确定性图案化碲的本征量子输运现象。所制备的场效应晶体管在77K下因单个一维子带被占据而表现出明确的电导平台；在1.7K下出现库仑阻塞，碲沟道表现为栅极可调量子点。该合成方法为未来电子与量子技术中碲基量子材料的集成提供了可规模化路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：在理论指导下使用纳米线形模板，在非晶基底上进行碲的定向单晶生长；通过4D扫描透射电子显微镜确认结构有序性；制备场效应晶体管并进行低温电学输运测试，测试温度为77K和1.7K，观察到电导平台与库仑阻塞。摘要未报告模板具体材质、合成温度、前驱体、器件制备细节及更多表征手段。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于纳米模板引导的晶体生长与确定性图案化，与自组装技术及框架材料组装主线并非直接同一体系，但在一维单晶定向生长、模板限域取向控制和量子输运验证方面具有方法学参考价值。其局限在于研究对象为碲量子线而非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料，且摘要未涉及电化学合成。若关注模板诱导取向生长与量子器件集成，可全文精读；若聚焦框架材料本身，则相关性有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目与摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告模板具体材质与尺寸分布、合成温度与前驱体、基底类型、器件结构、电学测试细节、4D扫描透射电子显微镜具体参数及理论计算内容，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 当模板宽度减小至20纳米以下时，碲原子链实现强取向排列。
4D扫描透射电子显微镜确认了碲的高结构有序性。
场效应晶体管在77K下因单个一维子带被占据而呈现明确的电导平台。
在1.7K下出现库仑阻塞，碲沟道表现为栅极可调量子点。

papers.title: Rational Construction of Fluoride Crystals With Record Birefringence via Water‐Regulated Hydrogen‐Bond Network Reconfiguration
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Birefringent crystals are central to optical polarization modulation. However, combining wide bandgap and ultrahigh birefringence (Δ n ≥ 1.0) is challenging due to the trade‐off between optical anisotropy and transparency. Herein, we report three molecular crystals: (C 10 H 10 N 2 )SiF 6 , (C 12 H 9 N 2 ) 2 SiF 6 , and (C 12 H 9 N 2 ) 2 SiF 6 ·2H 2 O, which are constructed from organic π‐conjugated units and rigid inorganic [SiF 6 ] 2− units via a hydrogen‐bond‐mediated co‐assembly strategy. Structural analysis reveals the organic moieties of the three compounds adopt parallel arrangements via synergistic [SiF 6 ] 2− skeletons and hydrogen bonds. Notably, water incorporation in (C 12 H 9 N 2 ) 2 SiF 6 ·2H 2 O reconstructs the hydrogen‐bond network into a binary N–H···O/O–H···F system, prompting [C 12 H 9 N 2 ] + cations to align more coplanarly relative to the optical axis plane, which endows (C 12 H 9 N 2 ) 2 SiF 6 ·2H 2 O with an outstanding birefringence of 1.121@546 nm. Although the highly delocalized π‐electron system of the [C 12 H 9 N 2 ] + cation leads to smallest bandgap of (C 12 H 9 N 2 ) 2 SiF 6 ·2H 2 O among the three materials, its bandgap of 3.21 eV remains the highest among all hybrid halides with Δ n ≥ 1.0. First‐principles calculations confirm that this exceptional performance originates from the synergy between the organic π‐conjugated modules and the inorganic units, mediated by the multiple hydrogen‐bond networks. This work sets a new performance benchmark for fluoride birefringent materials and inspires the molecular engineering design of high‐performance ultraviolet optical crystals.

papers.title_zh: 通过水调控氢键网络重构理性构建具有创纪录双折射的氟化物晶体
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过氢键介导的共组装策略构建了三种由有机π共轭单元与刚性[SiF₆]²⁻单元组成的分子晶体，其中水合物的引入重构了氢键网络，使其双折射率达到1.121@546 nm，同时保持3.21 eV的宽带隙，创下Δn≥1.0杂化卤化物的带隙新高。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在解决双折射晶体中宽带隙与超高双折射（Δn≥1.0）难以兼得的矛盾。作者设计并合成了三种分子晶体：(C₁₀H₁₀N₂)SiF₆、(C₁₂H₉N₂)₂SiF₆和(C₁₂H₉N₂)₂SiF₆·2H₂O，均通过有机π共轭单元与刚性无机[SiF₆]²⁻单元经氢键介导的共组装策略构建。结构分析表明，三种化合物的有机部分通过[SiF₆]²⁻骨架与氢键的协同作用呈平行排列。特别地，水分子引入(C₁₂H₉N₂)₂SiF₆·2H₂O后，将氢键网络重构为N–H···O/O–H···F二元体系，促使[C₁₂H₉N₂]⁺阳离子相对于光轴平面更共面排列，从而赋予该化合物1.121@546 nm的优异双折射率。第一性原理计算证实，这一卓越性能源于有机π共轭模块与无机单元之间通过多重氢键网络的协同作用。该工作为氟化物双折射材料树立了新的性能基准，并为高性能紫外光学晶体的分子工程设计提供了思路。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：氢键介导的共组装策略合成三种分子晶体；结构分析（未报告具体表征手段名称）；第一性原理计算。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征仪器型号及性能测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料组装与自组装技术范畴，其氢键介导的共组装策略及水调控氢键网络重构思路对介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料的组装设计具有方法学参考价值。但该研究体系为分子晶体而非框架材料，与介孔导电MOF主线关联有限，属于拓展推荐。若关注氢键网络调控与共组装策略，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要级信息，摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征手段、晶体学数据、计算细节及性能测试条件，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: (C₁₂H₉N₂)₂SiF₆·2H₂O的双折射率达到1.121@546 nm，为摘要明确报告的定量结果。
水合物的带隙为3.21 eV，是摘要所述所有Δn≥1.0的杂化卤化物中带隙最高者。
水分子引入将氢键网络重构为二元N–H···O/O–H···F体系，促使阳离子更共面排列于光轴平面，这是双折射增强的结构机制。
第一性原理计算确认优异性能源于有机π共轭模块与无机单元经多重氢键网络的协同作用。

papers.title: Regulating Sodium Deposition Behavior via Polar Functional Group‐Based Interfacial Engineering on an Industrial‐Scale Anode for High‐Performance Na‐CO 2 Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The development of sodium‐carbon dioxide (Na‐CO 2 ) batteries is crucial for renewable energy utilization and CO 2 fixation. However, their practical application is severely hindered by Na dendrite formation coupled with aggressive CO 2 electro‐/chemical corrosion, and extremely low Na anode utilization rates. This study addresses these interconnected challenges by employing a multifunctional covalent organic framework (COF) coating. Specifically, the C 6 O 6 ‐TAPT COF features a fully conjugated skeleton for rapid electron cloud response, abundantly distributed sodiophilic chelation sites (C═O and C═N) for Na + capture, and ordered AB stacked structure for homogenizing Na + flux. The COMSOL simulations further demonstrate the stress‐regulating strategy in mitigate solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) cracking and separator puncturing risks. Consequently, Na‐CO 2 batteries using the designed industrial‐scale anode achieve low polarization (1.4 V) and sustain stable cycling for over 1100 h at 100 mA g −1 across 0–60 °C. Remarkably, it maintained over 100 cycles at reduced N/P of 10 and delivered a high discharge capacity of 11552 mAh g −1 under lean electrolyte conditions (8.7 µL mAh −1 ). This study validates stable and functionalized COF substrates with dendrite suppression capability in Na‐CO 2 batteries, proposing a scalable pathway with implications for next‐generation energy storage.

papers.title_zh: 通过极性官能团界面工程调控工业级负极的钠沉积行为以实现高性能Na-CO₂电池
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用C₆O₆-TAPT共价有机框架（COF）涂层对工业级钠负极进行界面工程，利用其全共轭骨架、亲钠螯合位点（C=O和C=N）及有序AB堆叠结构，实现Na-CO₂电池低极化（1.4 V）和超过1100小时的稳定循环。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在解决Na-CO₂电池中钠枝晶形成、CO₂电化学/化学腐蚀及钠负极利用率极低等相互关联的挑战。作者采用多功能C₆O₆-TAPT COF涂层对工业级钠负极进行界面工程。该COF具有全共轭骨架以实现快速电子云响应，丰富分布的亲钠螯合位点（C=O和C=N）用于捕获Na⁺，以及有序AB堆叠结构用于均化Na⁺通量。COMSOL模拟进一步展示了应力调控策略在缓解固体电解质界面（SEI）开裂和隔膜穿刺风险方面的作用。结果表明，使用该设计工业级负极的Na-CO₂电池实现低极化（1.4 V），在100 mA g⁻¹下于0–60 °C范围内稳定循环超过1100小时。在N/P比为10时维持超过100次循环，并在贫电解液条件（8.7 µL mAh⁻¹）下提供11552 mAh g⁻¹的高放电容量。该研究验证了具有枝晶抑制能力的稳定功能化COF基底在Na-CO₂电池中的可行性，提出了可规模化的路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：C₆O₆-TAPT COF涂层制备与界面工程；COMSOL模拟用于应力调控分析；Na-CO₂电池组装与电化学性能测试（极化、循环稳定性、放电容量）。摘要未报告COF的具体合成条件、表征手段及电池组装细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于共轭COF在电化学储能中的应用，其全共轭骨架设计、亲钠螯合位点调控及有序堆叠结构对共轭MOF/COF的组装与电化学合成主线具有直接参考价值。COF涂层界面工程策略对框架材料在金属负极保护中的应用有启发意义，属于核心推荐，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要级信息，摘要未报告COF的具体合成条件、表征数据、COMSOL模拟参数及电池测试细节，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Na-CO₂电池实现低极化1.4 V，在100 mA g⁻¹下0–60 °C范围内稳定循环超过1100小时。
在N/P比为10时维持超过100次循环，贫电解液条件（8.7 µL mAh⁻¹）下放电容量达11552 mAh g⁻¹。
COF的全共轭骨架、亲钠螯合位点（C=O和C=N）及有序AB堆叠结构协同实现Na⁺捕获与通量均化。
COMSOL模拟展示应力调控策略可缓解SEI开裂和隔膜穿刺风险。

papers.title: Two‐Dimensional fes‐Topology Covalent Organic Frameworks With Intrinsic Paramagnetic Semiconducting Properties
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The structural diversity and periodic arrangement of two‐dimensional (2D) covalent organic frameworks (COFs) endow them with great promise for electronic and magnetic functionalities. Nevertheless, magnetic functionalities in semiconducting 2D COFs are not easily attainable due to the scarcity of effective topology diagrams and building blocks. In this study, we designed and synthesized three examples of fes ‐topology COFs by rationally tessellating octagonal and rhombic pores using redox‐active building blocks. The resulting fes ‐net COFs exhibit high crystallinity, excellent porosity, and well‐resolved pore structures. Furthermore, the highly ordered orthogonal arrangement of the embedded redox‐active units endows these fes ‐net COFs with electrical conductivities up to 10 −2 S cm −1 . In particular, Cu‐BBFPP‐TQTA‐COF displayed enhanced paramagnetic properties attributed to the generated stable tetrathiafulvalene radical species. This work provides an effective design strategy for constructing octagonal fes ‐COFs and offers new insights into the development of semiconducting magnets.

papers.title_zh: 具有本征顺磁半导体性质的二维fes拓扑共价有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过合理镶嵌八边形和菱形孔道，采用氧化还原活性构筑单元设计合成了三种fes拓扑COF，其高度有序的正交排列赋予材料高达10⁻² S cm⁻¹的电导率，其中Cu-BBFPP-TQTA-COF因生成稳定四硫富瓦烯自由基物种而表现出增强的顺磁性质。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在解决半导体二维COF中磁功能难以实现的问题，原因在于有效拓扑图和构筑单元的稀缺。作者通过合理镶嵌八边形和菱形孔道，采用氧化还原活性构筑单元设计并合成了三种fes拓扑COF。所得fes-net COF表现出高结晶性、优异孔隙率和清晰解析的孔结构。嵌入的氧化还原活性单元的高度有序正交排列赋予这些fes-net COF高达10⁻² S cm⁻¹的电导率。特别地，Cu-BBFPP-TQTA-COF因生成稳定的四硫富瓦烯自由基物种而表现出增强的顺磁性质。该工作为构建八边形fes-COF提供了有效的设计策略，并为半导体磁体的开发提供了新见解。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：合理镶嵌八边形和菱形孔道的拓扑设计策略；采用氧化还原活性构筑单元合成三种fes拓扑COF；结晶性和孔隙率表征（未报告具体手段）；电导率测量；顺磁性质表征。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器及测试细节。

papers.title: Expanding the DNA Nanotechnology Toolbox: Hierarchical Assembly and Self‐Sorting of DNA Tiles With Precisely Controlled Hydrophobic Behavior
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT DNA self‐assembly is a powerful strategy to build complex nanostructures, but the chemical uniformity of natural nucleotides limits architectural diversity and long‐range organization. Here, we expand the DNA nanotechnology toolbox by integrating tunable hydrophobic effects directly into DNA double‐crossover (DX) tiles using non‐natural nucleotides. Sequence‐defined, monodisperse amphiphiles are constructed on a DNA synthesizer, with hydrophobic strength precisely controlled by the number of incorporated hexaethylene (C 12 ) units. By varying hydrophobic strength and applying thermal annealing, we define an energetic threshold that dictates the hierarchical order of hydrophobic assembly versus DNA hybridization. Weak hydrophobic effects allow base pairing to occur first, followed by hydrophobic assembly, yielding quantized DX‐tile star architectures. Strong hydrophobicity instead drives early micelle formation, followed by DNA‐mediated cross‐linking into robust spherical nucleic acids (SNAs). These crosslinked SNAs show enhanced serum stability and remain fully reversible via strand‐displacement‐triggered decrosslinking. Furthermore, DX‐tiles with identical DNA sequences but different hydrophobic segment lengths undergo narcissistic self‐sorting, assembling in one pot into distinct DX‐star and SNA populations that complement the social self‐sorting of base pairing. Finally, we demonstrate that this design principle extends to other DNA nanostructures, including three‐point star tiles, enabling cooperative, protein‐like assembly pathways and emergent functions inaccessible to DNA alone.

papers.title: Chemical Editing Reveals Atomic-Level Control of Supramolecular Structure in Self-Assembling Peptides
papers.abstract: Abstract Can replacement of single atoms within amino acid sequences redirect peptide self-assembly into different supramolecular structures? To address this question, we investigated a compositionally similar class of bola-amphiphilic peptides that were designed to self-assemble into filamentous nanostructures. The chemical differences between these peptides were confined to minimally perturbative substitutions on a phenylalanine side chain at a single site within the sequence. Cryo-EM structural analysis of five peptide filaments at near-atomic resolution revealed the presence of distinct supramolecular architectures between the different peptides. Despite sharing a common cross-β framework, the filament structures displayed distinct helical symmetries, protofilament organizations, and steric zipper interfaces. We hypothesize that the observed structural divergence between filaments arises from subtle changes in side-chain polarity and solvent interactions that remodel peptide packing at structural interfaces within cross-sectional amyloid layers. These findings demonstrate that the supramolecular structural landscape of self-assembling peptides is sensitive to atomic-level substitution and suggest that chemical editing provides a strategy for interrogating and potentially controlling biomolecular assembly. These results further highlight a fundamental limitation in the predictive design of peptide-based materials in that subtle chemical modifications in local composition can produce disproportionate changes in higher-order structure.

papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在回答氨基酸序列中单原子替换能否重定向肽自组装为不同超分子结构。作者设计了一类组成相似的双亲性bola肽，其化学差异仅限于序列中单一位点苯丙氨酸侧链上的最小扰动取代。利用冷冻电镜对五种肽纤维进行近原子分辨率结构分析，发现不同肽之间存在不同的超分子架构。尽管共享交叉β框架，纤维结构在螺旋对称性、原纤维组织和空间拉链界面上呈现明显差异。作者假设这种结构分化源于侧链极性和溶剂相互作用的细微变化，重塑了淀粉样横截面层内结构界面的肽堆积。该工作表明自组装肽的超分子结构景观对原子级取代高度敏感，化学编辑可作为探究和潜在控制生物分子组装的策略。

papers.title: Curvature-Enhanced and Chirality-Modulated Anomalous Thermal Transport in Pentagonal Covalent Organic Framework Nanotubes
papers.abstract: Abstract The emergence of covalent organic framework (COF) nanotubes extends tubular materials from rigid atomic networks to flexible molecular frameworks, yet their thermal transport properties remain unexplored. Here, based on an experimentally synthesized two-dimensional pentagonal COF (penta-COF), we construct a series of one-dimensional nanotubes and systematically investigate their axial thermal conductivity (κaxial) across the curvature and chirality parameter spaces. Using molecular dynamics simulations powered by a fine-tuned universal machine-learning potential, we uncover an anomalous curvature-enhanced thermal transport (κaxial ∼ 1/R1.31), opposite to the curvature-suppressed behavior commonly observed in conventional atom-based nanotubes. Moreover, at nearly constant radius, κaxial exhibits a pronounced dependence on chirality. Structural and vibrational analyses reveal that curvature acts as a geometric confinement field that suppresses disordered vibrations of flexible organic linkers and enhances conformational ordering, thereby improving the transport efficiency of low-frequency phonons. Further symmetry-guided analysis shows that the chirality dependence originates from a competition between the chirality-induced axial-misalignment penalty associated with the intrinsic elastic anisotropy of the pentagonal parent lattice and the conformational-ordering enhancement induced by rolling-driven symmetry reduction and strain homogenization. These findings reveal an unconventional geometry-phonon coupling mechanism in penta-COF nanotubes, and establish curvature and chirality as effective design parameters for tuning thermal transport in molecule-based one-dimensional pentagonal materials.

papers.title: Design and synthesis of ultrastable 3D porous aromatic frameworks via stereochemical control of building blocks for hydrogen and methane storage
papers.abstract: Abstract Achieving ultrahigh porosity together with exceptional framework stability remains a central challenge in the synthetic chemistry of porous materials. Here, we report a stereochemical design strategy to construct three-dimensional backbone frameworks composed exclusively of robust Csp2–Csp2 linkages. Based on this approach, a series of porous aromatic frameworks are synthesized. Among them, PAF-486 exhibits an ultrahigh specific surface area of 5690 m2 g−1. Owing to its Csp2–Csp2 backbone, PAF-486 shows exceptional framework robustness for post-synthetic sulfonation, preserving its framework integrity upon treatment with concentrated sulfuric acid, while the well-known stable porous materials PAF-1 and Cr-based metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) degraded under the same conditions. In addition, its highly open and interconnected pore architecture enables exceptional gas storage performance.

papers.title: The Multi‐Scale Paradigm: An Integrated Design Logic for Nonlinear Optical Crystals
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Nonlinear optical (NLO) crystals are essential for laser frequency conversion, yet rational crystal design remains challenging due to intrinsic trade‐offs among key performance parameters. This review establishes a multi‐scale design paradigm to unify fragmented knowledge of NLO materials by correlating microscopic, mesoscopic, and macroscopic structural features, delivering a chemistry‐based framework to recognize cross‐scale constraints and direct NLO crystal exploration. At the microscopic level, the intrinsic optical responses of planar π‐conjugated units, non‐π‐conjugated tetrahedral motifs, and distorted polyhedra are systematically analyzed at the atomic scale, with emphasis on the chemical substitution, functional‐group modification, and multi‐unit assembly strategies that directly manipulate the microscopic electronic structures of these functional building blocks. At the mesoscopic scale, cation‐regulated coordination, dimensionality engineering, hydrogen bonding, domain manipulation, and interfacial coupling are discussed for ordered functional unit arrangement and constructive polarization accumulation. At the macroscopic scale, we discuss converting small‐scale designs into usable bulk crystals, focusing on mitigating layered growth via strengthened interlayer interactions to improve crystal dimension, quality, and device compatibility. Representative NLO crystal examples validate this coherent logic. This framework clarifies structure‐property correlations and supplies guidelines for new NLO materials, advancing this field from empirical screening toward rational, application‐driven design.

papers.title_zh: 多尺度范式：非线性光学晶体的集成设计逻辑
papers.summary_zh: 该综述提出多尺度设计范式，将非线性光学晶体的微观、介观与宏观结构特征关联，统一碎片化知识，建立基于化学的框架以识别跨尺度约束，推动该领域从经验筛选走向理性、应用驱动的设计。
papers.research_details_zh: 非线性光学晶体对激光频率转换至关重要，但关键性能参数之间存在内在权衡，理性晶体设计仍具挑战。本文建立多尺度设计范式，关联微观、介观与宏观结构特征，提供基于化学的框架以识别跨尺度约束并指导晶体探索。微观层面系统分析平面π共轭单元、非π共轭四面体基元和畸变多面体的本征光学响应，强调化学取代、官能团修饰和多单元组装策略对功能构筑单元微观电子结构的直接调控。介观层面讨论阳离子调控配位、维度工程、氢键、畴操控和界面耦合，以实现功能单元有序排列和建设性极化积累。宏观层面讨论将小尺度设计转化为可用块体晶体，聚焦通过增强层间相互作用缓解层状生长，以改善晶体尺寸、质量和器件兼容性。代表性晶体实例验证了该逻辑，框架阐明了结构—性能关联并为新材料提供指南。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要未报告具体实验方法。该文为综述，摘要明确提及的分析框架包括：在原子尺度系统分析平面π共轭单元、非π共轭四面体基元和畸变多面体的本征光学响应；讨论化学取代、官能团修饰和多单元组装策略；在介观尺度讨论阳离子调控配位、维度工程、氢键、畴操控和界面耦合；在宏观尺度讨论通过增强层间相互作用缓解层状生长。摘要未报告具体合成、表征或性能测试方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述与框架材料组装及结构—性能关联主线相关，其多尺度设计逻辑可为介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料的跨尺度结构调控提供方法论借鉴。但该文聚焦非线性光学晶体，未涉及MOF、COF、HOF或介孔材料，也未报告电化学合成或自组装实验。对关注框架材料理性设计的读者有参考价值，是否精读取决于对多尺度设计范式的兴趣。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体实验条件、表征手段、数值结果及代表性晶体实例的详细信息，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 提出统一微观、介观、宏观三个尺度的多尺度设计范式，用于关联非线性光学晶体的结构特征与性能。
微观层面强调化学取代、官能团修饰和多单元组装可直接调控平面π共轭单元、非π共轭四面体基元和畸变多面体的电子结构。
介观层面通过阳离子调控配位、维度工程、氢键、畴操控和界面耦合实现功能单元有序排列与极化积累。
宏观层面通过增强层间相互作用缓解层状生长，改善晶体尺寸、质量和器件兼容性。

papers.title: Rylene Diimides Featuring Quadruple C─H···(O═C) Locking for High‐Mobility Organic Semiconductors
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons with large conjugated planes and low reorganization energy serve as an ideal molecular platform for organic semiconductors; however, precisely controlling their aggregated structures to achieve large transfer integrals and thus excellent charge transport efficiency remains a significant challenge. Herein, we design and synthesize a sila‐annulated hexarylene diimide ( 2Si‐HDI ) featuring imide units at both peri ‐positions and two silole rings at the central bay ‐positions. Through the quadruple C─H···(O═C) locking between carbonyls of the diimide groups and the hydrogen atoms of the 1,1'‐diethylsilyl groups at the silole rings, we realized the first 1D slipped π – π stacking of ultra‐long rylenes (naphthalene unit ≥ 6), providing groundbreaking guidance for the well‐ordered π – π self‐assembly of large planar PAHs relevant to armchair graphene nanoribbons. The single‐crystalline organic field‐effect transistor properties of 2Si‐HDI exhibit hole/electron mobilities up to 3.08/0.06 cm 2 V −1 s −1 . Theoretical calculations reveal hole/electron transfer integrals of 2Si‐HDI as high as 110.08/78.08 meV along the π – π stacking direction, rationalizing its superior charge transport performance.

papers.title_zh: 具有四重C─H···(O═C)锁定的萘二酰亚胺类高迁移率有机半导体
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计合成含硅杂环稠合六联萘二酰亚胺2Si-HDI，通过四重C─H···(O═C)锁定实现超长萘二酰亚胺的一维滑移π–π堆积，单晶有机场效应晶体管空穴/电子迁移率最高达3.08/0.06 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹。
papers.research_details_zh: 大共轭平面和低重组能的多环芳烃是有机半导体的理想分子平台，但精确控制其聚集结构以获得大转移积分和优异电荷传输效率仍是重大挑战。本文设计并合成了一种含硅杂环稠合的六联萘二酰亚胺2Si-HDI，其peri位具有酰亚胺单元，中心bay位具有两个硅杂环戊二烯环。通过二酰亚胺基团羰基与硅杂环上1,1'-二乙基硅基氢原子之间的四重C─H···(O═C)锁定，实现了超长萘二酰亚胺（萘单元≥6）的首例一维滑移π–π堆积，为与扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带相关的大平面多环芳烃的有序π–π自组装提供了开创性指导。2Si-HDI的单晶有机场效应晶体管表现出高达3.08/0.06 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹的空穴/电子迁移率。理论计算揭示2Si-HDI沿π–π堆积方向的空穴/电子转移积分高达110.08/78.08 meV，合理解释了其优异电荷传输性能。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：设计并合成含硅杂环稠合的六联萘二酰亚胺2Si-HDI；利用四重C─H···(O═C)锁定实现一维滑移π–π堆积；制备单晶有机场效应晶体管并测试其空穴/电子迁移率；进行理论计算获得沿π–π堆积方向的空穴/电子转移积分。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段和器件制备细节。

papers.title: Synergy of Cobalt Single Atoms and Mesoporous Single-Layered Molybdenum Sulfide/Carbon Composites for Enhanced Sodium Ion Storage
papers.abstract: Abstract Molybdenum disulfide (MoS2)-based nanomaterials are considered promising anodes for sodium-ion batteries (SIBs), but their practical application remains constrained by sluggish electrochemical kinetics and structural degradation induced by irreversible compositional conversion. Herein, we propose a synergistic interfacial engineering strategy that integrates atomically dispersed cobalt single-atom catalytic sites within a nitrogen-doped, mesoporous single-layered molybdenum sulfide/carbon hybrid architecture (SA Co-MoS2/C) via a versatile dual-template synthesis. Advanced structural characterizations and X-ray absorption spectroscopy reveal that the incorporation of Co single-atom sites triggers a partial semiconducting 2H-to-metallic 1T phase transition and drives substantial electron transfer from Co sites to the MoS2/C substrate. Consequently, the optimized SA Co-MoS2/C electrode delivers exceptional electrochemical performance, featuring a superior rate capability of 130 mAh g−1 at 6.0 A g−1 and robust cycling stability with a retained capacity of ∼300 mAh g−1 after 1000 cycles at 2.0 A g−1. These substantial performance enhancements are fundamentally attributed to the synergistic effects of single-atom catalytic sites and single-layered MoS2/C nanostructure, which collectively accelerate reaction kinetics and ensure highly reversible conversion chemistry. This work provides a compelling paradigm for precise interfacial regulation in transition metal dichalcogenides, offering valuable insights for designing high-performance energy storage materials.

papers.title_zh: 钴单原子与介孔单层硫化钼/碳复合材料的协同作用增强钠离子存储
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过双模板法构建氮掺杂介孔单层MoS₂/C复合材料并集成原子分散钴单原子，Co单原子触发部分2H向1T相转变并驱动电子转移，优化电极在6.0 A g⁻¹下比容量达130 mAh g⁻¹，2.0 A g⁻¹循环1000次后保持约300 mAh g⁻¹。
papers.research_details_zh: MoS₂基纳米材料被认为是钠离子电池有前景的负极，但缓慢的电化学动力学和不可逆组分转化引起的结构退化限制了实际应用。本文提出一种协同界面工程策略，通过通用双模板合成法将原子分散的钴单原子催化位点集成到氮掺杂介孔单层硫化钼/碳杂化结构（SA Co-MoS₂/C）中。先进结构表征和X射线吸收谱揭示，Co单原子位点的引入触发部分半导体2H向金属1T相转变，并驱动从Co位点到MoS₂/C基底的大量电子转移。优化后的SA Co-MoS₂/C电极表现出优异电化学性能：在6.0 A g⁻¹下倍率容量达130 mAh g⁻¹，在2.0 A g⁻¹下循环1000次后容量保持约300 mAh g⁻¹。性能提升归因于单原子催化位点与单层MoS₂/C纳米结构的协同效应，共同加速反应动力学并确保高度可逆的转化化学。该工作为过渡金属二硫属化物的精确界面调控提供了范式。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：通过通用双模板合成法构建氮掺杂介孔单层硫化钼/碳杂化结构并集成原子分散钴单原子；采用先进结构表征和X射线吸收谱分析Co单原子的引入对相转变和电子转移的影响；对优化后的SA Co-MoS₂/C电极进行电化学性能测试，包括倍率性能（6.0 A g⁻¹）和循环稳定性（2.0 A g⁻¹，1000次循环）。摘要未报告具体模板种类、合成条件和表征参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究涉及介孔材料、单层MoS₂/碳复合结构和电化学储能，与介孔材料及电化学合成主线相关。其双模板合成策略和单原子界面调控方法可为介孔导电框架材料的构建提供借鉴。但该文聚焦过渡金属二硫属化物负极，未涉及MOF、COF、HOF或框架材料组装。对关注介孔材料界面工程和电化学应用的读者有参考价值。

papers.title: NH2-MIL-53(Al) with Hierarchical Micro–Mesoporosity for Highly Efficient Capture of Direct Scarlet Anionic Dye: Insights into Structure–Property Correlations
papers.abstract: Fabricating nanoscale metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) with hierarchical pores is an effective strategy to engineer high-performance adsorbents. Herein, hierarchically porous NH2-MIL-53(Al) nanorods were synthesized through a straightforward one-pot solvothermal approach, featuring inherently interconnected micro-/mesoporous with an average pore width of 19.51 nm and abundant amino-functionalized active sites. Toward the anionic Direct Scarlet dye, the material delivers a Langmuir maximum adsorption capacity of 694.99 mg·g−1, with its adsorption kinetics and isotherms well described by the pseudo-second-order kinetics and Langmuir isotherm model. Combined spectroscopic, thermodynamic, and diffusion analyses suggest monolayer electrostatic chemisorption between protonated –NH3+ and dye sulfonate groups. The material exhibits favorable reusability, retaining over 85% of its original dye removal efficiency after five adsorption–desorption cycles, and PXRD and SEM results verify well-preserved morphology and crystalline lattice. This work clarifies the intrinsic correlation between structure and adsorption performance of NH2-MIL-53(Al), offering a facile nanoscale pore-tuning strategy for the design and fabrication of high-performance MOF adsorbents.

papers.title_zh: 具有分级微孔-介孔结构的NH2-MIL-53(Al)用于高效捕获直接猩红阴离子染料：结构-性能关联研究
papers.summary_zh: 本研究通过一锅溶剂热法合成具有互连微孔-介孔的分级多孔NH2-MIL-53(Al)纳米棒，平均孔径19.51 nm，对阴离子直接猩红染料Langmuir最大吸附容量达694.99 mg·g−1，五次循环后去除效率保持85%以上，并阐明质子化氨基与染料磺酸基之间的单层静电化学吸附机制。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对高性能吸附剂的设计需求，本研究旨在通过纳米尺度孔结构调控提升MOF对阴离子染料的捕获能力。以NH2-MIL-53(Al)为材料体系，采用简便的一锅溶剂热法合成具有本征互连微孔-介孔结构的分级多孔纳米棒，平均孔宽为19.51 nm，并富含氨基功能化活性位点。研究以阴离子直接猩红染料为目标污染物，系统考察吸附动力学、等温线、热力学及扩散行为，并结合光谱分析揭示吸附机制。结果表明吸附动力学符合准二级动力学模型，等温线符合Langmuir模型，最大吸附容量为694.99 mg·g−1。光谱、热力学与扩散分析共同表明，质子化–NH3+与染料磺酸基之间发生单层静电化学吸附。材料经五次吸附-脱附循环后仍保持85%以上去除效率，PXRD和SEM验证了形貌与晶格的保持。该工作阐明了NH2-MIL-53(Al)结构与吸附性能之间的内在关联，为高性能MOF吸附剂的纳米孔调控提供了简便策略。
papers.methods_zh: 采用一锅溶剂热法合成分级多孔NH2-MIL-53(Al)纳米棒。通过吸附动力学、等温线和热力学分析评估对阴离子直接猩红染料的吸附性能，并利用扩散分析辅助机制研究。结合光谱分析探究吸附作用机制。通过五次吸附-脱附循环测试可重复使用性，并采用PXRD和SEM表征循环前后材料的形貌与晶格保持情况。摘要未报告具体光谱类型、温度条件及染料浓度等细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于介孔MOF吸附剂方向，展示了通过一锅溶剂热法构建分级微孔-介孔NH2-MIL-53(Al)纳米棒以高效捕获阴离子染料的策略，结构-性能关联分析对框架材料孔工程具有参考价值。定量吸附容量与循环稳定性数据明确，机制证据较充分。局限在于仅针对单一染料体系，未涉及电化学合成或导电框架。对介孔MOF吸附主线有实际参考价值，值得全文精读以核查合成参数与表征细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征手段、数值或机制。摘要未报告具体溶剂热温度、时间、溶剂组成、染料初始浓度、pH条件、光谱类型及热力学参数等关键细节，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 分级多孔NH2-MIL-53(Al)纳米棒具有互连微孔-介孔结构，平均孔径为19.51 nm，并含丰富氨基功能化活性位点。
对阴离子直接猩红染料的Langmuir最大吸附容量为694.99 mg·g−1，吸附动力学符合准二级动力学模型，等温线符合Langmuir模型。
光谱、热力学与扩散分析表明吸附机制为质子化–NH3+与染料磺酸基之间的单层静电化学吸附。
五次吸附-脱附循环后染料去除效率保持85%以上，PXRD和SEM证实形貌与晶格保持良好。

papers.title: Fe‐Regulated Coupled 2e − /4e − ORR Pathway in a Conductive Co‐Fe HITP Framework for Rechargeable Zinc‐Air Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Zinc‐air batteries based on non‐precious‐metal catalysts are promising for sustainable energy conversion, yet their performance is hindered by sluggish oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) kinetics and limited understanding of pathway regulation in metal–organic framework (MOF)‐based catalysts. Herein, we report a bimetallic electron‐conductive Co‐Fe framework based on 2,3,6,7,10,11‐hexaiminotriphenylene (HITP), in which Fe incorporation shifts the ORR toward a greater four‐electron contribution. Structural, electrochemical, and density functional theory (DFT) analyses reveal complementary dual‐site roles: Co sites favor peroxide formation via the 2e − pathway, whereas Fe sites promote O─O bond activation and subsequent reduction of peroxide intermediates. Peroxide intermediates generated on Co sites can be further converted to OH − at Fe sites. As a result, the Co 2.2 Fe 0.8 (HITP) 2 catalyst exhibits enhanced ORR activity and enables a rechargeable zinc‐air battery with an open‐circuit voltage of 1.37 V, a peak power density of 154.2 mW cm −2 , and a high specific capacity of 843 mAh g Zn −1 along with enhanced cycling stability. This work establishes electron‐conductive MOFs as a well‐defined platform for probing ORR mechanisms and highlights dual‐metal site engineering as an effective strategy for modulating ORR pathways and improving electrocatalytic performance.

papers.title_zh: 导电Co-Fe HITP框架中Fe调控的耦合2e−/4e− ORR路径用于可充电锌空气电池
papers.summary_zh: 本研究报道基于HITP的双金属电子导电Co-Fe框架，Fe掺入使ORR向四电子路径偏移。Co位点倾向2e−路径生成过氧化物，Fe位点促进O─O键活化及过氧化物还原，Co2.2Fe0.8(HITP)2催化剂使锌空气电池实现1.37 V开路电压、154.2 mW cm−2峰值功率密度和843 mAh gZn−1比容量。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对锌空气电池中非贵金属催化剂ORR动力学迟缓及MOF基催化剂路径调控理解不足的问题，本研究设计并报道了基于2,3,6,7,10,11-六氨基三亚苯（HITP）的双金属电子导电Co-Fe框架。通过Fe掺入调控ORR向更大四电子贡献偏移。结构、电化学与DFT分析揭示互补双位点作用：Co位点倾向通过2e−路径生成过氧化物，Fe位点促进O─O键活化及后续过氧化物中间体还原；Co位点生成的过氧化物中间体可在Fe位点进一步转化为OH−。所得Co2.2Fe0.8(HITP)2催化剂表现出增强的ORR活性，并构建可充电锌空气电池，实现开路电压1.37 V、峰值功率密度154.2 mW cm−2、比容量843 mAh gZn−1及增强的循环稳定性。该工作确立电子导电MOF作为探测ORR机制的良好定义平台，并突出双金属位点工程作为调控ORR路径与提升电催化性能的有效策略。
papers.methods_zh: 合成基于HITP的双金属电子导电Co-Fe框架，通过结构分析、电化学测试和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算揭示双位点作用机制。将Co2.2Fe0.8(HITP)2催化剂用于可充电锌空气电池，测试开路电压、峰值功率密度、比容量及循环稳定性。摘要未报告具体合成条件、电化学测试参数及DFT计算细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于导电MOF电催化方向，直接关联介孔导电MOF与框架材料电化学应用主线。通过双金属位点工程调控ORR路径的机制清晰，定量电池性能数据明确，对导电MOF在能源器件中的应用有重要参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告孔径或介孔结构信息，且未涉及自组装或电化学合成方法。对导电MOF与电催化主线价值高，值得全文精读以核查合成与表征细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征手段、数值或机制。摘要未报告具体合成条件、HITP框架的孔结构参数、电化学测试条件及DFT计算细节，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: Fe掺入使导电Co-Fe HITP框架的ORR向更大四电子贡献偏移。
Co位点倾向2e−路径生成过氧化物，Fe位点促进O─O键活化及过氧化物中间体还原，Co位点生成的过氧化物可在Fe位点进一步转化为OH−。
Co2.2Fe0.8(HITP)2催化剂使可充电锌空气电池实现开路电压1.37 V、峰值功率密度154.2 mW cm−2、比容量843 mAh gZn−1及增强的循环稳定性。

papers.title: Mixed-Linker Metal–Organic Frameworks Modified Separators as Li+-Transport Accelerators for Wide-Temperature and Long-Cycling Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract: Abstract The inherent interfacial instability and severe dendritic growth of lithium (Li) metal anodes pose significant challenges to the operational safety and cycling stability of rechargeable Li metal batteries. Herein, we report three mixed-linker metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) by integrating tetrathiafulvalene (TTF)-based ligands and benzene/trimethylbenzene/triazine-based tritopic linkers with robust zirconium-oxo (Zr6) clusters, and utilize them to functionalize conventional polypropylene separators. The incorporated TTF-based functional sites are demonstrated to serve as efficient ion-transport channels to facilitate rapid Li+ migration and homogeneous Li+ flux distribution at the molecular level. Compared with benzene- and trimethylbenzene-based linkers, the integration of electron-deficient triazine linkers with N-rich sites results in more effective interactions with PF6– anions in electrolytes to enhance Li+ transference number and inhibit PF6– decomposition, thereby improving Li+ concentration gradient and inhibiting Li dendrite growth. Consequently, the Li||LiFePO4 and Li||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 batteries with MOF-functionalized separators demonstrate impressive redox reversibility, rate performance, and cycling stability. Even within a wide temperature range from −15 to 100 °C, the upgraded Li||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 batteries can still cycle stably for over 500 cycles with ultrahigh Coulombic efficiency and considerable capacity retentions. This study presents a feasible and scalable MOF-based separator modification strategy, paving the way for developing practical wide-temperature Li metal batteries.

papers.title_zh: 混合连接体金属-有机框架修饰隔膜作为锂离子传输加速器用于宽温域长循环锂金属电池
papers.summary_zh: 本研究报道三种混合连接体MOF，将四硫富瓦烯（TTF）基配体与苯/三甲苯/三嗪基三齿连接体及Zr6簇整合，用于功能化聚丙烯隔膜。TTF功能位点作为离子传输通道促进Li+快速迁移，三嗪连接体的缺电子N位点增强与PF6−相互作用，提升Li+迁移数并抑制PF6−分解，使电池在−15至100 °C宽温域稳定循环超500次。
papers.research_details_zh: 针对锂金属负极界面不稳定与枝晶生长严重制约电池安全性和循环稳定性的问题，本研究设计并报道三种混合连接体金属-有机框架（MOF），通过将四硫富瓦烯（TTF）基配体与苯、三甲苯或三嗪基三齿连接体及稳健的锆氧（Zr6）簇整合，并将其用于功能化传统聚丙烯隔膜。研究证明引入的TTF基功能位点可作为高效离子传输通道，在分子层面促进Li+快速迁移和均匀Li+通量分布。与苯基和三甲苯基连接体相比，缺电子三嗪连接体与富氮位点的整合可更有效地与电解液中PF6−阴离子相互作用，从而提升Li+迁移数并抑制PF6−分解，进而改善Li+浓度梯度并抑制锂枝晶生长。采用MOF功能化隔膜的Li||LiFePO4和Li||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2电池表现出优异的氧化还原可逆性、倍率性能和循环稳定性。在−15至100 °C宽温域内，升级后的Li||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2电池仍可稳定循环超过500次，具有超高库仑效率和可观容量保持率。该研究提出了一种可行且可扩展的MOF基隔膜改性策略，为开发实用化宽温域锂金属电池铺平道路。
papers.methods_zh: 合成三种混合连接体MOF，将TTF基配体与苯/三甲苯/三嗪基三齿连接体及Zr6簇整合，用于功能化聚丙烯隔膜。通过电化学测试评估Li+迁移数、PF6−分解抑制及Li+浓度梯度改善情况。组装Li||LiFePO4和Li||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2电池，测试氧化还原可逆性、倍率性能、循环稳定性及宽温域（−15至100 °C）循环性能。摘要未报告具体合成条件、MOF孔结构参数及电化学测试细节。

缺电子三嗪连接体与富氮位点比苯基和三甲苯基连接体更有效地与PF6−相互作用，提升Li+迁移数并抑制PF6−分解，改善Li+浓度梯度并抑制锂枝晶生长。

papers.title: Formation of Highly Selective Binding Pockets in UiO‐Type MOFs From Bridged Linkers
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) with precisely modified pore environments are essential for applications in catalysis, gas capture, and gas sensing. However, creating these highly selective sites through straightforward synthetic routes remains a challenge. Herein, we present a design strategy for UiO‐type MOFs that enables control over the precise placement of functional groups within the tetrahedral pores of the framework, distinguishing it from less precise post‐synthetic modification methods. By crosslinking two linker molecules with a short functional urea bridge pre‐synthetically, the combination of the resulting linker geometry and the UiO‐66 framework confines the crosslink to the trigonal pore windows. This results in pocket‐like arrangements, as the urea bridges effectively “wall off” some of the pore windows. The structural implications are supported by modelling and electron crystallography. To demonstrate the functional versatility, we probe the selectivity of the obtained MOF toward aliphatic nitro compounds at low concentrations using vapor sorption measurements and compare it with other UiO‐66 derivatives.

papers.title_zh: 通过桥联连接体在UiO型MOF中形成高选择性结合口袋
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种预合成桥联策略，用短功能化尿素桥将两个连接体交联，在UiO型MOF中精准构筑结合口袋。桥联受几何与框架限制定位于三角孔窗，形成口袋状结构。模型与电子晶体学支持结构，并展示对低浓度脂肪族硝基化合物的选择性吸附。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对MOF孔环境精准修饰难题，尤其是后合成修饰精度不足的问题，提出一种预合成设计策略。作者将两个连接体分子通过短的功能化尿素桥预先交联，再用于构建UiO型MOF。由于所得连接体几何与UiO-66框架的协同限制，交联被限定在三角孔窗位置，尿素桥有效“封堵”部分孔窗，从而形成口袋状排列。结构推论由建模和电子晶体学支持。为展示功能多样性，作者用蒸气吸附测量考察所得MOF在低浓度下对脂肪族硝基化合物的选择性，并与其他UiO-66衍生物比较。该工作意义在于提供一种无需后合成修饰即可在UiO型框架中精准放置官能团、构筑高选择性结合位点的合成路线，并初步验证其在选择性吸附中的潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：预合成法将两个连接体分子用短功能化尿素桥交联；以此构建UiO型MOF；采用建模和电子晶体学支持结构解析；通过蒸气吸附测量评估所得MOF在低浓度下对脂肪族硝基化合物的选择性，并与其它UiO-66衍生物比较。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器参数及吸附测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料孔环境精准工程主线，对介孔导电MOF、共轭框架及自组装研究有方法学参考价值：其预合成桥联与孔窗限域思路可用于设计选择性结合位点。局限在于摘要仅给出定性选择性结论，未提供定量吸附数据与导电或电化学相关信息，是否值得全文精读取决于对UiO型MOF孔道精准功能化的关注程度。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本文为摘要级解读，仅依据题目与摘要。关键细节如具体连接体结构、尿素桥化学、合成条件、电子晶体学数据、建模方法、吸附等温线、选择性数值及对照衍生物信息均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 预合成尿素桥联两个连接体后，交联受连接体几何与UiO-66框架共同限制，定位于三角孔窗，形成口袋状排列并封堵部分孔窗。
建模与电子晶体学结果支持所提出的结构模型。
所得MOF在低浓度下对脂肪族硝基化合物表现出选择性，并与其它UiO-66衍生物进行了比较。
摘要未报告具体吸附容量、选择性数值或检测限等定量数据。

papers.title: Heteroleptic Dicopper Molecular Design Unlocks Distinct Dual Synergies in Electrocatalytic Hydrodimerization of Dilute Acetylene to 1,3‐Butadiene
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Electrocatalytic hydrodimerization of acetylene to 1,3‐butadiene is an attractive sustainable route, yet reconciling the disparate kinetic demands of acetylene dimerization and hydrogenation remains challenging, especially in catholyte‐free membrane electrode assembly (MEA) systems with dilute acetylene feeds. Herein, we report a heteroleptic dicopper molecular catalyst featuring piperonylate and acetate ligands that effectively addresses this incompatibility—a distinctive advantage over homoleptic catalysts. Mechanistic studies reveal that the heteroleptic design provides distinct dual synergies: (i) heteroleptic coordination minimizes steric hindrance and optimizes the Cu d ‐band center of dicopper sites, promoting efficient acetylene activation and dimerization; (ii) heteroleptic‐induced localized electric fields reorganize interfacial water structure and enrich free water molecules, critically enhancing hydrogen availability for hydrogenation. The heteroleptic catalyst substantially surpasses homoleptic analogues across a broad range of acetylene concentrations (15%–100%), delivering 91% Faradaic efficiency toward 1,3‐butadiene at just 15% acetylene in a flow cell. In a MEA setup, the catalyst continuously operates at −500 mA for 31 h, converting 15% acetylene to 1,3‐butadiene and accumulating 224 mmol of product despite restricted hydrogen availability. This work demonstrates heteroleptic molecular design as a powerful and versatile strategy for selectively controlling competing pathways in complex multi‐carbon electrosynthesis.

papers.title_zh: 异配位双铜分子设计解锁稀乙炔电催化加氢二聚制1,3-丁二烯中的独特双重协同效应
papers.summary_zh: 该工作报道一种含胡椒基酸和乙酸配体的异配位双铜分子催化剂，用于稀乙炔电催化加氢二聚制1,3-丁二烯。异配位设计通过降低位阻、优化Cu d带中心并重构界面水结构，实现乙炔活化与加氢的双重协同，在15%乙炔下获得91%法拉第效率。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对乙炔电催化加氢二聚制1,3-丁二烯中乙炔二聚与加氢动力学需求不匹配的问题，尤其是在无阴极电解液的膜电极组装体系和稀乙炔进料条件下。作者设计了一种含胡椒基酸和乙酸配体的异配位双铜分子催化剂，并与同配位类似物进行对比。机理研究揭示异配位设计提供双重协同：异配位配位降低空间位阻并优化双铜位点Cu d带中心，促进乙炔活化和二聚；异配位诱导的局域电场重组界面水结构并富集自由水分子，增强加氢所需氢的可及性。该催化剂在15%至100%乙炔浓度范围内均显著优于同配位类似物，在流动池中仅15%乙炔下对1,3-丁二烯的法拉第效率达91%。在MEA装置中，催化剂在−500 mA下连续运行31小时，将15%乙炔转化为1,3-丁二烯并累积224 mmol产物。该工作表明异配位分子设计是调控复杂多碳电合成中竞争路径的有效策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：合成含胡椒基酸和乙酸配体的异配位双铜分子催化剂及同配位类似物；在流动池中进行电催化乙炔加氢二聚性能测试，乙炔浓度范围为15%至100%；在无阴极电解液的膜电极组装体系中以−500 mA进行31小时连续运行；通过机理研究探讨配位环境对Cu d带中心、空间位阻和界面水结构的影响。摘要未报告具体表征手段、电解质组成和产物定量方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于电化学合成与配位分子催化交叉方向，对框架材料主线的直接关联有限，但其异配位分子设计、双金属协同和界面水调控策略可为导电MOF/COF中金属位点配位环境工程提供思路。局限在于该催化剂为分子配合物而非框架材料，且摘要未报告长期稳定性以外的结构表征。若关注电催化多碳产物选择性调控，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。具体合成条件、表征手段、电解质组成、产物定量方法、机理计算细节及MEA长期稳定性数据仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 异配位双铜催化剂在15%乙炔下对1,3-丁二烯的法拉第效率达91%，显著优于同配位类似物。
异配位设计通过降低空间位阻和优化Cu d带中心促进乙炔活化与二聚，并通过局域电场重构界面水结构增强加氢。
在MEA装置中，催化剂在−500 mA下连续运行31小时，将15%乙炔转化并累积224 mmol 1,3-丁二烯。
该催化剂在15%至100%乙炔浓度范围内均优于同配位类似物。

papers.title: Poly(ionic liquid)-Grafted MOF Gels: A Co-catalyst-free Platform for High-Efficiency CO2 Cycloaddition
papers.abstract: Abstract Poly(ionic liquid)-grafted UiO-66-NH2 gels are developed as a high-performance and co-catalyst-free platform for efficient CO2 capture and chemical fixation under mild conditions. To address the mass transfer limitations and high energy barriers typical of purely microporous powder materials, a series of hierarchically porous metal–organic framework (MOF)-poly(ionic liquid) hybrid gels (HP-MOF-PILs) were engineered within a structurally adaptive UiO-66-NH2 gel matrix by integrating covalent anchoring with subsequent radical polymerization. Structural characterization reveals that the hybrid catalyst maintains the structural integrity of the MOF gel framework while successfully preserving the well-defined, highly interconnected mesoporous network inherent to the gel skeleton. Although the intensive grafting of PIL segments leads to a reduction in intrinsic microporosity, the gel-derived open mesopores significantly alleviate mass transfer resistance, preventing the active-site burial and heavy aggregation common in bulk polymers or packed powders, thereby ensuring high accessibility to the catalytic centers. The hybrid catalyst achieves over 99% cyclochloroallyl carbonate yield under 0.1 MPa CO2 without any co-catalyst. The high catalytic efficiency stems from a multi-site cooperative effect, wherein coordinatively unsaturated Zr4+ Lewis acid centers assisted by structural Zr−OH groups on the MOF nodes electrophilically activate epoxide C−O bonds, while grafted PIL segments supply hydrogen-bonding donors and nucleophilic Br− anions for rapid ring-opening. Furthermore, owing to the macrostructural stability and resilient coordination network of the gel matrix, the catalyst exhibits excellent durability over six consecutive cycles. This work provides a promising strategy for designing integrated gel-based composite catalysts with self-supporting pore architectures for sustainable carbon utilization.

papers.title_zh: 聚离子液体接枝MOF凝胶：无助催化剂高效CO2环加成平台
papers.summary_zh: 该工作开发聚离子液体接枝UiO-66-NH2凝胶，作为无助催化剂平台用于温和条件下CO2捕获与化学固定。分级多孔凝胶骨架保留介孔网络，缓解传质限制，在0.1 MPa CO2下环氯烯丙基碳酸酯产率超过99%，并具六次循环耐久性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对纯微孔粉末材料在CO2环加成中传质受限和能垒高的问题，设计了一系列分级多孔MOF-聚离子液体杂化凝胶。作者在结构自适应的UiO-66-NH2凝胶基质中，通过共价锚定与后续自由基聚合相结合，将聚离子液体链接枝到MOF凝胶上。结构表征显示杂化催化剂保持MOF凝胶骨架的结构完整性，并成功保留凝胶骨架固有的高度互联介孔网络。尽管聚离子液体链的密集接枝导致本征微孔性降低，但凝胶衍生的开放介孔显著缓解传质阻力，防止活性位点被包埋和严重聚集，确保催化中心的高可及性。该杂化催化剂在0.1 MPa CO2下、无任何助催化剂时，环氯烯丙基碳酸酯产率超过99%。高催化效率源于多位点协同效应：MOF节点上配位不饱和Zr4+路易斯酸中心在结构Zr−OH基团辅助下亲电活化环氧化物C−O键，接枝的聚离子液体链段提供氢键供体和亲核Br−阴离子促进快速开环。由于凝胶基质的宏观结构稳定性和弹性配位网络，催化剂在六次连续循环中表现出优异耐久性。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：在结构自适应UiO-66-NH2凝胶基质中通过共价锚定与后续自由基聚合相结合，制备分级多孔MOF-聚离子液体杂化凝胶；进行结构表征以确认MOF凝胶骨架完整性和介孔网络保留；在0.1 MPa CO2、无助催化剂条件下测试环氯烯丙基碳酸酯产率；进行六次连续循环耐久性测试。摘要未报告具体表征技术、聚合条件和产物定量方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联介孔MOF、分级多孔框架材料和框架组装方向，其凝胶化策略与聚离子液体接枝为构建自支撑介孔MOF复合材料提供了可借鉴路径。对CO2环加成催化中的多位点协同机制和传质优化具有参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告孔径分布、比表面积和聚离子液体接枝量等定量结构数据。若关注MOF凝胶催化平台，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。具体合成条件、表征技术、孔径分布、比表面积、聚离子液体接枝量、循环测试条件和产物定量方法仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 分级多孔MOF-聚离子液体杂化凝胶在0.1 MPa CO2、无助催化剂条件下实现环氯烯丙基碳酸酯产率超过99%。
凝胶骨架保留高度互联介孔网络，虽接枝导致微孔性降低，但开放介孔缓解传质阻力并防止活性位点包埋和聚集。
催化效率源于多位点协同：配位不饱和Zr4+路易斯酸中心与Zr−OH辅助活化环氧化物，聚离子液体提供氢键供体和Br−亲核试剂促进开环。
催化剂在六次连续循环中表现出优异耐久性。

papers.title: Single-Walled Carbon Nanotubes as Near-Infrared Fluorescent Multiplexed Optical Reporters for Trigger-Induced π-Conjugated Peptide Self-Assembly
papers.abstract: Abstract Supramolecular peptide assemblies provide versatile, functional material platforms with structures and properties that can be regulated by molecular design and external stimuli. Monitoring their structural evolution is therefore important for tracking trigger-induced reorganization, and thus property changes, during the assembly process. Here, we introduce near-infrared (NIR) fluorescent single-walled carbon nanotube (SWCNT) optical reporters as probes of trigger-induced peptide self-assembly in aqueous environments. We employ the π-conjugated peptide DVV4T, a quaterthiophene (4T)-Asp–Val–Val unit, as a model system that undergoes electrostatically regulated supramolecular reorganization while simultaneously acting as a noncovalent dispersant for SWCNTs. Exposure to distinct chemical triggers induces self-assembly of DVV4T, which incorporates the peptide-SWCNT hybrids into the resulting supramolecular structures. Electron microscopy reveals trigger-specific morphologies, ranging from bundled filaments to extended, interconnected networks of peptide-SWCNTs. These self-assembly transformations produce trigger-specific, chirality-resolved, time-dependent modulations in the SWCNT NIR fluorescence, enabling optical readouts of supramolecular restructuring within the NIR biologically transparent spectral window. Together, these results establish SWCNTs as information-rich optical transducers of stimulus-responsive peptide self-assembly and highlight their potential for tracking dynamic supramolecular reorganization in adaptive functional nanomaterials.

papers.title_zh: 单壁碳纳米管作为近红外荧光多重光学报告器用于触发诱导的π共轭肽自组装
papers.summary_zh: 该工作引入近红外荧光单壁碳纳米管作为水环境中触发诱导肽自组装的光学报告器。以π共轭肽DVV4T为模型，其自组装将肽-SWCNT杂化物纳入超分子结构，产生触发特异、手性分辨和时间依赖的NIR荧光调制，实现自组装重构的光学读出。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对超分子肽组装体结构演化监测的需求，提出以近红外荧光单壁碳纳米管作为水环境中触发诱导肽自组装的光学报告器。作者采用π共轭肽DVV4T作为模型体系，该分子由四噻吩（4T）-Asp-Val-Val单元组成，可在静电调控下发生超分子重组，同时作为SWCNT的非共价分散剂。暴露于不同化学触发剂后，DVV4T发生自组装，并将肽-SWCNT杂化物纳入所得超分子结构中。电子显微镜显示触发特异形貌，从成束细丝到延伸互联的肽-SWCNT网络。这些自组装转变产生触发特异、手性分辨、时间依赖的SWCNT近红外荧光调制，从而在近红外生物透明光谱窗口内实现超分子重构的光学读出。该结果确立SWCNT作为刺激响应肽自组装的信息丰富光学换能器，并展示其在追踪自适应功能纳米材料中动态超分子重组方面的潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：采用π共轭肽DVV4T作为模型体系，其同时作为SWCNT的非共价分散剂；暴露于不同化学触发剂诱导肽自组装；使用电子显微镜观察触发特异形貌；监测SWCNT近红外荧光的手性分辨和时间依赖调制。摘要未报告具体触发剂种类、荧光光谱参数、显微镜技术和定量分析条件。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作关联π共轭肽自组装、超分子纳米材料和碳纳米管光学报告器方向，对自组装技术主线有参考价值。其利用SWCNT近红外荧光监测超分子重构的策略可为框架材料组装过程的原位光学追踪提供思路。局限在于该体系为肽-SWCNT杂化物而非框架材料，且摘要未报告定量荧光参数和触发剂具体信息。若关注自组装动态监测，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。具体触发剂种类、荧光光谱参数、显微镜技术、手性分辨机制和定量分析条件仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: π共轭肽DVV4T在静电调控下发生超分子重组，同时作为SWCNT的非共价分散剂。
不同化学触发剂诱导DVV4T自组装，并将肽-SWCNT杂化物纳入超分子结构，电子显微镜显示从成束细丝到延伸互联网络的触发特异形貌。
自组装转变产生触发特异、手性分辨、时间依赖的SWCNT近红外荧光调制，可在近红外生物透明窗口实现超分子重构光学读出。
SWCNT被确立为刺激响应肽自组装的信息丰富光学换能器。

papers.title: Subcomponent Self‐Assembly of Anion‐Coordinated Quadruple Helicates With Light‐Induced Guest Release
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Developing new self‐assembly strategies is important not only for constructing otherwise inaccessible materials, but also for understanding the principles that govern how molecules organize. Herein, we report the use of subcomponent self‐assembly for the construction of anion‐coordinated quadruple helicates with high to quantitative yields. These quadruple helicates were assembled in situ from simple subcomponents through the simultaneous formation of dynamic acylhydrazone bonds and hydrogen bonds. Among them, the A 2 L 4 quadruple helicate featuring linkers of 4,4′‐methylenebis(phenyl) ( H 1 ) demonstrated the ability to encapsulate a range of cationic guests, such as TBA + and TPA + . At the same time, the templating effect of the guests was able to drive the selective formation of H 1 ⊃TBA from a dynamic combinatorial library. Notably, the incorporated acylhydrazone units function as a photoresponsive motif, enabling light‐induced release of encapsulated guests. By demonstrating subcomponent self‐assembly for constructing photoresponsive anion‐coordinated architectures, this work provides a robust strategy that paves the way for metal‐free, high‐nuclearity hydrogen‐bonded assemblies and their advanced applications in smart materials for targeted molecular delivery and release.

papers.title_zh: 阴离子配位四重螺旋体的亚组分自组装及其光诱导客体释放
papers.summary_zh: 该工作利用亚组分自组装策略，通过动态酰腙键与氢键的同步形成，原位构建了高产率至定量产率的阴离子配位四重螺旋体，其中A2L4型螺旋体可包封阳离子客体，并借助酰腙单元的光响应性实现光诱导客体释放。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在发展新的自组装策略以构建常规方法难以获得的材料，并理解分子组织原理。作者采用亚组分自组装方法，由简单亚组分通过动态酰腙键和氢键的同时形成，原位组装出阴离子配位的四重螺旋体，产率从高到定量。其中，以4,4′-亚甲基双(苯基)为连接子的A2L4四重螺旋体H1能够包封TBA+和TPA+等一系列阳离子客体。客体的模板效应可驱动从动态组合库中选择性形成H1⊃TBA。值得注意的是，嵌入的酰腙单元作为光响应基元，可实现包封客体的光诱导释放。该工作展示了亚组分自组装构建光响应阴离子配位结构的可行性，为无金属、高核数氢键组装体及其在靶向分子递送与释放智能材料中的先进应用提供了稳健策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：亚组分自组装，通过动态酰腙键和氢键的同时形成原位组装四重螺旋体；利用客体模板效应从动态组合库中选择性形成H1⊃TBA；利用酰腙单元的光响应性实现光诱导客体释放。摘要未报告具体的表征手段、光谱类型、光照条件、释放效率及定量测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装技术与框架材料组装主线，展示了亚组分自组装构建阴离子配位四重螺旋体及光响应客体释放功能，对超分子组装和智能递送材料有参考价值。但其体系为离散螺旋体而非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料，与主线的直接关联有限。若关注动态共价键、氢键组装及光响应释放机制，值得全文精读；若聚焦MOF/COF/HOF电化学合成，则相关性较低。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征方法、光照参数、释放效率、产率数值、动态组合库组成及机制证据等关键细节，仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 亚组分自组装可高产率至定量产率地构建阴离子配位四重螺旋体。
A2L4四重螺旋体H1可包封TBA+和TPA+等阳离子客体，且客体模板效应可驱动从动态组合库中选择性形成H1⊃TBA。
嵌入的酰腙单元作为光响应基元，可实现光诱导的包封客体释放。
该策略为无金属、高核数氢键组装体及其在智能材料中的应用提供了途径。

papers.title: Automated Spin‐Assisted Layer‐by‐Layer Epitaxy Produces Highly Oriented Mixed‐Linker MOF Thin Films
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Control over crystallographic orientation in metal‐organic framework (MOF) thin films is crucial for exploiting their anisotropic properties in sensing, catalysis, and separation. Achieving reproducible, highly oriented films remains challenging, especially for mixed‐linker, pillared‐layered frameworks. Here we present an automated, spin‐assisted layer‐by‐layer liquid‐phase epitaxy (LbL‐LPE) strategy that enables rapid, ambient‐condition fabrication of highly oriented, mixed‐linker MOF thin films, demonstrated for Zn 2 BDC 2 DABCO (BDC = terephthalate, DABCO = 1,4‐diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane). Correlative process monitoring by grazing‐incidence wide‐angle x‐ray scattering (GIWAXS), grazing‐angle infrared (GI‐IR) and UV‐Vis spectroscopy, contact‐angle measurements, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and time‐of‐flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (ToF‐SIMS) ensures formation of uniform films with exceptional out‐of‐plane (001) orientation (degree of orientation > 85%, Hermans orientation parameter ∼0.95) and excellent reproducibility. This strategy enables high‐throughput fabrication of orientation‐controlled MOF thin films, providing a generalizable alternative to conventional LbL approaches. The resulting highly oriented Zn 2 (BDC) 2 (DABCO) thin films retain their crystallinity after prolonged exposure to 80% and short‐term exposure up to 90% relative humidity, whereas defect‐rich films undergo rapid degradation. Thus, this reproducible, automated strategy establishes the role of crystallographic orientation in humidity stability and advances the integration of oriented MOFs into optoelectronic, sensing, and membrane devices.

papers.title_zh: 自动化旋涂辅助逐层外延制备高取向混合连接子MOF薄膜
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出自动化旋涂辅助逐层液相外延策略，在常温条件下快速制备高取向混合连接子MOF薄膜Zn2BDC2DABCO，获得优异的(001)面外取向和重现性，并揭示取向对湿度稳定性的关键作用。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是如何在混合连接子、柱撑层状框架中实现可重现的高取向MOF薄膜，以利用其各向异性用于传感、催化和分离。作者提出自动化、旋涂辅助的逐层液相外延策略，在常温条件下快速制备高取向混合连接子MOF薄膜，以Zn2BDC2DABCO为模型体系，其中BDC为对苯二甲酸，DABCO为1,4-二氮杂双环[2.2.2]辛烷。通过掠入射广角X射线散射、掠角红外、紫外-可见光谱、接触角测量、扫描电子显微镜和飞行时间二次离子质谱进行关联过程监测，确保形成均匀薄膜，具有优异的(001)面外取向，取向度大于85%，Hermans取向参数约0.95，且重现性优异。该策略可实现取向可控MOF薄膜的高通量制备，为传统逐层方法提供可推广的替代方案。所得高取向Zn2(BDC)2(DABCO)薄膜在长时间暴露于80%相对湿度和短期暴露于高达90%相对湿度后仍保持结晶性，而缺陷丰富的薄膜则快速降解。因此，该可重现的自动化策略确立了结晶取向在湿度稳定性中的作用，并推进了取向MOF在光电子、传感和膜器件中的集成。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：自动化旋涂辅助逐层液相外延，在常温条件下制备混合连接子MOF薄膜；以Zn2BDC2DABCO为模型体系；采用掠入射广角X射线散射、掠角红外、紫外-可见光谱、接触角测量、扫描电子显微镜和飞行时间二次离子质谱进行关联过程监测；进行湿度稳定性测试。摘要未报告具体前驱体浓度、旋涂参数、循环次数及器件性能测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于框架材料组装与薄膜制备主线，展示了自动化旋涂辅助逐层外延在混合连接子MOF薄膜取向控制中的价值，并建立取向与湿度稳定性的关系。对MOF薄膜器件化、传感、分离和膜应用有实际参考意义。但其体系为致密取向薄膜，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料，与电化学合成主线关联有限。若关注MOF薄膜外延组装和取向调控，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体合成条件、前驱体浓度、旋涂参数、循环次数、薄膜厚度、器件性能及湿度测试的详细条件等关键细节，仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 自动化旋涂辅助逐层液相外延可在常温条件下快速制备高取向混合连接子MOF薄膜Zn2BDC2DABCO。
所得薄膜具有优异的(001)面外取向，取向度大于85%，Hermans取向参数约0.95，且重现性优异。
高取向Zn2(BDC)2(DABCO)薄膜在长时间暴露于80%相对湿度和短期暴露于高达90%相对湿度后仍保持结晶性，而缺陷丰富的薄膜快速降解。
该策略可实现取向可控MOF薄膜的高通量制备，并推进其在光电子、传感和膜器件中的集成。

papers.title: Modulating the Pore Environment of a Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Framework for Efficient Separation of a Ternary Mixture of Methanol‐to‐Olefin Products
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Developing energy‐efficient adsorbents for one‐step purification of ethylene (C 2 H 4 ) from ternary methanol‐to‐olefins (MTO) product mixture remains highly important but essentially unexplored in hydrogen‐bonded organic frameworks (HOFs). Herein, an ultramicroporous HOF, HOF‐36, with pyridine‐functionalized pore surfaces, was synthesized from 4,4′,4″,4‴‐(pyridine‐2,3,5,6‐tetrayl)tetrabenzoic acid. According to the single‐component sorption isotherm, the activated HOF‐36 (HOF‐36a) exhibits preferential adsorption toward ethane (C 2 H 6 ) and propylene (C 3 H 6 ) over C 2 H 4 , with IAST selectivities of 1.6 for C 2 H 6 /C 2 H 4 and 13.1 for C 3 H 6 /C 2 H 4 mixtures at 298 K, where the C 3 H 6 /C 2 H 4 selectivity surpasses those of all previously reported HOFs. Dynamic breakthrough experiments demonstrate that HOF‐36a enables one‐step purification of polymer‐grade C 2 H 4 (≥ 99.99%) from binary and ternary MTO‐related hydrocarbon mixtures. Notably, HOF‐36a affords a C 2 H 4 productivity of 1.1 L kg −1 for the challenging ternary C 3 H 6 /C 2 H 6 /C 2 H 4 (33.3/33.3/33.3, v / v / v ) mixture. Moreover, the separation performance remains nearly unchanged under humid conditions and repeated breakthrough cycles. Theoretical calculations reveal that the pyridine‐functionalized pore surface strengthens the binding affinity toward C 2 H 6 and C 3 H 6 through enhanced host–guest interactions. This work demonstrates the potential of HOFs for challenging multicomponent olefin separation and highlights pore environment engineering for regulating host–guest interactions.

papers.title_zh: 调控氢键有机框架孔环境以实现甲醇制烯烃三元混合物高效分离
papers.summary_zh: 该工作合成吡啶功能化孔表面的超微孔HOF-36，通过孔环境工程增强对乙烷和丙烯的优先吸附，实现从甲醇制烯烃三元混合物中一步纯化聚合物级乙烯，并展示优异的丙烯/乙烯选择性和湿度稳定性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题是如何开发节能吸附剂，从甲醇制烯烃三元产物混合物中一步纯化乙烯，这在氢键有机框架中此前基本未被探索。作者以4,4′,4″,4‴-(吡啶-2,3,5,6-四基)四苯甲酸为构筑单元，合成了具有吡啶功能化孔表面的超微孔HOF-36。根据单组分吸附等温线，活化后的HOF-36a在298 K下对乙烷和丙烯的吸附优先于乙烯，IAST选择性为C2H6/C2H4 1.6和C3H6/C2H4 13.1，其中C3H6/C2H4选择性超过所有此前报道的HOF。动态穿透实验表明，HOF-36a可从二元和三元MTO相关烃混合物中一步纯化聚合物级C2H4（≥99.99%）。值得注意的是，对于具有挑战性的三元C3H6/C2H6/C2H4（33.3/33.3/33.3，v/v/v）混合物，HOF-36a的C2H4产率为1.1 L kg−1。此外，分离性能在潮湿条件和重复穿透循环下几乎不变。理论计算表明，吡啶功能化孔表面通过增强主客体相互作用，强化了对C2H6和C3H6的结合亲和力。该工作展示了HOF在挑战性多组分烯烃分离中的潜力，并突出了孔环境工程调控主客体相互作用的重要性。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以4,4′,4″,4‴-(吡啶-2,3,5,6-四基)四苯甲酸合成超微孔HOF-36，并活化得到HOF-36a；测定单组分吸附等温线并计算IAST选择性；进行动态穿透实验以评估二元和三元MTO相关烃混合物的分离性能；在潮湿条件和重复穿透循环下测试稳定性；通过理论计算分析主客体相互作用。摘要未报告具体合成条件、活化条件、穿透实验参数及计算细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作属于氢键有机框架与孔环境工程主线，展示了HOF在挑战性多组分烯烃分离中的潜力，并通过吡啶功能化孔表面调控主客体相互作用。对框架材料的气体吸附与分离研究有实际参考价值，尤其是C3H6/C2H4选择性超过此前HOF的定量结果。但其体系为超微孔HOF，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭MOF/COF或介孔材料，与电化学合成主线关联有限。若关注HOF孔工程和烯烃纯化，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体合成条件、活化条件、单组分吸附等温线细节、穿透实验参数、理论计算方法和湿度测试条件等关键细节，仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: HOF-36a在298 K下对C2H6/C2H4的IAST选择性为1.6，对C3H6/C2H4的IAST选择性为13.1，其中C3H6/C2H4选择性超过所有此前报道的HOF。
动态穿透实验表明HOF-36a可从二元和三元MTO相关烃混合物中一步纯化聚合物级C2H4（≥99.99%）。
对于三元C3H6/C2H6/C2H4（33.3/33.3/33.3，v/v/v）混合物，HOF-36a的C2H4产率为1.1 L kg−1。
分离性能在潮湿条件和重复穿透循环下几乎不变；理论计算表明吡啶功能化孔表面通过增强主客体相互作用强化对C2H6和C3H6的结合亲和力。

papers.title: A Modular Tecton Matrix for Mechanosynthesis of Large‐Pore Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Frameworks With Programmable Pore Environments
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hydrogen‐bonded organic frameworks (HOFs) offer versatile porous architectures, yet predictable pore expansion via tecton extension remains challenging because framework assembly is highly sensitive to solvent‐mediated crystallization. Here, we establish a mechanosynthesis‐enabled modular tecton matrix for constructing large‐pore HOFs. Pairwise combination of complementary tectons systematically generates four micro‐ and mesoporous HOFs, including G4, which is difficult to obtain by solution crystallization. These HOFs exhibit surface areas up to 1824 m 2 /g, pore apertures up to 2.4 nm, with record CO 2 and C 2 H 2 adsorption capacities for HOFs at 195 K. One‐pot incorporation of AgOTf during mechanosynthesis enables programmable pore decoration, enhancing room‐temperature C 2 H 2 uptake through stronger framework‐substrate interactions. This work establishes a modular tecton matrix enabled by mechanosynthesis as a general design and discovery strategy for constructing and functionalizing large‐pore HOFs.
institutions: SRM Institute of Science and Technology

papers.title_zh: 用于机械合成大孔氢键有机框架的模块化构筑单元矩阵及其可编程孔环境
papers.summary_zh: 该工作建立机械合成驱动的模块化构筑单元矩阵，通过互补构筑单元配对系统构建四种微孔和介孔氢键有机框架，比表面积最高达1824平方米每克，孔径最大2.4纳米，并在195K下获得氢键有机框架中创纪录的二氧化碳和乙炔吸附容量，还可一锅法引入AgOTf实现孔道可编程修饰。
papers.research_details_zh: 氢键有机框架具有多样的多孔结构，但通过构筑单元延伸实现可预测的孔扩张仍具挑战，因为框架组装对溶剂介导的结晶高度敏感。该研究针对这一问题，建立了一种机械合成赋能的模块化构筑单元矩阵，用于构建大孔氢键有机框架。通过互补构筑单元的成对组合，系统生成了四种微孔和介孔氢键有机框架，其中包括难以通过溶液结晶获得的G4。这些框架的比表面积最高达1824平方米每克，孔径最大达2.4纳米，并在195K下表现出氢键有机框架中创纪录的二氧化碳和乙炔吸附容量。此外，在机械合成过程中一锅法引入AgOTf可实现孔道可编程装饰，通过更强的框架-底物相互作用增强室温乙炔吸附。该工作确立了机械合成赋能的模块化构筑单元矩阵作为构建和功能化大孔氢键有机框架的通用设计与发现策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告采用机械合成方法构建模块化构筑单元矩阵，通过互补构筑单元的成对组合组装氢键有机框架。在机械合成过程中一锅法引入AgOTf实现孔道装饰。表征和测试包括比表面积测量、孔径测定、195K下二氧化碳和乙炔吸附容量测试以及室温乙炔吸附测试。摘要未报告具体的机械合成条件、表征仪器型号和吸附测试详细参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联介孔框架材料、氢键有机框架和自组装技术等研究主线，提出的机械合成模块化构筑单元矩阵策略为可预测孔扩张和孔环境功能化提供了新思路，且报道了创纪录的吸附容量，具有较高的参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告机械合成具体条件和孔环境调控的分子机制细节，值得全文精读以获取合成参数和结构表征信息。

这些氢键有机框架比表面积最高达1824平方米每克，孔径最大达2.4纳米。
在195K下表现出氢键有机框架中创纪录的二氧化碳和乙炔吸附容量。

papers.title: Ionic clusters as high-connectivity secondary building units for crystalline porous organic salts
papers.abstract: Abstract The solid-state assembly of crystalline porous materials is dictated by a balance between primary node–linker interactions and other weaker intermolecular forces. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) exploit highly directional and rigid coordination bonds that outweigh competing packing effects. This allows high-connectivity secondary building units (SBUs) to be assembled into a diverse range of architectures. By contrast, molecular crystals comprise weaker intermolecular interactions, making it challenging to realize porous packings with the highly connected reticular topologies achieved in MOFs. Here we introduce Coulombic aggregation as a means to generate primary SBU motifs. By suppressing intermolecular dispersion interactions, ammonium halide ion pairs aggregate into discrete multinuclear clusters that function as non-metal SBUs. Coupled with multitopic three-dimensional linkers, these ionic clusters create extended non-metal organic frameworks with diverse topologies, large voids and polar channels. This study extends reticular chemistry from directional chemical bonds to ‘soft’ ionic interactions, opening pathways to new porous materials and principles of solid-state assembly.

papers.title_zh: 离子簇作为高连接性次级构筑单元用于晶态多孔有机盐
papers.summary_zh: 该工作引入库仑聚集作为生成初级次级构筑单元基元的手段，通过抑制分子间色散相互作用，使卤化铵离子对聚集成离散多核簇，作为非金属次级构筑单元，与多齿三维连接体耦合构建具有多样拓扑、大空隙和极性通道的扩展非金属有机框架。
papers.research_details_zh: 晶态多孔材料的固态组装由初级节点-连接体相互作用与其他较弱分子间作用力之间的平衡决定。金属有机框架利用高度方向性和刚性配位键超越竞争性堆积效应，使高连接性次级构筑单元组装成多样结构。相比之下，分子晶体由较弱分子间相互作用构成，难以实现金属有机框架中高度连接的网状拓扑多孔堆积。该研究引入库仑聚集作为生成初级次级构筑单元基元的手段。通过抑制分子间色散相互作用，卤化铵离子对聚集成离散多核簇，作为非金属次级构筑单元。与多齿三维连接体耦合，这些离子簇创建了具有多样拓扑、大空隙和极性通道的扩展非金属有机框架。该研究将网状化学从方向性化学键扩展到软离子相互作用，为新型多孔材料和固态组装原理开辟了途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告采用库仑聚集策略生成初级次级构筑单元基元，通过抑制分子间色散相互作用使卤化铵离子对聚集成离散多核簇，并与多齿三维连接体耦合组装扩展非金属有机框架。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、表征方法和性能测试数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作关联框架材料组装和网状化学研究主线，提出的库仑聚集生成非金属次级构筑单元策略为多孔有机盐和框架材料的固态组装提供了新原理，具有概念创新价值。局限在于摘要未报告具体拓扑结构、孔隙率和稳定性等关键性能数据，值得全文精读以评估其实际材料性能。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征细节、数值或机制。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、拓扑类型、比表面积、孔径数值和稳定性数据，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过抑制分子间色散相互作用，卤化铵离子对聚集成离散多核簇，可作为非金属次级构筑单元。
离子簇与多齿三维连接体耦合，构建出具有多样拓扑、大空隙和极性通道的扩展非金属有机框架。
该研究将网状化学从方向性化学键扩展到软离子相互作用，提出了新的固态组装原理。

papers.title: Interface engineering of mesoporous SnO2/TiO2 heterojunction with tailored defects for light-motivated gas sensor
papers.abstract: Abstract The convergence of embodied intelligence, neuromorphic computing, and the Internet of Things has propelled intelligent gas sensors to the forefront of artificial olfaction, enabling adaptive, context-aware, and biologically inspired odor perception. Tailoring active sites or defects in sensing materials is an efficient strategy to confer selective gas-surface recognition constitutes for amplifying sensor sensitivity. Herein, a facile ligand-mediated interfacial co-assembly strategy was developed to construct mesoporous crystalline SnO2/TiO2 composites, which enables a composition-dependent structural evolution from Sn-substituted TiO2 solid solutions to well-defined n-n heterojunctions. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that Sn4+ ions can be substitutionally incorporated into the TiO2 lattice to form charge-balanced Sn-O-Ti bridging units, whereas excessive Sn induces spontaneous phase separation to establish SnO2/TiO2 heterojunctions. The optimized mesoporous hybrids exhibit ∼22-fold higher photocurrent and ∼4-fold stronger light-motivated ethanol sensing response than pristine mesoporous TiO2 under identical conditions. The outstanding performance was attributed to the site-selective doping that effectively tune the local electronic structure and promote the efficient separation and directional transport of photogenerated charges. In-situ doping allows for the tailoring engineering of the pore wall chemical microenvironment, affording an active interface conducive to target gas adsorption and detection reactions. This study establishes a design paradigm for coupling surface reactivity regulation with charge transfer engineering in light-activated gas sensors.

papers.title_zh: 具有定制缺陷的介孔SnO2/TiO2异质结界面工程用于光驱动气体传感器

papers.research_details_zh: 该研究针对智能气体传感器对选择性气体-表面识别和灵敏度放大的需求，开发了一种配体介导的界面共组装策略，构建介孔晶态SnO2/TiO2复合材料。该策略可实现组成依赖的结构演化，从Sn取代TiO2固溶体转变为明确的n-n异质结。密度泛函理论计算揭示，Sn4+离子可取代掺入TiO2晶格形成电荷平衡的Sn-O-Ti桥连单元，而过量Sn诱导自发相分离建立SnO2/TiO2异质结。优化后的介孔杂化物在相同条件下光电流比原始介孔TiO2提高约22倍，光驱动乙醇传感响应增强约4倍。优异性能归因于位点选择性掺杂有效调控局部电子结构并促进光生电荷的高效分离和定向传输。原位掺杂可定制孔壁化学微环境，提供有利于目标气体吸附和检测反应的活性界面。该研究建立了光激活气体传感器中表面反应性调控与电荷转移工程耦合的设计范式。

papers.title: Dynamic Electrophoretic Assembly Coupled With Water‐Splitting‐Induced pH Control Enables Precision Ion Sieving Membranes
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Discriminating among monovalent ions of similar charge and size, such as Li + , Na + , and K + , remains one of the most persistent challenges in separation science. Here we present a green, external‐acid‐free route to fabricate defect‐free covalent organic framework (COF)‐based thin‐film composite (TFC) membranes for high precision monovalent‐ion sieving. The method relies on a dynamic electric‐field‐assisted strategy in which an alternating electric field couples electrophoretic monomer assembly at the surface of an ion‐exchange membrane (IEM) substrate with spatiotemporally resolved delivery of hydronium ions generated in situ via water splitting. This localized in situ‐generated acid pulse initiates interfacial condensation into primary COF nuclei, which subsequently undergo continuous growth and fusion into a uniform ultrathin film through a self‐healing mechanism. The proposed membrane formation strategy effectively suppresses non‐selective transport pathways and enables rapid formation of highly selective ion‐transport channels, resulting in a membrane with near‐complete fractionation of Li + from other monovalent ions (e.g., K + and Na + ), while preserving fast ion permeation that exceeds that of previously reported membranes. The governing ion separation mechanism is elucidated as hydration‐shell restructuring under electrostatic confinement. The work establishes a scalable and energy‐efficient platform for precision ion separation and opens new opportunities for membrane‐based resource recovery and molecular purification.

papers.title_zh: 动态电泳组装耦合水分解诱导pH控制实现精密离子筛分膜
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种无外加酸、绿色的动态电场辅助策略，将电泳单体组装与水分解原位产生的酸脉冲耦合，在离子交换膜基底上快速生长无缺陷超薄COF薄膜，实现Li+与Na+、K+等单价离子的近完全分离，同时保持快速离子渗透。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对电荷与尺寸相近的单价离子（Li+、Na+、K+）分离难题，提出一种绿色、无需外加酸的共价有机框架（COF）基薄膜复合（TFC）膜制备路线。设计策略为动态电场辅助组装：交变电场驱动电泳单体在离子交换膜（IEM）基底表面组装，同时通过水分解在时空上可控地原位产生水合氢离子，形成局部酸脉冲，引发界面缩合生成初级COF晶核，随后通过自愈合机制持续生长并融合为均匀超薄膜。该策略有效抑制非选择性传输通道，快速形成高选择性离子传输通道。所得膜实现Li+与其他单价离子（如K+、Na+）的近完全分离，且离子渗透速率超过此前报道的膜。分离机制被阐明为静电限域下的水合壳层重构。该工作为精密离子分离提供了可放大、节能的平台，并为膜基资源回收与分子纯化开辟新机会。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：动态电场辅助组装策略，采用交变电场耦合电泳单体在离子交换膜（IEM）基底表面组装；通过水分解原位产生水合氢离子形成局部酸脉冲，引发界面缩合并经自愈合机制生长融合为超薄COF膜；对所得膜进行单价离子分离性能测试，并阐明静电限域下的水合壳层重构机制。摘要未报告具体表征手段、电场参数、膜厚度及定量渗透/选择性数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共价有机框架（COF）薄膜的电场辅助组装与电化学合成主线，展示动态电泳组装与水分解原位pH控制耦合制备无缺陷超薄COF膜，对框架材料组装与膜分离应用具有实际参考价值。其局限在于摘要未给出具体电场条件、膜结构表征与定量性能数据，若关注COF膜精密离子筛分及电化学组装机制，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要级信息，摘要未报告具体电场参数、水分解条件、COF结构表征、膜厚度、定量离子选择性/渗透速率数值及自愈合机制的直接证据，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 所得COF基TFC膜实现Li+与K+、Na+等其他单价离子的近完全分离，同时保持快速离子渗透，渗透速率超过此前报道的膜。
分离机制被阐明为静电限域下的水合壳层重构。
动态电场辅助组装耦合水分解原位产酸，可抑制非选择性传输通道并快速形成高选择性离子传输通道。
该策略为绿色、无外加酸、可放大且节能的精密离子分离平台。

papers.title: Flow-Guided Chemical Language Modeling for Linker Design in Reticular Chemistry
papers.abstract: Abstract Reticular chemistry has enabled the synthesis of tens of thousands of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), yet the discovery of new materials still relies largely on intuition-driven linker design and iterative experimentation. As a result, researchers explore only a small fraction of the vast chemical space accessible to reticular materials, limiting the systematic discovery of frameworks with targeted properties. Here, we introduce NexerraR1, a building-block chemical language model that enables inverse design in reticular chemistry through targeted generation of organic linkers. Rather than generating complete frameworks directly, Nexerra operates at the level of molecular building blocks, preserving the modular logic that underpins reticular synthesis. The model supports both unconstrained generation of low-connectivity linkers and scaffold-constrained design of symmetric multidentate motifs compatible with predefined nodes and topologies. We further combine linker generation with flow-guided distributional targeting to steer the generative process toward application-relevant objectives while maintaining chemical validity and assembly feasibility. The generated linkers are subsequently assembled into three-dimensional frameworks and structurally optimized to produce candidate materials compatible with experimental synthesis. Using NexerraR1, we validate this strategy by rediscovering known MOFs and by proposing the experimental synthesis of a previously unreported framework, CU-525, generated in silico. Together, these results establish a controllable building-block-level design framework for reticular chemistry in which chemical language modeling enables the direct translation from computational design to synthesizable frameworks.

papers.title_zh: 面向网状化学连接体设计的流引导化学语言建模
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出NexerraR1建筑单元化学语言模型，在分子连接体层面进行逆设计，支持无约束生成低连接性连接体及骨架约束设计对称多齿基元，并结合流引导分布靶向优化，实现从计算设计到可合成框架的转化，重新发现已知MOF并提出新框架CU-525。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对网状化学中MOF发现主要依赖直觉驱动连接体设计与迭代实验、仅探索巨大化学空间一小部分的问题，提出NexerraR1建筑单元化学语言模型，实现网状化学的逆设计。该模型不直接生成完整框架，而是在分子建筑单元层面操作，保留网状合成的模块化逻辑，支持无约束生成低连接性连接体，以及骨架约束设计兼容预定节点与拓扑的对称多齿基元。研究进一步将连接体生成与流引导分布靶向结合，在保持化学有效性与组装可行性的同时，将生成过程导向应用相关目标。生成的连接体随后被组装为三维框架并进行结构优化，产生与实验合成兼容的候选材料。通过重新发现已知MOF并提议在计算机中生成此前未报道框架CU-525的实验合成，验证了该策略。该工作建立了建筑单元层面可控的网状化学设计框架，使化学语言建模能够直接将计算设计转化为可合成框架。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：构建建筑单元化学语言模型NexerraR1进行连接体逆设计；支持无约束生成低连接性连接体与骨架约束设计对称多齿基元；结合流引导分布靶向 steering 生成过程；将生成连接体组装为三维框架并进行结构优化；通过重新发现已知MOF及在计算机中生成CU-525并提议实验合成进行验证。摘要未报告具体模型架构、训练数据、流引导算法细节及合成表征方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作关联网状化学与框架材料设计主线，将化学语言建模用于连接体逆设计，为MOF等框架材料的计算到可合成转化提供新思路，对框架材料组装与设计具有参考价值。其局限在于摘要未给出模型性能指标、生成连接体数量及CU-525的具体结构与性质，若关注AI辅助框架设计值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要级信息，摘要未报告模型架构、训练数据规模、生成成功率、CU-525的具体结构/性质及实验合成验证细节，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: NexerraR1在分子建筑单元层面实现逆设计，保留网状合成的模块化逻辑，支持无约束生成低连接性连接体及骨架约束设计对称多齿基元。
结合流引导分布靶向可引导生成过程趋向应用相关目标，同时保持化学有效性与组装可行性。
生成的连接体可组装为三维框架并结构优化，产生与实验合成兼容的候选材料。
通过重新发现已知MOF并提议此前未报道框架CU-525的实验合成，验证了该策略。

papers.title: Helical Single Crystals of Porous Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Frameworks as a Candidate for Morphologically Functional Organic Materials
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Modulation and control of the crystalline morphology of porous materials are important for their functionality yet remain underdeveloped. In this study, we report the first example of a porous hydrogen‐bonded organic framework (HOF) with helical crystalline morphology. The helical HOF was prepared using pyrene‐based tetracarboxylic acid. The formation of helical‐shaped and needle‐shaped crystals of the HOFs can be controlled by the solvent evaporation rate and temperature during heating. X‐ray diffraction analysis indicates that both crystals have the same layered porous structure. Based on these data and theoretical calculations, we propose the hypothesis that certain structural defects are locally generated, which induces nonuniform crystal growth and consequently results in the formation of the helical crystals. The obtained HOFs exhibit thermal stability and permanent porosity with Brunauer‐Emmett‐Teller (BET) surface area up to 1602 m 2 g −1 . Interestingly, the helical HOFs exhibited dynamic expansion and contraction through the desorption and adsorption of a guest solvent. Moreover, doping with a second component in the helical HOF enables the modulation of fluorescence properties and crystalline morphology into a double helix. These results highlight the potential of a new category of organic materials: helical porous crystals and morphologically functional organic materials.

papers.title_zh: 多孔氢键有机框架螺旋单晶作为形貌功能有机材料候选者
papers.summary_zh: 该研究首次报道具有螺旋晶体形貌的多孔氢键有机框架（HOF），以芘基四羧酸制备，通过溶剂蒸发速率与加热温度调控螺旋形与针形晶体，两者具相同层状多孔结构，BET比表面积最高达1602 m2 g−1，螺旋HOF展现客体脱附/吸附的动态膨胀收缩及掺杂调控荧光与双螺旋形貌。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究关注多孔材料晶体形貌的调控与控制对其功能化的重要性，但该方向仍不发达。研究以芘基四羧酸为构筑单元，报道了首个具有螺旋晶体形貌的多孔氢键有机框架（HOF）。通过控制加热过程中的溶剂蒸发速率与温度，可调控HOF形成螺旋形或针形晶体。X射线衍射分析表明两种晶体具有相同的层状多孔结构。基于这些数据与理论计算，作者提出假设：局部生成某些结构缺陷，诱导非均匀晶体生长，从而导致螺旋晶体形成。所得HOF具有热稳定性与永久孔隙率，BET比表面积最高达1602 m2 g−1。螺旋HOF通过客体溶剂的脱附与吸附表现出动态膨胀与收缩。此外，在螺旋HOF中掺杂第二组分可将荧光性质与晶体形貌调控为双螺旋。该结果凸显了一类新型有机材料——螺旋多孔晶体与形貌功能有机材料的潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以芘基四羧酸为构筑单元制备HOF；通过控制加热过程中溶剂蒸发速率与温度调控螺旋形与针形晶体；采用X射线衍射分析晶体结构；结合理论计算提出结构缺陷诱导非均匀生长形成螺旋晶体的假设；测定热稳定性与BET比表面积；考察客体溶剂脱附/吸附引起的动态膨胀收缩；通过掺杂第二组分调控荧光性质与晶体形貌。摘要未报告具体合成条件、掺杂组分及荧光定量数据。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联氢键有机框架（HOF）与框架材料自组装主线，首次展示多孔HOF的螺旋晶体形貌及其形貌依赖功能，对框架材料晶体生长调控与形貌功能化具有实际参考价值。其局限在于摘要未给出具体合成条件、缺陷直接证据及荧光定量数据，若关注HOF形貌调控与动态响应值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要级信息，摘要未报告具体合成条件、溶剂蒸发速率与温度数值、结构缺陷的直接表征证据、掺杂组分及荧光定量数据，这些关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 首次报道具有螺旋晶体形貌的多孔氢键有机框架（HOF），以芘基四羧酸制备。
通过溶剂蒸发速率与加热温度可调控螺旋形与针形晶体，X射线衍射表明两者具有相同层状多孔结构。
所得HOF具热稳定性与永久孔隙率，BET比表面积最高达1602 m2 g−1。
螺旋HOF通过客体溶剂脱附/吸附表现动态膨胀收缩；掺杂第二组分可调控荧光性质与晶体形貌为双螺旋。

papers.title: Machine Learning and Molecular Simulations Reveal Mechanisms of ZIFs Polymorph Selection
papers.abstract: metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) exhibit a remarkable degree of polymorphism. Because of their promising industrial applications, many research groups have investigated phase transitions, phase diagram and relative stability of these polymorphs. There is now wide consensus in the research community that these MOFs are solvothermally formed via non-classical nucleation mechanisms, in which pre-nucleation clusters are first formed, followed by an intermediate amorphous structure that subsequently reorganizes to yield the final crystalline MOF. However, no study up to date has uncovered which part of the synthesis process determines the final polymorph obtained. In this work, path collective variable metadynamics simulations performed with a partially reactive force field give insights into mechanistic and thermodynamic aspects of the self-assembly of these MOFs. Databases of transient and intermediate synthesis structures are built from the simulations. By developing and applying neural network classifiers over these databases, it is found that both pre-nucleation clusters and the amorphous intermediate structures are polymorph-dependent. These results suggest possible self-assembly pathways in which pre-nucleation clusters already exhibit polymorph-dependent structural features.

papers.title_zh: 机器学习与分子模拟揭示ZIFs多晶型选择机制
papers.summary_zh: 该工作通过路径集合变量元动力学模拟结合神经网络分类器，研究ZIFs自组装过程，发现预成核团簇与无定形中间体均具有多晶型依赖性，提示预成核团簇阶段已决定最终多晶型选择。
papers.research_details_zh: 金属有机框架存在显著多晶型现象，学界普遍认为其经非经典成核机制形成，即先形成预成核团簇，再经无定形中间体重组为最终晶体，但此前尚无研究揭示合成过程中哪一阶段决定最终多晶型。本文采用部分反应力场进行路径集合变量元动力学模拟，从模拟中构建瞬态与中间合成结构数据库，并开发和应用神经网络分类器分析这些数据库。研究发现预成核团簇和无定形中间体结构均具有多晶型依赖性，据此提出可能的自组装路径，其中预成核团簇已表现出多晶型依赖的结构特征。该工作为理解MOF多晶型选择的机制与热力学层面提供了新视角。
papers.methods_zh: 采用部分反应力场进行路径集合变量元动力学模拟，研究MOF自组装机制与热力学；从模拟中构建瞬态和中间合成结构数据库；开发并应用神经网络分类器对数据库进行分析。摘要未报告具体表征手段和实验合成方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联框架材料自组装与成核机制研究主线，为理解MOF多晶型选择提供了计算层面的机制证据，对介孔导电MOF及框架材料可控合成具有参考价值。但研究为模拟工作，摘要未报告实验验证，建议结合全文评估其与实验体系的关联度。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅基于摘要信息，模拟参数、力场细节、数据库规模、分类器性能及实验验证等关键细节需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 预成核团簇和无定形中间体结构均表现出多晶型依赖性。
提出可能的自组装路径，其中预成核团簇已具有多晶型依赖的结构特征。
摘要未报告具体定量数值或能量数据。

papers.title: Bio‐Inspired Janus All‐Nanofiber Self‐Powered Electronic Skins for Multifunctional, High‐Resolution, Artifact‐Free Human–Machine Interface
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Artificial skins combining sustainable tactile sensing and high‐precision contextual interaction could transform medical devices and robotics yet developing body‐integrated systems that are electrically stable, comfortable, and scalable remain challenging. We develop a heterogeneous Janus e‐skin enabled by gel‐fiber‐mediated interlayer adhesion and co‐design of materials, structure, and architecture. An engineered polyurethane ionogel (PUIL) coupled with an elastic SBS scaffold redistributes mechanical stress. Hydrogen bonding and ion‐dipole interactions immobilize the liquid metal (LM) conductor to form a reconfigurable interface. Consequently, interleaved conductive, strain‐insensitive nanofiber electrodes mitigate LM migration and leakage and exhibit exceptional long‐term electrical stability, withstanding 400% strain with minimal resistance change (R/R 0 ≈ 1.07). The bonding interlayer and hierarchically porous Janus membrane create a surface‐energy gradient that promotes air permeability and unidirectional moisture transport, thereby improving comfort and cycling durability. Additionally, the Janus fibrous membrane mitigates strain/thermal/moisture‐induced signal distortion, ensuring stable bioelectrical feedback and bolstering the robustness of machine‐learning‐assisted decoding in self‐powered human–machine interactions. Remarkably, the e‐skin exhibits excellent scalable bioinspired multifunctional protection, enabling seamless module integration for electromagnetic shielding and on‐demand thermal management. This work paves the way for next‐generation human–machine interfaces by demonstrating a holistic strategy that achieves wearer comfort, multifunctional integration, and multi‐scenario AI interaction.

papers.title_zh: 仿生Janus全纳米纤维自供电电子皮肤用于多功能高分辨率无伪影人机接口
papers.summary_zh: 该工作开发了基于凝胶纤维介导层间粘附的异质Janus电子皮肤，通过材料结构架构协同设计实现应变不敏感导电纳米纤维电极、透气单向导湿及多功能集成，用于自供电人机交互。
papers.research_details_zh: 人工皮肤需兼顾可持续触觉传感与高精度情境交互，但兼具电学稳定、舒适和可扩展的身体集成系统仍具挑战。本文开发了一种异质Janus电子皮肤，通过凝胶纤维介导的层间粘附及材料、结构、架构协同设计实现。工程化聚氨酯离子凝胶与弹性SBS支架耦合以重新分布机械应力，氢键和离子偶极相互作用固定液态金属导体形成可重构界面。交错排列的导电、应变不敏感纳米纤维电极抑制液态金属迁移和泄漏，展现优异长期电学稳定性。粘合中间层和分级多孔Janus膜形成表面能梯度，促进透气性和单向水分传输。Janus纤维膜还减轻应变、热和湿度引起的信号失真，确保稳定生物电反馈并增强机器学习辅助解码鲁棒性。该电子皮肤还实现电磁屏蔽和按需热管理等多功能集成。
papers.methods_zh: 采用凝胶纤维介导层间粘附构建异质Janus膜；工程化聚氨酯离子凝胶与弹性SBS支架耦合；利用氢键和离子偶极相互作用固定液态金属导体；制备交错导电纳米纤维电极；进行拉伸电学测试（400%应变下电阻变化）、透气性和水分传输测试、生物电信号采集及机器学习辅助解码。摘要未报告具体合成条件和表征仪器。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作涉及分级多孔膜、导电纳米纤维和自组装界面设计，与介孔材料和框架材料组装主线有一定交叉，但其核心为柔性电子皮肤而非框架材料。对导电材料界面工程和自供电传感有参考价值，但非框架材料研究核心，建议根据具体需求选择性精读。

papers.title: Conjugated Hydrazide‐Mediated Precursor Coordination Regulation Enables Uniform Crystallization of Tin‐Lead Perovskites
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Narrow‐bandgap tin‐lead (Sn‐Pb) mixed perovskites are important materials for advancing single‐junction photovoltaics toward their theoretical efficiency limit. However, their inherent asynchronous crystallization triggers severe morphological inhomogeneity and generates a high defect density, which limits the performance and long‐term stability of devices. Unlike conventional Lewis base strategies that predominantly focus on direct bonding effects for simple defect passivation, we propose a strategy for precursor colloidal regulation mediated by aromatic conjugated hydrazide derivatives. Extending the conjugation length of the hydrazide molecular framework established preferential coordination interactions between the additive and SnI 2 precursor. This preferential complexation alleviated the aggregation of perovskite clusters and inhibited the rapid precipitation of Sn species, while simultaneously suggesting a lowered apparent heterogeneous nucleation energy barrier on the substrate. This approach achieved uniform and balanced Sn/Pb crystallization kinetics, which enabled the formation of compact, pinhole‐free perovskite films. The optimal device modified with 2‐naphthoylhydrazine delivered a power conversion efficiency of 24.16%, along with significantly enhanced operational stability, which retained 88.2% of its initial efficiency after 1200 h of continuous illumination. This work offers novel insights into precisely regulating the crystallization of narrow‐bandgap Sn‐Pb perovskites to enable the development of efficient and stable perovskite photovoltaics.

papers.title_zh: 共轭酰肼介导的前驱体配位调控实现锡铅钙钛矿均匀结晶
papers.summary_zh: 该工作提出芳香共轭酰肼衍生物介导前驱体胶体调控策略，通过延长共轭长度增强与SnI2的优先配位，抑制Sn物种快速沉淀，实现均匀Sn/Pb结晶，最优器件效率达24.16%。
papers.research_details_zh: 窄带隙锡铅混合钙钛矿是推动单结光伏接近理论效率极限的重要材料，但其固有异步结晶导致严重形貌不均匀和高缺陷密度，限制器件性能和长期稳定性。不同于传统Lewis碱策略主要关注直接键合效应进行简单缺陷钝化，本文提出芳香共轭酰肼衍生物介导的前驱体胶体调控策略。延长酰肼分子骨架共轭长度可建立添加剂与SnI2前驱体之间的优先配位相互作用，这种优先络合缓解了钙钛矿团簇聚集并抑制Sn物种快速沉淀，同时表明基底上表观异质成核能垒降低。该方法实现均匀平衡的Sn/Pb结晶动力学，形成致密无针孔钙钛矿薄膜。经2-萘甲酰肼修饰的最优器件功率转换效率达24.16%，连续光照1200小时后保持初始效率的88.2%。
papers.methods_zh: 采用芳香共轭酰肼衍生物作为添加剂进行前驱体胶体调控；通过延长共轭长度调控与SnI2的配位相互作用；制备锡铅混合钙钛矿薄膜及光伏器件；进行功率转换效率测试和连续光照稳定性测试（1200小时）。摘要未报告具体表征手段如XRD、SEM或光谱分析细节。

papers.title: Ligand‐Dependent Electronic Modulation of Conjugated Metal–Organic Frameworks Enables Efficient Electrocatalytic Nitric Oxide Reduction to Ammonia
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Electrochemical reduction of ammonia represents a highly promising approach for transforming harmful environmental pollutants into more valuable products. In this study, we successfully achieved precise control over the environment surrounding single‐atom Ni sites by modifying functional groups on ligands. To validate this strategy, we constructed two similar hollow Ni‐MOFs. The metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) containing the p‐type tetraazanaphthotetraphene ligand (Ni‐TT) demonstrated exceptional performance compared to n‐type triphenylene (Ni‐TP). Its overall reduction rate reached 196.9 µmol·h −1 ·cm 2 , with a Faraday efficiency as high as 90.9% at −0.4 V versus RHE. The exceptional performance of Ni‐TT stems from the p‐type tetranaphthalenetetracene ligand, which is nitrogen‐rich and electron‐deficient. The electronic properties of the ligand significantly influence the coordination environment around the single‐atom Ni site, enabling precise control over proton‐transfer behavior during the reaction. Theoretical calculations also indicate that hydrogen adsorption on p‐type Ni‐TT surfaces accelerates hydrogen transfer at Ni active sites compared to n‐type Ni‐TP. This significantly enhances the rate‐determining step (RDS) in the NO hydrogenation process. The constructed Ni‐TT‐based Zn‐NO battery achieved a power density of 2.1 mW cm −2 . These results provide insight into how conjugated ligand structures modulate the electronic structure and hydrogenation behavior, which may guide future studies on MOF‐based electrocatalysts for nitric oxide reduction reaction (NORR).
