papers.title_zh: 配体依赖的共轭金属有机框架电子调控实现高效电催化一氧化氮还原制氨
papers.summary_zh: 通过配体官能团调控单原子Ni位点环境，构建两种中空Ni-MOF。富氮缺电子的p型Ni-TT在-0.4 V vs RHE下产氨速率达196.9 µmol·h⁻¹·cm⁻²，法拉第效率90.9%，并组装Zn-NO电池实现2.1 mW cm⁻²功率密度。
papers.research_details_zh: 本研究针对电催化一氧化氮还原制氨中催化剂电子结构调控问题，提出通过配体官能团修饰来精确控制单原子Ni位点配位环境的策略。研究构建了两种结构相似的中空Ni-MOF：含p型四氮杂萘并四苯配体的Ni-TT和含n型三亚苯配体的Ni-TP。系统比较了两者的电催化NORR性能，发现Ni-TT性能显著优于Ni-TP。机理上，p型配体富氮且缺电子，显著影响单原子Ni位点周围的配位环境，从而精确调控反应中的质子转移行为。理论计算表明，p型Ni-TT表面上的氢吸附加速了Ni活性位点的氢转移，相比n型Ni-TP显著增强了NO加氢过程的决速步。此外，基于Ni-TT构建的Zn-NO电池实现了2.1 mW cm⁻²的功率密度。该工作揭示了共轭配体结构如何调控电子结构和加氢行为，为MOF基NORR电催化剂设计提供指导。

papers.title: Modulating the Pore Environment of a Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Framework for Efficient Separation of a Ternary Mixture of Methanol‐to‐Olefin Products
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Developing energy‐efficient adsorbents for one‐step purification of ethylene (C 2 H 4 ) from ternary methanol‐to‐olefins (MTO) product mixture remains highly important but essentially unexplored in hydrogen‐bonded organic frameworks (HOFs). Herein, an ultramicroporous HOF, HOF‐36, with pyridine‐functionalized pore surfaces, was synthesized from 4,4′,4″,4‴‐(pyridine‐2,3,5,6‐tetrayl)tetrabenzoic acid. According to the single‐component sorption isotherm, the activated HOF‐36 (HOF‐36a) exhibits preferential adsorption toward ethane (C 2 H 6 ) and propylene (C 3 H 6 ) over C 2 H 4 , with IAST selectivities of 1.6 for C 2 H 6 /C 2 H 4 and 13.1 for C 3 H 6 /C 2 H 4 mixtures at 298 K, where the C 3 H 6 /C 2 H 4 selectivity surpasses those of all previously reported HOFs. Dynamic breakthrough experiments demonstrate that HOF‐36a enables one‐step purification of polymer‐grade C 2 H 4 (≥ 99.99%) from binary and ternary MTO‐related hydrocarbon mixtures. Notably, HOF‐36a affords a C 2 H 4 productivity of 1.1 L kg −1 for the challenging ternary C 3 H 6 /C 2 H 6 /C 2 H 4 (33.3/33.3/33.3, v / v / v ) mixture. Moreover, the separation performance remains nearly unchanged under humid conditions and repeated breakthrough cycles. Theoretical calculations reveal that the pyridine‐functionalized pore surface strengthens the binding affinity toward C 2 H 6 and C 3 H 6 through enhanced host–guest interactions. This work demonstrates the potential of HOFs for challenging multicomponent olefin separation and highlights pore environment engineering for regulating host–guest interactions.

papers.title: Engineering Directional Ion Transport Channels in Three‐Dimensional Covalent Organic Frameworks for High‐Performance Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) with abundant redox‐active sites are promising electrode materials for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs). However, conventional design strategies are often limited by sluggish Na + transport and low utilization of active sites. Here, we report a pair of 3D COFs (COF‐O and COF‐H). In COF‐O, the C═O groups are precisely oriented toward the pore channels, allowing the O atoms to serve as effective Na + storage sites. In contrast, COF‐H contains only C–H groups within the pores, which lack Na + storage capability. When employed as an anode material in SIBs, COF‐O exhibits a high specific capacity of 318 mAh/g (1.9 times that of COF‐H) and excellent cycling stability over 6000 cycles. In situ spectroscopic studies combined with theoretical calculations reveal that the C═O groups in COF‐O act as efficient Na + storage sites, effectively enhancing the capacity and accelerating Na + transport kinetics. This work demonstrates that precisely orienting functional groups in 3D COFs can create effective ion transport channels, providing a promising strategy for designing advanced organic electrode materials for SIBs.

papers.title_zh: 在三维共价有机框架中构建定向离子传输通道用于高性能钠离子电池

COF-H孔道内仅含C–H基团，缺乏Na+存储能力，说明功能基团定向对性能的关键作用。

papers.title: Ultrasound-Synchronized In Situ Crystallization Locks Transient High-Activity Enzyme Conformations within Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Abstract Enzymes transiently access high-activity conformations with exposed cryptic sites and heightened substrate affinity, yet these states dissipate upon relaxation to the thermodynamic ground state once the activating perturbation is removed, leaving this catalytic potential largely inaccessible. Here we show that such fleeting conformations can be captured by synchronizing enzyme activation with host crystallization in a single sonochemical process, where ultrasound simultaneously drives enzymes into open conformations and promotes aqueous crystallization of covalent organic frameworks that grow around and lock the activated proteins before relaxation occurs. Using a library of six frameworks with systematically varied pore sizes and chemistries, we find that effective locking requires both tight steric confinement and abundant nonbonded interactions. The optimal framework increased the catalytic activity of horseradish peroxidase by 3.4-fold, primarily through a marked reduction in the Michaelis constant, while retaining &gt;70% activity over 10 catalytic cycles. Molecular dynamics simulations identify the captured species as a globally reorganized open state defined by displacement of gating phenylalanine residues, while high-resolution 2D solid-state NMR analysis further elucidates the COF-enzyme interfacial interactions that stabilize this otherwise metastable conformation. Moreover, ex situ controls in which activation precedes encapsulation fail entirely, establishing that temporal synchrony between conformational opening and framework crystallization is mechanistically essential. Extending this strategy to laccase, cytochrome c, and lipase enhanced immobilized enzyme activity by 3.8-fold, 2.7-fold, and 1.5-fold over conventional stirring. This work reframes enzyme immobilization from passive protection to active conformational upgrading, enabling a general strategy to harvest transient functional states beyond equilibrium reach.

papers.title: High-dimensional inverse design enables multiple synthesis routes to prescribed carbon nanotube array descriptors
papers.abstract: Abstract Prescribed synthesis of carbon nanotube (CNT) arrays remains challenging because multiple processing stages jointly regulate array height (H), density (ρ), and orientational order (HOF), creating a nonlinear and non-unique relationship between structural targets and synthesis conditions. Here, we develop an Multilayer perceptron–Differential dvolution (MLP–DE) inverse design framework that searches for an eight-dimensional process space for multiple separated recipes rather than a single optimum. The framework was established from 200 unique water-assisted CVD recipes and evaluated across three prescribed H–ρ–HOF targets. Of 27 independent validation batches, 26 achieved descriptor matching scores above 95%. Importantly, recipes that reached similar array-level states retained variations in CNT diameters and wall structures, showing that comparable macroscopic outcomes can arise from different nanoscale structural realizations. These results challenge the conventional assumption that a prescribed CNT-array state must be approached through progressive refinement around a single local process window. Instead, the same target state can be accessed from multiple separate regions of process space. This descriptor-level route degeneracy reframes inverse synthesis from locating one optimum to resolving multiple experimentally accessible solutions, providing greater design freedom for the controlled synthesis of complex nanomaterials.

papers.title_zh: 高维逆向设计实现多种合成路线通向预设碳纳米管阵列描述符
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发MLP–DE逆向设计框架，在八维工艺空间中搜索多种分离配方而非单一最优解。基于200个水辅助CVD配方建立，在三个预设H–ρ–HOF目标上评估，27个独立验证批次中26个描述符匹配得分超过95%。相似阵列状态可保留碳纳米管直径与壁结构差异，表明同一目标状态可从工艺空间多个分离区域获得。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对碳纳米管阵列预设合成难题：多个加工阶段共同调控阵列高度（H）、密度（ρ）和取向有序度（HOF），导致结构目标与合成条件之间呈非线性且非唯一关系。作者开发了多层感知机–差分进化（MLP–DE）逆向设计框架，在八维工艺空间中搜索多种分离配方而非单一最优解。该框架基于200个独特的水辅助CVD配方建立，并在三个预设H–ρ–HOF目标上评估。在27个独立验证批次中，26个达到描述符匹配得分超过95%。重要的是，达到相似阵列级状态的配方在碳纳米管直径和壁结构上仍保留差异，表明可比的宏观结果可源于不同的纳米级结构实现。这些结果挑战了预设碳纳米管阵列状态必须通过围绕单一局部工艺窗口逐步细化来逼近的传统假设；相反，同一目标状态可从工艺空间的多个分离区域获得。这种描述符层面的路线简并性将逆向合成从定位单一最优解重新定义为解析多个实验可及解，为复杂纳米材料的可控合成提供更大设计自由度。

papers.title: Bowl-shaped Janus mesoporous silica nanomotors: active drug delivery and oxygen modulation for boosting bacterial keratitis treatment
papers.abstract: Abstract Bacterial keratitis is a primary cause of corneal blindness, with its clinical treatment hampered by inadequate drug penetration into the deep corneal stroma and the growing emergence of antibiotic resistance. Corneal collagen cross-linking (CXL), a promising non-antibiotic strategy relying on riboflavin (RF) photosensitization and UV-induced stromal stiffening, is limited by poor bioavailability and diminished efficacy in infection-induced hypoxic microenvironments. Herein, we fabricate a self-propelled nanomotor system based on bowl-shaped Janus mesoporous SiO2 nanoparticles via ZIF-8-templated in situ masking, for active ocular drug delivery and spatiotemporal oxygen modulation. The nanomotors possess an open hemispherical architecture with abundant mesopores for efficient RF loading; catalase (CAT) is asymmetrically anchored on their outer surface via regioselective functionalization, forming a Janus structure that enables spatially controlled catalysis and directional propulsion. In antibiotic-resistant lesions, CAT catalyzes endogenous H2O2 to generate O2, driving autonomous nanomotor motion while alleviating hypoxia. This propulsion boosts trans-corneal penetration and stromal drug delivery, and sustained RF release combined with localized oxygenation restores CXL efficacy under hypoxia. This work thus presents a microenvironment-responsive nanoplatform with well-defined structure that integrates active drug delivery and oxygen modulation, overcoming key therapeutic barriers in bacterial keratitis and holding great translational potential for precision ocular nanomedicine.

papers.title: Biological growth self-assembly of mycelia enables eco-friendly full-color room-temperature phosphorescence materials via internalized confinement
papers.abstract: Abstract Preparing room-temperature phosphorescence (RTP) materials via biological growth processes presents an attractive yet rarely explored strategy. Herein, we report a facile and sustainable biological growth self-assembly strategy for preparing mycelia of Trametes pubescens (MTP) that exhibit RTP. During fungal growth, sulfonic acid chromophores (SACs) with various degrees of π conjugation are readily internalized into mycelial pellets through hydrogen bonding and confinement interactions, thereby suppressing non-radiative decay to enable highly efficient RTP. The afterglow color can be modulated from blue to red by altering the degree of chromophore conjugation. MTP and the chromophores exhibit synergistic growth behavior since SACs serve as nutrients that promote fungal growth. The resulting RTP MTP exhibits a minimal environmental footprint, not only degrading safely in nature but further enhancing soil fertility to promote plant growth. This strategy can facilitate the development of highly eco-friendly RTP materials to expand the potential of fungi for functional optical applications.

papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在探索通过生物生长过程制备室温磷光材料的新策略，该路径此前鲜有报道。材料体系为Trametes pubescens菌丝体与磺酸发色团的复合体系，设计策略是利用真菌生长过程中的自然自组装能力，将发色团内化至菌丝球内部。在真菌生长期间，不同π共轭程度的磺酸发色团通过氢键和限域相互作用被内化，有效抑制非辐射衰变从而产生高效RTP。通过改变发色团共轭程度可实现余辉颜色从蓝色到红色的调控。菌丝体与发色团呈现协同生长行为，发色团作为营养物质促进真菌生长。所得RTP菌丝体环境足迹极小，不仅可在自然界安全降解，还能提高土壤肥力促进植物生长。该策略为开发高环保RTP材料提供了新途径，拓展了真菌在功能光学应用中的潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 制备方法为生物生长自组装策略，在Trametes pubescens培养过程中将磺酸发色团内化至菌丝球。表征涉及RTP性能测试包括余辉颜色和效率评估，结构表征包括发色团与菌丝体的相互作用确认。降解性和生态影响通过自然降解实验和土壤肥力测试评估。
papers.relevance_zh: 该论文属于自组装技术与功能材料交叉领域，展示了生物生长驱动的自组装策略，与自组装研究方向相关。其内化限域机制和环保设计理念对框架材料的绿色合成具有启发意义，但材料体系非传统框架材料，相关性有限，可作为拓展阅读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，摘要明确报告了材料制备策略、颜色调控范围和生态友好特性，但具体磷光量子产率、寿命、余辉颜色对应的波长范围、发色团种类及浓度等定量数据均未报告，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过真菌生物生长自组装可将磺酸发色团内化到菌丝球中，实现高效室温磷光
改变发色团π共轭程度可实现余辉颜色从蓝色到红色的调控
磺酸发色团作为营养物质促进真菌生长，菌丝体与发色团呈现协同生长行为
所得RTP菌丝体可自然降解并增强土壤肥力，具有极小的环境足迹

papers.title: Dual-Function Donor Engineering of a Metal–Organic Framework for Efficient Photocatalytic Oxidative Synthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract Donor and/or acceptor engineering that allows the delicate optimization of the charge or energy transfer process within heterogeneous photocatalysts for the efficient generation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) of the superoxide radical (O2•–) or singlet oxygen (1O2) dictates the efficiency of aerobic oxidative synthesis. However, the development of donor and/or acceptor engineering approaches that can simultaneously optimize the charge and energy transfer processes for abundant generation of O2•– and 1O2 is a major challenge. Herein, a series of porphyrin (electron donor)- and naphthalene diimide (NDI, electron acceptor)-based isostructural mixed-ligand donor–acceptor MOFs were designed and synthesized. Experiments and theoretical calculations revealed that by delicately tuning the electron-pushing capacity of the organic conjugated groups on the donor porphyrin units, the charge transfer kinetics from the donors to the acceptors as well as the energy transfer gifted by the donor porphyrins related to their singlet–triplet energy gaps could be simultaneously optimized. As a result, Zr-NDI-H2DPBP(Pyr), wherein the porphyrin donor ligand with pyrene (Pyr) groups possesses the strongest electron-pushing capacity, exhibited the highest O2•– and 1O2 generation activities, which can be utilized for efficient aerobic oxidation reactions, including dipolar [3 + 2] cycloaddition and the synthesis of quinoxaline derivatives. This work exemplifies a dual-function donor engineering approach for developing heterogeneous catalysts toward advanced artificial photosynthesis.

papers.title_zh: 金属有机框架的双功能供体工程用于高效光催化氧化合成
papers.summary_zh: 本研究通过供体卟啉上共轭基团的推电子能力调控，同时优化了MOF内电荷转移与能量转移过程，实现了超氧自由基和单线态氧的高效生成，并用于好氧氧化反应。该工作为人工光合作用催化剂设计提供了双功能供体工程策略。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于如何通过供体/受体工程同时优化异质光催化剂中电荷与能量转移过程，以高效生成超氧自由基和单线态氧，从而提升好氧氧化合成效率。材料体系为基于卟啉（电子供体）和萘二酰亚胺（NDI，电子受体）的同构混合配体供体-受体MOF系列。设计策略是在供体卟啉单元上引入不同推电子能力的有机共轭基团，系统调节供体到受体的电荷转移动力学以及供体卟啉的单重态-三重态能隙相关的能量转移。研究过程包括设计合成系列MOF，并通过实验与理论计算验证推电子能力对电荷和能量转移的协同优化效果。结果表明，含芘基团的Zr-NDI-H2DPBP(Pyr)具有最强推电子能力，表现出最高的超氧自由基和单线态氧生成活性，可高效催化偶极[3+2]环加成及喹喔啉衍生物合成等好氧氧化反应。该工作为开发先进人工光合作用异质催化剂提供了双功能供体工程范例。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及合成了系列同构混合配体供体-受体MOF，并通过实验和理论计算研究了电荷与能量转移过程。性能测试涉及超氧自由基和单线态氧的生成活性评估，以及好氧氧化反应（包括偶极[3+2]环加成和喹喔啉衍生物合成）的催化测试。具体合成条件、表征手段和测试参数摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究直接关联介孔导电MOF和共轭MOF的光催化应用，展示了通过供体工程调控电荷与能量转移以增强活性氧生成的设计思路，对框架材料的光电性能优化具有参考价值。摘要提供了明确的结构-性能关系，值得全文精读以获取详细的合成与表征数据，但需注意其光催化氧化方向与导电性研究主线存在一定距离。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，具体实验条件（如溶剂、温度、光照波长）、定量产率、量子效率、详细的表征数据（如瞬态吸收、荧光寿命）以及理论计算细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过精细调控供体卟啉单元上有机共轭基团的推电子能力，可同时优化从供体到受体的电荷转移动力学以及供体卟啉单重态-三重态能隙相关的能量转移。
含芘基团的Zr-NDI-H2DPBP(Pyr)因供体配体具有最强推电子能力，表现出最高的超氧自由基和单线态氧生成活性。
该MOF可高效催化偶极[3+2]环加成反应和喹喔啉衍生物的合成等好氧氧化反应。

papers.title: Precise Construction of Heterobimetallic Covalent Organic Frameworks for Cooperative Photocatalysis of Defluorination
papers.abstract: Abstract Precisely positioning two distinct metal centers within covalent organic frameworks (COFs) is inherently difficult because competitive coordination and uncontrolled metal distribution often compromise structural integrity. Herein, we report a rational strategy that overcomes this challenge, enabling the atomically precise construction of a heterobimetallic COF incorporating nickel porphyrin and iron quinoline units. This synthesis leverages fundamental differences in the thermodynamic and kinetic behaviors of metal ions and organic building blocks and achieves near-quantitative metal occupancy at predetermined coordination sites while preserving framework crystallinity. Despite coordinating independently, the two metal centers engage in strong electronic coupling through local orbital hybridization, establishing an efficient charge-transfer pathway that promotes directional electron migration and suppresses recombination. This bimetallic architecture drives efficient defluorination photocatalysis with broad substrate tolerance and robust recyclability, achieving performance inaccessible to any photocatalysts reported to date. Our work provides a generalizable platform for designing heterobimetallic COFs with tailored charge-transfer kinetics for complex organic transformations.

papers.title: A Modular Tecton Matrix for Mechanosynthesis of Large‐Pore Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Frameworks With Programmable Pore Environments
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hydrogen‐bonded organic frameworks (HOFs) offer versatile porous architectures, yet predictable pore expansion via tecton extension remains challenging because framework assembly is highly sensitive to solvent‐mediated crystallization. Here, we establish a mechanosynthesis‐enabled modular tecton matrix for constructing large‐pore HOFs. Pairwise combination of complementary tectons systematically generates four micro‐ and mesoporous HOFs, including G4, which is difficult to obtain by solution crystallization. These HOFs exhibit surface areas up to 1824 m 2 /g, pore apertures up to 2.4 nm, with record CO 2 and C 2 H 2 adsorption capacities for HOFs at 195 K. One‐pot incorporation of AgOTf during mechanosynthesis enables programmable pore decoration, enhancing room‐temperature C 2 H 2 uptake through stronger framework‐substrate interactions. This work establishes a modular tecton matrix enabled by mechanosynthesis as a general design and discovery strategy for constructing and functionalizing large‐pore HOFs.

papers.title: Large‐Pore 3D Covalent Organic Frameworks with Light‐Sensitized Synergy for Efficient Photocatalytic Antibacterial Therapies and Wound Healing
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Escalating antimicrobial resistance and declining antibiotic efficacy spur interest in photocatalytic antibacterial therapies. Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are promising photodynamic antibacterial agents, though rapid carrier recombination, low reactive oxygen species (ROS) yields, and poor photostability remain constraints. Herein, we report the successful synthesis of two large‐pore [8+2] 3D‐bcu‐COFs. SEU‐301 was constructed from an 8‐connected porphyrin building unit and a linear tetraphenyl linker. Introducing a linear side‐chain bis(benzothiadiazole) linker via three‐component functional modulation afforded SEU‐302, which enhances light absorption, accelerates charge separation, and suppresses carrier recombination, thereby extending the excited‐state lifetime—confirmed by femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy (fs‐TAS) and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Further proteomic analysis shows that the ROS efficiently generated by light‐activated SEU‐302 elicit membrane damage and homeostatic imbalance, precipitating a cascade of stress responses that culminate in metabolic dysregulation, while also synergistically combating bacteria and inflammation. The therapeutic potential was further validated in vitro and in vivo, where light‐activated SEU‐302 not only effectively eliminated Staphylococcus aureus and inhibited its proliferation, but also promoted wound healing with increased collagen deposition and hair follicle regeneration. Results identify 3D COFs as very promising materials for both photodynamic therapies and antibacterial therapies.

papers.title: Helical Single Crystals of Porous Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Frameworks as a Candidate for Morphologically Functional Organic Materials
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Modulation and control of the crystalline morphology of porous materials are important for their functionality yet remain underdeveloped. In this study, we report the first example of a porous hydrogen‐bonded organic framework (HOF) with helical crystalline morphology. The helical HOF was prepared using pyrene‐based tetracarboxylic acid. The formation of helical‐shaped and needle‐shaped crystals of the HOFs can be controlled by the solvent evaporation rate and temperature during heating. X‐ray diffraction analysis indicates that both crystals have the same layered porous structure. Based on these data and theoretical calculations, we propose the hypothesis that certain structural defects are locally generated, which induces nonuniform crystal growth and consequently results in the formation of the helical crystals. The obtained HOFs exhibit thermal stability and permanent porosity with Brunauer‐Emmett‐Teller (BET) surface area up to 1602 m 2 g −1 . Interestingly, the helical HOFs exhibited dynamic expansion and contraction through the desorption and adsorption of a guest solvent. Moreover, doping with a second component in the helical HOF enables the modulation of fluorescence properties and crystalline morphology into a double helix. These results highlight the potential of a new category of organic materials: helical porous crystals and morphologically functional organic materials.

papers.title_zh: 多孔氢键有机框架的螺旋单晶：形态功能有机材料的候选者
papers.summary_zh: 本研究报道了首例具有螺旋晶体形态的多孔氢键有机框架(HOF)。该螺旋HOF由芘基四羧酸制备，通过溶剂蒸发速率和加热温度可控制备螺旋状和针状晶体。两种晶体具有相同的层状多孔结构，BET比表面积高达1602 m²/g。螺旋HOF在客体溶剂的吸附/脱附过程中表现出动态膨胀和收缩，掺杂第二组分可实现荧光性质和晶体形态（双螺旋）的调控。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于多孔材料晶体形态的调控和控制在功能化应用中的重要性，但该领域仍发展不足。材料体系为基于芘基四羧酸的HOF。设计策略是通过调控结晶条件（溶剂蒸发速率和加热温度）实现螺旋状和针状晶体形态的可控形成。研究过程包括：制备螺旋HOF并系统表征其结构；X射线衍射分析确认两种晶体具有相同的层状多孔结构；结合理论计算提出螺旋晶体形成假说——局部产生特定结构缺陷诱导非均匀晶体生长，最终形成螺旋形态；测试所得HOFs的热稳定性和永久孔隙率；观察螺旋HOF在客体溶剂吸附/脱附过程中的动态膨胀收缩行为；通过掺杂第二组分调控荧光性质和晶体形态为双螺旋。研究意义在于展示了螺旋多孔晶体和形态功能有机材料这一新类别的潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的制备方法为溶剂蒸发结晶法，通过调控溶剂蒸发速率和加热温度控制晶体形态。表征方法包括X射线衍射分析用于晶体结构确认，BET法测定比表面积（1602 m²/g）。性能测试包括热稳定性测试、永久孔隙率评估、客体溶剂吸附/脱附过程中的动态行为观察，以及掺杂第二组分后的荧光性质表征。理论计算用于支持螺旋形成机制假说。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究与本课题组对HOF框架材料及自组装技术的研究主线直接相关，其螺旋晶体形态的调控策略为框架材料形态工程提供了新维度，动态膨胀收缩行为和荧光调控拓展了HOFs的功能应用前景。摘要未报告详细结晶条件参数、结构缺陷的具体表征证据和掺杂组分的详细信息，建议全文精读以获取完整实验方案。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于摘要报告的信息。溶剂蒸发速率和温度的具体参数、X射线衍射结构精修细节、结构缺陷的直接实验证据、动态膨胀收缩的定量数据、掺杂组分种类及含量、荧光性能的具体数值等仍需全文核查，摘要未报告相应数据。
key_findings_zh: 首次报道具有螺旋晶体形态的多孔HOF，由芘基四羧酸制备，通过溶剂蒸发速率和温度可控制备螺旋状和针状晶体
X射线衍射分析表明螺旋状和针状晶体具有相同的层状多孔结构，BET比表面积高达1602 m²/g
基于实验数据和理论计算提出假说：局部结构缺陷诱导非均匀晶体生长导致螺旋晶体形成
螺旋HOF在客体溶剂脱附/吸附过程中表现出动态膨胀和收缩，掺杂第二组分可调控荧光性质并将形态变为双螺旋

papers.title: Breaking of π‐Continuity by σ‐Linkers in Covalent Organic Frameworks for Efficient Photoreduction and Recovery of Gold From Electronic Waste
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Photoreduction of metal ions plays a central role in the recovery of precious metals from electronic waste, yet its design is still largely governed by a semiconductor paradigm that links extended π‐conjugation and long‐range charge transport to superior performance. Herein, we challenge this assumption by demonstrating that deliberate disruption of π‐continuity via σ‐linkers in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) affords a more effective electronic architecture for localized redox reactions. The resulting π‐disrupted framework (σ‐COF) generates low‐energy, spatially confined electronic states that prolong photogenerated electron lifetimes and promote their transfer to adsorbed Au(III) species. Under illumination, σ‐COF exhibits a dramatic enhancement in gold uptake from electronic‐waste‐derived solutions, increasing from ∼1000 to 3045 mg/g, whereas a structurally analogous π‐conjugated framework (π‐COF) shows only a modest increase (from ∼1200 to 1700 mg/g). Spectroscopic and photoelectrochemical studies reveal efficient electron accumulation at redox‐active sites without reliance on extended π‐delocalization, with adsorption and reduction occurring within the same local domains. This work establishes controlled π‐disruption as a new electronic design principle for COF photoreductants in noble metal recovery.

papers.title_zh: 共价有机框架中σ连接基打断π连续性用于高效光还原回收电子废弃物中的金
papers.summary_zh: 本研究挑战半导体范式，证明在COF中通过σ连接基刻意打断π共轭可构建更有效的局域氧化还原电子架构。所得σ-COF延长光生电子寿命并促进其向Au(III)转移，金吸附量从约1000提升至3045 mg/g，显著优于π-COF，为贵金属回收提出新的电子设计原则。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于光还原金属离子在电子废弃物贵金属回收中的核心作用，但传统设计受半导体范式主导，认为扩展π共轭和长程电荷传输必然带来优异性能。材料体系为共价有机框架，设计策略是引入σ连接基打断π连续性，构建π-打断框架。研究过程通过对比结构类似的π-共轭框架，系统考察光催化还原回收金的性能差异。意义在于确立受控π打断作为COF光还原剂用于贵金属回收的新电子设计原则，突破传统共轭主导的认知框架。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及光照条件下的金吸附性能测试，使用电子废弃物来源溶液。光谱和光电化学研究用于揭示电子积累和转移机制。通过对比σ-COF与π-COF的结构-性能关系，评估π连续性与光还原效率的关联。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究直接关联导电MOF/COF中电荷传输与框架电子结构设计主线，通过σ连接基打断π共轭实现高效局域氧化还原，为框架材料光催化应用提供新思路。核心推荐级别，值得全文精读以获取详细的合成条件、光谱证据及定量对比数据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。具体合成条件、σ连接基种类、光谱表征细节、光电流测试参数、金吸附动力学及循环稳定性等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: σ-COF在光照下金吸附量从约1000提升至3045 mg/g，而π-COF仅从约1200提升至1700 mg/g。
σ-COF产生低能、空间受限的电子态，延长光生电子寿命并促进其向吸附的Au(III)物种转移。
光谱和光电化学研究揭示氧化还原活性位点处高效电子积累不依赖扩展π离域，吸附和还原发生在同一局域内。

papers.title: n -Butane Capture Accompanied by a Colorimetric Response in a Flexible Thiazolothiazole Metal–Organic Framework
papers.abstract: Abstract Simultaneous capture and optical detection of flammable gases in enclosed environments are critical for operational safety. Herein, using two dynamic MOFs, UAM-1S and UAM-1O, which differ compositionally by a single atom, we demonstrate the crucial role of framework flexibility in enabling this dual function. The mechanistic, kinetic, and energetic landscape of n-butane-induced structural transformations is revealed by in situ UV–vis spectroscopy and static/time-resolved powder X-ray diffraction conducted during adsorption along calorimetric studies. The integration of these results with single-crystal X-ray diffraction data of UAM-1O loaded with hydrocarbons, together with grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations and DFT calculations, enables us to propose a diffusion mechanism. Furthermore, isothermal adsorption measurements show that UAM-1S adsorbs 1.5 mmol g–1 of n-butane at 298 K and 0.016 bar, below its explosive limit (1.9%), while exhibiting minimal water uptake. Complementary dynamic column breakthrough and temperature-programmed desorption experiments reveal the selective capture of n-butane from simulated air at concentrations below 1.9% under dry conditions and below 3% under humid conditions. Finally, the loading of n-butane leads to a distinct color change of the host material thereby enabling its use as a visual indicator. These results open a new research direction, highlighting the untapped potential of flexible MOFs for capturing and detecting flammable gases at low concentrations.

papers.title_zh: 柔性噻唑并噻唑金属有机框架中正丁烷捕获伴随比色响应
papers.summary_zh: 本研究利用仅差一个原子的两种动态MOF（UAM-1S和UAM-1O），证明框架柔性对同时捕获和光学检测可燃气体至关重要。UAM-1S在298 K、0.016 bar下吸附1.5 mmol/g正丁烷，低于爆炸极限，且水吸附极低。正丁烷负载引起主体材料明显颜色变化，可作为视觉指示器。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于密闭环境中可燃气体（正丁烷）的同时捕获与光学检测，对操作安全至关重要。材料体系为两种动态MOF，UAM-1S和UAM-1O，组成上仅差一个原子。设计策略利用框架柔性的关键作用实现双重功能。研究过程通过原位紫外-可见光谱、静态和时间分辨粉末X射线衍射在吸附过程中结合量热研究，揭示正丁烷诱导结构转变的机理、动力学和能量景观。结合单晶X射线衍射、巨正则蒙特卡洛模拟和DFT计算提出扩散机制。意义在于开辟柔性MOF捕获和检测低浓度可燃气体的新研究方向。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及原位紫外-可见光谱、静态和时间分辨粉末X射线衍射在吸附过程中进行，结合量热研究。单晶X射线衍射用于UAM-1O负载烃类结构解析。巨正则蒙特卡洛模拟和DFT计算辅助机制理解。等温吸附测量、动态柱穿透和程序升温脱附实验用于性能评估。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于柔性MOF动态响应范畴，与框架材料组装和结构-性能关系主线相关，但主题偏向气体捕获与光学检测，与导电框架和电化学合成关联较弱。拓展推荐级别，可选择性阅读以了解柔性框架的动态行为表征方法。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。具体合成步骤、单晶结构细节、颜色变化定量参数、吸附动力学数据及模拟参数等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: UAM-1S在298 K、0.016 bar下吸附1.5 mmol/g正丁烷，低于爆炸极限1.9%，且水吸附极低。
动态柱穿透和程序升温脱附实验显示，在干燥条件下可从模拟空气中选择性捕获浓度低于1.9%的正丁烷，潮湿条件下低于3%。
正丁烷负载导致主体材料明显颜色变化，使其可作为视觉指示器使用。

papers.title: Engineered Multivariate Metal-Organic Frameworks for Magnetic Resonance Molecular Imaging Signal Enhancement
papers.abstract: Abstract Trapping Xe atoms within MOFs represents a promising strategy for hyperpolarized 129Xe MRI, owing to their structural tunability and ultrahigh porosity. Enhancing the entrapped 129Xe NMR signal is critical to overcoming current limitations of 129Xe MRI in biomedical applications. Although metal-centered doping has been explored to boost 129Xe signals, ligand-centered precise engineering to optimize the entrapped 129Xe NMR signal in MOFs remains largely underexplored. Herein, we present, for the first time, a ligand-based multivariate engineering approach to enhance the entrapped 129Xe NMR signal of water-stable CAU-1-derived MTV-MOFs. By finely tuning the molar ratio of −OH and −NH2 functionalized linkers, the pore microenvironment and Xe-framework interactions are continuously modulated. The MTV-MOF with the optimal ligand composition exhibits a remarkable 65-fold enhancement in 129Xe NMR signal compared to the single-component MOF. Furthermore, this material demonstrates excellent 129Xe MRI performance in living cells, highlighting its potential for biomedical imaging. This ligand-engineered multivariate approach establishes a versatile platform for tailoring Xe-host interactions in MOFs, offering a promising pathway to develop high-performance Xe molecular cages and expand the frontier of MOF-based molecular imaging technologies.

papers.title_zh: 工程化多元金属有机框架用于磁共振分子成像信号增强
papers.summary_zh: 本研究首次提出基于配体的多元工程策略，增强水稳定CAU-1衍生MTV-MOF中捕获Xe的129Xe NMR信号。通过精细调控-OH和-NH2功能化连接基的摩尔比，连续调节孔微环境和Xe-框架相互作用。最优配体组成的MTV-MOF相比单组分MOF实现65倍信号增强，并在活细胞中展现优异129Xe MRI性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于增强MOF内捕获Xe的129Xe NMR信号，以克服129Xe MRI在生物医学应用中的当前限制。材料体系为水稳定的CAU-1衍生多元MOF。设计策略采用配体中心的多元工程，通过调控-OH和-NH2功能化连接基比例优化Xe-框架相互作用。研究过程系统考察不同配体组成对孔微环境和Xe吸附行为的影响。意义在于建立配体工程化多元策略作为调控MOF中Xe-主体相互作用的通用平台，为高性能Xe分子笼和MOF基分子成像技术发展提供新路径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及配体基多元工程策略合成MTV-MOF，通过调控功能化连接基比例实现孔环境调控。129Xe NMR信号测量用于评估Xe捕获增强效果。129Xe MRI实验在活细胞中进行以验证生物医学成像性能。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究涉及MOF配体工程和孔微环境调控，与框架材料设计主线相关，但主题偏向磁共振成像信号增强，与导电框架、自组装和电化学合成关联较弱。拓展推荐级别，可选择性阅读以了解多元MOF配体工程策略。

key_findings_zh: 最优配体组成的MTV-MOF相比单组分MOF实现65倍的129Xe NMR信号增强。
通过精细调控-OH和-NH2功能化连接基的摩尔比，可连续调节孔微环境和Xe-框架相互作用。
该材料在活细胞中展现优异的129Xe MRI性能，凸显其在生物医学成像中的应用潜力。

papers.title: Steric Control over the Assembly of Zirconium Metal–Organic Cages Using Zirconium Clusters with Bulky Capping Ligands
papers.abstract: Abstract Zirconium metal–organic cages are an emerging class of highly tunable supramolecular materials that feature porous structures as well as relatively high thermal and chemical stability. Self-assembly of zirconium cages with ditopic organic linkers can result in the formation of porous tetrahedral or less porous lantern-shaped geometries, posing a key challenge in the synthesis and application of these materials. Herein, we demonstrate steric control in the synthesis of tetrahedral zirconium cages ([((CpZr(μ2-OH))3(μ3-O))4(L)6]X4; Cp– = cyclopentadienide; L2– = dicarboxylate linker; X– = OTf– or Cl–) by tuning the steric profile of zirconium clusters ([(CpZr(μ2-OH))3(μ3-O)(RCO2)3]X; RCO2– = carboxylate capping ligand) used as precursors for cage synthesis. Specifically, zirconium clusters with bulky carboxylate capping ligands hinder the assembly of the more compact lantern geometry, which ultimately leads to selective formation of the tetrahedral structure. Using this approach, we developed a general method for the selective synthesis tetrahedral zirconium metal–organic cages as either triflate or chloride salts. This method was used to synthesize six different zirconium cages, which were characterized by 1H NMR spectroscopy, high-resolution mass spectrometry, gas adsorption measurements, powder X-ray diffraction, and thermogravimetric analysis. We further show that the method enables synthesis of tetrahedral cages with the same selectivity at the gram scale. This work provides a facile route for the synthesis of a wide range of zirconium cages and highlights precursor design as a powerful tool to realize synthetic control over supramolecular cage assembly.

papers.title_zh: 利用带大体积封端配体的锆簇实现锆基金属有机笼组装的空间位阻控制
papers.summary_zh: 本研究提出通过调节锆簇前驱体上羧酸封端配体的空间位阻，实现四面体锆基金属有机笼的选择性合成。大体积封端配体抑制灯笼状几何构型的形成，从而导向四面体结构。该方法适用于三氟甲磺酸盐和氯化物盐形式，并成功合成六种不同笼，且可放大至克级规模。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于锆基金属有机笼自组装中选择性难题：同一双位点有机连接配体可形成多孔四面体或致密灯笼状结构，后者不利于多孔应用。材料体系为以环戊二烯基锆簇为前驱体、二羧酸配体为连接单元的超分子笼。设计策略是改变锆簇前驱体上羧酸封端配体的空间体积，利用位阻效应阻断灯笼状结构的紧凑堆积路径，从而热力学或动力学上偏好四面体构型。研究过程包括合成不同位阻的锆簇前驱体，将其与配体组装，并通过多种手段表征产物。意义在于提供了一种通用且可放大的选择性合成方法，强调前驱体设计对超分子笼组装控制的关键作用，为锆基多孔材料的结构定制开辟了简便途径。
papers.methods_zh: 合成方法：以带不同位阻羧酸封端配体的锆簇为前驱体，与二羧酸配体进行自组装，分别制备三氟甲磺酸盐和氯化物盐形式的笼。表征方法包括1H NMR谱、高分辨质谱、气体吸附测量、粉末X射线衍射和热重分析。此外，进行了克级规模放大合成实验以验证方法的可扩展性。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与框架材料组装主线直接相关，展示了通过前驱体空间位阻调控实现超分子笼拓扑选择性的策略，对介孔或微孔框架的定向合成具有方法学参考价值。局限性在于仅涉及锆笼体系，未延伸至导电或共轭框架。鉴于其通用性和放大可行性，值得全文精读以获取详细的位阻效应机制和表征数据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于摘要文本。具体位阻配体种类、合成条件细节、孔隙率数值、气体吸附性能、热稳定性数据以及选择性机制的直接证据均需在全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 摘要报告：锆簇前驱体上带有大体积羧酸封端配体时，可抑制灯笼状几何构型的组装，从而选择性形成四面体结构。
摘要报告：该方法可合成六种不同的四面体锆基金属有机笼，且以三氟甲磺酸盐或氯化物盐形式均可实现。
摘要报告：该方法在克级规模下仍能保持相同的四面体选择性。
摘要未报告具体孔隙率数值、热稳定性温度或气体吸附量等定量数据。

papers.title: Mesoporous PU/PEDOT:PSS Electrodes Reveal Population‐Level Stochastic Bioelectrical Dynamics in Marine Diatoms
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding how microbial populations generate and modulate electrical signals remains a major technical challenge because extracellular ionic processes are inherently weak, spatially distributed and stochastic. Here, we introduce a mesoporous ultra‐low‐impedance PEDOT:PSS electrode that exploits volumetric ionic‐electronic coupling to probe stochastic electrochemical dynamics in axenic populations of the marine model diatom Phaeodactylum tricornutum . The three‐dimensional porous architecture provides a large electrochemically accessible surface area with high capacitance and low impedance, enabling sensitive detection of non‐equilibrium current fluctuations under applied bias. Applied bias systematically amplifies stochastic electrical fluctuations, while living diatoms significantly modify their amplitude and temporal statistics. Noise analysis reveals enhanced low‐frequency fluctuations, increased power‐law exponents and higher transient‐event rates, indicating biologically driven perturbations of the local electrochemical environment. Pharmacological inhibition with tetraethylammonium suppresses spontaneous electrical activity, providing independent functional evidence that membrane‐associated potassium‐dependent processes contribute to the measured signals. Increasing diatom cell density further produces progressively larger spectral exponents and distinct changes in stochastic‐event dynamics, demonstrating that these electrical signatures encode microbial population density. These findings establish stochastic electrochemical noise as a sensitive, label‐free probe of microbial bioelectrochemical activity and a bioelectronic strategy for monitoring living microbial systems through their intrinsic non‐equilibrium electrical fluctuations.

papers.title_zh: 介孔PU/PEDOT:PSS电极揭示海洋硅藻种群水平随机生物电动力学
papers.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种介孔超低阻抗PEDOT:PSS电极，利用体积离子-电子耦合效应探测海洋硅藻Phaeodactylum tricornutum的随机电化学动力学。三维多孔结构提供高电容和低阻抗，实现非平衡电流波动的灵敏检测。噪声分析显示生物驱动的低频波动增强和功率谱指数增加，并证明信号编码微生物种群密度。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于理解微生物种群如何产生和调节电信号，这是技术挑战，因为细胞外离子过程本质微弱、空间分布且随机。材料体系为介孔超低阻抗PEDOT:PSS电极，其三维多孔架构提供大的电化学可及表面积、高电容和低阻抗。设计策略是利用体积离子-电子耦合来探测无菌培养的海洋模式硅藻Phaeodactylum tricornutum的随机电化学动力学。研究过程包括在施加偏压下检测非平衡电流波动，通过噪声分析评估低频波动、功率谱指数和瞬态事件率；使用四乙铵进行药理学抑制以验证膜相关钾依赖过程的贡献；并通过改变硅藻细胞密度观察光谱指数和随机事件动力学的变化。研究意义在于建立随机电化学噪声作为微生物电化学活性的灵敏无标记探针，提供监测活体微生物系统的生物电子策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：制备介孔超低阻抗PEDOT:PSS电极，利用三维多孔结构实现体积离子-电子耦合；在施加偏压下进行电化学测量以检测非平衡电流波动；采用噪声分析评估低频波动、功率谱指数和瞬态事件率；使用四乙铵进行药理学抑制实验；通过改变硅藻细胞密度进行种群密度效应研究。摘要未报告具体合成条件、电极制备参数、噪声分析算法细节及表征仪器的具体信息。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究将介孔导电聚合物电极应用于微生物电信号探测，展示了介孔结构在增强电化学传感性能中的关键作用，与介孔导电MOF框架材料的研究主线在孔道结构-电学性能关系方面具有方法论借鉴价值。但研究对象为硅藻而非框架材料，且未涉及MOF/COF体系，属于拓展性参考。建议精读以获取介孔电极设计策略和电化学噪声分析方法，但需注意其材料体系与框架材料主线的差异。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是基于摘要的解读，未核查全文。摘要未报告电极的具体孔径分布、比表面积数值、阻抗谱定量参数、噪声分析的详细统计方法、四乙铵浓度及处理时间、硅藻细胞密度的具体数值范围等关键实验细节，这些信息需查阅全文确认。

papers.title: Complex Displacement Deposition: A Self‐Templating Mechanism for Forming High‐Surface‐Area Catalysts
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Controlling the structure and composition of metal deposits is central to advancing electrocatalysis and functional materials. Here, we introduce Complex Displacement Deposition (CDD), a general electrodeposition framework in which an electrochemically inert displacing agent competes with a target metal for a shared complexing agent, decoupling precipitation from metal reduction and granting access to architectures unattainable by conventional electrodeposition. We demonstrate CDD using the Cu‐citrate‐Ca system, in which interfacial alkalinization drives Ca 2+ to displace Cu 2+ from its citrate complex, producing a previously unreported ternary Ca‐Cu‐citrate‐hydroxide phase. The reversible formation and electrochemical reduction of this phase establish a dynamic self‐templating cycle that generates hierarchical, high‐surface‐area copper networks. Evaluated for the electrochemical nitrate reduction reaction, these electrodes achieve partial current densities of 302 mA cm −2 and ammonia yield rates of 1.41 mmol h −1 cm −2 , exceeding comparable metallic copper and many other copper‐based catalysts. Based on these results, we identify within CDD two thermodynamically distinct displacement regimes. An indirect regime, demonstrated here, proceeds through a ternary intermediate. A direct regime, predicted thermodynamically but not demonstrated here, yields a pure metal hydroxide. CDD thus establishes a modular strategy for electrodepositing high‐surface‐area metals, metal‐oxide composites, and compositionally complex architectures.

papers.title_zh: 络合物置换沉积：一种形成高比表面积催化剂的自模板机制
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出络合物置换沉积（CDD）这一通用电沉积框架，通过惰性置换剂与目标金属竞争共享络合剂，将沉淀与金属还原解耦。在Cu-柠檬酸-Ca体系中，界面碱化驱动Ca²⁺置换Cu²⁺，形成三元Ca-Cu-柠檬酸-氢氧化物相，其可逆形成与电化学还原构成动态自模板循环，生成高比表面积铜网络，在硝酸盐电还原中性能优异。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于如何调控金属沉积物的结构与组成以推进电催化。材料体系为Cu-柠檬酸-Ca三元体系。设计策略是引入电化学惰性的置换剂Ca²⁺，使其与目标金属Cu²⁺竞争共享的柠檬酸络合剂，从而在界面碱化条件下驱动置换反应，形成此前未见报道的三元Ca-Cu-柠檬酸-氢氧化物相。该相的可逆生成与电化学还原构成动态自模板循环，生成多级结构的高比表面积铜网络。研究过程包括电沉积实验、结构表征及硝酸盐还原反应性能评估。意义在于CDD提供了一种模块化策略，可电沉积高比表面积金属、金属氧化物复合材料及成分复杂结构，并识别出间接与直接两种热力学上不同的置换区域。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及采用电沉积框架进行材料制备，通过界面碱化驱动置换反应。表征方面提及识别出三元Ca-Cu-柠檬酸-氢氧化物相。性能测试采用电化学硝酸盐还原反应，报告了部分电流密度和氨产率。热力学分析用于区分间接与直接置换区域。具体合成参数、详细表征手段及测试条件摘要未报告。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究提出一种新的电沉积自模板机制，可生成高比表面积金属网络，对框架材料电化学合成及自组装技术具有方法论参考价值。其性能数据突出，但体系为无机构成而非导电MOF/COF，相关性为拓展层面。建议精读以评估CDD策略向框架材料电化学合成迁移的可能性，但需注意其与共轭框架主线的直接关联有限。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。具体电沉积参数、三元相的结构解析细节、比表面积数值、硝酸盐还原测试条件及稳定性数据等均需全文核查，摘要未报告相应数据。
key_findings_zh: CDD在Cu-柠檬酸-Ca体系中通过界面碱化驱动Ca²⁺置换Cu²⁺，形成此前未见报道的三元Ca-Cu-柠檬酸-氢氧化物相。
该三元相的可逆形成与电化学还原建立动态自模板循环，生成多级高比表面积铜网络。
所得电极在电化学硝酸盐还原反应中实现302 mA cm⁻²的部分电流密度和1.41 mmol h⁻¹ cm⁻²的氨产率，超过可比金属铜及许多其他铜基催化剂。
CDD包含间接与直接两种热力学上不同的置换区域，其中间接区域经三元中间体进行，直接区域经纯金属氢氧化物进行但本文未实验验证。

papers.title: Vinylene-Linked Woven Covalent Organic Frameworks for the Oxygen Reduction Reaction
papers.abstract: Abstract Woven covalent organic frameworks (woven COFs) represent a rare class of mechanically interlaced crystalline polymers whose synthesis is largely limited by the availability of suitable linkage chemistry. Herein, we report the first example of a vinylene-linked woven covalent organic framework, constructed through a Knoevenagel-type condensation between a Cu(I)-coordinated neocuproine node (Cu(DmPhen)2) and an extended aromatic dialdehyde linker under melt-polymerization conditions. The incorporation of a rigid copper-phenanthroline node and an elongated terphenyl-based aldehyde promotes framework interlocking, enabling the formation of a crystalline woven architecture featuring robust C═C linkages and permanent porosity. The resulting Cu-TPy COF exhibits a long-range periodicity, extended π-conjugation, and remarkable chemical stability. Owing to the synergistic combination of accessible copper centers and an ordered conjugated framework, Cu-TPy exhibits outstanding electrocatalytic activity for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) even in the absence of conductive additives, maintaining stable performance for more than 2 days of continuous operation. This work demonstrates the successful incorporation of vinylene linkages into the woven framework, thereby extending the conjugation pathway and broadening the structural diversity of woven porous materials.

papers.title: Confined Predesolvation in a Yolk–Shell Metal–Organic Framework Interphase Enables Reversible Lithium-Metal Anodes
papers.abstract: Abstract Artificial interfaces for lithium-metal anodes typically regulate nucleation after Li+ desolvation, while the preceding solvation-to-interface transition remains poorly controlled. Herein, we show that a yolk–shell H-Fe3O4@ZIF-67 interphase can act as a confined predesolvation layer. The subnanometer apertures of ZIF-67 sterically constrain intact solvated Li+ complexes, forcing partial solvent removal before electron transfer takes place. Polar Fe–O/Co–N environments favor anion-derived solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) chemistry, while the internal void accommodates the deposited Li. These coupled effects lower the Li nucleation overpotential to 14.6 mV, decrease the apparent interfacial activation energy to 34.53 kJ mol–1, and increase the Li+ transference number to 0.60. Symmetric cells operate for over 2000 h. High-loading LiFePO4 full cells retain 132.6 mAh g–1 after 400 cycles at 1 C and deliver an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.88%. Confining predesolvation at the molecular scale thus provides an effective strategy for stabilizing reactive metal anodes.

papers.title: Self‐Assembly and Molecular Recognition by Synthetic Receptors at the Oil‐Water Interface in Aqueous Microdroplets
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aqueous microdroplets in a bulk fluorous oil medium confer unique behavior on self‐folding water‐soluble synthetic receptors (deep cavitands). The lipophilic, yet water‐soluble cavitands self‐assemble at the water‐oil interface, coating the surface of the microdroplet rather than diffusing through the interior. By combining the receptors with indicator dyes that bind in the host cavity, simple optical detection of the molecular recognition event is possible, as is spatiotemporal monitoring of the receptors in the droplets. The interfacial self‐assembly of the host–guest complex is driven by hydrophobic association between the individual cavitand molecules, and controlled molecular recognition of suitable guest molecules can be observed. By exploiting droplet merging experiments, the cavity‐based and aggregative molecular recognition behaviors can be differentiated. The system provides a unique insight into supramolecular aggregation, interfacial behavior, and molecular recognition at water‐oil interfaces.

papers.title_zh: 水相微滴中油-水界面合成受体的自组装与分子识别
papers.summary_zh: 本研究报道了水溶性深穴受体在氟油微滴的水-油界面自组装行为，结合指示剂染料实现分子识别的光学检测，并通过液滴融合实验区分腔基识别与聚集识别，为界面超分子化学提供了新见解。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于水溶性合成受体在油-水界面上的自组装与分子识别行为。材料体系采用亲脂但水溶性的深穴空腔受体（deep cavitands），分散于氟油连续相中的水相微滴体系。设计策略是利用受体分子的疏水相互作用驱动其在微滴界面自组装，形成界面涂层而非扩散至液滴内部。研究过程包括将受体与可结合于空腔的指示剂染料联用，通过光学信号监测分子识别事件，并利用液滴融合实验区分基于空腔的分子识别与基于聚集的识别行为。该研究的意义在于揭示了水-油界面处超分子聚集、界面行为与分子识别的独特关联，为界面限域环境中的主客体化学提供了新的理解维度。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的方法包括：在氟油介质中制备水相微滴体系；利用自折叠水溶性深穴受体进行界面自组装；将受体与指示剂染料结合以实现光学检测；采用液滴融合实验区分不同识别机制。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、表征手段及定量测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究涉及自组装与界面分子识别，与框架材料界面组装研究主线相关，但体系为合成受体而非MOF/COF，关联度有限。其界面自组装策略和光学检测方法对理解框架材料在界面上的组装行为具有参考价值，可作为拓展阅读材料，建议根据具体研究需求决定是否精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告受体合成细节、界面自组装的定量表征数据（如覆盖度、组装动力学）、指示剂染料的种类与结合常数、液滴尺寸及融合实验的具体条件，这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 深穴受体在水-油界面自组装并包覆微滴表面，而非扩散至液滴内部
受体与指示剂染料结合可实现分子识别事件的光学检测及受体时空监测
界面自组装由受体分子间的疏水缔合驱动，并可观察到对合适客体的受控分子识别
液滴融合实验可区分腔基识别与聚集性识别行为

papers.title: Programmable Soft Actuator with Multi‐Responsiveness Based on Conductive MOF‐Liquid Crystal Polymer Composite
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Independent dual alignment of the anisotropic, conductive metal–organic framework (MOF) crystals and liquid‐crystal polymer (LCP) network enables a multi‐responsive soft actuator capable of both UV‐driven photothermal and electrothermal operation. In this design, LC alignment ensures reversible actuation, whereas Cu 3 (HHTP) 2 (HHTP = 2,3,6,7,10,11‐hexahydroxytriphenylene) alignment governs bilayer structure and charge transport pathways, enabling advanced functionalities including on/off switching, region‐selective actuation, and programmable directionality. In the photothermally driven mode, strong UV absorption and efficient non‐radiative relaxation of Cu 3 (HHTP) 2 , combined with a horizontal bilayer structure, induce rapid and reversible bending. A Hercules beetle‐inspired horn actuator lifted loads up to 40 times its own weight. In the electrically driven mode, Cu 3 (HHTP) 2 produced uniform Joule heating and large bending only when horizontally aligned, reflecting the creation of long‐range conductive pathways. As a proof of concept, this principle was applied to a self‐protective smart wire that autonomously disconnects under overcurrent. Collectively, these findings provide valuable insights into the alignment, manipulation, and utilization of anisotropic conductive MOFs for diverse applications, including soft grippers, adhesive/reconfigurable electrical wiring, and microelectronics.

papers.title_zh: 基于导电MOF-液晶聚合物复合材料的可编程多响应软致动器
papers.summary_zh: 本研究通过各向异性导电MOF晶体与液晶聚合物网络的双重独立取向，实现了兼具紫外光热与电热响应的多响应软致动器，展示了区域选择性致动、可编程方向性及过流自保护智能导线等应用。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于如何利用各向异性导电MOF实现多响应软致动器的可编程控制。材料体系为Cu3(HHTP)2导电MOF与液晶聚合物（LCP）的复合材料。设计策略的核心在于实现MOF晶体取向与LC网络取向的独立双重调控：LC取向保证可逆致动，而Cu3(HHTP)2的取向决定双层结构和电荷传输路径。研究过程涵盖光热驱动模式与电驱动模式两种工作方式。在光热模式下，Cu3(HHTP)2的强紫外吸收和高效非辐射弛豫结合水平双层结构诱导快速可逆弯曲；在电驱动模式下，仅水平取向的Cu3(HHTP)2产生均匀焦耳热和大弯曲，归因于长程导电通路的形成。作为概念验证，该原理被应用于过流时自主断开的自保护智能导线。该研究为各向异性导电MOF的取向调控与利用提供了重要见解。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的方法包括：Cu3(HHTP)2（HHTP = 2,3,6,7,10,11-六羟基三亚苯基）导电MOF的合成与使用；液晶聚合物网络的构建；MOF晶体与LC网络的双重取向控制；光热驱动与电热驱动的致动性能测试；负载提升实验；智能导线过流断开演示。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、取向控制工艺参数及详细的表征手段。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究直接涉及导电MOF（Cu3(HHTP)2）的取向调控与电荷传输应用，与介孔导电MOF及框架材料组装主线高度相关。其双重取向策略和导电通路设计对导电MOF功能化应用具有重要参考价值，属于核心推荐文献，值得全文精读以获取详细的制备与取向控制方法。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告Cu3(HHTP)2的合成条件与表征数据、液晶聚合物的具体组成与交联方式、取向控制的具体工艺参数、弯曲角度与响应时间的定量数值、电导率数据及智能导线的详细性能指标，这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Cu3(HHTP)2与LCP的双重独立取向实现了UV光热与电热双模式响应的软致动器
光热驱动模式下，甲虫角启发致动器可举起高达自身重量40倍的负载
电驱动模式下，仅水平取向的Cu3(HHTP)2产生均匀焦耳热和大弯曲，表明长程导电通路的关键作用
该原理成功应用于过流时自主断开的自保护智能导线

papers.title: Conjugated Coordination Polymer Aerogels with Disordered Interfacial Water Structures for Enhanced Electrocatalytic Oxygen Evolution Kinetics
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Beyond rational design of active sites, regulation of the local chemical environment of electrocatalysts to promote the reactant transport dynamics is crucial for enhancing the reaction kinetics, which faces significant limitations owing to the rigid hydrogen‐bond networks formed by interfacial water molecules. Here, an entropy‐derived regulation strategy was proposed to engineer disordered interfacial water structures, which induces a flexible and adaptive environment that can substantially enhance the reactant transport dynamics and reaction kinetics. Taking a conjugated coordination polymer aerogel with homogeneous single‐atom metal active sites as the model system, a comparative study investigating high‐entropy and low‐entropy conjugated coordination polymer aerogels (denoted as HE‐CCPA and LE‐CCPA) was carried out. Our findings reveal that, relative to LE‐CCPA, the inhomogeneity of electron density distribution and reactant adsorption across multiple different single‐atom metal sites of the HE‐CCPA profoundly disrupts the rigid hydrogen‐bond network, resulting in disordered interfacial water structures that can appreciably facilitate the transport dynamics of hydroxide ion reactants to improve the alkaline oxygen evolution kinetics. These findings highlight disordered interfacial water engineering as a promising approach for performance enhancement in widespread aqueous electrocatalysis.

papers.title_zh: 具有无序界面水结构的共轭配位聚合物气凝胶用于增强电催化析氧反应动力学
papers.summary_zh: 本研究提出熵调控策略构建无序界面水结构，以高熵共轭配位聚合物气凝胶（HE-CCPA）为模型，证明多单原子位点的电子密度不均匀性可破坏刚性氢键网络，促进氢氧根传输，显著改善碱性析氧反应动力学。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于电催化剂局部化学环境的调控，旨在通过打破界面水分子的刚性氢键网络来促进反应物传输动力学。材料体系为具有均匀单原子金属活性位点的共轭配位聚合物气凝胶，具体比较了高熵（HE-CCPA）与低熵（LE-CCPA）两种体系。设计策略为熵衍生调控策略，通过引入多种不同的单原子金属位点构建高熵环境。研究过程包括对HE-CCPA和LE-CCPA进行对比研究，考察其界面水结构、电子密度分布、反应物吸附行为及碱性析氧反应性能。研究发现，相对于LE-CCPA，HE-CCPA中多个不同单原子金属位点上的电子密度分布不均匀性和反应物吸附差异显著破坏了刚性氢键网络，形成无序界面水结构，从而促进氢氧根离子的传输动力学，改善碱性析氧反应动力学。该研究凸显了无序界面水工程作为提升水相电催化性能的潜在途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的方法包括：共轭配位聚合物气凝胶的制备（高熵HE-CCPA与低熵LE-CCPA）；单原子金属活性位点的构建；界面水结构调控（熵衍生调控策略）；对比研究不同熵态样品的电催化析氧性能。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、单原子位点种类与含量、气凝胶结构表征及电化学测试的具体条件与数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究涉及共轭配位聚合物气凝胶的界面水结构调控与电催化性能，与共轭MOF/COF及框架材料电化学应用主线相关。其熵调控策略和界面水工程思路对框架材料电催化领域的性能优化具有借鉴意义，属于核心推荐文献，建议全文精读以获取材料制备与电化学测试的详细数据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告HE-CCPA和LE-CCPA的具体组成与单原子金属种类及比例、气凝胶的孔径与比表面积、界面水结构的谱学表征数据、析氧反应的过电位与Tafel斜率等定量电化学数值，这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: HE-CCPA中多个不同单原子金属位点的电子密度分布不均匀性显著破坏刚性氢键网络，形成无序界面水结构
无序界面水结构可显著促进氢氧根离子反应物的传输动力学，改善碱性析氧反应动力学
相对于LE-CCPA，HE-CCPA在碱性析氧反应中表现出增强的动力学性能

papers.title: A Dynamic Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Framework With Giant OFF–ON Birefringence
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Birefringence, the optical property enabling materials to split light based on polarization and propagation direction, is crucial for many technological fields, spanning from telecommunications to imaging and photonics. Particularly, controlling the birefringence is vital in high‐performance applications such as nonlinear optics, adaptable spectroscopy filters, adaptive imaging, for biomedical, and space applications. Most known switchable birefringent materials suffer from either low birefringence values or narrow tuneable values, thus hindering their use in dynamic optical systems. Here, a novel approach based on a dynamic hydrogen‐bonded organic framework (HOF) capable of reversible single crystal to single crystal transformation, during guest molecule inclusion is reported. Changes in the planar conformation of the π–π stacking between layers during guest inclusion drastically alters the birefringence off–on, from negligible values to 0.73, surpassing all known switchable materials. This approach represents a novel platform for the development of high‐performance optical devices.
papers.recommendation: 与晶态多孔框架主题相关，建议根据摘要判断是否进一步阅读。
papers.title_zh: 具有巨大OFF-ON双折射响应的动态氢键有机框架
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道了一种动态氢键有机框架（HOF），在客体分子包合过程中发生可逆的单晶到单晶转变，通过层间π-π堆叠的平面构象变化，实现双折射从可忽略值到0.73的OFF-ON切换，性能超越所有已知可切换双折射材料，为高性能光学器件提供了新平台。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于现有可切换双折射材料普遍存在的双折射值低或可调范围窄的瓶颈，难以满足动态光学系统（如非线性光学、自适应光谱滤波、生物医学与空间成像）的需求。材料体系为一种动态氢键有机框架（HOF），其核心设计策略是利用框架的动态性，在客体分子包合过程中实现可逆的单晶到单晶转变。研究过程表明，客体包合引起层间π-π堆叠的平面构象发生显著变化，从而大幅改变材料的光学各向异性，使双折射从接近零的值跃升至0.73，实现OFF-ON式切换。该结果超越了所有已知的可切换双折射材料，证明动态HOF可作为高性能光学器件开发的新型平台。研究意义在于为动态光学材料提供了一种基于超分子框架结构转变的全新机制，拓展了框架材料在光子学领域的应用潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：利用动态氢键有机框架（HOF）进行客体分子包合实验，通过单晶到单晶转变过程实现结构可逆变化；采用双折射测量表征光学性能，对比客体包合前后的双折射值变化；通过结构分析关联层间π-π堆叠构象与光学性质的关系。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、晶体生长方法、客体分子种类、表征仪器细节及定量测试参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究为动态HOF在光学调控领域的应用提供了直接证据，展示了框架材料结构动态性与宏观光学性能之间的关联，对理解框架材料的结构-性能关系具有参考价值。其OFF-ON双折射切换机制可能为后续设计响应型框架材料提供新思路。但摘要未涉及电化学合成或自组装技术，与主线中框架材料组装方向的直接关联有限，建议作为拓展阅读，若需深入理解机制细节，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于原文摘要内容。双折射值0.73、单晶到单晶转变、π-π堆叠构象变化等结论均来自摘要明确报告，但具体实验条件（如客体分子种类、温度、溶剂体系）、定量表征方法（如双折射测量波长与设备）、可逆循环次数及稳定性数据等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 动态HOF在客体分子包合过程中发生可逆的单晶到单晶转变，驱动双折射从可忽略值切换至0.73，实现OFF-ON式响应
层间π-π堆叠的平面构象变化是双折射显著改变的结构机制
该材料的双折射值0.73超越所有已知可切换双折射材料

papers.title: Synthesis of mesoporous salen polymer nanospheres for highly efficient photocatalytic extraction of uranium from seawater
papers.abstract: Abstract Efficient uranium extraction from seawater is essential to the long-term sustainability of nuclear energy, yet the rational design of high-performance materials for this purpose remains a formidable challenge. Herein, we develop an ionization regulated self-assembly strategy to synthesize mesoporous Salen polymer nanospheres (mDSR) for photocatalytic uranium extraction. Partial ionization improves the aqueous solubility of otherwise insoluble Salen ligands and enhances their reactivity towards formaldehyde, while preserving sufficient precursor-micelle interactions for co-assembly, thereby directing the formation of ordered mesostructures. This strategy is facile, universal, and it can accommodate a series of structurally distinct Salen ligands, enabling the modular construction of mesoporous polymers with programmable molecular functions. The mDSR nanospheres feature a large pore size (6.2 nm), a high surface area (68 m2 g−1), and intrinsic photocatalytic activity. As a result, under simulated sunlight and without sacrificial agents, mDSR achieves a high uranium uptake capacity of 867 mg U g−1 from a 10 ppm U(VI) solution, outperforming most adsorbents. This protocol establishes a new paradigm for functional mesoporous polymers.

papers.title_zh: 介孔萨伦聚合物纳米球的可控合成及其用于海水中铀的高效光催化提取
papers.summary_zh: 本文报道了一种电离调控自组装策略，用于合成具有有序介孔结构的萨伦聚合物纳米球（mDSR）。该材料兼具大孔径、高比表面积和本征光催化活性，在模拟太阳光且无牺牲剂条件下，对10 ppm铀溶液展现出高达867 mg U/g的吸附容量，为功能介孔聚合物的设计提供了新范式。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对海水中高效提取铀这一核能可持续发展关键需求，聚焦于高性能吸附/光催化材料的设计难题。作者提出电离调控的自组装策略：对原本不溶的萨伦配体进行部分电离，以提高其水溶性并增强与甲醛的反应活性，同时保留足够的前驱体-胶束相互作用以驱动共组装，从而导向有序介观结构的形成。该策略简便且具有普适性，可适配多种结构不同的萨伦配体，实现分子功能可编程的介孔聚合物模块化构建。所得mDSR纳米球具有6.2 nm的大孔径和68 m2/g的比表面积，并具备本征光催化活性。在模拟太阳光且无牺牲剂条件下，mDSR对10 ppm U(VI)溶液的铀摄取容量达867 mg U/g，性能优于多数吸附剂。该工作为功能介孔聚合物的合成建立了新范式，并展示了其在海水提铀领域的应用潜力。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及采用电离调控自组装策略合成介孔萨伦聚合物纳米球，涉及配体部分电离、与甲醛反应及前驱体-胶束共组装过程。表征方面报告了孔径（6.2 nm）和比表面积（68 m2/g）的测定。性能测试在模拟太阳光且无牺牲剂条件下进行，通过铀摄取容量评估光催化提取性能。摘要未报告更具体的合成参数、表征仪器或测试细节。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料及自组装技术主线高度契合，展示了电离调控自组装在构建功能介孔聚合物中的潜力，并为海水提铀提供了新材料方案。其策略的普适性和模块化特点对框架材料的功能化设计具有参考价值。建议精读以获取合成细节和机理验证，但需注意其铀吸附性能测试条件与真实海水环境的差异。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于摘要报告的信息。关于电离调控的具体程度、胶束类型与结构、光催化机理细节、铀吸附的动力学与选择性、以及真实海水测试表现等关键细节，摘要未报告，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: mDSR纳米球具有6.2 nm的大孔径和68 m2/g的比表面积，并具备本征光催化活性

papers.title: Metal‐Organic Framework‐Templated Deconstruction‐Reconstruction Enables One‐Dimensional to Two‐Dimensional Self‐Assembly of Transition Metal Phosphates for High‐Performance Ammonia Sensing
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Self‐assembled nanomaterials formed through the spontaneous organisation of nanoscale building blocks are attractive because of their high surface areas, strong interparticle connectivity, and ease of processing. However, programming the assembly of one‐dimensional (1D) transition‐metal nanostructures into two‐dimensional (2D) architectures remains challenging because of dimensional mismatch and kinetic or thermodynamic barriers. Here, we report a general metal‐organic framework (MOF)‐templating strategy that enables the 1D‐to‐2D self‐assembly of nickel phosphate into nanofibre‐assembled quasi‐nanosheets (QNSs). The conversion proceeds through an acid‐driven deconstruction‐reconstruction (ADR) mechanism, in which Ni‐MOFs act as dissolution‐programmable metal reservoirs that regulate local Ni 2+ release and phosphate nucleation. This process first generates nickel phosphate nanofibres and subsequently drives their secondary assembly into QNSs. By changing the parent Ni‐MOF, the porosity and specific surface area of the resulting nanofibre‐assembled nickel phosphate QNSs can be readily tuned, and the strategy can be extended to bimetallic phosphate analogues. As a proof‐of‐concept sensing platform, the Ni‐BPDC‐derived nickel phosphate QNSs exhibit a high response to ammonia (NH 3 ), with a frequency shift of 897.9 ± 24.8 Hz µg −1 at 69.5 ppm, a limit of detection (LoD) of 480 ppb, and excellent long‐term stability, retaining 97% of the initial response after 6 months.

papers.title_zh: 金属有机框架模板化解构-重构实现过渡金属磷酸盐从一维到二维的自组装及其高性能氨气传感应用
papers.summary_zh: 本文报道了一种基于MOF模板的酸驱动解构-重构（ADR）策略，实现镍磷酸盐从一维纳米纤维到二维准纳米片（QNSs）的自组装。所得Ni-BPDC衍生QNSs对氨气表现出高响应（897.9 Hz/μg@69.5 ppm）、低检测限（480 ppb）及优异长期稳定性，为MOF模板化组装提供了新思路。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对一维过渡金属纳米结构自组装为二维架构所面临的维度失配及动力学/热力学障碍，旨在开发普适性组装策略。作者提出MOF模板化策略，通过酸驱动的解构-重构（ADR）机制实现镍磷酸盐从一维到二维的自组装：Ni-MOF作为溶解过程可编程的金属储库，调控局部Ni2+释放和磷酸盐成核，先生成镍磷酸盐纳米纤维，再驱动其二次组装为准纳米片（QNSs）。通过更换母体Ni-MOF，可方便地调控所得QNSs的孔隙率和比表面积，且策略可拓展至双金属磷酸盐类似物。作为概念验证的传感平台，Ni-BPDC衍生的镍磷酸盐QNSs对氨气表现出高响应，频率位移达897.9 ± 24.8 Hz/μg（69.5 ppm），检测限为480 ppb，并在6个月后保持97%的初始响应，展示出优异的长期稳定性。该工作为MOF模板化组装及高性能气体传感材料设计提供了新途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及采用MOF模板化策略，通过酸驱动的解构-重构（ADR）机制合成镍磷酸盐准纳米片，涉及Ni-MOF作为金属储库调控Ni2+释放和磷酸盐成核，以及纳米纤维的二次组装过程。表征方面报告了孔隙率和比表面积的调控。性能测试采用氨气传感平台，报告了频率响应、检测限和长期稳定性数据。摘要未报告具体的酸处理条件、MOF合成细节或传感测试装置。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与框架材料及自组装技术主线高度相关，展示了MOF作为模板和金属源在调控无机纳米材料维度转换中的独特价值。ADR策略为克服一维到二维组装的维度失配问题提供了新思路，对框架材料衍生物的设计具有借鉴意义。建议精读以获取ADR机理的详细证据和传感性能的边界条件。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于摘要报告的信息。关于ADR过程中酸的类型与浓度、Ni2+释放动力学、QNSs的形貌细节、氨气传感的选择性及湿度影响等关键细节，摘要未报告，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Ni-BPDC衍生的镍磷酸盐QNSs对氨气响应达897.9 ± 24.8 Hz/μg（69.5 ppm），检测限为480 ppb
该QNSs传感器在6个月后仍保持97%的初始响应，表现出优异的长期稳定性

papers.title: Multifunctional Mesoporous Calcium-Aluminosilicate Nanoparticles Enable Heterogeneous Activation of Endogenous Transforming Growth Factor β1 and Rapid Hemostasis for Bone Repair
papers.abstract: Abstract The development of multifunctional biomaterials capable of simultaneously activating endogenous growth factors, promoting rapid hemostasis, and enhancing bone regeneration remains a significant challenge in regenerative medicine. Here, we report a rationally designed calcium-aluminosilicate dendritic mesoporous silica nanoparticle (CaAl-DMSN) that integrates heterogeneous catalytic growth factor activation with pro-coagulant and osteogenic functionalities in a single nanoscale platform. Featuring a four-coordinate aluminosilicate framework functionalized with calcium in a radial large-pore architecture, CaAl-DMSN generates a nanoconfined alkaline microenvironment via Ca2+ mediated hydroxide enrichment. This enables more than an order-of-magnitude higher activation efficiency of latent Transforming Growth Factor β1 (TGF-β1) compared to conventional homogeneous alkaline catalysis. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal a markedly reduced free-energy barrier for TGF-β1 dissociation, establishing a direct structure–function relationship between composition, nanostructure, and catalytic activity. Functionally, CaAl-DMSN induces rapid clot formation, enhances CD105+ CD73+ mesenchymal stromal cell recruitment, and promotes osteogenic differentiation via Smad signaling activation. In a rat critical-size calvarial defect model, CaAl-DMSN increases bone volume fraction by ∼80% compared with controls, while exhibiting excellent biocompatibility. Collectively, CaAl-DMSN couples interfacial chemistry, endogenous growth factor activation, hemostasis, and regenerative microenvironment modulation, offering a growth factor-free strategy for bone repair and broader tissue regeneration applications.

papers.title_zh: 多功能介孔钙铝硅酸盐纳米颗粒实现内源性转化生长因子β1的异相激活与快速止血以促进骨修复
papers.summary_zh: 本文报道了钙铝硅酸盐树枝状介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒（CaAl-DMSN），其通过四配位铝硅酸盐骨架和钙功能化产生纳米限域碱性微环境，实现潜伏TGF-β1的高效异相催化激活（效率提升一个数量级以上），同时具备促凝血和促成骨功能，在大鼠颅骨缺损模型中骨体积分数提升约80%。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究针对再生医学中同时激活内源性生长因子、促进快速止血和增强骨再生的多功能生物材料开发难题。作者设计了钙铝硅酸盐树枝状介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒（CaAl-DMSN），其具有四配位铝硅酸盐骨架和径向大孔结构，并通过钙功能化产生Ca2+介导的氢氧根富集，形成纳米限域碱性微环境。该设计使潜伏TGF-β1的激活效率比传统均相碱性催化提高一个数量级以上。分子动力学模拟揭示了TGF-β1解离自由能垒的显著降低，建立了组成、纳米结构与催化活性之间的直接构效关系。功能上，CaAl-DMSN可诱导快速血凝块形成，增强CD105+ CD73+间充质基质细胞募集，并通过Smad信号激活促进成骨分化。在大鼠临界尺寸颅骨缺损模型中，CaAl-DMSN使骨体积分数较对照组增加约80%，且表现出良好的生物相容性。该工作将界面化学、内源性生长因子激活、止血和再生微环境调控耦合于单一纳米平台，为无生长因子的骨修复策略提供了新方案。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及合成了钙铝硅酸盐树枝状介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒（CaAl-DMSN），具有四配位铝硅酸盐骨架和径向大孔结构。采用分子动力学模拟研究TGF-β1解离机制。功能评价包括凝血实验、细胞实验（CD105+ CD73+细胞募集和成骨分化）以及大鼠临界尺寸颅骨缺损模型的体内骨修复评价。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、表征手段或模拟参数。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作与介孔材料及框架材料主线相关，展示了介孔硅基材料在生物医学领域的多功能集成潜力。其纳米限域催化激活生长因子的机制对理解介孔结构-功能关系具有参考价值，但研究主题偏向生物医学应用，与导电MOF/COF等电子功能材料主线关联较弱。可根据兴趣选择性阅读。

papers.title: Defect Passivation of Mesoporous Al2O3-Based Buried Interface for Efficient Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells
papers.abstract: Abstract Buried interface engineering between the hole transport layer and perovskite remains a critical challenge for inverted perovskite solar cells (IPSCs). Al2O3-based interface modification provides excellent interfacial stability and ion-blocking capability; however, its insulating nature and chemical inertness limit effective carrier transport modulation and defect regulation at the buried interface. Here, a synergistic interface engineering strategy is developed by incorporating phenethylammonium bromide (PEABr) into an ultrathin Al2O3 matrix to construct a multifunctional composite interlayer at the NiOX/perovskite buried interface. The introduced PEABr chemically reconstructs the buried interface through the formation of an interfacial quasi-2D/3D perovskite heterostructure. Bromide species derived from PEABr interact with undercoordinated Pb2+ sites and compensate iodine-vacancy-related defects, while phenethylammonium (PEA+) cations participate in constructing the quasi-2D interfacial phase, which optimizes energy-level alignment and promotes efficient hole extraction across the NiOX/perovskite heterojunction. Moreover, the PEABr-induced quasi-2D/3D interfacial structure improves carrier selectivity and suppresses interfacial recombination, thereby enhancing carrier collection. Electronic characterizations demonstrate that the composite interlayer reduces the charge-transfer resistance from 462.81 to 279.65 kΩ, increases the built-in potential from 0.617 to 0.703 V, and decreases the ideality factor from 2.44 to 1.63, enabling a champion power conversion efficiency of 21.34% for IPSCs. This work provides a feasible strategy for constructing multifunctional oxide-based buried interfaces through simultaneous defect regulation, energy-level optimization, and efficient carrier extraction.

papers.title_zh: 介孔Al2O3基埋底界面的缺陷钝化用于高效反式钙钛矿太阳能电池
papers.summary_zh: 本研究针对反式钙钛矿太阳能电池中NiOX/钙钛矿埋底界面的关键挑战，提出将苯乙基溴化铵（PEABr）掺入超薄Al2O3基质的协同界面工程策略。PEABr通过形成准二维/三维钙钛矿异质结构化学重构界面，钝化缺陷并优化能级排列，最终实现21.34%的冠军效率，为氧化物基埋底界面设计提供了可行方案。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于反式钙钛矿太阳能电池（IPSCs）中空穴传输层与钙钛矿之间埋底界面的工程调控。传统Al2O3基界面修饰虽提供优异界面稳定性和离子阻挡能力，但其绝缘性和化学惰性限制了载流子传输调控和缺陷调节。材料体系为NiOX/钙钛矿埋底界面处的Al2O3基复合中间层，设计策略是将PEABr掺入超薄Al2O3基质构建多功能复合层。研究过程表明，PEABr通过形成界面准二维/三维钙钛矿异质结构实现化学重构，溴化物与欠配位Pb2+位点相互作用并补偿碘空位相关缺陷，苯乙胺阳离子参与构建准二维界面相，优化能级排列并促进空穴提取。该策略同时实现缺陷调控、能级优化和高效载流子提取，对提升反式钙钛矿器件性能具有重要指导意义。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要报告了以下方法：将PEABr掺入超薄Al2O3基质构建复合中间层，应用于NiOX/钙钛矿埋底界面；通过电子表征测量电荷转移电阻、内建电势和理想因子；采用电流-电压特性测试获得功率转换效率。摘要未报告具体的合成条件、薄膜制备工艺细节、表征仪器型号及测试环境等。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究与介孔材料及氧化物基界面工程主线相关，展示了介孔Al2O3作为基质与有机铵盐协同构建多功能界面的策略，对框架材料在光电器件中的应用具有拓展价值。局限性在于Al2O3并非导电MOF或共轭框架材料，且摘要未提供介孔结构表征数据。建议作为拓展阅读，若关注氧化物介孔界面修饰可精读全文。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于论文摘要内容。具体的实验条件（如PEABr浓度、Al2O3厚度、制备工艺）、介孔结构表征数据（如孔径、比表面积）、准二维相的结构证据及长期稳定性数据等关键细节仍需全文核查。

papers.title: 2D Covalent Organic Frameworks as Robust n‐Type Organic Mixed Ionic‐Electronic Conductors for Electrochemical Transistors
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Organic mixed ionic‐electronic conductors (OMIECs) with exclusive electrochemical modulation and coupling between ions and electrons have exhibited intriguing efficiencies in bioelectronics, logic circuits, and wearable devices. However, OMIECs are typically linear polymers whose excessive structural swelling and morphological disorder during electrochemical doping led to low performance and instability. Here, we report n‐type 2D covalent organic frameworks (2D COFs) as novel OMIECs (BTID‐BFDO COF and BTDD‐BFDO COF). The rigid π‐conjugated scaffold functions as both a charge transport pathway and an ion‐electron coupling plane, whilst the nanochannels serve as directional conduits for rapid ion transport. 2D OMIECs‐based OECTs exhibit favorable threshold voltages (< 0.5 V), I on /I off ratios (10 3 ) and high stability (modulation current retention rate of 91.3% during continuous operation) compared with the linear counterpart (< 10%). More importantly, we elucidate the mechanism underlying in situ ion transport and doping within the rigid porous architectures of 2D OMIECs, establishing a novel design paradigm for robust n‐type organic semiconductors.

papers.title_zh: 二维共价有机框架作为用于电化学晶体管的稳健n型有机混合离子-电子导体
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道了两种n型二维共价有机框架（BTID-BFDO COF和BTDD-BFDO COF）作为新型有机混合离子-电子导体。刚性π共轭骨架同时提供电荷传输路径和离子-电子耦合平面，纳米通道实现快速离子传输。基于该材料的有机电化学晶体管表现出低阈值电压、高开关比和优异稳定性，为稳健n型有机半导体确立了新设计范式。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于传统线性聚合物OMIEC在电化学掺杂过程中因过度结构溶胀和形态无序导致的性能低下与不稳定性。材料体系为两种n型二维COF（BTID-BFDO COF和BTDD-BFDO COF），其设计策略是利用刚性π共轭骨架作为电荷传输路径和离子-电子耦合平面，同时利用纳米通道作为离子快速传输的定向导管。研究过程涉及合成上述COF并组装成OECT器件，系统评估其电化学晶体管性能，并与线性聚合物对应物进行对比。该研究的意义在于阐明刚性多孔架构内原位离子传输和掺杂机制，为设计稳健n型有机半导体提供全新范式，突破线性聚合物在电化学掺杂中的固有局限。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及合成了两种n型二维COF（BTID-BFDO COF和BTDD-BFDO COF），并基于这些材料组装了有机电化学晶体管（OECT）。性能测试包括阈值电压、开关比和调制电流保持率的测量，并与线性聚合物对应物进行对比。机制研究涉及对原位离子传输和掺杂过程的分析。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF在电化学离子-电子耦合器件中的应用，为框架材料在生物电子学和逻辑电路中的功能化提供新思路。其刚性骨架设计策略对解决导电框架材料在电化学掺杂中的稳定性问题具有重要参考价值。摘要提供了明确的性能数据和机制阐述，值得全文精读以获取合成细节和更深入的机制证据。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。具体合成条件、表征手段（如PXRD、氮气吸附等）、器件制备工艺细节、离子传输机制的详细光谱或电化学证据、稳定性测试的具体条件等均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 基于2D COF的OECT器件展现出有利的阈值电压（<0.5 V）和开关比（10³）
连续运行期间调制电流保持率达91.3%，而线性对应物低于10%
刚性π共轭骨架同时充当电荷传输路径和离子-电子耦合平面，纳米通道作为离子快速传输的定向导管
阐明了刚性多孔架构内原位离子传输和掺杂机制

papers.title: Electrocatalytic CO 2 Reduction in Acidic Media via Host‐Guest Synergy Engineered Ionic Liquid@Metal‐Covalent Organic Framework
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Although acidic CO 2 electroreduction to multicarbon products offers superior carbon utilization compared to alkaline/neutral routes, its performance is severely hampered by proton‐enrichment‐induced hydrogen evolution (HER). To address this issue, we propose a host‐guest cooperative catalysis strategy by constructing a structurally well‐defined Ionic Liquid functionalized Metal‐covalent organic framework (IL@MCOF). Within this architecture, the confined ionic liquid creates a localized high‐concentration CO 2 microenvironment and induces interfacial water restructuring, thereby effectively suppressing HER caused by proton enrichment. Meanwhile, non‐covalent interactions between the π‐conjugated framework of MCOF and the IL cations promote directional transport of adsorbed CO 2 toward copper active sites. Mechanistic studies further reveal that the MCOF catalytic sites synergize with the guest IL to lower the formation energy barriers of the key C 2+ intermediates *COCO and *OCCOH. Consequently, IL@MCOF achieves a record 56.5% Faradaic efficiency with −162 mA cm −2 for C 2+ products at −1.8 V versus RHE in acidic media, surpassing all reported MOF‐based acidic catalysts. This work provides a host‐guest molecular engineering approach for highly selective acidic CO 2 electroreduction.

papers.title_zh: 通过主客体协同工程构筑离子液体@金属-共价有机框架用于酸性介质中电催化CO₂还原
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出主客体协同催化策略，构建离子液体功能化金属-共价有机框架用于酸性CO₂电还原。限域离子液体营造局部高浓度CO₂微环境并诱导界面水重构，抑制析氢反应；MCOF与IL阳离子间的非共价相互作用促进CO₂向铜活性位点定向传输。该催化剂在酸性介质中实现创纪录的C₂+产物法拉第效率56.5%和-162 mA cm⁻²电流密度。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题针对酸性CO₂电还原制多碳产物中质子富集诱导析氢反应严重制约性能的挑战。材料体系为离子液体功能化的金属-共价有机框架（IL@MCOF），设计策略为通过主客体协同催化实现高效C₂+产物选择性。研究过程涉及构建结构明确的IL@MCOF，利用限域离子液体营造局部高浓度CO₂微环境并诱导界面水重构以抑制HER，同时通过MCOFπ共轭骨架与IL阳离子间的非共价相互作用促进CO₂向铜活性位点定向传输。机制研究表明MCOF催化位点与客体IL协同降低关键C₂+中间体*COCO和*OCCOH的形成能垒。该工作提供了一种用于高选择性酸性CO₂电还原的主客体分子工程方法。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及构建了结构明确的离子液体功能化金属-共价有机框架（IL@MCOF）。性能测试为酸性介质中的电催化CO₂还原，测定了C₂+产物的法拉第效率和电流密度。机制研究涉及对HER抑制机制、CO₂传输路径以及关键中间体形成能垒的分析。
papers.relevance_zh: 该工作展示了主客体工程在框架材料电催化中的应用潜力，将COF/MOF的限域效应与离子液体功能结合，为酸性条件下高选择性CO₂还原提供新策略。对研究主线中框架材料的功能化组装和电化学应用具有直接参考价值。摘要报告了明确的性能数据和机制认识，值得全文精读以获取详细的合成和表征信息。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。IL@MCOF的具体合成步骤、IL负载量和分布、MCOF结构表征、CO₂还原产物的详细分析、原位机制研究的具体手段（如原位光谱）等均需全文核查。

papers.title: Intrinsic Large‐Unit‐Cell Systems for Advanced Thermoelectrics and Thermal Management
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The urgent demand for efficient thermoelectric conversion and precise heat management technologies drives the search for materials capable of simultaneously optimizing often‐conflicting electronic and thermal transport properties. Intrinsic large‐unit‐cell (LUC) systems, such as high‐entropy alloys, sub‐nanometer clusters, porous frameworks, and amorphous materials, demonstrate hierarchically scaled structural complexity and are classified as “structural complexity‐driven transport‐modulating materials.” Characterized by severe lattice distortions, configurational entropy, nanoconfinement, hierarchical porosity, and inherent disorder, these materials intrinsically restrict phonon transport across multiple scales, enabling ultralow lattice thermal conductivity essential for high thermoelectric performance and thermal insulation. Concurrently, their vast compositional flexibility and complex electronic structures provide unique avenues for enhancing electrical conductivity and Seebeck coefficients via mechanisms like band convergence, resonant levels, and energy filtering. This review critically examines the fundamental mechanisms linking the intricate atomic architectures of LUC systems to their exceptional performance in thermoelectrics and thermal management. Furthermore, it highlights the indispensable role of machine learning in navigating their immense design complexity for accelerated discovery, inverse design, and decoding of intricate structure–property relationships, paving the way for next‐generation thermoelectrics and thermal management.

papers.title_zh: 本征大晶胞体系用于先进热电与热管理
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统评述了本征大晶胞体系（包括高熵合金、亚纳米团簇、多孔框架和非晶材料）在热电转换和热管理中的应用。这些材料通过层级结构复杂性在多尺度上限制声子传输，实现超低晶格热导率，同时其组分灵活性和复杂电子结构为提升电导率和塞贝克系数提供独特途径。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于寻找能同时优化相互冲突的电子和热传输性能的材料，以满足高效热电转换和精确热管理的需求。材料体系涵盖本征大晶胞系统，包括高熵合金、亚纳米团簇、多孔框架和非晶材料，这些材料被归类为“结构复杂性驱动的传输调控材料”。设计策略利用其严重的晶格畸变、构型熵、纳米限域、层级孔隙和固有无序性，在多尺度上限制声子传输，实现超低晶格热导率。综述还探讨了通过能带收敛、共振能级和能量过滤等机制增强电导率和塞贝克系数的途径，并强调了机器学习在加速材料发现、逆向设计和解码复杂结构-性能关系中的关键作用。该综述对理解大晶胞体系中的传输机制和指导下一代热电材料设计具有重要意义。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要未报告具体的实验合成或表征方法。作为综述性文章，其方法主要涉及对现有文献中关于大晶胞体系热电和热管理性能的机制进行批判性评述，并讨论机器学习在该领域中的应用。
papers.relevance_zh: 该综述将多孔框架材料纳入本征大晶胞体系范畴，从结构复杂性角度统一理解声子和电子传输调控，为框架材料在热电领域的应用提供了更广阔的理论视角。对研究主线中多孔和框架材料的功能拓展具有参考价值，但作为综述，其具体实验细节有限，可根据需要选择性精读相关章节。

papers.title: Self‐Assembled Hybrid Cell‐Enzyme Materials for Gas‐Powered Biocatalysis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The integration of biological energy conversion into functional materials represents a key challenge in the development of advanced catalytic systems. Here, we introduce self‐assembled cell‐enzyme hybrid materials that integrate cellular metabolism with programmable enzyme networks for gas‐powered biocatalysis. By harnessing the native formate hydrogenlyase machinery of Escherichia coli , H 2 and CO 2 are converted into formate, which serves as a transient electron carrier for enzymatic NADH regeneration by a highly stable formate dehydrogenase. Integration of a transhydrogenase further provides access to NADPH‐dependent pathways, establishing a modular redox platform that can be coupled to diverse downstream biocatalysts. The catalytic system is translated into ready‐to‐use material formats through cryogenic fabrication of lyophilized carrier‐free hybrid beads and their subsequent encapsulation into alginate composites, enabling simple “count‐and‐add” operation, catalyst recycling, and robust performance under challenging reaction conditions. By exploiting H 2 as the reducing substrate while recycling CO 2 within the formate‐mediated regeneration cycle, the system avoids sacrificial organic reduction equivalents and associated by‐products, resulting in high atom economy. The integration of metabolic energy conversion, programmable self‐assembly, and materials engineering thus provides a general strategy for gas‐powered redox biocatalysis.

papers.title_zh: 自组装杂化细胞-酶材料用于气体驱动的生物催化
papers.summary_zh: 本研究开发了自组装细胞-酶杂化材料，将大肠杆菌的甲酸氢裂解酶机制与甲酸脱氢酶及转氢酶整合，实现H₂和CO₂驱动的模块化氧化还原平台，并通过冷冻干燥和藻酸盐封装制成可回收的即用型催化材料，避免牺牲性有机还原剂，具有高原子经济性。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于将生物能量转换整合到功能材料中，以开发先进催化系统。材料体系基于大肠杆菌天然的甲酸氢裂解酶机制，将H₂和CO₂转化为甲酸，甲酸作为瞬时电子载体，由高稳定性甲酸脱氢酶催化NADH再生；进一步整合转氢酶可提供NADPH依赖途径，形成模块化氧化还原平台，可偶联多种下游生物催化剂。设计策略强调可编程自组装与代谢能量转换的集成。研究过程包括利用冷冻干燥技术制备无载体杂化珠粒，随后封装入藻酸盐复合材料，实现简单的“计数-添加”操作、催化剂回收及在挑战性反应条件下的稳健性能。该系统的意义在于通过利用H₂作为还原底物并在甲酸介导的再生循环中回收CO₂，避免了牺牲性有机还原当量及相关副产物，实现高原子经济性，为气体驱动的氧化还原生物催化提供了通用策略。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的合成与组装方法包括：利用大肠杆菌的甲酸氢裂解酶机制进行生物转化；通过冷冻干燥制备无载体杂化珠粒；将珠粒封装入藻酸盐复合材料。表征与性能测试方法包括：催化活性评估（H₂和CO₂转化、NADH/NADPH再生）、催化剂回收测试及在挑战性反应条件下的性能测试。摘要未报告具体表征仪器或定量性能数值。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于自组装技术与框架材料交叉领域，展示了生物组分（细胞与酶）通过自组装和材料工程集成实现气体驱动催化，对研究主线的价值在于提供了一种非传统框架材料的杂化组装策略，拓展了自组装材料的功能边界。局限性在于其不涉及介孔导电MOF或共轭框架材料，且摘要未报告详细结构表征。鉴于其创新性和通用策略潜力，值得全文精读以获取组装机制和材料工程细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于摘要文本。关键细节如具体自组装条件、冷冻干燥参数、藻酸盐封装比例、催化效率定量数据、材料稳定性数值及结构表征结果均需全文核查，摘要未报告相应数据。

摘要报告整合转氢酶可提供NADPH依赖途径，建立模块化氧化还原平台。
摘要报告通过冷冻干燥和藻酸盐封装实现即用型材料格式，支持催化剂回收和挑战性条件下的稳健性能。
摘要报告系统避免牺牲性有机还原当量及相关副产物，实现高原子经济性。

papers.title: Ultra‐Tough Hybrid Supramolecular Gelatin Hydrogels
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Natural load‐bearing tissues derive mechanical performance from sequential self‐assembly, in which collagen fibrils first compact and are then stabilized by enzymatic covalent crosslinking. Replicating this design in synthetic hydrogels while limiting swelling and preserving toughness and viscoelasticity remains challenging. Here, we report a gelatin‐based hybrid hydrogel in which tannic acid‐mediated coacervation creates a compact acidic microenvironment that triggers in situ covalent crosslinking. Tannic acid induces rapid phase separation, lowers the local pH to ∼2.7, and promotes proton‐catalyzed ring opening of the preloaded bis‐oxazoline crosslinker, resulting in diester‐linked covalent stabilization of the compacted gelatin network. This decouples physical compaction from covalent stabilization and avoids the metastability of supramolecular tannic acid‐gelatin networks. The optimized formulation showed a ∼60‐fold increase in storage modulus (G′ ∼54 kPa) relative to acid‐swollen controls and combined high extensibility (elongation at break ∼900%), tensile strength (∼2.0 MPa), and toughness (5.46 MJ m −3 ). It also retained cyclic dissipation (4.21 MJ m −3 in the first cycle) and long‐term structural stability in water. In vitro, the hydrogels supported adhesion, spreading, and proliferation of human dermal fibroblasts over 3 days. Together, these results show that tannic acid‐mediated compaction coupled with acid‐triggered covalent crosslinking provides an effective route to strong, extensible, and dissipative gelatin hydrogels.

papers.title_zh: 超韧杂化超分子明胶水凝胶
papers.summary_zh: 本研究受天然组织顺序自组装启发，开发了明胶基杂化水凝胶，利用单宁酸介导的凝聚形成酸性微环境（pH约2.7），触发双恶唑啉交联剂的质子催化开环，实现物理压实与共价稳定的解耦，获得超高韧性（5.46 MJ m⁻³）和优异力学性能的水凝胶。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于在合成水凝胶中复制天然承重组织的顺序自组装机制（胶原纤维先压实再酶促共价交联），同时限制溶胀并保持韧性和粘弹性。材料体系为明胶基杂化水凝胶，其中单宁酸介导的凝聚创造紧凑的酸性微环境，触发原位共价交联。设计策略是单宁酸诱导快速相分离，将局部pH降至约2.7，促进预载双恶唑啉交联剂的质子催化开环，形成二酯连接的共价稳定化明胶网络，从而将物理压实与共价稳定解耦，避免超分子单宁酸-明胶网络的亚稳定性。研究过程包括优化配方并评估力学性能、循环耗散、水中的长期结构稳定性及体外细胞相容性。该研究的意义在于提供了一种通过单宁酸介导压实结合酸触发共价交联来制备强韧、可伸展且具耗散性的明胶水凝胶的有效途径。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的合成与组装方法包括：单宁酸介导的凝聚（诱导相分离并降低局部pH至约2.7）；预载双恶唑啉交联剂的质子催化开环实现共价交联。表征与性能测试方法包括：储能模量测定（G′）、断裂伸长率测试、拉伸强度测试、韧性计算、循环耗散测试、水中结构稳定性评估，以及人真皮成纤维细胞的体外培养（粘附、铺展、增殖评估）。摘要未报告具体仪器型号或测试标准。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究属于自组装技术领域，展示了超分子凝聚与共价交联的顺序自组装策略，对研究主线的价值在于提供了仿生顺序自组装的设计范式，可启发框架材料或介孔材料的分级组装设计。局限性在于其材料体系为明胶水凝胶，不涉及导电MOF或共轭框架材料，且未报告微观结构表征。鉴于其力学性能突出且机制清晰，值得全文精读以获取凝聚与交联的详细条件。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于摘要文本。关键细节如单宁酸与明胶的具体配比、双恶唑啉交联剂的结构与用量、pH调节机制、力学测试条件、细胞实验的具体方法及长期稳定性数据均需全文核查，摘要未报告相应数据。
key_findings_zh: 摘要报告优化配方相对于酸溶胀对照的储能模量（G′约54 kPa）增加约60倍。
摘要报告水凝胶兼具高伸展性（断裂伸长率约900%）、拉伸强度（约2.0 MPa）和韧性（5.46 MJ m⁻³）。
摘要报告水凝胶保留循环耗散（第一循环4.21 MJ m⁻³）和在水中的长期结构稳定性。
摘要报告体外实验中水凝胶支持人真皮成纤维细胞在3天内的粘附、铺展和增殖。

papers.title: Hybrid Single‐Crystalline Mesoporous Frameworks Merging Metal–Organic and Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Networks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Mesoporous materials represent an important class of porous materials; however, it remains a great challenge to systematically synthesize hybrid single‐crystalline mesoporous frameworks merging metal–organic and hydrogen‐bonded organic networks. Herein, we report a hybrid merged‐net strategy that integrates a supramolecular hydrogen‐bonded organic network with a single‐crystalline mesoporous metal–organic framework (MOF), significantly enhancing structural robustness without sacrificing intrinsic mesoporosity. The assembly of pyridine‐containing carboxylate linkers and iron‐containing trinuclear clusters affords M‐PPB featuring the (6,6)‐connected 6 2 T44 net, in which directional O─H⋯N hydrogen bonds between adjacent linkers form a one‐dimensional hydrogen‐bonded network. In contrast to the unstable parent (4,6)‐connected stp ‐MOF, M‐PPB—merging metal–organic and hydrogen‐bonded organic networks—exhibits enhanced robustness and achieves full porosity, displaying a pore volume of 1.58 cm 3 g − 1 . We further apply an isoreticular expansion strategy to synthesize extended MOFs—M‐PPPB—containing mesopores of about 4.2 nm and exhibiting a pore volume of up to 2.77 cm 3 g − 1 . On account of its ultrahigh porosity, M‐PPPB exhibits a methane uptake of 1.047 g g − 1 at 159 K and 10 bar, nearly twice that of M‐PPB, while its hydrogen uptake at 77 K and 100 bar increases by about 50%.

papers.title_zh: 融合金属-有机与氢键有机网络的杂化单晶介孔框架
papers.summary_zh: 本研究提出一种杂化合并网络策略，将超分子氢键有机网络整合进单晶介孔金属-有机框架中，在不牺牲固有介孔性的前提下显著增强结构稳健性。所得M-PPB和扩展的M-PPPB展现出高孔隙率，其中M-PPPB的甲烷和氢气吸附性能显著提升。
papers.research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于如何系统合成融合金属-有机与氢键有机网络的杂化单晶介孔框架，以克服传统介孔材料结构不稳定的挑战。材料体系基于含吡啶的羧酸连接体和含铁三核簇，通过自组装形成M-PPB，其具有(6,6)-连接的6²T44拓扑网络，相邻连接体间的定向O─H⋯N氢键构成一维氢键网络。设计策略为杂化合并网络，即整合超分子氢键有机网络与单晶介孔MOF。与不稳定的母体(4,6)-连接stp-MOF相比，M-PPB展现出增强的稳健性和完全孔隙率，孔体积为1.58 cm³ g⁻¹。进一步采用等网状扩展策略合成M-PPPB，其介孔约4.2 nm，孔体积高达2.77 cm³ g⁻¹。该研究的意义在于提供了一种通用策略，用于构建兼具结构稳定性和高孔隙率的新型杂化框架材料。
papers.methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的合成方法包括杂化合并网络策略和等网状扩展策略，涉及含吡啶羧酸连接体与含铁三核簇的自组装。表征方面提及了网络拓扑分析（6²T44）和孔体积测定。性能测试包括甲烷吸附（159 K, 10 bar）和氢吸附（77 K, 100 bar）测试。摘要未报告其他具体合成条件、表征技术细节或测试方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究直接契合介孔导电MOF和框架材料组装的研究主线，提出了一种融合氢键有机网络与MOF的新策略，显著提升结构稳健性并保持高孔隙率，为设计新型杂化框架材料提供了重要思路。其等网状扩展和气体吸附性能数据具有参考价值，值得全文精读以获取详细的合成与表征细节。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅基于摘要提供的信息。关于合成条件（如溶剂、温度、时间）、详细表征手段（如PXRD、N₂吸附等温线）、氢键网络的具体结构证据、以及气体吸附测试的详细条件（如样品预处理）等关键细节，摘要未报告，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: M-PPB具有(6,6)-连接的6²T44网络，相邻连接体间通过定向O─H⋯N氢键形成一维氢键网络，实现金属-有机与氢键有机网络的融合。
与不稳定的母体(4,6)-连接stp-MOF相比，M-PPB展现出增强的稳健性和完全孔隙率，孔体积为1.58 cm³ g⁻¹。
等网状扩展的M-PPPB含有约4.2 nm的介孔，孔体积高达2.77 cm³ g⁻¹。
M-PPPB在159 K和10 bar下甲烷吸附量为1.047 g g⁻¹，约为M-PPB的两倍；在77 K和100 bar下氢吸附量增加约50%。
